habitat.t: n. (动植物的) 栖息地、生境

e.en: Pollution is destroying the panda's natural {habitat}.
e.zh: 污染正在破坏大熊猫的自然栖息地。

e.en: This wetland is a critical {habitat} for migrating birds.
e.zh: 这片湿地是候鸟重要的栖息地。

e.en: The cave shows signs of human {habitation} from 10,000 years ago.
e.zh: 这个洞穴显示出一万年前人类居住过的痕迹。

e.en: The cabin was unfit for {habitation} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨之后，这间小屋已无法居住。

habitations.t: n. 住所、居所 (habitation 复数)

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered ancient {habitations} beneath the modern city.
e.zh: 考古学家在现代城市之下挖出了古代居住遗址。

e.en: Permanent {habitations} are forbidden inside the national park.
e.zh: 国家公园内禁止建造永久性居所。

e.en: Coral reefs are among Earth's most diverse {habitats}.
e.zh: 珊瑚礁是地球上生物最多样的栖息地之一。

e.en: Climate change is shrinking many polar {habitats}.
e.zh: 气候变化正在让许多极地栖息地不断缩小。

habits.t: n. 习惯、习性 (habit 复数)

e.en: Healthy eating {habits} take time to develop.
e.zh: 健康的饮食习惯需要时间慢慢养成。

e.en: The app tracks your sleep {habits} every night.
e.zh: 这款应用每天晚上追踪你的睡眠习惯。

e.en: He's a {habitual} latecomer to morning meetings.
e.zh: 早上开会他是个惯常迟到的人。

e.en: The doctor warned her about {habitual} painkiller use.
e.zh: 医生提醒她注意止痛药的长期习惯性使用。

e.en: She {habitually} checks her phone first thing each morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上一起来就习惯性地查看手机。

e.en: He {habitually} arrives ten minutes early to every meeting.
e.zh: 他每次开会都习惯性地提前十分钟到。

e.en: It takes a few weeks to {habituate} yourself to night shifts.
e.zh: 要适应上夜班通常需要几周时间。

e.en: Trainers slowly {habituate} young horses to loud noises.
e.zh: 驯马师会让小马慢慢习惯嘈杂的声音。

habituated.t:
adj. 已习惯的
v. habituate 的过去式

e.en: The bears have become {habituated} to human campers.
e.zh: 那些熊已经习惯了露营的人类。

e.en: She quickly {habituated} herself to the new time zone.
e.zh: 她很快就适应了新的时区。

e.en: Repeated exposure leads to {habituation} and weaker reactions.
e.zh: 反复接触会导致习惯化，反应也随之减弱。

e.en: {Habituation} to caffeine reduces its energizing effect over time.
e.zh: 对咖啡因产生习惯后，提神效果会逐渐变弱。

e.en: He's a {habitue} of that little jazz club downtown.
e.zh: 他是市中心那家小爵士俱乐部的常客。

e.en: Every {habitue} of the cafe knew her by name.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆的每位常客都知道她的名字。

habitus.t: n. 习性；体型 (医学/社会学术语)

e.en: Bourdieu used {habitus} to explain ingrained social behaviors.
e.zh: 布迪厄用 惯习 来解释根深蒂固的社会行为。

e.en: The patient's overall {habitus} suggested chronic malnutrition.
e.zh: 病人的整体体态显示出长期营养不良。

habsburg.t: n. 哈布斯堡 (欧洲王室家族)

e.en: The {Habsburg} dynasty ruled much of Europe for centuries.
e.zh: 哈布斯堡王朝统治了欧洲大部分地区数百年。

e.en: Vienna was the heart of the {Habsburg} empire.
e.zh: 维也纳是哈布斯堡帝国的中心。

e.en: The {hacendado} owned vast cattle ranches in Mexico.
e.zh: 这位庄园主在墨西哥拥有广阔的牧场。

e.en: Workers gathered outside the {hacendado}'s grand house.
e.zh: 工人们聚集在那位庄园主气派的宅院外。

hachette.t: n. 阿歇特 (法国出版集团)

e.en: The novel was published by {Hachette} last spring.
e.zh: 这部小说去年春天由阿歇特出版社出版。

e.en: {Hachette} is one of the world's largest publishing groups.
e.zh: 阿歇特是全球最大的出版集团之一。

hacienda.t: n. (西语国家) 大庄园、种植园

e.en: We stayed at a restored colonial {hacienda} near Oaxaca.
e.zh: 我们住在瓦哈卡附近一座修复过的殖民时期庄园。

e.en: The old {hacienda} now operates as a boutique hotel.
e.zh: 这座古老的庄园如今改作精品酒店经营。

hack.t:
v. 黑客入侵；砍、劈
n. 窍门、妙招

e.en: Someone tried to {hack} into my email account.
e.zh: 有人试图入侵我的邮箱账户。

e.en: This kitchen {hack} saves hours of prep time.
e.zh: 这个厨房小窍门能省下好几个小时的备菜时间。

hackberry.t: n. 朴树 (一种落叶乔木)

e.en: A tall {hackberry} shaded the back of the yard.
e.zh: 一棵高大的朴树为后院投下一片阴凉。

e.en: Birds love the small purple fruit of the {hackberry}.
e.zh: 鸟儿喜欢吃朴树结的紫色小果实。

hacked.t:
adj. 被黑客入侵的
v. hack 的过去式

e.en: My account got {hacked} last night through a phishing email.
e.zh: 昨晚我的账号被一封钓鱼邮件入侵了。

e.en: She {hacked} together a prototype over the weekend.
e.zh: 她在周末赶工拼出了一个原型。

e.en: A {hacker} exposed the company's leaked customer data.
e.zh: 一名黑客曝光了该公司泄露的客户数据。

e.en: She's a talented {hacker} who finds bugs for bounties.
e.zh: 她是位才华出众的黑客，靠找漏洞赚赏金。

hacking.t: n. 黑客攻击、入侵行为

e.en: He's been {hacking} on a side project all week.
e.zh: 他整周都在捣鼓一个业余项目。

e.en: The {hacking} attempt was blocked by our firewall.
e.zh: 那次入侵尝试被我们的防火墙拦下了。

e.en: The dog raised every {hackle} along its back.
e.zh: 那只狗背上的每根颈毛都竖了起来。

e.en: The fly fisher tied a bright red {hackle} on the lure.
e.zh: 飞蝇钓手在饵上系了一根鲜红的羽饰。

hackney.t: n. 出租马车；哈克尼 (伦敦地名)

e.en: A black {hackney} carriage waited outside the hotel.
e.zh: 一辆黑色出租马车停在酒店门外等候。

e.en: London's {hackney} cabs are famous around the world.
e.zh: 伦敦的出租车在全世界都很有名。

hackneyed.t: adj. 陈词滥调的、老套的

e.en: The film relies on {hackneyed} romantic clichés.
e.zh: 这部电影充满了陈词滥调式的爱情桥段。

e.en: Avoid {hackneyed} phrases like "at the end of the day".
e.zh: 少用 归根结底 这种老掉牙的套话。

hacks.t:
n. 小窍门、生活妙招
v. hack 的第三人称

e.en: This blog shares clever travel {hacks} for budget trips.
e.zh: 这个博客分享适合穷游的实用旅行小窍门。

e.en: Recent {hacks} exposed millions of users' passwords.
e.zh: 近期的几起黑客攻击使数百万用户的密码外泄。

e.en: He cut through the rusted bolt with a {hacksaw}.
e.zh: 他用钢锯把那颗生锈的螺栓锯断了。

e.en: A sharp {hacksaw} blade makes metal cutting much easier.
e.zh: 锋利的钢锯片能让切割金属轻松很多。

had.t: v. have 的过去式/过去分词

e.en: We {had} pizza for dinner last night.
e.zh: 我们昨晚晚饭吃的是披萨。

e.en: She {had} never visited Japan before that trip.
e.zh: 在那次旅行之前，她从没去过日本。

haddington.t: n. 哈丁顿 (苏格兰地名)

e.en: {Haddington} is a charming market town east of Edinburgh.
e.zh: 哈丁顿是爱丁堡东边一座迷人的集市小镇。

e.en: We drove through {Haddington} on our way to the coast.
e.zh: 我们去海边的路上经过了哈丁顿。

haddock.t: n. 黑线鳕 (一种食用鱼)

e.en: I ordered grilled {haddock} with chips and peas.
e.zh: 我点了烤黑线鳕配薯条和豌豆。

e.en: Smoked {haddock} is a classic Scottish breakfast dish.
e.zh: 烟熏黑线鳕是经典的苏格兰早餐菜肴。

hades.t: n. 冥府；哈迪斯 (希腊神话冥王)

e.en: In Greek myth, {Hades} ruled the underworld.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中，哈迪斯统治着冥界。

e.en: The video game {Hades} won several major awards.
e.zh: 电子游戏《哈迪斯》赢得了多项重要奖项。

e.en: Emperor {Hadrian} built a wall across northern Britain.
e.zh: 哈德良皇帝在不列颠北部修筑了一道长墙。

e.en: Tourists flock to {Hadrian}'s villa near Tivoli each summer.
e.zh: 每年夏天游客都涌向蒂沃利附近的哈德良别墅。

e.en: The Large {Hadron} Collider smashes protons at near-light speeds.
e.zh: 大型强子对撞机以接近光速的速度撞击质子。

e.en: A proton is the most familiar example of a {hadron}.
e.zh: 质子是最为人熟知的强子例子。

e.en: Physicists study {hadronic} interactions inside atomic nuclei.
e.zh: 物理学家研究原子核内部的强子相互作用。

e.en: The detector measures {hadronic} showers from high-energy collisions.
e.zh: 该探测器测量高能碰撞产生的强子簇射。

e.en: The {hadrosaur} fossil included an almost complete skull.
e.zh: 这具鸭嘴龙化石包含一个近乎完整的头骨。

e.en: Each {hadrosaur} had hundreds of teeth for grinding plants.
e.zh: 每一只鸭嘴龙都有数百颗用来磨碎植物的牙齿。

e.en: The patient was referred for {haematological} testing.
e.zh: 病人被转诊去做血液学检查。

e.en: She specializes in treating {haematological} cancers like leukemia.
e.zh: 她专门治疗白血病等血液系统癌症。

e.en: She works in the {haematology} department of a teaching hospital.
e.zh: 她在一家教学医院的血液科工作。

e.en: His blood test was sent straight to {haematology}.
e.zh: 他的血液样本被直接送往血液科化验。

e.en: The lab uses {haematoxylin} to stain cell nuclei dark blue.
e.zh: 实验室用苏木精把细胞核染成深蓝色。

e.en: Slides treated with {haematoxylin} show tissue structure clearly under the microscope.
e.zh: 用苏木精处理的切片在显微镜下能清楚显示组织结构。

e.en: He goes to the clinic for {haemodialysis} three times a week.
e.zh: 他每周去诊所做三次血液透析。

e.en: Patients with kidney failure often depend on {haemodialysis} to survive.
e.zh: 肾衰竭患者往往依赖血液透析维持生命。

e.en: Iron is essential for the body to produce {haemoglobin}.
e.zh: 铁是人体生成血红蛋白的必需元素。

e.en: Her {haemoglobin} levels were low, so the doctor prescribed supplements.
e.zh: 她的血红蛋白偏低,医生开了补充剂。

e.en: The newborn was diagnosed with a {haemolytic} disease shortly after birth.
e.zh: 新生儿出生后不久就被诊断出溶血性疾病。

e.en: Certain bacteria produce {haemolytic} toxins that destroy red blood cells.
e.zh: 某些细菌会产生破坏红细胞的溶血毒素。

e.en: His son was born with {haemophilia} and bruises easily.
e.zh: 他的儿子患有血友病,很容易瘀青。

e.en: Modern treatments have greatly improved life expectancy for people with {haemophilia}.
e.zh: 现代疗法大大提高了血友病患者的预期寿命。

e.en: As a {haemophiliac}, he must avoid contact sports entirely.
e.zh: 作为血友病患者,他必须完全避免身体接触类运动。

e.en: The clinic specializes in treating young {haemophiliac} patients.
e.zh: 该诊所专门治疗年轻的血友病患者。

e.en: The Shetland word {haa} refers to a laird's house.
e.zh: 设得兰方言中 haa 指的是地主的宅邸。

e.en: She let out a surprised {haa} when she won.
e.zh: 她获胜时惊讶地发出一声 哈 的喊叫。

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring museums in {Haarlem}.
e.zh: 我们整个周末在哈勒姆参观各家博物馆。

e.en: {Haarlem} is just a short train ride from Amsterdam.
e.zh: 从阿姆斯特丹坐火车到哈勒姆只要很短的时间。

e.en: The old {haberdasher} sold buttons, ribbons, and thread.
e.zh: 那位老服饰用品商出售纽扣、丝带和线。

e.en: He visited a London {haberdasher} for a new tie.
e.zh: 他去伦敦一家男装店挑选新领带。

e.en: She runs a small {haberdashery} on the high street.
e.zh: 她在主街上经营一家小型缝纫用品店。

e.en: The {haberdashery} stocked every shade of thread imaginable.
e.zh: 这家针线铺备有你能想到的各种颜色的线。

habit.t:
n. 习惯
n. 僧袍；修道服

e.en: Reading before bed is a great {habit} to build.
e.zh: 睡前阅读是个值得养成的好习惯。

e.en: Smoking is a hard {habit} to break.
e.zh: 抽烟是一种很难戒掉的习惯。

e.en: Scientists study Mars's {habitability} for future human missions.
e.zh: 科学家在研究火星的宜居性以备未来的载人任务。

e.en: The leak ruined the apartment's {habitability} overnight.
e.zh: 这次漏水一夜之间让公寓变得无法居住。

e.en: The planet sits in the star's {habitable} zone.
e.zh: 这颗行星位于其恒星的宜居带中。

e.en: After repairs, the cottage was finally {habitable} again.
e.zh: 修缮之后，这座小屋终于又能住人了。

e.en: Each {habitant} of the village knew the old miller.
e.zh: 村里每一位居民都认识那位老磨坊主。

e.en: The novel describes a French Canadian {habitant} farmer.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了一位法裔加拿大农民。

e.en: The island's {habitants} rely mostly on fishing.
e.zh: 这座岛上的居民主要靠捕鱼为生。

e.en: Quebec's early {habitants} cleared the land along the river.
e.zh: 魁北克最早的定居者沿河开垦了土地。

haemorrhage.t:
n. 大出血
v. 大量流失

e.en: Doctors fought through the night to stop the brain {haemorrhage}.
e.zh: 医生彻夜抢救,设法止住脑出血。

e.en: The startup is trying to stem the {haemorrhage} of senior engineers.
e.zh: 这家创业公司正设法阻止资深工程师的流失。

e.en: Ebola is a deadly {haemorrhagic} fever that spreads through bodily fluids.
e.zh: 埃博拉是一种通过体液传播的致命出血热。

e.en: The patient showed clear signs of a {haemorrhagic} stroke on the scan.
e.zh: 扫描显示患者明显是出血性中风。

haemorrhaging.t:
v. 大出血（现在分词）
v. 大量流失

e.en: Surgeons worked quickly to control the {haemorrhaging} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后,外科医生迅速控制出血。

e.en: The company has been {haemorrhaging} cash since the new product flopped.
e.zh: 自从新产品失败,公司一直在大量烧钱。

e.en: He bought a cream at the pharmacy to treat a painful {haemorrhoid}.
e.zh: 他在药店买了药膏治疗疼痛的痔疮。

e.en: Sitting too long every day can make a {haemorrhoid} worse.
e.zh: 每天久坐会让痔疮加重。

e.en: Modern computer chips often contain a thin layer of {hafnium} oxide.
e.zh: 现代计算机芯片中常含有一层薄薄的氧化铪。

e.en: {Hafnium} is used in control rods inside nuclear reactors.
e.zh: 铪被用于核反应堆内的控制棒。

e.en: He gripped the {haft} of the axe firmly before swinging.
e.zh: 他紧紧握住斧柄,然后挥了下去。

e.en: The knife's wooden {haft} had cracked from years of use.
e.zh: 那把刀的木柄因多年使用已经裂开。

hag.t: n. 丑陋的老太婆；巫婆

e.en: In the fairy tale, an old {hag} lures children into the forest.
e.zh: 童话里,一个老巫婆把孩子们引进森林。

e.en: Don't call her a {hag} just because she lives alone.
e.zh: 不要因为她独居就叫她老巫婆。

e.en: In the Bible, {Hagar} flees into the wilderness with her son.
e.zh: 在《圣经》中,夏甲带着儿子逃进荒野。

e.en: The novel retells the story of {Hagar} from a feminist perspective.
e.zh: 小说从女性主义视角重述了夏甲的故事。

hagen.t: n. 哈根（德国地名/人名）

e.en: We changed trains in {Hagen} on our way to Cologne.
e.zh: 我们去科隆途中在哈根换乘了火车。

e.en: {Hagen} is an industrial city in western Germany.
e.zh: 哈根是德国西部的一座工业城市。

haggard.t: adj. 憔悴的；面容枯槁的

e.en: After three sleepless nights, he looked pale and {haggard}.
e.zh: 三个不眠之夜后,他面色苍白,憔悴不堪。

e.en: Her {haggard} expression told us the interview had gone badly.
e.zh: 她憔悴的神情告诉我们面试很不顺利。

haggis.t: n. 哈吉斯（苏格兰羊杂布丁）

e.en: Tourists are often nervous about trying traditional Scottish {haggis}.
e.zh: 游客们尝试传统苏格兰哈吉斯时常常很紧张。

e.en: On Burns Night, every table has a steaming plate of {haggis}.
e.zh: 彭斯之夜,每张桌上都摆着一盘热气腾腾的哈吉斯。

haggle.t: v. 讨价还价；争论不休

e.en: Tourists love to {haggle} over prices in the night market.
e.zh: 游客们喜欢在夜市上讨价还价。

e.en: Don't be afraid to {haggle} a little when buying a used car.
e.zh: 买二手车时别怕多砍点价。

e.en: She {haggled} with the vendor and got the rug for half price.
e.zh: 她跟摊主一番讨价,最后半价拿下了那块地毯。

e.en: The two sides {haggled} for hours over the contract terms.
e.zh: 双方就合同条款讨价还价了好几个小时。

haggles.t: v. 讨价还价（第三人称单数）

e.en: My grandmother always {haggles} at the farmers' market.
e.zh: 我奶奶在农贸市场总要讨价还价。

e.en: He {haggles} over every invoice the supplier sends.
e.zh: 供应商每寄来一张发票他都要计较一番。

haggling.t:
v. 讨价还价（现在分词）
n. 讨价还价

e.en: After ten minutes of {haggling}, we agreed on a fair price.
e.zh: 讨价还价了十分钟后,我们谈到了一个公平的价格。

e.en: I'm tired of {haggling} with insurance companies over claims.
e.zh: 我厌倦了为理赔跟保险公司扯皮。

hagiographer.t: n. 圣徒传作者；歌功颂德者

e.en: Critics accused the {hagiographer} of ignoring the founder's flaws.
e.zh: 批评者指责这位圣徒传作者忽视了创始人的缺点。

e.en: The medieval {hagiographer} described countless miracles in glowing detail.
e.zh: 那位中世纪的圣徒传作者用华丽笔触描写了无数神迹。

hagiographic.t: adj. 圣徒传式的；歌功颂德的

e.en: The CEO's new biography reads as embarrassingly {hagiographic}.
e.zh: 这位 CEO 的新传记读起来像吹捧文,令人尴尬。

e.en: Reviewers dismissed the documentary as a {hagiographic} portrait of the founder.
e.zh: 评论家把这部纪录片贬为对创始人的歌功颂德。

hagiography.t: n. 圣徒传记；歌功颂德的传记

e.en: The book is less a biography than a {hagiography} of the founder.
e.zh: 这本书与其说是传记,不如说是对创始人的歌功颂德。

e.en: Medieval {hagiography} often blended miracle stories with historical fact.
e.zh: 中世纪的圣徒传记常把神迹故事与史实糅合在一起。

e.en: The international tribunal sits in The {Hague}.
e.zh: 国际法庭设在海牙。

e.en: He was summoned to The {Hague} to testify on war crimes.
e.zh: 他被传唤到海牙就战争罪行作证。

hah.t: int. 哈（表示惊讶或得意）

e.en: "{Hah}, I knew you'd forget the keys again," she teased.
e.zh: "哈,我就知道你又会忘带钥匙,"她打趣道。

e.en: "{Hah}! That's the funniest thing I've heard all week."
e.zh: "哈!这是我这周听过最好笑的事。"

e.en: In Japanese, "{hai}" simply means "yes" or "understood."
e.zh: 在日语中,"hai"就是"是的"或"明白了"的意思。

e.en: She bowed politely and answered "{hai}" to her teacher.
e.zh: 她礼貌地鞠了一躬,对老师回答"hai"。

e.en: {Haifa} is a major port city on Israel's northern coast.
e.zh: 海法是以色列北部沿海的重要港口城市。

e.en: The conference will be held at a university in {Haifa}.
e.zh: 会议将在海法的一所大学举行。

e.en: She wrote a {haiku} about the first snow of winter.
e.zh: 她写了一首关于初冬第一场雪的俳句。

e.en: A traditional {haiku} has just seventeen syllables in three lines.
e.zh: 传统俳句仅有三行共十七个音节。

hail.t:
n. 冰雹
v. 称赞；呼喊（出租车等）

e.en: Critics {hail} the new film as a modern masterpiece.
e.zh: 评论家盛赞这部新电影是当代杰作。

e.en: Sudden {hail} smashed the windshield as we drove home.
e.zh: 我们开车回家时,突如其来的冰雹砸碎了挡风玻璃。

e.en: The vaccine was {hailed} as a breakthrough in cancer treatment.
e.zh: 这种疫苗被誉为癌症治疗的重大突破。

e.en: She {hailed} a taxi outside the hotel and rushed to the airport.
e.zh: 她在酒店外叫了辆出租车,匆匆赶往机场。

e.en: The lifeguard shouted warnings through a battery-powered {hailer}.
e.zh: 救生员用电池供电的扩音器喊话警告。

e.en: Police used a {hailer} to communicate with the crowd outside.
e.zh: 警方用扩音喇叭与外面的人群沟通。

hailing.t: v. 招呼；来自（现在分词）

e.en: Ride-{hailing} apps have completely changed how city dwellers travel.
e.zh: 打车软件彻底改变了城市居民的出行方式。

e.en: She stood at the curb {hailing} a cab in the rain.
e.zh: 她站在路边的雨中招手叫出租车。

hails.t: v. 招呼；来自（第三人称单数）

e.en: Our new manager {hails} from a small town in Ireland.
e.zh: 我们的新经理来自爱尔兰的一个小镇。

e.en: The reviewer {hails} the album as the band's finest work.
e.zh: 评论家盛赞这张专辑是该乐队最杰出的作品。

hailsham.t: n. 海尔舍姆（英国地名）

e.en: {Hailsham} is a quiet market town in East Sussex.
e.zh: 海尔舍姆是东萨塞克斯郡一座宁静的集镇。

e.en: They moved from London to {Hailsham} for a slower pace of life.
e.zh: 他们从伦敦搬到海尔舍姆,过更慢节奏的生活。

e.en: A {hailstone} the size of a golf ball cracked the car window.
e.zh: 一颗高尔夫球大小的冰雹砸裂了车窗。

e.en: Each {hailstone} that hit the roof made a loud bang.
e.zh: 每一颗砸在屋顶上的冰雹都发出巨响。

e.en: A sudden {hailstorm} flattened crops across the entire valley.
e.zh: 一场突如其来的冰雹摧毁了整个山谷的庄稼。

e.en: We took shelter in the café when the {hailstorm} began.
e.zh: 冰雹开始时,我们到咖啡馆里避雨。

e.en: The Central line runs all the way out to {Hainault}.
e.zh: 中央线一直通到海诺特站。

e.en: They bought a small flat near {Hainault} station.
e.zh: 他们在海诺特站附近买了一套小公寓。

e.en: She tied her long {hair} into a loose ponytail.
e.zh: 她把长发松松地扎成了马尾。

e.en: There's a {hair} stuck on the lens — let me wipe it.
e.zh: 镜头上粘了一根头发,我来擦一下。

e.en: The cat coughed up a {hairball} on the new rug.
e.zh: 猫在新地毯上吐出了一个毛球。

e.en: Regular brushing helps prevent your cat from forming a {hairball}.
e.zh: 经常梳毛有助于防止猫咪形成毛球。

hairbreadth.t:
n. 一发之差；毫厘
adj. 间不容发的

e.en: The cyclist missed the truck by a {hairbreadth}.
e.zh: 骑车人与卡车擦身而过,差之毫厘。

e.en: We escaped disaster by a {hairbreadth} when the brakes finally caught.
e.zh: 刹车终于制住时,我们是间不容发地躲过了一场灾难。

e.en: She picked up the {hairbrush} and quickly tidied her hair.
e.zh: 她拿起发刷,很快把头发梳整齐了。

e.en: My toddler keeps hiding the {hairbrush} under the sofa.
e.zh: 我家小孩老把发刷藏到沙发底下。

e.en: The brand launched a new {haircare} line for curly hair.
e.zh: 该品牌推出了一个针对卷发的全新护发系列。

e.en: Good {haircare} starts with using the right shampoo for your scalp.
e.zh: 好的护发从选对适合自己头皮的洗发水开始。

e.en: I'm getting a {haircut} after work today.
e.zh: 我今天下班后要去剪头发。

e.en: That short {haircut} really suits the shape of your face.
e.zh: 那个短发型很衬你的脸型。

e.en: Kids' {haircuts} at this salon cost only ten dollars.
e.zh: 这家店的儿童理发只要十美元。

e.en: He experiments with new {haircuts} every few months.
e.zh: 他每隔几个月就尝试新的发型。

e.en: She showed up at the wedding with a fancy new {hairdo}.
e.zh: 她顶着一头精致的新发型出现在婚礼上。

e.en: That {hairdo} from the eighties is suddenly trendy again.
e.zh: 那种八十年代的发型突然又流行起来了。

e.en: My {hairdresser} suggested a shorter cut for the summer.
e.zh: 我的理发师建议夏天剪短一点。

e.en: She trained as a {hairdresser} before opening her own salon.
e.zh: 她先做了理发师,后来开了自己的发廊。

halley.t: n. 哈雷（姓氏，如哈雷彗星）

e.en: {Halley}'s Comet returns to view roughly every 76 years.
e.zh: 哈雷彗星大约每76年才能再次被观测到。

e.en: Edmond {Halley} accurately predicted the comet's return.
e.zh: 埃德蒙·哈雷准确预测了那颗彗星的回归。

hallmark.t:
n. 标志；典型特征
v. 盖纯度印记

e.en: Attention to detail is the {hallmark} of her writing.
e.zh: 对细节的关注是她写作的标志性特点。

e.en: Check the silver spoon for an authentic {hallmark}.
e.zh: 检查一下这把银勺上是否有正品的纯度标记。

e.en: He shouted a cheerful {hallo} across the garden fence.
e.zh: 他隔着花园栅栏开心地喊了一声你好。

e.en: She answered the phone with a friendly {hallo}.
e.zh: 她用友好的一声你好接起了电话。

halloo.t: int. 吆喝声（唤狗、招呼用）

e.en: The hunter let out a loud {halloo} to call the hounds.
e.zh: 猎人大声呼喊以召唤猎犬。

e.en: A {halloo} echoed through the valley as he searched.
e.zh: 他寻找时,一声呼喊在山谷中回荡。

e.en: Ancient peoples would {hallow} certain groves as sacred.
e.zh: 古代人会将某些树林尊为神圣之地。

e.en: The monks gathered to {hallow} the new chapel.
e.zh: 僧侣们聚集起来为新建的小教堂祝圣。

e.en: Wimbledon's center court is {hallowed} ground for tennis fans.
e.zh: 温布尔登中央球场对网球迷来说是神圣之地。

e.en: They walked quietly through the {hallowed} halls of the cathedral.
e.zh: 他们安静地穿过大教堂庄严的走廊。

e.en: The kids dressed as ghosts for {Halloween} this year.
e.zh: 今年孩子们万圣节装扮成了鬼。

e.en: We carved three pumpkins for {Halloween} last night.
e.zh: 我们昨晚为万圣节雕了三个南瓜。

halls.t: n. 大厅；礼堂（hall 的复数）

e.en: Students chatted loudly in the {halls} between classes.
e.zh: 课间学生们在走廊里大声聊天。

e.en: The museum's marble {halls} echoed with footsteps.
e.zh: 博物馆的大理石大厅里回荡着脚步声。

hallucinate.t: v. 产生幻觉；（AI）胡编乱造

e.en: Patients with high fevers sometimes {hallucinate} vivid images.
e.zh: 高烧的病人有时会产生生动的幻觉。

e.en: Language models can {hallucinate} facts that sound convincing but are wrong.
e.zh: 大语言模型可能会编造听起来可信但实际上错误的事实。

hallucinated.t: v. 出现了幻觉（过去式）

e.en: The chatbot {hallucinated} a court case that never existed.
e.zh: 聊天机器人凭空编造了一个根本不存在的案例。

e.en: After days without sleep, he {hallucinated} voices in the hallway.
e.zh: 几天没睡后，他在走廊里产生了幻听。

e.en: The model's answer was a clear {hallucination} with fake citations.
e.zh: 模型的回答明显是幻觉，引用全是编造的。

e.en: High fever can sometimes cause vivid {hallucination} in children.
e.zh: 高烧有时会让孩子出现生动的幻觉。

hallucinatory.t: adj. 引起幻觉的；幻觉般的

e.en: The film has a dreamy, {hallucinatory} quality throughout.
e.zh: 这部电影自始至终带有梦幻般的迷幻气质。

e.en: Patients reported {hallucinatory} side effects from the new drug.
e.zh: 患者反映这种新药会引起幻觉副作用。

e.en: LSD is a powerful {hallucinogen} that distorts perception.
e.zh: LSD 是一种会扭曲感知的强效致幻剂。

e.en: Some mushrooms contain a natural {hallucinogen} called psilocybin.
e.zh: 某些蘑菇含有一种叫裸盖菇素的天然致幻剂。

e.en: Researchers are studying {hallucinogenic} drugs for treating depression.
e.zh: 研究人员正在研究用致幻药物治疗抑郁症。

e.en: The plant has {hallucinogenic} properties used in ancient rituals.
e.zh: 这种植物具有致幻特性，曾用于古代仪式。

e.en: She bumped into her boss in the office {hallway}.
e.zh: 她在办公室走廊里撞见了上司。

e.en: The {hallway} was lined with old family photographs.
e.zh: 走廊两侧挂满了老家庭照片。

e.en: A faint {halo} appeared around the moon last night.
e.zh: 昨晚月亮周围出现了一圈淡淡的光晕。

e.en: The angel in the painting wore a golden {halo}.
e.zh: 画中的天使头顶有一圈金色的光环。

haloed.t: adj. 带光环的；被光晕环绕的

e.en: The streetlamp {haloed} her hair as she walked home.
e.zh: 路灯在她走回家的路上为她的头发镀上了一圈光。

e.en: Snowflakes {haloed} the lantern in soft white light.
e.zh: 雪花在灯笼周围形成了柔和的白色光晕。

e.en: Replace the old {halogen} bulb with an LED to save energy.
e.zh: 把旧的卤素灯泡换成 LED 灯可以省电。

e.en: Chlorine and iodine are both members of the {halogen} group.
e.zh: 氯和碘都属于卤素族元素。

halon.t: n. 哈龙（灭火用卤代烷）

e.en: The server room uses a {halon} system to suppress fires.
e.zh: 机房使用哈龙气体系统来灭火。

e.en: Many countries banned {halon} because it harms the ozone layer.
e.zh: 许多国家因哈龙破坏臭氧层而禁用它。

haloperidol.t: n. 氟哌啶醇（抗精神病药）

e.en: The doctor prescribed {haloperidol} to manage her psychotic symptoms.
e.zh: 医生开了氟哌啶醇来控制她的精神病症状。

e.en: {Haloperidol} can cause stiffness as a side effect.
e.zh: 氟哌啶醇可能引起肌肉僵硬等副作用。

halt.t:
v. 停止；使停下
n. 停顿

e.en: The police ordered the truck to {halt} at the checkpoint.
e.zh: 警察命令卡车在检查站停下。

e.en: Production came to a sudden {halt} after the power outage.
e.zh: 停电后生产突然中断了。

halted.t: v. 停止了（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: Trading was {halted} after the stock crashed twenty percent.
e.zh: 股票暴跌百分之二十后交易被暂停。

e.en: She {halted} mid-sentence when she saw him enter.
e.zh: 看到他进来时她话说到一半就停了下来。

halter.t: n. 马笼头；露背式上衣

e.en: She wore a stylish black {halter} top to the party.
e.zh: 她穿着一件时髦的黑色露背上衣去派对。

e.en: The trainer slipped a {halter} over the horse's head.
e.zh: 驯马师把笼头套到马头上。

halting.t: adj. 犹豫的；断断续续的

e.en: He spoke English in a slow, {halting} voice.
e.zh: 他用缓慢、结结巴巴的语气说着英语。

e.en: The committee made {halting} progress on the new policy.
e.zh: 委员会在新政策上进展缓慢、断断续续。

haltingly.t: adv. 迟疑地；结结巴巴地

e.en: She {haltingly} explained why she had quit the job.
e.zh: 她吞吞吐吐地解释了自己为什么辞职。

e.en: The toddler walked {haltingly} across the living room.
e.zh: 小孩一步一停地走过客厅。

e.en: We use a {halton} sequence for low-discrepancy sampling in simulations.
e.zh: 我们在模拟中使用 Halton 序列进行低差异采样。

e.en: {Halton} is a borough located near Liverpool, England.
e.zh: 哈尔顿是位于英国利物浦附近的一个自治市。

halts.t:
v. 停止（第三人称单数）
n. 停顿（复数）

e.en: The train {halts} briefly at every small station.
e.zh: 火车在每个小站都会短暂停靠。

e.en: A single bug {halts} the entire deployment pipeline.
e.zh: 一个小 bug 就能让整条部署流水线停下来。

e.en: The new tool can {halve} the time spent on reports.
e.zh: 这个新工具能把写报告的时间减半。

e.en: Please {halve} the lemon before squeezing it.
e.zh: 请先把柠檬切成两半再挤汁。

e.en: The company {halved} its workforce after the merger.
e.zh: 合并之后公司把员工人数砍了一半。

e.en: She {halved} the recipe to feed just two people.
e.zh: 她把食谱的分量减半，只够两个人吃。

halves.t:
n. half 的复数
v. halve 的三单

e.en: Cut the avocado into two equal {halves}.
e.zh: 把牛油果切成大小相等的两半。

e.en: The team played much better in the second of two {halves}.
e.zh: 球队在下半场打得比上半场好多了。

e.en: Bitcoin's next {halving} will reduce mining rewards again.
e.zh: 比特币的下一次减半将再次降低挖矿奖励。

e.en: {Halving} the budget forced us to cancel two projects.
e.zh: 预算砍半迫使我们取消了两个项目。

e.en: The sailor pulled the {halyard} to raise the mainsail.
e.zh: 水手拉动升降索把主帆升起来。

e.en: A frayed {halyard} can snap under heavy wind.
e.zh: 磨损的升降索在大风下可能会断裂。

ham.t:
n. 火腿
v. 过火表演

e.en: I made a {ham} and cheese sandwich for lunch.
e.zh: 我做了个火腿芝士三明治当午餐。

e.en: My uncle is a licensed {ham} radio operator.
e.zh: 我叔叔是一名有执照的业余无线电爱好者。

e.en: The ancient city of {Hama} is famous for its waterwheels.
e.zh: 古城哈马以其水车而闻名。

e.en: My daughter loves making patterns with {Hama} beads.
e.zh: 我女儿喜欢用 Hama 拼豆做图案。

e.en: {Hamburg} is Germany's second-largest city and a major port.
e.zh: 汉堡是德国第二大城市，也是重要港口。

e.en: We took a ferry along the harbor in {Hamburg}.
e.zh: 我们在汉堡乘渡轮沿港口游览。

e.en: I ordered a cheese {hamburger} with extra pickles.
e.zh: 我点了一个加多酸黄瓜的芝士汉堡。

e.en: This restaurant grinds its own beef for every {hamburger}.
e.zh: 这家餐厅每个汉堡都用自家现绞的牛肉。

e.en: Dad grilled {hamburgers} for everyone at the cookout.
e.zh: 爸爸在户外烧烤时给大家烤了汉堡。

e.en: These frozen {hamburgers} are surprisingly tasty.
e.zh: 这些冷冻汉堡肉饼意外地好吃。

hairdressers.t: n. 理发师（复数）；美发店

e.en: There are three {hairdressers} on this street alone.
e.zh: 光这条街上就有三家理发店。

e.en: I'm popping over to the {hairdressers} for a quick trim.
e.zh: 我去趟理发店稍微修一下头发。

e.en: She's studying {hairdressing} at the local vocational college.
e.zh: 她在本地的职业学院学美发。

e.en: After ten years in {hairdressing}, he opened his own salon.
e.zh: 做了十年美发后,他开了自己的发廊。

e.en: I packed a small {hairdryer} for the trip.
e.zh: 我为这次旅行带了一个小吹风机。

e.en: The {hairdryer} in the hotel room barely worked.
e.zh: 酒店房间里的吹风机几乎不能用。

e.en: The hotel room had two {hairdryers} in the bathroom.
e.zh: 酒店房间的浴室里有两个吹风机。

e.en: Modern {hairdryers} use ionic technology to reduce frizz.
e.zh: 现代吹风机采用负离子技术来减少毛躁。

haired.t: adj. 有…头发的（构词，如 long-haired）

e.en: A dark-{haired} woman waved at me from the platform.
e.zh: 一位黑发女子在站台上向我挥手。

e.en: Long-{haired} cats need daily brushing to avoid mats.
e.zh: 长毛猫需要每天梳理以防止打结。

e.en: The {hairiness} of the kiwi skin puts some people off.
e.zh: 猕猴桃皮上的绒毛让一些人不太喜欢。

e.en: He joked about the {hairiness} of his arms in summer.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说自己夏天手臂上的毛真多。

e.en: Sphynx cats are almost completely {hairless}.
e.zh: 斯芬克斯猫几乎完全没有毛。

e.en: The newborn mice were pink and {hairless}.
e.zh: 刚出生的小老鼠粉粉的,没有毛。

e.en: The dog's {hairlessness} was caused by a skin condition.
e.zh: 这只狗的脱毛是由一种皮肤病引起的。

e.en: Some breeds are prized for their {hairlessness}.
e.zh: 有些品种因无毛特征而备受推崇。

hairlike.t: adj. 像头发的；细如发丝的

e.en: Tiny {hairlike} cracks appeared in the old paint.
e.zh: 旧漆面上出现了细如发丝的裂纹。

e.en: The plant has {hairlike} roots that absorb water quickly.
e.zh: 这种植物有像头发一样细的根,能快速吸水。

hairline.t:
n. 发际线
adj. 极细的（如 hairline crack）

e.en: His {hairline} has been receding since his thirties.
e.zh: 他从三十多岁开始发际线就一直在后移。

e.en: The vase had a {hairline} crack along the rim.
e.zh: 花瓶边缘有一道发丝般细的裂纹。

e.en: All kitchen staff must wear a {hairnet} on duty.
e.zh: 所有厨房员工上班时都必须戴发网。

e.en: She tucked her bun under a tight {hairnet}.
e.zh: 她把发髻塞进了一个紧绷的发网里。

e.en: The actor wore a {hairpiece} for the period drama.
e.zh: 那位演员为这部年代剧戴了假发片。

e.en: Her {hairpiece} blended seamlessly with her natural color.
e.zh: 她的假发片和自己的发色融合得天衣无缝。

e.en: She fastened the bun with a silver {hairpin}.
e.zh: 她用一支银色发夹固定住发髻。

e.en: The mountain road has a sharp {hairpin} turn ahead.
e.zh: 前方山路上有一个急转的发夹弯。

e.en: A light mist of {hairspray} keeps the style in place.
e.zh: 轻轻喷一层定型喷雾就能保持发型。

e.en: Don't use too much {hairspray} or your hair gets stiff.
e.zh: 别用太多发胶,不然头发会变得很硬。

e.en: A purple {hairstreak} butterfly landed on the oak leaf.
e.zh: 一只紫线灰蝶落在了橡树叶上。

e.en: Birders also enjoy spotting the rare green {hairstreak}.
e.zh: 观鸟者也喜欢寻找稀有的绿色线灰蝶。

e.en: She changed her {hairstyle} before the job interview.
e.zh: 她在面试前换了个发型。

e.en: That {hairstyle} was really popular in the nineties.
e.zh: 那种发型在九十年代非常流行。

e.en: My {hairstylist} suggested adding some layers this time.
e.zh: 我的发型师建议这次加一些层次感。

e.en: She works as a {hairstylist} at a downtown salon.
e.zh: 她在市中心一家美发沙龙当发型师。

hairy.t:
adj. 多毛的
adj. 棘手的；惊险的

e.en: He has very {hairy} arms and shoulders.
e.zh: 他的手臂和肩膀上毛很多。

e.en: Driving down that icy road was a {hairy} experience.
e.zh: 开车经过那条结冰的路真是惊险。

e.en: {Haiti} shares the island of Hispaniola with the Dominican Republic.
e.zh: 海地与多米尼加共和国共享伊斯帕尼奥拉岛。

e.en: The earthquake in {Haiti} caused widespread devastation in 2010.
e.zh: 2010年海地地震造成了大范围的破坏。

haitian.t:
adj. 海地的
n. 海地人

e.en: She enjoys cooking traditional {Haitian} dishes on weekends.
e.zh: 她喜欢周末做传统的海地菜。

e.en: The {Haitian} community in Miami is large and vibrant.
e.zh: 迈阿密的海地社区规模庞大且充满活力。

hajj.t: n. 朝觐（穆斯林的麦加朝圣）

e.en: Millions of Muslims travel to Mecca for the {hajj} each year.
e.zh: 每年有数百万穆斯林前往麦加进行朝觐。

e.en: Completing the {hajj} is a deeply meaningful spiritual journey.
e.zh: 完成朝觐是一段意义深远的精神之旅。

e.en: We ordered grilled {hake} with lemon and garlic butter.
e.zh: 我们点了配柠檬和蒜香黄油的烤鳕鱼。

e.en: Fresh {hake} is a popular choice in Spanish cuisine.
e.zh: 新鲜的无须鳕在西班牙菜中很受欢迎。

hakim.t: n. 哈基姆（伊斯兰医生或统治者）

e.en: The village {hakim} prepared herbal remedies for the family.
e.zh: 村里的草医为这家人配制了草药。

e.en: Her grandfather was a respected {hakim} in the region.
e.zh: 她的祖父在当地是一位受人尊敬的草医。

halal.t: adj. 清真的（符合伊斯兰教规）

e.en: The restaurant serves only {halal} meat and poultry.
e.zh: 这家餐厅只供应清真的肉类和禽类。

e.en: Look for the {halal} certification label on the package.
e.zh: 请留意包装上的清真认证标识。

e.en: The guard stood at attention holding an ornate {halberd}.
e.zh: 卫兵手持华丽的戟笔直站立。

e.en: A {halberd} combines an axe blade with a long spear.
e.zh: 戟把斧刃和长矛结合在一起。

halcyon.t: adj. 宁静的；太平美好的

e.en: She remembered the {halcyon} days of her college years.
e.zh: 她回忆起大学时代那段宁静美好的日子。

e.en: The painting captured a {halcyon} summer afternoon by the lake.
e.zh: 这幅画捕捉到了湖边一个宁静的夏日午后。

e.en: My grandfather is still {hale} and hearty at ninety.
e.zh: 我祖父九十岁了依然身强体健。

e.en: She looked surprisingly {hale} after her long illness.
e.zh: 久病之后她看起来出奇地健康。

half.t:
n. 一半
adj./adv. 半的；部分地

e.en: Please cut the apple in {half} for the kids.
e.zh: 请把苹果切成两半给孩子们。

e.en: I spent {half} the morning waiting in line at the bank.
e.zh: 我在银行排队等了大半个早上。

e.en: All winter coats are {half-price} this weekend only.
e.zh: 所有冬季外套仅本周末半价出售。

e.en: I grabbed a {half-price} ticket to the matinee show.
e.zh: 我抢到了一张半价的午场演出票。

halfback.t: n. (足球) 中前卫；(橄榄球) 半卫

e.en: The {halfback} sprinted past the defense for a touchdown.
e.zh: 那名半卫冲过防守球员达阵得分。

e.en: He played {halfback} for his college football team.
e.zh: 他在大学橄榄球队担任半卫。

e.en: She made a {halfhearted} attempt to clean her room.
e.zh: 她敷衍地打扫了一下自己的房间。

e.en: His {halfhearted} apology only made things worse.
e.zh: 他那不情不愿的道歉只让事情变得更糟。

e.en: He {halfheartedly} agreed to come to the party.
e.zh: 他勉勉强强地同意来参加派对。

e.en: She nodded {halfheartedly}, clearly thinking about something else.
e.zh: 她心不在焉地点了点头,显然在想别的事。

halfpenny.t: n. 半便士（英国旧硬币）

e.en: My grandmother kept an old {halfpenny} as a lucky charm.
e.zh: 我奶奶把一枚旧半便士当作幸运符珍藏着。

e.en: The shopkeeper gave the boy a {halfpenny} in change.
e.zh: 店主找给男孩半便士的零钱。

halftime.t: n. 中场休息；半场时间

e.en: The band performed during {halftime} at the football game.
e.zh: 乐队在橄榄球比赛中场休息时进行了表演。

e.en: Our team was losing by ten points at {halftime}.
e.zh: 中场休息时我们队落后十分。

e.en: Old newspaper photos use a {halftone} dot pattern.
e.zh: 旧报纸上的照片使用网点印刷的方式呈现。

e.en: The artist printed the image as a coarse {halftone}.
e.zh: 这位艺术家把图像印成了粗网点效果。

halfway.t:
adv. 到一半；中途
adj. 中途的

e.en: We stopped for coffee {halfway} through the road trip.
e.zh: 我们在公路旅行的中途停下来喝了杯咖啡。

e.en: The library is {halfway} between my home and office.
e.zh: 图书馆位于我家和办公室的中间位置。

e.en: Don't be such a {halfwit} — read the instructions first.
e.zh: 别这么糊涂,先把说明书看一遍。

e.en: Only a {halfwit} would leave the front door unlocked overnight.
e.zh: 只有傻瓜才会整晚不锁前门。

e.en: The chef recommended the pan-seared {halibut} with capers.
e.zh: 主厨推荐了配酸豆的香煎大比目鱼。

e.en: Alaskan {halibut} can grow to enormous sizes.
e.zh: 阿拉斯加大比目鱼可以长到巨大的尺寸。

e.en: Silver {halide} crystals form the basis of traditional film photography.
e.zh: 卤化银晶体是传统胶片摄影的基础。

e.en: The lab synthesized a new {halide} compound for the experiment.
e.zh: 实验室为实验合成了一种新的卤化物化合物。

halifax.t: n. 哈利法克斯（城市名）

e.en: We took a ferry from {Halifax} to explore the harbor.
e.zh: 我们从哈利法克斯乘渡轮去游览港口。

e.en: {Halifax} is the largest city in Nova Scotia, Canada.
e.zh: 哈利法克斯是加拿大新斯科舍省最大的城市。

e.en: Regular flossing can help prevent {halitosis}.
e.zh: 经常使用牙线可以帮助预防口臭。

e.en: The dentist diagnosed his bad breath as chronic {halitosis}.
e.zh: 牙医诊断他的口臭为慢性口臭症。

e.en: Please leave your shoes in the {hall} by the door.
e.zh: 请把鞋子放在门边的走廊里。

e.en: The concert {hall} can seat over two thousand people.
e.zh: 这座音乐厅可以容纳两千多人。

halle.t: n. 哈雷（德国城市；人名）

e.en: The university in {Halle} has a long academic history.
e.zh: 哈勒的这所大学有着悠久的学术历史。

e.en: Handel was born in {Halle}, Germany, in 1685.
e.zh: 亨德尔于1685年出生在德国的哈勒。

e.en: The choir sang a thunderous {hallelujah} at the finale.
e.zh: 唱诗班在终曲处唱出震撼人心的哈利路亚。

e.en: {Hallelujah}, the package finally arrived after three weeks!
e.zh: 谢天谢地,包裹三周后终于到了!

hamelin.t: n. 哈梅林（德国城市，花衣魔笛手传说发生地）

e.en: The Pied Piper of {Hamelin} led the children away forever.
e.zh: 花衣魔笛手把哈梅林的孩子们永远带走了。

e.en: {Hamelin} is a small German town famous for its legend.
e.zh: 哈梅林是一个因传说而闻名的德国小镇。

hamilton.t: n. 汉密尔顿（人名/地名）

e.en: We finally got tickets to see {Hamilton} on Broadway.
e.zh: 我们终于买到了百老汇音乐剧《汉密尔顿》的票。

e.en: Alexander {Hamilton} appears on the ten-dollar bill.
e.zh: 亚历山大·汉密尔顿出现在十美元纸币上。

hamiltonian.t:
n. 哈密顿量（物理）
adj. 汉密尔顿的

e.en: The {Hamiltonian} describes the total energy of the system.
e.zh: 哈密顿量描述了系统的总能量。

e.en: Finding a {Hamiltonian} cycle in a graph is NP-complete.
e.zh: 在图中寻找哈密顿回路是 NP 完全问题。

hamlet.t:
n. 小村庄
n. 哈姆雷特（莎剧主角）

e.en: They live in a tiny {hamlet} with only twelve houses.
e.zh: 他们住在一个只有十二户人家的小村庄里。

e.en: Shakespeare's {Hamlet} is performed all over the world.
e.zh: 莎士比亚的《哈姆雷特》在世界各地上演。

hammer.t:
n. 锤子
v. 锤打；反复强调

e.en: Pass me the {hammer} so I can fix this fence.
e.zh: 把锤子递给我，我来修一下这道篱笆。

e.en: Critics continue to {hammer} the company over its safety record.
e.zh: 批评者继续就安全记录猛烈抨击这家公司。

hammered.t:
adj. 锤打过的；被痛击的
adj. (俚) 喝醉的

e.en: He {hammered} the nail into the wall in three quick strikes.
e.zh: 他三下就把钉子敲进了墙里。

e.en: The team got {hammered} four to nothing in the final.
e.zh: 球队在决赛中以四比零惨败。

hammerhead.t:
n. 锤头鲨
n. 锤头

e.en: A {hammerhead} shark glided silently past the divers.
e.zh: 一条双髻鲨悄无声息地从潜水员身边游过。

e.en: The carpenter swung a heavy {hammerhead} onto the workbench.
e.zh: 木匠把沉重的锤头甩到工作台上。

hammering.t:
n. 锤击；痛击
v. 锤打 (进行时)

e.en: The constant {hammering} from upstairs gave me a headache.
e.zh: 楼上不停的敲打声让我头疼。

e.en: Reporters kept {hammering} the senator with tough questions.
e.zh: 记者们不断用尖锐的问题逼问那位参议员。

e.en: The wrestler trapped his opponent in a tight {hammerlock}.
e.zh: 摔跤选手用一个紧锁的反臂锁制住了对手。

e.en: Police applied a {hammerlock} to subdue the suspect quickly.
e.zh: 警察用反臂锁迅速制服了嫌疑人。

e.en: The {hammermill} grinds corn into fine animal feed.
e.zh: 锤式粉碎机把玉米磨成细腻的饲料。

e.en: Farmers rely on a sturdy {hammermill} during harvest season.
e.zh: 农民在收获季节都靠一台结实的锤式粉碎机。

hammers.t:
n. 锤子 (复数)
v. 锤打 (第三人称单数)

e.en: The toolbox contains three {hammers} of different sizes.
e.zh: 工具箱里有三把不同大小的锤子。

e.en: She {hammers} away at the keyboard until midnight.
e.zh: 她在键盘上敲到半夜。

hammersmith.t: n. 哈默史密斯（伦敦地名）

e.en: I take the tube to {Hammersmith} every morning.
e.zh: 我每天早上坐地铁到哈默史密斯。

e.en: The concert hall in {Hammersmith} hosts many famous bands.
e.zh: 哈默史密斯的演出厅经常有著名乐队演出。

e.en: He spent the afternoon napping in a {hammock} between two palms.
e.zh: 他下午躺在两棵棕榈树之间的吊床上小睡。

e.en: We strung a {hammock} across the backyard for summer reading.
e.zh: 我们在后院挂了张吊床，夏天用来看书。

hammond.t: n. 哈蒙德（姓氏/电风琴品牌）

e.en: The jazz trio features a vintage {Hammond} organ.
e.zh: 这个爵士三重奏有一台老式哈蒙德电风琴。

e.en: Richard {Hammond} is best known for hosting Top Gear.
e.zh: 理查德·哈蒙德最为人熟知的是主持《疯狂汽车秀》。

hammy.t: adj. 表演做作的；夸张的

e.en: The actor's {hammy} performance ruined the dramatic scene.
e.zh: 那位演员浮夸做作的表演毁了这场戏。

e.en: He told the joke with a {hammy} grin and exaggerated wink.
e.zh: 他咧着夸张的笑容、挤眉弄眼地讲了那个笑话。

hampden.t: n. 姓氏/地名 汉普登

e.en: Scotland played their World Cup qualifier at {Hampden} Park.
e.zh: 苏格兰在汉普顿公园进行了世界杯预选赛。

e.en: John {Hampden} was a key figure in the English Civil War.
e.zh: 约翰·汉普登是英国内战中的关键人物。

hamper.t:
v. 妨碍，阻碍
n. 大篮子；食品礼篮

e.en: Heavy rain may {hamper} the rescue efforts in the mountains.
e.zh: 大雨可能会妨碍山区的救援工作。

e.en: She tossed her socks into the laundry {hamper}.
e.zh: 她把袜子扔进了脏衣篮里。

hampered.t:
v. 妨碍 (过去式)
adj. 受阻碍的

e.en: The investigation was {hampered} by missing evidence and witnesses.
e.zh: 调查因证据和证人缺失而受阻。

e.en: Snow {hampered} traffic across the entire city this morning.
e.zh: 今早大雪阻碍了全市的交通。

e.en: Bureaucracy is {hampering} innovation at the company.
e.zh: 官僚作风正在阻碍公司的创新。

e.en: Bad weather kept {hampering} our hiking plans all week.
e.zh: 恶劣天气整个星期都在妨碍我们的徒步计划。

hampers.t:
v. 妨碍 (第三人称单数)
n. 大篮子 (复数)

e.en: Slow Wi-Fi {hampers} my ability to work from home.
e.zh: 网速慢影响了我居家办公的效率。

e.en: They sent gift {hampers} full of cheese and wine for Christmas.
e.zh: 他们寄来装满奶酪和红酒的圣诞礼篮。

hampshire.t: n. 汉普郡（英格兰郡名）

e.en: We spent the weekend hiking in the {Hampshire} countryside.
e.zh: 我们周末在汉普郡乡间徒步。

e.en: New {Hampshire} holds the first primary in U.S. presidential elections.
e.zh: 新罕布什尔州举行美国总统选举的首场初选。

hampstead.t: n. 汉普斯特德（伦敦地名）

e.en: Many writers and artists have lived in {Hampstead} over the years.
e.zh: 多年来许多作家和艺术家都住在汉普斯特德。

e.en: We had a picnic on {Hampstead} Heath last Sunday.
e.zh: 上周日我们在汉普斯特德荒野野餐。

e.en: We spent the weekend at a cottage in {Hampton}.
e.zh: 我们在汉普顿的一间小屋度过了周末。

e.en: {Hampton} Court Palace attracts thousands of tourists each year.
e.zh: 汉普顿宫每年吸引成千上万的游客。

hams.t:
n. 火腿 (复数)
n. (俚) 大腿后侧

e.en: The deli sells smoked {hams} during the holiday season.
e.zh: 这家熟食店在节日期间出售烟熏火腿。

e.en: He always {hams} it up in front of the camera.
e.zh: 他在镜头前总是过度卖弄。

e.en: My daughter keeps a fluffy {hamster} in her bedroom.
e.zh: 我女儿在卧室里养了一只毛茸茸的仓鼠。

e.en: The {hamster} runs on its wheel all night long.
e.zh: 那只仓鼠整夜都在轮子上跑。

hamstring.t:
n. 腘绳肌（大腿后腱）
v. 使无力，削弱

e.en: The runner pulled a {hamstring} during yesterday's race.
e.zh: 那名跑者在昨天的比赛中拉伤了腿筋。

e.en: Budget cuts will {hamstring} the entire research program.
e.zh: 预算削减将会严重制约整个研究项目。

hamstrung.t:
adj. 受掣肘的，被削弱的
v. hamstring 的过去式

e.en: The team was {hamstrung} by injuries all season.
e.zh: 球队整个赛季都因伤病而举步维艰。

e.en: New regulations have {hamstrung} small businesses across the country.
e.zh: 新规定让全国各地的小企业都束手束脚。

han.t:
n. 汉族；汉朝
n. 姓氏 韩

e.en: The {Han} dynasty lasted for over four hundred years.
e.zh: 汉朝延续了四百多年。

e.en: {Han} Chinese make up the majority of the population.
e.zh: 汉族人口占总人口的大多数。

hanbury.t: n. 姓氏/地名 汉伯里

e.en: We met for coffee on {Hanbury} Street last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们在汉伯里街喝咖啡见面。

e.en: The {Hanbury} estate has been preserved as a museum.
e.zh: 汉伯里庄园已被保留作为博物馆。

e.en: John {Hancock} signed the Declaration of Independence boldly.
e.zh: 约翰·汉考克在《独立宣言》上签下了大名。

e.en: Just put your John {Hancock} at the bottom.
e.zh: 请在下方签上你的大名。

hand.t:
n. 手；指针
v. 递交，交给

e.en: Please raise your {hand} if you have a question.
e.zh: 如果有问题请举手。

e.en: Can you {hand} me the salt, please?
e.zh: 能把盐递给我吗?

e.en: She filmed the concert with a {hand-held} camera.
e.zh: 她用一台手持摄像机拍摄了那场演唱会。

e.en: The store sells {hand-held} gaming consoles for travel.
e.zh: 这家店出售旅行用的掌上游戏机。

e.en: She pulled her phone out of her leather {handbag}.
e.zh: 她从皮质手提包里拿出了手机。

e.en: That designer {handbag} costs more than my rent.
e.zh: 那只名牌手提包比我的房租还贵。

handbags.t:
n. 手提包 (复数)
n. (俚) 小打小闹的争执

e.en: The boutique displays {handbags} in the front window.
e.zh: 那家精品店把手提包陈列在临街橱窗里。

e.en: She collects vintage {handbags} from the nineteen sixties.
e.zh: 她收藏六十年代的复古手提包。

e.en: The referee called a {handball} penalty in the box.
e.zh: 裁判判罚禁区内手球犯规。

e.en: He plays {handball} every Saturday morning at the gym.
e.zh: 他每周六早上在健身房打手球。

e.en: Two clear {handballs} were missed by the referee today.
e.zh: 今天裁判漏判了两次明显的手球。

e.en: The coach ordered new {handballs} for the school team.
e.zh: 教练为校队订购了新的手球。

e.en: The choir performed a beautiful {handbell} arrangement at Christmas.
e.zh: 唱诗班在圣诞节表演了一段优美的手摇铃合奏。

e.en: She rang a small {handbell} to summon the guests.
e.zh: 她摇响小手铃召唤客人。

e.en: He handed me a {handbill} promoting tonight's concert.
e.zh: 他递给我一张宣传今晚音乐会的传单。

e.en: Volunteers distributed a {handbill} about the new policy.
e.zh: 志愿者们分发了一张关于新政策的传单。

e.en: The employee {handbook} explains all company policies clearly.
e.zh: 员工手册清楚地说明了公司的所有规定。

e.en: Every new hire receives a training {handbook} on day one.
e.zh: 每位新员工在入职第一天都会收到培训手册。

e.en: Always pull the {handbrake} when parking on a hill.
e.zh: 在斜坡上停车时一定要拉手刹。

e.en: He forgot to release the {handbrake} before driving off.
e.zh: 他开车前忘了松开手刹。

e.en: The vendor pushed his {handcart} through the crowded market.
e.zh: 小贩推着手推车穿过拥挤的市场。

e.en: Workers loaded boxes onto a wooden {handcart}.
e.zh: 工人们把箱子装上木制手推车。

e.en: They sealed the deal with a firm {handclasp}.
e.zh: 他们以一次坚定的握手敲定了这笔交易。

e.en: Her warm {handclasp} reassured the nervous patient.
e.zh: 她温暖的握手安抚了紧张的病人。

handcraft.t:
n. 手工艺品
v. 手工制作

e.en: Local artisans {handcraft} every piece of jewelry sold here.
e.zh: 当地工匠手工制作店里出售的每一件首饰。

e.en: They {handcraft} leather wallets in a small workshop.
e.zh: 他们在一个小作坊里手工制作皮夹。

e.en: This {handcrafted} wooden bowl took a week to finish.
e.zh: 这个手工制作的木碗花了一周才完成。

e.en: The shop sells {handcrafted} chocolates from Belgium.
e.zh: 这家店出售来自比利时的手工巧克力。

handcuff.t:
n. 手铐
v. 给…戴上手铐

e.en: The officer moved to {handcuff} the suspect quietly.
e.zh: 警官悄悄上前给嫌疑人戴上手铐。

e.en: Strict rules can {handcuff} creative teams unnecessarily.
e.zh: 严苛的规定可能会无端束缚创意团队。

handcuffed.t: adj. 戴着手铐的；被铐住的

e.en: The suspect was {handcuffed} and led to the patrol car.
e.zh: 嫌疑人被戴上手铐,押上了巡逻车。

e.en: Managers feel {handcuffed} by the new approval process.
e.zh: 经理们觉得被新的审批流程束缚住了手脚。

handed.t: adj. 用…手的（如 right-handed 右撇子）

e.en: She {handed} the report to her boss this morning.
e.zh: 她今早把报告交给了老板。

e.en: Most golf clubs are designed for right-{handed} players.
e.zh: 大多数高尔夫球杆都是为右手球员设计的。

handedness.t: n. 惯用手（左/右撇子倾向）

e.en: Researchers study how {handedness} develops in young children.
e.zh: 研究人员研究幼儿用手习惯是如何形成的。

e.en: The form asks about your {handedness} for ergonomic reasons.
e.zh: 出于人体工学考虑,表格会询问你的左右手习惯。

hander.t: n. 递送者（多作后缀，如 left-hander 左撇子）

e.en: She is the only left-{hander} on the team.
e.zh: 她是队里唯一的左撇子。

e.en: Most tennis pros struggle against a strong left-{hander}.
e.zh: 大多数职业网球选手都难以对付强劲的左撇子。

handful.t: n. 一把；少数；难对付的人

e.en: He grabbed a {handful} of popcorn from the bowl.
e.zh: 他从碗里抓了一把爆米花。

e.en: Only a {handful} of students showed up for the lecture.
e.zh: 只有寥寥几个学生来听讲座。

handfuls.t: n. 几把；少量（handful 的复数）

e.en: The children scooped up {handfuls} of sand at the beach.
e.zh: 孩子们在海滩上一把把地捧起沙子。

e.en: She tossed {handfuls} of birdseed across the lawn.
e.zh: 她把一把把鸟食撒在草坪上。

e.en: The bicycle's rubber {handgrip} was worn from years of use.
e.zh: 自行车的橡胶把手已经用了多年磨损了。

e.en: He squeezed the {handgrip} to strengthen his forearm.
e.zh: 他握紧握力器来锻炼前臂。

e.en: Owning a {handgun} requires a license in most states.
e.zh: 在大多数州持有手枪都需要许可证。

e.en: The officer carefully holstered his {handgun} after the drill.
e.zh: 演习结束后警官小心地把手枪收回枪套。

handheld.t:
adj. 手持的
n. 手持设备

e.en: This {handheld} scanner reads barcodes from across the room.
e.zh: 这款手持扫描仪可以从房间另一头读取条形码。

e.en: Kids love playing on the new {handheld} game console.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢玩这台新的掌上游戏机。

e.en: The climber searched for a secure {handhold} on the cliff.
e.zh: 攀岩者在悬崖上寻找牢固的抓手点。

e.en: Each {handhold} on the wall is color-coded by difficulty.
e.zh: 墙上的每个攀岩点都按难度用颜色区分。

handicap.t:
n. 障碍；残疾
v. 妨碍

e.en: His golf {handicap} dropped to twelve after lessons.
e.zh: 上完课后,他的高尔夫差点降到了十二。

e.en: Lacking proper tools is a serious {handicap} for the team.
e.zh: 缺乏合适的工具对团队来说是个严重的不利因素。

handicapped.t: adj. 残障的；有身体障碍的

e.en: The building has dedicated parking for {handicapped} visitors.
e.zh: 这栋楼为残障访客设有专用停车位。

e.en: Poor planning {handicapped} the project from the start.
e.zh: 糟糕的规划从一开始就阻碍了该项目。

e.en: The {handicapper} predicted a close finish in the third race.
e.zh: 赛马预测员预测第三场比赛将势均力敌。

e.en: A professional {handicapper} analyzes statistics before each game.
e.zh: 专业评分师会在每场比赛前分析数据。

handicapping.t: v. 让分；使不利（handicap 的 -ing 形式）

e.en: Slow internet is {handicapping} our remote workers daily.
e.zh: 网速慢每天都在拖累我们的远程员工。

e.en: He spent the morning {handicapping} tomorrow's horse races.
e.zh: 他花了一上午给明天的赛马评定让分。

handicaps.t:
n. 障碍；残疾（复数）
v. 妨碍（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new system levels the {handicaps} between amateur golfers.
e.zh: 新系统平衡了业余高尔夫球手之间的差点。

e.en: Limited funding {handicaps} many promising research projects.
e.zh: 资金有限阻碍了许多有前景的研究项目。

e.en: She sells traditional {handicraft} at the village market.
e.zh: 她在乡村集市上出售传统手工艺品。

e.en: Pottery making is a {handicraft} passed down through generations.
e.zh: 制陶是一门代代相传的手艺。

e.en: Tourists love buying local {handicrafts} as souvenirs.
e.zh: 游客们喜欢购买当地手工艺品作为纪念。

e.en: The festival showcases {handicrafts} from artisans nationwide.
e.zh: 这个节日展示了来自全国各地工匠的手工艺品。

handiest.t: adj. 最便利的；最顺手的（handy 的最高级）

e.en: A smartphone is the {handiest} tool for daily life.
e.zh: 智能手机是日常生活中最方便的工具。

e.en: This pocket knife is the {handiest} gift I ever received.
e.zh: 这把小刀是我收到过最实用的礼物。

e.en: The home team won {handily} by twenty points.
e.zh: 主队以二十分的优势轻松获胜。

e.en: This app {handily} converts files between dozens of formats.
e.zh: 这款应用可以方便地在几十种格式之间转换文件。

handing.t: v. 递；交给（hand 的 -ing 形式）

e.en: The teacher is {handing} out the test papers now.
e.zh: 老师正在分发试卷。

e.en: She thanked him before {handing} back the borrowed book.
e.zh: 她在归还借来的书之前向他道谢。

handiwork.t: n. 手工作品；所作所为

e.en: He stepped back to admire his {handiwork} on the fence.
e.zh: 他退后几步欣赏自己在篱笆上的杰作。

e.en: The graffiti was clearly the {handiwork} of local teenagers.
e.zh: 那些涂鸦显然是当地青少年的手笔。

e.en: He pulled a silk {handkerchief} from his jacket pocket.
e.zh: 他从夹克口袋里掏出一块丝绸手帕。

e.en: She dabbed her tears with a lace {handkerchief}.
e.zh: 她用一块蕾丝手帕轻拭眼泪。

e.en: My grandmother embroidered {handkerchiefs} as Christmas gifts.
e.zh: 我奶奶绣手帕作为圣诞礼物。

e.en: The drawer was full of neatly folded {handkerchiefs}.
e.zh: 抽屉里装满了叠得整整齐齐的手帕。

handle.t:
v. 处理；操作
n. 把手；手柄

e.en: Please {handle} the package with extra care.
e.zh: 请小心搬运这个包裹。

e.en: The door {handle} broke off when I pulled it.
e.zh: 我一拉,门把手就掉了下来。

e.en: He gripped the {handlebar} tightly as the bike sped downhill.
e.zh: 自行车冲下坡时他紧紧握住车把。

e.en: His vintage motorcycle has a chrome {handlebar} mustache decal.
e.zh: 他的老式摩托车上贴着八字胡车把贴纸。

handled.t: v. 处理过；操作过（handle 的过去式）

e.en: She {handled} the difficult customer with patience.
e.zh: 她耐心地应对了那位难缠的顾客。

e.en: The team {handled} the crisis better than expected.
e.zh: 团队对这次危机的处理比预期的要好。

handler.t: n. 处理程序；处理者；训练员

e.en: The dog {handler} guided the German shepherd through the course.
e.zh: 训犬员引导德国牧羊犬完成了赛道。

e.en: You need to register an event {handler} for the button.
e.zh: 你需要为这个按钮注册一个事件处理函数。

handles.t:
n. 把手（复数）
v. 处理（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {handles} customer complaints with patience and care.
e.zh: 她耐心细致地处理客户投诉。

e.en: The suitcase has two sturdy {handles} on top.
e.zh: 这个手提箱顶部有两个结实的把手。

handling.t:
n. 处理；操控
v. 处理（-ing 形式）

e.en: Shipping and {handling} fees are added at checkout.
e.zh: 运费和手续费会在结账时加上。

e.en: His {handling} of the crisis impressed the entire team.
e.zh: 他对这次危机的处理让整个团队印象深刻。

handlings.t: n. 各种处理方式（handling 的复数，罕用）

e.en: The report compared different {handlings} of fragile cargo.
e.zh: 报告比较了易碎货物的不同搬运方式。

e.en: Various {handlings} of the data led to similar conclusions.
e.zh: 对数据的多种处理方式得出了相似的结论。

e.en: She sells {handmade} soap at the local market.
e.zh: 她在当地市场出售手工皂。

e.en: This sweater is {handmade} from organic wool.
e.zh: 这件毛衣是用有机羊毛手工制作的。

e.en: In the novel, the {handmaid} serves a powerful family.
e.zh: 在小说中,这位使女服侍着一个权贵家庭。

e.en: She felt like a {handmaid} to her demanding boss.
e.zh: 她觉得自己像是苛刻老板的侍女。

e.en: Technology became the {handmaiden} of modern medicine.
e.zh: 科技已成为现代医学的得力助手。

e.en: The queen's {handmaiden} prepared her morning tea.
e.zh: 女王的侍女为她准备了晨茶。

handoff.t: n. 交接；任务移交；（橄榄球）传球

e.en: The project {handoff} to the new team went smoothly.
e.zh: 项目向新团队的交接进行得很顺利。

e.en: The quarterback faked a {handoff} and threw deep.
e.zh: 四分卫假装交球后向远处长传。

handout.t: n. 讲义；散发的资料；施舍物

e.en: The teacher gave each student a {handout} on grammar.
e.zh: 老师给每位学生发了一份语法讲义。

e.en: He refused to accept a {handout} from his neighbors.
e.zh: 他拒绝接受邻居的施舍。

e.en: Please pick up the conference {handouts} at the door.
e.zh: 请在门口领取会议讲义。

e.en: The charity provides food {handouts} every Friday.
e.zh: 该慈善机构每周五发放食物救济。

e.en: The official {handover} ceremony took place at noon.
e.zh: 正式的交接仪式于中午举行。

e.en: A smooth {handover} between shifts prevents mistakes.
e.zh: 班次间顺利交接可以避免出错。

e.en: The CEO will {handpick} her successor next month.
e.zh: 首席执行官下个月将亲自挑选她的继任者。

e.en: Farmers {handpick} the ripest berries each morning.
e.zh: 农民每天早晨亲手采摘最熟的浆果。

handpiece.t: n. 手持件（牙钻等器械手柄）

e.en: The dentist replaced the drill {handpiece} before the procedure.
e.zh: 牙医在手术前更换了钻头手柄。

e.en: This laser {handpiece} is designed for delicate skin treatments.
e.zh: 这款激光手柄专为娇嫩肌肤护理而设计。

e.en: A small {handprint} appeared on the foggy window.
e.zh: 雾蒙蒙的窗户上出现了一个小小的手印。

e.en: Her child's {handprint} hangs framed in the hallway.
e.zh: 她孩子的手印装裱起来挂在走廊上。

harboring.t: v. 窝藏；心怀（harbor 的现在分词）

e.en: Police accused him of {harboring} a fugitive at home.
e.zh: 警方指控他在家窝藏逃犯。

e.en: She admitted {harboring} resentment toward her former boss.
e.zh: 她承认对前老板心怀怨恨。

e.en: Market {Harborough} is a charming town in Leicestershire.
e.zh: 马基特哈伯勒是莱斯特郡的一座迷人小镇。

e.en: They opened a café in {Harborough} last spring.
e.zh: 他们去年春天在哈伯勒开了一家咖啡馆。

harbors.t:
n. 港口（复数）
v. 窝藏；心怀

e.en: The bay {harbors} dozens of fishing boats year-round.
e.zh: 这个海湾常年停泊着几十艘渔船。

e.en: She still {harbors} doubts about his real intentions.
e.zh: 她对他的真实意图仍心存疑虑。

harbour.t:
n. 港口（英式拼写）
v. 窝藏

e.en: The yacht sailed slowly into the {harbour} at sunset.
e.zh: 游艇在日落时分缓缓驶入港口。

e.en: Try not to {harbour} resentment toward your old colleagues.
e.zh: 尽量不要对老同事心怀怨恨。

harboured.t: v. 窝藏；心怀（过去式，英式）

e.en: He {harboured} a secret crush on her for years.
e.zh: 他暗恋了她好多年。

e.en: The village {harboured} refugees during the long war.
e.zh: 那个村庄在漫长的战争中收留了难民。

harbouring.t: v. 窝藏；心怀（英式拼写）

e.en: Police accused him of {harbouring} a wanted criminal.
e.zh: 警方指控他窝藏一名通缉犯。

e.en: She admitted to {harbouring} doubts about the project.
e.zh: 她承认对这个项目心存疑虑。

harbours.t:
n. 港口（英式复数）
v. 窝藏

e.en: Britain has many natural {harbours} along its coast.
e.zh: 英国沿海有许多天然港湾。

e.en: He still {harbours} hopes of becoming a novelist.
e.zh: 他仍怀有成为小说家的希望。

hard.t:
adj. 困难的；坚硬的
adv. 努力地

e.en: Learning a new language is genuinely {hard} at first.
e.zh: 学一门新语言一开始确实很难。

e.en: The bread had gone {hard} after sitting out overnight.
e.zh: 面包放了一夜变硬了。

hard-working.t: adj. 勤奋的，努力工作的

e.en: She's the most {hard-working} student in our class.
e.zh: 她是我们班最用功的学生。

e.en: Our team is small but extremely {hard-working}.
e.zh: 我们团队虽小但非常勤奋。

e.en: I prefer the {hardback} edition for my favorite novels.
e.zh: 我最喜欢的小说我更愿意买精装版。

e.en: The {hardback} sits proudly on her bookshelf.
e.zh: 那本精装书自豪地摆在她的书架上。

hardball.t: n. 强硬策略；（美）硬式棒球

e.en: The negotiators decided to play {hardball} this round.
e.zh: 谈判代表这一轮决定采取强硬手段。

e.en: Investors play {hardball} when millions are on the line.
e.zh: 当涉及数百万美元时,投资者会毫不留情。

hardbitten.t: adj. 饱经风霜的；顽强的

e.en: The {hardbitten} detective had seen it all before.
e.zh: 这位饱经风霜的侦探早已见怪不怪。

e.en: Even {hardbitten} reporters were moved by her story.
e.zh: 连最冷酷的记者也被她的故事打动了。

e.en: He cut the {hardboard} into panels for the cabinet.
e.zh: 他把硬纸板切成几块用作橱柜面板。

e.en: The artist primed the {hardboard} before painting.
e.zh: 画家在硬质纤维板上作画前先打了底。

hardcore.t:
adj. 硬核的；死忠的
n. 铁杆分子

e.en: She's a {hardcore} fan of indie video games.
e.zh: 她是独立游戏的铁杆粉丝。

e.en: The gym attracts mostly {hardcore} weightlifters.
e.zh: 这家健身房主要吸引硬核举重爱好者。

e.en: The {hardcover} edition costs twice as much online.
e.zh: 精装版在网上的售价是平装版的两倍。

e.en: She gifted him a signed {hardcover} for his birthday.
e.zh: 她送了他一本签名精装书作生日礼物。

e.en: The clay will {harden} in the kiln overnight.
e.zh: 黏土在窑里放一夜就会变硬。

e.en: Years of failure can {harden} even kind hearts.
e.zh: 多年的挫败会让最善良的心也变得冷硬。

hardened.t:
adj. 变硬的；冷酷的
v. 已硬化

e.en: The concrete had {hardened} by the next morning.
e.zh: 到第二天早上水泥已经凝固了。

e.en: He's a {hardened} criminal with a long record.
e.zh: 他是个有前科的惯犯。

e.en: Mix the resin with the {hardener} before applying it.
e.zh: 使用前要把树脂与固化剂混合。

e.en: The nail polish {hardener} prevents chipping.
e.zh: 这款指甲油固化剂可以防止指甲开裂。

hardening.t:
n. 硬化
v. 使变硬

e.en: Public opinion is {hardening} against the new tax.
e.zh: 公众对新税的反对态度正变得越来越强硬。

e.en: The glue is {hardening} faster than I expected.
e.zh: 胶水凝固得比我预想的还要快。

harder.t: adj. 更难的；更硬的（hard 的比较级）

e.en: This puzzle is much {harder} than the last one.
e.zh: 这个谜题比上一个难多了。

e.en: You'll need to push {harder} to open the door.
e.zh: 你得再用力一点才能把门推开。

hardest.t: adj. 最难的；最硬的（hard 的最高级）

e.en: That was the {hardest} decision of my career.
e.zh: 那是我职业生涯中最艰难的决定。

e.en: Diamonds are the {hardest} natural material on Earth.
e.zh: 钻石是地球上最坚硬的天然物质。

e.en: Every visitor must wear a {hardhat} on the construction site.
e.zh: 每位访客在工地上都必须戴安全帽。

e.en: His yellow {hardhat} was scuffed from years of work.
e.zh: 他那顶黄色安全帽因多年使用已经磨损了。

e.en: She's a {hardheaded} businesswoman who trusts data over feelings.
e.zh: 她是位务实的女商人,相信数据胜过直觉。

e.en: My {hardheaded} brother refuses to ask for directions.
e.zh: 我那固执的哥哥从不肯问路。

e.en: He had the {hardihood} to challenge the CEO directly.
e.zh: 他竟有胆量直接挑战首席执行官。

e.en: Few possess the {hardihood} to thrive in Antarctica.
e.zh: 很少有人有在南极生存的坚毅。

e.en: This rose is prized for its {hardiness} in cold winters.
e.zh: 这种玫瑰因其耐寒性而受到推崇。

e.en: Mountain climbers need both skill and {hardiness}.
e.zh: 登山者既需要技巧也需要顽强的体魄。

e.en: The party took a {hardline} stance on immigration.
e.zh: 该党在移民问题上采取了强硬立场。

e.en: His {hardline} approach alienated potential allies.
e.zh: 他的强硬做法疏远了潜在的盟友。

e.en: The new minister is a known {hardliner} on security.
e.zh: 这位新部长是出了名的安全问题强硬派。

e.en: Even {hardliner} lawmakers supported the compromise bill.
e.zh: 连强硬派议员也支持了这项妥协法案。

e.en: I can {hardly} hear you over the traffic.
e.zh: 车流声太大,我几乎听不见你说话。

e.en: She had {hardly} finished speaking when applause began.
e.zh: 她话音未落,掌声就响起来了。

e.en: The {hardness} of the steel makes it ideal for tools.
e.zh: 这种钢的硬度使它非常适合做工具。

e.en: Test the water {hardness} before installing the dishwasher.
e.zh: 安装洗碗机前请先测一下水的硬度。

e.en: Tree roots struggle to penetrate the dense {hardpan} below.
e.zh: 树根很难穿透下面密实的硬土层。

e.en: Farmers broke up the {hardpan} to improve drainage.
e.zh: 农民翻碎硬土层以改善排水。

hardscape.t: n. 硬质景观（园林中的石材等）

e.en: The new patio adds beautiful {hardscape} to the backyard.
e.zh: 新建的露台为后院增添了漂亮的硬质景观。

e.en: Designers balance plants with stone {hardscape} in modern gardens.
e.zh: 设计师在现代花园中平衡植物与石质景观。

e.en: The family endured great {hardship} during the recession.
e.zh: 那个家庭在经济衰退期间经历了巨大的苦难。

e.en: Financial {hardship} forced her to drop out of school.
e.zh: 经济困难迫使她辍学。

e.en: Immigrants often face countless {hardships} in their first year.
e.zh: 移民在第一年常常面临无数艰辛。

e.en: The novel describes the {hardships} of frontier life.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了边疆生活的艰辛。

e.en: Sailors once survived months at sea on {hardtack} alone.
e.zh: 水手们曾仅靠硬饼干在海上撑过数月。

e.en: The soldiers complained about the stale {hardtack} rations.
e.zh: 士兵们抱怨那些陈旧的硬饼干口粮。

e.en: He bought a sleek black {hardtop} convertible last summer.
e.zh: 他去年夏天买了一辆光亮的黑色硬顶敞篷车。

e.en: The {hardtop} retracts automatically with the push of a button.
e.zh: 硬顶按一下按钮就能自动收起。

e.en: Our team upgraded the server {hardware} last weekend.
e.zh: 我们团队上周末升级了服务器硬件。

e.en: The {hardware} store sells everything from nails to drills.
e.zh: 这家五金店从钉子到电钻什么都卖。

e.en: These boots are {hardwearing} and perfect for hiking.
e.zh: 这双靴子很耐穿,非常适合徒步旅行。

e.en: Choose a {hardwearing} carpet for high-traffic hallways.
e.zh: 在人流量大的走廊请选择耐磨的地毯。

e.en: They installed gorgeous oak {hardwood} floors throughout the house.
e.zh: 他们在整个屋子里铺上了漂亮的橡木硬木地板。

e.en: Tropical {hardwood} is becoming increasingly expensive to import.
e.zh: 热带硬木的进口成本正变得越来越高。

hardworking.t: adj. 勤奋的，努力工作的

e.en: My grandmother was the most {hardworking} person I knew.
e.zh: 我奶奶是我认识的最勤劳的人。

e.en: Employers love hiring {hardworking} graduates with real curiosity.
e.zh: 雇主喜欢聘用既勤奋又有好奇心的毕业生。

e.en: Lavender is a {hardy} plant that survives most winters.
e.zh: 薰衣草是一种耐寒植物,大多数冬天都能存活。

e.en: Only {hardy} hikers attempt the trail in February.
e.zh: 只有最坚韧的徒步者才会在二月挑战这条小道。

hare.t:
n. 野兔
v. 飞奔

e.en: A startled {hare} darted across the country road.
e.zh: 一只受惊的野兔窜过乡间小路。

e.en: In the fable, the {hare} loses to a tortoise.
e.zh: 寓言里那只野兔输给了一只乌龟。

e.en: Tiny blue {harebell} flowers swayed in the meadow breeze.
e.zh: 草地上小小的蓝色风铃草在微风中摇曳。

e.en: The {harebell} thrives on rocky Scottish hillsides.
e.zh: 风铃草在苏格兰多石的山坡上长势良好。

e.en: His {harebrained} scheme to get rich quickly fell apart.
e.zh: 他那个一夜暴富的疯狂计划彻底泡汤了。

e.en: Don't fund another one of his {harebrained} startup ideas.
e.zh: 别再为他那些异想天开的创业点子掏钱了。

e.en: The charity funds surgery for children born with {harelip}.
e.zh: 该慈善机构资助天生唇裂儿童的手术费用。

e.en: Modern doctors prefer 'cleft lip' to the older term {harelip}.
e.zh: 现代医生更喜欢用"唇裂"而非旧词"兔唇"。

e.en: We took a fast train from Berlin to {Hannover}.
e.zh: 我们乘高铁从柏林前往汉诺威。

e.en: {Hannover} hosts one of the world's biggest tech fairs.
e.zh: 汉诺威举办着全球最大的科技博览会之一。

e.en: Street food in {Hanoi} is cheap and delicious.
e.zh: 河内的街头小吃既便宜又好吃。

e.en: She booked a flight to {Hanoi} for next month.
e.zh: 她订了下个月飞往河内的机票。

e.en: The {Hanover} dynasty ruled Britain for nearly two centuries.
e.zh: 汉诺威王朝统治英国近两个世纪。

e.en: They moved to {Hanover}, New Hampshire for college.
e.zh: 他们搬到新罕布什尔州的汉诺威上大学。

hanoverian.t:
adj. 汉诺威的
n. 汉诺威王朝成员

e.en: Queen Victoria was the last {Hanoverian} monarch of Britain.
e.zh: 维多利亚女王是英国最后一位汉诺威王朝君主。

e.en: She rides a powerful {Hanoverian} horse in competitions.
e.zh: 她在比赛中骑着一匹强壮的汉诺威马。

e.en: The minister's exact words appear in today's {Hansard}.
e.zh: 部长的原话刊载于今日的议会议事录中。

e.en: Researchers searched {Hansard} for past debates on the bill.
e.zh: 研究人员在议会议事录中查找该法案的过往辩论。

e.en: Lübeck was the heart of the medieval {Hanseatic} League.
e.zh: 吕贝克是中世纪汉萨同盟的核心。

e.en: Many {Hanseatic} cities still preserve their old merchant houses.
e.zh: 许多汉萨城市至今仍保留着古老的商人宅邸。

hansel.t:
n. 汉塞尔（人名）
n. 新年贺礼

e.en: In the fairy tale, {Hansel} drops breadcrumbs in the forest.
e.zh: 童话中,汉赛尔在森林里撒下面包屑。

e.en: The opera retells {Hansel} and Gretel for modern audiences.
e.zh: 这部歌剧为现代观众重新演绎了《汉赛尔与格莱特》。

e.en: Sherlock Holmes hailed a {hansom} cab in the fog.
e.zh: 福尔摩斯在雾中招了一辆双轮马车。

e.en: Tourists ride a {hansom} through the old city center.
e.zh: 游客乘坐双轮马车游览老城中心。

e.en: Hikers can catch {hantavirus} from rodent droppings in cabins.
e.zh: 徒步者可能因小屋中的鼠粪而感染汉坦病毒。

e.en: The CDC issued a warning about a {hantavirus} outbreak.
e.zh: 美国疾控中心就汉坦病毒疫情发出警告。

e.en: She grew up in a small village in {Hants}.
e.zh: 她在汉普郡的一个小村庄长大。

e.en: The address listed Winchester, {Hants} as her hometown.
e.zh: 地址上写着她的家乡是汉普郡温彻斯特。

e.en: One dong is divided into ten {hao} in Vietnam.
e.zh: 在越南,一盾分为十毫。

e.en: Old coins worth a {hao} are now collectors' items.
e.zh: 面值一毫的旧硬币如今成了收藏品。

haole.t: n. 夏威夷语：非本地人（多指白人）

e.en: Locals sometimes call white tourists {haole} in Hawaii.
e.zh: 在夏威夷,当地人有时称白人游客为"哈奥利"。

e.en: He grew up as a {haole} kid in Honolulu.
e.zh: 他作为一个白人孩子在檀香山长大。

hap.t:
n. 运气、机缘
v. 偶然发生

e.en: By some strange {hap}, the two strangers met again.
e.zh: 机缘巧合,两位陌生人再次相遇。

e.en: Whatever may {hap}, we will face it together.
e.zh: 无论发生什么,我们都会一起面对。

e.en: His notes were a {haphazard} mess of ideas.
e.zh: 他的笔记是一堆杂乱无章的想法。

e.en: The city grew in a {haphazard} way over decades.
e.zh: 这座城市数十年来杂乱无序地扩张。

e.en: Books were stacked {haphazardly} all over the floor.
e.zh: 书本胡乱地堆满了整个地板。

e.en: He answered the questions {haphazardly} without thinking.
e.zh: 他不假思索地随便回答了那些问题。

e.en: The {hapless} traveler missed every connecting flight.
e.zh: 这位倒霉的旅客错过了每一班转机航班。

e.en: A {hapless} intern got blamed for the entire mistake.
e.zh: 一个倒霉的实习生为整个错误背了锅。

e.en: He stood {haplessly} in the rain without an umbrella.
e.zh: 他没带伞,无助地站在雨中。

e.en: The puppy chased its tail {haplessly} for hours.
e.zh: 小狗徒劳地追着自己的尾巴转了几个小时。

haploid.t:
adj. 单倍体的
n. 单倍体

e.en: Sperm and egg cells are both {haploid}.
e.zh: 精子和卵子都是单倍体细胞。

e.en: Yeast can grow stably as a {haploid} organism.
e.zh: 酵母可以作为单倍体生物稳定生长。

e.en: Researchers compared each patient's {haplotype} for the study.
e.zh: 研究人员为该研究比对了每位患者的单倍型。

e.en: This {haplotype} is common among Northern European populations.
e.zh: 这种单倍型在北欧人群中很常见。

e.en: What will {happen} if I click this button?
e.zh: 如果我点这个按钮会发生什么?

e.en: Accidents {happen} when drivers ignore the speed limit.
e.zh: 司机无视限速时事故就会发生。

happened.t: v. happen 的过去式，发生了

e.en: Tell me exactly what {happened} after the meeting ended.
e.zh: 告诉我会议结束后究竟发生了什么。

e.en: I {happened} to see her at the coffee shop.
e.zh: 我碰巧在咖啡店看到了她。

happening.t:
v. 正在发生
n. 事件

e.en: Something strange is {happening} with my laptop today.
e.zh: 我的笔记本电脑今天发生了一些奇怪的事。

e.en: The downtown street fair is the {happening} of the summer.
e.zh: 市中心的街头集市是今夏最热闹的活动。

happens.t: v. happen 的第三人称单数

e.en: It {happens} that I have a spare ticket.
e.zh: 我碰巧有一张多余的票。

e.en: Nothing ever {happens} in this sleepy little town.
e.zh: 在这座宁静的小镇上从来没什么事发生。

e.en: By pure {happenstance}, they sat next to each other.
e.zh: 纯属偶然,他们俩坐在了一起。

e.en: Their reunion was a happy {happenstance} on vacation.
e.zh: 他们的重逢是度假中一次愉快的偶遇。

e.en: Life is full of small {happenstances} that change everything.
e.zh: 生活充满了改变一切的小巧合。

e.en: A series of {happenstances} led her to the job.
e.zh: 一连串的巧合让她得到了这份工作。

e.en: The children played {happily} in the backyard all afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们在后院开心地玩了一下午。

e.en: She would {happily} help if you just asked.
e.zh: 只要你开口,她会乐意帮忙。

e.en: Money alone cannot guarantee true {happiness}.
e.zh: 金钱本身并不能保证真正的幸福。

e.en: Small daily routines bring her quiet {happiness}.
e.zh: 日常的小习惯给她带来宁静的幸福感。

e.en: I'm so {happy} you finally came to visit.
e.zh: 你终于来探望我,我太开心了。

e.en: She was {happy} with the test results.
e.zh: 她对考试结果感到满意。

e.en: The {Hapsburg} family ruled much of Europe for centuries.
e.zh: 哈布斯堡家族统治欧洲大部分地区数个世纪。

e.en: Vienna is full of palaces from the {Hapsburg} era.
e.zh: 维也纳到处都是哈布斯堡时代的宫殿。

haptic.t: adj. 触觉的（如手机震动反馈）

e.en: The phone uses {haptic} feedback to confirm each tap.
e.zh: 这款手机用触觉反馈来确认每次点击。

e.en: VR gloves provide {haptic} sensations for virtual objects.
e.zh: VR 手套为虚拟物体提供触觉感受。

haptics.t: n. 触觉技术、震动反馈

e.en: Modern game controllers feature advanced {haptics} for immersion.
e.zh: 现代游戏手柄配有先进的触觉反馈以增强沉浸感。

e.en: Surgeons train with {haptics} that simulate real tissue.
e.zh: 外科医生用模拟真实组织的触觉设备进行训练。

e.en: "{Har}, har, very funny," she replied sarcastically.
e.zh: "哈哈,真好笑,"她讽刺地回应。

e.en: He let out a loud "{har}!" at the joke.
e.zh: 听到那个笑话,他大声"哈!"了一声。

harangue.t:
n. 长篇训斥
v. 滔滔不绝地训斥

e.en: The coach launched into a long {harangue} after the loss.
e.zh: 输球后,教练开始长篇大论地训话。

e.en: She had to {harangue} the staff into meeting the deadline.
e.zh: 她不得不严厉训斥员工以赶上截止日期。

harare.t: n. 哈拉雷（津巴布韦首都）

e.en: {Harare} is the capital and largest city of Zimbabwe.
e.zh: 哈拉雷是津巴布韦的首都和最大城市。

e.en: Our flight to {Harare} was delayed by six hours.
e.zh: 我们飞往哈拉雷的航班延误了六个小时。

e.en: It is illegal to {harass} customers over unpaid debts.
e.zh: 因未付债务骚扰客户是违法的。

e.en: Reporters continued to {harass} the actor outside his hotel.
e.zh: 记者们继续在酒店外骚扰这位演员。

harassed.t:
v. 被骚扰
adj. 疲惫烦恼的

e.en: She felt {harassed} by constant calls from telemarketers.
e.zh: 她被电话推销员的不断来电骚扰得不堪其烦。

e.en: The {harassed} parents tried to calm three crying toddlers.
e.zh: 那对疲惫不堪的父母试图安抚三个哭闹的幼儿。

e.en: The court ordered the {harasser} to stay away from her.
e.zh: 法庭命令骚扰者远离她。

e.en: Victims are encouraged to report any {harasser} to HR.
e.zh: 鼓励受害者向人力资源部举报任何骚扰者。

harasses.t: v. harass 的第三人称单数

e.en: He constantly {harasses} her with unwanted text messages.
e.zh: 他不断用骚扰短信纠缠她。

e.en: The neighbor's dog {harasses} every cat on the street.
e.zh: 邻居家的狗骚扰着街上每一只猫。

harassing.t:
v. 正在骚扰
adj. 骚扰性的

e.en: Stop sending {harassing} emails to my coworkers immediately.
e.zh: 立刻停止给我的同事发骚扰邮件。

e.en: He was fired for {harassing} junior staff at work.
e.zh: 他因在工作中骚扰下属员工而被解雇。

e.en: The company has a strict policy against workplace {harassment}.
e.zh: 公司对职场骚扰有严格的政策。

e.en: She filed a formal complaint of online {harassment}.
e.zh: 她正式提交了一份网络骚扰投诉。

e.en: The report listed multiple {harassments} reported by employees.
e.zh: 报告列出了员工反映的多起骚扰事件。

e.en: Repeated {harassments} forced her to change her phone number.
e.zh: 屡次的骚扰迫使她更换了电话号码。

e.en: Falling stock prices were a {harbinger} of the recession.
e.zh: 股价下跌是经济衰退的先兆。

e.en: The first robin is a {harbinger} of spring.
e.zh: 第一只知更鸟是春天的先兆。

harbor.t:
n. 港口
v. 心怀（想法）、藏匿

e.en: Several yachts were anchored in the small {harbor}.
e.zh: 几艘游艇停泊在这个小港湾里。

e.en: She seemed to {harbor} doubts about the new plan.
e.zh: 她似乎对这个新计划心存疑虑。

e.en: He {harbored} a secret crush on his coworker for years.
e.zh: 他多年来一直暗恗着自己的同事。

e.en: The villagers {harbored} refugees during the war.
e.zh: 战争期间,村民们窝藏了难民。

e.en: Always hold the {handrail} when climbing the stairs.
e.zh: 上楼时一定要扶好扶手。

e.en: They installed a wooden {handrail} along the porch.
e.zh: 他们沿着门廊安装了木制扶手。

e.en: The bathroom needs {handrails} for elderly visitors.
e.zh: 浴室需要为年长的访客安装扶手。

e.en: Polished steel {handrails} line both sides of the staircase.
e.zh: 楼梯两侧装有抛光钢制扶手。

hands.t:
n. 手（复数）
v. 递、交给（第三人称单数）

e.en: Wash your {hands} thoroughly before eating.
e.zh: 吃饭前要把手彻底洗干净。

e.en: The clock's {hands} pointed to midnight exactly.
e.zh: 钟的指针正好指向午夜。

hands-on.t: adj. 亲自动手的、实操的

e.en: The workshop offers {hands-on} experience with new tools.
e.zh: 研讨会提供使用新工具的实操体验。

e.en: She prefers a {hands-on} approach to managing her team.
e.zh: 她偏爱亲力亲为的方式来管理团队。

e.en: He cut the board with an old {handsaw}.
e.zh: 他用一把旧手锯把木板锯开。

e.en: A sharp {handsaw} makes woodworking much easier.
e.zh: 锋利的手锯让木工活轻松许多。

e.en: Please pick up the {handset} to answer the call.
e.zh: 请拿起话筒接听电话。

e.en: This {handset} supports both 4G and 5G networks.
e.zh: 这款手机同时支持4G和5G网络。

handshake.t:
n. 握手
n. 握手协议（计算机通信）

e.en: They sealed the deal with a firm {handshake}.
e.zh: 他们以坚定的握手敲定了这笔交易。

e.en: The server completed the SSL {handshake} in milliseconds.
e.zh: 服务器在毫秒内完成了SSL握手。

e.en: The diplomat exchanged {handshakes} with every delegate.
e.zh: 这位外交官与每位代表都握了手。

e.en: Failed {handshakes} between devices caused the connection error.
e.zh: 设备间握手失败导致了连接错误。

handshaking.t: n. 握手过程、握手协议

e.en: Network {handshaking} establishes a secure communication channel.
e.zh: 网络握手过程建立起安全的通信通道。

e.en: After hours of {handshaking}, the politicians finally sat down.
e.zh: 经过数小时的握手寒暄,政客们终于坐下来。

handsome.t:
adj. 英俊的、帅气的
adj. 可观的（数额）

e.en: He looked {handsome} in his new gray suit.
e.zh: 他穿着新的灰色西装显得很英俊。

e.en: She earned a {handsome} profit from the investment.
e.zh: 她从这项投资中获得了可观的利润。

e.en: The loyal employees were {handsomely} rewarded last year.
e.zh: 忠诚的员工去年得到了丰厚的奖励。

e.en: The renovation paid off {handsomely} when we sold.
e.zh: 我们出售时,这次装修带来了丰厚回报。

e.en: His quiet {handsomeness} made him stand out in photos.
e.zh: 他那种内敛的英俊在照片中格外显眼。

e.en: Critics praised the {handsomeness} of the building's facade.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这栋建筑外立面的美观大方。

handspring.t: n. 手翻、前手翻（体操动作）

e.en: The gymnast performed a perfect {handspring} on the mat.
e.zh: 体操运动员在垫子上完成了一个完美的手翻。

e.en: He learned to do a {handspring} during summer camp.
e.zh: 他在夏令营期间学会了做手翻。

e.en: She can hold a {handstand} for over a minute.
e.zh: 她可以倒立保持一分多钟。

e.en: Kids practiced doing a {handstand} against the wall.
e.zh: 孩子们靠着墙练习倒立。

e.en: The mover wheeled the boxes in on a {handtruck}.
e.zh: 搬运工用手推车把箱子推了进来。

e.en: Use the {handtruck} to move heavy packages safely.
e.zh: 用手推车安全地搬运沉重的包裹。

e.en: This silk blouse requires {handwash} only.
e.zh: 这件丝绸衬衫只能手洗。

e.en: Please {handwash} the delicate wine glasses.
e.zh: 请手洗这些精致的葡萄酒杯。

e.en: Her embroidery shows beautiful, intricate {handwork}.
e.zh: 她的刺绣展现出精美细腻的手工。

e.en: This quilt represents months of patient {handwork}.
e.zh: 这条被子凝聚了数月耐心的手工劳作。

e.en: His {handwriting} is so neat it looks printed.
e.zh: 他的字迹工整得像印刷出来的一样。

e.en: Children today rarely practice cursive {handwriting} in school.
e.zh: 如今的孩子在学校很少练习连笔字了。

e.en: Experts compared the {handwritings} on the two letters.
e.zh: 专家比对了两封信上的笔迹。

e.en: The exhibit displayed {handwritings} of famous historical figures.
e.zh: 展览展出了著名历史人物的手迹。

e.en: She received a {handwritten} thank-you note in the mail.
e.zh: 她收到了一封手写的感谢信。

e.en: The recipe was {handwritten} on a faded index card.
e.zh: 这道菜谱手写在一张褪色的卡片上。

handy.t:
adj. 方便的、顺手的
adj. 灵巧的

e.en: Keep a flashlight {handy} in case of power outages.
e.zh: 把手电筒放在手边以防停电。

e.en: This app is really {handy} for tracking expenses.
e.zh: 这款应用记录开支非常方便。

e.en: We hired a {handyman} to fix the leaking faucet.
e.zh: 我们雇了个杂工来修漏水的水龙头。

e.en: Her father was the neighborhood {handyman} for decades.
e.zh: 几十年来她父亲一直是社区里的万能修理工。

hang.t:
v. 挂、悬挂
v. 卡住、死机

e.en: Please {hang} your coat on the rack by the door.
e.zh: 请把外套挂在门边的架子上。

e.en: Let's {hang} out at the new café this weekend.
e.zh: 咱们这周末去新开的咖啡馆玩玩吧。

e.en: The plane was towed back into the {hangar} for repairs.
e.zh: 飞机被拖回机库进行维修。

e.en: A massive {hangar} houses the airline's largest jets.
e.zh: 一个巨大的机库停放着该航空公司最大的喷气式飞机。

hangdog.t: adj. 垂头丧气的、愧疚的

e.en: He returned home with a {hangdog} expression after losing.
e.zh: 输了之后他带着一副垂头丧气的表情回家。

e.en: The puppy gave her a {hangdog} look for forgiveness.
e.zh: 小狗用一副可怜兮兮的眼神向她求饶。

hanged.t: v. 绞死（hang 的过去式）

e.en: In medieval times, criminals were often publicly {hanged}.
e.zh: 在中世纪,罪犯常被公开绞死。

e.en: The convicted murderer was {hanged} at dawn.
e.zh: 被定罪的凶手在黎明时被处以绞刑。

e.en: Put the dress back on its {hanger} when you're done.
e.zh: 穿完后把裙子重新挂回衣架上。

e.en: She bought wooden {hanger} sets for her new closet.
e.zh: 她为新衣柜买了几套木质衣架。

hanging.t:
v. 悬挂中（现在分词）
n. 绞刑

e.en: A beautiful painting was {hanging} above the fireplace.
e.zh: 壁炉上方挂着一幅美丽的画。

e.en: The kids enjoyed {hanging} out at the mall together.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢一起在商场里闲逛。

e.en: Tapestry {hangings} added warmth to the stone walls.
e.zh: 挂毯为石墙增添了几分温暖。

e.en: Public {hangings} were once common forms of punishment.
e.zh: 公开绞刑曾经是常见的惩罚方式。

hangman.t:
n. 刽子手
n. 猜字游戏（Hangman）

e.en: We played {hangman} on a long road trip.
e.zh: 我们在长途旅行中玩了猜单词游戏。

e.en: In old films, the {hangman} wore a black hood.
e.zh: 在老电影里,刽子手戴着黑色的头罩。

e.en: A painful {hangnail} bothered her all morning.
e.zh: 一个疼痛的倒刺让她一上午都不舒服。

e.en: Don't pull at that {hangnail} or it'll bleed.
e.zh: 别去拽那个倒刺,会流血的。

hangout.t: n. 常去的场所、聚集地

e.en: The diner was their favorite teenage {hangout}.
e.zh: 那家小餐馆是他们少年时代最爱去的地方。

e.en: This park has become a popular {hangout} for skaters.
e.zh: 这个公园成了滑板爱好者常去的聚集地。

hangover.t:
n. 宿醉
n. 遗留问题

e.en: She woke up with a terrible {hangover} after the party.
e.zh: 派对之后她醒来时宿醉得厉害。

e.en: Drinking water before bed helps prevent a {hangover}.
e.zh: 睡前喝水有助于防止宿醉。

hangs.t: v. 挂、悬挂（第三人称单数）

e.en: A family portrait {hangs} in the entryway.
e.zh: 门厅里挂着一张全家福。

e.en: Her future {hangs} on the outcome of this exam.
e.zh: 她的未来取决于这次考试的结果。

e.en: She bought a {hank} of yarn for the sweater.
e.zh: 她买了一束毛线来织毛衣。

e.en: The sailor coiled a {hank} of rope on the deck.
e.zh: 水手把一捆绳子盘在甲板上。

e.en: I {hanker} for a slice of homemade apple pie.
e.zh: 我特别想吃一块自家做的苹果派。

e.en: Many city dwellers {hanker} after a quieter country life.
e.zh: 许多城市人都向往更宁静的乡村生活。

e.en: She had a sudden {hankering} for spicy noodles.
e.zh: 她突然很想吃辣面条。

e.en: He's always had a {hankering} to travel through Japan.
e.zh: 他一直渴望去日本旅行。

hankie.t: n. 手帕（handkerchief 口语形式）

e.en: She pulled a lace {hankie} from her purse.
e.zh: 她从手包里抽出一块花边手帕。

e.en: Grandpa always carried a clean cotton {hankie}.
e.zh: 爷爷总是随身带着一块干净的棉手帕。

hanks.t: n. 一束束（hank 复数）；人名 Hanks

e.en: The shop sells {hanks} of yarn in every color.
e.zh: 店里出售各种颜色的纱线绞束。

e.en: She wound two {hanks} of wool into neat balls.
e.zh: 她把两绞羊毛绕成整齐的线球。

hanky.t: n. 手帕（handkerchief 口语形式）

e.en: He dabbed his forehead with a folded {hanky}.
e.zh: 他用折好的手帕轻拭额头。

e.en: She tucked a silk {hanky} into his jacket pocket.
e.zh: 她将一块丝质手帕塞进他的西装口袋。

hannibal.t: n. 人名 Hannibal（迦太基名将）

e.en: {Hannibal} famously crossed the Alps with war elephants.
e.zh: 汉尼拔以率战象翻越阿尔卑斯山而闻名。

e.en: The film portrays {Hannibal} Lecter as terrifyingly intelligent.
e.zh: 这部电影将汉尼拔·莱克特刻画得聪明得令人恐惧。

e.en: The sultan's {harem} was hidden behind ornate palace walls.
e.zh: 苏丹的后宫藏在华丽的宫墙之后。

e.en: A male lion typically defends a {harem} of females.
e.zh: 一头雄狮通常会守护一群雌狮。

harewood.t: n. 哈伍德（英国地名、姓氏）

e.en: The antique cabinet features stunning {harewood} inlays.
e.zh: 这件古董柜镶嵌着精美的灰木饰面。

e.en: Craftsmen prize {harewood} for its silvery, weathered look.
e.zh: 工匠们看重灰木那银灰、做旧的外观。

e.en: The stew calls for white {haricot} beans and rosemary.
e.zh: 这道炖菜需要白扁豆和迷迭香。

e.en: She soaked the {haricot} beans overnight before cooking.
e.zh: 她把菜豆泡了一夜才下锅煮。

e.en: She grew up in {Haringey}, a diverse North London borough.
e.zh: 她在哈林盖长大,那是伦敦北部一个多元化的自治市。

e.en: The new train line will improve transit through {Haringey}.
e.zh: 新的铁路线将改善哈林盖的交通。

harissa.t: n. 哈里萨辣酱（北非辣椒酱）

e.en: Stir a spoonful of {harissa} into the tomato soup.
e.zh: 在番茄汤里拌入一勺哈里萨辣酱。

e.en: Tunisian {harissa} adds smoky heat to roasted vegetables.
e.zh: 突尼斯哈里萨辣酱给烤蔬菜增添了烟熏辣味。

hark.t: v. 听；倾听（多用于旧体）

e.en: Critics often {hark} back to the band's earlier albums.
e.zh: 评论家们常常追忆这支乐队早期的专辑。

e.en: Older readers {hark} fondly to the days of print newspapers.
e.zh: 年长的读者满怀深情地回忆纸质报纸的年代。

harken.t: v. 倾听；留意（hearken 变体）

e.en: These designs {harken} back to mid-century modern style.
e.zh: 这些设计让人想起二十世纪中叶的现代风格。

e.en: Please {harken} to the words of our elders.
e.zh: 请聆听长者的教诲。

e.en: She won a prestigious {Harkness} fellowship to study abroad.
e.zh: 她获得了著名的哈克尼斯奖学金赴海外学习。

e.en: The seminar uses the {Harkness} discussion method around an oval table.
e.zh: 该研讨课采用围绕椭圆桌的哈克尼斯讨论法。

e.en: {Harland} grew up in a small town in Iowa.
e.zh: 哈兰在爱荷华州的一个小镇长大。

e.en: My friend {Harland} just started a new tech startup.
e.zh: 我的朋友哈兰刚创办了一家新的科技公司。

harlech.t: n. 哈莱赫（威尔士地名）

e.en: We visited {Harlech} Castle on our trip to Wales.
e.zh: 我们去威尔士旅行时参观了哈莱克城堡。

e.en: {Harlech} is famous for its medieval stone fortress.
e.zh: 哈莱克以其中世纪石头城堡而闻名。

e.en: {Harlem} is known for its rich African American cultural history.
e.zh: 哈莱姆区以其丰富的非裔美国人文化历史而闻名。

e.en: We caught a jazz show in {Harlem} last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们在哈莱姆区看了一场爵士演出。

harlequin.t:
n. 滑稽丑角
adj. 杂色的；花斑的

e.en: She wore a {harlequin} costume to the masquerade ball.
e.zh: 她穿着小丑装去参加化装舞会。

e.en: The cafe had a colorful {harlequin} pattern on its walls.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆的墙上有彩色的菱形花纹。

harlequins.t: n. 丑角（复数）；英式橄榄球哈勒昆队

e.en: The {Harlequins} won their rugby match by ten points.
e.zh: 哈勒昆橄榄球队以十分的优势赢得了比赛。

e.en: Two {harlequins} performed acrobatics at the street festival.
e.zh: 两个小丑在街头节庆上表演杂技。

harleston.t: n. 哈尔斯顿（英国地名）

e.en: {Harleston} is a market town in Norfolk, England.
e.zh: 哈勒斯顿是英格兰诺福克郡的一个集镇。

e.en: We stopped in {Harleston} for lunch on our drive north.
e.zh: 我们北上途中在哈勒斯顿停下来吃午饭。

harley.t: n. 哈雷（人名；常指哈雷摩托）

e.en: He rides a vintage {Harley} every weekend.
e.zh: 他每个周末都骑一辆复古哈雷摩托。

e.en: {Harley} Street in London is famous for private medical practices.
e.zh: 伦敦的哈利街以私人诊所闻名。

e.en: The old novel describes her unfairly as a {harlot}.
e.zh: 那本旧小说不公平地把她描述成一个荡妇。

e.en: In medieval texts, {harlot} was a deeply derogatory term.
e.zh: 在中世纪文献中,harlot 是一个非常贬损的词。

harlow.t: n. 哈洛（英国城镇、人名）

e.en: {Harlow} is a planned new town in Essex, England.
e.zh: 哈洛是英格兰埃塞克斯郡的一座规划新城。

e.en: Jean {Harlow} was a famous Hollywood actress in the 1930s.
e.zh: 珍·哈露是20世纪30年代著名的好莱坞女演员。

harm.t:
n. 伤害；损害
v. 伤害；损害

e.en: Too much sugar can {harm} your health over time.
e.zh: 长期摄入过多糖分会损害你的健康。

e.en: The storm caused little {harm} to the village.
e.zh: 这场风暴对村庄造成的损害不大。

harmed.t: v. 伤害（过去式）；受到损害

e.en: No one was {harmed} in the minor car accident.
e.zh: 那起小型车祸中没有人受伤。

e.en: The scandal seriously {harmed} the company's reputation.
e.zh: 这起丑闻严重损害了公司的声誉。

e.en: The law treats a deliberate {harmer} more harshly than an accidental one.
e.zh: 法律对故意伤人者比对意外伤人者处置更严厉。

e.en: Mr. {Harmer} has been our neighbor for twenty years.
e.zh: 哈默先生已经做了我们二十年的邻居。

harmful.t: adj. 有害的；造成伤害的

e.en: Smoking is {harmful} to both you and those around you.
e.zh: 吸烟对你自己和身边的人都有害。

e.en: The app filters out {harmful} content for younger users.
e.zh: 该应用会为低龄用户过滤掉有害内容。

e.en: Studies confirmed the {harmfulness} of long-term screen exposure.
e.zh: 研究证实了长期接触屏幕的有害性。

e.en: Regulators debated the {harmfulness} of the new additive.
e.zh: 监管部门就这种新添加剂的危害性展开了讨论。

e.en: Constant criticism is {harming} her self-confidence.
e.zh: 不断的批评正在伤害她的自信心。

e.en: The factory was fined for {harming} the local environment.
e.zh: 那家工厂因损害当地环境而被罚款。

harmless.t: adj. 无害的；不会造成伤害的

e.en: Don't worry, the spider in the corner is completely {harmless}.
e.zh: 别担心,角落里那只蜘蛛完全无害。

e.en: It was just a {harmless} prank between friends.
e.zh: 那只是朋友之间一个无伤大雅的玩笑。

harmlessly.t: adv. 无害地；不造成伤害地

e.en: The firework exploded {harmlessly} high above the field.
e.zh: 烟花在田野高空安全地炸开,没有造成伤害。

e.en: The rumor passed {harmlessly} through the office.
e.zh: 那个谣言在办公室里传了一圈,没造成什么影响。

e.en: The lab proved the {harmlessness} of the food coloring.
e.zh: 实验室证实了这种食用色素的无害性。

e.en: AI safety teams test models for both helpfulness and {harmlessness}.
e.zh: AI 安全团队会测试模型的有用性和无害性。

harmondsworth.t: n. 哈蒙兹沃思（伦敦村名）

e.en: {Harmondsworth} is a village near London's Heathrow Airport.
e.zh: 哈蒙兹沃思是伦敦希思罗机场附近的一个村庄。

e.en: Penguin Books was once based in {Harmondsworth}.
e.zh: 企鹅图书公司曾经设在哈蒙兹沃思。

harmonic.t:
adj. 和谐的；谐波的
n. 谐波；泛音

e.en: The choir produced a beautiful {harmonic} blend of voices.
e.zh: 合唱团唱出了优美的和声。

e.en: Engineers analyzed the {harmonic} vibrations in the bridge.
e.zh: 工程师分析了桥梁的谐波振动。

e.en: He pulled a {harmonica} from his pocket and started playing.
e.zh: 他从口袋里掏出一把口琴,开始吹了起来。

e.en: She learned to play the {harmonica} from her grandfather.
e.zh: 她跟着祖父学会了吹口琴。

e.en: The two melodies blend {harmonically} throughout the song.
e.zh: 这两段旋律在整首歌中和谐地交织在一起。

e.en: The piece is {harmonically} more complex than it sounds.
e.zh: 这首曲子在和声上比听上去要复杂。

harmonies.t: n. 和声；和谐（harmony 复数）

e.en: Their vocal {harmonies} are what make the band special.
e.zh: 他们的人声和声正是这支乐队的特别之处。

e.en: The choir practiced three-part {harmonies} for weeks.
e.zh: 合唱团练习了三声部和声好几个星期。

e.en: They built a {harmonious} relationship despite their differences.
e.zh: 尽管彼此不同,他们还是建立了和谐的关系。

e.en: The room had a {harmonious} mix of colors and textures.
e.zh: 这个房间在色彩和质感上搭配得十分和谐。

e.en: The two teams worked {harmoniously} on the new product.
e.zh: 两个团队在新产品上合作得十分融洽。

e.en: Modern and traditional elements blend {harmoniously} in the design.
e.zh: 现代与传统元素在这件设计中融合得十分协调。

harmonisation.t: n. 协调；统一（英式拼写）

e.en: The EU pushed for {harmonisation} of consumer protection laws.
e.zh: 欧盟推动各国消费者保护法律的协调统一。

e.en: Tax {harmonisation} between member states remains controversial.
e.zh: 成员国之间的税收协调仍然存在争议。

harmonise.t: v. 使协调；使一致（英式拼写）

e.en: The committee aims to {harmonise} regulations across regions.
e.zh: 该委员会旨在协调各地区的法规。

e.en: The backup singers {harmonise} beautifully behind the lead.
e.zh: 伴唱们在主唱身后唱出了优美的和声。

harmonised.t:
v. 协调（过去式）
adj. 已统一的

e.en: The country's standards have been {harmonised} with international norms.
e.zh: 该国的标准已与国际规范保持一致。

e.en: Their voices {harmonised} perfectly on the chorus.
e.zh: 他们的声音在副歌部分配合得天衣无缝。

e.en: The old church had a small wooden {harmonium} near the altar.
e.zh: 那座老教堂里,祭坛旁有一架小木质簧风琴。

e.en: She accompanied the singers on a portable {harmonium}.
e.zh: 她用一架便携式簧风琴为歌手们伴奏。

e.en: International {harmonization} of accounting rules took decades.
e.zh: 国际会计准则的协调统一花了几十年时间。

e.en: The treaty calls for the {harmonization} of safety standards.
e.zh: 该条约要求对安全标准进行协调统一。

e.en: We need to {harmonize} our schedules before booking the trip.
e.zh: 在订行程之前,我们得把彼此的日程协调一下。

e.en: The two singers {harmonize} effortlessly on every track.
e.zh: 这两位歌手在每首歌里都能轻松地和声。

harmonized.t:
v. 协调（过去式）
adj. 已统一的

e.en: Their styles {harmonized} surprisingly well on the duet.
e.zh: 在这首二重唱里,他们的风格出奇地协调。

e.en: The branches of the company operate under {harmonized} policies.
e.zh: 公司各分支都按照统一协调的政策运作。

harmony.t:
n. 和谐；融洽
n. 和声

e.en: The roommates lived in {harmony} for three years.
e.zh: 那几位室友和睦相处了三年。

e.en: She added a soft vocal {harmony} to the chorus.
e.zh: 她在副歌中加入了一段轻柔的和声。

harms.t: n./v. 伤害（harm 的复数/第三人称单数）

e.en: Eating fast food daily {harms} your long-term health.
e.zh: 每天吃快餐会损害你的长期健康。
