e.en: Researchers study the {harms} of social media on teenagers.
e.zh: 研究人员在研究社交媒体对青少年的危害。

e.en: The {Harmsworth} family founded several major British newspapers.
e.zh: 哈姆斯沃思家族创办了几家英国主要报纸。

e.en: Alfred {Harmsworth} became Lord Northcliffe in 1905.
e.zh: 阿尔弗雷德·哈姆斯沃思于1905年获封诺斯克利夫勋爵。

harness.t:
v. 利用；驾驭（能源等）
n. 马具；安全带

e.en: We need to {harness} renewable energy more effectively.
e.zh: 我们需要更有效地利用可再生能源。

e.en: The climber checked his {harness} before starting the ascent.
e.zh: 那位攀岩者在开始攀登前检查了一下安全带。

harnesses.t:
v. 利用、驾驭
n. 挽具；安全带

e.en: Modern climbing {harnesses} are both lightweight and very strong.
e.zh: 现代攀岩安全带既轻便又非常结实。

e.en: The startup {harnesses} AI to streamline customer support.
e.zh: 这家初创公司利用人工智能来优化客户服务。

harnessing.t: v. 利用、驾驭（harness 的动名词）

e.en: They are {harnessing} solar power to run the entire farm.
e.zh: 他们正在利用太阳能为整个农场供电。

e.en: {Harnessing} user feedback helped the team improve the app.
e.zh: 善用用户反馈帮助团队改进了这款应用。

harp.t:
n. 竖琴
v. 唠叨不休

e.en: She plays the {harp} in a chamber music ensemble.
e.zh: 她在一个室内乐团里弹竖琴。

e.en: Please stop {harp}ing on the same old complaint.
e.zh: 别再老是唠叨那件老掉牙的牢骚了。

e.en: {Harper} just started kindergarten this fall.
e.zh: 哈珀今年秋天刚上幼儿园。

e.en: {Harper} Lee is best known for writing To Kill a Mockingbird.
e.zh: 哈珀·李最为人熟知的作品是《杀死一只知更鸟》。

harping.t: v. 喋喋不休、反复提及

e.en: Stop {harping} on my one mistake from last year.
e.zh: 别再揪着我去年那个错误不放了。

e.en: He kept {harping} about the dishwasher being too loud.
e.zh: 他一直唠叨洗碗机声音太吵。

e.en: A talented {harpist} performed at the wedding ceremony.
e.zh: 一位才华横溢的竖琴演奏家在婚礼上演奏。

e.en: She has been a professional {harpist} for fifteen years.
e.zh: 她当职业竖琴演奏家已经十五年了。

harpoon.t:
n. 鱼叉
v. 用鱼叉叉

e.en: The whaler hurled the {harpoon} into the rough sea.
e.zh: 捕鲸人朝着汹涌的海面掷出了鱼叉。

e.en: Modern fishermen rarely use a {harpoon} anymore.
e.zh: 现代渔民已经很少使用鱼叉了。

e.en: Bach composed many pieces for the {harpsichord}.
e.zh: 巴赫为羽管键琴创作了许多作品。

e.en: The museum displays a beautifully restored {harpsichord} from 1750.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一架修复精美的1750年的羽管键琴。

e.en: The {harpsichordist} performed a Bach concerto from memory.
e.zh: 那位羽管键琴演奏家凭记忆演奏了一首巴赫的协奏曲。

e.en: She studied for years to become a professional {harpsichordist}.
e.zh: 她苦练多年才成为一名专业的羽管键琴演奏家。

harpy.t: n. 鹰身女妖；凶悍的女人

e.en: In Greek mythology, a {harpy} is a winged spirit with sharp claws.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,哈耳庇厄是一种长翅膀、有利爪的妖灵。

e.en: The {harpy} eagle is one of the largest raptors in the world.
e.zh: 角雕是世界上最大的猛禽之一。

e.en: The novel unfairly portrays the landlady as a screaming {harridan}.
e.zh: 那本小说不公平地把女房东描绘成一个泼妇。

e.en: Calling any older woman a {harridan} is offensive and outdated.
e.zh: 把任何上了年纪的女性称作泼妇都是无礼且过时的说法。

harried.t:
adj. 焦头烂额的
v. 不断骚扰

e.en: The {harried} waiter rushed between tables during the dinner rush.
e.zh: 那位手忙脚乱的服务员在晚餐高峰期在餐桌间穿梭。

e.en: She looked {harried} after a long day of back-to-back meetings.
e.zh: 开了一整天连轴转的会议后,她看起来疲惫不堪。

e.en: A {harrier} glided low over the marsh hunting for prey.
e.zh: 一只白尾鹞低低地掠过沼泽寻找猎物。

e.en: The Royal Navy retired its {Harrier} jets several years ago.
e.zh: 英国皇家海军几年前退役了它的鹞式战斗机。

e.en: He wore a classic {Harrington} jacket over his t-shirt.
e.zh: 他在T恤外面套了一件经典的哈灵顿夹克。

e.en: Mr. {Harrington} taught math at the local high school.
e.zh: 哈灵顿先生在当地高中教数学。

e.en: Kamala {Harris} delivered a speech on economic policy.
e.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯发表了一场关于经济政策的演讲。

e.en: The {Harris} family has lived in this town for generations.
e.zh: 哈里斯一家在这个小镇住了好几代了。

harrisburg.t: n. 哈里斯堡（美国宾州首府）

e.en: {Harrisburg} is the capital city of Pennsylvania.
e.zh: 哈里斯堡是宾夕法尼亚州的首府。

e.en: We drove through {Harrisburg} on our way to Philadelphia.
e.zh: 我们去费城的路上经过了哈里斯堡。

e.en: George {Harrison} was the lead guitarist of the Beatles.
e.zh: 乔治·哈里森是披头士乐队的主音吉他手。

e.en: President {Harrison} served only one month before dying.
e.zh: 哈里森总统上任仅一个月便去世了。

harrogate.t: n. 哈罗盖特（英国城镇）

e.en: {Harrogate} is famous for its Victorian spa heritage.
e.zh: 哈罗盖特以其维多利亚时代的温泉文化而闻名。

e.en: We had afternoon tea at a charming café in {Harrogate}.
e.zh: 我们在哈罗盖特一家迷人的咖啡馆喝了下午茶。

harrow.t:
n. 耙
v. 耙地；使痛苦

e.en: The farmer used a {harrow} to break up the soil.
e.zh: 农夫用耙子把土块打碎。

e.en: He attended {Harrow} School before going to Oxford.
e.zh: 他在去牛津之前就读于哈罗公学。

harrowing.t: adj. 令人痛心的、折磨人的

e.en: She shared a {harrowing} account of her escape from war.
e.zh: 她讲述了自己从战火中逃生的惊心动魄经历。

e.en: The documentary contains {harrowing} footage of the disaster.
e.zh: 这部纪录片包含了那场灾难令人揪心的画面。

harrows.t:
n. 耙（复数）
v. 耙地

e.en: Modern {harrows} are pulled by tractors across the fields.
e.zh: 现代的耙具由拖拉机牵引穿过田地。

e.en: The memory of the accident still {harrows} him today.
e.zh: 那场事故的记忆至今仍折磨着他。

harry.t:
n. 哈利（男子名）
v. 骚扰

e.en: {Harry} Potter remains one of the most beloved fictional characters.
e.zh: 哈利·波特仍是最受喜爱的虚构人物之一。

e.en: Reporters continued to {harry} the politician with questions.
e.zh: 记者们不停地用问题骚扰那位政客。

harsh.t: adj. 严厉的；刺耳的；恶劣的

e.en: The critics were unusually {harsh} about her new album.
e.zh: 评论家们对她的新专辑异常苛刻。

e.en: Plants struggle to survive in such a {harsh} climate.
e.zh: 植物在如此严酷的气候中很难生存。

e.en: The judge spoke {harshly} to the defendant during sentencing.
e.zh: 法官在宣判时严厉地训斥了被告。

e.en: Don't judge yourself too {harshly} for one mistake.
e.zh: 别为一个错误太苛责自己。

e.en: The {harshness} of his criticism surprised everyone in the meeting.
e.zh: 他批评的严厉程度让会上每个人都感到意外。

e.en: Winter brought a new {harshness} to life on the farm.
e.zh: 冬天给农场生活带来了新的艰辛。

e.en: A magnificent {hart} appeared at the edge of the forest.
e.zh: 一头雄伟的雄鹿出现在森林边缘。

e.en: Kevin {Hart} hosted a stand-up comedy show last night.
e.zh: 凯文·哈特昨晚主持了一场单口喜剧表演。

hartford.t: n. 哈特福德（美国康州首府）

e.en: {Hartford} is home to many major insurance companies.
e.zh: 哈特福德是许多大型保险公司的所在地。

e.en: She moved to {Hartford} for a new job last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天为了新工作搬到了哈特福德。

e.en: {Hartland} is a quiet village along the Devon coast.
e.zh: 哈特兰是德文郡海岸旁一个宁静的村庄。

e.en: We hiked the cliffs near {Hartland} Point last weekend.
e.zh: 我们上周末在哈特兰角附近的悬崖徒步。

hartlepool.t: n. 哈特尔浦（英国港城）

e.en: {Hartlepool} is a coastal town in northeast England.
e.zh: 哈特尔浦是英格兰东北部的一座沿海城镇。

e.en: The football club from {Hartlepool} faces relegation this season.
e.zh: 哈特尔浦的足球俱乐部本赛季面临降级。

e.en: {Hartley} is a common surname in northern England.
e.zh: 哈特利在英格兰北部是个常见的姓氏。

e.en: Mrs. {Hartley} taught chemistry at our high school.
e.zh: 哈特利夫人在我们高中教化学。

hartwell.t: n. 哈特韦尔（姓氏/地名）

e.en: {Hartwell} House is a historic country estate in Buckinghamshire.
e.zh: 哈特韦尔府是白金汉郡的一座历史悠久的乡村庄园。

e.en: Professor {Hartwell} published a new book on medieval history.
e.zh: 哈特韦尔教授出版了一本关于中世纪历史的新书。

e.en: She got accepted to {Harvard} on a full scholarship.
e.zh: 她获得全额奖学金被哈佛大学录取了。

e.en: The {Harvard} Business Review published her article last month.
e.zh: 《哈佛商业评论》上个月刊登了她的文章。

harvest.t:
n. 收获、收成
v. 收割；采集

e.en: Farmers begin the wheat {harvest} in late August.
e.zh: 农民们在八月下旬开始收割小麦。

e.en: Apps that {harvest} user data face increasing regulation.
e.zh: 收集用户数据的应用面临着越来越严格的监管。

harvestable.t: adj. 可收获的、可采集的

e.en: Only the ripe fruit on the upper branches is {harvestable}.
e.zh: 只有上层枝条上熟透的果实才能采摘。

e.en: Solar panels turn sunlight into {harvestable} electrical energy.
e.zh: 太阳能板把阳光转化为可收集的电能。

harvested.t: v. 已收割、已采集（harvest 过去式）

e.en: The grapes are {harvested} by hand each September.
e.zh: 葡萄在每年九月都是用手工采摘的。

e.en: The app {harvested} location data without user consent.
e.zh: 该应用未经用户同意就收集了位置数据。

e.en: A modern combine {harvester} can clear acres in hours.
e.zh: 现代联合收割机几小时就能清空数英亩田地。

e.en: The browser blocked a data {harvester} script on the page.
e.zh: 浏览器拦截了页面上的一个数据收集脚本。

e.en: They are {harvesting} rice in the terraced fields right now.
e.zh: 他们正在梯田里收割水稻。

e.en: The company was fined for {harvesting} personal information illegally.
e.zh: 该公司因非法收集个人信息而被罚款。

harvests.t:
n. 收成（复数）
v. 收割

e.en: Recent {harvests} have suffered due to severe drought.
e.zh: 近年的收成因严重干旱而受损。

e.en: The farm {harvests} organic vegetables twice a week.
e.zh: 这家农场每周采收两次有机蔬菜。

e.en: Hurricane {Harvey} caused massive flooding across Houston in 2017.
e.zh: 2017年飓风哈维在休斯敦引发了大规模洪灾。

e.en: {Harvey} works as a software engineer at a startup.
e.zh: 哈维在一家初创公司当软件工程师。

e.en: {Harwell} is known for its scientific research campus.
e.zh: 哈韦尔以其科学研究园区而闻名。

e.en: He worked at the {Harwell} laboratory in the 1960s.
e.zh: 他在20世纪60年代曾在哈韦尔实验室工作。

harwich.t: n. 哈里奇（英国港口城市）

e.en: The ferry from {Harwich} crosses to the Netherlands overnight.
e.zh: 从哈里奇出发的渡轮连夜驶往荷兰。

e.en: {Harwich} is a historic port town in Essex.
e.zh: 哈里奇是埃塞克斯郡的一座历史悠久的港口城镇。

e.en: Mr. {Harwood} ran the local bookshop for forty years.
e.zh: 哈伍德先生经营当地的书店长达四十年。

e.en: The {Harwood} family hosted us for dinner last Sunday.
e.zh: 哈伍德一家上周日请我们吃了晚饭。

haryana.t: n. 哈里亚纳邦（印度北部）

e.en: {Haryana} is a state in northern India near Delhi.
e.zh: 哈里亚纳邦是印度北部靠近德里的一个邦。

e.en: Many tech companies have offices in {Haryana}'s Gurgaon district.
e.zh: 许多科技公司在哈里亚纳邦的古尔冈区设有办公室。

e.en: The {Harz} mountains stretch across central Germany.
e.zh: 哈茨山脉横亘于德国中部。

e.en: We hiked through the {Harz} forest during our vacation.
e.zh: 我们度假时在哈茨森林里徒步。

has.t: v. 有；拥有（have 的第三人称单数）

e.en: She {has} three meetings scheduled for tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 她明天上午安排了三个会议。

e.en: The team {has} won every game this season.
e.zh: 这支队伍本赛季每场比赛都赢了。

hash.t:
n. 哈希值；井号（#）
v. 剁碎；散列运算

e.en: The password is stored as a secure {hash} in the database.
e.zh: 密码以安全哈希值的形式存储在数据库中。

e.en: He ordered corned beef {hash} with eggs for breakfast.
e.zh: 他早餐点了咸牛肉土豆碎配鸡蛋。

hashish.t: n. 大麻脂；印度大麻毒品

e.en: Police seized a large quantity of {hashish} at the border.
e.zh: 警方在边境查获了大量大麻脂。

e.en: The sale of {hashish} remains illegal in most countries.
e.zh: 大麻脂的销售在大多数国家仍属违法。

hasidic.t: adj. 哈西德派犹太教的

e.en: The {Hasidic} community in Brooklyn maintains strict religious traditions.
e.zh: 布鲁克林的哈西迪派社区严守宗教传统。

e.en: He grew up in a {Hasidic} family in Jerusalem.
e.zh: 他在耶路撒冷一个哈西迪派家庭长大。

hasp.t:
n. 搭扣；扣环
v. 用搭扣扣住

e.en: The old gate's {hasp} had rusted shut over the years.
e.zh: 那扇旧门的搭扣多年来已经锈死了。

e.en: She secured the chest with a heavy iron {hasp}.
e.zh: 她用一只沉重的铁搭扣把箱子扣牢。

hassidic.t: adj. 哈西德派犹太教的

e.en: The {Hassidic} movement originated in 18th-century Eastern Europe.
e.zh: 哈西迪派运动起源于18世纪的东欧。

e.en: Many {Hassidic} men wear distinctive black hats and coats.
e.zh: 许多哈西迪派男子戴着独特的黑色礼帽,穿黑色长外套。

hassle.t:
n. 麻烦事；争吵
v. 烦扰；纠缠

e.en: Booking flights online saves so much {hassle} these days.
e.zh: 如今在网上订机票省去了许多麻烦。

e.en: Don't {hassle} the staff while they're handling other customers.
e.zh: 员工在接待其他顾客时,别去烦他们。

hassled.t: v. 被烦扰；被纠缠（hassle 过去式）

e.en: Tourists often get {hassled} by vendors near the famous landmarks.
e.zh: 游客经常在著名景点附近被小贩纠缠。

e.en: She felt {hassled} by constant emails from the recruiter.
e.zh: 招聘人员不断发邮件让她感到很烦扰。

e.en: He rested his feet on a soft velvet {hassock}.
e.zh: 他把脚搁在一个柔软的丝绒脚凳上。

e.en: The church pews each had a kneeling {hassock} underneath.
e.zh: 教堂的每个长椅下都有一个跪垫。

hast.t: v. 有（古英语 have 第二人称单数）

e.en: In old English, "thou {hast}" simply means "you have".
e.zh: 在古英语中,"thou hast"就是"你有"的意思。

e.en: The hymn begins, "Thou {hast} given so much to me."
e.zh: 那首赞美诗开头是:"你赐予我如此之多。"

e.en: In her {haste}, she forgot to lock the front door.
e.zh: 她匆忙之中忘了锁前门。

e.en: Important decisions should never be made in {haste}.
e.zh: 重要的决定绝不能仓促作出。

e.en: New regulations will {hasten} the shift to electric vehicles.
e.zh: 新法规将加速向电动汽车的转变。

e.en: I must {hasten} to add that this is just my opinion.
e.zh: 我得赶紧补充一句,这只是我个人的看法。

hastes.t: v. 匆忙；赶紧（haste 第三人称单数）

e.en: Whoever {hastes} through the work usually makes more mistakes.
e.zh: 赶着做事的人通常会出更多的错。

e.en: He always {hastes} home after dinner to play with his kids.
e.zh: 他总是晚饭后赶着回家陪孩子玩。

e.en: She {hastily} packed her bags before the taxi arrived.
e.zh: 她在出租车到来之前匆匆收拾了行李。

e.en: The report was written {hastily} and contained several errors.
e.zh: 这份报告写得很仓促,出现了几处错误。

hastings.t: n. 黑斯廷斯（英国城市/姓氏）

e.en: The Battle of {Hastings} took place in 1066.
e.zh: 黑斯廷斯战役发生于1066年。

e.en: We spent a sunny weekend by the seaside in {Hastings}.
e.zh: 我们在黑斯廷斯海边度过了一个阳光明媚的周末。

e.en: Don't make a {hasty} decision you'll regret later.
e.zh: 不要做出日后会后悔的草率决定。

e.en: He gave a {hasty} apology and rushed out the door.
e.zh: 他匆忙道了个歉就冲出了门。

e.en: She bought a wide-brimmed straw {hat} for the beach.
e.zh: 她买了一顶宽边草帽去沙滩戴。

e.en: As a manager, I wear many {hats} every single day.
e.zh: 作为一名经理,我每天都要扮演多种角色。

e.en: His cowboy {hatband} was decorated with silver conchos.
e.zh: 他牛仔帽的帽带上装饰着银色圆片。

e.en: She tucked a feather into the {hatband} of her fedora.
e.zh: 她在软呢帽的帽带上插了一根羽毛。

e.en: She kept her grandmother's letters inside an old {hatbox}.
e.zh: 她把祖母的信件放在一个旧帽盒里。

e.en: He pulled a vintage fedora out of the dusty {hatbox}.
e.zh: 他从落满灰尘的帽盒里取出一顶复古软呢帽。

hatch.t:
v. 孵化；策划
n. 舱口；小门

e.en: The chicks will {hatch} in about three weeks.
e.zh: 小鸡大约三周后就会孵出来。

e.en: The crew opened the cargo {hatch} to unload supplies.
e.zh: 船员打开货舱舱门卸下补给品。

e.en: She loaded the groceries into her small red {hatchback}.
e.zh: 她把买的菜装进她那辆红色小掀背车里。

e.en: A {hatchback} is easier to park than a sedan.
e.zh: 掀背车比三厢轿车更容易停。

hatched.t: v. 已孵化；已策划（hatch 过去式）

e.en: The chicks {hatched} early this morning in the incubator.
e.zh: 小鸡今早在孵化器里破壳而出了。

e.en: They {hatched} a clever plan to surprise their teacher.
e.zh: 他们策划了一个巧妙的方案来给老师一个惊喜。

e.en: The salmon {hatchery} releases millions of fish each spring.
e.zh: 那家鲑鱼孵化场每年春天放流数百万条鱼。

e.en: We toured a local trout {hatchery} on the weekend.
e.zh: 我们周末参观了当地的鳟鱼孵化场。

hatches.t:
n. 舱口（复数）
v. 孵化（第三人称单数）

e.en: The crew battened down the {hatches} before the storm.
e.zh: 船员在暴风雨来临前关紧了所有舱口。

e.en: Every spring, a new batch of ducklings {hatches} at the pond.
e.zh: 每年春天,池塘边都会孵出一批新的小鸭子。

e.en: He used a small {hatchet} to chop kindling for the fire.
e.zh: 他用一把小斧头劈柴生火。

e.en: The two old friends finally buried the {hatchet}.
e.zh: 两位老友终于握手言和了。

hatching.t:
v. 孵化；策划（进行时）
n. 影线

e.en: The eggs are {hatching} right now—come look quickly!
e.zh: 蛋正在孵化,快过来看!

e.en: They were {hatching} a plan to start their own company.
e.zh: 他们正在策划开办自己的公司。

hatchings.t: n. 影线；阴影线条（复数）

e.en: The artist added fine {hatchings} to shade the drawing.
e.zh: 画家用细密的影线为画作添加阴影。

e.en: Several {hatchings} of mayflies appeared on the river this week.
e.zh: 本周河面上出现了好几批蜉蝣的羽化。

hatchling.t: n. 刚孵出的幼雏；雏鸟

e.en: A tiny sea turtle {hatchling} crawled toward the ocean.
e.zh: 一只小海龟幼崽朝着大海爬去。

e.en: The {hatchling} chirped loudly for its mother.
e.zh: 刚出壳的小鸟大声啁啾呼唤妈妈。

e.en: He climbed down through the {hatchway} into the cargo hold.
e.zh: 他从舱口爬下去进入货舱。

e.en: The {hatchway} on deck was sealed shut for safety.
e.zh: 甲板上的舱口为了安全被封死了。

hate.t:
v. 讨厌；憎恨
n. 仇恨

e.en: I really {hate} waking up before sunrise on weekends.
e.zh: 我真的很讨厌周末天没亮就起床。

e.en: Online platforms struggle to remove {hate} speech effectively.
e.zh: 网络平台难以有效清除仇恨言论。

hated.t: v. 讨厌；憎恨（hate 过去式）

e.en: As a kid, I {hated} the taste of broccoli.
e.zh: 小时候我特别讨厌西兰花的味道。

e.en: The {hated} new policy was finally repealed last week.
e.zh: 那项不得人心的新政策上周终于被废除了。

hateful.t: adj. 可恶的；令人憎恶的

e.en: The website removed several {hateful} comments from the thread.
e.zh: 网站删除了帖子中几条充满仇恨的评论。

e.en: She refused to listen to his {hateful} remarks any longer.
e.zh: 她不愿再听他那些恶毒的言论了。

hatefully.t: adv. 可憎地；令人厌恶地

e.en: He stared {hatefully} at the player who fouled him.
e.zh: 他怀着恨意盯着那个犯规的球员。

e.en: The villain spoke {hatefully} about everyone in the village.
e.zh: 反派恶毒地谈论着村里的每个人。

e.en: Don't let one {hater} in the comments ruin your day.
e.zh: 别让评论区一个喷子毁了你一整天。

e.en: Every successful creator deals with the occasional {hater}.
e.zh: 每个成功的创作者都会遇到偶尔出现的酸民。

hates.t: v. 讨厌；憎恨（hate 第三人称单数）

e.en: My cat absolutely {hates} getting a bath.
e.zh: 我家猫超级讨厌洗澡。

e.en: He {hates} when people talk loudly during movies.
e.zh: 他讨厌别人在看电影时大声讲话。

hatfield.t: n. 哈特菲尔德（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: The conference will be held in {Hatfield} next month.
e.zh: 会议下个月将在哈特菲尔德举行。

e.en: She grew up in a small village near {Hatfield}.
e.zh: 她在哈特菲尔德附近的一个小村庄长大。

e.en: He picked a {hatful} of ripe strawberries from the garden.
e.zh: 他从园子里摘了满满一帽子成熟的草莓。

e.en: The striker scored a {hatful} of goals last season.
e.zh: 那位前锋上赛季进了一大堆球。

e.en: As the old saying goes, hell {hath} no fury like a scorned lover.
e.zh: 正如古语所说,被抛弃的情人怒火滔天。

e.en: The poem begins, "Whoso {hath} found a virtuous wife..."
e.zh: 那首诗开头写道:“凡寻得贤妻者……”。

e.en: Anne {Hathaway} won an Oscar for her supporting role.
e.zh: 安妮·海瑟薇凭借她的配角表演获得了奥斯卡奖。

e.en: Berkshire {Hathaway} reported strong earnings this quarter.
e.zh: 伯克希尔·哈撒韦本季度公布了强劲的盈利。

hating.t: v. 讨厌；憎恨（hate 进行时）

e.en: I'm really {hating} this rainy weather all week.
e.zh: 我真的很讨厌这一整周的下雨天气。

e.en: Stop {hating} on people just because they disagree with you.
e.zh: 别因为别人意见不同就攻击人家。

e.en: Singapore's {hawker} centers serve some of the best street food.
e.zh: 新加坡的小贩中心提供一些最棒的街头美食。

e.en: A {hawker} shouted prices for fresh fish at the market.
e.zh: 一个小贩在市场上吆喝着鲜鱼的价格。

hawking.t:
n. 姓氏 霍金
v. 叫卖

e.en: Stephen {Hawking} explained black holes to a global audience.
e.zh: 史蒂芬·霍金向全球观众讲解黑洞。

e.en: Vendors were {hawking} cheap umbrellas during the sudden rain.
e.zh: 突降大雨时小贩们正叫卖着廉价雨伞。

e.en: Coach {Hawkins} led the team to a championship victory.
e.zh: 霍金斯教练带领球队赢得了冠军。

e.en: The kids in Stranger Things live in fictional {Hawkins}, Indiana.
e.zh: 《怪奇物语》中的孩子们住在虚构的印第安纳州霍金斯镇。

e.en: The senator took a {hawkish} stance on military spending.
e.zh: 这位参议员在军费开支问题上立场强硬。

e.en: Investors fear the central bank's {hawkish} tone on rates.
e.zh: 投资者担心央行对利率的强硬态度。

e.en: Sailors tied the ship to the dock with a thick {hawser}.
e.zh: 水手们用一根粗缆绳把船系在码头上。

e.en: The {hawser} snapped as the storm tossed the boat violently.
e.zh: 风暴猛烈摇晃船只时缆绳突然断裂。

e.en: The {hawthorn} hedge bloomed with white flowers in May.
e.zh: 五月里山楂树篱开满了白色的花。

e.en: Birds nest safely inside the thorny {hawthorn} bushes.
e.zh: 鸟儿在多刺的山楂丛中安全地筑巢。

e.en: Nathaniel {Hawthorne} wrote The Scarlet Letter in 1850.
e.zh: 纳撒尼尔·霍桑于1850年创作了《红字》。

e.en: The {Hawthorne} effect describes how observation changes behavior.
e.zh: 霍桑效应描述了观察会如何改变人的行为。

e.en: The farmer stacked bales of {hay} in the barn.
e.zh: 农夫把一捆捆干草堆放在谷仓里。

e.en: Make {hay} while the sun shines, as the saying goes.
e.zh: 俗话说,要趁着太阳好赶紧晒干草。

e.en: {Haydn} composed over a hundred symphonies during his lifetime.
e.zh: 海顿一生创作了一百多部交响曲。

e.en: The orchestra performed a beautiful {Haydn} string quartet.
e.zh: 乐团演奏了一首优美的海顿弦乐四重奏。

e.en: {Hayek} won the Nobel Prize in Economics in 1974.
e.zh: 哈耶克于1974年获得诺贝尔经济学奖。

e.en: Salma {Hayek} starred in the film Frida.
e.zh: 萨尔玛·海耶克主演了电影《弗里达》。

e.en: Rutherford B. {Hayes} served as the nineteenth U.S. president.
e.zh: 拉瑟福德·B·海斯曾任美国第十九任总统。

e.en: We caught the train at {Hayes} station this morning.
e.zh: 我们今早在海斯火车站搭上了火车。

e.en: Children ran laughing across the sunlit {hayfield}.
e.zh: 孩子们在阳光照耀的干草田里奔跑欢笑。

e.en: The tractor cut neat rows through the wide {hayfield}.
e.zh: 拖拉机在宽阔的干草田里割出一道道整齐的行。

e.en: The kittens hid in the warm {hayloft} above the barn.
e.zh: 小猫们躲在谷仓上方暖和的干草棚里。

e.en: He climbed the ladder up to the dusty {hayloft}.
e.zh: 他爬梯子上到布满灰尘的干草阁楼。

haymaker.t:
n. 强有力的一击
n. 晒干草的人

e.en: The boxer landed a {haymaker} that ended the fight.
e.zh: 拳击手一记重拳直接终结了比赛。

e.en: He swung a wild {haymaker} but missed completely.
e.zh: 他猛挥一记重拳却完全打空了。

e.en: {Haymaking} season keeps farmers busy throughout July.
e.zh: 七月里晒草季节让农民们忙个不停。

e.en: The whole village helped with {haymaking} before the rains.
e.zh: 全村人都在大雨来临前帮忙晒制干草。

e.en: The {Haymarket} affair shaped American labor history forever.
e.zh: 干草市场事件深刻影响了美国劳工史。

e.en: London's {Haymarket} theatre has staged plays for centuries.
e.zh: 伦敦干草市场剧院数百年来一直上演戏剧。

e.en: The kids loved the {hayride} through the pumpkin patch.
e.zh: 孩子们很喜欢穿过南瓜田的干草车之旅。

e.en: Our autumn {hayride} ended at a bonfire and cider stand.
e.zh: 我们的秋日干草车游最后停在篝火和苹果酒摊旁。

hays.t: n. 姓氏/地名 海斯

e.en: The {Hays} Code restricted Hollywood film content for decades.
e.zh: 《海斯法典》对好莱坞电影内容限制了数十年。

e.en: We refueled in {Hays} on our drive across Kansas.
e.zh: 我们穿越堪萨斯途中在海斯加了油。

hayseed.t:
n. 乡下人，土包子
n. 干草籽

e.en: Tourists laughed at the {hayseed} stereotype in the comedy.
e.zh: 游客们对喜剧里的乡巴佬刻板形象哈哈大笑。

e.en: Don't call me a {hayseed} just because I'm from the country.
e.zh: 别因为我来自乡下就叫我土包子。

e.en: Finding the bug felt like searching a {haystack} for a needle.
e.zh: 找这个漏洞就像大海捞针一样困难。

e.en: Monet painted the same {haystack} under different lighting.
e.zh: 莫奈在不同光线下反复描绘同一垛干草堆。

hayward.t: n. 姓氏/地名 海沃德

e.en: We drove through {Hayward} on our way to Oakland.
e.zh: 我们去奥克兰的路上经过海沃德。

e.en: The {Hayward} fault runs along the East Bay hills.
e.zh: 海沃德断层沿着东湾山脉延伸。

e.en: My laptop went totally {haywire} after the update.
e.zh: 更新之后我的笔记本电脑完全失控了。

e.en: Plans went {haywire} when the keynote speaker canceled.
e.zh: 主讲人取消后计划全乱套了。

hazard.t:
n. 危险，隐患
v. 冒险尝试

e.en: Wet floors are a serious slipping {hazard} in restaurants.
e.zh: 餐厅里湿地板是严重的滑倒隐患。

e.en: I wouldn't {hazard} a guess about tomorrow's weather.
e.zh: 我可不敢贸然猜测明天的天气。

hazarded.t: v. hazard 的过去式；冒险提出

e.en: She {hazarded} a guess that the meeting was canceled.
e.zh: 她大胆猜测说会议已经取消了。

e.en: The climber {hazarded} his life on the icy ridge.
e.zh: 登山者在结冰的山脊上拿生命冒险。

hazarding.t: v. hazard 的现在分词；冒险

e.en: He answered without {hazarding} a clear opinion on the matter.
e.zh: 他回答时没敢冒险表达对此事的明确看法。

e.en: She kept investing, {hazarding} her savings on risky stocks.
e.zh: 她继续投资,把积蓄押在了高风险股票上。

e.en: The factory stores {hazardous} chemicals in sealed containers.
e.zh: 工厂将危险化学品储存在密封容器中。

e.en: Driving in heavy fog can be extremely {hazardous}.
e.zh: 在浓雾中开车可能极其危险。

hazards.t:
n. 危险/隐患（复数）
v. 冒险（第三人称单数）

e.en: Construction sites pose many {hazards} to untrained visitors.
e.zh: 施工现场对未受训的访客存在诸多危险。

e.en: He flicked on his {hazards} before pulling over.
e.zh: 他靠边停车前打开了双闪灯。

haze.t:
n. 薄雾，霾
v. 欺负新人

e.en: A thick {haze} hung over the city after the wildfire.
e.zh: 野火过后整座城市笼罩在浓厚的烟霾中。

e.en: I remember those days through a {haze} of nostalgia.
e.zh: 我对那些日子的记忆笼罩在朦胧的怀旧中。

hazel.t:
n. 榛树，浅褐色
n. 人名 黑兹尔

e.en: She has beautiful {hazel} eyes that change in sunlight.
e.zh: 她有一双在阳光下会变色的漂亮淡褐色眼睛。

e.en: The {hazel} tree dropped nuts all over the lawn.
e.zh: 榛树把坚果撒满了整个草坪。

e.en: I love a warm {hazelnut} latte on cold mornings.
e.zh: 寒冷的早晨我喜欢喝一杯温热的榛果拿铁。

e.en: Nutella is made primarily from {hazelnut} and cocoa.
e.zh: 能多益主要由榛子和可可制成。

e.en: She {hazily} remembered meeting him at a party years ago.
e.zh: 她隐约记得多年前在派对上见过他。

e.en: The mountains appeared {hazily} through the morning mist.
e.zh: 群山在晨雾中朦胧地显现。

e.en: There's some {haziness} in his recollection of that night.
e.zh: 他对那晚的回忆有些模糊不清。

e.en: The {haziness} of the photo made faces hard to identify.
e.zh: 照片的模糊使人脸难以辨认。

hazing.t: n. 对新人的欺凌戏弄

e.en: The university banned {hazing} rituals after several incidents.
e.zh: 经过数起事件后,大学禁止了入会欺凌仪式。

e.en: Fraternity {hazing} can have serious legal consequences.
e.zh: 兄弟会的欺凌新人行为可能带来严重的法律后果。

hazlitt.t: n. 姓氏 哈兹里特

e.en: William {Hazlitt} wrote brilliant essays on art and politics.
e.zh: 威廉·哈兹利特撰写了关于艺术与政治的精彩散文。

e.en: Students still read {Hazlitt} in nineteenth-century literature courses.
e.zh: 学生们至今仍在十九世纪文学课上研读哈兹利特。

e.en: My memory of that summer is pretty {hazy} now.
e.zh: 我对那个夏天的记忆现在已经相当模糊了。

e.en: The skyline looked {hazy} through the polluted afternoon air.
e.zh: 在被污染的午后空气中,天际线显得朦胧不清。

e.en: The clinic offers free {HBV} screening for new patients.
e.zh: 诊所为新患者提供免费的乙肝病毒筛查。

e.en: Doctors recommend the {HBV} vaccine for all newborns.
e.zh: 医生建议所有新生儿接种乙肝疫苗。

e.en: He stood {hatless} in the cold morning wind.
e.zh: 他没戴帽子站在清晨的寒风中。

e.en: The {hatless} runner finished the marathon despite the sun.
e.zh: 那名没戴帽子的跑者顶着太阳完成了马拉松。

e.en: The old {hatmaker} crafted each fedora entirely by hand.
e.zh: 那位老制帽匠纯手工打造每一顶软呢帽。

e.en: She apprenticed with a famous London {hatmaker} for two years.
e.zh: 她跟着伦敦一位著名制帽师当了两年学徒。

e.en: The film explores how {hatred} can divide a community.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了仇恨如何撕裂一个社区。

e.en: She felt no {hatred} toward the people who had wronged her.
e.zh: 她对那些伤害过她的人并无恨意。

e.en: All the {hats} in the shop are twenty percent off today.
e.zh: 店里所有的帽子今天打八折。

e.en: As a startup founder, she wears many {hats} every day.
e.zh: 作为创业者,她每天都要身兼数职。

e.en: The Mad {Hatter} invited Alice to a strange tea party.
e.zh: 疯帽匠邀请爱丽丝参加一场怪异的茶会。

e.en: My grandfather worked as a {hatter} in the 1950s.
e.zh: 我爷爷在五十年代当过制帽匠。

hattersley.t: n. 人名或地名 哈特斯利

e.en: The train stopped briefly at {Hattersley} station this morning.
e.zh: 火车今早在哈特斯利站短暂停靠了一下。

e.en: Roy {Hattersley} served as a senior Labour politician for decades.
e.zh: 罗伊·哈特斯利曾担任工党资深政治家数十年。

hatton.t: n. 人名／地名 哈顿

e.en: Ricky {Hatton} was once a champion British boxer.
e.zh: 里基·哈顿曾是英国的拳击冠军。

e.en: We met for coffee near {Hatton} Garden in London.
e.zh: 我们在伦敦哈顿花园附近见面喝咖啡。

e.en: She {haughtily} refused to shake his hand at the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会上傲慢地拒绝与他握手。

e.en: He spoke {haughtily} to the waiter, embarrassing everyone.
e.zh: 他对服务员说话趾高气扬,弄得大家都很尴尬。

e.en: Her {haughtiness} made it hard to work with her on the team.
e.zh: 她的傲慢让团队里的人很难与她合作。

e.en: There was a hint of {haughtiness} in his polite reply.
e.zh: 他礼貌的回答中透着一丝高傲。

e.en: The {haughty} duchess refused to mingle with the guests.
e.zh: 那位高傲的公爵夫人不愿与客人们交谈。

e.en: He gave me a {haughty} look when I asked for help.
e.zh: 我请他帮忙时,他给了我一个傲慢的眼神。

haul.t:
v. 拖、拽、运输
n. 一次的收获量

e.en: It's a long {haul} from Beijing to Lhasa by train.
e.zh: 从北京到拉萨坐火车路途遥远。

e.en: She filmed a clothing {haul} video for her followers.
e.zh: 她为粉丝拍了一期服装购物分享视频。

e.en: The {haulage} company moved heavy machinery across Europe.
e.zh: 这家货运公司在欧洲各地运输重型机械。

e.en: Rising fuel prices have pushed up {haulage} costs sharply.
e.zh: 燃油价格上涨大幅推高了运输成本。

e.en: The truck {hauler} delivered the steel beams overnight.
e.zh: 那辆运输卡车连夜把钢梁运到了。

e.en: He works as a long-distance {hauler} along the highway.
e.zh: 他在高速公路上跑长途货运。

haulier.t: n. 货运公司、卡车司机

e.en: The {haulier} apologized for the late delivery of the goods.
e.zh: 那家货运公司为货物延迟送达道歉。

e.en: British {haulier} firms faced new customs rules after Brexit.
e.zh: 英国货运公司在脱欧后面临新的海关规定。

hauling.t: v. 拖运、搬运（haul 的现在分词）

e.en: The truck was {hauling} timber down the mountain road.
e.zh: 那辆卡车正沿着山路把木材运下来。

e.en: He spent the morning {hauling} boxes up to the attic.
e.zh: 他一上午都在把箱子搬到阁楼上。

e.en: The lion sat back on its {haunch} and yawned.
e.zh: 狮子用后腿坐着打了个哈欠。

e.en: He rested on one {haunch} while tying his shoelace.
e.zh: 他蹲在一条腿上系鞋带。

haunt.t:
v. (鬼魂) 出没；萦绕心头
n. 常去之处

e.en: That regret will {haunt} him for the rest of his life.
e.zh: 那份遗憾会困扰他一辈子。

e.en: This little café used to be our favorite weekend {haunt}.
e.zh: 这家小咖啡馆曾是我们周末最爱的去处。

haunted.t: adj. 闹鬼的；(表情) 忧虑的

e.en: The kids dared each other to enter the {haunted} house.
e.zh: 孩子们互相打赌看谁敢进那间鬼屋。

e.en: He looked {haunted} after reading the unexpected message.
e.zh: 读完那条意外的消息后,他神情忧郁不安。

haunting.t: adj. 萦绕心头的、难以忘怀的

e.en: The film features a beautifully {haunting} piano soundtrack.
e.zh: 这部电影配有一段美得令人难忘的钢琴配乐。

e.en: Her eyes had a {haunting} sadness that stayed with me.
e.zh: 她眼中那种萦绕心头的悲伤让我久久难忘。

e.en: The melody was {hauntingly} familiar, though I'd never heard it.
e.zh: 那段旋律熟悉得让人难以释怀,可我从未听过。

e.en: She sang the old folk song {hauntingly} well.
e.zh: 她把那首古老民谣唱得动人心魄。

haunts.t:
n. 常去的地方
v. 萦绕、作祟

e.en: He returned to his old college {haunts} after twenty years.
e.zh: 二十年后他重返大学时代常去的地方。

e.en: The memory of that mistake still {haunts} her today.
e.zh: 那个错误的记忆至今仍困扰着她。

e.en: Many people in northern Nigeria speak {Hausa} as their first language.
e.zh: 尼日利亚北部许多人以豪萨语为母语。

e.en: She's learning {Hausa} for her upcoming trip to West Africa.
e.zh: 她正在学豪萨语,准备去西非旅行。

haussmann.t: n. 人名 奥斯曼（巴黎改造者）

e.en: Baron {Haussmann} redesigned much of central Paris in the 1860s.
e.zh: 奥斯曼男爵在十九世纪六十年代重新设计了巴黎市中心大部分地区。

e.en: The wide boulevards of Paris are a legacy of {Haussmann}.
e.zh: 巴黎宽阔的林荫大道是奥斯曼留下的遗产。

haute.t: adj. 高级的、上等的（法语借词）

e.en: She dreams of working in {haute} couture in Paris one day.
e.zh: 她梦想有一天能在巴黎的高级定制时装界工作。

e.en: The restaurant serves {haute} cuisine at surprisingly reasonable prices.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应高级料理,价格却出乎意料地合理。

e.en: She greeted her rivals with cool {hauteur} at the gala.
e.zh: 她在晚会上以冷淡的傲气向对手们打招呼。

e.en: His {hauteur} alienated even his closest colleagues.
e.zh: 他的高傲让连最亲近的同事也疏远了他。

hav.t: v. have 的非正式拼写

e.en: In casual texts, people often type "{hav}" instead of "have".
e.zh: 在随意的短信里,人们常打“hav”来代替“have”。

e.en: She wrote "i {hav} time tomorrow" in her quick reply.
e.zh: 她在快速回复里写道:“我明天有空”。

e.en: We spent a wonderful week exploring old {Havana} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在哈瓦那老城逛了愉快的一周。

e.en: He lit a {Havana} cigar after dinner on the balcony.
e.zh: 他晚饭后在阳台上点了一支哈瓦那雪茄。

havant.t: n. 英国地名 哈万特

e.en: They live in {Havant}, a small town near Portsmouth.
e.zh: 他们住在哈万特,朴茨茅斯附近的一个小镇。

e.en: The train to {Havant} leaves from platform three.
e.zh: 开往哈万特的火车从三号站台发车。

have.t: v. 有、拥有；(助动词) 构成完成时

e.en: Do you {have} a moment to discuss the project?
e.zh: 你有空讨论一下这个项目吗?

e.en: We {have} already finished all the assigned homework.
e.zh: 我们已经把布置的作业都做完了。

e.en: Václav {Havel} led the Velvet Revolution in Czechoslovakia.
e.zh: 瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔领导了捷克斯洛伐克的天鹅绒革命。

e.en: I just finished reading a biography of {Havel} last night.
e.zh: 我昨晚刚读完一本哈维尔的传记。

havelock.t: n. 军帽后的护颈布；人名

e.en: The soldier wore a {havelock} to shield his neck from the sun.
e.zh: 士兵戴着护颈帽以遮挡阳光。

e.en: Old paintings show officers in white {havelock} caps.
e.zh: 旧画作中军官戴着白色的护颈军帽。

e.en: The small café became a {haven} for tired writers.
e.zh: 这家小咖啡馆成了疲惫作家们的避风港。

e.en: Iceland is a {haven} for travelers seeking quiet.
e.zh: 冰岛是寻求宁静的旅行者的天堂。

havens.t: n. 避难所、港湾（haven 的复数）

e.en: Tropical islands are popular tax {havens} for corporations.
e.zh: 热带岛屿是企业常用的避税天堂。

e.en: City parks serve as urban {havens} for migrating birds.
e.zh: 城市公园是候鸟在都市中的栖息地。

e.en: We drove through {Haverfordwest} on the way to the Welsh coast.
e.zh: 我们去威尔士海岸途中经过哈弗福德韦斯特。

e.en: {Haverfordwest} has a charming medieval castle ruin.
e.zh: 哈弗福德韦斯特有一座迷人的中世纪城堡遗迹。

havering.t:
v. 犹豫不决
n. 伦敦自治市 黑弗灵

e.en: Stop {havering} and just pick a restaurant already.
e.zh: 别再犹豫不决了,赶紧选一家餐厅吧。

e.en: He kept {havering} between accepting the job and staying home.
e.zh: 他在接受工作和留在家里之间犹豫不定。

havers.t: n. 废话、胡言（苏格兰方言）

e.en: She always {havers} when asked to make big decisions.
e.zh: 每当要做重大决定时她总是犹豫不决。

e.en: Don't talk such {havers} about ghosts in the attic.
e.zh: 别胡扯什么阁楼里有鬼的废话。

e.en: He packed sandwiches into his canvas {haversack} for the hike.
e.zh: 他把三明治装进帆布背包准备去徒步。

e.en: The soldier's {haversack} carried rations and a water bottle.
e.zh: 士兵的行军背包里装着口粮和水壶。

having.t: v. 拥有、正在进行（have 的现在分词）

e.en: I'm {having} trouble logging into my account today.
e.zh: 我今天登录账号时遇到了麻烦。

e.en: We're {having} pizza for dinner tonight.
e.zh: 我们今晚吃披萨当晚餐。

e.en: The storm wreaked {havoc} on the coastal villages.
e.zh: 风暴对沿海村庄造成了严重破坏。

e.en: A single bug can cause {havoc} in production systems.
e.zh: 一个小漏洞就能让生产系统陷入混乱。

havre.t: n. 法国港市 勒阿弗尔

e.en: The ferry from Portsmouth arrives in Le {Havre} by morning.
e.zh: 从朴茨茅斯出发的渡轮清晨抵达勒阿弗尔。

e.en: Le {Havre} is a major port city in northern France.
e.zh: 勒阿弗尔是法国北部的一座主要港口城市。

haw.t:
n. 山楂果
v. 支吾 (hem and haw)

e.en: He hemmed and {haw}ed before finally answering the question.
e.zh: 他支支吾吾了好久才回答这个问题。

e.en: Birds love to eat the red {haw} berries in winter.
e.zh: 鸟儿喜欢在冬天吃红色的山楂果。

e.en: We're flying to {Hawaii} for our honeymoon next month.
e.zh: 我们下个月要飞去夏威夷度蜜月。

e.en: {Hawaii} became the fiftieth U.S. state in 1959.
e.zh: 夏威夷于1959年成为美国第五十个州。

hawaiian.t:
adj. 夏威夷的
n. 夏威夷人／语

e.en: She wore a colorful {Hawaiian} shirt to the beach party.
e.zh: 她穿着色彩鲜艳的夏威夷衬衫去海滩派对。

e.en: {Hawaiian} pizza famously combines ham and pineapple.
e.zh: 夏威夷披萨以火腿配菠萝而闻名。

hawes.t: n. 姓氏或地名 霍斯

e.en: The market town of {Hawes} is famous for Wensleydale cheese.
e.zh: 霍斯小镇以温斯利代尔奶酪闻名。

e.en: We stayed overnight in {Hawes} during our Yorkshire trip.
e.zh: 我们在约克郡旅行时在霍斯过了一夜。

hawk.t:
n. 鹰、隼；主战派
v. 沿街叫卖

e.en: A {hawk} circled high above the open field.
e.zh: 一只鹰在开阔的田野上空盘旋。

e.en: Street vendors {hawk} souvenirs to tourists near the plaza.
e.zh: 街头小贩在广场附近向游客兜售纪念品。

hci.t: n. 人机交互（human-computer interaction 缩写）

e.en: She studied {HCI} to design more intuitive mobile apps.
e.zh: 她学习人机交互以设计更直观的手机应用。

e.en: The {HCI} lab tests how users interact with prototypes.
e.zh: 人机交互实验室测试用户如何与原型互动。

e.en: The lab uses dilute {HCl} to clean the glassware.
e.zh: 实验室用稀盐酸清洗玻璃器皿。

e.en: Stomach acid contains {HCl} to help digest food.
e.zh: 胃酸中含有盐酸来帮助消化食物。

e.en: Bicarbonate is written as {HCO}3 minus in chemistry class.
e.zh: 碳酸氢根在化学课上写作HCO3负离子。

e.en: Blood tests measure {HCO}3 levels to check acid balance.
e.zh: 血液检查会测HCO3水平以判断酸碱平衡。

e.en: Exercise helps raise your {HDL} cholesterol levels.
e.zh: 运动有助于提高你的高密度脂蛋白胆固醇水平。

e.en: Doctors call {HDL} the good cholesterol in your blood.
e.zh: 医生把HDL称为血液中的好胆固醇。

e.en: We finally upgraded to a 65-inch {HDTV} last weekend.
e.zh: 我们上周末终于换了一台65英寸的高清电视。

e.en: The game looks amazing on this new {HDTV}.
e.zh: 这款游戏在新高清电视上看起来棒极了。

head.t:
n. 头；负责人
v. 率领；前往

e.en: She turned her {head} when someone called her name.
e.zh: 有人叫她名字时她转过头。

e.en: He is the {head} of the engineering department now.
e.zh: 他现在是工程部门的负责人。

headache.t: n. 头痛；令人头疼的事

e.en: I have a terrible {headache} after staring at screens.
e.zh: 盯着屏幕看完我头疼得厉害。

e.en: Tax season is always a huge {headache} for freelancers.
e.zh: 报税季对自由职业者来说总是个大麻烦。

e.en: She gets frequent {headaches} from skipping meals.
e.zh: 她常因不吃饭而头疼。

e.en: The new software caused endless {headaches} for the team.
e.zh: 新软件给团队带来了无尽的麻烦。

e.en: She wore a sweat-absorbing {headband} during her morning run.
e.zh: 她晨跑时戴着一条吸汗的发带。

e.en: The yoga teacher tied a colorful {headband} around her hair.
e.zh: 瑜伽老师在头发上系了一条彩色发带。

headbanger.t: n. 重金属乐迷（随音乐甩头的人）

e.en: He is a total {headbanger} at every metal concert.
e.zh: 他在每场金属演唱会上都是个疯狂甩头的乐迷。

e.en: That new song is a real {headbanger} from start to finish.
e.zh: 那首新歌从头到尾都让人忍不住甩头。

e.en: She picked a velvet {headboard} for the master bedroom.
e.zh: 她为主卧挑了一个天鹅绒床头板。

e.en: He hit his elbow on the wooden {headboard} last night.
e.zh: 他昨晚胳膊肘撞到了木制床头板。

e.en: Please email me the final {headcount} for the dinner.
e.zh: 请把晚餐的最终人数发邮件告诉我。

e.en: The team is doubling its {headcount} next quarter.
e.zh: 该团队下季度将把员工人数翻倍。

e.en: The dancer wore an elaborate feathered {headdress} on stage.
e.zh: 舞者在台上戴着精致的羽毛头饰。

e.en: The bride's beaded {headdress} caught the afternoon light.
e.zh: 新娘的串珠头饰在午后的阳光下闪闪发亮。

headed.t:
v. 前往（head 的过去式）
adj. 有…头的

e.en: We {headed} downtown for dinner after the meeting.
e.zh: 开完会后我们就前往市中心吃晚饭。

e.en: The project is clearly {headed} in the wrong direction.
e.zh: 这个项目显然正朝错误的方向发展。

header.t:
n. 页眉；标头
n. 头球

e.en: Add a sticky {header} so users can always see navigation.
e.zh: 添加一个固定页头,这样用户始终能看到导航。

e.en: He scored on a powerful {header} in extra time.
e.zh: 他在加时赛中用一记有力的头球破门。

e.en: He dove {headfirst} into the cold mountain lake.
e.zh: 他一头扎进了冰冷的山间湖水里。

e.en: She jumped {headfirst} into her new startup last year.
e.zh: 去年她一头扎进了自己的新创业项目。

e.en: All players must wear protective {headgear} during practice.
e.zh: 所有球员训练时必须佩戴防护头具。

e.en: His braces came with awkward nighttime {headgear}.
e.zh: 他的牙套还配了一副夜间戴的笨重头套。

e.en: Top firms aggressively {headhunt} engineers from competitors.
e.zh: 顶尖公司会积极从竞争对手那里挖角工程师。

e.en: Several agencies tried to {headhunt} her this spring.
e.zh: 今年春天有好几家猎头公司想挖她。

e.en: A {headhunter} contacted me about a senior role.
e.zh: 一位猎头联系我谈一个高级职位。

e.en: She works as a tech {headhunter} in San Francisco.
e.zh: 她在旧金山做科技行业的猎头。

headhunting.t: n. 猎头（高级人才招聘）

e.en: The agency specializes in {headhunting} machine learning experts.
e.zh: 该机构专门猎聘机器学习专家。

e.en: Aggressive {headhunting} has driven up engineering salaries lately.
e.zh: 激进的猎头行为最近推高了工程师的薪资。

heading.t:
n. 标题
v. 前往中

e.en: We are {heading} to the airport in twenty minutes.
e.zh: 我们二十分钟后就要前往机场。

e.en: Each section starts with a bold {heading} in blue.
e.zh: 每个章节都以蓝色粗体标题开头。

e.en: She lives in {Headington}, just east of central Oxford.
e.zh: 她住在海丁顿,就在牛津市中心以东。

e.en: The hospital in {Headington} treats patients from across England.
e.zh: 海丁顿的这家医院接收来自全英格兰的病人。

e.en: Always pack a {headlamp} when camping in the mountains.
e.zh: 在山里露营时一定要带上头灯。

e.en: The cyclist's {headlamp} cut through the foggy morning air.
e.zh: 骑行者的头灯划破了多雾的清晨空气。

e.en: The lighthouse stands on a windswept {headland} above the sea.
e.zh: 那座灯塔矗立在海上一处大风呼啸的海角上。

e.en: We hiked along the {headland} to watch the sunset.
e.zh: 我们沿着海岬徒步去看日落。

e.en: Many companies now use a {headless} CMS for flexibility.
e.zh: 许多公司现在使用无头CMS以获得更大灵活性。

e.en: The old statue stood {headless} in the museum garden.
e.zh: 那尊古老的雕像在博物馆花园里无头矗立着。

e.en: One {headlight} flickered as the car turned the corner.
e.zh: 汽车转弯时,一只前灯闪了一下。

e.en: He replaced the broken {headlight} before the road trip.
e.zh: 自驾游之前他换掉了那只坏掉的车前灯。

headline.t:
n. 头条新闻
v. 担任主角

e.en: That shocking {headline} went viral within an hour.
e.zh: 那条惊人的头条一小时内就刷屏了。

e.en: Taylor Swift will {headline} the festival on Saturday night.
e.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特将在周六晚的音乐节担任压轴。

headlined.t: v. 登上头条；担任主演

e.en: The band {headlined} Coachella for the very first time.
e.zh: 该乐队首次在科切拉音乐节担任压轴演出。

e.en: Her resignation {headlined} every major newspaper that morning.
e.zh: 那天早上她的辞职登上了各大报纸头条。

headliner.t: n. 头牌演员，主打嘉宾

e.en: Beyoncé was the surprise {headliner} at the festival.
e.zh: 碧昂丝是音乐节的惊喜压轴艺人。

e.en: Tickets sold out once they announced the {headliner}.
e.zh: 压轴艺人一公布,门票就售罄了。

e.en: His arrest made international {headlines} overnight.
e.zh: 他被捕的消息一夜之间登上了国际头条。

e.en: I skim the morning {headlines} while drinking coffee.
e.zh: 我喝咖啡时会浏览一下早间头条新闻。

e.en: She is {headlining} a sold-out tour across Europe.
e.zh: 她正在欧洲各地担任一场场满座巡演的压轴。

e.en: That scandal is {headlining} every news site today.
e.zh: 那起丑闻今天占据了所有新闻网站的头条。

e.en: The wrestler caught his opponent in a tight {headlock}.
e.zh: 那名摔跤手将对手紧紧锁住了脖子。

e.en: His older brother put him in a playful {headlock}.
e.zh: 他哥哥开玩笑地把他锁住了脖子。

e.en: She rushed {headlong} into the new relationship.
e.zh: 她不顾一切地一头扎进了这段新恋情。

e.en: The country plunged {headlong} into an economic crisis.
e.zh: 该国一头栽进了经济危机。

e.en: The village {headman} welcomed us with hot tea.
e.zh: 村长用热茶招待了我们。

e.en: Disputes are usually settled by the local {headman}.
e.zh: 纠纷通常由当地的村长出面解决。

e.en: The new {headmaster} introduced stricter phone policies last term.
e.zh: 新校长上学期推行了更严格的手机管理规定。

e.en: Students lined up to greet the visiting {headmaster}.
e.zh: 学生们排队迎接来访的校长。

e.en: The {headmistress} addressed parents at the morning assembly.
e.zh: 女校长在早会上向家长们讲话。

e.en: Our {headmistress} pushed hard for new science labs.
e.zh: 我们的女校长极力争取建新的科学实验室。

e.en: Three former {headmistresses} attended the school's centenary celebration.
e.zh: 三位前女校长出席了学校的百年校庆。

e.en: The conference brought together {headmistresses} from across the country.
e.zh: 这次会议汇集了来自全国各地的女校长。

headnote.t: n. 题头注释；判例摘要

e.en: Read the {headnote} before diving into the court opinion.
e.zh: 在深入阅读判决意见之前先看一下案例提要。

e.en: Each case starts with a clear {headnote} summarizing the ruling.
e.zh: 每个案例开头都有一段清晰的提要总结裁决。

e.en: Plug your {headphone} cable into the bottom of the laptop.
e.zh: 把你的耳机线插到笔记本底部。

e.en: This {headphone} jack still works on older phones.
e.zh: 这个耳机插孔在旧款手机上仍然能用。

e.en: I bought noise-cancelling {headphones} for my long flights.
e.zh: 我买了降噪耳机,用于长途飞行。

e.en: She wears {headphones} all day to focus on coding.
e.zh: 她整天戴着耳机以便专心写代码。

e.en: The bride wore a delicate pearl {headpiece} down the aisle.
e.zh: 新娘戴着一件精致的珍珠头饰走过红毯。

e.en: His costume included a feathered {headpiece} for the play.
e.zh: 他这部戏的服装里包括一件羽毛头饰。

e.en: The startup chose to {headquarter} its operations in Singapore.
e.zh: 这家初创公司选择把总部设在新加坡。

e.en: Many tech firms {headquarter} themselves near top universities.
e.zh: 许多科技公司把总部设在顶尖大学附近。

e.en: Apple's sleek new {headquarters} sits in Cupertino, California.
e.zh: 苹果时尚的新总部坐落在加州库比蒂诺。

e.en: The company moved its {headquarters} from Boston to Austin.
e.zh: 该公司把总部从波士顿迁到了奥斯汀。

e.en: Adjust the {headrest} so it supports the back of your skull.
e.zh: 调好头枕,让它能托住后脑勺。

e.en: The car's leather {headrest} smelled brand new.
e.zh: 车子的皮质头枕散发着崭新的味道。

headroom.t: n. 头顶空间；净空高度

e.en: Tall passengers appreciate the SUV's generous {headroom}.
e.zh: 高个子乘客很欣赏这款SUV宽敞的头部空间。

e.en: The team still has plenty of {headroom} to grow revenue.
e.zh: 该团队的营收增长仍有很大空间。

heads.t:
n. 硬币正面
v. 率领（第三人称）

e.en: Everyone turned their {heads} when the celebrity walked in.
e.zh: 那位名人走进来时,大家都转头看过去。

e.en: She {heads} the marketing team at a fintech startup.
e.zh: 她在一家金融科技创业公司领导市场团队。

e.en: She tied a silk {headscarf} before stepping into the wind.
e.zh: 她在迎风走出去之前系上了一条丝绸头巾。

e.en: The patterned {headscarf} matched her flowing summer dress.
e.zh: 那条带花纹的头巾和她飘逸的夏装很搭。

e.en: The agent answered calls through a wireless {headset}.
e.zh: 客服通过无线耳机接听电话。

e.en: He tested the new VR {headset} for almost an hour.
e.zh: 他试用了那款新VR头显将近一个小时。

headship.t: n. 领导职位；校长职位

e.en: She accepted the {headship} of the history department last fall.
e.zh: 去年秋天她接受了历史系系主任的职位。

e.en: Competition for the school's {headship} grew unusually fierce.
e.zh: 该校校长一职的竞争变得异常激烈。

headshot.t:
n. 头像照片
n. 爆头（射击游戏）

e.en: She updated her LinkedIn profile with a professional {headshot}.
e.zh: 她用一张专业的头像更新了领英资料。

e.en: The sniper landed a clean {headshot} from across the map.
e.zh: 狙击手从地图另一端干净利落地爆头。

headspace.t: n. 心理状态；思维空间

e.en: I need some {headspace} before tackling that report.
e.zh: 在处理那份报告前我需要一点思考空间。

e.en: Meditation gives me the {headspace} to focus better.
e.zh: 冥想让我有更清晰的心境去专注。

e.en: Reading the syllabus early gave her a {headstart} on classmates.
e.zh: 提前读教学大纲让她比同学抢先一步。

e.en: The early funding gave the startup a real {headstart}.
e.zh: 早期融资让这家初创公司真正抢占了先机。

e.en: The guitar's {headstock} cracked when it fell off the stand.
e.zh: 吉他从架子上掉下来时琴头裂了。

e.en: He polished the lathe's {headstock} before starting work.
e.zh: 他在开工前擦亮了车床的主轴箱。

e.en: They placed fresh flowers beside the granite {headstone}.
e.zh: 他们在花岗岩墓碑旁放了一束鲜花。

e.en: The {headstone} was engraved with her grandmother's name.
e.zh: 墓碑上刻着她祖母的名字。

e.en: Her {headstrong} attitude often clashed with the team lead.
e.zh: 她固执的态度常常和组长产生冲突。

e.en: The {headstrong} puppy refused to follow any commands.
e.zh: 那只倔强的小狗拒绝服从任何命令。

e.en: The {headteacher} announced new uniform rules at assembly.
e.zh: 校长在晨会上宣布了新的校服规定。

e.en: Parents emailed the {headteacher} about the schedule change.
e.zh: 家长们就课程调整给校长发了邮件。

e.en: Local {headteachers} met to discuss the new curriculum.
e.zh: 当地几位校长开会讨论新课程。

e.en: The union represents {headteachers} across the country.
e.zh: 该工会代表着全国各地的中小学校长。

e.en: The {headwaiter} showed us to a quiet corner table.
e.zh: 领班把我们带到了一张安静的角落桌。

e.en: Tip the {headwaiter} if you want better service next time.
e.zh: 如果想下次得到更好的服务,可以给领班小费。

headwall.t: n. 冰斗后壁；陡峭山壁

e.en: Climbers roped up before tackling the icy {headwall}.
e.zh: 登山者在挑战冰封陡壁前结好了绳。

e.en: The waterfall cascades down a sheer granite {headwall}.
e.zh: 瀑布顺着陡峭的花岗岩崖壁倾泻而下。

e.en: The river's {headwater} lies high in the mountains.
e.zh: 这条河的源头位于高山之中。

e.en: Pollution at the {headwater} affects the entire valley.
e.zh: 源头的污染影响着整个山谷。

e.en: We hiked to the {headwaters} of the Amazon.
e.zh: 我们徒步走到了亚马逊河的源头。

e.en: Conservation groups protect the {headwaters} from logging.
e.zh: 环保组织保护源头水域不受砍伐影响。

e.en: We're finally making real {headway} on the project.
e.zh: 我们终于在这个项目上取得了实质进展。

e.en: Negotiators struggled to make {headway} in the talks.
e.zh: 谈判人员在会谈中难以取得突破。

e.en: The shop sells stylish {headwear} for winter sports.
e.zh: 这家店出售时尚的冬季运动头饰。

e.en: Religious {headwear} is respected at our workplace.
e.zh: 我们的工作场所尊重宗教头饰。

e.en: The plane landed late due to a strong {headwind}.
e.zh: 由于强劲的逆风,飞机晚点降落。

e.en: Rising costs are a major {headwind} for small businesses.
e.zh: 成本上升是小企业面临的主要逆风。

e.en: Each dictionary entry begins with a bold {headword}.
e.zh: 每个词典条目都以一个加粗的词目开头。

e.en: The app highlights the {headword} when you tap a word.
e.zh: 点击单词时应用会高亮显示词目。

heady.t: adj. 令人陶醉的；头脑发热的

e.en: Winning the championship was a {heady} experience for the rookie.
e.zh: 赢得冠军对这位新秀来说是一次令人陶醉的经历。

e.en: The wine had a {heady} aroma of dark berries.
e.zh: 这款酒散发着浓郁的黑莓香气。

e.en: The cut should {heal} within a week.
e.zh: 伤口应该会在一周内愈合。

e.en: Time alone won't {heal} a broken friendship.
e.zh: 光靠时间是治不好破裂友情的。

e.en: The weaver replaced a broken {heald} on the loom.
e.zh: 织工换掉了织布机上一根断了的综丝。

e.en: Each {heald} guides a single warp thread through the shed.
e.zh: 每根综丝引导一根经线穿过梭口。

e.en: Her sprained ankle finally {healed} after six weeks.
e.zh: 她扭伤的脚踝过了六周终于好了。

e.en: Honest conversation {healed} the rift between the brothers.
e.zh: 坦诚的对话弥合了兄弟之间的裂痕。

e.en: The village {healer} mixed herbs into a warm tea.
e.zh: 村里的治疗师把草药泡成了热茶。

e.en: In the game, the {healer} keeps the team alive.
e.zh: 在游戏里,治疗师负责让队伍存活。

healing.t:
n. 治愈；疗愈
adj. 有疗效的

e.en: Long walks have a {healing} effect on my anxiety.
e.zh: 长时间散步对我的焦虑有疗愈作用。

e.en: The wound is {healing} faster than the doctor expected.
e.zh: 伤口愈合得比医生预期的还快。

heals.t: v. 治愈（第三人称单数）

e.en: This ointment {heals} minor burns within days.
e.zh: 这种药膏几天内就能治好轻微烫伤。

e.en: Laughter often {heals} what medicine cannot.
e.zh: 笑声常常能治愈药物无法治愈的伤痛。

e.en: Regular exercise improves both mental and physical {health}.
e.zh: 规律运动能改善身心健康。

e.en: The CEO stepped down to focus on his {health}.
e.zh: 该首席执行官辞职专心调养身体。

e.en: Affordable {healthcare} remains a top political issue.
e.zh: 可负担的医疗保健仍是重要的政治议题。

e.en: AI is transforming how {healthcare} providers diagnose patients.
e.zh: 人工智能正在改变医疗机构诊断病人的方式。

healthcares.t: n. 医疗保健（复数少用）

e.en: Global {healthcares} differ widely in coverage and quality.
e.zh: 各国医疗体系在覆盖范围与质量上差异很大。

e.en: The summit compared national {healthcares} across Europe.
e.zh: 峰会比较了欧洲各国的医疗体系。

e.en: She prepares {healthful} meals for the whole family.
e.zh: 她为全家人准备有益健康的饭菜。

e.en: Spending time outdoors is genuinely {healthful}.
e.zh: 在户外活动确实有益健康。

e.en: He cooks {healthfully} using olive oil and fresh herbs.
e.zh: 他用橄榄油和新鲜香草做出健康的菜肴。

e.en: Living {healthfully} requires both diet and sleep discipline.
e.zh: 健康地生活需要饮食和睡眠的双重自律。

e.en: Studies confirm the {healthfulness} of a Mediterranean diet.
e.zh: 研究证实地中海饮食对健康有益。

e.en: The label exaggerates the {healthfulness} of the snack.
e.zh: 标签夸大了这款零食的健康程度。

e.en: He eats {healthily} despite his packed work schedule.
e.zh: 尽管工作很忙,他依然吃得很健康。

e.en: The plants grew {healthily} on the sunny windowsill.
e.zh: 那些植物在阳光充足的窗台上长得很健康。

e.en: A {healthy} breakfast sets you up for the day.
e.zh: 健康的早餐能为一天打下好基础。

e.en: The startup posted {healthy} revenue growth this quarter.
e.zh: 这家初创公司本季度收入增长良好。

heap.t:
n. 一堆；堆（内存）
v. 堆积

e.en: He dropped his clothes in a {heap} on the floor.
e.zh: 他把衣服一堆扔在地板上。

e.en: She has a {heap} of unread messages to deal with.
e.zh: 她有一大堆未读消息要处理。

e.en: The waiter set down a plate {heaped} with pasta.
e.zh: 服务员端上来一盘堆得满满的意面。

e.en: Critics {heaped} praise on her debut novel.
e.zh: 评论家对她的处女作赞不绝口。

e.en: Add a {heaping} spoonful of cocoa to the batter.
e.zh: 在面糊里加满满一勺可可粉。

e.en: Fans were {heaping} flowers at the singer's memorial.
e.zh: 粉丝们在歌手的纪念地堆放了大量鲜花。

e.en: There are {heaps} of leftover pizza in the fridge.
e.zh: 冰箱里还剩好多披萨。

e.en: Workers cleared {heaps} of leaves from the park paths.
e.zh: 工人们清理了公园小路上一堆堆的落叶。

e.en: I can barely {hear} you over the traffic.
e.zh: 路上车声太吵,我几乎听不见你说话。

e.en: Did you {hear} about the new café downtown?
e.zh: 你听说市中心新开的那家咖啡馆了吗?

e.en: I've never {heard} this song before — who's the artist?
e.zh: 我从没听过这首歌,是谁唱的?

e.en: She felt {heard} for the first time in that meeting.
e.zh: 在那次会议上她第一次感到自己被倾听。

e.en: A skilled speaker adapts the message to each {hearer}.
e.zh: 出色的演讲者会让信息贴合每位听众。

e.en: The story moved every {hearer} in the room.
e.zh: 这个故事打动了房间里的每一位听众。

e.en: My grandfather's {hearing} has gotten worse this year.
e.zh: 我爷爷今年的听力变差了。

e.en: The court scheduled a {hearing} for next Monday.
e.zh: 法院将听证会安排在下周一。

e.en: Senate {hearings} on the bill begin next week.
e.zh: 参议院关于该法案的听证会下周开始。

e.en: Reporters camped outside the courthouse during the {hearings}.
e.zh: 听证会期间记者们守在法院外。

e.en: {Hearken} to the wisdom of those who came before us.
e.zh: 请聆听前人留下的智慧。

e.en: The retro design {hearken} back to the 1980s arcade era.
e.zh: 这款复古设计让人回想起八十年代的街机时代。

hears.t: v. 听见（第三人称单数）

e.en: She always {hears} the kettle whistle from upstairs.
e.zh: 她在楼上总能听见水壶响。

e.en: He never {hears} criticism without taking it personally.
e.zh: 他每次听到批评都会往心里去。

e.en: The judge dismissed the testimony as mere {hearsay}.
e.zh: 法官认为该证词只是道听途说,予以驳回。

e.en: Don't trust office gossip — it's all {hearsay}.
e.zh: 别信办公室的八卦,那都是道听途说。

e.en: The black {hearse} led the funeral procession slowly.
e.zh: 黑色的灵车缓缓领着送葬队伍前行。

e.en: A vintage {hearse} was parked outside the chapel.
e.zh: 一辆老式灵车停在小教堂外。

e.en: Running every morning is good for your {heart}.
e.zh: 每天早上跑步对心脏有益。

e.en: Her speech really touched my {heart}.
e.zh: 她的演讲真的打动了我的心。

e.en: The reunion video was a truly {heart-warming} moment.
e.zh: 那段重逢视频真是温暖人心。

e.en: She shared a {heart-warming} story about her rescue dog.
e.zh: 她分享了一个关于救助犬的暖心故事。

e.en: The breakup caused her months of {heartache}.
e.zh: 那次分手让她伤心了好几个月。

e.en: Losing the championship was pure {heartache} for the team.
e.zh: 输掉冠军赛对球队来说是彻头彻尾的心痛。

e.en: The doctor listened carefully to the baby's {heartbeat}.
e.zh: 医生仔细地听了听宝宝的心跳。

e.en: I'd move to Tokyo in a {heartbeat} if offered the job.
e.zh: 如果有这份工作,我会立刻搬到东京。

e.en: Missing the goal in extra time caused real {heartbreak}.
e.zh: 加时赛中错失进球真是令人心碎。

e.en: Her latest album is full of songs about {heartbreak}.
e.zh: 她的新专辑里满是关于心碎的歌。

e.en: That last-minute loss was a real {heartbreaker} for fans.
e.zh: 最后时刻的失利让球迷们心碎不已。

e.en: He has a reputation as a charming {heartbreaker}.
e.zh: 他被认为是个迷人的情场杀手。

e.en: The documentary tells a {heartbreaking} story of wartime loss.
e.zh: 这部纪录片讲述了一个令人心碎的战争失去亲人的故事。

e.en: Losing the final by one point was {heartbreaking}.
e.zh: 以一分之差输掉决赛真是令人心碎。

e.en: The film is {heartbreakingly} honest about grief.
e.zh: 这部电影对悲伤的描绘真实得让人心碎。

e.en: She sang {heartbreakingly} of the friend she had lost.
e.zh: 她用令人心碎的歌声唱着失去的朋友。

e.en: He was {heartbroken} when his dog passed away.
e.zh: 他的狗去世时他伤心欲绝。

e.en: Fans were {heartbroken} by the band's breakup announcement.
e.zh: 乐队宣布解散时粉丝们都心碎了。

e.en: Spicy food gives me terrible {heartburn} at night.
e.zh: 辛辣食物让我晚上胃灼热得厉害。

e.en: She took an antacid to relieve her {heartburn}.
e.zh: 她吃了一片抗酸药来缓解胃灼热。

hearted.t: adj. 有…心肠的（构词成分）

e.en: He's a kind-{hearted} man who volunteers every weekend.
e.zh: 他是一个心地善良的人,每个周末都去做义工。

e.en: The light-{hearted} comedy was perfect for a tired evening.
e.zh: 这部轻松的喜剧很适合疲惫的夜晚观看。

e.en: The team's comeback should {hearten} every loyal fan.
e.zh: 球队的逆转应该会让每位忠实球迷振奋起来。

e.en: Kind words from strangers can truly {hearten} someone struggling.
e.zh: 陌生人的善言真的能让正在挣扎的人重燃信心。

e.en: I was {heartened} by the community's generous response.
e.zh: 社区慷慨的回应让我深受鼓舞。

e.en: Doctors were {heartened} by the patient's rapid recovery.
e.zh: 病人迅速的康复让医生们倍感欣慰。

e.en: It's {heartening} to see neighbors helping each other rebuild.
e.zh: 看到邻居们互相帮助重建家园真令人感到欣慰。

e.en: The latest sales numbers are genuinely {heartening} for the team.
e.zh: 最新的销售数据真的让团队备受鼓舞。

e.en: She gave a {heartfelt} apology to her former colleague.
e.zh: 她向以前的同事真诚地道了歉。

e.en: The speech ended with {heartfelt} thanks to all volunteers.
e.zh: 演讲以对所有志愿者的衷心感谢作结。

e.en: The cat curled up beside the warm {hearth}.
e.zh: 那只猫蜷缩在温暖的壁炉边。

e.en: They hung stockings above the {hearth} on Christmas Eve.
e.zh: 圣诞夜他们把袜子挂在壁炉上方。

e.en: The dog slept happily on the {hearthrug} every evening.
e.zh: 那只狗每晚都开心地躺在壁炉前的地毯上睡觉。

e.en: Grandma knitted a thick woolen {hearthrug} last winter.
e.zh: 奶奶去年冬天织了一块厚实的羊毛壁炉地毯。

e.en: We told ghost stories at the cozy {hearthside}.
e.zh: 我们围坐在温馨的炉边讲鬼故事。

e.en: He spent winter evenings reading by the {hearthside}.
e.zh: 他冬天的晚上常在炉边读书。

e.en: The old {hearthstone} was cracked from decades of fires.
e.zh: 那块古老的炉床石因几十年的烧火而出现了裂痕。

e.en: She swept ashes off the {hearthstone} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早晨把炉床石上的灰扫干净。

e.en: The audience laughed {heartily} at the comedian's punchline.
e.zh: 观众听到那位喜剧演员的笑点后开怀大笑。

e.en: I {heartily} recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting.
e.zh: 我衷心向每位来访的人推荐这家餐厅。

e.en: His {heartiness} at breakfast made everyone smile.
e.zh: 他早餐时的热情劲儿让大家都笑了起来。

e.en: The soup's {heartiness} made it perfect for cold nights.
e.zh: 这汤的浓郁醇厚让它在寒夜里格外合适。

e.en: Country music remains popular across America's rural {heartland}.
e.zh: 乡村音乐在美国农村腹地依然广受欢迎。

e.en: The campaign focused on voters in the industrial {heartland}.
e.zh: 竞选活动把重点放在了工业腹地的选民身上。

e.en: Firing him on his birthday seemed truly {heartless}.
e.zh: 在他生日那天解雇他实在是太冷酷无情了。

e.en: The {heartless} villain showed no mercy to anyone.
e.zh: 那个冷酷无情的反派对任何人都不留情面。

e.en: He {heartlessly} ignored the homeless man's plea for help.
e.zh: 他冷酷地无视了那个流浪汉的求助。

e.en: The landlord {heartlessly} evicted the family right before Christmas.
e.zh: 房东在圣诞节前冷酷地把那家人赶了出去。

e.en: The {heartlessness} of the decision shocked the entire community.
e.zh: 这个决定的冷酷无情震惊了整个社区。

e.en: His {heartlessness} toward animals revealed his true character.
e.zh: 他对动物的冷酷无情暴露了他真实的本性。

e.en: The refugee's {heartrending} testimony moved everyone in the room.
e.zh: 那位难民令人心碎的陈述感动了房间里的每个人。

e.en: She wrote a {heartrending} letter to her estranged father.
e.zh: 她给疏远多年的父亲写了一封令人心碎的信。

hearts.t: n. 红桃（扑克花色）；心（复数）

e.en: The charity drive won the {hearts} of local residents.
e.zh: 这次慈善活动赢得了当地居民的心。

e.en: He drew tiny {hearts} in the margins of her notebook.
e.zh: 他在她笔记本的页边画了许多小小的心形。

e.en: She felt {heartsick} after reading the rejection email.
e.zh: 读完那封拒绝邮件后她感到心如刀割。

e.en: He was {heartsick} over leaving his hometown forever.
e.zh: 想到要永远离开家乡他便心如死灰。

heartstring.t: n. 心弦；内心深处的情感

e.en: That commercial about lost pets tugged at every {heartstring}.
e.zh: 那则关于走失宠物的广告触动了每个人的心弦。

e.en: Her grandmother's old letter pulled at his {heartstring}.
e.zh: 她祖母的旧信牵动了他的心弦。

e.en: That actor was the teenage {heartthrob} of the nineties.
e.zh: 那位演员是九十年代少女们的万人迷。

e.en: The new K-pop {heartthrob} sold out arenas worldwide.
e.zh: 那位新晋韩流男神在全球的演出门票都销售一空。

e.en: The video of the rescue dog reunion was {heartwarming}.
e.zh: 那段救援犬重聚的视频暖人心扉。

e.en: She shared a {heartwarming} story about her elderly neighbor.
e.zh: 她分享了一个关于她年迈邻居的暖心故事。

e.en: Furniture makers prize the dense {heartwood} of old oaks.
e.zh: 家具匠人非常珍视老橡树致密的心材。

e.en: The tree's dark {heartwood} resists rot for decades.
e.zh: 这棵树深色的心材能抗腐烂数十年。

e.en: Vets recommend monthly {heartworm} prevention for every dog.
e.zh: 兽医建议每只狗每月做一次心丝虫预防。

e.en: Mosquitoes can transmit {heartworm} to unprotected pets.
e.zh: 蚊子会把心丝虫传染给未做防护的宠物。

e.en: We enjoyed a {hearty} bowl of beef stew for dinner.
e.zh: 我们晚餐美美地吃了一碗丰盛的炖牛肉。

e.en: He gave his old friend a {hearty} handshake.
e.zh: 他热情地与老朋友握了握手。

heat.t:
n. 热；高温
v. 加热

e.en: The summer {heat} made it impossible to sleep.
e.zh: 夏天的酷热让人根本睡不着。

e.en: Please {heat} the leftover pasta in the microwave.
e.zh: 请把剩下的意大利面放微波炉加热一下。

e.en: The two candidates had a {heated} debate on television.
e.zh: 两位候选人在电视上展开了激烈的辩论。

e.en: My new car has {heated} seats for cold mornings.
e.zh: 我的新车配有加热座椅,适合寒冷的早晨。

e.en: They argued {heatedly} about who should pay the bill.
e.zh: 他们就该由谁付账激烈地争论起来。

e.en: She {heatedly} denied the rumors during the interview.
e.zh: 她在采访中激动地否认了那些谣言。

e.en: Please turn on the {heater} — it's freezing in here.
e.zh: 请把暖气开开,这里冷得要命。

e.en: The old space {heater} stopped working last winter.
e.zh: 那台老式取暖器去年冬天就坏了。

e.en: All the office {heaters} were replaced over the weekend.
e.zh: 办公室所有的暖气片都在周末被换掉了。

e.en: Patio {heaters} kept guests warm during the outdoor wedding.
e.zh: 户外婚礼期间露台暖灯让宾客们保持温暖。

e.en: They went walking across the windy purple {heath}.
e.zh: 他们漫步在那片紫色花开、风很大的荒野上。

e.en: The {heath} blooms beautifully every August in Scotland.
e.zh: 苏格兰的这片石南荒原每年八月都开得很美。

e.en: In Wuthering Heights, {Heathcliff} is the brooding antihero.
e.zh: 在《呼啸山庄》中,希斯克利夫是阴郁的反英雄人物。

e.en: She named her black cat {Heathcliff} after the novel.
e.zh: 她用那部小说里的名字给她的黑猫取名希斯克利夫。

e.en: The missionary was sent to convert so-called {heathen} tribes.
e.zh: 那位传教士被派去使所谓的异教部落皈依。

e.en: He jokingly called his coffee-hating friend a {heathen}.
e.zh: 他开玩笑地把那位讨厌咖啡的朋友称作异教徒。

e.en: Early missionaries condemned local rituals as {heathenism}.
e.zh: 早期传教士谴责当地仪式为异教崇拜。

e.en: The historian studied the persistence of {heathenism} in rural Europe.
e.zh: 那位历史学家研究了异教信仰在欧洲乡村的延续。

e.en: Purple {heather} covered the Scottish hills in late summer.
e.zh: 夏末紫色的石南花覆盖了苏格兰的山丘。

e.en: She picked some {heather} on her morning walk.
e.zh: 她在晨间散步时摘了一些石南花。

e.en: We hiked across the {heathery} moor at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时我们徒步穿过那片长满石南的沼地。

e.en: The {heathery} slopes turned bright purple in August.
e.zh: 八月里那些长满石南的山坡变成了亮紫色。

e.en: {Heathfield} is a small market town in East Sussex.
e.zh: 希思菲尔德是东萨塞克斯郡的一个小集镇。

e.en: They moved to {Heathfield} for its quieter pace of life.
e.zh: 为了更安静的生活节奏,他们搬到了希思菲尔德。

e.en: Rare birds nest in the protected southern {heathland}.
e.zh: 稀有鸟类在受保护的南部石南荒原上筑巢。

e.en: Conservationists are restoring the ancient Surrey {heathland}.
e.zh: 环保人士正在恢复古老的萨里石南荒原。

e.en: They led a {hedonistic} lifestyle in their twenties.
e.zh: 他们二十多岁时过着享乐主义的生活。

e.en: The novel portrays a {hedonistic} society in decline.
e.zh: 小说描绘了一个走向衰落的享乐主义社会。

e.en: "{Hee} hee," she giggled at the silly joke.
e.zh: "嘻嘻,"她被那个傻笑话逗乐了。

e.en: The child let out a soft "{hee}" of delight.
e.zh: 孩子高兴地发出一声轻轻的"嘻"。

heed.t:
v. 留意，注意
n. 注意

e.en: You should {heed} your doctor's advice about exercise.
e.zh: 你应该听从医生关于锻炼的建议。

e.en: She paid no {heed} to the warning signs.
e.zh: 她对警示标志毫不留意。

heedless.t: adj. 不留心的，漫不经心的

e.en: He ran across the road, {heedless} of the traffic.
e.zh: 他不顾来往车辆冲过了马路。

e.en: She remained {heedless} of her friends' concerns.
e.zh: 她对朋友们的担忧不以为意。

heedlessly.t: adv. 漫不经心地，不留心地

e.en: He spent his savings {heedlessly} on luxury items.
e.zh: 他不计后果地把积蓄花在奢侈品上。

e.en: The driver sped {heedlessly} through the residential area.
e.zh: 司机毫不在意地在居民区飞驰而过。

e.en: His {heedlessness} of safety rules caused the accident.
e.zh: 他对安全规则的漠视导致了这场事故。

e.en: The report criticized the {heedlessness} of city planners.
e.zh: 报告批评了城市规划者的疏忽大意。

e.en: I twisted my {heel} while running yesterday.
e.zh: 我昨天跑步时扭伤了脚跟。

e.en: Her left shoe {heel} broke on the cobblestones.
e.zh: 她左脚鞋跟在鹅卵石路上断了。

e.en: She wore black {heeled} boots to the interview.
e.zh: 她穿着黑色高跟靴去面试。

e.en: The yacht {heeled} sharply in the strong wind.
e.zh: 游艇在强风中急剧倾斜。

e.en: Their blue {heeler} loves to round up the sheep.
e.zh: 他们的蓝色牧牛犬喜欢驱赶羊群。

e.en: A {heeler} is a herding dog that nips at livestock.
e.zh: 赫勒犬是一种会咬牲畜脚跟的牧畜犬。

e.en: The cobbler replaced the worn {heelpiece} of my boot.
e.zh: 鞋匠更换了我靴子上磨损的鞋跟。

e.en: A leather {heelpiece} can extend a shoe's lifespan.
e.zh: 皮制鞋跟可以延长鞋子的使用寿命。

e.en: She kicked off her {heels} after the long meeting.
e.zh: 漫长的会议结束后她踢掉了高跟鞋。

e.en: My new shoes are giving me blisters on my {heels}.
e.zh: 我的新鞋把脚后跟磨出了水泡。

e.en: The farmer raised a young {heffer} on the pasture.
e.zh: 农夫在牧场上养了一头小母牛。

e.en: That {heffer} produces excellent milk every morning.
e.zh: 那头小母牛每天早上产出优质牛奶。

heft.t:
n. 分量，重量
v. 掂量

e.en: I could feel the {heft} of the heavy textbook.
e.zh: 我能感觉到那本厚教科书的分量。

e.en: He had to {heft} the suitcase onto the rack.
e.zh: 他不得不把行李箱举到架子上。

hefty.t: adj. 大而重的；（金额）巨额的

e.en: She paid a {hefty} fine for parking illegally.
e.zh: 她因违章停车被罚了一大笔钱。

e.en: The book is a {hefty} thousand pages long.
e.zh: 这本书厚达一千页,分量十足。

hegel.t: n. 黑格尔（德国哲学家）

e.en: Many philosophy students struggle to read {Hegel} in German.
e.zh: 许多哲学学生很难用德语读懂黑格尔。

e.en: {Hegel} developed an influential theory of dialectics.
e.zh: 黑格尔发展出了一套影响深远的辩证法理论。

e.en: The professor explained the {Hegelian} dialectic with simple examples.
e.zh: 教授用简单的例子解释了黑格尔的辩证法。

e.en: Marx adapted a {Hegelian} framework into his own philosophy.
e.zh: 马克思把黑格尔式的框架改造进了自己的哲学。

e.en: The country pursued a {hegemonic} role in regional politics.
e.zh: 该国在地区政治中追求霸权地位。

e.en: English has become a {hegemonic} language online.
e.zh: 英语已成为网络上占主导地位的语言。

e.en: American cultural {hegemony} spread through Hollywood films.
e.zh: 美国的文化霸权通过好莱坞电影传播开来。

e.en: The empire's {hegemony} over trade routes lasted centuries.
e.zh: 该帝国对贸易路线的霸权持续了数个世纪。

e.en: "{Heh}, that meme actually made me laugh," he typed.
e.zh: “嘿嘿,这个梗真的让我笑了,”他打字说道。

e.en: She replied with a quiet "{heh}" to the joke.
e.zh: 她对那个笑话轻轻回了一句“呵呵”。

e.en: The {Heian} period produced classics like The Tale of Genji.
e.zh: 平安时代孕育了《源氏物语》这样的经典。

e.en: Kyoto served as the capital throughout the {Heian} era.
e.zh: 京都在整个平安时代都是首都。

e.en: Tourists visited an ancient {heiau} on the Big Island.
e.zh: 游客们参观了大岛上一座古老的夏威夷神庙。

e.en: Locals consider the {heiau} a deeply sacred site.
e.zh: 当地人视那座神庙为非常神圣的场所。

e.en: {Heidegger} wrote about being and time in dense prose.
e.zh: 海德格尔用晦涩的文笔讨论存在与时间。

e.en: Many existentialists were influenced by {Heidegger}'s ideas.
e.zh: 许多存在主义者都受到海德格尔思想的影响。

e.en: We spent a sunny weekend exploring {Heidelberg}'s old castle.
e.zh: 我们度过了一个阳光明媚的周末,游览海德堡古堡。

e.en: {Heidelberg} University is one of Germany's oldest schools.
e.zh: 海德堡大学是德国最古老的大学之一。

heifer.t: n. 小母牛（未生育过的）

e.en: The young {heifer} wandered away from the herd.
e.zh: 那头小母牛离开了牛群,独自走开了。

e.en: He bought a healthy {heifer} at the country auction.
e.zh: 他在乡村拍卖会上买了一头健康的小母牛。

e.en: The rancher counted his {heifers} before sundown.
e.zh: 农场主在日落前清点了他的小母牛。

e.en: Several {heifers} grazed peacefully along the fence.
e.zh: 几头小母牛在围栏边安静地吃草。

e.en: What is the average {height} of NBA players?
e.zh: NBA球员的平均身高是多少?

e.en: At the {height} of his career, he won three awards.
e.zh: 在事业巅峰时期,他赢得了三个奖项。

e.en: Soft music can {heighten} the emotional impact of a film.
e.zh: 柔和的音乐能增强电影的情感冲击力。

e.en: New evidence may {heighten} concerns about food safety.
e.zh: 新的证据可能会加剧人们对食品安全的担忧。

e.en: Airport security remains {heightened} during the holiday season.
e.zh: 机场安保在假期期间保持加强状态。

e.en: The thriller created a {heightened} sense of suspense.
e.zh: 这部惊悚片营造出一种强烈的悬疑感。

heightening.t:
n. 加剧
v. 增强（-ing）

e.en: The dramatic lighting was {heightening} the mood of the scene.
e.zh: 戏剧化的灯光正在烘托场景的氛围。

e.en: Rising prices are {heightening} anxiety among young families.
e.zh: 物价上涨正在加剧年轻家庭的焦虑。

e.en: A good soundtrack {heightens} every emotion in the movie.
e.zh: 出色的配乐会放大电影中的每一种情感。

e.en: Lack of sleep {heightens} the risk of making mistakes.
e.zh: 睡眠不足会增加犯错的风险。

e.en: The historical film recreated a chilling {heil} salute scene.
e.zh: 这部历史片重现了一个令人毛骨悚然的纳粹敬礼场景。

e.en: Performing a {heil} gesture is illegal in modern Germany.
e.zh: 在现代德国做出纳粹式敬礼的动作是违法的。

e.en: In German, "{heim}" simply means "home" or "homeland."
e.zh: 在德语中,“heim”就是“家”或“故乡”的意思。

e.en: The novel's title borrowed the German word {heim}.
e.zh: 小说的标题借用了德语单词“heim”。

e.en: "You agree, {hein}?" the old Frenchman asked with a smile.
e.zh: “你同意吧,嗯?”那位法国老人微笑着问道。

e.en: He ended every sentence with a casual "{hein}."
e.zh: 他每句话都随口加上一声“嗯”。

e.en: {Heine} wrote some of the most beloved German lyric poems.
e.zh: 海涅写下了一些最受人喜爱的德语抒情诗。

e.en: Schubert set several poems by {Heine} to music.
e.zh: 舒伯特为海涅的几首诗谱了曲。

e.en: He ordered a cold {Heineken} after a long workday.
e.zh: 漫长工作日结束后,他点了一瓶冰镇喜力啤酒。

e.en: {Heineken} is one of the most exported Dutch beers.
e.zh: 喜力是出口量最大的荷兰啤酒之一。

heinemann.t: n. 海涅曼（出版社/姓氏）

e.en: The textbook was published by {Heinemann} in London.
e.zh: 这本教科书由伦敦的海尼曼出版社出版。

e.en: Many classic novels appear in {Heinemann}'s African Writers Series.
e.zh: 许多经典小说收录于海尼曼的非洲作家丛书中。

e.en: The toddler fell and bumped his {heinie} on the floor.
e.zh: 小孩摔了一跤,屁股磕到了地板上。

e.en: She slipped on the ice and landed on her {heinie}.
e.zh: 她在冰上滑倒,屁股着地。

heinkel.t: n. 亨克尔（德国飞机制造商）

e.en: A vintage {Heinkel} bomber sat in the aviation museum.
e.zh: 一架老式的海因克尔轰炸机停在航空博物馆里。

e.en: Engineers studied the {Heinkel} jet's pioneering design.
e.zh: 工程师们研究了海因克尔喷气机的开创性设计。

heinous.t: adj. 极恶的，令人发指的

e.en: The court sentenced him for the {heinous} crime.
e.zh: 法庭因这起令人发指的罪行判处了他。

e.en: Reporters described the attack as utterly {heinous}.
e.zh: 记者形容这次袭击极其残忍可恶。

e.en: He squeezed {Heinz} ketchup all over his fries.
e.zh: 他把亨氏番茄酱挤得满薯条都是。

e.en: {Heinz} has produced canned beans for over a century.
e.zh: 亨氏生产罐装豆子已经有一百多年了。

e.en: The prince is the rightful {heir} to the throne.
e.zh: 这位王子是王位的合法继承人。

e.en: She became the sole {heir} to her uncle's fortune.
e.zh: 她成了叔叔财产的唯一继承人。

e.en: The young {heiress} inherited a vast hotel empire.
e.zh: 这位年轻的女继承人继承了庞大的酒店帝国。

e.en: Tabloids followed the {heiress} everywhere she went.
e.zh: 小报记者跟随这位女继承人去往任何地方。

e.en: Grandma gave me a beautiful {heirloom} ring at graduation.
e.zh: 外婆在我毕业时送了我一枚漂亮的传家戒指。

e.en: The farm grows several rare {heirloom} tomato varieties.
e.zh: 这个农场种植着几种珍稀的传家宝番茄品种。

e.en: {Heisenberg} formulated the famous uncertainty principle in physics.
e.zh: 海森堡提出了物理学中著名的测不准原理。

e.en: In Breaking Bad, Walter White calls himself {Heisenberg}.
e.zh: 在《绝命毒师》中,沃尔特·怀特自称海森堡。

heist.t:
n. 抢劫，盗窃案
v. 抢劫

e.en: The film tells the story of a daring bank {heist}.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述了一场大胆的银行抢劫。

e.en: Police are still investigating the jewelry store {heist}.
e.zh: 警方仍在调查那起珠宝店抢劫案。

e.en: Scientists worldwide still use {HeLa} cells in cancer research.
e.zh: 全世界的科学家至今仍在癌症研究中使用海拉细胞。

e.en: The {HeLa} cell line came from Henrietta Lacks in 1951.
e.zh: 海拉细胞系于1951年取自亨丽埃塔·拉克斯。

held.t: v. hold 的过去式/过去分词

e.en: She {held} her baby gently throughout the long flight.
e.zh: 在整个漫长的航程中,她温柔地抱着宝宝。

e.en: The conference was {held} online due to bad weather.
e.zh: 由于天气恶劣,会议改在线上举行。

e.en: My flight from {Heathrow} was delayed by three hours.
e.zh: 我从希思罗机场起飞的航班晚点了三个小时。

e.en: {Heathrow} remains one of Europe's busiest airports.
e.zh: 希思罗机场依然是欧洲最繁忙的机场之一。

heating.t:
n. 供暖；加热
v. 加热（heat 的现在分词）

e.en: The central {heating} broke down on the coldest night.
e.zh: 中央供暖在最冷的那个夜晚坏掉了。

e.en: {Heating} bills always rise sharply during January.
e.zh: 一月份的供暖账单总是大幅上涨。

heatings.t: n. 加热；供暖（heating 的复数）

e.en: Repeated {heatings} can weaken the metal's structure.
e.zh: 反复加热会削弱金属的结构。

e.en: The lab recorded several {heatings} of the sample overnight.
e.zh: 实验室记录了样品过夜的几次加热过程。

e.en: {Heaton} is a lively neighborhood in northeast Newcastle.
e.zh: 希顿是纽卡斯尔东北部一个充满活力的街区。

e.en: My cousin opened a small café in {Heaton} last year.
e.zh: 我表弟去年在希顿开了一家小咖啡馆。

e.en: Use a {heatproof} bowl when melting chocolate over water.
e.zh: 隔水融化巧克力时要用一个耐热的碗。

e.en: These {heatproof} gloves protect your hands at the grill.
e.zh: 这副耐热手套能在烤架前保护你的双手。

heats.t:
v. 加热（heat 的三单）
n. 预赛场次

e.en: The microwave {heats} leftovers in less than a minute.
e.zh: 微波炉一分钟内就能把剩饭加热好。

e.en: Runners must qualify through preliminary {heats} before the final.
e.zh: 选手必须先通过预赛分组才能进入决赛。

e.en: Three hikers were hospitalized with severe {heatstroke}.
e.zh: 三名徒步者因严重中暑被送进了医院。

e.en: Drink plenty of water to avoid {heatstroke} in summer.
e.zh: 夏天要多喝水以防中暑。

e.en: Europe is bracing for another record-breaking summer {heatwave}.
e.zh: 欧洲正准备迎接又一场破纪录的夏季热浪。

e.en: Air conditioners sold out during last week's brutal {heatwave}.
e.zh: 上周酷热的热浪期间空调被抢购一空。

heave.t:
v. 用力举起；起伏
n. 起伏；推举

e.en: It took four men to {heave} the piano upstairs.
e.zh: 四个男人才把那架钢琴抬到了楼上。

e.en: She gave a deep {heave} of relief when finals ended.
e.zh: 期末考试结束时她长长地舒了一口气。

e.en: She felt like she was in {heaven} after tasting the cake.
e.zh: 尝过那块蛋糕后她觉得简直进入了天堂。

e.en: Many religions describe {heaven} as a peaceful afterlife.
e.zh: 许多宗教把天堂描述为宁静的来世。

e.en: This chocolate mousse tastes absolutely {heavenly}.
e.zh: 这款巧克力慕斯尝起来美妙极了。

e.en: We watched the {heavenly} bodies through the telescope.
e.zh: 我们用望远镜观察那些天体。

heavens.t:
n. 天空；苍穹
int. 天哪

e.en: Good {heavens}, I forgot my passport at home!
e.zh: 天哪,我把护照忘在家里了!

e.en: Stars filled the {heavens} on that clear night.
e.zh: 那个晴朗的夜晚星辰布满天空。

heavenward.t: adv./adj. 朝天空地；向天国的

e.en: She turned her gaze {heavenward} and whispered a prayer.
e.zh: 她将目光投向天空,轻声祈祷。

e.en: The rocket soared {heavenward} in a blaze of light.
e.zh: 火箭在一片光焰中冲向天空。

e.en: The balloon drifted {heavenwards} until it disappeared.
e.zh: 气球向天空飘去,直到消失不见。

e.en: He raised his arms {heavenwards} in celebration.
e.zh: 他高举双臂朝向天空欢呼庆祝。

e.en: It rained {heavily} all weekend in Shanghai.
e.zh: 上海整个周末都在下大雨。

e.en: The company relies {heavily} on overseas customers.
e.zh: 该公司严重依赖海外客户。

e.en: She felt a {heaviness} in her chest after the news.
e.zh: 听到消息后她胸口一阵沉重。

e.en: The {heaviness} of the backpack made hiking difficult.
e.zh: 背包的沉重让徒步变得吃力。

heaving.t:
v. 起伏；用力举（heave 的现在分词）
adj. 拥挤的

e.en: His chest was {heaving} after the long sprint.
e.zh: 长距离冲刺后他的胸膛剧烈起伏。

e.en: The bar was {heaving} on Saturday night.
e.zh: 周六晚上酒吧里挤得水泄不通。

heavy.t: adj. 重的；大量的；沉重的

e.en: This suitcase is too {heavy} to carry upstairs.
e.zh: 这个行李箱太重了搬不上楼。

e.en: Traffic was unusually {heavy} this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上交通异常拥堵。

heavy-handedness.t: n. 笨拙；粗暴；高压手段

e.en: Critics condemned the police's {heavy-handedness} during the protest.
e.zh: 批评人士谴责警方在抗议中的粗暴手段。

e.en: His {heavy-handedness} as a manager drove employees away.
e.zh: 他作为经理的专横作风让员工纷纷离开。

heavyweight.t:
n. 重量级（拳击）；大人物
adj. 重量级的

e.en: She is a political {heavyweight} in the region.
e.zh: 她是该地区举足轻重的政治人物。

e.en: The {heavyweight} champion defended his title last night.
e.zh: 重量级冠军昨晚成功卫冕。

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring {Hebden} Bridge in Yorkshire.
e.zh: 我们周末在约克郡的赫布登桥游玩。

e.en: {Hebden} is known for its independent shops and cafes.
e.zh: 赫布登以其独立小店和咖啡馆而闻名。

hebrew.t:
n. 希伯来语；希伯来人
adj. 希伯来的

e.en: She studied {Hebrew} for three years at university.
e.zh: 她在大学学了三年希伯来语。

e.en: The ancient text was written in {Hebrew}.
e.zh: 这部古老的文献是用希伯来语写成的。

hebridean.t:
adj. 赫布里底群岛的
n. 赫布里底人

e.en: We took a {Hebridean} cruise around the Scottish islands.
e.zh: 我们搭乘游轮游览了苏格兰赫布里底群岛。

e.en: The {Hebridean} coastline is rugged and breathtaking.
e.zh: 赫布里底群岛的海岸线崎岖而壮丽。

hebrides.t: n. 赫布里底群岛（苏格兰）

e.en: The {Hebrides} lie off the west coast of Scotland.
e.zh: 赫布里底群岛位于苏格兰西海岸外。

e.en: Storms often batter the Outer {Hebrides} in winter.
e.zh: 冬季外赫布里底群岛常遭风暴袭击。

hebron.t: n. 希伯伦（巴勒斯坦城市）

e.en: {Hebron} is one of the oldest cities in the West Bank.
e.zh: 希伯伦是约旦河西岸最古老的城市之一。

e.en: Tourists visit {Hebron} for its historic religious sites.
e.zh: 游客前往希伯伦参观其历史宗教遗址。

hecatomb.t: n. 大规模杀戮；古希腊百牛祭

e.en: The battle became a {hecatomb} of young soldiers.
e.zh: 那场战役成了年轻士兵的大屠杀。

e.en: Ancient Greeks offered a {hecatomb} to honor the gods.
e.zh: 古希腊人献上百牲祭以敬神明。

e.en: What the {heck} is going on in here?
e.zh: 这里到底发生了什么事?

e.en: Oh {heck}, I left my keys at the office.
e.zh: 糟了,我把钥匙落在办公室了。

e.en: Audience members tried to {heckle} the stand-up comedian.
e.zh: 观众试图起哄打断那位单口喜剧演员。

e.en: Protesters began to {heckle} the senator during her speech.
e.zh: 抗议者在参议员演讲时开始大声叫嚷。

e.en: A loud {heckler} disrupted the politician's speech.
e.zh: 一名大声起哄者打断了政客的演讲。

e.en: The comedian fired back at the {heckler} with a joke.
e.zh: 喜剧演员用一个笑话回击了那位起哄者。

heckling.t:
n. 起哄；喝倒彩
v. 起哄（heckle 的现在分词）

e.en: The constant {heckling} from the crowd ruined the show.
e.zh: 观众不断的起哄毁了整场演出。

e.en: She ignored the {heckling} and finished her speech calmly.
e.zh: 她无视嘲讽,平静地讲完了演讲。

e.en: The farm covers more than fifty {hectare}s of land.
e.zh: 这家农场占地超过五十公顷。

e.en: One {hectare} equals about 2.47 acres.
e.zh: 一公顷约等于2.47英亩。

hectic.t: adj. 忙乱的；紧张繁忙的

e.en: I had a really {hectic} day at work today.
e.zh: 我今天工作非常忙乱。

e.en: December is always a {hectic} month for retailers.
e.zh: 十二月对零售商来说总是忙碌的月份。

e.en: She worked {hectically} to meet the project deadline.
e.zh: 她拼命赶工以赶上项目截止日期。

e.en: The kitchen staff moved {hectically} during the dinner rush.
e.zh: 晚餐高峰时厨房员工忙得团团转。

e.en: The brewery produces ten thousand {hectolitre}s of beer monthly.
e.zh: 这家酿酒厂每月生产一万百升啤酒。

e.en: One {hectolitre} contains one hundred litres.
e.zh: 一百升等于一百公升。

hector.t:
v. 威吓；欺凌
n. 赫克托耳（人名）

e.en: Stop trying to {hector} me into changing my mind.
e.zh: 别再对我恃强凌弱地逼我改变主意了。

e.en: The boss would {hector} junior staff at every meeting.
e.zh: 老板每次开会都会盛气凌人地训斥下属。

hectoring.t: adj. 威吓的；盛气凌人的

e.en: His {hectoring} tone made everyone uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他咄咄逼人的语气让大家都很不舒服。

e.en: She refused to tolerate his {hectoring} any longer.
e.zh: 她不愿再忍受他的盛气凌人。

hedge.t:
n. 树篱；对冲
v. 对冲；含糊其辞

e.en: He trimmed the {hedge} along the front garden.
e.zh: 他修剪了前花园边的树篱。

e.en: Investors buy gold to {hedge} against inflation.
e.zh: 投资者购买黄金以对冲通胀。

hedged.t:
adj. 对冲的；用树篱围起的
v. 对冲（hedge 过去式）

e.en: She {hedged} her answer to avoid commitment.
e.zh: 她回答得含糊其辞以避免做出承诺。

e.en: The fund {hedged} its bets across multiple currencies.
e.zh: 该基金在多种货币上对冲下注。

e.en: A small {hedgehog} crossed the garden path at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时一只小刺猬穿过了花园小径。

e.en: The {hedgehog} curled into a ball when frightened.
e.zh: 刺猬受惊时蜷成了一个球。

e.en: {Hedgehogs} hibernate in piles of leaves during winter.
e.zh: 刺猬冬季在落叶堆中冬眠。

e.en: Wildlife groups are working to protect British {hedgehogs}.
e.zh: 野生动物组织正在努力保护英国刺猬。

hedger.t: n. 套期保值者；修剪树篱者

e.en: A skilled {hedger} can shape a hedge beautifully.
e.zh: 熟练的修篱工能把树篱修剪得很漂亮。

e.en: Currency {hedger}s reduce risk for international companies.
e.zh: 货币对冲者为跨国公司降低风险。

e.en: Birds nest in the dense {hedgerow} behind the cottage.
e.zh: 鸟儿在小屋后茂密的树篱中筑巢。

e.en: The country lane was bordered by a flowering {hedgerow}.
e.zh: 乡间小路两旁是开满花的树篱。

hedgerows.t: n. 矮树篱（hedgerow 的复数）

e.en: Ancient {hedgerows} mark the boundaries of English fields.
e.zh: 古老的树篱标示着英格兰田地的边界。

e.en: Many wild flowers grow along rural {hedgerows}.
e.zh: 许多野花生长在乡间的树篱旁。

hedges.t:
n. 树篱（复数）
v. 对冲；含糊（三单）

e.en: He spent Sunday afternoon trimming the garden {hedges}.
e.zh: 他周日下午都在修剪花园的树篱。

e.en: The fund {hedges} its risk by diversifying investments.
e.zh: 该基金通过分散投资来对冲风险。

hedging.t:
n. 对冲；含糊其辞
v. 对冲（hedge 的现在分词）

e.en: Stop {hedging} and just give me a straight answer.
e.zh: 别再含糊其辞,直接给我一个明确的答案。

e.en: {Hedging} strategies can protect portfolios from market swings.
e.zh: 对冲策略可以保护投资组合免受市场波动影响。

e.en: Researchers measured the {hedonic} value of the experience.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了这种体验的享乐价值。

e.en: Modern advertising appeals to {hedonic} desires.
e.zh: 现代广告诉诸于人们的享乐欲望。

e.en: He criticized the {hedonism} of modern consumer culture.
e.zh: 他批评了现代消费文化中的享乐主义。

e.en: Ancient philosophers debated the merits of {hedonism}.
e.zh: 古代哲学家辩论享乐主义的价值。

e.en: He's a self-confessed {hedonist} who lives for pleasure.
e.zh: 他自称是个为享乐而活的享乐主义者。

e.en: As a {hedonist}, she chose comfort over career success.
e.zh: 作为享乐主义者,她选择舒适而非事业成功。

helena.t: n. 海伦娜（女性名／地名）

e.en: {Helena} is the capital city of the state of Montana.
e.zh: 海伦娜是蒙大拿州的首府。

e.en: My friend {Helena} just moved to Berlin for work.
e.zh: 我朋友海伦娜刚因工作搬到了柏林。

heli.t: n. 直升机（helicopter 的缩写）

e.en: They booked a {heli} tour over the snowy mountains.
e.zh: 他们预订了一趟飞越雪山的直升机之旅。

e.en: Rescue teams arrived by {heli} within twenty minutes.
e.zh: 救援队在二十分钟内乘直升机赶到了。

e.en: DNA forms a famous double {helical} structure.
e.zh: DNA形成了著名的双螺旋结构。

e.en: The staircase has an elegant {helical} shape.
e.zh: 那座楼梯呈现出优雅的螺旋形状。

e.en: The propeller's {helice} cut through the calm water.
e.zh: 螺旋桨的叶片划过平静的水面。

e.en: Engineers redesigned the {helice} for better fuel efficiency.
e.zh: 工程师重新设计了螺旋桨以提高燃油效率。

helicobacter.t: n. 螺杆菌（幽门螺杆菌属）

e.en: {Helicobacter} pylori is a common cause of stomach ulcers.
e.zh: 幽门螺杆菌是导致胃溃疡的常见病因。

e.en: Doctors test for {Helicobacter} using a simple breath test.
e.zh: 医生通过简单的呼气测试来检测幽门螺杆菌。

e.en: A rescue {helicopter} airlifted the injured hiker to safety.
e.zh: 一架救援直升机把受伤的登山者空运到安全地带。

e.en: The {helicopter} circled the stadium during the broadcast.
e.zh: 直升机在转播期间在体育场上空盘旋。

e.en: Several {helicopters} hovered above the breaking news scene.
e.zh: 几架直升机在突发新闻现场上空盘旋。

e.en: Military {helicopters} delivered supplies to the flooded village.
e.zh: 军用直升机向被洪水围困的村庄运送了物资。

e.en: The brand {Helio} once made colorful budget smartphones.
e.zh: Helio 这个品牌曾经生产过色彩鲜艳的平价智能手机。

e.en: "{Helio}" is a Greek prefix meaning "sun."
e.zh: “helio”是一个希腊语前缀,意思是“太阳”。

heliocentric.t: adj. 日心的（以太阳为中心）

e.en: Copernicus proposed a {heliocentric} model of the solar system.
e.zh: 哥白尼提出了太阳系的日心说模型。

e.en: The {heliocentric} view replaced earlier Earth-centered theories.
e.zh: 日心说取代了早先以地球为中心的理论。

e.en: {Helioseismology} lets scientists study the sun's hidden interior.
e.zh: 日震学使科学家能够研究太阳隐藏的内部结构。

e.en: Recent advances in {helioseismology} reveal new solar dynamics.
e.zh: 日震学的最新进展揭示了新的太阳动力学现象。

heliotrope.t:
n. 天芥菜
n. 淡紫色

e.en: She planted purple {heliotrope} along the garden path.
e.zh: 她在花园小径旁种了紫色的天芥菜。

e.en: The {heliotrope} fills the yard with sweet vanilla scent.
e.zh: 天芥菜让院子里弥漫着甜甜的香草气味。

e.en: The hospital built a new {helipad} on its rooftop.
e.zh: 医院在屋顶上建了一个新的直升机停机坪。

e.en: A private jet owner added a {helipad} beside the mansion.
e.zh: 那位私人飞机机主在豪宅旁加建了一个直升机停机坪。

e.en: The downtown {heliport} handles dozens of flights daily.
e.zh: 市中心的直升机场每天起降数十架次航班。

e.en: Executives shuttle between offices using a private {heliport}.
e.zh: 高管们通过一座私人直升机场在各办公室间往返。

e.en: The kids filled colorful balloons with {helium} for the party.
e.zh: 孩子们为派对在彩色气球里灌满了氦气。

e.en: Inhaling {helium} temporarily makes your voice sound squeaky.
e.zh: 吸入氦气会让你的声音暂时变得尖细。

e.en: DNA forms a double {helix} structure.
e.zh: DNA 形成双螺旋结构。

e.en: The staircase spirals up in a tight {helix}.
e.zh: 楼梯以紧凑的螺旋形向上盘旋。

e.en: Traffic during rush hour is pure {hell}.
e.zh: 高峰时段的交通简直是地狱。

e.en: Old beliefs describe {hell} as a place of punishment.
e.zh: 古老的信仰把地狱描绘成受罚之地。

e.en: That new burger spot is {hella} good.
e.zh: 那家新汉堡店超级好吃。

e.en: It's {hella} cold outside today.
e.zh: 今天外面冷得要命。

hellacious.t: adj. 极糟的；极强的（俚语）

e.en: We sat through a {hellacious} traffic jam.
e.zh: 我们经历了一场可怕的大堵车。

e.en: The team pulled off a {hellacious} comeback win.
e.zh: 那支队伍打出了惊天逆转的胜利。

e.en: She drives a Dodge {Hellcat} on weekends.
e.zh: 她周末开着一辆道奇地狱猫。

e.en: That little {hellcat} of a kitten scratched everyone.
e.zh: 那只小野猫似的小猫抓了所有人。

e.en: The {hellebore} blooms in late winter.
e.zh: 嚏根草在冬末开花。

e.en: She planted a {hellebore} near the shaded path.
e.zh: 她在阴凉的小径旁种了一株嚏根草。

e.en: The garden was full of pink {hellebores}.
e.zh: 花园里开满了粉色的嚏根草。

e.en: {Hellebores} thrive in cool, shady gardens.
e.zh: 嚏根草在阴凉的花园里长得很好。

e.en: The museum displays ancient {Hellenic} pottery.
e.zh: 博物馆展出古希腊的陶器。

e.en: She studies {Hellenic} philosophy at university.
e.zh: 她在大学里研究古希腊哲学。

e.en: Alexander's conquests spread {Hellenistic} culture across Asia.
e.zh: 亚历山大的征服将希腊化文化传播到亚洲。

e.en: This sculpture is a fine example of {Hellenistic} art.
e.zh: 这件雕塑是希腊化艺术的精彩范例。

heller.t: n. 海勒（姓氏）；小额硬币

e.en: Joseph {Heller} wrote the novel Catch-22.
e.zh: 约瑟夫·海勒写了小说《第二十二条军规》。

e.en: My grandfather was a real {heller} in his youth.
e.zh: 我祖父年轻时真是个调皮鬼。

e.en: The preacher warned of {hellfire} and damnation.
e.zh: 传教士警告说会下地狱受火刑。

e.en: The drone fired a {Hellfire} missile at the target.
e.zh: 无人机向目标发射了一枚地狱火导弹。

e.en: That cheap motel turned out to be a real {hellhole}.
e.zh: 那家便宜旅馆原来真是个鬼地方。

e.en: The prison was widely known as a {hellhole}.
e.zh: 那座监狱以人间地狱闻名。

e.en: The myth describes a three-headed {hellhound} guarding the underworld.
e.zh: 神话描述一只守护冥界的三头地狱犬。

e.en: In the game, a fiery {hellhound} chased the player.
e.zh: 游戏里,一只炽热的地狱犬追着玩家。

e.en: Her younger brother is a total {hellion}.
e.zh: 她弟弟简直是个小恶魔。

e.en: The teacher struggled to control the classroom {hellion}.
e.zh: 老师很难管住班上那个捣蛋鬼。

e.en: The commute home was absolutely {hellish}.
e.zh: 回家的路程简直像地狱一样。

e.en: They endured {hellish} working conditions for years.
e.zh: 他们多年忍受着地狱般的工作环境。

e.en: The exam was {hellishly} difficult.
e.zh: 那场考试难得要命。

e.en: It was {hellishly} hot in the unventilated room.
e.zh: 那间不通风的房间里热得要命。

e.en: She said {hello} as she walked into the office.
e.zh: 她走进办公室时打了声招呼。

e.en: Just call to say {hello} when you have time.
e.zh: 有空就打个电话问声好。

e.en: Quick {helloes} were exchanged before the meeting started.
e.zh: 会议开始前大家匆匆打了招呼。

e.en: Warm {helloes} filled the room at the reunion.
e.zh: 聚会上,热情的问候充满了整个房间。

e.en: Different religions describe many kinds of {hells}.
e.zh: 不同的宗教描述了多种地狱。

e.en: He's been through several personal {hells} this year.
e.zh: 他今年经历了几段地狱般的日子。

helluva.t: adj. 非常的（hell of a 的缩读）

e.en: That was a {helluva} game last night.
e.zh: 昨晚那场比赛真是精彩极了。

e.en: She's a {helluva} good cook.
e.zh: 她可是个超棒的厨师。

e.en: A new CEO has taken the {helm} of the company.
e.zh: 一位新任首席执行官接管了公司。

e.en: The captain stood calmly at the {helm}.
e.zh: 船长沉着地站在舵旁。

e.en: Always wear a {helmet} when riding a bike.
e.zh: 骑自行车时一定要戴头盔。

e.en: The construction worker adjusted his {helmet}.
e.zh: 建筑工人整了整他的安全帽。
