e.en: {Helmeted} soldiers marched across the parade ground.
e.zh: 戴着头盔的士兵走过阅兵场。

e.en: A {helmeted} cyclist sped down the hill.
e.zh: 一位戴头盔的骑行者飞速冲下山坡。

e.en: All workers must wear {helmets} on this site.
e.zh: 此工地上所有工人必须戴安全帽。

e.en: The shop sells colorful motorcycle {helmets}.
e.zh: 这家店出售各种颜色的摩托车头盔。

helmholtz.t: n. 亥姆霍兹（德国物理学家）

e.en: {Helmholtz} made major contributions to physics and physiology.
e.zh: 亥姆霍兹对物理学和生理学有重大贡献。

e.en: The speaker uses a {Helmholtz} resonator design.
e.zh: 这款音箱采用了亥姆霍兹共振器设计。

e.en: Doctors found a parasitic {helminth} in the patient.
e.zh: 医生在病人体内发现了一种寄生蠕虫。

e.en: This drug treats common {helminth} infections.
e.zh: 这种药物可治疗常见的蠕虫感染。

e.en: She {helms} the design team at the studio.
e.zh: 她负责领导这家工作室的设计团队。

e.en: The sailors gripped the {helms} of their boats.
e.zh: 水手们紧握着船舵。

helmsley.t: n. 赫尔姆斯利（姓氏／地名）

e.en: Leona {Helmsley} was famous for her luxury hotels.
e.zh: 利昂娜·赫尔姆斯利以她的豪华酒店闻名。

e.en: The {Helmsley} Building stands in midtown Manhattan.
e.zh: 赫尔姆斯利大厦坐落于曼哈顿中城。

e.en: The {helmsman} steered the ship through the storm.
e.zh: 舵手驾驶着船只穿越风暴。

e.en: He served as {helmsman} on a fishing trawler.
e.zh: 他在一艘渔船上担任舵手。

helo.t: n. 直升机（helicopter 军事俚语）

e.en: A rescue {helo} hovered above the wreckage.
e.zh: 一架救援直升机在残骸上方盘旋。

e.en: The marines boarded the {helo} at dawn.
e.zh: 海军陆战队员在黎明时登上直升机。

helot.t: n. 古斯巴达奴隶；农奴

e.en: In ancient Sparta, a {helot} worked the land for citizens.
e.zh: 在古斯巴达,黑劳士为公民耕种土地。

e.en: The novel portrays workers treated like a modern {helot}.
e.zh: 小说把工人描绘成现代的农奴。

help.t:
v. 帮助
n. 帮助，援助

e.en: Can you {help} me carry these boxes?
e.zh: 你能帮我搬这些箱子吗?

e.en: Click the button if you need {help}.
e.zh: 如果需要帮助,请点击按钮。

helped.t: v. 帮助（help 的过去式）

e.en: She {helped} me prepare for the interview.
e.zh: 她帮我准备了面试。

e.en: A cup of tea {helped} calm my nerves.
e.zh: 一杯茶帮我平复了紧张的情绪。

e.en: The teacher's {helper} handed out worksheets.
e.zh: 老师的助手分发了练习纸。

e.en: My new AI {helper} schedules all my meetings.
e.zh: 我的新 AI 助手帮我安排所有会议。

e.en: Volunteer {helpers} served meals at the shelter.
e.zh: 志愿帮手在收容所里供应饭菜。

e.en: The library hires student {helpers} every summer.
e.zh: 图书馆每年夏天都会雇学生帮工。

e.en: The staff was incredibly {helpful} during our stay.
e.zh: 我们入住期间员工非常乐于助人。

e.en: This guide is really {helpful} for beginners.
e.zh: 这份指南对新手非常有帮助。

e.en: He {helpfully} pointed out the typo in my email.
e.zh: 他贴心地指出了我邮件里的拼写错误。

e.en: The app {helpfully} suggests replies to messages.
e.zh: 这个应用会贴心地为消息推荐回复。

e.en: We appreciated the receptionist's {helpfulness}.
e.zh: 我们很感激前台的热心服务。

e.en: The chatbot is rated highly for its {helpfulness}.
e.zh: 这款聊天机器人因其乐于助人而广受好评。

helping.t:
n. 一份（食物）
v. 帮助（help 的现在分词）

e.en: Thanks for {helping} me move last weekend.
e.zh: 谢谢你上周末帮我搬家。

e.en: She had a second {helping} of pasta.
e.zh: 她又添了一份意大利面。

helpless.t: adj. 无助的，无能为力的

e.en: I felt {helpless} watching the news from afar.
e.zh: 远远地看着新闻,我感到无能为力。

e.en: The kitten was tiny and completely {helpless}.
e.zh: 那只小猫又小又完全无助。

e.en: He watched {helplessly} as the boat drifted away.
e.zh: 他无助地看着船漂走。

e.en: She shrugged {helplessly} when asked for an explanation.
e.zh: 被问到原因时,她无奈地耸了耸肩。

e.en: A sense of {helplessness} overcame the rescue workers.
e.zh: 一种无力感笼罩了救援人员。

e.en: Therapy can ease feelings of {helplessness}.
e.zh: 心理治疗可以缓解无助感。

helpline.t: n. 求助热线，帮助热线

e.en: Call the {helpline} if you need someone to talk to.
e.zh: 如果需要倾诉,请拨打求助热线。

e.en: The mental health {helpline} operates around the clock.
e.zh: 这条心理健康热线全天候运营。

e.en: He considered his wife his closest {helpmate}.
e.zh: 他把妻子视为最亲密的伴侣。

e.en: A good {helpmate} shares both joys and burdens.
e.zh: 好的伴侣会与你共担甘苦。

e.en: The old text describes a wife as a {helpmeet}.
e.zh: 古文将妻子描述为得力的伴侣。

e.en: He found a true {helpmeet} in his business partner.
e.zh: 他在商业伙伴身上找到了真正的助手。

helps.t: v. 帮助（help 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Drinking water {helps} prevent headaches.
e.zh: 喝水有助于防止头痛。

e.en: It {helps} to plan your day in advance.
e.zh: 提前规划一天会很有帮助。

helsinki.t: n. 赫尔辛基（芬兰首都）

e.en: {Helsinki} is the capital of Finland.
e.zh: 赫尔辛基是芬兰的首都。

e.en: We took a ferry from {Helsinki} to Tallinn.
e.zh: 我们从赫尔辛基坐渡轮去塔林。

e.en: The axe broke at the {helve} during the swing.
e.zh: 挥斧时,斧柄断了。

e.en: He carved a new {helve} from a piece of oak.
e.zh: 他用一块橡木雕了一个新的斧柄。

hem.t:
n. 衣物的褶边
v. 给…缝边

e.en: She let down the {hem} of the dress.
e.zh: 她把裙子的下摆放长了。

e.en: The tailor will {hem} these pants for free.
e.zh: 裁缝会免费帮这条裤子缝边。

e.en: The baby was born with a small {hemangioma} on her cheek.
e.zh: 婴儿出生时脸颊上有一小块血管瘤。

e.en: Most cases of {hemangioma} fade on their own.
e.zh: 大多数血管瘤会自行消退。

e.en: The miners extracted {hematite} ore for steel production.
e.zh: 矿工们开采赤铁矿用于炼钢。

e.en: She polished a piece of {hematite} into a smooth bead.
e.zh: 她将一块赤铁矿打磨成光滑的珠子。

hematocrit.t: n. 红细胞比容（血检指标）

e.en: The doctor checked her {hematocrit} levels after surgery.
e.zh: 医生在手术后检查了她的红细胞压积水平。

e.en: A low {hematocrit} can indicate anemia or blood loss.
e.zh: 红细胞压积偏低可能表示贫血或失血。

e.en: The patient was referred for a {hematologic} evaluation.
e.zh: 该患者被转诊接受血液学评估。

e.en: Several {hematologic} disorders run in his family.
e.zh: 他家族中有几种血液系统疾病。

e.en: The lab specializes in {hematological} testing and diagnosis.
e.zh: 该实验室专门从事血液学检测和诊断。

e.en: She published research on {hematological} cancers last year.
e.zh: 她去年发表了关于血液系统癌症的研究。

e.en: The {hematologist} reviewed her bone marrow biopsy results.
e.zh: 血液科医生审阅了她的骨髓活检结果。

e.en: Her son became a pediatric {hematologist} after residency.
e.zh: 她儿子住院医师培训后成为了一名儿科血液科医生。

e.en: She works in the {hematology} department at the hospital.
e.zh: 她在医院的血液科工作。

e.en: Modern {hematology} relies heavily on flow cytometry techniques.
e.zh: 现代血液学在很大程度上依赖流式细胞术。

e.en: A large {hematoma} formed on his thigh after the fall.
e.zh: 摔倒后他大腿上形成了一大块血肿。

e.en: The surgeon drained the {hematoma} to relieve pressure.
e.zh: 外科医生抽出血肿以缓解压力。

e.en: {Hematopoietic} stem cells produce all the body's blood cells.
e.zh: 造血干细胞能产生身体所有的血细胞。

e.en: He underwent a {hematopoietic} stem cell transplant last month.
e.zh: 他上个月接受了造血干细胞移植。

e.en: The slides were stained with {hematoxylin} and eosin.
e.zh: 玻片用苏木精和伊红进行了染色。

e.en: {Hematoxylin} stains cell nuclei a deep blue color.
e.zh: 苏木精会将细胞核染成深蓝色。

e.en: {Heme} is the iron-containing component of hemoglobin.
e.zh: 血红素是血红蛋白中含铁的组成部分。

e.en: Plant-based burgers sometimes use {heme} for a meaty flavor.
e.zh: 植物肉汉堡有时会用血红素来模拟肉味。

hemel.t: n. 赫默尔（英国地名，Hemel Hempstead 的简称）

e.en: They moved to {Hemel} Hempstead for cheaper housing.
e.zh: 他们为了更便宜的房子搬到了赫默尔亨普斯特德。

e.en: The train to {Hemel} leaves from Euston station.
e.zh: 开往赫默尔的火车从尤斯顿车站发车。

e.en: She read every {Hemingway} novel during her summer break.
e.zh: 她在暑假期间读完了海明威的每一部小说。

e.en: {Hemingway}'s sparse prose influenced generations of writers.
e.zh: 海明威简练的文风影响了几代作家。

e.en: The stroke left him with {hemiplegia} on his right side.
e.zh: 中风使他右侧身体出现偏瘫。

e.en: Physical therapy can help patients living with {hemiplegia}.
e.zh: 物理治疗可以帮助患有偏瘫的患者。

hemiplegic.t:
adj. 偏瘫的
n. 偏瘫患者

e.en: The {hemiplegic} patient regained partial movement after therapy.
e.zh: 这位偏瘫患者经过治疗后恢复了部分活动能力。

e.en: He developed a {hemiplegic} gait following the accident.
e.zh: 事故之后他出现了偏瘫步态。

e.en: Australia lies entirely in the southern {hemisphere}.
e.zh: 澳大利亚完全位于南半球。

e.en: The left {hemisphere} of the brain handles most language tasks.
e.zh: 大脑左半球处理大部分语言任务。

e.en: Leaders met to discuss {hemispheric} trade and security.
e.zh: 各国领导人会面讨论半球范围的贸易和安全问题。

e.en: The scan revealed {hemispheric} differences in brain activity.
e.zh: 扫描显示大脑两半球的活动存在差异。

e.en: The temple is topped with a beautiful {hemispherical} dome.
e.zh: 这座神庙顶部有一个漂亮的半球形圆顶。

e.en: Engineers designed a {hemispherical} mirror for the telescope.
e.zh: 工程师为望远镜设计了一面半球形反射镜。

e.en: This season's {hemline} sits just above the knee.
e.zh: 本季的裙摆长度刚好在膝盖以上。

e.en: She let down the {hemline} to make the dress longer.
e.zh: 她把裙摆放下来,让连衣裙更长一些。

e.en: Socrates was famously executed by drinking {hemlock}.
e.zh: 苏格拉底因饮下毒芹而著名地被处死。

e.en: A tall {hemlock} tree shaded the corner of the garden.
e.zh: 一棵高大的铁杉树为花园的角落遮荫。

hemmed.t: v. 缝边（hem 的过去式）

e.en: She {hemmed} the curtains to fit the new window.
e.zh: 她把窗帘缝边以适合新窗户。

e.en: The crowd {hemmed} him in on every side.
e.zh: 人群从四面八方把他围住。

hemming.t: v. 缝边（hem 的现在分词）

e.en: She spent the afternoon {hemming} her wedding dress.
e.zh: 她花了一下午时间给婚纱缝边。

e.en: Stop {hemming} and hawing and just make a decision.
e.zh: 别再支支吾吾的,赶紧做决定吧。

e.en: He undergoes {hemodialysis} three times a week.
e.zh: 他每周接受三次血液透析。

e.en: The clinic opened a new {hemodialysis} unit last month.
e.zh: 这家诊所上个月新开了一个血液透析中心。

e.en: Doctors monitored her {hemodynamic} status during surgery.
e.zh: 医生在手术过程中监测她的血流动力学状态。

e.en: The drug caused significant {hemodynamic} changes in patients.
e.zh: 该药物导致患者血流动力学发生显著变化。

e.en: {Hemoglobin} carries oxygen from the lungs to the body.
e.zh: 血红蛋白将氧气从肺部输送到全身。

e.en: Her {hemoglobin} levels dropped after the surgery.
e.zh: 手术后她的血红蛋白水平下降了。

e.en: The infant was diagnosed with {hemolytic} anemia at birth.
e.zh: 这名婴儿出生时被诊断出溶血性贫血。

e.en: Some medications can trigger a {hemolytic} reaction.
e.zh: 某些药物可能引发溶血反应。

e.en: His son was born with {hemophilia} and bruises easily.
e.zh: 他儿子出生就患有血友病,很容易瘀青。

e.en: {Hemophilia} affects the blood's ability to clot properly.
e.zh: 血友病会影响血液正常凝结的能力。

e.en: As a {hemophiliac}, he must avoid contact sports.
e.zh: 作为血友病患者,他必须避免身体接触类运动。

e.en: The {hemophiliac} received regular infusions of clotting factor.
e.zh: 这位血友病患者定期接受凝血因子输注。

e.en: {Hemoptysis} can be a warning sign of lung disease.
e.zh: 咯血可能是肺部疾病的警示信号。

e.en: The patient came to the ER with sudden {hemoptysis}.
e.zh: 该患者因突发咯血来到急诊室。

hemorrhage.t:
n. 大出血
v. 大量流失

e.en: Doctors worked to stop the internal {hemorrhage} quickly.
e.zh: 医生们紧急设法止住内出血。

e.en: The startup is suffering a {hemorrhage} of senior engineers.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正大量流失资深工程师。

e.en: The CT scan confirmed a {hemorrhagic} stroke.
e.zh: CT扫描确诊为出血性中风。

e.en: Ebola is a deadly {hemorrhagic} fever virus.
e.zh: 埃博拉是一种致命的出血热病毒。

hermaphrodite.t:
n. 雌雄同体的生物
adj. 两性的

e.en: Earthworms are a classic example of a {hermaphrodite} in nature.
e.zh: 蚯蚓是自然界中雌雄同体生物的经典例子。

e.en: The snail is a {hermaphrodite} with both male and female reproductive organs.
e.zh: 蜗牛是雌雄同体生物，同时具有雄性和雌性生殖器官。

e.en: Many flowering plants have {hermaphroditic} blossoms with both stamens and pistils.
e.zh: 许多开花植物的花朵是雌雄同体的，同时具有雄蕊和雌蕊。

e.en: Certain fish species exhibit {hermaphroditic} traits during their life cycle.
e.zh: 某些鱼类在其生命周期中表现出雌雄同体的特征。

e.en: The professor took a {hermeneutic} approach to interpreting the ancient text.
e.zh: 教授采用诠释学方法来解读这段古代文本。

e.en: Her {hermeneutic} analysis revealed hidden meanings in the poem.
e.zh: 她的诠释分析揭示了这首诗中隐藏的含义。

e.en: The seminar focused on {hermeneutical} methods for studying scripture.
e.zh: 研讨会聚焦于研究经文的诠释学方法。

e.en: Different {hermeneutical} traditions yield very different readings of the text.
e.zh: 不同的诠释学传统会对文本产生截然不同的解读。

e.en: Biblical {hermeneutics} examines how religious texts should be interpreted.
e.zh: 圣经诠释学探讨宗教文本应如何被解读。

e.en: He wrote his thesis on the {hermeneutics} of legal documents.
e.zh: 他的论文研究的是法律文件的诠释学。

hermes.t: n. 爱马仕（品牌）；赫尔墨斯（希腊神）

e.en: In Greek mythology, {Hermes} was the messenger of the gods.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中，赫尔墨斯是众神的信使。

e.en: She saved up to buy a designer scarf from {Hermes}.
e.zh: 她攒钱买了一条爱马仕的设计师丝巾。

hermetic.t: adj. 密封的；与外界隔绝的

e.en: The lab requires a {hermetic} seal to prevent contamination.
e.zh: 实验室需要密封封口以防止污染。

e.en: He lived a {hermetic} life, rarely leaving his small cabin.
e.zh: 他过着与世隔绝的生活，很少离开他的小木屋。

e.en: The food is {hermetically} sealed to keep it fresh for years.
e.zh: 食物被密封包装，可以保鲜多年。

e.en: Astronauts work inside a {hermetically} sealed module in space.
e.zh: 宇航员在太空中密封舱内工作。

e.en: He became a {hermit} after retiring to the mountains.
e.zh: 他退休后隐居山中，成了一名隐士。

e.en: The old {hermit} hadn't spoken to anyone in years.
e.zh: 那位年迈的隐士已经多年没和任何人说过话了。

e.en: The monk built a small {hermitage} deep in the forest.
e.zh: 那位僧侣在森林深处建了一间小小的隐居所。

e.en: We visited the famous {Hermitage} museum in St. Petersburg.
e.zh: 我们参观了圣彼得堡著名的艾尔米塔什博物馆。

e.en: Ancient {hermits} often lived in caves to seek spiritual enlightenment.
e.zh: 古代隐士常常住在洞穴中以寻求精神启迪。

e.en: Some {hermits} avoided all contact with modern society.
e.zh: 有些隐士回避与现代社会的一切接触。

e.en: The legend of {Herne} the Hunter haunts Windsor Forest.
e.zh: 猎人赫恩的传说萦绕在温莎森林中。

e.en: Shakespeare references {Herne} in The Merry Wives of Windsor.
e.zh: 莎士比亚在《温莎的风流娘儿们》中提到了赫恩。

e.en: He needs surgery to repair a painful {hernia} in his abdomen.
e.zh: 他需要手术来修复腹部疼痛的疝气。

e.en: Lifting heavy boxes can cause a {hernia} if you're not careful.
e.zh: 如果不小心，搬重箱子可能导致疝气。

herniated.t: adj. 突出的（如椎间盘突出）

e.en: She suffers chronic back pain from a {herniated} disc.
e.zh: 她因椎间盘突出而长期背痛。

e.en: The doctor confirmed he has a {herniated} disc in his lower spine.
e.zh: 医生确诊他的下脊柱有一处椎间盘突出。

e.en: MRI scans revealed a significant disc {herniation} in his neck.
e.zh: 核磁共振扫描显示他颈部有明显的椎间盘突出。

e.en: Spinal {herniation} can cause numbness and weakness in the limbs.
e.zh: 脊椎突出可能导致四肢麻木和无力。

e.en: The firefighter became a local {hero} after rescuing the family.
e.zh: 那位消防员救出那家人后成为当地英雄。

e.en: My grandfather has always been my personal {hero}.
e.zh: 我祖父一直是我心目中的英雄。

e.en: King {Herod} is a controversial figure in biblical history.
e.zh: 希律王是圣经历史上一位有争议的人物。

e.en: {Herod} the Great built many fortresses across ancient Judea.
e.zh: 大希律王在古犹太地区建造了许多堡垒。

herodotus.t: n. 希罗多德（古希腊史学家）

e.en: {Herodotus} is often called the father of history.
e.zh: 希罗多德常被称为历史之父。

e.en: The writings of {Herodotus} describe the Greco-Persian Wars in detail.
e.zh: 希罗多德的著作详细描述了希波战争。

e.en: Marvel movies feature superpowered {heroes} saving the world.
e.zh: 漫威电影中有超能力英雄拯救世界的情节。

e.en: The fallen soldiers were honored as national {heroes}.
e.zh: 阵亡的士兵被誉为国家英雄。

e.en: The pilot's {heroic} actions saved hundreds of passengers.
e.zh: 飞行员的英勇行为拯救了数百名乘客。

e.en: She made a {heroic} effort to finish the marathon despite injury.
e.zh: 尽管受伤，她仍英勇地坚持跑完了马拉松。

e.en: The lifeguard {heroically} swam through rough waves to rescue the child.
e.zh: 救生员英勇地穿过汹涌的波浪救起了那个孩子。

e.en: She {heroically} defended her teammates during the heated debate.
e.zh: 她在激烈的辩论中英勇地维护了队友。

heroics.t: n. 逞英雄的言行；豪言壮语

e.en: Don't try any {heroics} — just call the police and wait.
e.zh: 别逞英雄，赶紧报警等待就好。

e.en: His goal-line {heroics} won the championship for his team.
e.zh: 他在球门线上的英勇表现为球队赢得了冠军。

e.en: {Heroin} addiction has devastated many communities across the country.
e.zh: 海洛因成瘾摧毁了全国许多社区。

e.en: Police seized a large shipment of {heroin} at the border.
e.zh: 警方在边境查获了一大批海洛因。

e.en: The novel's {heroine} fights to save her village from invaders.
e.zh: 小说的女主人公奋力拯救她的村庄免受侵略者侵害。

e.en: Mulan is a beloved {heroine} in Chinese folklore.
e.zh: 花木兰是中国民间传说中深受喜爱的女英雄。

heroines.t: n. 女英雄/女主角（复数）

e.en: Modern fantasy novels feature strong, complex {heroines}.
e.zh: 现代奇幻小说塑造了坚强而复杂的女主人公。

e.en: The exhibition celebrated unsung {heroines} of the civil rights movement.
e.zh: 展览颂扬了民权运动中默默无闻的女英雄。

heroism.t: n. 英雄主义；英勇行为

e.en: The medal recognizes acts of extraordinary {heroism} in combat.
e.zh: 该勋章表彰战斗中非凡的英雄主义行为。

e.en: Her quiet {heroism} during the crisis inspired everyone.
e.zh: 她在危机中默默的英勇精神激励了所有人。

e.en: A grey {heron} stood motionless at the edge of the pond.
e.zh: 一只灰鹭一动不动地站在池塘边。

e.en: The {heron} swiftly snatched a fish from the shallow water.
e.zh: 那只苍鹭迅速从浅水中叼起一条鱼。

herpe.t: n. 疱疹（herpes 的误拼/单数形式）

e.en: People sometimes shorten {herpe} when casually referring to herpes.
e.zh: 人们有时会把疱疹一词简称为 herpe。

e.en: Note that {herpe} is informal slang, not the proper medical term.
e.zh: 请注意 herpe 是非正式俚语，并非正规医学术语。

e.en: The doctor prescribed antiviral medication for the {herpes} outbreak.
e.zh: 医生为这次疱疹发作开了抗病毒药物。

e.en: {Herpes} is a common viral infection that has no permanent cure.
e.zh: 疱疹是一种常见的病毒感染，目前无法根治。

e.en: Researchers are developing new vaccines targeting the {herpesvirus} family.
e.zh: 研究人员正在开发针对疱疹病毒家族的新疫苗。

e.en: The {herpesvirus} can remain dormant in nerve cells for years.
e.zh: 疱疹病毒可在神经细胞中潜伏多年。

herpetologist.t: n. 爬虫学家；两栖爬行动物学家

e.en: The {herpetologist} carefully handled the venomous snake during the demonstration.
e.zh: 那位爬行动物学家在演示中小心地处理了那条毒蛇。

e.en: As a {herpetologist}, she has discovered three new species of frogs.
e.zh: 作为一名爬行动物学家，她发现了三种新的青蛙物种。

herpetology.t: n. 爬虫学；两栖爬行动物学

e.en: He studied {herpetology} to learn more about reptiles and amphibians.
e.zh: 他研究爬行动物学，以更多了解爬行动物和两栖动物。

e.en: The university offers an advanced course in {herpetology} every spring.
e.zh: 该大学每年春季开设一门高级爬行动物学课程。

e.en: In Germany, you address a man formally as {Herr} Schmidt.
e.zh: 在德国，正式称呼男士时会说施密特先生。

e.en: {Herr} Müller greeted us warmly at the hotel entrance.
e.zh: 穆勒先生在酒店门口热情地迎接了我们。

e.en: Pickled {herring} is a traditional dish in Scandinavian cuisine.
e.zh: 腌鲱鱼是斯堪的纳维亚菜系中的一道传统菜肴。

e.en: The clue turned out to be a red {herring} in the mystery novel.
e.zh: 那条线索在这部推理小说中原来是个误导。

herringbone.t:
n. 人字形（花纹）
adj. 人字纹的

e.en: He wore a stylish {herringbone} jacket to the interview.
e.zh: 他穿着时尚的人字纹外套去面试。

e.en: The hallway features a beautiful {herringbone} wood floor.
e.zh: 走廊铺着漂亮的人字形木地板。

e.en: That blue umbrella by the door is {hers}.
e.zh: 门边那把蓝色的雨伞是她的。

e.en: The decision to move abroad was entirely {hers}.
e.zh: 出国的决定完全是她自己做的。

e.en: William {Herschel} discovered the planet Uranus in 1781.
e.zh: 威廉·赫歇尔于 1781 年发现了天王星。

e.en: The {Herschel} Space Observatory captured stunning infrared images of distant galaxies.
e.zh: 赫歇尔太空望远镜拍摄了遥远星系令人惊叹的红外图像。

e.en: She taught {herself} to code during the pandemic.
e.zh: 她在疫情期间自学了编程。

e.en: The CEO {herself} answered my support email.
e.zh: 那位首席执行官亲自回复了我的客服邮件。

e.en: He grabbed a {Hershey} bar from the checkout aisle.
e.zh: 他从结账通道拿了一条好时巧克力。

e.en: {Hershey} is famous for its chocolate factory in Pennsylvania.
e.zh: 好时以宾州的巧克力工厂而闻名。

hertford.t: n. 赫特福德（英国地名）

e.en: We took the train from London to {Hertford} this morning.
e.zh: 我们今早从伦敦坐火车去了赫特福德。

e.en: The old castle in {Hertford} attracts many weekend tourists.
e.zh: 赫特福德的古城堡吸引了许多周末游客。

hertfordshire.t: n. 赫特福德郡（英格兰）

e.en: Her family lives in a quiet village in {Hertfordshire}.
e.zh: 她家住在赫特福德郡一个安静的村庄。

e.en: {Hertfordshire} borders Greater London to the north.
e.zh: 赫特福德郡与大伦敦的北部接壤。

e.en: The address on the form just said {Herts}, UK.
e.zh: 表格上的地址只写了英国赫特福德郡。

e.en: She grew up in a small town in {Herts}.
e.zh: 她在赫特福德郡的一个小镇长大。

hertz.t: n. 赫兹（频率单位 Hz）

e.en: The monitor refreshes at 144 {hertz} for smoother gameplay.
e.zh: 这台显示器以144赫兹刷新,游戏画面更流畅。

e.en: We rented a car from {Hertz} at the airport.
e.zh: 我们在机场的赫兹租车点租了一辆车。

hemorrhaging.t:
v. 大量出血
n. 出血

e.en: The wounded soldier was {hemorrhaging} badly when help arrived.
e.zh: 救援到达时,这名受伤的士兵正在大量出血。

e.en: The company is {hemorrhaging} money on failed ad campaigns.
e.zh: 这家公司在失败的广告活动上大量亏钱。

e.en: He bought cream to treat a painful {hemorrhoid}.
e.zh: 他买了药膏来治疗疼痛的痔疮。

e.en: A high-fiber diet can help prevent {hemorrhoid} flare-ups.
e.zh: 高纤维饮食有助于预防痔疮发作。

e.en: The surgeon achieved {hemostasis} before closing the incision.
e.zh: 外科医生在缝合切口前完成了止血。

e.en: Platelets play a crucial role in {hemostasis}.
e.zh: 血小板在止血过程中起着关键作用。

e.en: The nurse handed the surgeon a small {hemostat}.
e.zh: 护士递给外科医生一把小止血钳。

e.en: He clamped the bleeding vessel with a {hemostat}.
e.zh: 他用止血钳夹住了出血的血管。

hemostatic.t:
adj. 止血的
n. 止血药

e.en: Combat medics carry {hemostatic} gauze for severe wounds.
e.zh: 战地医务人员会携带止血纱布用于严重伤口。

e.en: The surgeon applied a {hemostatic} agent to control bleeding.
e.zh: 外科医生使用止血剂来控制出血。

e.en: The bag is woven from durable {hemp} fibers.
e.zh: 这个包是用结实的麻纤维编织的。

e.en: Farmers in the region now grow {hemp} for textiles.
e.zh: 该地区的农民现在种植大麻用于纺织。

e.en: The shop sells various {hemps} sourced from local farms.
e.zh: 这家店销售来自本地农场的各种大麻产品。

e.en: Different {hemps} produce fibers of varying strength and texture.
e.zh: 不同的大麻品种产出的纤维强度和质地各异。

e.en: They grew up in Hemel {Hempstead}, just north of London.
e.zh: 他们在伦敦北边的赫默尔亨普斯特德长大。

e.en: The train stopped briefly at {Hempstead} before continuing.
e.zh: 火车在亨普斯特德短暂停靠后继续行驶。

e.en: The {hen} laid three eggs in the nesting box.
e.zh: 那只母鸡在产蛋箱里下了三个蛋。

e.en: A {hen} clucked loudly outside the kitchen window.
e.zh: 一只母鸡在厨房窗外大声咯咯叫。

e.en: The roads are icy; {hence}, schools are closed today.
e.zh: 道路结冰,因此今天学校停课。

e.en: The contract expires two years {hence}.
e.zh: 合同两年后到期。

e.en: {Henceforth}, all employees must use the new login system.
e.zh: 今后所有员工都必须使用新的登录系统。

e.en: The committee declared that {henceforth} meetings would be virtual.
e.zh: 委员会宣布今后会议将以线上方式进行。

e.en: {Henceforward}, the museum will charge an entrance fee.
e.zh: 从今往后,博物馆将收取入场费。

e.en: The treaty stated that {henceforward} both nations would cooperate.
e.zh: 条约规定从此两国将相互合作。

e.en: The villain sent his loyal {henchman} to deliver the threat.
e.zh: 反派派他忠心的手下去传达威胁。

e.en: Every Bond film features at least one memorable {henchman}.
e.zh: 每部邦德电影都至少有一个令人难忘的手下。

e.en: She trained as an officer at the {Hendon} police college.
e.zh: 她在亨登警察学院接受了军官培训。

e.en: They bought a small flat near {Hendon} Central station.
e.zh: 他们在亨登中央车站附近买了一套小公寓。

e.en: Tourists from around the world visit Stone{henge} each year.
e.zh: 每年都有来自世界各地的游客参观巨石阵。

e.en: Archaeologists discovered another ancient {henge} buried in the field.
e.zh: 考古学家在田野中发现了另一座埋藏的古代环状遗址。

e.en: The fox managed to break into the {henhouse} overnight.
e.zh: 狐狸在夜里设法闯进了鸡舍。

e.en: She collected fresh eggs from the {henhouse} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都从鸡舍里收集新鲜鸡蛋。

e.en: {Henkel} produces popular brands like Persil and Loctite.
e.zh: 汉高公司生产宝莹和乐泰等知名品牌。

e.en: She landed a marketing job at {Henkel}'s headquarters in Düsseldorf.
e.zh: 她在汉高位于杜塞尔多夫的总部找到了一份市场营销工作。

e.en: He wore a navy {henley} with rolled-up sleeves.
e.zh: 他穿着一件袖子卷起的海军蓝亨利衫。

e.en: They watched the rowing races at {Henley} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天他们在亨利观看了赛艇比赛。

e.en: She had intricate {henna} designs painted on her hands.
e.zh: 她手上画着精致的海娜花纹。

e.en: Many people use {henna} as a natural hair dye.
e.zh: 许多人用海娜作为天然染发剂。

e.en: He poured a glass of {Hennessy} cognac after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后他倒了一杯轩尼诗干邑。

e.en: The bar specializes in rare {Hennessy} vintages from France.
e.zh: 这家酒吧专营来自法国的稀有轩尼诗年份酒。

henpecked.t: adj. 怕老婆的；妻管严的

e.en: His friends teased him for being a {henpecked} husband.
e.zh: 朋友们嘲笑他是个怕老婆的丈夫。

e.en: The {henpecked} man quietly agreed to every demand.
e.zh: 那个唯命是从的男人默默答应了每个要求。

henry.t: n. 亨利（人名）；亨利（电感单位）

e.en: My neighbor named his golden retriever {Henry}.
e.zh: 我邻居给他的金毛取名叫亨利。

e.en: King {Henry} VIII is famous for his six wives.
e.zh: 亨利八世国王以他的六任妻子而闻名。

e.en: The {hens} laid eggs every morning in the coop.
e.zh: 母鸡们每天早上都在鸡舍里下蛋。

e.en: She keeps six {hens} in her backyard garden.
e.zh: 她在自家后院养了六只母鸡。

e.en: The nurse injected {heparin} to prevent blood clots.
e.zh: 护士注射了肝素以防止血栓形成。

e.en: Doctors monitor patients closely while administering {heparin}.
e.zh: 医生在使用肝素时会密切观察病人。

hepatic.t: adj. 肝脏的；与肝相关的

e.en: The test revealed signs of {hepatic} damage from alcohol.
e.zh: 检查显示饮酒造成的肝损伤迹象。

e.en: {Hepatic} function declines with age in many adults.
e.zh: 许多成年人的肝功能会随年龄下降。

e.en: He was vaccinated against {hepatitis} B before traveling.
e.zh: 他在出行前接种了乙型肝炎疫苗。

e.en: Chronic {hepatitis} can lead to serious liver disease.
e.zh: 慢性肝炎可能导致严重的肝脏疾病。

e.en: {Hepatocellular} carcinoma is the most common liver cancer.
e.zh: 肝细胞癌是最常见的肝癌类型。

e.en: The biopsy confirmed {hepatocellular} injury caused by the drug.
e.zh: 活检证实该药物引起了肝细胞损伤。

e.en: Each {hepatocyte} performs hundreds of metabolic functions daily.
e.zh: 每个肝细胞每天执行数百种代谢功能。

e.en: Researchers grew {hepatocyte} cultures to test new drugs.
e.zh: 研究人员培养肝细胞以测试新药。

hepplewhite.t: n. 赫普怀特（家具风格/姓氏）

e.en: She inherited a beautiful {Hepplewhite} chair from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她从祖母那里继承了一把精美的赫普怀特椅子。

e.en: The auction featured rare {Hepplewhite} furniture from England.
e.zh: 拍卖会上有来自英国的稀有赫普怀特家具。

e.en: {Heptachlor} was banned due to its environmental toxicity.
e.zh: 七氯因其环境毒性而被禁用。

e.en: Traces of {heptachlor} were found in the soil samples.
e.zh: 土壤样本中发现了七氯的残留。

e.en: She won gold in the Olympic {heptathlon} last summer.
e.zh: 她去年夏天在奥运会七项全能中夺得金牌。

e.en: The {heptathlon} tests speed, strength, and endurance over two days.
e.zh: 七项全能在两天内考验速度、力量和耐力。

e.en: I gave {her} the book she had been wanting.
e.zh: 我把她一直想要的那本书给了她。

e.en: She lost {her} phone somewhere on the train.
e.zh: 她把手机丢在火车上的某个地方了。

hera.t: n. 赫拉（希腊神话天后）

e.en: In Greek mythology, {Hera} was the queen of the gods.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,赫拉是众神之后。

e.en: The temple was built to honor the goddess {Hera}.
e.zh: 这座神庙是为纪念女神赫拉而建。

herald.t:
v. 预示；宣告
n. 先驱；传令官

e.en: Spring rains often {herald} the start of planting season.
e.zh: 春雨常常预示着播种季节的开始。

e.en: The medieval {herald} announced the king's arrival.
e.zh: 中世纪的传令官宣告了国王的到来。

heralded.t: v. 被誉为；预示（过去式）

e.en: The new policy was {heralded} as a major breakthrough.
e.zh: 这项新政策被誉为重大突破。

e.en: Trumpets {heralded} the queen's entrance into the hall.
e.zh: 号角声宣告女王进入大厅。

e.en: The shield bore an ornate {heraldic} design with lions.
e.zh: 盾牌上有一个带狮子的华丽纹章图案。

e.en: He studied {heraldic} symbols in old European manuscripts.
e.zh: 他研究欧洲古手稿中的纹章符号。

heralding.t: v. 预示；宣告（现在分词）

e.en: Cool winds began {heralding} the arrival of autumn.
e.zh: 凉风开始预示秋天的到来。

e.en: Critics are {heralding} the film as the year's best.
e.zh: 评论家们将这部电影誉为年度最佳。

e.en: He developed a passion for medieval {heraldry} and crests.
e.zh: 他对中世纪纹章学和盾徽产生了热情。

e.en: The museum has an excellent collection on English {heraldry}.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏了丰富的英国纹章学藏品。

heralds.t:
v. 预示，宣告
n. 先驱，传令官

e.en: The dawn chorus {heralds} a new day in the forest.
e.zh: 黎明的鸟鸣预示着森林新一天的开始。

e.en: Royal {heralds} once carried messages between kingdoms.
e.zh: 王室传令官曾在各王国之间传递消息。

e.en: Basil is my favorite {herb} for pasta dishes.
e.zh: 罗勒是我做意面最喜欢用的香草。

e.en: She grows every {herb} she needs on the windowsill.
e.zh: 她在窗台上种植了她需要的每种香草。

e.en: The garden features many {herbaceous} perennials in summer.
e.zh: 花园里夏季有许多草本多年生植物。

e.en: This wine has a fresh, {herbaceous} aroma of mint.
e.zh: 这款酒带有清新的薄荷草本香气。

herbage.t: n. 草本植物（总称）；牧草

e.en: The cattle grazed peacefully on the lush {herbage}.
e.zh: 牛群在茂盛的牧草上安静地吃草。

e.en: Drought reduced the {herbage} available to wild deer.
e.zh: 干旱减少了野鹿可吃的牧草。

herbal.t:
adj. 草药的，草本的
n. 本草书

e.en: I drink {herbal} tea every night before bed.
e.zh: 我每晚睡前都喝草本茶。

e.en: She prefers {herbal} remedies over prescription medication.
e.zh: 她比起处方药更喜欢草药疗法。

e.en: She studied traditional Chinese {herbalism} for over a decade.
e.zh: 她研究中国传统草药学已经十多年了。

e.en: Modern {herbalism} blends ancient wisdom with scientific research.
e.zh: 现代草药学将古老智慧与科学研究相结合。

e.en: The village {herbalist} prepared a tonic for her cough.
e.zh: 村里的草药师为她的咳嗽配制了一剂药水。

e.en: He trained as a {herbalist} after leaving medical school.
e.zh: 他从医学院退学后接受了草药师培训。

herbarium.t: n. 植物标本馆；植物标本集

e.en: The university maintains a {herbarium} with thousands of specimens.
e.zh: 该大学维护着一座拥有数千份标本的植物标本馆。

e.en: Researchers visited the {herbarium} to study rare plant samples.
e.zh: 研究人员参观植物标本馆研究珍稀植物样本。

e.en: She served warm {herbed} bread with the soup.
e.zh: 她端上了配汤的温热香草面包。

e.en: The chicken was roasted with {herbed} butter and lemon.
e.zh: 这只鸡是用香草黄油和柠檬烤制的。

e.en: Farmers spray {herbicide} to control unwanted weeds in fields.
e.zh: 农民喷洒除草剂来控制田间杂草。

e.en: This {herbicide} is safe for use around vegetable gardens.
e.zh: 这种除草剂在菜园周围使用很安全。

e.en: The cow is a {herbivore} that eats only plants.
e.zh: 牛是一种只吃植物的食草动物。

e.en: Each {herbivore} in the zoo follows a specialized diet.
e.zh: 动物园里的每种食草动物都有专门的饮食。

e.en: Most dinosaurs were actually {herbivorous}, not fierce predators.
e.zh: 大多数恐龙其实是食草动物,而非凶猛的捕食者。

e.en: Pandas are {herbivorous} and feed almost entirely on bamboo.
e.zh: 熊猫是食草动物,几乎完全以竹子为食。

herbs.t: n. 香草，草本植物（herb 的复数）

e.en: Fresh {herbs} can transform a simple pasta dish.
e.zh: 新鲜香草能让简单的意面焕然一新。

e.en: He grows {herbs} like rosemary and thyme on the balcony.
e.zh: 他在阳台上种着迷迭香和百里香等香草。

herby.t: adj. 有香草味的；多草的

e.en: The salad had a fresh, {herby} flavor from the dill.
e.zh: 沙拉因莳萝而带有清新的香草味。

e.en: This olive oil has a wonderfully {herby} aftertaste.
e.zh: 这款橄榄油有着美妙的香草余味。

e.en: Bosnia and {Hercegovina} has stunning medieval bridges and rivers.
e.zh: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那有令人惊叹的中世纪桥梁和河流。

e.en: She traveled through {Hercegovina} to photograph its old towns.
e.zh: 她游历黑塞哥维那拍摄那里的古老小镇。

herculean.t: adj. 艰巨的；力大无穷的

e.en: Cleaning the entire house was a {herculean} task.
e.zh: 打扫整间房子是项艰巨无比的任务。

e.en: It took a {herculean} effort to finish the project on time.
e.zh: 按时完成这个项目需要付出巨大的努力。

hercules.t: n. 大力神赫拉克勒斯

e.en: {Hercules} is famous for completing twelve impossible labors.
e.zh: 赫拉克勒斯以完成十二项不可能的任务而闻名。

e.en: The statue of {Hercules} stood in the museum's main hall.
e.zh: 赫拉克勒斯雕像矗立在博物馆的大厅里。

herd.t:
n. 兽群，牧群
v. 放牧；聚集

e.en: A {herd} of elephants crossed the river at sunset.
e.zh: 一群大象在日落时分穿过了河流。

e.en: The dog helped {herd} the sheep into the barn.
e.zh: 那只狗帮忙把羊群赶进了牲口棚。

e.en: The breeder updated the {herdbook} with each new calf.
e.zh: 养殖人每生一头新犊就更新一次种畜登记簿。

e.en: Pedigree details are recorded carefully in the official {herdbook}.
e.zh: 血统详情会被仔细记录在官方种畜登记簿中。

e.en: The {herder} guided his goats up the mountain path.
e.zh: 牧人沿着山路赶着他的山羊向上走。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a cattle {herder} for decades.
e.zh: 他祖父做了几十年的牧牛人。

herding.t:
v. 放牧；群体聚集
n. 从众行为

e.en: Border collies are excellent at {herding} sheep.
e.zh: 边境牧羊犬非常擅长牧羊。

e.en: Managing toddlers sometimes feels like {herding} cats.
e.zh: 管小孩有时感觉就像在赶猫一样难。

e.en: Vast {herds} of bison once roamed the American plains.
e.zh: 大群的野牛曾在美洲平原上漫游。

e.en: The rancher {herds} his cattle to fresh pasture each morning.
e.zh: 牧场主每天早上把牛群赶到新鲜的草场。

e.en: The old {herdsman} knew every animal in his flock.
e.zh: 老牧人认识他羊群中的每一只动物。

e.en: A skilled {herdsman} can manage hundreds of cattle alone.
e.zh: 熟练的牧人可以独自管理数百头牛。

e.en: Please sit {here} while I get you some tea.
e.zh: 请坐在这里,我去给你倒杯茶。

e.en: I left my keys {here} on the table this morning.
e.zh: 我今早把钥匙放在这桌子上了。

e.en: There aren't many good restaurants {hereabouts} after midnight.
e.zh: 这附近午夜过后没几家好餐厅了。

e.en: People {hereabouts} still remember the old factory closing.
e.zh: 这一带的人们还记得那家老工厂关门的事。

hereafter.t:
adv. 此后，今后
n. 来世

e.en: Many religions teach about life in the {hereafter}.
e.zh: 许多宗教教导关于来世的生活。

e.en: The contract terms shall {hereafter} be governed by Swiss law.
e.zh: 此后合同条款将受瑞士法律管辖。

e.en: I {hereby} declare this meeting officially open.
e.zh: 我特此宣布会议正式开始。

e.en: The committee {hereby} approves the budget for next year.
e.zh: 委员会特此批准明年的预算。

e.en: Some forms of cancer are partly {hereditary}.
e.zh: 某些癌症在一定程度上是遗传性的。

e.en: The British monarchy is a {hereditary} institution.
e.zh: 英国君主制是世袭制度。

e.en: {Heredity} plays a major role in determining eye color.
e.zh: 遗传在决定眼睛颜色方面起主要作用。

e.en: Scientists study {heredity} to understand how traits pass down.
e.zh: 科学家研究遗传学以了解性状如何传递。

hereford.t: n. 赫里福德（英国地名／牛种）

e.en: The rancher raises {Hereford} cattle for premium beef.
e.zh: 这位牧场主饲养赫里福德牛以生产优质牛肉。

e.en: A {Hereford} bull is recognizable by its white face.
e.zh: 赫里福德公牛以其白色脸部而易于辨认。

herefordshire.t: n. 赫里福德郡（英格兰郡名）

e.en: {Herefordshire} is famous for its cider and rolling countryside.
e.zh: 赫里福德郡以其苹果酒和起伏的乡村闻名。

e.en: They bought a small farmhouse in rural {Herefordshire}.
e.zh: 他们在赫里福德郡乡下买了一栋小农舍。

e.en: The terms defined {herein} apply to the entire agreement.
e.zh: 本协议中所定义的条款适用于整份协议。

e.en: All data referenced {herein} comes from official sources.
e.zh: 此处引用的所有数据均来自官方来源。

e.en: The tenant, {hereinafter} called the lessee, must pay monthly rent.
e.zh: 承租人，以下简称租户，须按月支付租金。

e.en: John Smith, {hereinafter} referred to as the buyer, signed the contract.
e.zh: 约翰·史密斯，以下称买方，签署了合同。

hereof.t: adv. 关于此点；在本文件中

e.en: The terms {hereof} apply to all parties involved.
e.zh: 本协议的条款适用于所有相关方。

e.en: Section three {hereof} outlines the payment schedule.
e.zh: 本文件第三条列明了付款时间表。

e.en: Suggesting pineapple on pizza is culinary {heresy} to many Italians.
e.zh: 对许多意大利人来说，披萨上加菠萝是烹饪界的异端邪说。

e.en: The medieval church punished {heresy} severely.
e.zh: 中世纪教会对异端思想严加惩处。

e.en: He was branded a {heretic} for questioning the traditional teachings.
e.zh: 他因质疑传统教义而被斥为异端分子。

e.en: Galileo was treated as a {heretic} for supporting heliocentrism.
e.zh: 伽利略因支持日心说而被视为异端。

heretical.t: adj. 异端的；离经叛道的

e.en: Her {heretical} views on economics shocked the conservative panel.
e.zh: 她在经济学上的异端观点让保守派评审震惊。

e.en: The book was banned for containing {heretical} ideas.
e.zh: 这本书因含有异端思想而被禁。

e.en: The signatures of all parties {hereto} confirm the agreement.
e.zh: 本协议各方的签字确认了协议内容。

e.en: Please refer to the schedule attached {hereto} for details.
e.zh: 详情请参阅本文件所附的附表。

heretofore.t: adv. 迄今为止；在此之前

e.en: The discovery revealed details {heretofore} unknown to scientists.
e.zh: 这项发现揭示了科学家迄今未知的细节。

e.en: She achieved a level of success {heretofore} unseen in the company.
e.zh: 她取得了公司前所未有的成功。

herewith.t: adv. 随函附上；与此一同

e.en: Please find {herewith} the documents you requested.
e.zh: 随函附上您所要求的文件。

e.en: I am sending {herewith} a copy of the signed contract.
e.zh: 现随信寄上已签署合同的副本。

heriot.t:
n. (英史) 农奴死后领主征收的财物
(罕用)

e.en: Medieval peasants often paid a {heriot} to the lord upon a tenant's death.
e.zh: 中世纪农民在租户去世时常向领主缴纳遗产税。

e.en: The {heriot} was typically the deceased's best beast or chattel.
e.zh: 封建遗产税通常是死者最好的牲畜或动产。

e.en: Scientists study the {heritability} of intelligence across generations.
e.zh: 科学家研究智力在代际间的遗传性。

e.en: The {heritability} of height is estimated to be quite high.
e.zh: 身高的遗传率被估计为相当高。

heritable.t: adj. 可继承的；可遗传的

e.en: Eye color is a {heritable} trait passed from parents to children.
e.zh: 眼睛颜色是父母遗传给子女的可遗传特征。

e.en: Researchers identified several {heritable} risk factors for the disease.
e.zh: 研究人员确定了该疾病的几种可遗传风险因素。

e.en: Kyoto is famous for preserving Japan's cultural {heritage}.
e.zh: 京都以保存日本的文化遗产而闻名。

e.en: She is proud of her Irish {heritage} and traditions.
e.zh: 她为自己的爱尔兰血统和传统感到自豪。

e.en: The festival celebrates the diverse {heritages} of immigrant communities.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝移民社区的多元文化传承。

e.en: Many ancient {heritages} are at risk due to climate change.
e.zh: 许多古老的文化遗产因气候变化而面临风险。

herzog.t: n. 赫尔佐格（人名/姓氏）

e.en: Werner {Herzog} narrates documentaries with a haunting voice.
e.zh: 沃纳·赫尔佐格以令人难忘的嗓音为纪录片配音。

e.en: The film festival featured a retrospective of {Herzog}'s work.
e.zh: 电影节展映了赫尔佐格作品的回顾展。

hesiod.t: n. 赫西俄德（古希腊诗人）

e.en: {Hesiod} described the ages of mankind in his ancient poem.
e.zh: 赫西俄德在其古诗中描述了人类的诸时代。

e.en: Students read {Hesiod} alongside Homer in Greek literature class.
e.zh: 在希腊文学课上,学生们与荷马一同研读赫西俄德。

e.en: His {hesitance} to commit worried his business partners.
e.zh: 他迟迟不肯承诺,让生意伙伴感到担忧。

e.en: There was clear {hesitance} in her voice on the phone.
e.zh: 她在电话里的语气中带着明显的犹豫。

e.en: Vaccine {hesitancy} remains a public health challenge.
e.zh: 对疫苗的犹豫仍是公共卫生面临的挑战。

e.en: Her {hesitancy} about the offer suggested unspoken doubts.
e.zh: 她对这份提议的犹豫暗示着未说出口的疑虑。

hesitant.t: adj. 犹豫的；迟疑不决的

e.en: I'm {hesitant} to share my password with anyone online.
e.zh: 我不太愿意把密码分享给任何网上的人。

e.en: The new employee gave a {hesitant} answer in the meeting.
e.zh: 那位新员工在会上给出了一个犹豫的答复。

hesitantly.t: adv. 犹豫地；吞吞吐吐地

e.en: She {hesitantly} clicked the unsubscribe button on the email.
e.zh: 她犹豫地点击了邮件中的退订按钮。

e.en: He {hesitantly} agreed to join the group project.
e.zh: 他犹豫地答应加入这个小组项目。

e.en: Don't {hesitate} to message me if you have questions.
e.zh: 如有任何问题,请不要犹豫,随时给我发消息。

e.en: She didn't {hesitate} to dive into the cold pool.
e.zh: 她毫不犹豫地跳进了冰冷的泳池。

hesitated.t: v. 犹豫（hesitate 的过去式）

e.en: He {hesitated} before posting the controversial tweet.
e.zh: 他在发布那条有争议的推文前犹豫了一下。

e.en: She {hesitated} at the door, then walked inside.
e.zh: 她在门口犹豫了一下,然后走了进去。

hesitates.t: v. 犹豫（hesitate 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The app sometimes {hesitates} for a moment before loading.
e.zh: 这款应用加载前有时会卡顿片刻。

e.en: He never {hesitates} when ordering coffee in the morning.
e.zh: 早上点咖啡时,他从来不犹豫。

hesitating.t: v. 犹豫（hesitate 的现在分词）

e.en: She kept {hesitating} over which plan to subscribe to.
e.zh: 她一直在犹豫该订阅哪个套餐。

e.en: After {hesitating} for a moment, he finally accepted the offer.
e.zh: 犹豫了片刻之后,他终于接受了这个提议。

e.en: She {hesitatingly} typed her credit card number on the website.
e.zh: 她犹豫地在网站上输入了信用卡号。

e.en: He {hesitatingly} raised his hand to ask a question.
e.zh: 他犹豫地举起手准备提问。

e.en: Without {hesitation}, she accepted the job offer.
e.zh: 她毫不犹豫地接受了这份工作。

e.en: There was a brief {hesitation} before he replied to the text.
e.zh: 他在回复短信前停顿了一下。

e.en: Despite her {hesitations}, she signed up for the marathon.
e.zh: 尽管心存疑虑,她还是报名参加了马拉松。

e.en: The contract addressed all of his earlier {hesitations}.
e.zh: 这份合同回应了他先前所有的顾虑。

hesse.t: n. 黑塞（姓氏，如作家 Hermann Hesse）

e.en: Hermann {Hesse} won the Nobel Prize for literature in 1946.
e.zh: 赫尔曼·黑塞于1946年获得诺贝尔文学奖。

e.en: Frankfurt is the largest city in the German state of {Hesse}.
e.zh: 法兰克福是德国黑森州最大的城市。

hessian.t:
n. 粗麻布
n. 黑森雇佣兵

e.en: She wrapped the gift in rustic {hessian} cloth and twine.
e.zh: 她用粗麻布和麻绳把礼物包了起来。

e.en: The optimizer computes the {Hessian} matrix for second-order updates.
e.zh: 该优化器计算海森矩阵以进行二阶更新。

e.en: Charlton {Heston} starred in many classic Hollywood epics.
e.zh: 查尔顿·赫斯顿主演过许多经典的好莱坞史诗片。

e.en: Chef {Heston} Blumenthal is known for experimental cooking techniques.
e.zh: 赫斯顿·布鲁门撒尔大厨以其实验性的烹饪手法而闻名。

hetero.t: adj. 异性恋的（heterosexual 的缩写）

e.en: The dating app lets users filter by {hetero} or queer matches.
e.zh: 这款约会应用允许用户按异性恋或酷儿匹配进行筛选。

e.en: Most of his coworkers identify as {hetero}.
e.zh: 他的大多数同事都自认为是异性恋。

e.en: Many drugs contain {heterocyclic} rings in their molecular structure.
e.zh: 许多药物的分子结构中都含有杂环。

e.en: Caffeine is a well-known {heterocyclic} compound.
e.zh: 咖啡因是一种众所周知的杂环化合物。

e.en: Her {heterodox} views on economics sparked heated debate online.
e.zh: 她在经济学上的非正统观点在网上引发了激烈争论。

e.en: The professor is famous for his {heterodox} approach to teaching.
e.zh: 这位教授以其非正统的教学方法而闻名。

e.en: His book celebrates intellectual {heterodoxy} in modern academia.
e.zh: 他的书赞扬了现代学术界的思想异端。

e.en: The church once treated such ideas as dangerous {heterodoxy}.
e.zh: 教会曾把此类观点视为危险的异端邪说。

e.en: The dataset's {heterogeneity} makes simple averages misleading.
e.zh: 数据集的异质性使简单的平均值具有误导性。

e.en: Cultural {heterogeneity} is one of the city's greatest strengths.
e.zh: 文化的多元异质性是这座城市最大的优势之一。

heterogeneous.t: adj. 异质的；由不同成分组成的

e.en: The team is {heterogeneous}, with members from six countries.
e.zh: 这支团队成员多元,来自六个国家。

e.en: GPUs handle {heterogeneous} workloads better than traditional CPUs.
e.zh: GPU比传统CPU更擅长处理异构工作负载。

heterogenous.t: adj. 异质的（heterogeneous 的变体）

e.en: Patient responses to the drug were highly {heterogenous}.
e.zh: 患者对该药物的反应差异很大。

e.en: Cloud platforms must support {heterogenous} hardware configurations.
e.zh: 云平台必须支持各种不同的硬件配置。

e.en: Modern solar cells often use a silicon {heterojunction} design.
e.zh: 现代太阳能电池常采用硅异质结设计。

e.en: The laser relies on a {heterojunction} between two semiconductors.
e.zh: 该激光器依赖两种半导体之间的异质结。

heteronomous.t: adj. 他律的；受外部支配的

e.en: Children often follow {heteronomous} rules set by their parents.
e.zh: 孩子们往往遵守父母制定的他律规则。

e.en: Kant contrasted autonomous reason with {heteronomous} desires.
e.zh: 康德将自主理性与他律的欲望相对照。

heterosexism.t: n. 异性恋中心主义；对非异性恋者的歧视

e.en: The workshop addressed {heterosexism} in workplace policies.
e.zh: 研讨会探讨了职场政策中的异性恋至上主义。

e.en: Many films from that era reflect casual {heterosexism}.
e.zh: 那个年代的许多电影都流露出随意的异性恋至上主义。

heterosexist.t: adj. 歧视非异性恋者的

e.en: The advertisement was criticized for its {heterosexist} assumptions.
e.zh: 这则广告因其异性恋至上的预设而遭到批评。

e.en: She refused to laugh at his {heterosexist} jokes.
e.zh: 她拒绝对他那些异性恋至上的笑话发笑。

heterosexual.t:
adj. 异性恋的
n. 异性恋者

e.en: The survey included both {heterosexual} and LGBTQ respondents.
e.zh: 这项调查包含了异性恋者和LGBTQ受访者。

e.en: He came out as {heterosexual} after years of confusion.
e.zh: 经过多年的困惑后,他公开自己是异性恋。

e.en: The book examines how {heterosexuality} has been culturally constructed.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了异性恋在文化上是如何被建构的。

e.en: Compulsory {heterosexuality} is a key concept in feminist theory.
e.zh: 强制异性恋是女性主义理论中的一个关键概念。

e.en: The character is portrayed {heterosexually} throughout the series.
e.zh: 该角色在整部剧中都以异性恋形象呈现。

e.en: Most participants in the study identified {heterosexually}.
e.zh: 研究中的大多数参与者认同自己为异性恋。

e.en: The patient underwent a {heterotopic} heart transplant last year.
e.zh: 这位患者去年接受了异位心脏移植手术。

e.en: Doctors observed {heterotopic} bone growth after the injury.
e.zh: 医生在受伤后观察到了异位骨化现象。

e.en: Animals are {heterotrophic} and must consume other organisms for energy.
e.zh: 动物属于异养生物,必须摄食其他生物以获取能量。

e.en: Most fungi follow a {heterotrophic} mode of nutrition.
e.zh: 大多数真菌采取异养的营养方式。

e.en: Genetic {heterozygosity} helps populations adapt to changing environments.
e.zh: 遗传杂合性帮助种群适应不断变化的环境。

e.en: The study measured {heterozygosity} across hundreds of loci.
e.zh: 该研究测量了数百个基因位点上的杂合度。

e.en: A {heterozygote} carries two different alleles for the same gene.
e.zh: 杂合子在同一基因上携带两种不同的等位基因。

e.en: Sickle cell {heterozygote} carriers have some resistance to malaria.
e.zh: 镰状细胞杂合子携带者对疟疾有一定抵抗力。

e.en: The plant is {heterozygous} for flower color.
e.zh: 这株植物在花色基因上呈杂合状态。

e.en: She is {heterozygous} for the cystic fibrosis gene.
e.zh: 她是囊性纤维化基因的杂合携带者。

e.en: I planted {heuchera} along the shaded edge of the garden.
e.zh: 我在花园的阴凉边缘种了矾根。

e.en: The {heuchera} leaves turned a brilliant purple in autumn.
e.zh: 矾根的叶子在秋天变成了亮丽的紫色。

heuristic.t:
adj. 启发式的
n. 启发法；经验法则

e.en: The chess engine uses a {heuristic} to evaluate board positions.
e.zh: 国际象棋引擎使用一种启发式方法来评估棋局。

e.en: "Trust your gut" is a useful {heuristic} for quick decisions.
e.zh: "相信直觉"是一种用于快速决策的实用经验法则。

e.en: The algorithm {heuristically} prunes branches that look unpromising.
e.zh: 该算法以启发式方式剪去看起来希望不大的分支。

e.en: Designers often work {heuristically}, refining ideas through iteration.
e.zh: 设计师常采用启发式方法,通过反复迭代来完善想法。

heuristics.t: n. 启发法；启发式算法

e.en: Good UX design follows established usability {heuristics}.
e.zh: 优秀的用户体验设计遵循公认的可用性启发式准则。

e.en: Investors rely on {heuristics} when data is incomplete.
e.zh: 在数据不完整时,投资者会依赖经验法则。

e.en: The team continues to {hew} closely to the original product vision.
e.zh: 团队继续紧紧贴合最初的产品愿景。

e.en: Workers used axes to {hew} logs into rough planks.
e.zh: 工人们用斧头将原木砍成粗糙的木板。

e.en: The old {hewer} could shape a beam in under an hour.
e.zh: 那位老木匠能在一小时内砍出一根梁木。

e.en: Each {hewer} in the mine was paid by the ton.
e.zh: 矿里的每位采煤工都是按吨计酬的。

hewlett.t: n. 休利特（姓氏，如 HP 创始人）

e.en: {Hewlett}-Packard was founded in a small Palo Alto garage.
e.zh: 惠普公司是在帕洛阿尔托一间小车库里创立的。

e.en: The {Hewlett} Foundation funds many education research projects.
e.zh: 休利特基金会资助许多教育研究项目。

hewn.t: adj. 砍削成形的（hew 的过去分词）

e.en: The cabin was built from rough-{hewn} pine logs.
e.zh: 这间小木屋是用粗糙砍削的松木原木搭建的。

e.en: Stairs were {hewn} directly into the side of the cliff.
e.zh: 台阶被直接凿在悬崖的侧面。

hex.t:
n. 十六进制
n. 魔咒；诅咒

e.en: Designers usually pick brand colors using {hex} codes.
e.zh: 设计师通常使用十六进制代码来选取品牌色。

e.en: She joked that a {hex} was on her Wi-Fi router.
e.zh: 她开玩笑说她的Wi-Fi路由器中了魔咒。

hexadecimal.t:
adj. 十六进制的
n. 十六进制

e.en: Colors in CSS are often written in {hexadecimal} format like #FF5733.
e.zh: CSS中的颜色常用十六进制格式书写，例如#FF5733。

e.en: Programmers use {hexadecimal} to represent memory addresses compactly.
e.zh: 程序员用十六进制简洁地表示内存地址。

e.en: A honeycomb cell is shaped like a perfect {hexagon}.
e.zh: 蜂巢的小室呈现完美的六边形。

e.en: The board game uses tiles in the form of a {hexagon}.
e.zh: 这款桌游使用六边形的板块。

e.en: The new pavilion has a striking {hexagonal} roof.
e.zh: 新凉亭有一个引人注目的六角形屋顶。

e.en: Bees build {hexagonal} cells to store honey efficiently.
e.zh: 蜜蜂建造六角形巢室以高效储存蜂蜜。

e.en: Homer's epics were composed in dactylic {hexameter}.
e.zh: 荷马的史诗是用扬抑抑格六音步写成的。

e.en: Latin poets often wrote in {hexameter} for grand themes.
e.zh: 拉丁诗人常用六音步格律书写宏大主题。

hexham.t: n. 赫克瑟姆（英国地名）

e.en: We stopped in {Hexham} on our drive through Northumberland.
e.zh: 我们驾车穿越诺森伯兰时在赫克瑟姆停留。

e.en: {Hexham} Abbey is one of England's oldest standing churches.
e.zh: 赫克瑟姆修道院是英国现存最古老的教堂之一。

e.en: {Hey}, can you pass me the salt?
e.zh: 嘿，能把盐递给我吗？

e.en: {Hey} there, I haven't seen you in ages!
e.zh: 嘿，好久不见了！

e.en: In its {heyday}, the magazine sold millions of copies.
e.zh: 该杂志在鼎盛时期销量达数百万册。

e.en: Disco music had its {heyday} in the late 1970s.
e.zh: 迪斯科音乐在七十年代末迎来全盛时期。

e.en: The ferry to the Isle of Man departs from {Heysham}.
e.zh: 前往马恩岛的渡轮从赫舍姆出发。

e.en: {Heysham} is a small coastal village in Lancashire.
e.zh: 赫舍姆是兰开夏郡的一个海滨小村庄。

e.en: My grandfather grew up in {Heywood}, near Manchester.
e.zh: 我祖父在曼彻斯特附近的海伍德长大。

e.en: The town of {Heywood} hosts an annual brass band festival.
e.zh: 海伍德镇每年举办铜管乐队节。

hezbollah.t: n. 真主党（黎巴嫩组织）

e.en: {Hezbollah} is a political and militant group based in Lebanon.
e.zh: 真主党是一个总部设在黎巴嫩的政治与武装组织。

e.en: News reports discussed tensions between Israel and {Hezbollah}.
e.zh: 新闻报道讨论了以色列与真主党之间的紧张局势。

hgv.t: n. 重型货车（heavy goods vehicle）

e.en: He passed his {HGV} licence test last week.
e.zh: 他上周通过了重型货车驾照考试。

e.en: The motorway has a separate lane for {HGV} traffic.
e.zh: 这条高速公路为重型货车设置了专用车道。

hi-tech.t: adj. 高科技的；高技术的

e.en: The startup raised funds to build a {hi-tech} research lab.
e.zh: 这家初创公司筹集资金建立高科技研究实验室。

e.en: Her apartment is full of {hi-tech} smart-home gadgets.
e.zh: 她的公寓里满是高科技智能家居小玩意。

e.en: The band returned to touring after a five-year {hiatus}.
e.zh: 乐队在中断五年后重新开始巡演。

e.en: She took a brief {hiatus} from social media to focus on work.
e.zh: 她暂时离开社交媒体以专注于工作。

e.en: Longfellow's poem about {Hiawatha} is taught in many schools.
e.zh: 朗费罗关于海华沙的诗在许多学校都有教授。

e.en: The legend of {Hiawatha} inspired countless American artists.
e.zh: 海华沙的传说启发了无数美国艺术家。

hib.t: n. B型流感嗜血杆菌（疫苗缩写）

e.en: Babies routinely receive the {Hib} vaccine to prevent meningitis.
e.zh: 婴儿通常接种Hib疫苗以预防脑膜炎。

e.en: The {Hib} immunization schedule starts at two months of age.
e.zh: Hib免疫接种从两个月大时开始。

hibachi.t: n. 日式炭火烤炉；火钵

e.en: We grilled shrimp on a small {hibachi} on the balcony.
e.zh: 我们在阳台上用小型烧烤炉烤虾。

e.en: The chef performed tricks at the {hibachi} table.
e.zh: 厨师在铁板烧餐桌前表演花式技巧。

e.en: Bears {hibernate} through the cold winter months.
e.zh: 熊在寒冷的冬季会进入冬眠状态。

e.en: You can set your laptop to {hibernate} when the lid closes.
e.zh: 你可以设置笔记本电脑在合上盖子时进入休眠。

e.en: The tortoise {hibernated} in a box of straw all winter.
e.zh: 乌龟整个冬天都在一箱稻草里冬眠。

e.en: My computer {hibernated} overnight and saved all my tabs.
e.zh: 我的电脑昨晚进入休眠并保留了所有标签页。

hibernates.t: v. 冬眠；休眠（第三人称单数）

e.en: The dormouse {hibernates} for nearly six months each year.
e.zh: 睡鼠每年要冬眠近六个月。

e.en: This server {hibernates} automatically when traffic drops.
e.zh: 流量下降时这台服务器会自动进入休眠。

e.en: Don't disturb the {hibernating} hedgehog under the leaves.
e.zh: 不要打扰落叶下正在冬眠的刺猬。

e.en: My old phone has been {hibernating} in a drawer for years.
e.zh: 我的旧手机在抽屉里闲置了好几年。

e.en: Ground squirrels enter {hibernation} when temperatures drop sharply.
e.zh: 气温骤降时地松鼠会进入冬眠。

e.en: After a long {hibernation}, the project is finally active again.
e.zh: 经过长期搁置，这个项目终于又活跃起来了。

e.en: Some bats survive several long {hibernations} during their lifetime.
e.zh: 有些蝙蝠一生中要经历多次长时间冬眠。

e.en: Research compared the {hibernations} of bears and marmots.
e.zh: 研究比较了熊和土拨鼠的冬眠习性。

hibernian.t:
adj. 爱尔兰的
n. 爱尔兰人

e.en: He's a lifelong fan of the {Hibernian} football club.
e.zh: 他一生都是希伯尼安足球俱乐部的球迷。

e.en: The pub hosts a {Hibernian} cultural night every Friday.
e.zh: 这家酒吧每周五举办爱尔兰文化之夜。

e.en: A bright red {hibiscus} bloomed beside the front door.
e.zh: 一朵鲜红的木槿花在前门旁绽放。

e.en: She drank cold {hibiscus} tea on the hot afternoon.
e.zh: 她在炎热的午后喝着冰镇洛神花茶。

e.en: He gave a loud {hic} after drinking the soda too fast.
e.zh: 他汽水喝得太快，打了个响亮的嗝。

e.en: The baby let out a tiny {hic} and then fell asleep.
e.zh: 宝宝打了个小小的嗝，然后就睡着了。

e.en: She tried holding her breath to stop the {hiccough}.
e.zh: 她试着屏住呼吸来止住打嗝。

e.en: The launch went smoothly without a single {hiccough}.
e.zh: 发布过程一帆风顺，没有出现任何小问题。

hiccup.t:
n. 打嗝；小故障
v. 打嗝

e.en: There was a small {hiccup} in the deployment, but we fixed it.
e.zh: 部署过程中出了点小状况，不过我们已经解决了。

e.en: Drinking water sometimes cures a stubborn {hiccup}.
e.zh: 喝水有时能治好顽固的打嗝。

e.en: He grew tired of being called a country {hick} by his classmates.
e.zh: 他厌倦了被同学们叫做乡巴佬。

e.en: The film stereotypes the small town as a {hick} backwater.
e.zh: 那部电影把那个小镇刻板地描绘成乡下偏僻之地。

e.en: She wore a scarf to hide the {hickey} on her neck.
e.zh: 她围着围巾掩盖脖子上的吻痕。

e.en: He blushed when his sister noticed the {hickey}.
e.zh: 妹妹发现那个吻痕时，他脸红了。

e.en: The barbecue smelled wonderful from the burning {hickory} wood.
e.zh: 烧烤散发着山核桃木燃烧的诱人香味。

e.en: He carved a walking stick from a young {hickory} branch.
e.zh: 他用一根嫩山核桃树枝雕了一根手杖。

hid.t: v. 藏；躲藏（hide 的过去式）

e.en: The cat {hid} under the bed during the thunderstorm.
e.zh: 雷雨期间，猫躲在床底下。

e.en: She {hid} the gift in the closet until his birthday.
e.zh: 她把礼物藏在衣柜里，等到他生日那天。

hidalgo.t: n. 西班牙小贵族；伊达尔戈（地名）

e.en: The novel features a proud Spanish {hidalgo} on horseback.
e.zh: 小说塑造了一位骑马的高傲西班牙贵族绅士。

e.en: Don Quixote is the most famous fictional {hidalgo} in literature.
e.zh: 堂吉诃德是文学中最著名的虚构西班牙乡绅。

e.en: There's a {hidden} menu inside the app's settings page.
e.zh: 这款应用的设置页面里有一个隐藏菜单。

e.en: They discovered a {hidden} treasure beneath the old floorboards.
e.zh: 他们在旧地板下发现了一处隐藏的宝藏。

e.en: Theologians have long debated the {hiddenness} of God.
e.zh: 神学家长期以来一直在探讨上帝的隐匿性。

e.en: The poem explores the {hiddenness} of grief in everyday life.
e.zh: 这首诗探讨了日常生活中悲伤的隐藏性。

hide.t:
v. 隐藏；躲藏
n. 兽皮

e.en: Children love to {hide} behind the curtains during the game.
e.zh: 孩子们在游戏中喜欢躲在窗帘后面。

e.en: You can {hide} the toolbar by pressing this shortcut key.
e.zh: 按下这个快捷键就可以隐藏工具栏。

e.en: They rented a quiet {hideaway} in the mountains for the weekend.
e.zh: 他们在山里租了一处安静的隐居小屋度周末。

e.en: The cafe is a popular {hideaway} for local writers.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆是当地作家喜爱的静谧去处。

hidebound.t: adj. 墨守成规的；思想僵化的

e.en: The company's {hidebound} policies stifled new ideas.
e.zh: 公司墨守成规的政策扼杀了新的创意。

e.en: He criticized the {hidebound} traditions of the old institution.
e.zh: 他批评这家老机构那些固执守旧的传统。

e.en: That wallpaper pattern is absolutely {hideous}.
e.zh: 那种壁纸图案实在是丑得不行。

e.en: The accident left a {hideous} scar across his forehead.
e.zh: 事故在他额头上留下了一道可怕的疤痕。

e.en: The new logo is {hideously} designed and hard to read.
e.zh: 新标志设计得丑陋不堪，难以辨认。

e.en: Concert tickets are {hideously} expensive these days.
e.zh: 如今演唱会门票贵得离谱。

e.en: The film does not flinch from the {hideousness} of war.
e.zh: 这部电影毫不回避战争的丑恶面貌。

e.en: Even the painting's {hideousness} drew curious crowds.
e.zh: 就连这幅画的丑陋也吸引了好奇的人群。

e.en: Police finally tracked the suspects to their forest {hideout}.
e.zh: 警方最终追踪到嫌疑人位于森林中的藏身处。

e.en: As kids, we built a secret {hideout} in the backyard.
e.zh: 小时候我们在后院搭了一个秘密藏身处。

hides.t:
v. 躲藏；隐藏
n. 兽皮（复数）

e.en: Whenever the doorbell rings, the puppy {hides} behind the sofa.
e.zh: 门铃一响，小狗就躲到沙发后面。

e.en: The app {hides} notifications during scheduled focus hours.
e.zh: 该应用在专注时段内会隐藏通知。

e.en: The fugitive has been in {hiding} for nearly a year.
e.zh: 那名逃犯已经躲藏了将近一年。

e.en: Stop {hiding} your feelings and tell me what's wrong.
e.zh: 别再隐藏你的感受，告诉我出了什么事。

hie.t: v. 急忙前往（古旧用法）

e.en: Let us {hie} to the market before the rain begins.
e.zh: 我们赶紧在下雨前去市场吧。

e.en: The messenger had to {hie} back to the castle at once.
e.zh: 信使不得不立即赶回城堡。

e.en: The cathedral was filled with priests and a visiting {hierarch}.
e.zh: 大教堂里挤满了神父和一位来访的高级教士。

e.en: Each {hierarch} of the church wore distinctive ceremonial robes.
e.zh: 教会的每位高级主教都身着独特的礼服。

e.en: The army has a strictly {hierarchal} chain of command.
e.zh: 军队拥有严格的等级指挥体系。

e.en: Their startup avoids the {hierarchal} structure of big firms.
e.zh: 他们的初创公司避免大公司的等级结构。

e.en: Medieval society followed a rigid {hierarchic} order.
e.zh: 中世纪社会遵循严格的等级秩序。

e.en: The file system uses a {hierarchic} folder structure.
e.zh: 文件系统采用层级式的文件夹结构。

e.en: The database stores categories in a {hierarchical} tree structure.
e.zh: 数据库以层级树状结构存储类别。

e.en: Many Asian workplaces still follow a {hierarchical} management style.
e.zh: 许多亚洲工作场所仍沿用等级森严的管理方式。

e.en: The menu items are arranged {hierarchically} for easy navigation.
e.zh: 菜单项按层级排列，便于浏览。

e.en: Tasks are organized {hierarchically} under each main project.
e.zh: 任务在每个主项目下按层级组织。

e.en: Modern startups try to flatten traditional corporate {hierarchies}.
e.zh: 现代初创公司努力打破传统的企业层级结构。

e.en: Animal {hierarchies} often determine access to food and mates.
e.zh: 动物的等级关系往往决定它们获取食物和配偶的机会。

hierarchy.t: n. 层级结构；等级制度

e.en: The company has a strict {hierarchy} of management levels.
e.zh: 公司有严格的管理层级体系。

e.en: In the file system, folders form a clear {hierarchy}.
e.zh: 在文件系统中,文件夹形成清晰的层级结构。

hieratic.t:
adj. 祭司的
n. 古埃及僧侣体文字

e.en: The priest's {hieratic} robes were embroidered with gold thread.
e.zh: 祭司的圣职袍上用金线绣着花纹。

e.en: Ancient Egyptians used a {hieratic} script for religious texts.
e.zh: 古埃及人用一种僧侣体文字书写宗教文献。

e.en: Each {hieroglyph} on the tomb wall told part of a story.
e.zh: 墓墙上的每个象形文字都讲述着故事的一部分。

e.en: The scholar tried to decode the mysterious {hieroglyph}.
e.zh: 那位学者试图破译这个神秘的象形符号。

hieroglyphic.t:
adj. 象形文字的
n. 象形文字

e.en: The temple walls were covered in {hieroglyphic} inscriptions.
e.zh: 神庙墙壁上布满了象形文字铭文。

e.en: His handwriting is so messy it looks {hieroglyphic}.
e.zh: 他的字迹潦草得像象形文字一样难辨认。

higgs.t: n. 希格斯（姓氏/希格斯粒子）

e.en: Scientists confirmed the {Higgs} boson at the Large Hadron Collider.
e.zh: 科学家在大型强子对撞机上证实了希格斯玻色子的存在。

e.en: Peter {Higgs} won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2013.
e.zh: 彼得·希格斯于2013年获得诺贝尔物理学奖。

high.t:
adj. 高的；高水平的
adv. 高高地

e.en: The mountain is too {high} to climb without proper gear.
e.zh: 这座山太高,没有专业装备无法攀登。

e.en: Gas prices are unusually {high} this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天油价异常地高。

high-profile.t: adj. 高调的；备受关注的

e.en: She took on a {high-profile} case that made national headlines.
e.zh: 她接手了一桩登上全国头条的高知名度案件。

e.en: The startup hired a {high-profile} CEO from Google.
e.zh: 这家初创公司从谷歌挖来一位备受瞩目的首席执行官。

high-rise.t:
adj. 高层的
n. 高层建筑

e.en: They moved into a {high-rise} apartment overlooking the river.
e.zh: 他们搬进了一套俯瞰河景的高层公寓。

e.en: New {high-rise} buildings are reshaping the city skyline.
e.zh: 新建的高层建筑正在重塑城市的天际线。

e.en: The hospital invested in {high-tech} surgical equipment.
e.zh: 医院投资购置了高科技手术设备。

e.en: Shenzhen is famous for its {high-tech} industries.
e.zh: 深圳以其高科技产业而闻名。

e.en: The train stopped briefly at {Higham} station before continuing.
e.zh: 火车在海厄姆站短暂停靠后继续前行。

e.en: Charles Dickens once lived near {Higham} in Kent.
e.zh: 查尔斯·狄更斯曾住在肯特郡海厄姆附近。

highball.t: n. 加冰烈酒兑苏打水的调酒

e.en: He ordered a whiskey {highball} at the hotel bar.
e.zh: 他在酒店酒吧点了一杯威士忌高球。

e.en: A {highball} glass is taller than a regular tumbler.
e.zh: 高球杯比普通的平底杯要高一些。

e.en: The {highborn} lady refused to marry a commoner.
e.zh: 那位出身高贵的女士拒绝嫁给平民。

e.en: Only {highborn} children attended the royal academy.
e.zh: 只有出身名门的孩子才能入读皇家学院。

e.en: She inherited an antique {highboy} from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她从祖母那里继承了一个古董高脚柜。

e.en: The {highboy} in the bedroom holds all my sweaters.
e.zh: 卧室里的高脚抽屉柜放着我所有的毛衣。

highbrow.t:
adj. 高雅的；自诩高深的
n. 自命不凡者

e.en: The magazine targets {highbrow} readers who love literary fiction.
e.zh: 这本杂志面向喜爱文学小说的高雅读者。

e.en: His taste in films is too {highbrow} for most audiences.
e.zh: 他的电影品味对大多数观众来说过于高雅。

e.en: Arsenal played at {Highbury} stadium for nearly a century.
e.zh: 阿森纳在海布里球场踢了将近一个世纪。

e.en: She rented a small flat in {Highbury}, North London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦北部的海布里租了一间小公寓。

e.en: The baby giggled while sitting in the wooden {highchair}.
e.zh: 宝宝坐在木制高脚椅上咯咯地笑。

e.en: Please strap your toddler securely into the {highchair}.
e.zh: 请把孩子牢牢地绑在高脚餐椅上。

e.en: Prices are {higher} this year than last year.
e.zh: 今年的物价比去年更高。

e.en: She aims for a {higher} position in the company.
e.zh: 她的目标是在公司里获得更高的职位。

highers.t: n. 苏格兰高级会考科目

e.en: Scottish students sit their {Highers} exams in May.
e.zh: 苏格兰学生在五月份参加高级会考。

e.en: She passed five {Highers} and got into Edinburgh University.
e.zh: 她通过了五门高级会考并考入了爱丁堡大学。

e.en: Mount Everest is the {highest} mountain in the world.
e.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最高的山。

e.en: This product received the {highest} rating from customers.
e.zh: 该产品获得了客户的最高评分。

highfield.t: n. 地名/姓氏（海菲尔德）

e.en: The new shopping center opened in {Highfield} last month.
e.zh: 新的购物中心上个月在海菲尔德开业了。

e.en: She grew up on a farm near {Highfield} village.
e.zh: 她在海菲尔德村附近的一个农场长大。

e.en: Karl Marx is buried in {Highgate} Cemetery in London.
e.zh: 卡尔·马克思安葬于伦敦的海格特公墓。

e.en: They bought a Victorian house in {Highgate} village.
e.zh: 他们在海格特村买下了一栋维多利亚式房屋。

highland.t:
n. 高地；山区
adj. 高地的

e.en: The Scottish {Highland} scenery attracts millions of tourists yearly.
e.zh: 苏格兰高地的风光每年吸引数百万游客。

e.en: They raise cattle on a {highland} farm in Peru.
e.zh: 他们在秘鲁的一个高地农场养牛。

highlander.t: n. 高地居民；苏格兰高地人

e.en: The proud {Highlander} wore his clan's traditional tartan kilt.
e.zh: 那位骄傲的高地人穿着家族传统的格子呢短裙。

e.en: My uncle drives a Toyota {Highlander} for family trips.
e.zh: 我叔叔开着一辆丰田汉兰达去家庭旅行。

highlight.t:
v. 突出；高亮显示
n. 亮点；精彩片段

e.en: Let me {highlight} the key points of the report.
e.zh: 让我重点说明这份报告的关键要点。

e.en: Meeting the author was the {highlight} of my trip.
e.zh: 见到那位作家是我此次旅行最精彩的部分。

highlighted.t: adj. 被高亮的；被强调的

e.en: The teacher {highlighted} important passages in yellow marker.
e.zh: 老师用黄色记号笔标出了重要段落。

e.en: Her speech {highlighted} the urgent need for climate action.
e.zh: 她的演讲强调了采取气候行动的紧迫性。

e.en: She used a yellow {highlighter} to mark the test answers.
e.zh: 她用黄色荧光笔标出测验答案。

e.en: This makeup {highlighter} adds a subtle glow to your cheeks.
e.zh: 这款高光化妆品能为脸颊增添柔和的光泽。

e.en: The article is {highlighting} the dangers of plastic pollution.
e.zh: 这篇文章着重指出了塑料污染的危害。

e.en: She spent the afternoon {highlighting} her textbook chapters.
e.zh: 她花了一下午用荧光笔标记教科书的章节。

highlights.t: n. 精彩片段；亮点合集

e.en: I watched the match {highlights} on YouTube last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我在YouTube上看了比赛的精彩片段。

e.en: She got blonde {highlights} added to her hair.
e.zh: 她在头发里挑染了金色的发丝。

e.en: This restaurant is {highly} recommended by food critics.
e.zh: 这家餐厅深受美食评论家的推荐。

e.en: He speaks {highly} of his former teacher.
e.zh: 他对他以前的老师赞不绝口。

e.en: Her Royal {Highness} will attend the charity gala tonight.
e.zh: 殿下今晚将出席慈善晚宴。

e.en: The guards bowed as His {Highness} entered the hall.
e.zh: 卫兵在殿下进入大厅时鞠躬致意。

e.en: Winning the championship was the {highpoint} of her career.
e.zh: 赢得冠军是她职业生涯的巅峰时刻。

e.en: The fireworks display was the {highpoint} of the festival.
e.zh: 烟花表演是这次节日活动的最高潮。

e.en: A new {highrise} is being built next to the park.
e.zh: 公园旁边正在兴建一栋新的高层建筑。

e.en: They live on the 30th floor of a {highrise}.
e.zh: 他们住在一栋高层建筑的30楼。

highs.t: n. 高点；兴奋状态（复数）

e.en: The stock market hit new {highs} this week.
e.zh: 本周股市创下新高。

e.en: Her career has had its {highs} and lows.
e.zh: 她的职业生涯有过高峰也有过低谷。

e.en: We need to {hightail} it home before the storm hits.
e.zh: 我们得在暴风雨来临前赶紧回家。

e.en: The thieves {hightailed} out of town after the robbery.
e.zh: 窃贼们抢劫之后迅速逃离了城镇。

e.en: There was a serious accident on the {highway} this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上高速公路上发生了一起严重事故。

e.en: This {highway} connects the two largest cities in the state.
e.zh: 这条公路连接着该州最大的两座城市。

e.en: The masked {highwayman} robbed travelers on the lonely road.
e.zh: 蒙面的拦路强盗在荒凉的路上抢劫旅客。

e.en: Legends tell of a {highwayman} who stole from the rich.
e.zh: 传说中有一位拦路大盗专门劫富济贫。

e.en: The government plans to repair aging {highways} across the country.
e.zh: 政府计划修缮全国各地老化的高速公路。

e.en: Trucks transport goods along the country's major {highways}.
e.zh: 卡车沿着国家的主要公路运送货物。

hijab.t: n. 希贾布（穆斯林女性头巾）

e.en: She chose to wear a colorful {hijab} to the wedding.
e.zh: 她选择戴一条彩色的头巾去参加婚礼。

e.en: Many Muslim women wear a {hijab} as an expression of faith.
e.zh: 许多穆斯林女性佩戴头巾以表达信仰。

hijack.t:
v. 劫持（飞机、车辆）
n. 劫持事件

e.en: Hackers tried to {hijack} the company's social media accounts.
e.zh: 黑客试图劫持该公司的社交媒体账号。

e.en: Don't let one person {hijack} the entire meeting agenda.
e.zh: 别让一个人把整个会议议程都霸占了。

hijacked.t: v. 劫持（hijack 的过去式）

e.en: Pirates {hijacked} the cargo ship off the coast of Somalia.
e.zh: 海盗在索马里海岸附近劫持了那艘货船。

e.en: Malware {hijacked} my browser and changed the homepage.
e.zh: 恶意软件劫持了我的浏览器并更改了主页。

e.en: The {hijacker} demanded a ransom of one million dollars.
e.zh: 劫机者要求一百万美元的赎金。

e.en: Security forces eventually captured the {hijacker} alive.
e.zh: 安全部队最终活捉了那名劫机者。

hijacking.t:
n. 劫持事件
v. 正在劫持

e.en: The airline strengthened security after the {hijacking} incident.
e.zh: 航空公司在劫机事件后加强了安保措施。

e.en: He was arrested for {hijacking} a delivery truck.
e.zh: 他因劫持一辆送货卡车而被捕。

hijacks.t:
v. 劫持（第三人称单数）
n. 劫持事件

e.en: This virus {hijacks} your computer's resources to mine cryptocurrency.
e.zh: 这种病毒会劫持你电脑的资源来挖加密货币。

e.en: There were several plane {hijacks} reported last decade.
e.zh: 过去十年曾报道过几起飞机劫持事件。

hijinks.t: n. 嬉闹，喧闹的恶作剧

e.en: The kids' {hijinks} at the sleepover kept everyone awake.
e.zh: 孩子们在过夜聚会上的胡闹让大家都没睡好。

e.en: The comedy film is full of college dorm {hijinks}.
e.zh: 这部喜剧电影充满了大学宿舍的搞笑闹剧。

hijra.t: n. 希吉拉（伊斯兰教纪元）

e.en: The Islamic calendar begins with the {Hijra} from Mecca to Medina.
e.zh: 伊斯兰历从先知由麦加迁徙到麦地那的希吉拉开始。

e.en: In India, the {hijra} community has gained legal recognition.
e.zh: 在印度,海吉拉群体已获得法律承认。

hike.t:
v. 徒步旅行
n. 远足；（价格）上涨

e.en: We're planning a long {hike} in the mountains this weekend.
e.zh: 我们计划这个周末去山里进行一次长途徒步。

e.en: The company announced a {hike} in subscription prices.
e.zh: 该公司宣布上调订阅价格。

e.en: The lost {hiker} was rescued after two days in the forest.
e.zh: 那位走失的徒步者在森林中迷路两天后获救。

e.en: Every experienced {hiker} carries extra water and a map.
e.zh: 每个有经验的徒步者都会带上额外的水和地图。

hikes.t:
n. 远足；上涨
v. 徒步旅行（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {hikes} in the national park every weekend.
e.zh: 她每个周末都去国家公园徒步。

e.en: The Fed announced two more interest rate {hikes} this year.
e.zh: 美联储宣布今年还会有两次加息。

e.en: We went {hiking} along the coastal trail at sunrise.
e.zh: 我们在日出时沿着海岸小径去徒步。

e.en: Good {hiking} boots are essential for rocky terrain.
e.zh: 在崎岖的地形上,一双好的徒步靴必不可少。

e.en: Their weekend {hikings} through the mountains became a family tradition.
e.zh: 他们周末穿越山区的徒步活动成了家庭传统。

e.en: Several {hikings} were canceled due to the heavy rainfall.
e.zh: 由于大雨,好几次徒步活动被取消了。

hilar.t: adj. 肺门的；门的（解剖学）

e.en: The doctor pointed to a {hilar} mass on the chest X-ray.
e.zh: 医生指着胸片上肺门处的一个肿块。

e.en: Enlarged {hilar} lymph nodes can indicate infection or cancer.
e.zh: 肺门淋巴结肿大可能提示感染或癌症。

hilarious.t: adj. 非常好笑的，令人捧腹的

e.en: That stand-up special was absolutely {hilarious} from start to finish.
e.zh: 那场单口喜剧专场从头到尾都笑死人了。

e.en: My dog's reaction to the cucumber was {hilarious}.
e.zh: 我家狗看到黄瓜的反应太搞笑了。

hilariously.t: adv. 滑稽地，令人捧腹地

e.en: The meme spread {hilariously} fast across Twitter overnight.
e.zh: 这个梗一夜之间在推特上传播得快得离谱。

e.en: He {hilariously} mispronounced the chef's name on live TV.
e.zh: 他在直播中把厨师的名字念错,笑翻全场。

e.en: The cat's antics caused {hilarity} in the office.
e.zh: 那只猫的滑稽举动让办公室笑成一片。

e.en: His autocorrect typo led to general {hilarity} in the group chat.
e.zh: 他的自动更正错字让群聊里笑翻了天。

hilbert.t: n. 希尔伯特（人名/数学家）

e.en: Quantum states live in an infinite-dimensional {Hilbert} space.
e.zh: 量子态存在于无穷维的希尔伯特空间中。

e.en: David {Hilbert} posed twenty-three famous problems in 1900.
e.zh: 大卫·希尔伯特在1900年提出了著名的二十三个问题。

e.en: We hiked up the {hill} to watch the sunset.
e.zh: 我们爬上山丘去看日落。

e.en: The little cottage sits on a grassy {hill}.
e.zh: 那座小屋坐落在一片青草覆盖的山丘上。

hillbilly.t: n. 山区乡巴佬（美国口语）

e.en: The movie portrays a {hillbilly} family with surprising warmth.
e.zh: 这部电影出人意料地温情地刻画了一个山里人家庭。

e.en: He plays {hillbilly} music on a banjo every weekend.
e.zh: 他每个周末都用班卓琴弹乡村山区音乐。

hillier.t: adj. 丘陵更多的（hilly 比较级）

e.en: San Francisco is much {hillier} than I expected.
e.zh: 旧金山的山坡比我想象的多得多。

e.en: The trail gets {hillier} after the second mile.
e.zh: 步道走过第二英里后坡度就变陡了。

e.en: {Hillingdon} is the second-largest borough in Greater London.
e.zh: 希灵登是大伦敦第二大的自治市。

e.en: Heathrow Airport lies within the borough of {Hillingdon}.
e.zh: 希思罗机场位于希灵登区内。

hillman.t: n. 希尔曼（姓氏/汽车品牌）

e.en: My grandfather drove an old {Hillman} Imp in the sixties.
e.zh: 我爷爷六十年代开过一辆老式希尔曼Imp。

e.en: The vintage {Hillman} sedan still runs surprisingly well.
e.zh: 这辆老式希尔曼轿车竟然还跑得挺顺。

e.en: A small {hillock} rose at the edge of the meadow.
e.zh: 草地边缘有一座小土丘。

e.en: Sheep grazed peacefully on the grassy {hillock}.
e.zh: 羊群在长满青草的小丘上安静地吃草。

e.en: The {hills} around Tuscany glow gold at sunset.
e.zh: 托斯卡纳周围的丘陵在日落时金光闪闪。

e.en: We drove through rolling green {hills} all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午我们都在连绵起伏的青山间行驶。

e.en: The {Hillsborough} disaster of 1989 changed UK stadium safety forever.
e.zh: 1989年的希尔斯堡惨案彻底改变了英国球场的安全标准。

e.en: {Hillsborough} County is one of Florida's most populous regions.
e.zh: 希尔斯堡郡是佛罗里达州人口最多的地区之一。

e.en: Wildflowers covered the entire {hillside} in spring.
e.zh: 春天里整个山坡都开满了野花。

e.en: Their cabin overlooks a vineyard on the southern {hillside}.
e.zh: 他们的小木屋俯瞰着南面山坡上的葡萄园。

e.en: The ancient temple sits proudly on a {hilltop}.
e.zh: 那座古老的寺庙巍然屹立在山顶上。

e.en: From the {hilltop} you can see three counties.
e.zh: 从山顶望去可以看到三个郡的景色。

e.en: Cycling through the {hilly} countryside left my legs aching.
e.zh: 骑车穿过这片多山的乡村让我两腿酸痛。

e.en: Lisbon is famous for its charming {hilly} streets.
e.zh: 里斯本以其迷人的山坡街道而闻名。

e.en: He gripped the sword's {hilt} and stepped forward.
e.zh: 他握紧剑柄向前一步。

e.en: The dagger was buried up to the {hilt}.
e.zh: 匕首一直插到了剑柄处。

hilton.t: n. 希尔顿（酒店品牌/姓氏）

e.en: We booked a suite at the {Hilton} for our anniversary.
e.zh: 我们在希尔顿订了一间套房庆祝结婚纪念日。

e.en: The {Hilton} downtown offers a great loyalty program.
e.zh: 市中心的希尔顿酒店有很棒的会员计划。

e.en: I told {him} the meeting starts at nine.
e.zh: 我告诉他会议九点开始。

e.en: Everyone at the party was looking for {him}.
e.zh: 派对上每个人都在找他。

e.en: Climbing the {Himalaya} requires months of preparation.
e.zh: 攀登喜马拉雅山需要数月的准备。

e.en: The {Himalaya} stretches across five different countries.
e.zh: 喜马拉雅山脉横跨五个不同的国家。

e.en: {Himalayan} pink salt has become wildly popular in cooking.
e.zh: 喜马拉雅粉盐在烹饪中变得非常受欢迎。

e.en: The {Himalayan} cat has long fur and blue eyes.
e.zh: 喜马拉雅猫有着长毛和蓝眼睛。

e.en: He taught {himself} Python through online tutorials.
e.zh: 他通过网上教程自学了Python。

e.en: The CEO {himself} replied to my email.
e.zh: 是CEO本人回复了我的邮件。

e.en: {Hinckley} is a market town in Leicestershire, England.
e.zh: 欣克利是英格兰莱斯特郡的一个集镇。

e.en: We stopped for lunch in {Hinckley} on our way north.
e.zh: 北上途中我们在欣克利停下来吃了午饭。

hind.t:
adj. 后面的，后部的
n. 母鹿

e.en: The deer balanced briefly on its {hind} legs.
e.zh: 那只鹿短暂地用后腿站立平衡。

e.en: My dog scratched its ear with a {hind} paw.
e.zh: 我家狗用一只后爪挠耳朵。

hindenburg.t: n. 兴登堡（人名/飞艇名）

e.en: The {Hindenburg} airship disaster shocked the world in 1937.
e.zh: 1937年兴登堡飞艇灾难震惊了全世界。

e.en: Paul von {Hindenburg} served as Germany's president before Hitler.
e.zh: 保罗·冯·兴登堡在希特勒之前担任德国总统。

e.en: Heavy traffic could {hinder} our arrival at the airport.
e.zh: 严重的交通堵塞可能会拖延我们到达机场。

e.en: Don't let fear {hinder} you from trying new things.
e.zh: 别让恐惧阻碍你尝试新事物。

e.en: Fog {hindered} rescue efforts throughout the night.
e.zh: 大雾整夜阻碍了救援工作。

e.en: His progress was {hindered} by a lack of funding.
e.zh: 他的进展因资金不足而受阻。

e.en: Outdated software is {hindering} the team's productivity.
e.zh: 过时的软件正在拖累团队的生产效率。

e.en: Stop {hindering} your colleagues by skipping meetings.
e.zh: 别再因为缺席会议而拖累同事了。

hinders.t: v. 阻碍（第三人称单数）

e.en: Lack of sleep seriously {hinders} memory and focus.
e.zh: 睡眠不足会严重影响记忆力和注意力。

e.en: Bureaucracy often {hinders} small business growth.
e.zh: 官僚主义常常阻碍小企业的发展。

e.en: She's been learning {Hindi} on Duolingo for six months.
e.zh: 她在Duolingo上学印地语已经六个月了。

e.en: Many Bollywood films are produced primarily in {Hindi}.
e.zh: 许多宝莱坞电影主要以印地语制作。

e.en: The puppy stood on one {hindleg} to reach the treat.
e.zh: 小狗用一只后腿站起来够零食。

e.en: The horse injured its {hindleg} during the race.
e.zh: 那匹马在比赛中弄伤了一条后腿。

hindmost.t: adj. 最后面的；最靠后的

e.en: The {hindmost} runner finally crossed the finish line.
e.zh: 最后一名跑者终于冲过了终点线。

e.en: Save yourselves and devil take the {hindmost}.
e.zh: 各自逃命,落后者自求多福。

hindquarter.t: n. （四足动物的）后半身；后腿

e.en: The butcher trimmed the {hindquarter} of beef expertly.
e.zh: 屠夫熟练地修整了那块牛后腿肉。

e.en: A wolf bit the deer's {hindquarter} during the chase.
e.zh: 追逐中一只狼咬住了那只鹿的后腿部位。

e.en: His shyness was a real {hindrance} during job interviews.
e.zh: 他的害羞在求职面试中确实是个障碍。

e.en: Bad weather proved no {hindrance} to the marathon runners.
e.zh: 恶劣天气并未阻碍马拉松选手们。

e.en: We removed several {hindrances} from the onboarding flow.
e.zh: 我们从注册流程中移除了好几个障碍。

e.en: Language barriers are common {hindrances} for new immigrants.
e.zh: 语言障碍是新移民常见的阻碍。

e.en: Three young {hinds} grazed quietly at the forest edge.
e.zh: 三只年轻的母鹿在森林边静静地吃草。

e.en: The estate is home to dozens of red {hinds}.
e.zh: 这片庄园里栖息着数十头马鹿母鹿。

hindsight.t: n. 事后之见；后见之明

e.en: In {hindsight}, I should have invested earlier.
e.zh: 事后看来,我本该更早投资的。

e.en: {Hindsight} makes every decision look obvious.
e.zh: 事后诸葛亮总能让每个决定看起来都显而易见。

e.en: The book collects {hindsights} from retired tech founders.
e.zh: 这本书收录了退休科技创始人们的事后反思。

e.en: Her essay shared honest {hindsights} about her startup failure.
e.zh: 她的文章坦诚分享了创业失败后的种种反思。

hindu.t:
n. 印度教徒
adj. 印度教的

e.en: Diwali is a major {Hindu} festival celebrated worldwide.
e.zh: 排灯节是全球庆祝的重要印度教节日。

e.en: The {Hindu} temple opens early for morning prayers.
e.zh: 那座印度教神庙清晨就开放供晨祷。

e.en: {Hinduism} is one of the world's oldest living religions.
e.zh: 印度教是世界上最古老的现存宗教之一。

e.en: The professor lectured on the core texts of {Hinduism}.
e.zh: 教授讲授了印度教的核心经典。

e.en: Indian cooks add a pinch of {hing} to lentil dishes.
e.zh: 印度厨师会在扁豆菜里加一小撮阿魏粉。

e.en: {Hing} gives curry a distinctive savory aroma.
e.zh: 阿魏粉为咖喱带来独特的鲜香气味。

hinge.t:
n. 铰链；合页
v. 取决于

e.en: The cabinet door's {hinge} squeaks every time it opens.
e.zh: 柜门的合页每次打开都会吱吱作响。

e.en: The whole argument seems to {hinge} on one assumption.
e.zh: 整个论点似乎都取决于一个假设。

hinged.t:
adj. 装有铰链的
v. 取决于（过去式）

e.en: The success of the launch {hinged} on server stability.
e.zh: 发布的成败取决于服务器的稳定性。

e.en: The box has a {hinged} lid for easy access.
e.zh: 这个盒子有一个铰链盖,方便取用。

e.en: {Hinkley} Point C is a major nuclear project in England.
e.zh: 欣克利角C核电站是英格兰的一项重大核能工程。

e.en: Erin Brockovich exposed pollution in {Hinkley}, California.
e.zh: 艾琳·布罗克维奇揭露了加州欣克利的污染事件。

hint.t:
n. 提示；暗示
v. 暗示

e.en: Could you give me a small {hint} about the answer?
e.zh: 能给我一点关于答案的小提示吗?

e.en: There's a {hint} of lemon in this dressing.
e.zh: 这款调味汁里有一丝柠檬味。

e.en: She {hinted} that a promotion might be coming soon.
e.zh: 她暗示我可能很快会被提拔。

e.en: The trailer {hinted} at a major plot twist.
e.zh: 预告片暗示了一个重大的剧情反转。

e.en: The startup expanded from the city into the rural {hinterland}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司从城市扩张到了乡村腹地。

e.en: Australia's vast {hinterland} remains sparsely populated.
e.zh: 澳大利亚广袤的内陆地区依然人烟稀少。

e.en: He kept {hinting} that he wanted a new phone.
e.zh: 他一直在暗示自己想要一部新手机。

e.en: The CEO is {hinting} at major changes next quarter.
e.zh: CEO正在暗示下季度会有重大变动。

hints.t:
n. 提示（复数）
v. 暗示（第三人称单数）

e.en: The puzzle game offers three free {hints} per day.
e.zh: 这款解谜游戏每天提供三次免费提示。

e.en: Her smile gave subtle {hints} that she knew the secret.
e.zh: 她的微笑微妙地暗示她知道这个秘密。

hip.t:
n. 臀部；髋部
adj. 时髦的

e.en: That café in Brooklyn is super {hip} right now.
e.zh: 布鲁克林那家咖啡馆现在非常潮。

e.en: My grandmother needs surgery on her left {hip}.
e.zh: 我奶奶的左髋关节需要做手术。

e.en: She bruised her {hipbone} after slipping on the icy sidewalk.
e.zh: 她在结冰的人行道上滑倒，撞伤了髋骨。

e.en: The dog was so thin that its {hipbone} stuck out.
e.zh: 那只狗瘦得髋骨都凸了出来。

e.en: The cafe lost its {hipness} once tourists started flocking in.
e.zh: 游客一涌入，这家咖啡馆就失去了它的潮流感。

e.en: He works hard to maintain an air of effortless {hipness}.
e.zh: 他费尽心思营造一种毫不费力的时髦感。

e.en: She's totally {hipped} on that new Korean drama.
e.zh: 她迷上了那部新的韩剧。

e.en: The house has a {hipped} roof that sheds rain well.
e.zh: 这房子是四坡屋顶，排水效果很好。

e.en: Her grandfather was a {hippie} who lived in a commune.
e.zh: 她爷爷曾是个住在公社里的嬉皮士。

e.en: The cafe has a relaxed {hippie} vibe with tie-dye decor.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆有种轻松的嬉皮风，挂着扎染装饰。

e.en: A {hippo} surfaced slowly in the muddy river.
e.zh: 一只河马慢慢地从泥泞的河中浮了上来。

e.en: The kids loved watching the {hippo} yawn at the zoo.
e.zh: 孩子们最爱在动物园看河马打哈欠。

hippocampal.t: adj. 海马体的（脑部结构）

e.en: The study found {hippocampal} shrinkage in chronic stress patients.
e.zh: 研究发现长期压力患者出现海马体萎缩。

e.en: Sleep plays a key role in {hippocampal} memory consolidation.
e.zh: 睡眠在海马体记忆巩固中起着关键作用。

e.en: The {hippocampus} is crucial for forming new long-term memories.
e.zh: 海马体对形成新的长期记忆至关重要。

e.en: Alzheimer's disease often damages the {hippocampus} early on.
e.zh: 阿尔茨海默病通常会在早期损害海马体。

hippocrates.t: n. 希波克拉底（古希腊医师）

e.en: {Hippocrates} is often called the father of Western medicine.
e.zh: 希波克拉底常被誉为西方医学之父。

e.en: Modern doctors still echo the ethics of {Hippocrates}.
e.zh: 现代医生仍在传承希波克拉底的医学伦理。

hippocratic.t: adj. 希波克拉底的（如誓言）

e.en: Every new doctor swears the {Hippocratic} Oath at graduation.
e.zh: 每位新医生在毕业时都要宣读希波克拉底誓言。

e.en: Selling patient data clearly violates {Hippocratic} principles.
e.zh: 出售患者数据明显违反了希波克拉底原则。

e.en: Crowds gathered at the {hippodrome} to watch the chariot races.
e.zh: 人群聚集在赛马场观看战车比赛。

e.en: The old London {Hippodrome} is now a famous casino.
e.zh: 伦敦那座老竞技场如今是一家著名赌场。

e.en: A {hippopotamus} can run surprisingly fast on land.
e.zh: 河马在陆地上跑起来速度快得惊人。

e.en: The {hippopotamus} spends most of the day submerged in water.
e.zh: 河马一天中大部分时间都泡在水里。

hippy.t:
n. 嬉皮士
adj. 臀部丰满的

e.en: Her parents were {hippy} types who loved folk music.
e.zh: 她父母是热爱民谣的嬉皮派。

e.en: The store sells {hippy} clothes like flowing skirts and beads.
e.zh: 这家店卖嬉皮风的衣服，比如飘逸长裙和串珠。

e.en: She rested her hands on her {hips} and laughed.
e.zh: 她双手叉腰大笑起来。

e.en: Yoga has really loosened up my tight {hips}.
e.zh: 瑜伽真的放松了我僵硬的胯部。

e.en: The neighborhood is full of {hipster} cafes and vintage shops.
e.zh: 这一带满是文艺青年咖啡馆和复古小店。

e.en: He looks like a typical {hipster} with his beard and beanie.
e.zh: 他留着胡子戴着毛线帽，活脱脱一个潮人。

e.en: Some writers use {hir} as a gender-neutral pronoun online.
e.zh: 一些作者在网上使用 hir 作为中性代词。

e.en: The character asked the author to use {hir} instead of him.
e.zh: 那个角色请作者用 hir 来代替 him。

hire.t:
v. 雇用；租用
n. 雇用

e.en: The startup plans to {hire} ten engineers this quarter.
e.zh: 这家初创公司计划本季度招聘十名工程师。

e.en: You can {hire} a bike near the train station.
e.zh: 你可以在火车站附近租一辆自行车。

hired.t:
adj. 受雇的
v. 雇用（过去式）

e.en: They {hired} her right after the second interview.
e.zh: 第二轮面试后他们就录用了她。

e.en: We {hired} a van to move our furniture across town.
e.zh: 我们租了一辆货车把家具搬到城另一头。

e.en: The villain sent a {hireling} to do his dirty work.
e.zh: 那个反派派了个雇佣打手去干肮脏勾当。

e.en: Critics dismissed the columnist as a corporate {hireling}.
e.zh: 评论家斥责这位专栏作家不过是企业的走狗。

e.en: The {hirer} is responsible for any damage to the equipment.
e.zh: 承租人需对设备的任何损坏负责。

e.en: A good {hirer} looks beyond the resume during interviews.
e.zh: 优秀的招聘者在面试时会看简历之外的东西。

hires.t:
v. 雇用（hire 的第三人称单数）
n. 新员工

e.en: Our team {hires} mostly through employee referrals.
e.zh: 我们团队主要通过员工推荐来招人。

e.en: The company onboarded twenty new {hires} last week.
e.zh: 公司上周让二十名新员工入职了。

hiring.t:
n. 招聘；雇用
v. hire 的现在分词

e.en: The company is {hiring} aggressively for AI engineers.
e.zh: 这家公司正在大力招聘 AI 工程师。

e.en: Bias in {hiring} remains a serious workplace issue.
e.zh: 招聘中的偏见仍是职场上的严重问题。

e.en: The atomic bombing of {Hiroshima} occurred in August 1945.
e.zh: 广岛原子弹爆炸发生在 1945 年 8 月。

e.en: Visitors leave paper cranes at the {Hiroshima} Peace Memorial.
e.zh: 游客在广岛和平纪念馆献上纸鹤。

hirsute.t: adj. 多毛的；毛发浓密的

e.en: His {hirsute} chest was visible through the open shirt.
e.zh: 敞开的衬衫露出了他毛茸茸的胸膛。

e.en: The actor grew a {hirsute} beard for his new role.
e.zh: 这位演员为新角色蓄起了浓密的胡子。

e.en: He left {his} keys on the kitchen counter again.
e.zh: 他又把钥匙落在厨房台面上了。

e.en: The dog wagged {his} tail when the owner returned.
e.zh: 主人回来时，狗摇着尾巴。

hispanic.t:
adj. 西班牙语裔的
n. 拉美裔人

e.en: The neighborhood has a vibrant {Hispanic} cultural scene.
e.zh: 这个街区有着充满活力的西班牙语裔文化氛围。

e.en: Many {Hispanic} families gather for big Sunday dinners.
e.zh: 许多西班牙语裔家庭会聚在一起共进周日大餐。

hiss.t:
n. 嘶嘶声
v. 发出嘘声

e.en: The cat let out an angry {hiss} at the dog.
e.zh: 那只猫朝狗愤怒地嘶嘶叫了一声。

e.en: You could hear the gas {hiss} from the broken pipe.
e.zh: 你能听见破裂管道里漏气的嘶嘶声。

hisself.t: pron. 他自己（himself 的非标准用法）

e.en: He fixed the leak {hisself} without calling a plumber.
e.zh: 他自己修好了漏水，没叫水管工。

e.en: In dialect speech, some folks say {hisself} instead of himself.
e.zh: 在方言中，有些人会说 hisself 而不是 himself。

hissing.t:
n. 嘶嘶声
v. 发嘘声（现在分词）

e.en: The kettle started {hissing} loudly on the stove.
e.zh: 水壶在炉子上开始大声嘶嘶作响。

e.en: A {hissing} snake slithered across the dusty path.
e.zh: 一条嘶嘶叫的蛇从尘土飞扬的小路上爬过。

histamine.t: n. 组胺（引发过敏反应的物质）

e.en: Allergic reactions release {histamine} that causes itching and swelling.
e.zh: 过敏反应会释放组胺，引起瘙痒和肿胀。

e.en: Some cheeses are high in {histamine} and trigger headaches.
e.zh: 某些奶酪组胺含量高，会引发头痛。

e.en: A {histiocyte} is a type of immune cell found in tissues.
e.zh: 组织细胞是一种存在于组织中的免疫细胞。

e.en: The biopsy revealed clusters of abnormal {histiocyte} growth.
e.zh: 活检显示出现了异常的组织细胞聚集生长。

e.en: Langerhans cell {histiocytosis} mostly affects young children.
e.zh: 朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症主要影响幼儿。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed her son with a rare form of {histiocytosis}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她儿子患有一种罕见的组织细胞增生症。

e.en: The {histogram} shows how user ages are distributed across the app.
e.zh: 这张直方图显示了应用内用户年龄的分布情况。

e.en: Photographers check the {histogram} to avoid blown-out highlights.
e.zh: 摄影师会检查直方图，以避免高光溢出。

e.en: The {histologic} examination confirmed the tumor was benign.
e.zh: 组织学检查证实该肿瘤为良性。

e.en: Doctors await {histologic} results before planning treatment.
e.zh: 医生在制定治疗方案前会等待组织学结果。

e.en: The lab performed a {histological} analysis of the tissue sample.
e.zh: 实验室对该组织样本进行了组织学分析。

e.en: {Histological} differences between the two tumors were significant.
e.zh: 两种肿瘤在组织学上的差异非常显著。

e.en: The two diseases look {histologically} similar under the microscope.
e.zh: 这两种疾病在显微镜下从组织学上看十分相似。

e.en: The lesion was confirmed {histologically} as a benign growth.
e.zh: 该病变经组织学证实为良性增生。

e.en: She studies {histology} to understand the structure of tissues.
e.zh: 她学习组织学，以了解组织的结构。

e.en: The {histology} report came back showing no cancer cells.
e.zh: 组织学报告显示没有癌细胞。

e.en: DNA wraps around {histone} proteins to form chromatin.
e.zh: DNA 缠绕在组蛋白上形成染色质。

e.en: {Histone} modifications play a key role in gene regulation.
e.zh: 组蛋白修饰在基因调控中起着关键作用。

e.en: The {histopathologic} findings supported a diagnosis of lupus.
e.zh: 组织病理学结果支持了狼疮的诊断。

e.en: They reviewed the {histopathologic} slides during the tumor board.
e.zh: 他们在肿瘤多学科会诊上审阅了组织病理切片。

e.en: A {histopathological} review confirmed early-stage breast cancer.
e.zh: 一次组织病理学复查确认了早期乳腺癌。

e.en: The {histopathological} features were classic for hepatitis.
e.zh: 这些组织病理学特征是典型的肝炎表现。

e.en: {Histopathology} remains the gold standard for diagnosing cancer.
e.zh: 组织病理学仍是诊断癌症的金标准。

e.en: The lab specializes in skin {histopathology} and dermatology.
e.zh: 该实验室专注于皮肤组织病理学和皮肤病学。

e.en: He contracted {histoplasmosis} after exploring an old cave.
e.zh: 他探查一个旧洞穴后感染了组织胞浆菌病。

e.en: {Histoplasmosis} is common in regions with bird and bat droppings.
e.zh: 在鸟粪和蝙蝠粪便较多的地区，组织胞浆菌病较为常见。

e.en: The {historian} spent years researching the fall of Rome.
e.zh: 这位历史学家花了多年研究罗马的衰落。

e.en: As a military {historian}, he writes about World War II.
e.zh: 作为军事史学家，他主要撰写关于二战的著作。

e.en: {Historians} still debate the real cause of the war.
e.zh: 历史学家们至今仍在争论这场战争的真正起因。

e.en: Future {historians} will study how social media reshaped politics.
e.zh: 未来的历史学家会研究社交媒体如何重塑了政治。

historic.t: adj. 历史性的；有重大意义的

e.en: The signing of the treaty was a {historic} moment.
e.zh: 条约的签署是一个历史性的时刻。

e.en: They restored the {historic} building to its original glory.
e.zh: 他们将这座历史建筑恢复到了原本的辉煌。

historical.t: adj. 历史的；有关历史的

e.en: She loves reading {historical} novels set in Tudor England.
e.zh: 她喜欢读以都铎王朝英格兰为背景的历史小说。

e.en: The museum displays {historical} documents from the revolution.
e.zh: 博物馆陈列着革命时期的历史文献。

e.en: {Historically}, women were excluded from voting in most countries.
e.zh: 从历史上看，女性在大多数国家曾被排斥在投票权之外。

e.en: Tech stocks have {historically} outperformed the broader market.
e.zh: 科技股从历史上看一直跑赢大盘。

e.en: {Historicism} argues that ideas must be understood in their context.
e.zh: 历史主义主张思想必须放在其语境中去理解。

e.en: Critics accused his theory of relying on naive {historicism}.
e.zh: 批评者指责他的理论依赖于幼稚的历史主义。

historicist.t:
n. 历史主义者
adj. 历史主义的

e.en: She offered a {historicist} reading of the Victorian novel.
e.zh: 她对那部维多利亚时代小说做了历史主义的解读。

e.en: The professor takes a strongly {historicist} approach to philosophy.
e.zh: 这位教授对哲学采取了非常历史主义的方法。

historicity.t: n. 史实性；历史真实性
