e.en: Scholars still debate the {historicity} of King Arthur.
e.zh: 学者们仍在争论亚瑟王的历史真实性。

e.en: The film's {historicity} was praised by professional historians.
e.zh: 这部电影的历史真实性受到了专业历史学家的好评。

e.en: The book's {historicization} of gender roles was groundbreaking.
e.zh: 这本书对性别角色的历史化分析具有开创性。

e.en: Proper {historicization} prevents us from judging the past anachronistically.
e.zh: 恰当的历史化能让我们避免用今天的眼光评判过去。

e.en: The novel {historicized} the 1960s civil rights movement vividly.
e.zh: 这部小说生动地再现了上世纪六十年代的民权运动。

e.en: Critics {historicized} the painting within its colonial context.
e.zh: 评论家将这幅画置于殖民历史背景中加以解读。

histories.t: n. 历史；经历（history 的复数）

e.en: Patients should share their medical {histories} with the doctor.
e.zh: 病人应当向医生告知自己的病史。

e.en: The library has {histories} of every European country.
e.zh: 图书馆收藏有每个欧洲国家的历史书。

e.en: The royal {historiographer} documented every battle of the war.
e.zh: 宫廷史官记录了这场战争的每一场战役。

e.en: She became a respected {historiographer} of women's labor movements.
e.zh: 她成为研究妇女劳工运动的知名史学家。

e.en: His thesis offers a fresh {historiographic} perspective on the Cold War.
e.zh: 他的论文为冷战研究提供了新的史学视角。

e.en: The course explores {historiographic} debates about colonial archives.
e.zh: 这门课探讨关于殖民档案的史学争论。

e.en: The book triggered a major {historiographical} shift in medieval studies.
e.zh: 这本书在中世纪研究中引发了重大史学转向。

e.en: Her essay examines {historiographical} biases in early American textbooks.
e.zh: 她的文章分析早期美国教科书中的史学偏见。

historiography.t: n. 史学编纂；历史编纂学

e.en: Modern {historiography} relies heavily on digital archives and databases.
e.zh: 现代史学研究在很大程度上依赖数字档案和数据库。

e.en: She teaches a graduate seminar on Chinese {historiography}.
e.zh: 她教授一门关于中国史学的研究生课程。

e.en: My browser {history} shows everything I searched today.
e.zh: 我的浏览器历史记录显示了我今天搜过的所有内容。

e.en: He majored in ancient {history} at university.
e.zh: 他在大学主修古代史。

histrionic.t: adj. 戏剧化的；装腔作势的

e.en: Her {histrionic} reaction to the spilled coffee embarrassed everyone.
e.zh: 她对洒掉的咖啡反应过于戏剧化,让大家都很尴尬。

e.en: The politician's {histrionic} speech failed to convince voters.
e.zh: 那位政客夸张做作的演讲并未说服选民。

histrionically.t: adv. 戏剧化地；装模作样地

e.en: He {histrionically} clutched his chest after losing the game.
e.zh: 输了比赛后他夸张地捂住胸口装作心痛。

e.en: She gasped {histrionically} when she heard the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息时她戏剧化地倒吸了一口气。

histrionics.t: n. 夸张表现；装腔作势

e.en: Spare me the {histrionics} and just tell me what happened.
e.zh: 别再演戏了,直接告诉我发生了什么。

e.en: The boss has no patience for office {histrionics}.
e.zh: 老板对办公室里的小题大做毫无耐心。

hit.t:
v. 打；点击
n. 命中；热门

e.en: The new song became an instant {hit} on TikTok.
e.zh: 这首新歌在抖音上瞬间爆红。

e.en: A car {hit} the lamppost near the corner store.
e.zh: 一辆车撞上了便利店附近的路灯柱。

hitachi.t: n. 日立（日本公司/城市）

e.en: My old {Hitachi} drill still works after fifteen years.
e.zh: 我那台老日立电钻用了十五年还能用。

e.en: {Hitachi} announced a new line of energy-efficient elevators.
e.zh: 日立公司发布了一系列节能电梯新产品。

hitch.t:
n. 小问题；障碍
v. 拴住；搭便车

e.en: The wedding went off without a single {hitch}.
e.zh: 婚礼办得非常顺利,没出一点差错。

e.en: He tried to {hitch} a ride to the airport.
e.zh: 他想搭便车去机场。

hitchcock.t: n. 希区柯克（导演姓氏）

e.en: Alfred {Hitchcock} directed some of cinema's greatest thrillers.
e.zh: 阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克执导了影史上最伟大的几部惊悚片。

e.en: Film students still study {Hitchcock} for his masterful suspense.
e.zh: 电影学生至今仍在研究希区柯克高超的悬念手法。

hitchcockian.t: adj. 希区柯克式的（悬疑惊悚风格）

e.en: The thriller has a distinctly {Hitchcockian} sense of dread.
e.zh: 这部惊悚片带有明显的希区柯克式恐惧感。

e.en: Critics praised the film's {Hitchcockian} pacing and plot twists.
e.zh: 影评人称赞这部电影具有希区柯克式的节奏与反转。

hitched.t:
v. 拴住；搭便车（hitch 的过去式）
adj. 已婚的（口语）

e.en: They {hitched} the trailer to the back of the truck.
e.zh: 他们把拖车挂在了卡车后面。

e.en: My cousin and her boyfriend finally got {hitched} last weekend.
e.zh: 我表妹和她男朋友上周末终于结婚了。

e.en: The village of {Hitchen} sits quietly in the English countryside.
e.zh: 希钦村安静地坐落在英国乡村。

e.en: Mr. {Hitchen} has taught at the school for thirty years.
e.zh: 希钦先生在这所学校已经任教三十年。

hitches.t:
n. 故障；小问题
v. 拴住；搭便车

e.en: The launch went smoothly with no major {hitches}.
e.zh: 发布过程很顺利,没有出现什么大问题。

e.en: He {hitches} his backpack higher and starts walking.
e.zh: 他把背包往上提了提,然后开始走路。

e.en: It's risky to {hitchhike} alone on rural highways at night.
e.zh: 晚上独自在乡间公路上搭便车是很危险的。

e.en: They decided to {hitchhike} across New Zealand last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天他们决定一路搭便车穿越新西兰。

e.en: A friendly {hitchhiker} waved at us from the roadside.
e.zh: 一个友好的搭便车者在路边向我们挥手。

e.en: He read "The {Hitchhiker}'s Guide to the Galaxy" three times.
e.zh: 《银河系搭车客指南》他读了三遍。

e.en: {Hitchhiking} across Europe was popular in the 1970s.
e.zh: 上世纪七十年代,搭便车穿越欧洲非常流行。

e.en: She spent her gap year {hitchhiking} through South America.
e.zh: 她在间隔年里一路搭便车走遍了南美洲。

e.en: The train to {Hitchin} leaves from platform four.
e.zh: 开往希钦的列车在四号站台发车。

e.en: {Hitchin} is a market town in Hertfordshire, England.
e.zh: 希钦是英格兰赫特福德郡的一座集镇。

hitching.t: v. 拴住；搭便车（ing 形式）

e.en: He spent the summer {hitching} rides across the country.
e.zh: 那个夏天他一路搭便车横穿全国。

e.en: She is {hitching} the boat to the dock with rope.
e.zh: 她正用绳子把船拴到码头上。

hither.t: adv. 到这里；向此处（文言）

e.en: Come {hither} and see what I've discovered in the attic.
e.zh: 过来看看我在阁楼里发现了什么。

e.en: Tourists wander {hither} and thither across the old square.
e.zh: 游客们在古老的广场上四处游荡。

hitherto.t: adv. 迄今为止；到目前为止

e.en: The study reveals details {hitherto} unknown to historians.
e.zh: 这项研究揭示了历史学家迄今未知的细节。

e.en: {Hitherto}, the company had focused only on domestic markets.
e.zh: 在此之前,公司一直只专注于国内市场。

e.en: {Hitler} rose to power in Germany during the early 1930s.
e.zh: 希特勒于上世纪三十年代初在德国掌权。

e.en: Many books examine the psychology behind {Hitler}'s decisions.
e.zh: 许多书籍探讨希特勒决策背后的心理动机。

hitlerian.t: adj. 希特勒式的；纳粹的

e.en: Critics described his rhetoric as disturbingly {Hitlerian}.
e.zh: 评论家形容他的言论带有令人不安的希特勒式色彩。

e.en: The dictator built a {Hitlerian} cult around his image.
e.zh: 那位独裁者围绕自己的形象建立了希特勒式的个人崇拜。

hitless.t: adj. 无安打的（棒球）；未命中的

e.en: The pitcher kept the opposing team {hitless} for six innings.
e.zh: 这位投手让对方球队连续六局没能击出安打。

e.en: She went {hitless} in three at-bats last night.
e.zh: 她昨晚三次打击都没有击出安打。

e.en: The thriller follows a retired {hitman} hunting his former boss.
e.zh: 这部惊悚片讲述一名退休杀手追杀前老板的故事。

e.en: Police arrested a {hitman} hired through the dark web.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了一名通过暗网雇佣的职业杀手。

hits.t:
n. 点击量；热门作品
v. 击中（hit 的三单）

e.en: The video already has ten million {hits} on YouTube.
e.zh: 这段视频在 YouTube 上的点击量已经突破一千万。

e.en: The boxer {hits} the bag with steady, powerful punches.
e.zh: 那位拳击手以稳健有力的拳头击打沙袋。

e.en: He's the best {hitter} on the entire baseball team.
e.zh: 他是整支棒球队里最厉害的击球手。

e.en: The startup hired a heavy {hitter} from Google as CEO.
e.zh: 这家初创公司从谷歌挖来了一位重量级人物担任 CEO。

hitting.t: v. 击打；命中（ing 形式）

e.en: Inflation is {hitting} young families especially hard this year.
e.zh: 今年通货膨胀对年轻家庭的打击尤其严重。

e.en: The kids are {hitting} the pool right after school.
e.zh: 孩子们一放学就直奔泳池。

hittite.t:
n. 赫梯人；赫梯语
adj. 赫梯的

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered a {Hittite} temple in central Turkey.
e.zh: 考古学家在土耳其中部发掘出一座赫梯神庙。

e.en: The {Hittite} empire once rivaled ancient Egypt in power.
e.zh: 赫梯帝国曾在国力上与古埃及分庭抗礼。

hiv.t: n. 人类免疫缺陷病毒（艾滋病毒）

e.en: Modern medication allows people with {HIV} to live full lives.
e.zh: 现代药物让 HIV 感染者也能过上充实的生活。

e.en: The clinic offers free, anonymous {HIV} testing every Friday.
e.zh: 该诊所每周五提供免费匿名的 HIV 检测。

hive.t:
n. 蜂巢；繁忙场所
v. 聚集

e.en: Bees were swarming around the wooden {hive} in the garden.
e.zh: 蜜蜂在花园里那个木制蜂箱周围嗡嗡飞舞。

e.en: The newsroom was a {hive} of activity before the deadline.
e.zh: 截稿前,新闻编辑室忙得像一窝蜂。

e.en: Researchers compared different {HIVs} circulating across world regions.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了在世界各地区流行的不同 HIV 毒株。

e.en: The lab studies how various {HIVs} mutate over time.
e.zh: 该实验室研究各类 HIV 病毒随时间发生的变异。

e.en: "{Hiya}!" she said brightly as she walked through the door.
e.zh: 她推门进来,开朗地说了声“嗨呀!”

e.en: He gave a casual {hiya} to his neighbor on the stairs.
e.zh: 他在楼梯上随意地跟邻居打了声招呼。

e.en: Doctors check {HLA} compatibility before any bone marrow transplant.
e.zh: 医生在进行骨髓移植前都会检测 HLA 配型。

e.en: Certain {HLA} genes are linked to autoimmune diseases.
e.zh: 某些 HLA 基因与自身免疫疾病有关。

e.en: The auditors flagged the {HLCA} report for further review.
e.zh: 审计员标记了那份 HLCA 报告以便进一步审查。

e.en: Our team submitted the {HLCA} forms before the deadline.
e.zh: 我们团队在截止日期前提交了 HLCA 表格。

hmc.t: abbr. 常见机构/组织缩写

e.en: The school is a member of the prestigious {HMC} association.
e.zh: 这所学校是知名的 HMC(校长会议)成员之一。

e.en: He attended the annual {HMC} conference for headteachers.
e.zh: 他参加了一年一度面向校长的 HMC 会议。

hmg.t: abbr. 英国女王/国王陛下政府

e.en: The contract is funded directly by {HMG} through the Treasury.
e.zh: 该合同由英国政府通过财政部直接拨款。

e.en: Officials cited new {HMG} guidance on cybersecurity standards.
e.zh: 官员们引用了英国政府关于网络安全标准的新指引。

e.en: The factory upgraded its {HMI} screens for easier operator control.
e.zh: 工厂升级了人机界面屏幕,方便操作员控制。

e.en: A clear {HMI} design reduces costly mistakes on the assembly line.
e.zh: 清晰的人机界面设计能减少装配线上的代价高昂的错误。

e.en: "{Hmm}, that's an interesting question," the professor said slowly.
e.zh: “嗯,这个问题挺有意思。”教授慢慢说道。

e.en: {Hmm}, I'm not sure that recipe will work without butter.
e.zh: 嗯……我不确定这个食谱不放黄油还行不行。

hmmm.t: int. 嗯（表示沉思，比 hmm 更长）

e.en: "{Hmmm}, let me think about that for a minute," he replied.
e.zh: “唔……让我想一会儿。”他回答道。

e.en: {Hmmm}, the code looks correct but still throws an error.
e.zh: 嗯……这段代码看起来没错,却还是报错了。

hmo.t: abbr. 健康维护组织（美国医保机构）

e.en: My {HMO} requires a referral before seeing any specialist.
e.zh: 我的 HMO 保险计划要求在看专科医生前先取得转诊单。

e.en: Switching to an {HMO} lowered her monthly premiums significantly.
e.zh: 换成 HMO 计划后,她每月的保费大幅降低。

hms.t: abbr. 英国皇家海军舰艇前缀

e.en: {HMS} Victory is permanently docked in Portsmouth Harbour.
e.zh: 皇家海军“胜利号”长期停泊在朴次茅斯港。

e.en: The documentary tells the story of {HMS} Belfast in WWII.
e.zh: 这部纪录片讲述了二战时期“贝尔法斯特号”的故事。

e.en: All official statutes were once printed by {HMSO} in London.
e.zh: 所有官方法规过去都由伦敦的英国皇家文书局印制。

e.en: The archive contains rare {HMSO} publications from the 1950s.
e.zh: 该档案馆收藏有上世纪五十年代英国皇家文书局的珍贵出版物。

hmv.t: n. 英国唱片连锁品牌

e.en: He bought the vinyl record at a downtown {HMV} store.
e.zh: 他在市中心的 HMV 唱片店买下了那张黑胶唱片。

e.en: {HMV} was once a familiar sight on every British high street.
e.zh: HMV 唱片店曾是英国每条主街上的常见招牌。

hnc.t: abbr. 高等国家证书（英国学历）

e.en: He earned an {HNC} in mechanical engineering before joining the firm.
e.zh: 加入公司前,他取得了机械工程的 HNC 证书。

e.en: The college offers an {HNC} qualification in business administration.
e.zh: 这所学院提供工商管理 HNC 课程。

hnd.t: abbr. 高等国家文凭（英国学历）

e.en: She completed her {HND} in graphic design last June.
e.zh: 她在去年六月完成了平面设计 HND 文凭课程。

e.en: An {HND} can lead directly into the second year of university.
e.zh: HND 文凭可以直接衔接大学二年级课程。

hoagie.t: n. 潜艇三明治（美式长面包）

e.en: I ordered a turkey {hoagie} with extra cheese for lunch.
e.zh: 我午餐点了一个加芝士的火鸡潜艇堡。

e.en: This deli makes the best Italian {hoagie} in town.
e.zh: 这家熟食店做的意式潜艇堡是城里最棒的。

hoar.t:
n. 白霜
adj. 灰白的（文言）

e.en: A thin layer of {hoar} covered the morning grass.
e.zh: 清晨的草地上覆盖着一层薄薄的白霜。

e.en: The old man's {hoar} beard reached down to his chest.
e.zh: 老人花白的胡子一直垂到胸前。

hoard.t:
v. 囤积；贮藏
n. 贮藏物

e.en: People started to {hoard} toilet paper during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间人们开始囤积卫生纸。

e.en: Archaeologists found a {hoard} of Roman coins in the field.
e.zh: 考古学家在田里发现了一批罗马钱币。

hoarder.t: n. 囤积者；囤积癖患者

e.en: My uncle is a serious {hoarder} who never throws anything away.
e.zh: 我叔叔是个严重的囤积者,什么都不肯扔。

e.en: The show featured a {hoarder} whose house was filled with junk.
e.zh: 节目里有个囤积癖,他家堆满了废物。

hoarding.t: n. 囤积行为；（英）大型广告牌

e.en: Panic buying led to widespread {hoarding} of bottled water.
e.zh: 恐慌性购买导致瓶装水被大量囤积。

e.en: A giant {hoarding} advertised the new film on the highway.
e.zh: 高速公路上一块巨大的广告牌宣传着这部新片。

e.en: The trees were coated in glittering {hoarfrost} at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时树木被一层闪亮的白霜覆盖。

e.en: Heavy {hoarfrost} made the bridge dangerously slippery.
e.zh: 厚厚的白霜让桥面变得非常滑。

e.en: My voice grew {hoarse} after singing all night at the concert.
e.zh: 演唱会上唱了一晚,我的嗓子都哑了。

e.en: He gave a {hoarse} cough and reached for some water.
e.zh: 他沙哑地咳了一声,伸手去拿水。

e.en: She whispered {hoarsely} into the phone, barely audible.
e.zh: 她沙哑地对着电话低语,几乎听不清。

e.en: The coach shouted {hoarsely} from the sidelines.
e.zh: 教练在场边声音沙哑地喊着。

e.en: The {hoarseness} in his voice lasted for over a week.
e.zh: 他嗓子的沙哑持续了一个多星期。

e.en: Persistent {hoarseness} can be a sign of vocal cord strain.
e.zh: 持续性声音嘶哑可能是声带劳损的信号。

hoary.t:
adj. 灰白的、白发苍苍的
adj. 老掉牙的

e.en: He told the same {hoary} joke at every family gathering.
e.zh: 他在每次家庭聚会上都讲那个老掉牙的笑话。

e.en: A {hoary} old wizard appeared in the storybook illustration.
e.zh: 故事书的插图里出现了一位白发苍苍的老巫师。

hoax.t:
n. 骗局、恶作剧
v. 戏弄、欺骗

e.en: The viral video turned out to be an elaborate {hoax}.
e.zh: 那段疯传的视频原来是一场精心设计的骗局。

e.en: Police warned the public about the bomb threat {hoax}.
e.zh: 警方警告公众那是一场炸弹威胁恶作剧。

e.en: The {hoaxer} was finally caught after months of fake calls.
e.zh: 那个恶作剧者在数月的假来电后终于被抓获。

e.en: Online {hoaxer} accounts spread misinformation across platforms.
e.zh: 网络上的恶作剧账号在各个平台散布虚假信息。

e.en: Place the pan on the {hob} and turn up the heat.
e.zh: 把锅放在炉灶上,调大火。

e.en: My new induction {hob} heats up much faster than gas.
e.zh: 我的新电磁炉比燃气灶加热快多了。

hobart.t: n. 霍巴特（澳大利亚城市）

e.en: We flew to {Hobart} to start our Tasmanian road trip.
e.zh: 我们飞到霍巴特,开启塔斯马尼亚的自驾之旅。

e.en: {Hobart} is the southernmost capital city in Australia.
e.zh: 霍巴特是澳大利亚最南端的首府城市。

hobbes.t: n. 霍布斯（英国哲学家）

e.en: {Hobbes} argued that life without government would be brutal.
e.zh: 霍布斯认为没有政府的生活会是残酷的。

e.en: Many philosophy students read {Hobbes} before tackling Locke.
e.zh: 许多哲学学生在读洛克之前先读霍布斯。

hobbesian.t: adj. 霍布斯式的、霍布斯主义的

e.en: The novel paints a {Hobbesian} world where everyone fights to survive.
e.zh: 这部小说描绘了一个人人为生存而斗争的霍布斯式世界。

e.en: Critics called the policy a {Hobbesian} approach to security.
e.zh: 批评者称这项政策是霍布斯式的安全策略。

hobbies.t: n. 业余爱好（hobby 的复数）

e.en: My {hobbies} include painting, hiking, and playing the guitar.
e.zh: 我的爱好包括绘画、徒步和弹吉他。

e.en: List two {hobbies} on your resume to show personality.
e.zh: 在简历上写两个爱好可以展现个性。

hobbit.t: n. 霍比特人（《魔戒》中的种族）

e.en: Frodo is a brave {hobbit} who carries the One Ring.
e.zh: 佛罗多是一个勇敢的霍比特人,带着至尊魔戒。

e.en: The cozy cottage looked like a {hobbit} hole from Tolkien.
e.zh: 那间舒适的小屋看起来就像托尔金笔下的霍比特洞屋。

hobble.t:
v. 跛行、蹒跚而行
v. 阻碍、束缚

e.en: He had to {hobble} to the bench after spraining his ankle.
e.zh: 他扭伤脚踝后只能一瘸一拐地走到长椅旁。

e.en: Sanctions could {hobble} the country's struggling economy.
e.zh: 制裁可能会拖垮该国本已挣扎的经济。

hobbled.t:
v. 跛行（hobble 的过去式）
adj. 受束缚的

e.en: The injured runner {hobbled} across the finish line.
e.zh: 受伤的选手一瘸一拐地越过了终点线。

e.en: Supply chain issues {hobbled} production for several months.
e.zh: 供应链问题使生产受阻了好几个月。

e.en: Photography started as a {hobby} but became my career.
e.zh: 摄影最初是个爱好,后来变成了我的职业。

e.en: Gardening is a relaxing {hobby} for many retirees.
e.zh: 园艺对许多退休人士来说是个轻松的爱好。

e.en: He's a serious drone {hobbyist} with five different models.
e.zh: 他是个认真的无人机爱好者,有五种不同型号。

e.en: This software is designed for the casual {hobbyist}, not pros.
e.zh: 这款软件是为业余爱好者而设计的,不是专业人士。

hobgoblin.t:
n. 小妖精、淘气精灵
n. 烦扰之事

e.en: Foolish consistency is the {hobgoblin} of little minds.
e.zh: 愚蠢的一致性是小心眼的人作茧自缚的妖怪。

e.en: The children read about a mischievous {hobgoblin} in the forest.
e.zh: 孩子们读到了关于森林里一个调皮小妖精的故事。

e.en: {Hobhouse} wrote influential works on liberal political theory.
e.zh: 霍布豪斯撰写了多部有影响力的自由主义政治理论著作。

e.en: Emily {Hobhouse} exposed the harsh conditions in British camps.
e.zh: 艾米莉·霍布豪斯揭露了英军集中营的恶劣条件。

hobnob.t: v. 亲密交往、打成一片

e.en: She loves to {hobnob} with celebrities at film festivals.
e.zh: 她喜欢在电影节上和明星们打成一片。

e.en: Politicians {hobnob} with donors at fancy fundraising dinners.
e.zh: 政客们在豪华筹款晚宴上与金主们攀交情。

e.en: An old {hobo} sat by the railroad tracks warming his hands.
e.zh: 一个老流浪汉坐在铁轨边暖着双手。

e.en: The film tells the story of a {hobo} riding freight trains.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个搭乘货运火车的流浪汉的故事。

hoc.t: adj. 特设的（拉丁语，多见于 ad hoc）

e.en: The committee was set up on an ad {hoc} basis to handle the crisis.
e.zh: 委员会是为应对这场危机临时组建的。

e.en: They formed an ad {hoc} group to review the new proposal.
e.zh: 他们组成了一个临时小组来审查这项新提案。

e.en: The crowd shouted "{Hoch}!" to toast the bride and groom.
e.zh: 人群高呼"万岁!"为新郎新娘干杯。

e.en: Germans sometimes raise a glass and cry "{Hoch}!" in celebration.
e.zh: 德国人有时会举杯高呼"万岁!"以示庆祝。

hock.t:
v. 典当、抵押
n. 兽腿关节

e.en: He had to {hock} his guitar to pay the rent.
e.zh: 他不得不把吉他典当了来交房租。

e.en: The braised pork {hock} was tender and full of flavor.
e.zh: 红烧猪肘炖得酥烂入味。

e.en: My son plays ice {hockey} every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 我儿子每周六早上都打冰球。

e.en: Field {hockey} is hugely popular in India and the Netherlands.
e.zh: 曲棍球在印度和荷兰非常受欢迎。

hockeys.t: n. 曲棍球（hockey 的复数）

e.en: The store sells field {hockeys} sticks at a discount this week.
e.zh: 这家店本周打折出售曲棍球棒。

e.en: Different {hockeys} leagues have slightly different rules.
e.zh: 不同的曲棍球联盟规则略有不同。

hod.t: n. 灰浆斗、砖斗（建筑工具）

e.en: The bricklayer carried mortar in a wooden {hod} up the ladder.
e.zh: 砌砖工用木制灰浆斗扛着砂浆爬上梯子。

e.en: Workers filled the {hod} with bricks for the next floor.
e.zh: 工人们把砖装进灰浆斗,送到上一层楼。

e.en: The exhibition was a {hodgepodge} of styles from different eras.
e.zh: 这次展览是不同时代风格的大杂烩。

e.en: Her playlist is a {hodgepodge} of jazz, rock, and pop.
e.zh: 她的播放列表是爵士、摇滚和流行的大杂烩。

hoe.t:
n. 锄头
v. 用锄头锄地

e.en: She used a {hoe} to break up the soil in the garden.
e.zh: 她用锄头把花园里的土翻松。

e.en: Farmers still {hoe} small plots by hand in many villages.
e.zh: 许多村庄的农民仍然用手锄耕种小块土地。

hoechst.t: n. 赫希斯特（德国化工公司）

e.en: Researchers stained the cells with {Hoechst} dye to view nuclei.
e.zh: 研究人员用Hoechst染料染色以观察细胞核。

e.en: {Hoechst} was once one of Germany's largest chemical companies.
e.zh: 赫斯特公司曾是德国最大的化工公司之一。

hoedown.t: n. 美式乡村舞会、方块舞

e.en: The town held a country {hoedown} with fiddles and square dancing.
e.zh: 小镇举办了一场有提琴和方块舞的乡村舞会。

e.en: We kicked off our boots and joined the Saturday night {hoedown}.
e.zh: 我们脱掉靴子,加入了周六晚上的乡村方块舞会。

e.en: Wim {Hof} is famous for his extreme cold-exposure techniques.
e.zh: 维姆·霍夫以其极端的冷暴露训练法而闻名。

e.en: The Baseball Hall of Fame, or {HOF}, inducted three players this year.
e.zh: 棒球名人堂今年迎来了三位入选球员。

hog.t:
n. 猪、肥猪
v. 独占、霸占

e.en: Don't {hog} the bathroom when others need to use it.
e.zh: 别人要用洗手间时别独占着不出来。

e.en: The farmer raised a huge {hog} for the county fair.
e.zh: 农夫养了一头大肥猪要参加县集市。

hogan.t:
n. 霍根（姓氏）
n. 纳瓦霍人圆木屋

e.en: The Navajo family lived in a traditional {hogan} for generations.
e.zh: 这户纳瓦霍家庭世代住在传统的霍根屋里。

e.en: Tourists can visit a restored {hogan} on the reservation.
e.zh: 游客可以在保留地参观一座修复过的霍根屋。

e.en: We hiked along a narrow {hogback} ridge with steep drops on both sides.
e.zh: 我们沿着一条两侧陡峭的窄长山脊徒步。

e.en: The {hogback} formation rises sharply from the desert floor.
e.zh: 这道猪背山脊从沙漠地面陡然隆起。

e.en: Edinburgh's {Hogmanay} celebrations attract tourists from around the world.
e.zh: 爱丁堡的跨年庆典吸引着来自世界各地的游客。

e.en: Scots traditionally clean the house before {Hogmanay} arrives.
e.zh: 苏格兰人传统上会在跨年夜来临前打扫房屋。

e.en: The whisky aged for twelve years in an oak {hogshead}.
e.zh: 这款威士忌在橡木大酒桶中陈酿了十二年。

e.en: Workers rolled a heavy {hogshead} of tobacco into the warehouse.
e.zh: 工人们把一只沉重的烟草大桶滚进仓库。

hogwash.t:
n. 胡说八道
n. 猪食

e.en: His excuse was complete {hogwash} and nobody believed it.
e.zh: 他的借口完全是胡说八道,没人相信。

e.en: Don't fall for that marketing {hogwash} about miracle cures.
e.zh: 别相信那些神奇疗效的营销鬼话。

e.en: The {Hohenzollern} dynasty ruled Prussia for several centuries.
e.zh: 霍亨索伦王朝统治普鲁士长达数个世纪。

e.en: {Hohenzollern} Castle perches dramatically on a wooded hilltop.
e.zh: 霍亨索伦城堡矗立在林木茂盛的山顶上,蔚为壮观。

hoi.t: n. hoi polloi 平民百姓

e.en: The exclusive club kept the {hoi} polloi away from its events.
e.zh: 这家高级俱乐部把普通大众挡在活动之外。

e.en: He sneered at the {hoi} polloi crowding the public beach.
e.zh: 他对挤满公共海滩的平民百姓嗤之以鼻。

hoist.t:
v. 升起、吊起
n. 起重机

e.en: The crew used a crane to {hoist} the container onto the ship.
e.zh: 船员用起重机把集装箱吊上船。

e.en: They {hoist} the flag every morning at sunrise.
e.zh: 他们每天日出时升起国旗。

hoisted.t: v. 升起（hoist 的过去式）

e.en: The team {hoisted} the trophy after winning the championship.
e.zh: 球队赢得冠军后高高举起奖杯。

e.en: Workers {hoisted} the heavy beam into place using pulleys.
e.zh: 工人们用滑轮把沉重的横梁吊到位。

hoisting.t: v. 吊装（hoist 的现在分词）

e.en: They spent the morning {hoisting} sails before the race began.
e.zh: 比赛开始前他们花了一上午升起船帆。

e.en: The crane is {hoisting} steel beams to the top of the building.
e.zh: 起重机正把钢梁吊到大楼顶部。

e.en: The factory uses electric {hoists} to move heavy machinery.
e.zh: 工厂用电动葫芦移动重型机械。

e.en: Every morning the captain {hoists} the national flag on deck.
e.zh: 每天早上船长都会在甲板上升起国旗。

e.en: The movie's ending felt a bit {hokey} and overly sentimental.
e.zh: 这部电影的结尾感觉有点俗套又过于煽情。

e.en: His {hokey} jokes made the whole audience groan.
e.zh: 他那些老套的笑话让全场观众直翻白眼。

e.en: We skied in {Hokkaido} during the New Year holidays.
e.zh: 我们新年假期在北海道滑雪。

e.en: {Hokkaido} is famous for its fresh seafood and dairy.
e.zh: 北海道以新鲜海鲜和乳制品闻名。

e.en: Critics dismissed the movie as sentimental {hokum}.
e.zh: 影评人把这部电影贬为煽情的废话。

e.en: Don't believe that {hokum} about miracle diets.
e.zh: 别信那些关于神奇减肥法的胡扯。

e.en: She booked a two-week summer {hol} in Greece.
e.zh: 她订了在希腊度过的两周夏季假期。

e.en: The kids are off school on their half-term {hol}.
e.zh: 孩子们正在放期中假。

e.en: The gallery displays a famous portrait by {Holbein}.
e.zh: 这家画廊展出了荷尔拜因的一幅著名肖像画。

e.en: {Holbein} painted many members of the Tudor court.
e.zh: 荷尔拜因为都铎王朝的众多成员画过像。

e.en: Her office is near {Holborn} station in central London.
e.zh: 她的办公室在伦敦市中心霍尔本站附近。

e.en: We grabbed lunch at a café in {Holborn}.
e.zh: 我们在霍尔本的一家咖啡馆吃了午饭。

hold.t:
v. 拿着、持有
n. 掌控、货舱

e.en: Please {hold} the door open for the next person.
e.zh: 请帮后面的人把门撑开。

e.en: The new password rules {hold} for everyone in the company.
e.zh: 新密码规则对公司所有人都适用。

e.en: He stuffed his gym clothes into a canvas {holdall}.
e.zh: 他把健身衣物塞进一个帆布旅行袋。

e.en: She unzipped the {holdall} and pulled out her laptop.
e.zh: 她拉开旅行袋的拉链,取出笔记本电脑。

e.en: The contract included a ten percent {holdback} until project completion.
e.zh: 合同规定项目完工前预留百分之十的尾款。

e.en: Investors complained about the long {holdback} on their returns.
e.zh: 投资者抱怨回报被长期扣留。

holder.t:
n. 持有人
n. 支架、容器

e.en: The cup {holder} in this car fits a tall bottle.
e.zh: 这辆车的杯架可以放下一个高瓶子。

e.en: Every account {holder} must verify their email address.
e.zh: 每位账户持有人都必须验证电子邮箱。

holders.t: n. 持有人们（holder 复数）

e.en: All passport {holders} should join the priority lane.
e.zh: 所有护照持有人请走优先通道。

e.en: The shop sells phone {holders} for bicycles.
e.zh: 这家店出售自行车手机支架。

holding.t:
n. 持股、所有物
v. 握住（hold 现在分词）

e.en: She is {holding} a baby in the photo.
e.zh: 照片里她抱着一个婴儿。

e.en: The fund increased its {holding} in tech stocks.
e.zh: 该基金增加了对科技股的持仓。

e.en: Only one juror was a {holdout} against conviction.
e.zh: 只有一名陪审员坚持不同意定罪。

e.en: That tiny shop is the last {holdout} on the street.
e.zh: 那家小店是这条街上最后的坚守者。

e.en: This rule is a {holdover} from the previous administration.
e.zh: 这条规定是上届政府留下的遗产。

e.en: The coach was a {holdover} from the championship team.
e.zh: 这位教练是从冠军队留任下来的。

e.en: This jar {holds} about two liters of water.
e.zh: 这个罐子能装大约两升水。

e.en: She {holds} a master's degree in economics.
e.zh: 她拥有经济学硕士学位。

holdup.t:
n. 持械抢劫
n. 延误

e.en: Sorry for the {holdup}—traffic was terrible this morning.
e.zh: 抱歉耽搁了,今早交通很糟糕。

e.en: Police arrested two men after the bank {holdup}.
e.zh: 警方在银行抢劫案后逮捕了两名男子。

hole.t:
n. 洞、孔
n. 漏洞、缺陷

e.en: There's a {hole} in my left sock again.
e.zh: 我左脚的袜子又破了个洞。

e.en: He sank the ball into the {hole} on his first putt.
e.zh: 他一推就把球打进了洞。

e.en: The lawyer found several {holes} in the witness's story.
e.zh: 律师在证人的陈述中发现了几处漏洞。

e.en: Moths had eaten tiny {holes} in the wool sweater.
e.zh: 蛀虫在毛衣上咬出了许多小洞。

e.en: He still wears that {holey} old T-shirt to bed.
e.zh: 他仍然穿着那件破了好多洞的旧T恤睡觉。

e.en: Her favorite jeans are now embarrassingly {holey}.
e.zh: 她最喜欢的牛仔裤现在破洞多得让人尴尬。

holiday.t:
n. 假期、节日
v. 度假

e.en: We're going to Bali on {holiday} next month.
e.zh: 我们下个月要去巴厘岛度假。

e.en: Monday is a public {holiday}, so the office is closed.
e.zh: 周一是公共假日,办公室不上班。

e.en: Every {holidaymaker} on the beach was wearing sunglasses.
e.zh: 沙滩上的每一位度假者都戴着墨镜。

e.en: The town welcomes thousands of {holidaymaker} arrivals each summer.
e.zh: 这个小镇每年夏天迎接成千上万的度假者。

e.en: The kids are excited for the summer {holidays}.
e.zh: 孩子们对暑假感到非常兴奋。

e.en: Most shops close early during the winter {holidays}.
e.zh: 大多数商店在冬季假期会提前关门。

e.en: Pilgrims visit the temple to feel its {holiness}.
e.zh: 朝圣者前往寺庙感受它的神圣。

e.en: His {Holiness} the Pope addressed the crowd in St Peter's Square.
e.zh: 教宗在圣彼得广场对人群发表讲话。

e.en: Her therapy approach is rooted in {holism} and mindfulness.
e.zh: 她的治疗方法植根于整体论和正念。

e.en: The book argues for {holism} over reductionist thinking.
e.zh: 这本书主张整体论而非还原论思维。

e.en: As a {holist}, she treats body and mind together.
e.zh: 作为整体论者,她把身心一起治疗。

e.en: The doctor is a confirmed {holist} in his practice.
e.zh: 这位医生在行医中是坚定的整体论者。

e.en: The clinic offers a {holistic} approach to wellness.
e.zh: 这家诊所提供整体性的健康调理方法。

e.en: We need a {holistic} view of the company's strategy.
e.zh: 我们需要从全局角度看公司的战略。

e.en: Doctors should treat patients {holistically}, not just their symptoms.
e.zh: 医生应整体地治疗患者,而不只是处理症状。

e.en: The team approaches problems {holistically} across departments.
e.zh: 团队跨部门以整体思维来处理问题。

e.en: Tulips from {Holland} are exported all over the world.
e.zh: 来自荷兰的郁金香销往世界各地。

e.en: We cycled through small villages in {Holland} last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天我们骑车穿过荷兰的小村庄。

e.en: Eggs Benedict is served with rich {hollandaise} sauce.
e.zh: 班尼迪克蛋配着浓郁的荷兰酱一起上桌。

e.en: She whisked the {hollandaise} carefully over a warm bain-marie.
e.zh: 她在温水浴上小心地搅打荷兰酱。

holler.t:
v. 大声叫喊
n. 喊叫声

e.en: Just {holler} if you need help carrying the boxes.
e.zh: 搬箱子需要帮忙的话就喊一声。

e.en: The kids {holler} every time the ice-cream truck arrives.
e.zh: 每次冰淇淋车一来,孩子们就大喊大叫。

hollering.t: v. 大喊（holler 现在分词）

e.en: Fans were {hollering} for an encore after the song.
e.zh: 歌曲结束后,粉丝们大声喊着要求再来一首。

e.en: He came running over, {hollering} my name across the field.
e.zh: 他跑过来,在田野那头大声喊着我的名字。

hollow.t:
adj. 空心的；空洞的
n. 洞；凹处

e.en: The old tree trunk was completely {hollow} inside.
e.zh: 那棵老树干里面完全是空的。

e.en: Her apology sounded {hollow} and rehearsed.
e.zh: 她的道歉听起来空洞又像是排练过的。

e.en: The shop specializes in silver {holloware} like teapots and bowls.
e.zh: 这家店专营银制空心器皿,如茶壶和碗。

e.en: Antique {holloware} can be very valuable at auction.
e.zh: 古董空心银器在拍卖会上可能价值连城。

hollowed.t:
adj. 挖空的
v. hollow 的过去式

e.en: He {hollowed} out a pumpkin to make a lantern.
e.zh: 他把南瓜挖空做成了一盏灯。

e.en: Years of stress had {hollowed} her cheeks noticeably.
e.zh: 多年的压力让她的脸颊明显凹陷。

hollowing.t: v. 挖空（hollow 的现在分词）

e.en: Erosion is slowly {hollowing} out the cliffs along the coast.
e.zh: 侵蚀正在慢慢把海岸的悬崖掏空。

e.en: Automation is {hollowing} out many middle-class jobs.
e.zh: 自动化正在掏空许多中产阶级的工作。

e.en: His footsteps echoed {hollowly} in the empty hallway.
e.zh: 他的脚步声在空荡的走廊里空洞地回响。

e.en: She laughed {hollowly} at the unfunny joke.
e.zh: 她对那个不好笑的笑话干笑了几声。

e.en: He felt a sudden {hollowness} after the celebration ended.
e.zh: 庆祝结束后,他突然感到一阵空虚。

e.en: Critics noted the {hollowness} of the politician's promises.
e.zh: 评论人士指出那位政客承诺的空洞。

e.en: We decorated the mantel with sprigs of {holly} and pinecones.
e.zh: 我们用冬青枝和松果装饰了壁炉架。

e.en: A {holly} bush by the gate had bright red berries.
e.zh: 门边的一丛冬青结满了鲜红的浆果。

e.en: Tall {hollyhock} stems lined the cottage garden wall.
e.zh: 高高的蜀葵茎沿着小屋花园的墙生长。

e.en: She planted pink {hollyhock} seeds along the fence.
e.zh: 她沿着篱笆种下了粉色蜀葵的种子。

e.en: He moved to {Hollywood} hoping to become an actor.
e.zh: 他搬去好莱坞,希望成为一名演员。

e.en: The film has a classic {Hollywood} happy ending.
e.zh: 这部电影有一个经典的好莱坞式大团圆结局。

e.en: Cattle grazed peacefully on the river {holm}.
e.zh: 牛群在河中小岛上平静地吃草。

e.en: An ancient {holm} oak shaded the whole courtyard.
e.zh: 一棵古老的冬青栎为整个庭院遮阴。

holme.t: n. 河中小岛（holm 异拼）

e.en: The small {holme} in the river floods every spring.
e.zh: 河中那座小岛每年春天都会被淹。

e.en: Sheep were grazing on the grassy {holme}.
e.zh: 羊群在长满草的河中小岛上吃草。

e.en: Sherlock {Holmes} is the most famous fictional detective ever.
e.zh: 夏洛克·福尔摩斯是有史以来最著名的虚构侦探。

e.en: She binge-read every {Holmes} story over the weekend.
e.zh: 她整个周末一口气读完了所有福尔摩斯的故事。

holocaust.t: n. 大屠杀；（特指）纳粹屠犹

e.en: The museum documents survivors of the {Holocaust} during World War II.
e.zh: 这座博物馆记录了二战中大屠杀幸存者的故事。

e.en: Scientists warned of a possible nuclear {holocaust}.
e.zh: 科学家警告可能发生核浩劫。

holocausts.t: n. 大屠杀（holocaust 的复数）

e.en: History records several devastating {holocausts} caused by war.
e.zh: 历史上记载了若干由战争引发的毁灭性浩劫。

e.en: The novel imagines future {holocausts} triggered by climate change.
e.zh: 这部小说设想了气候变化引发的未来浩劫。

e.en: A 3D {hologram} of the singer appeared on stage.
e.zh: 舞台上出现了那位歌手的3D全息投影。

e.en: The credit card has a tiny security {hologram}.
e.zh: 这张信用卡上有一个小小的防伪全息图。

holograph.t:
n. 亲笔手书文件
adj. 亲笔的

e.en: The auction featured a {holograph} letter written by Lincoln.
e.zh: 这次拍卖会展出了林肯亲笔写的一封手稿。

e.en: Scholars verified the document as a genuine {holograph}.
e.zh: 学者们证实了这份文件是真正的亲笔手稿。

e.en: The new phone has a {holographic} display feature.
e.zh: 这款新手机带有全息显示功能。

e.en: Concert organizers used {holographic} effects to wow the audience.
e.zh: 演唱会主办方用全息特效震撼了观众。

e.en: Advances in {holography} are transforming medical imaging.
e.zh: 全息技术的进步正在改变医学成像。

e.en: The lab is researching new applications for {holography}.
e.zh: 该实验室正在研究全息技术的新应用。

holstein.t: n. 荷斯坦奶牛（黑白花奶牛）

e.en: The black-and-white {Holstein} cows produce most of our milk.
e.zh: 黑白相间的荷斯坦奶牛提供了我们大部分牛奶。

e.en: He raises {Holstein} cattle on his family farm.
e.zh: 他在家庭农场里饲养荷斯坦牛。

holster.t:
n. 手枪皮套
v. 把枪插入枪套

e.en: The officer slid the pistol back into its {holster}.
e.zh: 那名警官把手枪插回枪套里。

e.en: He wore a leather {holster} on his belt.
e.zh: 他在腰带上挂着一个皮制枪套。

e.en: The officer {holstered} her pistol after the suspect surrendered.
e.zh: 嫌疑人投降后,警官把手枪收回了枪套。

e.en: He kept the gun {holstered} throughout the tense conversation.
e.zh: 在紧张的对话中,他始终把枪收在枪套里。

holt.t: n. 霍尔特（姓氏/小树林）

e.en: The fox slipped quietly into its {holt} near the river.
e.zh: 狐狸悄悄钻进了河边的洞穴。

e.en: We hiked past a small {holt} of oak trees.
e.zh: 我们徒步经过一小片橡树林。

e.en: Pilgrims travel for miles to visit this {holy} site.
e.zh: 朝圣者跋涉数英里来到这处圣地。

e.en: {Holy} cow, that concert was absolutely incredible!
e.zh: 我的天,那场演唱会真是太棒了!

holyhead.t: n. 霍利黑德（威尔士港口）

e.en: We caught the ferry from {Holyhead} to Dublin last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们从霍利黑德搭渡轮去都柏林。

e.en: {Holyhead} is the largest town on the island of Anglesey.
e.zh: 霍利黑德是安格尔西岛上最大的城镇。

holyrood.t: n. 荷里路德（爱丁堡地名）

e.en: The Scottish Parliament meets at {Holyrood} in Edinburgh.
e.zh: 苏格兰议会在爱丁堡的荷里路德开会。

e.en: Tourists often photograph the gates of {Holyrood} Palace.
e.zh: 游客经常拍摄荷里路德宫的大门。

holyroodhouse.t: n. 荷里路德宫（苏格兰王宫）

e.en: The Queen stays at {Holyroodhouse} during her annual Scottish visit.
e.zh: 女王每年访问苏格兰时都住在荷里路德宫。

e.en: We toured the historic apartments of {Holyroodhouse} yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天参观了荷里路德宫的历史套房。

e.en: The film pays {homage} to classic 1970s thrillers.
e.zh: 这部电影向经典的七十年代惊悚片致敬。

e.en: Fans gathered to pay {homage} to the late musician.
e.zh: 粉丝们聚集在一起向已故的音乐家致敬。

hombre.t: n. 男人（源自西班牙语，俚语）

e.en: That tough {hombre} ran the saloon for twenty years.
e.zh: 那个硬汉经营那家酒馆已有二十年。

e.en: He's a smart {hombre} who knows the streets well.
e.zh: 他是个聪明的家伙,对街头的事很熟。

e.en: Grandfather always wore a black {homburg} to church.
e.zh: 祖父去教堂时总戴着一顶黑色洪堡帽。

e.en: The detective tipped his {homburg} and walked away.
e.zh: 侦探轻碰了一下洪堡帽,转身走开了。

home.t:
n. 家；主页
adj. 家的；主场的

e.en: I usually work from {home} on Fridays.
e.zh: 我周五通常在家办公。

e.en: Click the {home} icon to return to the main page.
e.zh: 点击主页图标即可返回首页。

e.en: She's a real {homebody} who prefers cooking to nightclubs.
e.zh: 她是个十足的宅家族,宁愿做饭也不爱去夜店。

e.en: Being a {homebody} saved me a lot of money.
e.zh: 喜欢宅在家让我省下了不少钱。

homebound.t: adj. 回家途中的；足不出户的

e.en: The volunteers deliver meals to {homebound} elderly residents.
e.zh: 志愿者为足不出户的老年人送餐。

e.en: Heavy snow left thousands of commuters {homebound} for hours.
e.zh: 大雪让数千名通勤者被困在回家的路上数小时。

e.en: My {homeboy} from college is flying in this weekend.
e.zh: 我大学时的好兄弟这周末要飞过来。

e.en: He nodded at his {homeboy} across the crowded room.
e.zh: 他朝拥挤房间另一头的老乡点了点头。

e.en: The {homebuilder} promised to finish the kitchen by June.
e.zh: 建筑商承诺六月前完成厨房装修。

e.en: Major {homebuilder} stocks rose after interest rates dropped.
e.zh: 利率下调后,主要房屋建筑商股票上涨。

e.en: First-time {homebuyer} programs offer lower down payments.
e.zh: 首次购房者计划提供较低的首付要求。

e.en: Every {homebuyer} should get a thorough inspection before closing.
e.zh: 每位购房者在交易前都应做一次彻底的房屋检查。

e.en: The whole town celebrated her {homecoming} after years abroad.
e.zh: 她在国外多年后归来,全镇都为她庆祝。

e.en: We're going to the {homecoming} dance on Saturday night.
e.zh: 我们周六晚上要去参加返校节舞会。

homed.t: v. 归巢；锁定目标（home 过去式）

e.en: The missile {homed} in on the heat signature.
e.zh: 导弹锁定了热信号并飞了过去。

e.en: Investigators {homed} in on a single suspect within days.
e.zh: 调查人员几天内就把焦点锁定在一名嫌疑人身上。

e.en: My {homegirl} always has my back in tough times.
e.zh: 我的好闺蜜在我困难的时候总是支持我。

e.en: She introduced her {homegirl} to everyone at the party.
e.zh: 她把好姐妹介绍给派对上的每个人。

e.en: The salad uses {homegrown} tomatoes from our backyard.
e.zh: 这份沙拉用的是我们后院自家种的番茄。

e.en: The startup is a {homegrown} success story from Detroit.
e.zh: 这家初创公司是底特律本土的成功故事。

e.en: After thirty years abroad, he finally returned to his {homeland}.
e.zh: 在国外生活三十年后,他终于回到了祖国。

e.en: Refugees often dream of one day seeing their {homeland} again.
e.zh: 难民常常梦想有一天能再见到自己的故土。

e.en: Indigenous communities are fighting to protect their ancestral {homelands}.
e.zh: 原住民社区正在努力保护他们的祖传家园。

e.en: Many immigrants send money back to their {homelands} monthly.
e.zh: 许多移民每月向自己的故乡汇款。

e.en: The city opened more shelters to help {homeless} families.
e.zh: 市政府开设了更多收容所来帮助无家可归的家庭。

e.en: The earthquake left thousands of people {homeless} overnight.
e.zh: 地震使数千人一夜之间无家可归。

e.en: Rising rents are a major cause of {homelessness}.
e.zh: 租金上涨是导致无家可归现象的主要原因。

e.en: The mayor announced a new plan to reduce {homelessness}.
e.zh: 市长宣布了减少无家可归现象的新计划。

e.en: The cozy café has a wonderfully {homelike} atmosphere.
e.zh: 这家温馨的咖啡馆有着宜人的家居氛围。

e.en: They decorated the hospital room to feel more {homelike}.
e.zh: 他们把病房布置得更有家的感觉。

e.en: The inn's {homeliness} made every guest feel welcome.
e.zh: 这家小旅馆的温馨感让每位客人都倍感亲切。

e.en: There's a quiet {homeliness} to her grandmother's kitchen.
e.zh: 她奶奶的厨房里有一种宁静朴素的温馨感。

homely.t: adj. 朴素的；相貌平平的

e.en: Grandma served us a {homely} meal of stew and bread.
e.zh: 奶奶给我们端上一顿朴实的炖菜配面包。

e.en: The cottage looked small and {homely} from the outside.
e.zh: 那间小屋从外面看显得朴素而温馨。

e.en: Nothing beats a slice of {homemade} apple pie.
e.zh: 没什么比得上一块自制苹果派。

e.en: She brought {homemade} cookies to the office meeting.
e.zh: 她带了自制饼干到办公室开会。

e.en: After the kids were born, she became a full-time {homemaker}.
e.zh: 孩子出生后,她成了一名全职家庭主妇。

e.en: The survey counted {homemaker} as a valid occupation.
e.zh: 这项调查把家庭主妇也算作一种正式职业。

e.en: She enjoys {homemaking} and runs a popular cooking blog.
e.zh: 她喜欢操持家务,还经营着一个人气美食博客。

e.en: The class teaches basic {homemaking} skills like budgeting and cooking.
e.zh: 这门课教授预算和烹饪等基本的居家技能。

e.en: Her {homeopath} prescribed tiny pills for the persistent headaches.
e.zh: 她的顺势疗法医生为持续性头痛开了小药丸。

e.en: He visits a {homeopath} instead of a regular doctor.
e.zh: 他看的是顺势疗法医师,而不是普通医生。

e.en: Some parents prefer {homeopathic} remedies for their children's colds.
e.zh: 有些父母更喜欢用顺势疗法治疗孩子的感冒。

e.en: Scientists remain skeptical about most {homeopathic} treatments.
e.zh: 科学家对大多数顺势疗法仍持怀疑态度。

e.en: She turned to {homeopathy} after standard medicine failed her.
e.zh: 在传统医学无效后,她转向了顺势疗法。

e.en: Critics argue that {homeopathy} works mainly through the placebo effect.
e.zh: 批评者认为顺势疗法主要靠安慰剂效应起作用。

e.en: The body maintains {homeostasis} by regulating temperature and blood sugar.
e.zh: 身体通过调节体温和血糖来维持内稳态。

e.en: Stress can disrupt the delicate {homeostasis} of the immune system.
e.zh: 压力会打乱免疫系统微妙的内稳态。

e.en: Sweating is a {homeostatic} response to rising body temperature.
e.zh: 出汗是身体对体温升高的内稳态反应。

e.en: The brain has powerful {homeostatic} mechanisms to regulate sleep.
e.zh: 大脑拥有强大的内稳态机制来调节睡眠。

e.en: Every {homeowner} should keep a small emergency fund for repairs.
e.zh: 每个房主都应该留一笔小额应急维修金。

e.en: Rising property taxes worry many first-time {homeowner} buyers.
e.zh: 房产税上涨让许多首次购房的房主感到担忧。

e.en: Their {homepage} loads in under two seconds on mobile.
e.zh: 他们的主页在手机上两秒内就能加载完成。

e.en: I bookmarked the news site's {homepage} for quick access.
e.zh: 我把那家新闻网站的主页加入书签以便快速访问。

e.en: He returned to his {homeplace} in the mountains every summer.
e.zh: 他每年夏天都回到山里的老家。

e.en: The old farm remained their family {homeplace} for generations.
e.zh: 那座老农场是他们家族世代相传的故居。

homer.t:
n. 本垒打
n. 荷马（人名）

e.en: He hit a game-winning {homer} in the ninth inning.
e.zh: 他在第九局打出了制胜全垒打。

e.en: The crowd roared when she launched a towering {homer}.
e.zh: 当她击出一记冲天全垒打时,观众沸腾了。

e.en: Their road trip became a {Homeric} adventure of mishaps.
e.zh: 他们的公路旅行变成了一场荷马史诗般的奇遇。

e.en: The novel uses {Homeric} themes of journey and homecoming.
e.zh: 这部小说借用了荷马式的旅程与归乡主题。

homeroom.t: n. 晨会教室；班主任课堂

e.en: Announcements are read every morning during {homeroom}.
e.zh: 每天早晨在班会课时间宣读通知。

e.en: My {homeroom} teacher remembered every student's birthday.
e.zh: 我的班主任记得每个学生的生日。

e.en: The new product launch was a complete {homerun} for the company.
e.zh: 新产品发布对公司来说是一次大获成功。

e.en: He smashed a {homerun} over the center field wall.
e.zh: 他把球轰过了中外野的围墙,打出全垒打。

homes.t: n. 家；住宅（home 的复数）

e.en: Many {homes} in the area lost power during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间,该地区许多家庭都停电了。

e.en: The app helps people find affordable {homes} near transit.
e.zh: 这个应用帮助人们寻找交通便利且价格合理的住房。

e.en: She felt {homesick} during her first month at college.
e.zh: 她在大学的第一个月感到很想家。

e.en: Eating dumplings always makes me a little {homesick}.
e.zh: 吃饺子总让我有点想家。

e.en: {Homesickness} hit him hardest around the holidays.
e.zh: 每到节假日,他的思乡之情最为强烈。

e.en: Many exchange students struggle with {homesickness} during winter.
e.zh: 许多交换生在冬天会饱受思乡之苦。

e.en: The developer is selling lakefront {homesite} lots starting next month.
e.zh: 开发商将于下个月开始出售湖畔住宅用地。

e.en: They picked a quiet wooded {homesite} for their cabin.
e.zh: 他们为自己的小木屋选了一块安静的林间宅地。

homespun.t: adj. 朴素的；土生土长的

e.en: The senator is famous for his {homespun} stories and humor.
e.zh: 这位参议员以朴实的故事和幽默而闻名。

e.en: She wore a simple dress of {homespun} cotton.
e.zh: 她穿着一件简朴的家织棉布连衣裙。

e.en: The family has farmed this {homestead} for four generations.
e.zh: 这家人在这块宅地上耕作了四代人。

e.en: They sold the city apartment to {homestead} in Vermont.
e.zh: 他们卖掉城里的公寓,搬到佛蒙特州自给自足地生活。

homesteader.t: n. 自耕农；农庄定居者

e.en: Each {homesteader} received 160 acres of free land.
e.zh: 每位拓荒者都获得了一百六十英亩的免费土地。

e.en: The young {homesteader} learned to raise chickens and bake bread.
e.zh: 那位年轻的自耕农学会了养鸡和烤面包。

e.en: They quit corporate jobs to try {homesteading} in Maine.
e.zh: 他们辞掉公司工作,跑到缅因州尝试自给自足的生活。

e.en: {Homesteading} videos have become wildly popular on YouTube.
e.zh: 自给自足生活的视频在油管上变得非常受欢迎。

e.en: Many original {homesteads} still stand along the old prairie road.
e.zh: 许多最初的拓荒宅地仍矗立在那条古老的草原路旁。

e.en: The pioneers built simple log {homesteads} near the river.
e.zh: 拓荒者们在河边建起了简陋的原木宅地。

homestretch.t: n. 终点直道；最后冲刺阶段

e.en: The runners entered the {homestretch} neck and neck.
e.zh: 赛跑选手并驾齐驱地进入了最后冲刺阶段。

e.en: We're in the {homestretch} of this project finally.
e.zh: 我们这个项目终于进入了收尾阶段。

e.en: He returned to his {hometown} after ten years abroad.
e.zh: 他在国外待了十年后回到了家乡。

e.en: My {hometown} has changed a lot recently.
e.zh: 我的家乡最近变化很大。

e.en: Many students miss their {hometowns} during the holidays.
e.zh: 许多学生在假期会想念自己的家乡。

e.en: Their {hometowns} are only fifty miles apart.
e.zh: 他们的家乡相距只有五十英里。

homeward.t:
adv. 向家地
adj. 回家的

e.en: The tired commuters began their {homeward} journey.
e.zh: 疲惫的通勤者们踏上了回家的路。

e.en: She turned the car {homeward} after the meeting.
e.zh: 开完会后她把车驶向回家的方向。

e.en: The flock of birds flew {homewards} at dusk.
e.zh: 鸟群在黄昏时分朝家的方向飞去。

e.en: We walked {homewards} through the quiet streets.
e.zh: 我们穿过寂静的街道朝家走去。

e.en: Finish your math {homework} before watching TV.
e.zh: 看电视之前先把数学作业写完。

e.en: Investors should do their {homework} before buying stocks.
e.zh: 投资者买股票前应该做足功课。

e.en: As a {homeworker}, she sets her own schedule daily.
e.zh: 作为居家工作者,她每天自己安排日程。

e.en: The company hired another {homeworker} to handle customer calls.
e.zh: 公司又雇了一名居家员工处理客户来电。

e.en: The little café has a {homey} atmosphere.
e.zh: 这家小咖啡馆有一种家的温馨感。

e.en: She decorated the apartment to feel cozy and {homey}.
e.zh: 她把公寓布置得既舒适又有家的感觉。

e.en: The suspect showed clear {homicidal} tendencies during interviews.
e.zh: 嫌疑人在审讯中表现出明显的杀人倾向。

e.en: Traffic on Mondays makes me feel almost {homicidal}.
e.zh: 周一的交通堵塞让我简直想杀人。

e.en: Detectives are investigating the {homicide} that occurred yesterday.
e.zh: 侦探们正在调查昨天发生的凶杀案。

e.en: The city's {homicide} rate dropped sharply last year.
e.zh: 该市去年的凶杀率大幅下降。

e.en: What's up, {homie}? Long time no see!
e.zh: 哥们儿你好啊,好久不见!

e.en: He's been my {homie} since elementary school.
e.zh: 他从小学起就是我的好兄弟。

e.en: The professor's lectures had a {homiletic} tone.
e.zh: 这位教授的讲课带有说教的口吻。

e.en: She published a book of {homiletic} essays.
e.zh: 她出版了一本布道散文集。

e.en: Seminary students must study {homiletics} for two years.
e.zh: 神学院学生必须学习两年的讲道学。

e.en: He teaches {homiletics} at the divinity school.
e.zh: 他在神学院教授讲道学。

e.en: The priest delivered a short {homily} on forgiveness.
e.zh: 牧师作了一篇关于宽恕的简短布道。

e.en: Grandpa loves giving us a {homily} about hard work.
e.zh: 爷爷喜欢给我们讲一通关于勤奋的大道理。

homing.t: adj. 归巢的；自动导向的

e.en: The missile uses heat-{homing} technology to track targets.
e.zh: 这枚导弹使用热寻的技术追踪目标。

e.en: Pigeons have an amazing {homing} instinct.
e.zh: 鸽子有着惊人的归巢本能。

hominid.t: n. 原始人类；人科动物

e.en: Scientists discovered a new {hominid} fossil in Africa.
e.zh: 科学家在非洲发现了一种新的人科化石。

e.en: Early {hominid} species walked upright on two legs.
e.zh: 早期人科物种用双腿直立行走。

e.en: She served grilled chicken with buttery {hominy} on the side.
e.zh: 她端上了烤鸡,配上一份黄油玉米粒。

e.en: Southern cooks often use {hominy} in traditional stews.
e.zh: 南方厨师常在传统炖菜中使用玉米粒。

homo.t:
n. 同性恋者（俚，贬）
n. 人属

e.en: {Homo} sapiens evolved roughly three hundred thousand years ago.
e.zh: 智人大约在三十万年前进化出现。

e.en: The museum displays skulls from various {homo} species.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了各种人属物种的头骨。

e.en: The system exhibits a {homoclinic} orbit near the saddle point.
e.zh: 该系统在鞍点附近呈现同宿轨道。

e.en: Mathematicians study {homoclinic} bifurcations in chaotic systems.
e.zh: 数学家研究混沌系统中的同宿分岔现象。

e.en: High {homocysteine} levels can increase heart disease risk.
e.zh: 高同型半胱氨酸水平会增加患心脏病的风险。

e.en: The doctor ordered a blood test for {homocysteine}.
e.zh: 医生要求做一次同型半胱氨酸血液检测。

e.en: She prefers {homoeopathic} remedies over conventional medicine.
e.zh: 她更喜欢顺势疗法而非传统药物。

e.en: The shop sells various {homoeopathic} treatments for allergies.
e.zh: 这家店出售各种治疗过敏的顺势疗法药品。

e.en: Many doctors are skeptical about the effectiveness of {homoeopathy}.
e.zh: 许多医生对顺势疗法的效果持怀疑态度。

e.en: She studied {homoeopathy} for three years in London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦学习了三年的顺势疗法。

e.en: The novel contains strong {homoerotic} themes throughout.
e.zh: 这部小说通篇带有强烈的同性情欲色彩。

e.en: Critics noted the {homoerotic} undertones in the film.
e.zh: 评论家注意到影片中的同性情欲暗流。

homoeroticism.t: n. 同性爱欲；同性恋情色倾向

e.en: The painting is famous for its subtle {homoeroticism}.
e.zh: 这幅画以其微妙的同性情欲意味而闻名。

e.en: Scholars debate the {homoeroticism} in ancient Greek poetry.
e.zh: 学者们就古希腊诗歌中的同性情欲展开辩论。

e.en: Researchers analyzed the tissue {homogenate} under the microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下分析了组织匀浆。

e.en: The lab prepared a liver {homogenate} for the experiment.
e.zh: 实验室为这项实验制备了肝脏匀浆。

e.en: The team lacks {homogeneity} in skill levels.
e.zh: 这个团队成员的技能水平参差不齐。

e.en: Cultural {homogeneity} is rare in major modern cities.
e.zh: 文化同质性在现代大城市中十分罕见。

e.en: The audience was surprisingly {homogeneous} in age and background.
e.zh: 观众在年龄和背景上意外地相似。

e.en: Mix the ingredients until the batter looks {homogeneous}.
e.zh: 把配料搅拌至面糊看起来均匀一致。

e.en: The dye spread {homogeneously} throughout the fabric.
e.zh: 染料均匀地渗透到整块布料中。

e.en: Wealth is rarely distributed {homogeneously} across regions.
e.zh: 财富在各地区的分布很少是均匀的。

e.en: Globalization has accelerated the {homogenisation} of pop culture.
e.zh: 全球化加速了流行文化的同质化。

e.en: Milk undergoes {homogenisation} before reaching supermarket shelves.
e.zh: 牛奶在上架超市前要经过均质化处理。

homogenise.t: v. 使均质化（英式拼写）

e.en: Critics worry that streaming will {homogenise} global cinema.
e.zh: 批评者担心流媒体会让全球电影同质化。

e.en: Factories {homogenise} milk to prevent cream from separating.
e.zh: 工厂对牛奶进行均质处理以防奶油分离。

e.en: The {homogenization} of fashion makes every city look similar.
e.zh: 时尚的同质化让每个城市看起来都差不多。

e.en: Pasteurization usually follows the {homogenization} of dairy products.
e.zh: 巴氏消毒通常在乳制品均质化之后进行。

e.en: Big media companies tend to {homogenize} news coverage.
e.zh: 大型媒体公司往往会让新闻报道趋同化。

e.en: You need to {homogenize} the mixture before bottling it.
e.zh: 你需要先把混合物均质化再装瓶。

homogenized.t:
adj. 已均质化的
v. homogenize 的过去式

e.en: Most supermarket milk has been {homogenized} and pasteurized.
e.zh: 大多数超市出售的牛奶都经过均质和巴氏消毒。

e.en: Mainstream media has {homogenized} how news stories are presented.
e.zh: 主流媒体让新闻报道的呈现方式变得千篇一律。

e.en: The chef is {homogenizing} the sauce with a hand blender.
e.zh: 厨师正用手持搅拌器把酱汁打匀。

e.en: Social media is rapidly {homogenizing} youth culture worldwide.
e.zh: 社交媒体正在迅速使全球青年文化趋同。

e.en: The neighborhood is fairly {homogenous} in income level.
e.zh: 这个社区在收入水平上相当一致。

e.en: Stir the soup until it becomes {homogenous}.
e.zh: 把汤搅拌至均匀一致为止。

e.en: The word "bow" is a classic {homograph} in English.
e.zh: 单词"bow"是英语中典型的同形异义词。

e.en: Students often confuse a {homograph} with a homophone.
e.zh: 学生常把同形异义词和同音词搞混。

e.en: Whale flippers and human arms are {homologous} structures.
e.zh: 鲸鱼的鳍状肢和人类手臂是同源结构。

e.en: The two genes are {homologous} across many species.
e.zh: 这两个基因在许多物种中都是同源的。

e.en: Scientists found a human {homologue} of the mouse gene.
e.zh: 科学家找到了这种小鼠基因的人类同源物。

e.en: The French foreign minister met his British {homologue} yesterday.
e.zh: 法国外长昨天会见了他的英国同行。

e.en: Researchers established {homology} between the two protein sequences.
e.zh: 研究人员确定了这两个蛋白质序列之间的同源关系。

e.en: Algebraic {homology} is a key concept in modern topology.
e.zh: 代数同调是现代拓扑学中的一个关键概念。

homonym.t: n. 同音（或同形）异义词

e.en: "Bat" is a {homonym} meaning either an animal or a club.
e.zh: "bat"是同音同形异义词,既指蝙蝠也指球棒。

e.en: English has many a {homonym} that confuses learners.
e.zh: 英语中有许多同形同音异义词让学习者困惑。

e.en: Linguists distinguish {homonymy} from polysemy in semantic studies.
e.zh: 语言学家在语义研究中区分同形同音异义与多义。

e.en: Chinese has extensive {homonymy} due to its limited syllable structure.
e.zh: 由于音节结构有限,汉语存在大量同音异义现象。

e.en: He was called a {homophobe} for his hateful comments.
e.zh: 他因发表充满仇恨的言论被斥为恐同者。

e.en: The politician denied being a {homophobe} despite his record.
e.zh: 尽管有过往记录,这位政客否认自己是恐同者。

homophobia.t: n. 对同性恋的恐惧或厌恶

e.en: The school launched a campaign against {homophobia} on campus.
e.zh: 学校发起了一场反对校园恐同的运动。

e.en: {Homophobia} remains a serious problem in many workplaces.
e.zh: 恐同现象在许多职场中仍是一个严重问题。

e.en: His {homophobic} jokes got him fired from the show.
e.zh: 他的恐同笑话让他被节目组解雇了。

e.en: The country still has several {homophobic} laws on the books.
e.zh: 该国法律中仍有几条恐同条款。

e.en: "Their" and "there" form a common English {homophone} pair.
e.zh: "their"和"there"是一对常见的英语同音词。

e.en: Chinese poetry often plays with each {homophone} for hidden meaning.
e.zh: 中文诗歌常利用同音字来传达隐含意义。

homophony.t: n. 同音现象；主调音乐

e.en: Cantonese {homophony} makes wordplay especially common in Hong Kong.
e.zh: 粤语的同音现象使香港的文字游戏特别常见。

e.en: Most pop songs rely on simple melodic {homophony}.
e.zh: 大多数流行歌曲依赖于简单的主调音乐结构。

homosexual.t:
adj. 同性恋的
n. 同性恋者

e.en: He came out as {homosexual} to his family last year.
e.zh: 去年他向家人坦白了自己是同性恋。

e.en: Many countries have legalized {homosexual} marriage in recent decades.
e.zh: 近几十年来许多国家已将同性婚姻合法化。

e.en: Attitudes toward {homosexuality} have changed dramatically since the 1990s.
e.zh: 自上世纪九十年代以来人们对同性恋的态度发生了巨大变化。

e.en: The documentary explores {homosexuality} in ancient civilizations.
e.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了古代文明中的同性恋现象。

e.en: The plant is {homozygous} for the red flower gene.
e.zh: 这株植物在红花基因上是纯合的。

e.en: Twins inherited {homozygous} traits from both parents.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎从父母双方继承了纯合性状。

e.en: The alchemist claimed to have created a tiny {homunculus}.
e.zh: 这位炼金术士声称创造出了一个微小的人造小人。

e.en: Neuroscientists use the cortical {homunculus} to map sensory regions.
e.zh: 神经科学家用皮层小人图来标示感觉区域。

hon.t: n. 亲爱的（honey 的昵称）

e.en: Pass me the salt, {hon}, the soup needs more.
e.zh: 亲爱的，把盐递给我，汤还需要再加点。

e.en: Thanks for waiting, {hon}, your table is ready now.
e.zh: 亲，让你久等了，您的桌子准备好了。

e.en: The head {honcho} approved the budget this morning.
e.zh: 今天上午大老板批准了预算。

e.en: Ask the {honcho} in charge of marketing for details.
e.zh: 详情请问负责市场部的那位头儿。

honda.t: n. 本田（日本汽车品牌）

e.en: My dad still drives his old red {Honda} Civic.
e.zh: 我爸还在开他那辆红色的老本田思域。

e.en: {Honda} announced a new electric model at the auto show.
e.zh: 本田在车展上发布了一款新电动车型。

honduran.t:
adj. 洪都拉斯的
n. 洪都拉斯人

e.en: She married a {Honduran} engineer she met in college.
e.zh: 她嫁给了一位大学时认识的洪都拉斯工程师。

e.en: The restaurant serves authentic {Honduran} street food.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应正宗的洪都拉斯街头小吃。

honduras.t: n. 洪都拉斯（中美洲国家）

e.en: We hiked through the rainforests of {Honduras} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们徒步穿越了洪都拉斯的雨林。

e.en: {Honduras} shares a long border with Guatemala.
e.zh: 洪都拉斯与危地马拉有很长的接壤边界。

e.en: Daily practice helps you {hone} your coding skills.
e.zh: 每天练习能帮你磨练编程能力。

e.en: The chef stopped to {hone} the blade before serving.
e.zh: 上菜前厨师停下来磨了磨刀。

hones.t: v. hone 的第三人称单数

e.en: She {hones} her writing every morning before work.
e.zh: 她每天上班前都磨练自己的写作功底。

e.en: The old barber {hones} his razor on a leather strap.
e.zh: 那位老理发师在皮带上磨他的剃刀。

e.en: To be {honest}, I didn't enjoy the movie.
e.zh: 老实说，我并不喜欢那部电影。

e.en: She gave an {honest} review of the new restaurant.
e.zh: 她对那家新餐厅给出了诚实的评价。

e.en: {Honestly}, I forgot we had a meeting today.
e.zh: 说实话，我忘了今天有会议。

e.en: He spoke {honestly} about his struggles with anxiety.
e.zh: 他坦率地谈到了自己与焦虑的斗争。

e.en: I appreciate your {honesty} about the project's risks.
e.zh: 我很感激你对项目风险的坦诚。

e.en: {Honesty} is the foundation of any good friendship.
e.zh: 诚实是任何良好友谊的基石。

e.en: I stir a spoonful of {honey} into my morning tea.
e.zh: 我会在早茶里搅一勺蜂蜜。

e.en: {Honey}, can you grab the laundry from upstairs?
e.zh: 亲爱的，你能去楼上把衣服拿下来吗？

e.en: A {honeybee} landed on the lavender outside my window.
e.zh: 一只蜜蜂落在了我窗外的薰衣草上。

e.en: Climate change is threatening {honeybee} populations worldwide.
e.zh: 气候变化正威胁着全球的蜜蜂种群。

e.en: The kids stared in awe at the dripping {honeycomb}.
e.zh: 孩子们目不转睛地盯着滴蜜的蜂巢。

e.en: This phone case has a {honeycomb} pattern for grip.
e.zh: 这款手机壳采用蜂窝纹路设计来防滑。

honeycombed.t: adj. 布满孔洞的；蜂窝状的

e.en: The cliff was {honeycombed} with tiny caves and tunnels.
e.zh: 那悬崖上布满了蜂窝状的小洞和隧道。

e.en: Old bread can become {honeycombed} with air pockets.
e.zh: 放久的面包内部会变得布满气孔。

e.en: I packed sliced {honeydew} for a refreshing summer snack.
e.zh: 我切了些蜜瓜当夏日清爽小食带着。

e.en: The fruit salad had grapes, melon, and {honeydew}.
e.zh: 那份水果沙拉里有葡萄、甜瓜和蜜瓜。

honeyed.t: adj. 甜言蜜语的；含蜜的

e.en: His {honeyed} words almost convinced me to invest.
e.zh: 他甜言蜜语差点说服我投资。

e.en: She served warm bread with {honeyed} butter on top.
e.zh: 她端上了抹着蜂蜜黄油的热面包。

honeymoon.t:
n. 蜜月；蜜月期
v. 度蜜月

e.en: They spent their {honeymoon} hiking in New Zealand.
e.zh: 他们的蜜月是在新西兰徒步度过的。

e.en: The new CEO's {honeymoon} period is already over.
e.zh: 新任首席执行官的蜜月期已经结束了。

e.en: The resort is full of starry-eyed {honeymooner} couples.
e.zh: 度假村里满是含情脉脉的蜜月新人。

e.en: That young {honeymooner} kept posting beach photos online.
e.zh: 那位年轻的蜜月新人不停在网上发海滩照片。

honeymoons.t:
n. honeymoon 的复数
v. 度蜜月（三单）

e.en: Bali remains one of the most popular {honeymoons} destinations.
e.zh: 巴厘岛仍是最热门的蜜月目的地之一。

e.en: Many corporate {honeymoons} end when budget cuts begin.
e.zh: 许多公司的蜜月期都在预算削减开始时结束。

honeypot.t: n. 蜜罐（诱捕系统）；诱饵

e.en: Security teams set up a {honeypot} to catch hackers.
e.zh: 安全团队设置了一个蜜罐来诱捕黑客。

e.en: The startup became a {honeypot} for venture capital money.
e.zh: 这家初创公司成了风投资金的香饽饽。

e.en: The {honeysuckle} climbing our fence smells amazing at night.
e.zh: 爬在我家篱笆上的金银花夜里香气扑鼻。

e.en: Bees love the sweet nectar of wild {honeysuckle}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂特别喜欢野生金银花的甜蜜花蜜。

honeywell.t: n. 霍尼韦尔（美国科技公司）

e.en: We installed a {Honeywell} thermostat to save on heating.
e.zh: 我们装了一个霍尼韦尔恒温器来节省取暖费。

e.en: {Honeywell} reported strong earnings in the aerospace division.
e.zh: 霍尼韦尔航空航天部门公布了强劲的业绩。

hong.t: n. 洋行（旧时中国商行）

e.en: My friend {Hong} runs a tea shop in Chinatown.
e.zh: 我朋友洪在唐人街开了一家茶叶店。

e.en: The old trading {hong} once dominated the Canton waterfront.
e.zh: 那家老商行曾主宰着广州的码头贸易。

e.en: We have a layover in {HongKong} on the way home.
e.zh: 我们回家途中要在香港转机停留。

e.en: {HongKong} skyline lights up beautifully every evening at eight.
e.zh: 香港的天际线每晚八点都会亮起绚丽灯光。

e.en: Her grandmother collected antique {Honiton} lace from Devon.
e.zh: 她奶奶收藏来自德文郡的古董霍尼顿花边。

e.en: We stopped in {Honiton} for tea and scones.
e.zh: 我们在霍尼顿小镇停下来喝茶吃司康。

honk.t:
v. 按喇叭；（鹅）叫
n. 喇叭声

e.en: Please don't {honk} at pedestrians in the crosswalk.
e.zh: 请不要对斑马线上的行人按喇叭。

e.en: I heard the loud {honk} of a goose overhead.
e.zh: 我听到头顶传来一声响亮的鹅叫。

honked.t: v. 按喇叭（honk 过去式）

e.en: The driver behind me {honked} when the light turned green.
e.zh: 绿灯一亮，后面的司机就按了喇叭。

e.en: A flock of geese {honked} as they flew south.
e.zh: 一群大雁向南飞时嘎嘎地叫着。

e.en: That impatient {honker} woke up the whole neighborhood.
e.zh: 那个不耐烦按喇叭的人吵醒了整个街区。

e.en: A massive Canadian {honker} landed near the pond.
e.zh: 一只大块头的加拿大雁降落在池塘边。

honking.t:
v. 按喇叭（现在分词）
adj. 巨大的（俚）

e.en: The {honking} traffic outside kept me awake all night.
e.zh: 窗外按喇叭的车流让我整夜没睡。

e.en: Geese were {honking} loudly above the misty lake.
e.zh: 大雁在雾蒙蒙的湖面上空大声鸣叫。

e.en: The taxi {honks} angrily at every slow pedestrian.
e.zh: 出租车对每个走得慢的行人都气愤地按喇叭。

e.en: Two short {honks} usually mean hello in our neighborhood.
e.zh: 在我们街区，按两声短喇叭通常表示打招呼。

honky.t: n. 白鬼（对白人的蔑称）

e.en: The bar had a real {honky}-tonk vibe Friday nights.
e.zh: 那家酒吧周五晚上有种地道的乡村酒吧氛围。

e.en: He played {honky}-tonk piano in a downtown saloon.
e.zh: 他在市中心的小酒馆里弹奏乡村酒吧风钢琴。

honolulu.t: n. 檀香山（夏威夷首府）

e.en: Our flight to {Honolulu} leaves at six tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我们飞往檀香山的航班明早六点起飞。

e.en: {Honolulu} beaches are crowded during the holiday season.
e.zh: 假期期间檀香山的海滩十分拥挤。

honor.t:
n. 荣誉；敬意
v. 尊敬；兑现

e.en: It's an {honor} to speak at this conference today.
e.zh: 今天能在这个会议上发言是我的荣幸。

e.en: The store will {honor} expired coupons through Sunday.
e.zh: 这家商店周日前都接受过期优惠券。

e.en: Stepping down was the {honorable} thing for him to do.
e.zh: 主动辞职对他来说是件光荣的事。

e.en: The {Honorable} Judge Lee will preside over the case.
e.zh: 尊敬的李法官将主持这宗案件。

e.en: He served {honorably} in the navy for twenty years.
e.zh: 他在海军中光荣服役了二十年。

e.en: She handled the difficult negotiation {honorably} and fairly.
e.zh: 她以光明磊落且公正的方式处理了那场艰难谈判。

e.en: The university paid her a small {honorarium} for the lecture.
e.zh: 学校为她的演讲支付了一小笔酬金。

e.en: Guest speakers usually receive an {honorarium} plus travel expenses.
e.zh: 嘉宾演讲者通常会收到酬金加差旅报销。

honorary.t: adj. 名誉的；荣誉授予的

e.en: The university awarded her an {honorary} doctorate last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天大学授予了她名誉博士学位。

e.en: He's an {honorary} member of the local rowing club.
e.zh: 他是当地划船俱乐部的名誉会员。

honored.t:
adj. 受尊敬的
v. 尊敬（过去式）

e.en: I'm truly {honored} to receive this award tonight.
e.zh: 今晚能获得这个奖项我真的深感荣幸。

e.en: The city {honored} the firefighters with a special ceremony.
e.zh: 市政府举办特别仪式表彰了那些消防员。

e.en: Tonight's {honoree} has spent decades fighting for clean water.
e.zh: 今晚的获奖者数十年来一直在为清洁水源奔走。

e.en: Each {honoree} received a custom plaque and standing ovation.
e.zh: 每位获奖者都获颁定制奖牌并获得起立鼓掌。

honorific.t:
adj. 敬称的
n. 敬语

e.en: In Japanese, you add an {honorific} suffix to names.
e.zh: 在日语中，你需要在名字后加上敬语后缀。

e.en: "Doctor" is an {honorific} earned through years of study.
e.zh: "博士"是经过多年学习才获得的尊称。

honoring.t: v. 尊敬；兑现（现在分词）

e.en: The ceremony is {honoring} veterans from three different wars.
e.zh: 该仪式是为了表彰参加过三场战争的退伍军人。

e.en: They're {honoring} her last wishes by donating the artwork.
e.zh: 他们正按她的遗愿捐出这些艺术作品。

honors.t:
n. 荣誉（复数）
v. 尊敬（三单）

e.en: She graduated with {honors} from a top engineering school.
e.zh: 她以优等成绩毕业于一所顶尖工程院校。

e.en: This restaurant {honors} all major credit cards and mobile pay.
e.zh: 这家餐厅接受所有主流信用卡和手机支付。

honour.t:
n. 荣誉（honor 英式拼写）
v. 尊敬

e.en: It's an {honour} to meet you in person finally.
e.zh: 终于能当面见到你真是我的荣幸。

e.en: They will {honour} the contract despite the price increase.
e.zh: 尽管价格上涨，他们仍将履行合同。

e.en: Resigning was the only {honourable} option left for him.
e.zh: 辞职是他剩下唯一光荣的选择。

e.en: The {Honourable} Member proposed a sensible amendment.
e.zh: 那位尊敬的议员提出了一项合理的修正案。

e.en: He was {honourably} discharged after fifteen years of service.
e.zh: 服役十五年后，他光荣退伍。

e.en: She conducted herself {honourably} throughout the lengthy trial.
e.zh: 在漫长的审判过程中，她始终表现得光明磊落。

honoured.t: adj. 受尊敬的（英式拼写）

e.en: I'm deeply {honoured} by your generous invitation.
e.zh: 承蒙您热情邀请，我深感荣幸。

e.en: The bank {honoured} the cheque despite the small overdraft.
e.zh: 尽管账户略有透支，银行还是兑付了这张支票。

honouring.t: v. 尊敬（英式现在分词）

e.en: The school is {honouring} retired teachers at next week's assembly.
e.zh: 学校将在下周的集会上表彰退休教师。

e.en: She's {honouring} her promise to call every Sunday evening.
e.zh: 她正履行着每周日晚上打电话的承诺。

honours.t: n. 荣誉；优等（英式拼写）

e.en: He earned first-class {honours} in mathematics at Cambridge.
e.zh: 他在剑桥以一等荣誉学位毕业于数学专业。

e.en: The queen {honours} outstanding citizens at a yearly ceremony.
e.zh: 女王每年都会举行典礼表彰杰出公民。

hoo.t: int. 呼（拟声，表惊讶或欢呼）

e.en: The owl let out a soft {hoo} from the tree.
e.zh: 猫头鹰从树上发出了一声轻柔的呼呼叫。

e.en: Woo-{hoo}, we finally finished the project on time!
e.zh: 哇呼，我们终于按时完成了项目！

e.en: Grandpa used to brew {hooch} in his backyard shed.
e.zh: 爷爷以前在后院的小棚里酿私酒。

e.en: They confiscated several bottles of cheap {hooch} at the border.
e.zh: 他们在边境没收了几瓶廉价烈酒。

hood.t:
n. 兜帽；引擎盖
v. 罩上

e.en: She pulled the {hood} over her head in the rain.
e.zh: 下雨时她把兜帽拉到头上。

e.en: The mechanic lifted the {hood} to check the engine.
e.zh: 机修工掀开引擎盖检查发动机。

e.en: A {hooded} figure walked quickly down the alley.
e.zh: 一个戴着兜帽的人快步走过小巷。

e.en: She wore a {hooded} jacket to the morning run.
e.zh: 她穿着连帽夹克去晨跑。

e.en: He grabbed his favorite gray {hoodie} before heading out.
e.zh: 出门前他抓起最爱的那件灰色连帽衫。

e.en: The startup gave every employee a branded {hoodie}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司给每位员工发了印有标志的连帽衫。

e.en: The shop owner chased the young {hoodlum} away.
e.zh: 店主把那个小流氓赶走了。

e.en: Police arrested a {hoodlum} who had vandalized the bus stop.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了一名破坏公交车站的小混混。

e.en: Tourists photographed the strange {hoodoo} rocks at sunset.
e.zh: 游客们在日落时拍摄那些奇形怪状的石柱。

e.en: He blamed his bad luck on some kind of {hoodoo}.
e.zh: 他把自己的霉运归咎于某种邪术。

e.en: Their winter coats all came with fur-lined {hoods}.
e.zh: 他们的冬季外套都带有毛皮内衬的兜帽。

e.en: The cars had matching black {hoods} and tinted windows.
e.zh: 那些车都配着同款的黑色引擎盖和深色车窗。

e.en: Scammers try to {hoodwink} elderly people with fake calls.
e.zh: 骗子们试图用假电话欺骗老年人。

e.en: Don't let flashy ads {hoodwink} you into buying junk.
e.zh: 别让花哨的广告骗你买下垃圾产品。

e.en: His excuse sounded like complete {hooey} to me.
e.zh: 他的借口在我听来完全是胡说八道。

e.en: That diet advice is pure {hooey} with no science behind it.
e.zh: 那种减肥建议纯属胡扯,毫无科学依据。

hoof.t:
n. 蹄子
v. 步行；踢

e.en: The horse lifted its {hoof} for the farrier.
e.zh: 那匹马抬起蹄子让钉蹄匠查看。

e.en: A loose stone got stuck in the pony's {hoof}.
e.zh: 一块松石卡在小马的蹄子里。

hoofed.t:
adj. 有蹄的
v. 步行（过去式）

e.en: Deer and cattle are common {hoofed} animals.
e.zh: 鹿和牛都是常见的有蹄动物。

e.en: The {hoofed} mammals grazed quietly in the meadow.
e.zh: 有蹄类哺乳动物在草地上安静地吃草。

e.en: She was a talented {hoofer} on Broadway in the 1940s.
e.zh: 四十年代她是百老汇一位才华横溢的踢踏舞演员。

e.en: The old {hoofer} could still dance circles around the kids.
e.zh: 那位老踢踏舞者跳起来仍能让年轻人甘拜下风。

e.en: We followed a fresh {hoofprint} through the muddy trail.
e.zh: 我们沿着泥泞小径上一个新鲜的蹄印追踪。

e.en: A single {hoofprint} in the snow led toward the barn.
e.zh: 雪地里一个孤单的蹄印通向谷仓。

hook.t:
n. 钩子；钩拳
v. 钩住；吸引

e.en: Hang your coat on the {hook} by the door.
e.zh: 把你的外套挂在门边的钩子上。

e.en: The song's catchy {hook} stayed in my head all day.
e.zh: 那首歌洗脑的副歌一整天都萦绕在我脑海里。

e.en: They smoked a {hookah} at the lounge after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他们在休闲吧抽了水烟。

e.en: The cafe served mint tea alongside a flavored {hookah}.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆供应薄荷茶,搭配调味水烟。

hooke.t: n. 胡克（人名，如罗伯特·胡克）

e.en: Robert {Hooke} discovered cells while examining cork in 1665.
e.zh: 罗伯特·胡克在1665年观察软木时发现了细胞。

e.en: Physics students still learn {Hooke}'s law about springs.
e.zh: 物理系学生至今仍要学习有关弹簧的胡克定律。

hooked.t:
adj. 着迷的；钩状的
v. 钩住（过去式）

e.en: My niece is completely {hooked} on that new cartoon.
e.zh: 我侄女彻底迷上了那部新动画片。

e.en: He {hooked} the trailer to the back of the truck.
e.zh: 他把拖车挂到了卡车后面。

hooker.t: n. 妓女（俚）；橄榄球勾球手

e.en: The rugby {hooker} threw the ball into the lineup.
e.zh: 橄榄球钩球手把球抛进列阵中。

e.en: Captain {Hooker} sailed his ship into the harbor at dawn.
e.zh: 胡克船长在拂晓时把船驶入港口。

hooking.t: v. 钩住；勾引（现在分词）

e.en: She is {hooking} a colorful rug for the living room.
e.zh: 她正在给客厅钩织一块色彩缤纷的地毯。

e.en: The penalty was for {hooking} an opposing player's stick.
e.zh: 那次判罚是因为用球杆勾住了对方球员。

hooks.t:
n. 钩子（复数）
v. 钩住（三单）

e.en: Kitchen utensils hung neatly from a row of {hooks}.
e.zh: 厨房用具整齐地挂在一排挂钩上。

e.en: React {hooks} let you manage state inside functional components.
e.zh: React的Hooks让你能在函数组件内管理状态。

e.en: The campsite offers a water and electric {hookup} for RVs.
e.zh: 营地为房车提供水电接驳设施。

e.en: He arranged a {hookup} between two old college friends.
e.zh: 他撮合了两位老大学同学相识。

e.en: {Hookworm} infections still affect millions in tropical regions.
e.zh: 钩虫感染至今仍困扰着热带地区数百万人。

e.en: Walking barefoot in contaminated soil can cause {hookworm}.
e.zh: 赤脚走在受污染的土壤上可能感染钩虫。

e.en: A drunk {hooligan} smashed the cafe window after the match.
e.zh: 一个醉酒的小流氓在比赛后砸了咖啡馆的窗户。

e.en: Police escorted the {hooligan} out of the stadium.
e.zh: 警察把那个闹事者押出了体育场。

hooliganism.t: n. 流氓行为；街头滋事

e.en: Football {hooliganism} declined sharply over the past decade.
e.zh: 过去十年里足球流氓行为大幅减少。

e.en: The city introduced new laws to combat street {hooliganism}.
e.zh: 该市出台新法律以打击街头流氓行为。

hoop.t:
n. 箍；圆环
v. 用箍围住

e.en: He shot the ball cleanly through the {hoop}.
e.zh: 他干净利落地把球投进了篮筐。

e.en: The dog jumped through a flaming {hoop} during the show.
e.zh: 表演中那只狗跳过了一个火圈。

e.en: She wore a {hooped} skirt to the costume party.
e.zh: 她穿着一条裙撑撑起的裙子去了化装舞会。

e.en: The team's {hooped} jerseys are recognized worldwide.
e.zh: 那支球队的横条纹球衣举世闻名。

e.en: He's a talented {hooper} who plays pickup games every weekend.
e.zh: 他是个出色的篮球玩家,每个周末都打野球。

e.en: The {hooper} crafted wooden barrels for the local brewery.
e.zh: 那位制桶匠为当地酿酒厂打造木桶。

hoopla.t: n. 大肆宣传；喧嚣热闹

e.en: There was a lot of {hoopla} around the product launch.
e.zh: 产品发布前后有大量的喧嚣炒作。

e.en: Despite all the {hoopla}, the movie was a disappointment.
e.zh: 尽管造势铺天盖地,这部电影还是令人失望。

e.en: A colorful {hoopoe} landed on the garden fence.
e.zh: 一只色彩鲜艳的戴胜鸟落在了花园栅栏上。

e.en: Birdwatchers traveled far to spot a wild {hoopoe}.
e.zh: 观鸟者远道而来只为目睹野生戴胜鸟。

e.en: The young {hoopster} dreams of playing in the NBA.
e.zh: 这位年轻的篮球小将梦想着打进NBA。

e.en: Every {hoopster} on the team practices three hours daily.
e.zh: 队里每个篮球队员每天都训练三小时。

e.en: {Hooray}, we finally finished the project on time!
e.zh: 太好了,我们终于按时完成了项目!

e.en: The kids shouted {hooray} when school was canceled.
e.zh: 得知学校停课时,孩子们欢呼万岁。

hoot.t:
v. (猫头鹰)鸣叫；起哄
n. 嘘声

e.en: I don't give a {hoot} what the critics think.
e.zh: 我才不在乎那些评论家怎么想。

e.en: We could hear an owl {hoot} outside the cabin.
e.zh: 我们能听到木屋外猫头鹰在啼叫。

e.en: They brewed cheap {hootch} in the basement during prohibition.
e.zh: 禁酒令时期他们在地下室酿造劣质私酒。

e.en: The old man kept a bottle of {hootch} hidden in the shed.
e.zh: 老人在棚屋里藏了一瓶私酿酒。

e.en: The factory {hooter} sounded at the end of the shift.
e.zh: 工厂的汽笛在换班结束时鸣响。

e.en: A barn owl is sometimes called a {hooter} by farmers.
e.zh: 农夫们有时把仓鸮称作叫枭。

e.en: The crowd was {hooting} loudly during the comedy show.
e.zh: 观众在喜剧表演中大声起哄欢呼。

e.en: Owls were {hooting} all night in the nearby woods.
e.zh: 附近树林里的猫头鹰整夜啼叫。

hoover.t:
n. 吸尘器
v. 用吸尘器清扫

e.en: I need to {hoover} the carpet before the guests arrive.
e.zh: 客人到来前我得先用吸尘器吸一下地毯。

e.en: The kids will {hoover} up any snacks left on the counter.
e.zh: 孩子们会把柜台上剩下的零食一扫而光。

hop.t:
v. 单脚跳；跳跃
n. 短途飞行

e.en: Just {hop} on the bus and we'll meet downtown.
e.zh: 直接跳上公交车,我们在市中心碰面。

e.en: The little rabbit gave a quick {hop} across the lawn.
e.zh: 那只小兔子蹦了一下跳过了草坪。

e.en: I {hope} you have a wonderful birthday tomorrow.
e.zh: 祝你明天生日过得愉快。

e.en: There is still {hope} that the missing hiker will be found.
e.zh: 失踪的徒步者仍有被找到的希望。

hoped.t: v. hope 的过去式；曾希望

e.en: She {hoped} her message would reach him in time.
e.zh: 她希望自己的消息能及时传到他那里。

e.en: Everyone {hoped} for sunshine on the wedding day.
e.zh: 大家都盼着婚礼当天能有阳光。

hopeful.t: adj. 充满希望的；乐观的

e.en: The doctor sounded {hopeful} about her recovery.
e.zh: 医生对她的康复听起来很乐观。

e.en: I'm {hopeful} that we can resolve this issue today.
e.zh: 我有信心我们今天就能解决这个问题。

e.en: {Hopefully} the rain will stop before the picnic starts.
e.zh: 但愿野餐开始前雨能停下来。

e.en: She looked {hopefully} at the interviewer awaiting an answer.
e.zh: 她满怀期待地看着面试官等待回答。

e.en: Her speech inspired a sense of {hopefulness} in the audience.
e.zh: 她的演讲在听众心中激起了一种希望感。

e.en: There's a quiet {hopefulness} returning to the neighborhood.
e.zh: 这个社区正悄悄重拾希望。

e.en: I'm absolutely {hopeless} at remembering people's names.
e.zh: 我在记别人名字方面完全没救。

e.en: The situation seemed {hopeless} until volunteers stepped in.
e.zh: 在志愿者介入之前,局面似乎毫无希望。

hopelessly.t: adv. 绝望地；无可救药地

e.en: He fell {hopelessly} in love with his neighbor.
e.zh: 他无可救药地爱上了自己的邻居。

e.en: The tourists got {hopelessly} lost in the old city.
e.zh: 游客们在老城里彻底迷了路。

e.en: A deep sense of {hopelessness} settled over the refugees.
e.zh: 一种深深的绝望感笼罩在难民们心头。

e.en: Therapy helped her overcome years of {hopelessness}.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮她走出了多年的绝望情绪。

hopes.t:
n. 希望（复数）
v. 希望（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {hopes} to study medicine at a top university.
e.zh: 她希望能在顶尖大学学习医学。

e.en: All our {hopes} now rest on the new treatment.
e.zh: 我们所有的希望现在都寄托在这种新疗法上。

hopi.t: n. 霍皮人（美洲原住民）

e.en: The {Hopi} people have lived in Arizona for centuries.
e.zh: 霍皮族人在亚利桑那州生活了数百年。

e.en: She studied traditional {Hopi} pottery during her research trip.
e.zh: 她在考察期间研究了传统的霍皮族陶器。

hoping.t: v. 希望（hope 的现在分词）

e.en: I'm {hoping} to hear back from the company by Friday.
e.zh: 我希望周五前能收到公司的回音。

e.en: She kept refreshing the page, {hoping} for good news.
e.zh: 她不停刷新页面,期待能有好消息。

e.en: Each Greek {hoplite} carried a heavy round shield and spear.
e.zh: 每位希腊重装步兵都携带着沉重的圆盾和长矛。

e.en: The {hoplite} formation dominated ancient Greek warfare.
e.zh: 重装步兵方阵主导了古希腊的战争形态。

hopper.t:
n. 漏斗；料斗
n. 跳跃者

e.en: Pour the grain into the {hopper} above the mill.
e.zh: 把谷物倒入磨坊上方的料斗里。

e.en: A grass {hopper} jumped onto my picnic blanket.
e.zh: 一只蚂蚱跳到了我的野餐毯上。

hopping.t:
v. 跳跃（hop 的现在分词）
adj. 跳跃的

e.en: The toddler was {hopping} on one foot across the yard.
e.zh: 那个小孩单脚蹦跳着穿过院子。

e.en: The downtown bar was {hopping} on Saturday night.
e.zh: 市中心的酒吧在周六晚上热闹非凡。

e.en: This IPA has a very {hoppy} bitter flavor.
e.zh: 这款印度淡啤酒有强烈的啤酒花苦味。

e.en: Craft breweries often produce {hoppy} beers for enthusiasts.
e.zh: 精酿啤酒厂常为爱好者酿造啤酒花味浓的啤酒。

hops.t:
n. 啤酒花
v. 跳（第三人称单数）

e.en: The rabbit {hops} across the lawn happily.
e.zh: 那只兔子开心地跳过草坪。

e.en: Brewers add {hops} to give beer its bitter taste.
e.zh: 酿酒师加入啤酒花来赋予啤酒苦味。

e.en: Children drew {hopscotch} squares on the sidewalk with chalk.
e.zh: 孩子们用粉笔在人行道上画跳房子格子。

e.en: She loved playing {hopscotch} during recess at school.
e.zh: 她喜欢在课间休息时玩跳房子。

hora.t: n. 霍拉舞（东欧圆圈舞）

e.en: Guests danced the {hora} at the Jewish wedding reception.
e.zh: 客人们在犹太婚礼上跳起了霍拉舞。

e.en: The {hora} is a traditional circle dance.
e.zh: 霍拉舞是一种传统的圆圈舞。

e.en: The poem follows a {Horatian} ode structure with calm reflection.
e.zh: 这首诗采用贺拉斯式颂歌结构,基调平静沉思。

e.en: Her satire has a gentle {Horatian} tone rather than biting wit.
e.zh: 她的讽刺带有温和的贺拉斯式语调,而非尖刻机智。

horde.t: n. 一大群（人）；游牧部落

e.en: A {horde} of fans waited outside the stadium.
e.zh: 一大群粉丝在体育场外等候。

e.en: The game pits players against a {horde} of zombies.
e.zh: 这款游戏让玩家对抗成群的僵尸。

e.en: Grandma always kept {horehound} candy in a glass jar.
e.zh: 奶奶总在玻璃罐里放着夏至草糖果。

e.en: Some people use {horehound} tea to soothe a sore throat.
e.zh: 有些人用夏至草茶来缓解喉咙痛。

e.en: The sun slowly dipped below the {horizon}.
e.zh: 太阳慢慢地落到地平线以下。

e.en: Travel can broaden your {horizon} in unexpected ways.
e.zh: 旅行能以意想不到的方式拓宽你的视野。

e.en: Reading widely expands your intellectual {horizons}.
e.zh: 广泛阅读能拓展你的知识视野。

e.en: New {horizons} opened up after she moved abroad.
e.zh: 她出国后,新的天地展现在眼前。

e.en: Draw a {horizontal} line across the page.
e.zh: 在纸上画一条横线。

e.en: The phone screen rotates when held in {horizontal} position.
e.zh: 手机屏幕在横着拿时会自动旋转。

e.en: The building's {horizontality} contrasts with nearby skyscrapers.
e.zh: 这栋建筑的水平延伸性与附近的摩天大楼形成对比。

e.en: Modernist design often emphasizes {horizontality} over height.
e.zh: 现代主义设计常强调水平感而非高度。

e.en: Scroll {horizontally} to see more columns in the spreadsheet.
e.zh: 水平滚动以查看电子表格中的更多列。

e.en: Place the book {horizontally} on the shelf.
e.zh: 把书横放在架子上。

horley.t: n. 霍利（英国地名/人名）

e.en: The train stopped briefly at {Horley} station near Gatwick.
e.zh: 火车在盖特威克附近的霍利车站短暂停靠。

e.en: She grew up in {Horley}, a small town in Surrey.
e.zh: 她在萨里郡的小镇霍利长大。

e.en: Teenagers often experience {hormonal} mood swings.
e.zh: 青少年常会经历激素引起的情绪波动。

e.en: The doctor ordered tests to check for {hormonal} imbalances.
e.zh: 医生开了检查以排查激素失衡。

e.en: Cortisol is a stress {hormone} produced by the adrenal glands.
e.zh: 皮质醇是由肾上腺分泌的压力激素。

e.en: Growth {hormone} levels typically peak during sleep.
e.zh: 生长激素水平通常在睡眠时达到峰值。

horn.t:
n. (动物的) 角；喇叭
v. 鸣笛

e.en: The driver honked the {horn} impatiently in traffic.
e.zh: 司机在堵车中不耐烦地按喇叭。

e.en: The bull lowered its head and pointed one {horn} forward.
e.zh: 公牛低下头,一只角向前指着。

e.en: The garden was lined with mature {hornbeam} hedges.
e.zh: 花园两侧种着成熟的鹅耳枥树篱。

e.en: {Hornbeam} wood is prized for its hardness and density.
e.zh: 鹅耳枥木以坚硬致密而受到推崇。

e.en: The {hornbill} has a distinctive curved bill and bright colors.
e.zh: 犀鸟有独特的弯喙和鲜艳的色彩。

e.en: Tourists hoped to spot a {hornbill} during the rainforest tour.
e.zh: 游客们希望在雨林游中能看到一只犀鸟。

e.en: The {horned} owl perched silently on the branch.
e.zh: 那只角鸮静静地栖息在树枝上。

e.en: A {horned} beetle crawled slowly across the path.
e.zh: 一只长角甲虫在小路上缓缓爬过。

e.en: A {hornet} stung him on the arm during the picnic.
e.zh: 野餐时一只大黄蜂蛰了他的手臂。

e.en: Don't disturb the {hornet} nest hanging from that tree.
e.zh: 别去碰挂在那棵树上的大黄蜂窝。

e.en: Sailors used to dance the {hornpipe} on long voyages.
e.zh: 水手们过去在长途航行中跳号笛舞。

e.en: The fiddler played a lively {hornpipe} at the festival.
e.zh: 小提琴手在节日上演奏了一曲欢快的号笛舞曲。

horns.t: n. 角（horn 的复数）；号角

e.en: The deer's {horns} were impressively large that autumn.
e.zh: 那只鹿的角在那个秋天格外巨大。

e.en: Drivers blared their {horns} stuck in the traffic jam.
e.zh: 司机们在堵车中猛按喇叭。

e.en: They bought a flat in {Hornsey} in north London.
e.zh: 他们在伦敦北部的霍恩西买了一套公寓。

e.en: The old {Hornsey} town hall is a heritage building.
e.zh: 古老的霍恩西市政厅是一处文化遗产建筑。

e.en: A green {hornworm} was eating the tomato leaves.
e.zh: 一条绿色的天蛾幼虫正在啃食番茄叶。

e.en: Gardeners often hand-pick the {hornworm} off their plants.
e.zh: 园丁常常用手把天蛾幼虫从植物上捉下来。

horny.t:
adj. 性欲强的；饥渴的
adj. 角质的

e.en: The turtle's shell has a tough, {horny} outer layer.
e.zh: 乌龟的壳有一层坚硬的角质外层。

e.en: Years of hard labor left his hands rough and {horny}.
e.zh: 多年的辛苦劳作让他的双手粗糙且长满老茧。

horology.t: n. 钟表制造学；计时学

e.en: He studied {horology} to learn how to repair antique watches.
e.zh: 他学习钟表学,以便修理古董手表。

e.en: The museum has an excellent collection on the history of {horology}.
e.zh: 这家博物馆收藏了丰富的钟表史藏品。

horoscope.t: n. 星座运势；占星天宫图

e.en: She reads her {horoscope} in the newspaper every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都看报纸上的星座运势。

e.en: My daily {horoscope} said I would meet someone interesting.
e.zh: 我今天的星座运势说我会遇到有趣的人。

e.en: Traffic this morning was absolutely {horrendous}.
e.zh: 今天早上的交通真是糟糕透顶。

e.en: The hotel had {horrendous} reviews online.
e.zh: 这家酒店在网上的评价惨不忍睹。

horrendously.t: adv. 极其可怕地；骇人地

e.en: The project went {horrendously} over budget.
e.zh: 这个项目严重超出了预算。

e.en: The restaurant was {horrendously} expensive for what it served.
e.zh: 以提供的食物来看,这家餐厅贵得离谱。

e.en: I had a {horrible} headache all afternoon.
e.zh: 我整个下午都头痛得厉害。

e.en: The weather has been absolutely {horrible} this week.
e.zh: 这周的天气糟糕透了。

e.en: The interview went {horribly} despite my preparation.
e.zh: 尽管我做了准备,面试还是糟糕透了。

e.en: His leg was {horribly} broken in the accident.
e.zh: 事故中他的腿摔得很惨。

e.en: What a {horrid} thing to say about your sister!
e.zh: 你怎么能这样说你妹妹,真讨厌!

e.en: The medicine had a {horrid} bitter taste.
e.zh: 那药有一股可怕的苦味。

e.en: The news showed {horrific} images from the disaster site.
e.zh: 新闻播出了灾难现场的可怕画面。

e.en: She survived a {horrific} car crash last year.
e.zh: 她去年从一场惨烈的车祸中幸存下来。

horrifically.t: adv. 骇人地；极其恐怖地

e.en: The building was {horrifically} damaged by the earthquake.
e.zh: 那栋建筑在地震中受损惨重。

e.en: He was {horrifically} burned in the kitchen fire.
e.zh: 他在厨房火灾中被严重烧伤。

e.en: She was {horrified} to find a spider in her shoe.
e.zh: 她在鞋子里发现一只蜘蛛,吓得不行。

e.en: Parents were {horrified} by the violence in the video.
e.zh: 家长们被视频中的暴力内容吓坏了。

horrifies.t: v. 使惊骇（horrify 的三单）

e.en: The thought of public speaking still {horrifies} him.
e.zh: 一想到要当众演讲他就感到害怕。

e.en: It {horrifies} me how much food we waste daily.
e.zh: 我们每天浪费的食物之多令我震惊。

e.en: Some scenes in the documentary may {horrify} younger viewers.
e.zh: 这部纪录片中的某些画面可能会吓到年幼的观众。

e.en: The statistics on poverty {horrify} anyone who reads them.
e.zh: 贫困方面的数据会让任何看到的人感到震惊。

horrifying.t: adj. 令人震惊的；骇人的

e.en: The witness gave a {horrifying} account of the attack.
e.zh: 目击者讲述了那场袭击的可怕经过。

e.en: It's {horrifying} how quickly the fire spread.
e.zh: 火势蔓延之快令人震惊。

horrifyingly.t: adv. 骇人地；令人震惊地

e.en: The infection spread {horrifyingly} fast through the ward.
e.zh: 感染在病房里以惊人的速度蔓延。

e.en: The streets were {horrifyingly} empty after the curfew.
e.zh: 宵禁后街道空荡得令人毛骨悚然。

horror.t:
n. 恐怖；惊恐
adj. 恐怖题材的

e.en: She watched the {horror} movie through her fingers.
e.zh: 她从指缝里偷看那部恐怖片。

e.en: To my {horror}, I had left my passport at home.
e.zh: 令我惊恐的是,我把护照落在家里了。

horrors.t: n. 恐怖的事物（horror 的复数）

e.en: The book describes the {horrors} of war in vivid detail.
e.zh: 这本书生动地描述了战争的恐怖。

e.en: Survivors still struggle with the {horrors} they witnessed.
e.zh: 幸存者仍在与他们目睹的恐怖记忆抗争。

horse.t:
n. 马
v. 哄闹（horse around）

e.en: She rode her {horse} along the beach at sunset.
e.zh: 她在日落时分骑着马沿海滩奔跑。

e.en: The wild {horse} galloped across the open plain.
e.zh: 那匹野马在开阔的平原上奔驰。

horseback.t:
n. 马背
adv. 骑马地

e.en: We explored the canyon on {horseback} for three days.
e.zh: 我们骑马探索峡谷度过了三天。

e.en: Police officers patrolled the park on {horseback}.
e.zh: 警察骑着马在公园里巡逻。

e.en: They loaded the pony into the {horsebox} for the show.
e.zh: 他们把小马装进运马车准备去参加比赛。

e.en: A large {horsebox} was parked outside the stables.
e.zh: 一辆大型运马车停在马厩外面。

e.en: He has a sharp eye for quality {horseflesh} at auctions.
e.zh: 他在拍卖会上挑选好马匹眼光独到。

e.en: In some cultures, {horseflesh} is considered a delicacy.
e.zh: 在一些文化中,马肉被视为美味佳肴。

e.en: A {horsefly} bit me painfully on the leg.
e.zh: 一只马蝇狠狠地咬了我的腿。

e.en: The {horsefly} buzzed annoyingly around the cattle.
e.zh: 马蝇在牛群周围烦人地嗡嗡飞。

e.en: The antique sofa was stuffed with {horsehair}.
e.zh: 那张古董沙发里填的是马毛。

e.en: Violin bows are traditionally made with {horsehair}.
e.zh: 小提琴弓传统上是用马尾毛制作的。

e.en: The old baseball was wrapped in tough {horsehide}.
e.zh: 那只旧棒球外面包着结实的马皮。

e.en: His boots were made of polished {horsehide}.
e.zh: 他的靴子是用打磨过的马皮做的。

horseless.t: adj. 无马的（如 horseless carriage 早期汽车）

e.en: Early cars were once called {horseless} carriages.
e.zh: 早期的汽车曾被称为无马马车。

e.en: The {horseless} carriage revolutionized personal transport.
e.zh: 无马马车彻底改变了个人出行方式。

e.en: He was a skilled {horseman} who competed in dressage.
e.zh: 他是一位擅长盛装舞步比赛的骑手。

e.en: A lone {horseman} appeared on the ridge at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分,一位孤独的骑手出现在山脊上。

e.en: Her {horsemanship} impressed the judges at the regional competition.
e.zh: 她的马术在地区比赛中给评委留下了深刻印象。

e.en: Good {horsemanship} requires patience and years of practice.
e.zh: 良好的骑术需要耐心和多年的练习。

e.en: Some European countries still sell {horsemeat} in supermarkets.
e.zh: 一些欧洲国家的超市仍有出售马肉。

e.en: The scandal revealed beef products contaminated with {horsemeat}.
e.zh: 这起丑闻揭露牛肉产品中混入了马肉。

e.en: The teacher told the boys to stop their {horseplay} in class.
e.zh: 老师叫那些男孩停止在课堂上嬉闹。

e.en: Rough {horseplay} on the playground led to a broken arm.
e.zh: 操场上粗野的打闹导致有人手臂骨折。

e.en: The new sports car delivers over 500 {horsepower}.
e.zh: 这款新跑车的马力超过五百匹。

e.en: Engineers measure engine output in {horsepower} or kilowatts.
e.zh: 工程师用马力或千瓦衡量发动机输出。

e.en: He spread {horseradish} sauce on his roast beef sandwich.
e.zh: 他在烤牛肉三明治上抹了辣根酱。

e.en: Fresh {horseradish} has a sharp, sinus-clearing flavor.
e.zh: 新鲜辣根有一股冲鼻醒脑的辛辣味。

e.en: Wild {horses} ran across the open prairie at sunset.
e.zh: 野马在夕阳下奔跑过开阔的草原。

e.en: She rides {horses} every weekend at the local stable.
e.zh: 她每个周末都在当地马场骑马。

horseshit.t:
n. 胡说八道（粗俗）
n. 马粪

e.en: He called the politician's promises pure {horseshit}.
e.zh: 他说那位政客的承诺纯粹是胡扯。

e.en: Don't feed me that {horseshit} about working late again.
e.zh: 别再拿加班那套鬼话来糊弄我。

horseshoe.t:
n. 马蹄铁
n. U 形物

e.en: A lucky {horseshoe} hung above the farmhouse door.
e.zh: 一个象征好运的马蹄铁挂在农舍门上。

e.en: The blacksmith hammered the {horseshoe} into shape.
e.zh: 铁匠把马蹄铁敲打成型。

horsetail.t:
n. 马尾
n. 木贼（植物）

e.en: {Horsetail} grows quickly along damp riverbanks.
e.zh: 问荆草在潮湿的河岸上生长得很快。

e.en: She tied her hair into a long {horsetail} for the run.
e.zh: 她把头发扎成长长的马尾去跑步。

horsewoman.t:
n. 女骑手
n. 女马术师

e.en: She is a skilled {horsewoman} who competes internationally.
e.zh: 她是一位技艺精湛的女骑手,在国际上参赛。

e.en: The {horsewoman} guided her mare gently around the arena.
e.zh: 那位女骑手温和地引导母马绕着场地走。

horsey.t:
adj. 爱马的
adj. 似马的

e.en: She loves the {horsey} crowd at country shows.
e.zh: 她喜欢乡村展会上那群爱马的人。

e.en: The toddler hugged her stuffed {horsey} at bedtime.
e.zh: 小宝宝在睡前抱着她的毛绒小马。

e.en: They drove south to {Horsham} for the weekend market.
e.zh: 他们驱车南下去霍舍姆赶周末集市。

e.en: The train from London reaches {Horsham} in about an hour.
e.zh: 从伦敦坐火车到霍舍姆约需一小时。

e.en: Geologists identified the ridge as an uplifted {horst} block.
e.zh: 地质学家认定这道山脊是抬升的地垒块。

e.en: A {horst} forms when faulting raises a section of crust.
e.zh: 当断层抬升一段地壳时便形成地垒。

horsy.t:
adj. 爱马的
adj. 似马的

e.en: He grew up in a {horsy} family that bred racehorses.
e.zh: 他在一个养赛马的爱马家庭里长大。

e.en: Her {horsy} laugh echoed across the dinner table.
e.zh: 她那阵马嘶般的大笑在餐桌上回荡。

hortative.t:
adj. 劝勉的
adj. 鼓励的

e.en: The coach gave a {hortative} speech before the final match.
e.zh: 教练在决赛前发表了一番激励人心的讲话。

e.en: His {hortative} tone urged everyone to keep pushing forward.
e.zh: 他鼓励的语气督促大家继续奋力向前。

e.en: The pastor's {hortatory} sermon moved the congregation deeply.
e.zh: 牧师那篇劝勉的布道深深打动了会众。

e.en: She wrote a {hortatory} essay encouraging civic engagement.
e.zh: 她写了一篇劝勉性的文章鼓励公民参与。

e.en: The {horticultural} show featured rare orchids from Asia.
e.zh: 园艺展上展出了来自亚洲的稀有兰花。

e.en: She studied {horticultural} science at the university.
e.zh: 她在大学里学习园艺学。

e.en: The {horticulturalist} recommended planting tulips in autumn.
e.zh: 那位园艺师建议在秋天种植郁金香。

e.en: As a {horticulturalist}, she designs sustainable urban gardens.
e.zh: 作为园艺师,她设计可持续的城市花园。

horticulture.t:
n. 园艺
n. 园艺学

e.en: He turned his passion for {horticulture} into a small business.
e.zh: 他把对园艺的热爱变成了一份小生意。

e.en: Modern {horticulture} relies on greenhouses and drip irrigation.
e.zh: 现代园艺依赖温室和滴灌系统。

e.en: The {horticulturist} pruned the roses with practiced care.
e.zh: 那位园艺师熟练而细心地修剪玫瑰。

e.en: She trained as a {horticulturist} at the botanical gardens.
e.zh: 她在植物园接受园艺师的培训。

e.en: Dr. Seuss's {Horton} the elephant teaches kids about loyalty.
e.zh: 苏斯博士笔下的大象霍顿教孩子们什么是忠诚。

e.en: They moved to a quiet street in {Horton} last summer.
e.zh: 他们去年夏天搬到了霍顿一条安静的街道。

horus.t: n. 荷鲁斯（古埃及鹰神）

e.en: Ancient Egyptians worshipped {Horus} as the falcon-headed sky god.
e.zh: 古埃及人崇拜鹰首天空之神荷鲁斯。

e.en: The eye of {Horus} symbolized protection and royal power.
e.zh: 荷鲁斯之眼象征着保护和王权。

e.en: The old locomotive works in {Horwich} closed decades ago.
e.zh: 霍威奇的老机车厂在几十年前就关闭了。

e.en: He grew up near {Horwich} on the edge of the moors.
e.zh: 他在沼地边缘的霍威奇附近长大。

hosanna.t: n. 和散那（赞颂上帝之词）
