e.en: The choir sang {hosanna} as the procession entered the church.
e.zh: 队伍走进教堂时唱诗班齐唱和散那。

e.en: Crowds shouted {hosanna} to welcome him into the city.
e.zh: 人群高呼和散那欢迎他进城。

hose.t:
n. 软管、水管
v. 用软管冲洗

e.en: He used a garden {hose} to water the tomato plants.
e.zh: 他用花园水管给番茄浇水。

e.en: Firefighters dragged a heavy {hose} toward the burning building.
e.zh: 消防员把沉重的水管拖向起火的大楼。

hosel.t: n. 杆颈（高尔夫球杆连接处）

e.en: The golf club's {hosel} cracked after years of use.
e.zh: 高尔夫球杆的杆颈在多年使用后裂开了。

e.en: A bent {hosel} can dramatically affect your swing path.
e.zh: 杆颈弯曲会显著影响你的挥杆路径。

e.en: The drought triggered a strict {hosepipe} ban across the county.
e.zh: 干旱促使该郡实施严格的禁用水管令。

e.en: He coiled the {hosepipe} neatly beside the garden tap.
e.zh: 他把水管整齐地盘在花园水龙头旁。

e.en: The department store's {hosiery} section sells tights and socks.
e.zh: 百货公司的袜类区出售连裤袜和袜子。

e.en: She launched a small {hosiery} brand selling sustainable tights.
e.zh: 她创立了一个销售环保袜子的小袜业品牌。

hospice.t:
n. 临终关怀医院
n. 安宁疗护中心

e.en: Her grandmother spent her final weeks in a {hospice}.
e.zh: 她的祖母在临终关怀院度过了最后几周。

e.en: The {hospice} nurse held the patient's hand gently.
e.zh: 临终关怀护士轻轻握着病人的手。

e.en: Local {hospices} rely heavily on community donations.
e.zh: 当地的临终关怀院严重依赖社区捐款。

e.en: Several {hospices} in the area offer free counseling services.
e.zh: 该地区的几家临终关怀院提供免费咨询服务。

hospitable.t:
adj. 好客的、热情的
adj. (环境)适宜的

e.en: The villagers were warm and {hospitable} to every traveler.
e.zh: 村民们对每一位旅客都热情好客。

e.en: Mars is not a {hospitable} environment for human life.
e.zh: 火星不是适合人类居住的环境。

e.en: They welcomed the guests {hospitably} with tea and cakes.
e.zh: 他们用茶和蛋糕热情地招待客人。

e.en: The innkeeper treated weary travelers {hospitably} every evening.
e.zh: 客栈老板每晚都热情款待疲惫的旅人。

e.en: She was rushed to the {hospital} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后她被紧急送往医院。

e.en: The new children's {hospital} opens downtown next month.
e.zh: 新的儿童医院下个月在市中心开业。

hospitalisation.t: n. 住院治疗（英式拼写）

e.en: His insurance covers full {hospitalisation} costs after surgery.
e.zh: 他的保险涵盖手术后全部住院费用。

e.en: The infection was severe enough to require {hospitalisation}.
e.zh: 这次感染严重到需要住院治疗。

hospitalise.t: v. 使住院治疗（英式拼写）

e.en: Doctors decided to {hospitalise} her for further observation.
e.zh: 医生决定让她住院接受进一步观察。

e.en: They had to {hospitalise} him after the heart attack.
e.zh: 他心脏病发作后,他们不得不让他住院。

e.en: He was {hospitalised} for three days with severe pneumonia.
e.zh: 他因重度肺炎住院三天。

e.en: Two passengers were {hospitalised} after the minor collision.
e.zh: 小型碰撞事故后有两名乘客住院。

e.en: The clinic only {hospitalises} patients in critical condition.
e.zh: 该诊所只让危重患者住院。

e.en: Each year flu season {hospitalises} thousands of elderly people.
e.zh: 每年流感季都让数千名老年人住院。

e.en: The doctor is {hospitalising} her for emergency tests tonight.
e.zh: 医生今晚正让她住院做紧急检查。

e.en: A heatwave is {hospitalising} dozens of vulnerable residents.
e.zh: 一场热浪正让数十名易受影响的居民入院。

hospitality.t:
n. 好客、款待
n. 酒店服务业

e.en: Thank you for your warm {hospitality} during our stay.
e.zh: 感谢你们在我们逗留期间的热情款待。

e.en: She works in the {hospitality} industry managing a boutique hotel.
e.zh: 她在酒店服务业工作,经营一家精品酒店。

e.en: Long {hospitalization} can be financially devastating without insurance.
e.zh: 长期住院在没有保险的情况下可能造成经济灾难。

e.en: The medication helped her avoid {hospitalization} entirely.
e.zh: 这种药让她完全避免了住院。

e.en: Doctors may {hospitalize} patients with dangerously low oxygen levels.
e.zh: 医生可能让血氧水平危险低的患者住院。

e.en: They had to {hospitalize} the toddler after the high fever.
e.zh: 高烧后他们不得不让那名幼儿住院。

e.en: The singer was {hospitalized} briefly for exhaustion last night.
e.zh: 那位歌手昨晚因疲劳短暂入院治疗。

e.en: Several firefighters were {hospitalized} for smoke inhalation.
e.zh: 数名消防员因吸入浓烟而住院。

e.en: The hospital {hospitalizes} only the most serious COVID cases now.
e.zh: 该医院现在只收治最严重的新冠病例。

e.en: Each winter, flu {hospitalizes} thousands across the country.
e.zh: 每年冬天,流感都让全国数千人住院。

e.en: The outbreak is {hospitalizing} children at an alarming rate.
e.zh: 这次疫情正以惊人速度让儿童住院。

e.en: Doctors are {hospitalizing} him to monitor his blood pressure.
e.zh: 医生让他住院以监测血压。

e.en: The medieval {hospitaller} cared for sick pilgrims along the route.
e.zh: 中世纪的医院骑士在沿途照料生病的朝圣者。

e.en: He joined the order as a {hospitaller} in his youth.
e.zh: 他年轻时作为医院骑士加入了那个修会。

e.en: Many {hospitals} across the city are short on nurses.
e.zh: 全市许多医院都缺少护士。

e.en: Rural {hospitals} often struggle to keep their emergency rooms open.
e.zh: 乡村医院往往难以维持急诊室的运营。

host.t:
n. 主人、主持人
v. 主办、托管（服务器）

e.en: She will {host} the podcast's first live episode next week.
e.zh: 她下周将主持该播客的首场直播节目。

e.en: Our {host} greeted us with drinks and a tour.
e.zh: 主人用饮料招待我们,还带我们参观了一圈。

e.en: The shaded border was filled with lush green {hosta} leaves.
e.zh: 阴凉的花坛边长满了葱绿的玉簪叶。

e.en: She divided the {hosta} clumps to plant along the path.
e.zh: 她把玉簪丛分株种在小径两旁。

e.en: The bank robbers held one customer {hostage} for several hours.
e.zh: 那些银行劫匪挟持一名顾客作为人质长达数小时。

e.en: Negotiators worked through the night to free the {hostage}.
e.zh: 谈判人员通宵努力以解救那名人质。

e.en: All the {hostages} were released unharmed after lengthy negotiations.
e.zh: 经过漫长的谈判,所有人质都安然获释。

e.en: The militants threatened to harm the remaining {hostages}.
e.zh: 武装分子威胁要伤害剩余的人质。

e.en: She {hosted} a podcast about climate change last year.
e.zh: 她去年主持了一档关于气候变化的播客。

e.en: The website is {hosted} on a cloud server.
e.zh: 该网站托管在云服务器上。

e.en: We stayed in a cheap {hostel} near the train station.
e.zh: 我们住在火车站附近一家便宜的青年旅社。

e.en: The youth {hostel} offers free breakfast to guests.
e.zh: 这家青年旅社为客人提供免费早餐。

e.en: They stopped at a roadside {hostelry} for the night.
e.zh: 他们在路边一家小旅店过了夜。

e.en: The old {hostelry} has welcomed travelers for centuries.
e.zh: 这家古老的旅馆几个世纪以来一直接待旅客。

e.en: Backpackers often book {hostels} to save money.
e.zh: 背包客常订青年旅社来省钱。

e.en: Most {hostels} in this city offer shared kitchens.
e.zh: 这座城市大多数青年旅社都提供共用厨房。

e.en: The {hostess} greeted us warmly at the door.
e.zh: 女主人在门口热情地迎接我们。

e.en: A flight {hostess} handed out blankets to passengers.
e.zh: 一位空乘给乘客们分发毯子。

e.en: The {hostesses} guided guests to their tables.
e.zh: 女招待们把客人引到各自的桌位。

e.en: Two {hostesses} welcomed visitors at the gallery opening.
e.zh: 两位女主人在画廊开幕式上迎接来宾。

hostile.t: adj. 敌对的；怀有敌意的

e.en: The crowd became {hostile} when the speaker arrived.
e.zh: 演讲者到场时人群变得充满敌意。

e.en: Soldiers operated in {hostile} desert conditions for months.
e.zh: 士兵们在恶劣的沙漠环境中作战了数月。

hostilities.t: n. 战争行动；敌对行为

e.en: {Hostilities} between the two nations finally ended yesterday.
e.zh: 两国之间的敌对行动昨日终于结束。

e.en: A ceasefire paused {hostilities} along the border.
e.zh: 停火协议暂停了边境的敌对行动。

e.en: She faced open {hostility} from her new coworkers.
e.zh: 她遭到新同事公然的敌意。

e.en: There is growing {hostility} toward the proposed tax law.
e.zh: 人们对拟议的税法越来越反感。

hosting.t:
n. 主机托管
v. 举办；主持

e.en: We're {hosting} a barbecue this Saturday afternoon.
e.zh: 我们这周六下午要办一场烧烤聚会。

e.en: Cloud {hosting} has become much cheaper this year.
e.zh: 今年云主机服务变得便宜多了。

hosts.t:
n. 主人；主机（复数）
v. 主办

e.en: The platform now {hosts} over a million videos.
e.zh: 该平台现已托管超过一百万个视频。

e.en: Our {hosts} prepared a lovely dinner for everyone.
e.zh: 主人为大家准备了一顿美味的晚餐。

e.en: Be careful—the soup is still very {hot}.
e.zh: 小心,这汤还很烫。

e.en: Sustainable fashion is a {hot} topic right now.
e.zh: 可持续时尚是当下的热门话题。

hotbed.t: n. 温床（常指坏事滋生之地）

e.en: Silicon Valley is a {hotbed} of tech innovation.
e.zh: 硅谷是科技创新的温床。

e.en: The forum became a {hotbed} for political debate.
e.zh: 那个论坛成了政治辩论的温床。

e.en: His desk was a {hotchpotch} of papers and cables.
e.zh: 他的桌子上乱七八糟堆满了文件和电线。

e.en: The album is a {hotchpotch} of styles and genres.
e.zh: 这张专辑是各种风格的大杂烩。

e.en: He grabbed a {hotdog} from the street vendor.
e.zh: 他从街头小贩那里买了一根热狗。

e.en: Nothing beats a grilled {hotdog} at a baseball game.
e.zh: 看棒球比赛时没什么比烤热狗更棒了。

e.en: We booked a {hotel} near the conference venue.
e.zh: 我们订了一家会议地点附近的酒店。

e.en: The {hotel} offers free Wi-Fi and breakfast.
e.zh: 这家酒店提供免费的无线网络和早餐。

e.en: The {hotelier} expanded his business to three cities.
e.zh: 这位酒店经营者把生意扩展到了三座城市。

e.en: She became a successful {hotelier} after years of training.
e.zh: 经过多年磨练,她成为了一位成功的酒店经营者。

e.en: Local {hoteliers} are worried about declining tourism.
e.zh: 当地酒店经营者担心旅游业萎缩。

e.en: Many {hoteliers} offer discounts during the off-season.
e.zh: 许多酒店经营者在淡季提供折扣。

e.en: All the {hotels} downtown were fully booked.
e.zh: 市中心所有的酒店都订满了。

e.en: Boutique {hotels} are popular with younger travelers.
e.zh: 精品酒店很受年轻旅客欢迎。

hotfoot.t:
adv. 急忙地
v. 匆忙赶往

e.en: She {hotfoot} it home before the storm hit.
e.zh: 她在暴风雨来临前急忙赶回了家。

e.en: Reporters {hotfoot} to the scene of the accident.
e.zh: 记者们火速赶往事故现场。

e.en: Don't argue with him—he's a real {hothead}.
e.zh: 别跟他争,他可是个急性子。

e.en: The team needs a leader, not another {hothead}.
e.zh: 球队需要的是领袖,而不是又一个暴躁鬼。

e.en: Orchids thrive in the warm, humid {hothouse}.
e.zh: 兰花在温暖潮湿的温室里长势喜人。

e.en: That school is a {hothouse} for elite athletes.
e.zh: 那所学校是培养精英运动员的摇篮。

e.en: Call the customer service {hotline} for immediate help.
e.zh: 请拨打客服热线以获得即时帮助。

e.en: The crisis {hotline} operates twenty-four hours a day.
e.zh: 危机求助热线全天二十四小时运营。

e.en: The proposal was {hotly} debated in parliament.
e.zh: 该提案在议会中遭到激烈辩论。

e.en: This year's election is {hotly} contested in swing states.
e.zh: 今年的选举在摇摆州竞争激烈。

e.en: Adjust the {hotness} of the chili to your taste.
e.zh: 按你的口味调整辣椒的辣度。

e.en: The sauce's {hotness} caught me completely off guard.
e.zh: 这酱料的辣度完全把我惊到了。

e.en: She warmed the soup on a small {hotplate}.
e.zh: 她在一个小电热炉上把汤热了热。

e.en: Most dorm rooms ban using a {hotplate} for cooking.
e.zh: 大多数宿舍禁止使用电热炉做饭。

e.en: He's a {hotshot} lawyer at a Manhattan firm.
e.zh: 他是曼哈顿一家律所的精英律师。

e.en: The startup hired some {hotshot} engineer from Google.
e.zh: 这家初创公司从谷歌挖来了一位顶尖工程师。

e.en: I connected my laptop to my phone's {hotspot}.
e.zh: 我把笔记本连上了手机的热点。

e.en: Bali is a popular {hotspot} for digital nomads.
e.zh: 巴厘岛是数字游民热门的聚集地。

e.en: The young {hotspur} charged into battle without hesitation.
e.zh: 那位年轻的鲁莽小子毫不犹豫地冲入战场。

e.en: Tottenham {Hotspur} won the match in extra time.
e.zh: 托特纳姆热刺队在加时赛中赢得了比赛。

e.en: Everyone agreed the new barista was a {hottie}.
e.zh: 大家都觉得新来的咖啡师是个帅哥。

e.en: She filled a {hottie} to warm her cold feet.
e.zh: 她灌了个热水袋来暖暖冰冷的脚。

e.en: Director John Woo's collaborator was named {Hou} Hsiao-hsien.
e.zh: 导演吴宇森的合作者名叫侯孝贤。

e.en: Mr. {Hou} runs a small bookshop in Taipei.
e.zh: 侯先生在台北经营一家小书店。

e.en: He pulled a {Houdini} and vanished from the meeting.
e.zh: 他玩了一招胡迪尼魔术,从会议中消失了。

e.en: {Houdini} was the most famous escape artist in history.
e.zh: 胡迪尼是史上最著名的逃脱表演大师。

hough.t: n. 膝后腱（旧称，同 hock）

e.en: The butcher trimmed the {hough} for stew.
e.zh: 屠夫把牛后腿肉修整好用来炖汤。

e.en: Image processing uses the {Hough} transform to detect lines.
e.zh: 图像处理使用霍夫变换来检测直线。

e.en: {Houghton} Mifflin published the textbook last spring.
e.zh: 霍顿·米夫林出版社去年春天出版了那本教材。

e.en: We drove through {Houghton} on our way north.
e.zh: 我们北上途中开车经过了霍顿镇。

hound.t:
n. 猎犬
v. 追逼；纠缠

e.en: The {hound} tracked the scent through the woods.
e.zh: 那只猎犬循着气味穿过了树林。

e.en: Reporters {hound} celebrities for any small scandal.
e.zh: 记者们紧追名人不放,只为挖出一点八卦。

hounslow.t: n. 豪恩斯洛（伦敦地区）

e.en: {Hounslow} is a busy borough in west London.
e.zh: 豪恩斯洛是伦敦西部一个繁忙的自治市。

e.en: The flight to Heathrow passed over {Hounslow}.
e.zh: 飞往希思罗的航班经过了豪恩斯洛上空。

e.en: The meeting lasted barely an {hour} this morning.
e.zh: 今天上午的会议勉强开了一个小时。

e.en: I'll meet you in an {hour} at the café.
e.zh: 一小时后我们在咖啡馆见。

e.en: Sand trickled steadily through the antique {hourglass}.
e.zh: 沙子稳定地从古董沙漏中流下。

e.en: The dress flattered her {hourglass} figure beautifully.
e.zh: 那条裙子把她沙漏般的身材衬得很美。

houri.t: n. 天堂仙女；绝色美女

e.en: Ancient poems describe the {houri} as eternally beautiful.
e.zh: 古老的诗篇把天堂仙女描绘得永远美丽。

e.en: The painting depicted a {houri} surrounded by flowers.
e.zh: 那幅画描绘了一位被鲜花环绕的天堂仙女。

hourly.t:
adj. 每小时的
adv. 每小时地

e.en: Buses run {hourly} between the airport and downtown.
e.zh: 机场和市中心之间的巴士每小时一班。

e.en: Freelancers often charge an {hourly} rate.
e.zh: 自由职业者通常按小时收费。

hours.t: n. 小时（复数）；营业时间

e.en: The store's opening {hours} are listed online.
e.zh: 这家店的营业时间在网上有公布。

e.en: I spent {hours} searching for my missing keys.
e.zh: 我花了好几个小时找丢失的钥匙。

house.t:
n. 房屋；家
v. 容纳；安置

e.en: They bought a small {house} in the suburbs.
e.zh: 他们在郊区买了一栋小房子。

e.en: The museum will {house} the collection from next year.
e.zh: 博物馆将从明年起收藏这批藏品。

e.en: They live on a {houseboat} along the canal.
e.zh: 他们住在运河边的一艘船屋里。

e.en: Renting a {houseboat} in Amsterdam was unforgettable.
e.zh: 在阿姆斯特丹租住船屋的经历令人难忘。

housebound.t: adj. 出不了门的；困在家里的

e.en: After surgery, she was {housebound} for three weeks.
e.zh: 手术后,她有三周时间出不了门。

e.en: Volunteers deliver groceries to {housebound} elderly residents.
e.zh: 志愿者为不能出门的老年居民送食品。

e.en: The diplomat employed a {houseboy} during his posting abroad.
e.zh: 那位外交官在驻外期间雇了一名男佣。

e.en: The novel's {houseboy} secretly observes the wealthy family.
e.zh: 小说中的男佣暗中观察着这个富裕家庭。

e.en: Police arrested the {housebreaker} after a long investigation.
e.zh: 警方经过长期调查后逮捕了那名入室盗贼。

e.en: A clever {housebreaker} disabled the alarm system silently.
e.zh: 一个狡猾的入室窃贼悄无声息地关闭了警报系统。

housebroken.t: adj. (宠物) 已学会室内便溺的

e.en: The puppy is fully {housebroken} and ready for adoption.
e.zh: 这只小狗已完全学会定点排便,可以被领养了。

e.en: Training a kitten to be {housebroken} takes patience.
e.zh: 训练小猫养成定点排便的习惯需要耐心。

housebuilder.t: n. 房屋建造者；建筑商

e.en: The country's largest {housebuilder} reported strong annual profits.
e.zh: 该国最大的房屋建筑商公布了强劲的年度利润。

e.en: A local {housebuilder} renovated the entire neighborhood.
e.zh: 一家本地房屋建筑商翻修了整个社区。

e.en: We hired a {housecleaner} to come every Friday.
e.zh: 我们雇了一位家政清洁工每周五来打扫。

e.en: The {housecleaner} polished every surface until it shone.
e.zh: 那位清洁工把每个表面都擦得闪闪发亮。

e.en: Spring {housecleaning} always takes the entire weekend.
e.zh: 春季大扫除总要花掉整个周末。

e.en: The new CEO began some serious {housecleaning} at headquarters.
e.zh: 新任首席执行官开始在总部进行大规模整顿。

e.en: She wore a faded {housecoat} while making morning coffee.
e.zh: 她穿着一件褪色的家居服煮早咖啡。

e.en: Grandma kept a flannel {housecoat} hanging by the door.
e.zh: 奶奶在门边挂着一件法兰绒家居袍。

housed.t: v. 收留；容纳（house 的过去式）

e.en: The museum {housed} a rare collection of Roman coins.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏着一批罕见的罗马硬币。

e.en: The shelter {housed} over fifty families after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后，避难所收容了五十多个家庭。

e.en: She slipped on a cotton {housedress} before answering the door.
e.zh: 她披上一件棉布家居裙才去开门。

e.en: The old photo shows mother in a floral {housedress}.
e.zh: 老照片里母亲穿着一件碎花家居裙。

e.en: A {housefly} kept buzzing around the kitchen window.
e.zh: 一只苍蝇一直在厨房窗户旁嗡嗡飞。

e.en: He swatted the {housefly} with a rolled-up newspaper.
e.zh: 他用卷起的报纸拍死了那只苍蝇。

e.en: We had a {houseful} of relatives over the holidays.
e.zh: 假期里我们家挤满了亲戚。

e.en: She cooked dinner for a {houseful} of hungry kids.
e.zh: 她为满屋饥饿的孩子做了晚饭。

e.en: My cousin will be our {houseguest} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我表弟周末会来我们家做客。

e.en: A polite {houseguest} always offers to help with dishes.
e.zh: 有礼貌的客人总会主动帮忙洗碗。

household.t:
n. 家庭；一家人
adj. 家用的；家喻户晓的

e.en: Most {household} chores are split between the roommates.
e.zh: 大部分家务都由室友们分担。

e.en: Taylor Swift is a {household} name worldwide.
e.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特是全球家喻户晓的名字。

e.en: Each {householder} received a notice about the new tax.
e.zh: 每位户主都收到了新税种的通知。

e.en: The survey targeted every {householder} in the district.
e.zh: 这项调查针对该区每一位户主。

e.en: Streaming services now reach billions of {households} globally.
e.zh: 流媒体服务如今覆盖全球数十亿家庭。

e.en: Many {households} struggle with rising electricity bills.
e.zh: 许多家庭都在为不断上涨的电费发愁。

e.en: The hotel {housekeeper} left fresh towels on the bed.
e.zh: 酒店清洁员在床上放了干净毛巾。

e.en: Their {housekeeper} comes twice a week to tidy up.
e.zh: 他们的家政阿姨每周来打扫两次。

e.en: The hotel hired more {housekeepers} during the busy season.
e.zh: 旺季期间酒店又招聘了更多客房服务员。

e.en: Many {housekeepers} were celebrated at the staff appreciation event.
e.zh: 许多家政人员在员工表彰活动中受到了肯定。

housekeeping.t: n. 家务管理；(酒店)客房清洁

e.en: Please call {housekeeping} for extra pillows and blankets.
e.zh: 请打电话给客房部要额外的枕头和毯子。

e.en: Good database {housekeeping} prevents performance issues later.
e.zh: 良好的数据库维护能避免日后性能问题。

houselights.t: n. 剧场观众席的照明灯

e.en: The {houselights} dimmed and the show finally began.
e.zh: 观众席灯光变暗，演出终于开始了。

e.en: After the curtain call, the {houselights} came back on.
e.zh: 谢幕之后，剧场灯光重新亮起。

e.en: The {housemaid} dusted the bookshelves every Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 女佣每周二早上都会给书架除尘。

e.en: In the novel, the {housemaid} secretly reads her employer's letters.
e.zh: 小说里那位女佣偷看了雇主的信。

houseman.t: n. 住院实习医师；男管家

e.en: The {houseman} greeted every guest at the front door.
e.zh: 那位男仆在大门口迎接每一位客人。

e.en: Each new {houseman} rotates through several hospital departments.
e.zh: 每位实习医师都要在医院多个科室轮转。

e.en: The {housemaster} enforced curfew rules in the boys' dormitory.
e.zh: 舍监严格执行男生宿舍的宵禁规定。

e.en: Our {housemaster} organized a weekend hiking trip for students.
e.zh: 我们舍监为学生组织了一次周末徒步。

e.en: The {housemasters} met weekly to discuss student welfare.
e.zh: 舍监们每周开会讨论学生的福利问题。

e.en: Boarding schools rely on experienced {housemasters} to mentor teens.
e.zh: 寄宿学校依靠经验丰富的舍监来指导青少年。

e.en: My {housemate} always forgets to take out the trash.
e.zh: 我室友总是忘记倒垃圾。

e.en: She found a friendly {housemate} through a Facebook group.
e.zh: 她通过脸书小组找到了一个友善的室友。

e.en: The {housemother} comforted homesick freshmen on their first night.
e.zh: 宿管阿姨安慰着想家的新生度过第一晚。

e.en: Every sorority needs a kind, attentive {housemother}.
e.zh: 每个姐妹会都需要一位贴心细致的宿舍管理员。

e.en: This {houseplant} only needs water once a week.
e.zh: 这种室内植物每周只需浇一次水。

e.en: My favorite {houseplant} died after I moved apartments.
e.zh: 我最爱的那盆室内植物在我搬家后枯死了。

houses.t:
n. 房屋（复数）
v. 容纳（第三人称单数）

e.en: The neighborhood has dozens of charming Victorian {houses}.
e.zh: 那个街区有几十座迷人的维多利亚风格房屋。

e.en: This building {houses} the city's largest art collection.
e.zh: 这栋建筑里珍藏着该市最大规模的艺术品。

e.en: Snow piled high on every {housetop} after the blizzard.
e.zh: 暴风雪过后每个屋顶上都堆满了雪。

e.en: Cats lounged lazily on the warm {housetop} at noon.
e.zh: 猫咪正午时懒洋洋地躺在暖暖的屋顶上。

e.en: We're throwing a {housewarming} party next Saturday night.
e.zh: 我们下周六晚上办乔迁派对。

e.en: She brought a candle as a {housewarming} gift.
e.zh: 她带了一支蜡烛作为乔迁礼物。

e.en: After her promotion, she no longer felt like a {housewife}.
e.zh: 升职之后，她不再觉得自己只是个家庭主妇。

e.en: The reality show follows the lives of a glamorous {housewife}.
e.zh: 这部真人秀讲述了一位光鲜家庭主妇的生活。

e.en: The show portrays wealthy {housewives} living in Beverly Hills.
e.zh: 这部剧描绘了住在比佛利山庄的富裕主妇们。

e.en: Suburban {housewives} formed a weekly book club together.
e.zh: 郊区的主妇们一起组建了每周读书俱乐部。

e.en: He hates doing {housework} after a long workday.
e.zh: 工作一整天后他最讨厌做家务。

e.en: They share {housework} equally between both partners.
e.zh: 他们夫妻俩平均分担家务。

housing.t: n. 住房；住宅；（设备的）外壳

e.en: Affordable {housing} remains a major issue in big cities.
e.zh: 经济适用房仍是大城市的一大难题。

e.en: The aluminum {housing} protects the camera's delicate sensor.
e.zh: 铝制外壳保护着相机精密的传感器。

e.en: The factory produces metal {housings} for industrial motors.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产工业电机用的金属外壳。

e.en: Waterproof {housings} keep cameras safe during dives.
e.zh: 防水外壳能在潜水时保护相机。

houston.t: n. 休斯顿（美国得州城市）

e.en: {Houston}, we have a problem with the launch sequence.
e.zh: 休斯顿，发射程序出问题了。

e.en: Her flight to {Houston} was delayed by thunderstorms.
e.zh: 她飞往休斯顿的航班因雷暴延误了。

hove.t: v. heave 的过去式；(船)停驶

e.en: A massive cargo ship {hove} into view at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分一艘巨型货轮缓缓出现在视野中。

e.en: The lighthouse finally {hove} into sight through the fog.
e.zh: 灯塔终于透过雾气出现在眼前。

e.en: The family lived in a tiny {hovel} near the river.
e.zh: 那家人住在河边一间狭小的破屋里。

e.en: His apartment is such a {hovel} I refuse to visit.
e.zh: 他的公寓简直是个棚屋，我都不愿去。

hover.t:
v. 悬停；(鼠标)悬浮
n. 悬停状态

e.en: {Hover} over the icon to see a tooltip appear.
e.zh: 将鼠标悬停在图标上即可看到提示。

e.en: Hummingbirds can {hover} perfectly still while sipping nectar.
e.zh: 蜂鸟可以一边吸食花蜜一边悬停不动。

e.en: The {hovercraft} glided smoothly across the choppy English Channel.
e.zh: 气垫船在波涛汹涌的英吉利海峡上平稳滑行。

e.en: Tourists boarded a {hovercraft} for a quick island tour.
e.zh: 游客们登上气垫船去做一次短途海岛游。

e.en: A drone {hovered} silently above the crowded festival grounds.
e.zh: 一架无人机静静地悬停在拥挤的节日场地上空。

e.en: She {hovered} her cursor over the suspicious link nervously.
e.zh: 她紧张地把光标悬停在那个可疑链接上。

e.en: A waiter kept {hovering} near our table all evening.
e.zh: 一位服务员整晚都在我们桌边徘徊。

e.en: The bee was {hovering} just above the lavender blossoms.
e.zh: 那只蜜蜂正悬停在薰衣草花朵上方。

hovers.t: v. 悬停（第三人称单数）

e.en: The drone {hovers} steadily even in moderate wind.
e.zh: 即使在中等风力下这架无人机也能稳稳悬停。

e.en: Her finger {hovers} over the send button hesitantly.
e.zh: 她的手指迟疑地停在发送键上方。

e.en: He bought a fresh loaf of {Hovis} from the bakery.
e.zh: 他从面包店买了一条新鲜的Hovis面包。

e.en: The classic {Hovis} advert is iconic in British culture.
e.zh: 那则经典的Hovis广告在英国文化中堪称标志。

e.en: {How} do I reset my password on this app?
e.zh: 我要怎么在这个应用上重置密码？

e.en: She showed me {how} to fold an origami crane.
e.zh: 她教我怎么折一只千纸鹤。

e.en: {Howard} University is a renowned historically Black college.
e.zh: 霍华德大学是一所著名的传统黑人大学。

e.en: My uncle {Howard} just retired after forty years teaching.
e.zh: 我叔叔霍华德教书四十年后刚刚退休。

howdah.t: n. 象背或驼背上的坐轿

e.en: The maharajah rode in a jeweled {howdah} atop his elephant.
e.zh: 大君坐在大象背上装饰着珠宝的象轿里。

e.en: Tourists climbed into a {howdah} for the jungle safari.
e.zh: 游客们爬上象轿去丛林狩猎旅行。

howden.t: n. 豪登（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: The market town of {Howden} sits in East Yorkshire.
e.zh: 豪登这个集镇位于东约克郡。

e.en: They visited the medieval minster at {Howden} last summer.
e.zh: 他们去年夏天参观了豪登的中世纪大教堂。

e.en: {Howdy}, partner—you new around these parts?
e.zh: 嗨，伙计，你是这一带的新人吧？

e.en: He greeted everyone with a cheerful {howdy} and a wave.
e.zh: 他向每个人愉快地打招呼并挥手致意。

e.en: Gordie {Howe} was a legendary figure in professional hockey.
e.zh: 戈迪·豪是职业冰球界的传奇人物。

e.en: Elias {Howe} patented the first practical sewing machine design.
e.zh: 伊莱亚斯·豪为首个实用缝纫机设计申请了专利。

e.en: Mr. {Howell} taught chemistry at our high school for years.
e.zh: 豪厄尔老师在我们高中教了多年化学。

e.en: {Howell} is a quiet town just outside Detroit.
e.zh: 豪厄尔是底特律城外一座安静的小镇。

e.en: The {Howes} family invited us over for Thanksgiving dinner.
e.zh: 豪斯一家邀请我们去吃感恩节晚餐。

e.en: Both {Howes} brothers joined the local fire department.
e.zh: 豪斯兄弟俩都加入了当地的消防队。

e.en: The plan sounds great; {however}, the budget is unrealistic.
e.zh: 这个计划听起来不错，然而预算不太现实。

e.en: You can decorate the room {however} you like.
e.zh: 你可以随心所欲地装饰这个房间。

e.en: We hiked across the rolling {Howgill} Fells last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们徒步穿越了起伏的豪吉尔丘陵。

e.en: The {Howgill} hills offer stunning views of Cumbria.
e.zh: 豪吉尔丘陵能看到坎布里亚郡的壮丽风景。

e.en: The army deployed a {howitzer} along the mountain ridge.
e.zh: 军队在山脊沿线部署了一门榴弹炮。

e.en: A vintage {howitzer} stands at the entrance of the museum.
e.zh: 博物馆门口立着一门老式榴弹炮。

howl.t:
v. 嚎叫；怒号
n. 长嚎

e.en: Wolves {howl} at the moon throughout the long winter nights.
e.zh: 狼在漫长的冬夜里对着月亮嚎叫。

e.en: The wind began to {howl} through the broken window.
e.zh: 风开始从破窗户里呼啸着灌进来。

e.en: Amelia Earhart was heading toward {Howland} Island when she vanished.
e.zh: 阿梅莉亚·埃尔哈特失踪时正飞往豪兰岛。

e.en: {Howland} Island is a tiny uninhabited atoll in the Pacific.
e.zh: 豪兰岛是太平洋上一个无人居住的小环礁。

howler.t: n. 嚎叫的动物；低级错误

e.en: That typo in the headline was a real {howler}.
e.zh: 标题里那个错别字真是个大笑话。

e.en: A {howler} monkey screamed from the tall jungle tree.
e.zh: 一只吼猴在高高的丛林树上嚎叫。

e.en: Professor {Howlett} taught chemistry at the local college.
e.zh: 豪利特教授在当地大学教化学。

e.en: The novel's hero is named James {Howlett}.
e.zh: 这本小说的主角名叫詹姆斯·豪利特。

howling.t:
adj. 呼啸的；极大的
n. 嚎叫声

e.en: The wind was {howling} through the empty streets all night.
e.zh: 狂风整夜在空荡的街道上呼啸。

e.en: His new app is a {howling} success online.
e.zh: 他的新应用在网上获得了巨大成功。

e.en: {Howsoever} difficult the task, she refused to give up.
e.zh: 无论任务多么艰难,她都拒绝放弃。

e.en: The rule applies, {howsoever} you interpret the contract.
e.zh: 无论你如何解读合同,该规则都适用。

hoy.t:
n. 小型单桅帆船
int. 喂

e.en: {Hoy}, watch where you're going with that cart!
e.zh: 喂,推那辆车小心点看路!

e.en: A small {hoy} sailed slowly across the harbor.
e.zh: 一艘小帆船缓缓驶过港口。

e.en: Her grandmother called her a wild {hoyden} for climbing trees.
e.zh: 奶奶因她爬树而叫她野丫头。

e.en: The novel's heroine is a charming young {hoyden}.
e.zh: 小说的女主角是个迷人的假小子。

hoyle.t: n. 霍伊尔（姓氏）；牌戏规则书

e.en: We played the card game strictly according to {Hoyle}.
e.zh: 我们严格按照霍伊尔规则玩这副牌。

e.en: Edmond {Hoyle} wrote the famous guide to card games.
e.zh: 埃德蒙·霍伊尔写了著名的纸牌游戏指南。

e.en: Doctors recommend the {HPV} vaccine for teenagers.
e.zh: 医生建议青少年接种 HPV 疫苗。

e.en: Regular screening can detect {HPV} infections early.
e.zh: 定期筛查可以及早发现 HPV 感染。

e.en: {HRH} the Duchess attended the charity gala last night.
e.zh: 公爵夫人殿下昨晚出席了慈善晚会。

e.en: The invitation was addressed to {HRH} Prince William.
e.zh: 邀请函是寄给威廉王子殿下的。

e.en: Her doctor prescribed {HRT} to ease menopause symptoms.
e.zh: 医生开了激素替代疗法来缓解她的更年期症状。

e.en: Many women weigh the risks before starting {HRT}.
e.zh: 许多女性在开始激素替代疗法前会权衡风险。

e.en: She studied hard for the {HSC} exams all year.
e.zh: 她整年都在为高中毕业考试刻苦学习。

e.en: Top {HSC} scores can secure university scholarships.
e.zh: 高中毕业考的高分能争取到大学奖学金。

e.en: The {HSE} inspector visited the factory after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后,卫生安全局检查员视察了工厂。

e.en: All staff must complete {HSE} training before starting work.
e.zh: 所有员工开工前必须完成健康安全培训。

e.en: The local news aired on {HTV} every weekday evening.
e.zh: 地方新闻每个工作日晚上在 HTV 播出。

e.en: She landed her first acting job at {HTV} studios.
e.zh: 她在 HTV 电视台找到了第一份演员工作。

e.en: Mr. {Hua} runs a small bakery near the station.
e.zh: 华先生在车站附近经营一家小面包店。

e.en: The article quoted economist Li {Hua} on inflation.
e.zh: 这篇文章引用了经济学家李华关于通胀的话。

e.en: Director {Huang} announced the merger at the press conference.
e.zh: 黄董事长在新闻发布会上宣布了合并。

e.en: The {Huang} River floods threatened several villages.
e.zh: 黄河洪水威胁着几个村庄。

e.en: Singapore is a major financial {hub} in Asia.
e.zh: 新加坡是亚洲主要的金融中心。

e.en: Plug the cable into the USB {hub} on the desk.
e.zh: 把线插到桌上的 USB 集线器上。

e.en: Old Mother {Hubbard} went to the cupboard for a bone.
e.zh: 哈伯德老妈妈去碗柜里找骨头。

e.en: L. Ron {Hubbard} founded the Church of Scientology.
e.zh: 罗恩·哈伯德创立了山达基教会。

e.en: The {Hubble} telescope captured stunning images of distant galaxies.
e.zh: 哈勃望远镜拍下了遥远星系的惊人图像。

e.en: Astronomer Edwin {Hubble} discovered the universe is expanding.
e.zh: 天文学家埃德温·哈勃发现宇宙在膨胀。

e.en: There was a sudden {hubbub} when the celebrity arrived.
e.zh: 明星到场时突然一阵喧闹。

e.en: She couldn't think clearly in the market's {hubbub}.
e.zh: 在市场的喧嚣中她无法清晰思考。

e.en: My {hubby} is cooking dinner for us tonight.
e.zh: 我老公今晚给我们做晚饭。

e.en: She posted a sweet photo with her {hubby} online.
e.zh: 她在网上发了一张和老公的甜蜜合照。

e.en: A {hubcap} flew off when the car hit the pothole.
e.zh: 汽车撞到坑洼时一个轮毂盖飞了出去。

e.en: He polished every {hubcap} until it gleamed.
e.zh: 他把每个轮毂盖都擦得发亮。

e.en: His {hubris} led him to ignore all the warning signs.
e.zh: 他的傲慢让他无视所有警示信号。

e.en: The CEO's {hubris} eventually destroyed the once-great company.
e.zh: 那位 CEO 的狂妄最终毁掉了曾经辉煌的公司。

e.en: His {hubristic} speech offended many longtime supporters.
e.zh: 他傲慢的演讲冒犯了许多长期支持者。

e.en: Such {hubristic} predictions rarely age well over time.
e.zh: 如此狂妄的预测通常经不起时间考验。

e.en: {Huck} Finn floated down the Mississippi on a raft.
e.zh: 哈克·芬乘木筏沿密西西比河漂流而下。

e.en: He'll {huck} the bag into the trunk and leave.
e.zh: 他会把包扔进后备箱然后离开。

e.en: We picked wild {huckleberry} bushes on the mountain trail.
e.zh: 我们在山间小路上采摘野生越橘。

e.en: Mom baked a delicious {huckleberry} pie for dessert.
e.zh: 妈妈烤了美味的越橘派当甜点。

huckster.t:
n. 叫卖小贩；广告商
v. 兜售

e.en: That salesman is just a slick {huckster} pushing junk.
e.zh: 那个销售员不过是个推销垃圾的油滑骗子。

e.en: Online {huckster} ads promise easy wealth to viewers.
e.zh: 网上的骗子广告向观众承诺轻松致富。

huddersfield.t: n. 哈德斯菲尔德（英国城市）

e.en: She moved to {Huddersfield} for a teaching job last year.
e.zh: 她去年搬到哈德斯菲尔德教书。

e.en: {Huddersfield} Town drew the match against Leeds yesterday.
e.zh: 哈德斯菲尔德队昨天与利兹队踢成平局。

huddle.t:
v. 挤成一团；聚拢商议
n. 人群

e.en: The team formed a quick {huddle} before the play.
e.zh: 球队在比赛前迅速围成一圈商讨。

e.en: Refugees {huddle} together for warmth in the cold shelter.
e.zh: 难民们在寒冷的避难所里挤在一起取暖。

huddled.t: adj. 蜷缩的；挤作一团的

e.en: The kittens {huddled} against their mother for warmth.
e.zh: 小猫们依偎在妈妈身边取暖。

e.en: Fans {huddled} under umbrellas waiting for the gates to open.
e.zh: 粉丝们挤在伞下等候大门开启。

e.en: The coach calls quick {huddles} between every play.
e.zh: 教练每次进攻间都召开短暂的小组讨论。

e.en: She {huddles} closer to the heater on cold mornings.
e.zh: 寒冷的早晨她会更靠近暖气取暖。

huddling.t: v. 挤作一团（huddle 的现分）

e.en: Penguins survive Antarctic winters by {huddling} tightly together.
e.zh: 企鹅靠紧紧挤在一起熬过南极的寒冬。

e.en: The executives were {huddling} in the corner office.
e.zh: 高管们在角落办公室里聚在一起密谈。

e.en: We took a ferry across the {Hudson} River last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们乘渡轮过了哈德逊河。

e.en: Captain {Hudson} explored the northern coast in 1610.
e.zh: 哈德逊船长于 1610 年探索了北部海岸。

e.en: The sunset cast a soft pink {hue} across the sky.
e.zh: 夕阳给天空染上一层柔和的粉色。

e.en: Designers love this season's earthy {hue} of olive green.
e.zh: 设计师们喜爱本季质朴的橄榄绿色调。

hued.t: adj. 有…色调的（常作复合词）

e.en: She wore a brightly {hued} scarf to the party.
e.zh: 她戴着一条色彩鲜艳的围巾去派对。

e.en: The garden was full of softly {hued} spring flowers.
e.zh: 花园里满是色彩柔和的春花。

huff.t:
v. 气鼓鼓地说
n. 怒气

e.en: She left the meeting in a {huff} after the argument.
e.zh: 她在争吵后气呼呼地离开了会议。

e.en: He paused to {huff} loudly before climbing the next hill.
e.zh: 他停下大声喘气,才继续爬下一个山坡。

e.en: She replied {huffily} when asked about her late arrival.
e.zh: 被问到迟到的事时,她气呼呼地回答。

e.en: He slammed the door {huffily} and refused to talk.
e.zh: 他气恼地摔上门,拒绝再说话。

e.en: He was {huffing} and puffing after climbing six flights.
e.zh: 爬完六层楼后他气喘吁吁。

e.en: She kept {huffing} about the unfair new office rules.
e.zh: 她一直对不公平的新办公室规定愤愤不平。

huffy.t: adj. 动辄生气的，恼怒的

e.en: Don't get {huffy} just because I forgot your birthday.
e.zh: 别因为我忘了你的生日就发脾气。

e.en: He gave a {huffy} reply and walked off quickly.
e.zh: 他没好气地回了一句就快步走开了。

e.en: She gave her son a tight {hug} before school.
e.zh: 她在儿子上学前紧紧拥抱了他。

e.en: The narrow road {hugs} the coastline for several miles.
e.zh: 这条窄路沿着海岸线延伸了好几英里。

e.en: That movie was a {huge} hit on opening weekend.
e.zh: 那部电影在首映周末大获成功。

e.en: They live in a {huge} house outside the city.
e.zh: 他们住在城外一栋巨大的房子里。

e.en: The new restaurant has been {hugely} popular this month.
e.zh: 这家新餐厅这个月非常受欢迎。

e.en: I'm {hugely} grateful for all your help last week.
e.zh: 非常感谢你上周给予的所有帮助。

e.en: The {hugeness} of the canyon left every visitor speechless.
e.zh: 峡谷的巨大让每位游客都目瞪口呆。

e.en: She was overwhelmed by the {hugeness} of the project.
e.zh: 项目的庞大规模让她感到不堪重负。

e.en: The puppy is so soft and {huggable}.
e.zh: 这只小狗又软又让人想抱。

e.en: Kids love that {huggable} teddy bear in the store window.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢橱窗里那只让人想抱抱的泰迪熊。

hugged.t: v. hug 的过去式，拥抱

e.en: She {hugged} her best friend at the airport gate.
e.zh: 她在机场登机口拥抱了她最好的朋友。

e.en: The dress {hugged} her figure perfectly at the gala.
e.zh: 这条裙子在晚会上完美贴合她的身形。

e.en: My grandmother is a real {hugger} who greets everyone warmly.
e.zh: 我奶奶特别爱拥抱,会热情地迎接每个人。

e.en: Tree {hugger} activists protested the planned forest clearing.
e.zh: 环保人士抗议计划中的森林砍伐。

hugging.t: v. 拥抱（hug 的现在分词）

e.en: They were {hugging} tearfully after years apart.
e.zh: 分别多年后,他们含泪相拥。

e.en: The road keeps {hugging} the river for several kilometers.
e.zh: 这条路沿着河流延伸了好几公里。

e.en: Victor {Hugo} wrote Les Misérables in the nineteenth century.
e.zh: 维克多·雨果在十九世纪写下了《悲惨世界》。

e.en: Her novel won the {Hugo} Award for best science fiction.
e.zh: 她的小说获得了雨果奖最佳科幻作品。

hugs.t: n./v. 拥抱（复数/第三人称）

e.en: She sent {hugs} and kisses at the end of her message.
e.zh: 她在消息末尾送上拥抱和亲吻。

e.en: My daughter always {hugs} me before bedtime.
e.zh: 我女儿睡前总会抱抱我。

huguenot.t: n. 胡格诺教徒（法国新教徒）

e.en: Many {Huguenot} families fled France in the seventeenth century.
e.zh: 许多胡格诺派家庭在十七世纪逃离法国。

e.en: The museum displays artifacts from {Huguenot} silk weavers.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了胡格诺派丝绸织工的文物。

huh.t: int. 啊？嗯？（表疑问或惊讶）

e.en: {Huh}, I didn't know the store closed on Sundays.
e.zh: 嗯?我不知道这家店周日不营业。

e.en: Pretty cool concert, {huh}?
e.zh: 演唱会挺棒的,对吧?

e.en: The Maori {hui} brought elders together to discuss tribal matters.
e.zh: 毛利人的集会让长老们聚在一起讨论部落事务。

e.en: We attended a community {hui} to share project updates.
e.zh: 我们参加了一场社区聚会以分享项目进展。

e.en: She learned to dance the {hula} during her trip to Hawaii.
e.zh: 她在夏威夷旅行时学会了跳草裙舞。

e.en: The children spun colorful {hula} hoops around their waists.
e.zh: 孩子们把彩色的呼啦圈绕在腰间转动。

hulk.t: n. 笨重的人或物；废船

e.en: A rusting {hulk} of an old ship sat in the harbor.
e.zh: 港口里停着一艘锈迹斑斑的旧船残骸。

e.en: The wrestler was a massive {hulk} of a man.
e.zh: 那位摔跤手是个魁梧得吓人的大块头。

e.en: A {hulking} security guard stood by the door.
e.zh: 一个魁梧高大的保安站在门旁。

e.en: The {hulking} truck barely fit through the narrow alley.
e.zh: 那辆庞大的卡车勉强挤过狭窄的小巷。

hull.t:
n. 船体；外壳
v. 去壳

e.en: The boat's {hull} was damaged after hitting the rocks.
e.zh: 船体在撞到礁石后受损了。

e.en: You should {hull} the strawberries before adding them to the salad.
e.zh: 加入沙拉前你应该先把草莓的蒂去掉。

e.en: There was a huge {hullabaloo} over the celebrity's new movie.
e.zh: 那位明星的新电影引发了巨大的喧闹议论。

e.en: What's all this {hullabaloo} about a minor software update?
e.zh: 为了一个小小的软件更新有什么好大惊小怪的?

e.en: She {hulled} a basket of strawberries for the dessert.
e.zh: 她为甜点摘掉了一篮草莓的蒂。

e.en: {Hulled} barley cooks faster than the unprocessed grain.
e.zh: 去壳的大麦比未加工的谷物煮得更快。

e.en: "{Hullo}, anyone home?" he called from the doorway.
e.zh: “喂,有人在家吗?”他在门口喊道。

e.en: She gave a cheerful {hullo} as she entered the office.
e.zh: 她走进办公室时愉快地打了声招呼。

e.en: The shipyard repairs damaged {hulls} of cargo vessels.
e.zh: 这家船厂修理货船受损的船体。

e.en: Remove the green {hulls} from the strawberries before serving.
e.zh: 上桌前先把草莓上绿色的蒂去掉。

e.en: {Hulme} is a vibrant inner-city area of Manchester.
e.zh: 休姆是曼彻斯特一个充满活力的市中心区域。

e.en: The poet T. E. {Hulme} influenced early modernist literature.
e.zh: 诗人T·E·休姆影响了早期的现代主义文学。

hum.t:
v. 哼曲子；嗡嗡作响
n. 嗡嗡声

e.en: I could hear the fridge {hum} quietly all night.
e.zh: 我整夜都能听到冰箱在轻轻地嗡嗡作响。

e.en: She started to {hum} her favorite tune in the shower.
e.zh: 她在淋浴时开始哼起最喜欢的曲子。

human.t:
n. 人，人类
adj. 人的

e.en: Everyone makes mistakes — it's only {human}.
e.zh: 每个人都会犯错——这只是人之常情。

e.en: AI still struggles to fully understand {human} emotions.
e.zh: 人工智能仍难以完全理解人类的情感。

e.en: The shelter is known for its {humane} treatment of stray animals.
e.zh: 这家收容所以人道对待流浪动物而闻名。

e.en: We need a more {humane} approach to immigration policy.
e.zh: 我们需要一种更人道的移民政策方式。

e.en: The chickens on this farm are raised {humanely}.
e.zh: 这家农场的鸡是按人道方式饲养的。

e.en: Prisoners must be treated {humanely} under international law.
e.zh: 根据国际法,囚犯必须受到人道对待。

e.en: Her {humaneness} toward refugees won widespread admiration.
e.zh: 她对难民的人道关怀赢得了广泛赞誉。

e.en: The judge praised the officer's {humaneness} during the arrest.
e.zh: 法官称赞了那名警官在逮捕过程中表现出的人性。

humanise.t: v. 使人性化（humanize 英式拼写）

e.en: The documentary tries to {humanise} the people behind the headlines.
e.zh: 这部纪录片试图让新闻头条背后的人物显得更有人情味。

e.en: Good design can {humanise} even the coldest technology.
e.zh: 好的设计能让最冰冷的科技也充满人情味。

e.en: The interview {humanised} the politician in the public's eyes.
e.zh: 那次采访让这位政客在公众眼中显得更有人情味。

e.en: Her novel {humanised} characters often dismissed as villains.
e.zh: 她的小说让那些常被视为反派的角色显得有血有肉。

humanises.t: v. 使人性化（第三人称）

e.en: Sharing personal stories {humanises} a brand on social media.
e.zh: 分享个人故事会让一个品牌在社交媒体上更有人情味。

e.en: The film {humanises} soldiers caught in impossible situations.
e.zh: 这部影片让陷入绝境的士兵显得有血有肉。

humanising.t: v. 使人性化（现在分词）

e.en: The author has a gift for {humanising} historical figures.
e.zh: 这位作者擅长把历史人物刻画得有血有肉。

e.en: Adding small flaws is a {humanising} touch in character design.
e.zh: 添加一些小缺陷是角色设计中让人物更真实的点睛之笔。

humanism.t: n. 人文主义，人本主义

e.en: Renaissance {humanism} placed great value on individual achievement.
e.zh: 文艺复兴时期的人文主义高度重视个人成就。

e.en: His teaching is rooted in secular {humanism}.
e.zh: 他的教学根植于世俗人文主义。

humanist.t:
n. 人文主义者
adj. 人文主义的

e.en: She is a {humanist} who values reason over religious dogma.
e.zh: 她是一位人文主义者,推崇理性而非宗教教条。

e.en: The scholar wrote a {humanist} interpretation of the classics.
e.zh: 那位学者对经典作品做出了人文主义的解读。

e.en: The therapist takes a {humanistic} approach to counseling.
e.zh: 这位治疗师在咨询中采用人本主义方法。

e.en: Her teaching reflects a deeply {humanistic} worldview.
e.zh: 她的教学反映了一种深刻的人本主义世界观。

e.en: Renaissance {humanists} revived interest in ancient Greek texts.
e.zh: 文艺复兴时期的人文主义者重新点燃了对古希腊文献的兴趣。

e.en: Modern {humanists} often advocate for science-based ethics.
e.zh: 现代人文主义者通常倡导以科学为基础的伦理观。

humanitarian.t:
adj. 人道主义的
n. 人道主义者

e.en: The UN launched a {humanitarian} mission to the war zone.
e.zh: 联合国向战区派出了一支人道主义救援队。

e.en: She received an award for her {humanitarian} work in Africa.
e.zh: 她因在非洲的人道主义工作获得了一项奖项。

e.en: His lifelong {humanitarianism} inspired thousands of volunteers.
e.zh: 他毕生的人道主义精神激励了成千上万的志愿者。

e.en: The charity is built on principles of {humanitarianism}.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构建立在人道主义原则之上。

e.en: She's majoring in the {humanities} at university.
e.zh: 她在大学主修人文学科。

e.en: Funding for the {humanities} has declined in recent years.
e.zh: 近年来人文学科的经费有所减少。

e.en: Climate change is one of the biggest threats facing {humanity}.
e.zh: 气候变化是人类面临的最大威胁之一。

e.en: His kindness to strangers shows real {humanity}.
e.zh: 他对陌生人的善意展现出真正的人性。

e.en: The film's {humanization} of refugees moved many viewers.
e.zh: 这部电影对难民的人性化呈现感动了许多观众。

e.en: Brand {humanization} helps companies connect with customers online.
e.zh: 品牌人性化有助于企业在网上与客户建立联系。

humanize.t: v. 使人性化，使更有人情味

e.en: Good storytelling can {humanize} complex political issues.
e.zh: 好的叙事能让复杂的政治议题更具人情味。

e.en: The CEO tries to {humanize} the company through honest blog posts.
e.zh: 这位CEO试图通过坦诚的博客文章让公司更有人情味。

humanized.t: v. 使人性化；使更有人情味

e.en: Her interview {humanized} a man the media had vilified.
e.zh: 她的采访让那个被媒体妖魔化的男人显得有血有肉。

e.en: The chatbot's {humanized} tone makes conversations feel natural.
e.zh: 这款聊天机器人拟人化的语气让对话感觉很自然。

humanizes.t: v. 使人性化（第三人称单数）

e.en: Adding personal anecdotes {humanizes} a public speech.
e.zh: 加入个人轶事会让公开演讲更有人情味。

e.en: The novel {humanizes} villains by exploring their childhoods.
e.zh: 这部小说通过描绘反派的童年使他们显得有血有肉。

humanizing.t: v. 使人性化（现在分词）

e.en: The photographer is known for {humanizing} her subjects.
e.zh: 这位摄影师以拍出有人情味的人物作品而闻名。

e.en: Sharing struggles is a {humanizing} act on social media.
e.zh: 在社交媒体上分享自己的挣扎是一种拉近人与人距离的举动。

e.en: Space exploration has long fascinated {humankind}.
e.zh: 太空探索长期以来令人类着迷。

e.en: The discovery could benefit all of {humankind}.
e.zh: 这一发现可能造福全人类。

humanly.t: adv. 以人力；在人力范围内

e.en: He worked as hard as was {humanly} possible to meet the deadline.
e.zh: 他为赶上截止日期付出了人力所能及的最大努力。

e.en: It's not {humanly} possible to read every email instantly.
e.zh: 瞬间读完每一封邮件并非人力所能做到。

e.en: The robot's awkward laugh added a touch of {humanness}.
e.zh: 那个机器人尴尬的笑声添了几分人味。

e.en: Her writing captures the {humanness} of everyday struggles.
e.zh: 她的作品捕捉到了日常挣扎中的人性。

humanoid.t:
adj. 类人的
n. 类人机器人

e.en: The company unveiled a new {humanoid} robot at the expo.
e.zh: 该公司在博览会上发布了一款新的仿人机器人。

e.en: Sci-fi films often feature {humanoid} aliens.
e.zh: 科幻电影中经常出现类人外星人。

e.en: {Humans} have lived on this island for thousands of years.
e.zh: 人类已经在这座岛上生活了数千年。

e.en: AI assistants are designed to help {humans} work more efficiently.
e.zh: AI助手旨在帮助人类更高效地工作。

e.en: The {Humber} bridge spans one of England's widest estuaries.
e.zh: 亨伯桥横跨英格兰最宽的入海口之一。

e.en: Cargo ships sail up the {Humber} to reach Hull's port.
e.zh: 货船沿亨伯河上行抵达赫尔港。

humberside.t: n. 亨伯赛德郡（英国旧郡）

e.en: She grew up in a small village in {Humberside}.
e.zh: 她在亨伯赛德的一个小村庄长大。

e.en: {Humberside} police launched an investigation into the incident.
e.zh: 亨伯赛德警方对该事件展开了调查。

humble.t:
adj. 谦逊的；卑微的
v. 使谦卑

e.en: Despite his fame, the actor remains remarkably {humble}.
e.zh: 尽管成名,这位演员依然非常谦逊。

e.en: She came from a {humble} background but built a global business.
e.zh: 她出身寒微,却建立起了一家全球性企业。

humbled.t:
v. 使谦卑（过去式）
adj. 感到自愧不如的

e.en: I'm truly {humbled} by all the support from my readers.
e.zh: 读者们的支持让我深感谦卑和感激。

e.en: The champion was {humbled} by an unexpected loss in the finals.
e.zh: 这位冠军在决赛中意外落败,深受打击而变得谦卑。

e.en: His {humbleness} despite great success surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他事业有成却依然谦逊,让所有人都感到惊讶。

e.en: Teachers admired the student's quiet {humbleness}.
e.zh: 老师们都欣赏这名学生那份默默的谦逊。

humbles.t: v. 使谦卑（第三人称单数）

e.en: Watching the night sky truly {humbles} me.
e.zh: 仰望夜空真的让我感到自身的渺小。

e.en: A single defeat often {humbles} even the best players.
e.zh: 哪怕是顶尖选手,一场失利也常会让其变得谦逊。

humbling.t:
adj. 令人谦卑的
v. 使谦卑（现在分词）

e.en: Receiving this award has been a deeply {humbling} experience.
e.zh: 获得这个奖项是一段令我深感谦卑的经历。

e.en: Failure can be a {humbling} but valuable teacher.
e.zh: 失败虽令人受挫,却是宝贵的老师。

e.en: He {humbly} accepted the award and thanked his team.
e.zh: 他谦逊地接过奖项,并向团队表达了谢意。

e.en: I {humbly} ask for your patience as we fix the bug.
e.zh: 在我们修复这个漏洞期间,恳请大家耐心等待。

e.en: The {Humboldt} Current cools the western coast of South America.
e.zh: 洪堡洋流为南美洲西海岸带来凉意。

e.en: Alexander von {Humboldt} was a pioneering naturalist and explorer.
e.zh: 亚历山大·冯·洪堡是一位开创性的博物学家和探险家。

e.en: Scrooge famously dismissed Christmas as "{humbug}!"
e.zh: 斯克鲁奇有句名言,把圣诞节斥为“胡说八道”!

e.en: His promises turned out to be complete {humbug}.
e.zh: 他的承诺到头来完全是骗人的鬼话。

e.en: Grandma kept a tin of striped {humbugs} in the cupboard.
e.zh: 奶奶在橱柜里放着一罐条纹薄荷糖。

e.en: The con artists were exposed as {humbugs} by local journalists.
e.zh: 那些骗子被当地记者揭穿是冒牌货。

humdinger.t: n. 出类拔萃的人或物

e.en: Last night's match was a real {humdinger} from start to finish.
e.zh: 昨晚的比赛从头到尾都精彩绝伦。

e.en: She told a {humdinger} of a joke at dinner.
e.zh: 她在晚餐时讲了一个非常精彩的笑话。

e.en: He quit his {humdrum} office job to travel the world.
e.zh: 他辞去了平淡乏味的办公室工作去环游世界。

e.en: Weekends help me escape the {humdrum} of daily routine.
e.zh: 周末帮我逃离日常生活的单调乏味。

hume.t: n. 休谟（苏格兰哲学家）

e.en: The philosopher David {Hume} questioned the basis of human knowledge.
e.zh: 哲学家大卫·休谟质疑人类知识的根基。

e.en: Students often read {Hume} in introductory philosophy classes.
e.zh: 学生通常在哲学入门课上阅读休谟的著作。

e.en: The misspelling {humen} should be corrected to humans.
e.zh: 拼写错误 humen 应更正为 humans。

e.en: Autocorrect flagged {humen} as an unrecognized word.
e.zh: 自动更正将 humen 标记为无法识别的词。

e.en: She fractured her {humerus} after slipping on the ice.
e.zh: 她在冰上滑倒后摔断了肱骨。

e.en: The {humerus} connects the shoulder to the elbow joint.
e.zh: 肱骨连接肩膀与肘关节。

e.en: Healthy soil contains plenty of {humic} acid for plant roots.
e.zh: 健康的土壤含有大量供植物根部吸收的腐植酸。

e.en: Farmers add compost to boost the {humic} content of the soil.
e.zh: 农民添加堆肥以提高土壤的腐殖质含量。

e.en: Singapore is famously hot and {humid} year-round.
e.zh: 新加坡以全年炎热潮湿而闻名。

e.en: My hair frizzes whenever the weather turns {humid}.
e.zh: 天气一潮湿,我的头发就会变得毛躁。

e.en: I run a {humidifier} in my bedroom during winter.
e.zh: 冬天我会在卧室开加湿器。

e.en: The {humidifier} helps soothe my dry throat at night.
e.zh: 加湿器有助于缓解我夜间的喉咙干燥。

e.en: This device can {humidify} a small office in minutes.
e.zh: 这台设备能在几分钟内为小办公室加湿。

e.en: Plants help {humidify} the air in dry apartments.
e.zh: 植物有助于让干燥公寓里的空气变得湿润。

e.en: The {humidity} in Hong Kong can feel suffocating in summer.
e.zh: 香港夏季的湿度让人感到几乎窒息。

e.en: High {humidity} makes ninety degrees feel like a hundred.
e.zh: 高湿度让九十度的气温感觉像一百度。

e.en: He keeps his cigars in a cedar-lined {humidor}.
e.zh: 他把雪茄存放在雪松木衬里的雪茄盒中。

e.en: A good {humidor} maintains steady moisture for premium cigars.
e.zh: 好的雪茄盒能为高档雪茄保持稳定的湿度。

e.en: Don't {humiliate} your coworker in front of the whole team.
e.zh: 不要在整个团队面前羞辱你的同事。

e.en: Critics tried to {humiliate} the senator on live television.
e.zh: 评论人士试图在直播中羞辱这位参议员。

humiliated.t:
adj. 感到羞辱的
v. 羞辱（过去式）

e.en: She felt {humiliated} after tripping on stage at graduation.
e.zh: 毕业典礼上在舞台上绊倒后,她感到无地自容。

e.en: The losing team was {humiliated} by a ten-goal margin.
e.zh: 输球的一方以十球的差距被羞辱。

humiliates.t: v. 羞辱（第三人称单数）

e.en: Nothing {humiliates} a professional athlete more than rookie mistakes.
e.zh: 没什么比新手级失误更让职业运动员蒙羞的了。

e.en: The boss publicly {humiliates} anyone who arrives late.
e.zh: 老板会当众羞辱任何迟到的人。

e.en: Losing my keys at the airport was {humiliating}.
e.zh: 在机场弄丢钥匙真是丢脸极了。

e.en: The team suffered a {humiliating} defeat in the final.
e.zh: 球队在决赛中遭遇了一场颜面尽失的失利。

e.en: The startup failed {humiliatingly} on its first demo day.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在首次路演日上颜面尽失地失败了。

e.en: He was {humiliatingly} dismissed from the meeting by his boss.
e.zh: 他被老板当众难堪地赶出了会议。

e.en: The viral tweet caused him lasting {humiliation} online.
e.zh: 那条疯传的推文给他带来了长久的网络羞辱。

e.en: Public {humiliation} is a real risk of livestreaming.
e.zh: 当众出丑是直播带来的真实风险。

e.en: She survived endless {humiliations} during her first year of medical school.
e.zh: 医学院第一年里她熬过了无数次羞辱。

e.en: The diary recorded the small {humiliations} of office life.
e.zh: 日记记下了职场生活中的种种小屈辱。

e.en: True leaders show {humility} when accepting credit for success.
e.zh: 真正的领导者在接受成功的赞誉时会保持谦逊。

e.en: She accepted the award with grace and {humility}.
e.zh: 她以优雅和谦逊接受了这个奖项。

hummer.t:
n. 悍马（汽车品牌）
n. 蜂鸟；哼唱者

e.en: A neighbor parks his black {Hummer} in our driveway.
e.zh: 一位邻居把他的黑色悍马车停在我们的车道上。

e.en: My grandmother is a constant {hummer} while she cooks.
e.zh: 我奶奶做饭时总是不停地哼着小曲。

humming.t:
n. 嗡嗡声；哼唱
adj. 活跃的

e.en: She kept {humming} her favorite song all afternoon.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在哼着自己最爱的歌。

e.en: The refrigerator started {humming} loudly last night.
e.zh: 冰箱昨晚开始嗡嗡作响。

e.en: A tiny {hummingbird} hovered near the red flowers.
e.zh: 一只小小的蜂鸟悬停在红花旁。

e.en: We hung a feeder to attract every {hummingbird} in the garden.
e.zh: 我们挂了喂食器,吸引花园里的每一只蜂鸟。

e.en: We rested on a grassy {hummock} overlooking the lake.
e.zh: 我们在一片可以俯瞰湖面的草丘上休息。

e.en: The trail wound around every mossy {hummock} in the bog.
e.zh: 小径绕过沼泽中每一个长满苔藓的小丘。

hummus.t: n. 鹰嘴豆泥（中东蘸酱）

e.en: I love dipping warm pita into homemade {hummus}.
e.zh: 我喜欢把热乎乎的皮塔饼蘸自制的鹰嘴豆泥。

e.en: This restaurant serves the creamiest {hummus} in town.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应全城最绵滑的鹰嘴豆泥。

e.en: They served us a {humongous} bowl of ramen.
e.zh: 他们端给我们一大碗超大份的拉面。

e.en: My nephew built a {humongous} Lego castle in the living room.
e.zh: 我侄子在客厅搭了一座超大的乐高城堡。

humor.t:
n. 幽默；诙谐
v. 迁就

e.en: His dry {humor} keeps the whole team laughing through long meetings.
e.zh: 他冷面式的幽默让整个团队在漫长的会议中都笑个不停。

e.en: Just {humor} her for now and agree to the plan.
e.zh: 先迁就她一下,同意这个计划吧。

e.en: The vaccine triggers a strong {humoral} immune response.
e.zh: 这种疫苗会引发强烈的体液免疫反应。

e.en: Ancient doctors believed in a {humoral} theory of disease.
e.zh: 古代医生信奉一种关于疾病的体液学说。

humorist.t: n. 幽默作家；诙谐的人

e.en: Mark Twain remains America's most beloved {humorist}.
e.zh: 马克·吐温至今仍是美国最受爱戴的幽默作家。

e.en: The newspaper hired a young {humorist} to write a weekly column.
e.zh: 报社聘请了一位年轻的幽默作家撰写每周专栏。

e.en: Our new manager is competent but completely {humorless}.
e.zh: 我们的新经理能力很强,但完全没有幽默感。

e.en: The film received a {humorless} review from every critic.
e.zh: 这部电影收到了每位评论家毫无幽默感的严苛评论。

humorlessly.t: adv. 一本正经地；无幽默感地

e.en: He stared {humorlessly} at the prankster across the room.
e.zh: 他面无表情地盯着房间另一头的恶作剧者。

e.en: The judge {humorlessly} dismissed the lawyer's joke.
e.zh: 法官板着脸驳回了律师那番玩笑话。

e.en: She wrote a {humorous} essay about commuting in Tokyo.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于在东京通勤的幽默文章。

e.en: The CEO opened the keynote with a {humorous} anecdote.
e.zh: 首席执行官以一则幽默的轶事开启了主题演讲。

e.en: He {humorously} described his disastrous first date.
e.zh: 他幽默地讲述了自己那场糟糕透顶的初次约会。

e.en: The author {humorously} compares cats to office managers.
e.zh: 作者幽默地把猫比作办公室经理。

humour.t:
n. 幽默；情绪
v. 迁就

e.en: British {humour} often relies on irony and understatement.
e.zh: 英式幽默常常依赖反讽与含蓄。

e.en: Try to {humour} your boss until the project is finished.
e.zh: 项目完成之前,先迁就一下你的老板。

humoured.t: v. 迁就；顺从（humour 的过去式）

e.en: She {humoured} the toddler by pretending to drink imaginary tea.
e.zh: 她迁就那个小孩,假装喝着想象中的茶。

e.en: He's always been a good-{humoured} colleague to work with.
e.zh: 他一直是个性情和善、好相处的同事。

humourless.t: adj. 没有幽默感的；一本正经的

e.en: The interviewer was so {humourless} that no one cracked a smile.
e.zh: 那位采访者毫无幽默感,没人能笑出来。

e.en: His {humourless} reply made the awkward silence even longer.
e.zh: 他那毫无幽默感的回答让尴尬的沉默更加漫长。

humourous.t: adj. 幽默的（humorous 的拼写变体）

e.en: Her blog is full of {humourous} stories about parenting twins.
e.zh: 她的博客里满是养双胞胎的幽默故事。

e.en: The advert took a {humourous} approach to selling insurance.
e.zh: 那则广告用幽默的方式来推销保险。

hump.t:
n. 驼峰；隆起
v. 弓起

e.en: Wednesday is often called {hump} day at the office.
e.zh: 在办公室里,星期三常被称作过半的“小山头”那天。

e.en: The camel's {hump} stores fat, not water.
e.zh: 骆驼的驼峰储存的是脂肪,而不是水。

e.en: We watched a {humpback} whale breach beside the boat.
e.zh: 我们看到一头座头鲸在船边跃出水面。

e.en: The {humpback} migrates thousands of miles each year.
e.zh: 座头鲸每年迁徙数千英里。

e.en: An old {humpbacked} bridge crosses the village stream.
e.zh: 一座古老的拱背桥横跨着村里的小溪。

e.en: The {humpbacked} cat arched even higher when startled.
e.zh: 那只弓背的猫受惊时把背拱得更高了。

e.en: He {humped} the heavy suitcase up four flights of stairs.
e.zh: 他扛着沉重的行李箱爬上了四层楼梯。

e.en: A {humped} road sign warned drivers about the speed bumps.
e.zh: 一块拱形路面标志提醒司机注意减速带。

humph.t: int. 哼（表示怀疑或不满）

e.en: "{Humph}!" she muttered, unconvinced by his excuse.
e.zh: “哼!”她嘟囔道,根本不相信他的借口。

e.en: He let out a quiet {humph} when his idea was rejected.
e.zh: 他的想法被否决时,他低低地哼了一声。

e.en: The children sang about {Humpty} Dumpty falling off the wall.
e.zh: 孩子们唱着 Humpty Dumpty 从墙上摔下来的儿歌。

e.en: She painted a cheerful {Humpty} on the nursery door.
e.zh: 她在婴儿房的门上画了一个快乐的 Humpty 形象。

e.en: Rich {humus} makes vegetables grow faster in the garden.
e.zh: 肥沃的腐殖质能让花园里的蔬菜长得更快。

e.en: Earthworms turn fallen leaves into dark, fertile {humus}.
e.zh: 蚯蚓把落叶转化为深色而肥沃的腐殖土。

humvee.t: n. 悍马军车（美军越野车）

e.en: A military {Humvee} blocked the entrance to the base.
e.zh: 一辆军用悍马挡住了基地的入口。

e.en: He drives a civilian {Humvee} just for weekend camping trips.
e.zh: 他开着一辆民用悍马,只为了周末露营之用。

hun.t:
n. 亲爱的（honey 的昵称）
n. 匈奴人

e.en: "Thanks, {hun}," she said, sliding the coffee across the counter.
e.zh: “谢啦,亲爱的,”她说着把咖啡顺着柜台推了过来。

e.en: Attila the {Hun} terrified the late Roman Empire.
e.zh: 匈奴王阿提拉令罗马帝国晚期闻风丧胆。

hunch.t:
n. 预感；直觉
v. 弓起（背）

e.en: I have a {hunch} that the project will be delayed.
e.zh: 我有种预感,这个项目会被推迟。

e.en: Don't {hunch} over your laptop or your back will hurt.
e.zh: 别弓着背趴在笔记本电脑上,不然会腰背酸痛。

e.en: Disney's adaptation of "The {Hunchback} of Notre Dame" remains popular.
e.zh: 迪士尼改编的《巴黎圣母院》(《钟楼怪人》)至今仍很受欢迎。

e.en: Years of poor posture left him with a slight {hunchback}.
e.zh: 多年姿势不良让他的背微微驼了起来。

e.en: A {hunchbacked} old man tended the lighthouse for decades.
e.zh: 一位驼背的老人看守灯塔几十年。

e.en: The {hunchbacked} silhouette appeared in countless gothic novels.
e.zh: 那个驼背的身影出现在无数哥特小说里。

e.en: He sat {hunched} over his keyboard for twelve hours straight.
e.zh: 他弓着身子在键盘前连续坐了十二个小时。

e.en: She {hunched} her shoulders against the freezing wind.
e.zh: 她耸起肩膀抵御刺骨的寒风。

hundred.t:
num. 一百
n. 许多

e.en: More than a {hundred} people showed up to the protest.
e.zh: 超过一百人参加了这场抗议活动。

e.en: This vintage guitar is worth several {hundred} dollars.
e.zh: 这把复古吉他价值好几百美元。

e.en: Cloud computing increased our processing power a {hundredfold}.
e.zh: 云计算让我们的处理能力提升了一百倍。

e.en: Her audience grew {hundredfold} after the video went viral.
e.zh: 视频走红后,她的观众增长了一百倍。

e.en: This is the {hundredth} time I've reminded him to log out.
e.zh: 这是我第一百次提醒他要退出登录。

e.en: The school celebrated its {hundredth} anniversary with a parade.
e.zh: 学校举行游行庆祝建校一百周年。

hundredths.t: n. 百分之几（hundredth 的复数）

e.en: She measured the part to the {hundredths} of a millimeter.
e.zh: 她将零件精确测量到百分之一毫米。

e.en: The stopwatch displays {hundredths} of a second clearly.
e.zh: 秒表清晰地显示百分之一秒的读数。

hundredweight.t: n. 英担（约50公斤的重量单位）

e.en: The farmer ordered a {hundredweight} of feed for the cattle.
e.zh: 农夫订了一英担饲料喂牛。

e.en: Each sack weighs roughly one {hundredweight} when full.
e.zh: 每个麻袋装满后约重一英担。

hung.t:
v. 悬挂（hang 的过去式）
adj. 僵持的

e.en: She {hung} the painting above the fireplace yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天把那幅画挂在了壁炉上方。

e.en: My phone {hung} for a minute before rebooting.
e.zh: 我的手机卡了一分钟才重启。

hungarian.t:
adj. 匈牙利的
n. 匈牙利人/语

e.en: He ordered a bowl of spicy {Hungarian} goulash.
e.zh: 他点了一碗辛辣的匈牙利炖牛肉。

e.en: She is learning {Hungarian} to visit her grandparents.
e.zh: 她正在学匈牙利语,以便去看望祖父母。

e.en: We spent a week exploring castles in {Hungary} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们花了一周时间在匈牙利游览城堡。

e.en: {Hungary} is famous for its thermal baths and paprika.
e.zh: 匈牙利以温泉浴场和红椒粉闻名。

hunger.t:
n. 饥饿；渴望
v. 渴求

e.en: Many charities work to fight world {hunger}.
e.zh: 许多慈善机构致力于消除世界饥饿。

e.en: She had a real {hunger} for adventure and travel.
e.zh: 她对冒险和旅行有着强烈的渴望。

hungerford.t: n. 亨格福德（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: We took a slow train to {Hungerford} for the antique fair.
e.zh: 我们坐慢车去亨格福德参加古董集市。

e.en: The bridge at {Hungerford} offers stunning views of the Thames.
e.zh: 亨格福德的桥上能看到泰晤士河的绝美景色。

hungover.t: adj. 宿醉的；醉后不适的

e.en: He felt completely {hungover} after the wedding party.
e.zh: 婚礼派对之后他宿醉得难受。

e.en: She looked {hungover} during the morning meeting.
e.zh: 她在早会上看起来一脸宿醉的样子。

e.en: The puppy ate his dinner {hungrily} in seconds.
e.zh: 小狗几秒钟就狼吞虎咽地吃完了晚饭。

e.en: She stared {hungrily} at the bakery window display.
e.zh: 她饥渴地盯着面包店橱窗里的展品。

e.en: I'm so {hungry} I could eat an entire pizza.
e.zh: 我饿得能吃下一整个披萨。

e.en: The startup is {hungry} for new engineering talent.
e.zh: 这家初创公司求贤若渴,急需工程人才。

e.en: He tore off a {hunk} of bread and dipped it in soup.
e.zh: 他撕下一大块面包蘸着汤吃。

e.en: The reviewer flagged a problematic {hunk} in the diff.
e.zh: 评审员标记了 diff 中有问题的一段代码。

e.en: We need to {hunker} down and finish the report tonight.
e.zh: 我们今晚得埋头苦干把报告写完。

e.en: Residents {hunker} indoors as the storm approaches.
e.zh: 风暴逼近时居民们躲在室内不出门。

e.en: The lifeguard was tall, tanned, and {hunky}.
e.zh: 那位救生员个子高、皮肤黝黑、身材健美。

e.en: After the update, everything is {hunky}-dory again.
e.zh: 更新之后,一切又恢复正常了。

hunt.t:
v. 打猎；搜寻
n. 追捕

e.en: I need to {hunt} for a new apartment this weekend.
e.zh: 这个周末我得找一套新公寓。

e.en: The treasure {hunt} kept the kids busy all afternoon.
e.zh: 寻宝游戏让孩子们玩了一下午。

e.en: She {hunted} through her bag for the missing keys.
e.zh: 她在包里翻找丢失的钥匙。

e.en: The fugitive looked {hunted} and exhausted.
e.zh: 那名逃犯神色慌张,疲惫不堪。

e.en: The {hunter} tracked the deer through fresh snow.
e.zh: 猎人沿着新雪中的足迹追踪鹿群。

e.en: She is a real bargain {hunter} during Black Friday.
e.zh: 黑五期间她是个真正的折扣猎手。

e.en: Bounty {hunters} captured the suspect near the border.
e.zh: 赏金猎人在边境附近抓获了嫌犯。

e.en: Job {hunters} flooded the career fair this morning.
e.zh: 今早求职者们涌入了招聘会。

e.en: He's been {hunting} for a remote job for months.
e.zh: 他找远程工作已经找了好几个月。

e.en: Deer {hunting} season opens next Saturday.
e.zh: 猎鹿季将于下周六开始。

e.en: The train to {Huntingdon} departs every half hour.
e.zh: 开往亨廷登的火车每半小时一班。

e.en: Oliver Cromwell was born in {Huntingdon} in 1599.
e.zh: 奥利弗·克伦威尔于1599年生于亨廷登。

huntingdonshire.t: n. 亨廷顿郡（英格兰旧郡）

e.en: {Huntingdonshire} is a historic district in eastern England.
e.zh: 亨廷登郡是英格兰东部的一个历史区。

e.en: They moved to a quiet village in {Huntingdonshire}.
e.zh: 他们搬到了亨廷登郡的一个宁静村庄。

huntings.t: n. 狩猎（hunting 的复数，罕用）

e.en: Several seasonal {huntings} were canceled due to floods.
e.zh: 几次季节性狩猎因洪水而被取消。

e.en: His memoir describes the great {huntings} of his youth.
e.zh: 他的回忆录描述了年轻时的几次大狩猎。

e.en: She visited the {Huntington} Library on her LA trip.
e.zh: 她洛杉矶之行参观了亨廷顿图书馆。

e.en: {Huntington} disease affects movement and cognition.
e.zh: 亨廷顿舞蹈症会影响运动和认知能力。

e.en: The ruined castle at {Huntly} draws many tourists.
e.zh: 亨特利的城堡遗迹吸引了许多游客。

e.en: We stopped in {Huntly} on our way through Scotland.
e.zh: 我们穿越苏格兰时在亨特利停留了一下。

e.en: The myth describes a swift {huntress} guarding the forest.
e.zh: 神话中描述了一位守护森林的迅捷女猎手。

e.en: She played a fierce {huntress} in the new fantasy series.
e.zh: 她在新奇幻剧集中饰演一位凶悍的女猎人。

hunts.t:
v. 狩猎、搜寻（hunt 的第三人称单数）
n. 狩猎活动（复数）

e.en: My cat {hunts} bugs in the garden every evening.
e.zh: 我家猫每晚都在花园里捉虫子。

e.en: The recruiter {hunts} for senior engineers across Europe.
e.zh: 那位招聘人员在欧洲各地物色资深工程师。

e.en: The {huntsman} blew his horn to call the hounds.
e.zh: 猎人吹响号角召唤猎犬。

e.en: A large {huntsman} spider startled her in the bathroom.
e.zh: 浴室里一只大猎人蛛吓了她一跳。

e.en: The film Ben-{Hur} won eleven Academy Awards.
e.zh: 电影《宾虚》赢得了十一项奥斯卡奖。

e.en: He recited a line from Ben-{Hur} from memory.
e.zh: 他凭记忆背诵了《宾虚》中的一句台词。

hurdle.t:
n. 障碍；难关
v. 跨栏；克服

e.en: Funding is the biggest {hurdle} for new founders.
e.zh: 融资是新创始人面临的最大障碍。

e.en: She cleared the final {hurdle} and won the race.
e.zh: 她跨过最后一道栏,赢得了比赛。

e.en: The young {hurdler} broke the national record.
e.zh: 那位年轻的跨栏运动员打破了全国纪录。

e.en: Every {hurdler} on the team trained twice a day.
e.zh: 队里的每位跨栏选手每天训练两次。

e.en: Don't {hurl} insults at the referee from the stands.
e.zh: 不要从看台上向裁判咒骂叫骂。

e.en: The pitcher can {hurl} a fastball at ninety miles per hour.
e.zh: 这位投手能投出每小时九十英里的快球。

e.en: The young {hurler} struck out twelve batters tonight.
e.zh: 这位年轻投手今晚三振了十二名打者。

e.en: Every {hurler} on the Irish team practiced for hours.
e.zh: 爱尔兰队的每位投球手都练习了好几个小时。

hurley.t: n. 赫尔利（姓氏）；爱尔兰曲棍球棍

e.en: He swung the {hurley} and scored a brilliant goal.
e.zh: 他挥动板棍,打进了一记精彩的进球。

e.en: Each player carries a wooden {hurley} on the field.
e.zh: 每位球员都在场上携带一根木制板棍。

e.en: The {Hurlingham} Club hosts polo matches every summer.
e.zh: 赫林厄姆俱乐部每年夏天举办马球比赛。

e.en: They had afternoon tea at the {Hurlingham} pavilion.
e.zh: 他们在赫林厄姆的亭子里享用了下午茶。

huron.t: n. 休伦（湖/印第安部族）

e.en: Lake {Huron} freezes partially during cold winters.
e.zh: 休伦湖在寒冬时会部分结冰。

e.en: We sailed across Lake {Huron} on a calm afternoon.
e.zh: 我们在一个平静的下午横渡了休伦湖。

e.en: The crowd shouted {hurrah} as the team scored.
e.zh: 球队进球时观众齐声欢呼。

e.en: This concert is her last {hurrah} before retirement.
e.zh: 这场音乐会是她退休前的告别演出。

e.en: {Hurray}, our flight finally arrived on time!
e.zh: 太棒了,我们的航班终于准时到达了!

e.en: The kids shouted {hurray} when school was canceled.
e.zh: 得知停课后,孩子们欢呼雀跃。

e.en: The {hurricane} knocked out power across the island.
e.zh: 飓风导致全岛断电。

e.en: She works like a {hurricane} when deadlines approach.
e.zh: 截止日期临近时她干起活来像一阵旋风。

e.en: Coastal towns brace for stronger {hurricanes} every year.
e.zh: 沿海城镇每年都要应对越来越强的飓风。

e.en: Climate change is making Atlantic {hurricanes} more intense.
e.zh: 气候变化正使大西洋飓风变得更加猛烈。

hurried.t:
adj. 匆忙的；仓促的
v. 赶紧（hurry 的过去式）

e.en: She {hurried} to catch the last train home.
e.zh: 她匆忙赶上了回家的末班车。

e.en: He gave a {hurried} apology before leaving the room.
e.zh: 他匆匆道了个歉就离开了房间。

e.en: He {hurriedly} packed his laptop and ran for the taxi.
e.zh: 他匆忙收起笔记本,跑去赶出租车。

e.en: She {hurriedly} typed a reply during the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会议中匆匆敲出了一条回复。

hurries.t: v. 赶忙；催促（hurry 的第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {hurries} through breakfast to beat the traffic.
e.zh: 他总是匆匆吃完早餐以避开交通高峰。

e.en: Mom {hurries} the kids out the door each morning.
e.zh: 妈妈每天早上催促孩子们出门。

hurry.t:
v. 赶紧；催促
n. 匆忙

e.en: Please {hurry}, the movie starts in five minutes.
e.zh: 快点,电影五分钟后就开始了。

e.en: There's no {hurry} to finish the project this week.
e.zh: 这周不必急着完成这个项目。

e.en: Commuters were {hurrying} across the platform to the train.
e.zh: 通勤者们匆匆穿过站台赶往列车。

e.en: She apologized for {hurrying} him during the call.
e.zh: 她为通话中催促他而道歉。

e.en: They bought a cottage near {Hurst} village last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天他们在赫斯特村附近买了一间小屋。

e.en: Director Sam {Hurst} announced his next project today.
e.zh: 导演山姆·赫斯特今天公布了他的下一个项目。

hurt.t:
v. 伤害；使疼痛
adj. 受伤的

e.en: My back still {hurts} after sitting all day.
e.zh: 坐了一整天,我的背还在痛。

e.en: His harsh comments really {hurt} her feelings.
e.zh: 他刻薄的话真的伤害了她的感情。

e.en: His {hurtful} remarks ruined the whole evening.
e.zh: 他那些伤人的话毁了整个晚上。

e.en: Please avoid {hurtful} language in the comment section.
e.zh: 请在评论区避免使用伤人的言语。

e.en: My knees are {hurting} after that long hike.
e.zh: 长途徒步之后我的膝盖很痛。

e.en: The new tariffs are {hurting} small businesses badly.
e.zh: 新关税正严重打击小企业。

e.en: Skiers {hurtle} down the slope at terrifying speeds.
e.zh: 滑雪者以惊人的速度俯冲下山。

e.en: Meteors {hurtle} through space and sometimes hit Earth.
e.zh: 流星在太空中飞驰,有时会撞上地球。

e.en: A truck came {hurtling} around the corner without warning.
e.zh: 一辆卡车毫无预警地从拐角飞驰而出。

e.en: The economy is {hurtling} toward another recession.
e.zh: 经济正快速滑向又一次衰退。

hurts.t: v. 疼痛；伤害（第三人称单数）

e.en: It really {hurts} when a close friend lies to you.
e.zh: 亲密朋友对你说谎真的很伤人。

e.en: My ankle {hurts} every time I climb the stairs.
e.zh: 我每次上楼脚踝都会疼。

husband.t:
n. 丈夫
v. 节俭使用

e.en: Her {husband} cooks dinner every Friday night.
e.zh: 她丈夫每周五晚上都做晚饭。

e.en: They {husband} their savings for a future home.
e.zh: 他们节俭地存钱，为将来买房做准备。

e.en: The old {husbandman} tended his fields from dawn till dusk.
e.zh: 那位年迈的农夫从早到晚耕作田地。

e.en: A skilled {husbandman} knows when to plant each crop.
e.zh: 熟练的农人懂得每种作物的播种时节。

e.en: Animal {husbandry} requires patience and careful planning.
e.zh: 畜牧业需要耐心和细致的规划。

e.en: Good {husbandry} of resources keeps the farm profitable.
e.zh: 妥善管理资源使农场保持盈利。

e.en: Both {husbands} attended the school's parent meeting.
e.zh: 两位丈夫都参加了学校的家长会。

e.en: She {husbands} her energy for the long workday ahead.
e.zh: 她为漫长的工作日节省体力。

hush.t:
int. 嘘；别出声
v. 使安静

e.en: A sudden {hush} fell over the crowd.
e.zh: 人群中突然安静下来。

e.en: Please {hush} the baby is sleeping.
e.zh: 请安静，宝宝在睡觉。

hushed.t: adj. 寂静的；压低声音的

e.en: They spoke in {hushed} tones at the library.
e.zh: 他们在图书馆里压低声音说话。

e.en: The teacher {hushed} the noisy classroom instantly.
e.zh: 老师立刻让吵闹的教室安静下来。

hushes.t: v. 使安静（第三人称单数）

e.en: The lullaby always {hushes} the crying baby.
e.zh: 那首摇篮曲总能让哭泣的宝宝安静下来。

e.en: A gentle breeze {hushes} the rustling leaves at dusk.
e.zh: 傍晚的微风让沙沙作响的树叶归于宁静。

e.en: She kept {hushing} the dog during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时她不停地让狗安静下来。

e.en: The {hushing} sound of waves helped me fall asleep.
e.zh: 海浪轻柔的声响伴我入眠。

husk.t:
n. (谷物、果实的) 外壳
v. 去壳

e.en: Remove the green {husk} before cooking the corn.
e.zh: 煮玉米前先剥掉绿色的外皮。

e.en: After the illness he was just a {husk} of his former self.
e.zh: 病后他只剩下昔日的空壳。

e.en: She sang {huskily} into the late-night microphone.
e.zh: 她对着深夜的麦克风沙哑地唱着。

e.en: He whispered {huskily} after hours of cheering.
e.zh: 欢呼几个小时后他声音沙哑地低语。

husky.t:
n. 哈士奇犬
adj. 声音沙哑的；魁梧的

e.en: His voice turned {husky} after the long speech.
e.zh: 长篇演讲后他的嗓音变得沙哑。

e.en: The {husky} pulled the sled across the snow.
e.zh: 那只哈士奇拉着雪橇穿越雪地。

e.en: The {hussar} rode proudly at the head of the parade.
e.zh: 那名骠骑兵神气地走在游行队伍前列。

e.en: Old paintings often depict the {hussar} in colorful uniforms.
e.zh: 古画中常描绘身着鲜艳军装的骠骑兵。

e.en: The novel's villain calls the heroine a {hussy}.
e.zh: 小说中的反派称女主角为轻浮女子。

e.en: She laughed off being labeled a {hussy} by the gossips.
e.zh: 被流言称为荡妇，她一笑置之。

hustle.t:
v. 奔忙；催促；推搡
n. 忙碌；副业打拼

e.en: He runs a side {hustle} selling handmade candles online.
e.zh: 他做副业，在网上卖手工蜡烛。

e.en: You need to {hustle} if you want to catch the train.
e.zh: 想赶上火车你得加快脚步。

e.en: She's a real {hustler} who turned her blog into a business.
e.zh: 她真是个能干人，把博客做成了生意。

e.en: The street {hustler} convinced tourists to buy fake watches.
e.zh: 街头骗子哄骗游客买假手表。

hustling.t:
v. 奔忙；努力赚钱
n. 忙碌奔波

e.en: He's been {hustling} for clients since graduation.
e.zh: 毕业以来他一直在拼命招揽客户。

e.en: The market was {hustling} with weekend shoppers.
e.zh: 市场上挤满了周末购物的人群。

e.en: They spent the night in a small wooden {hut}.
e.zh: 他们在一间小木屋里过了一夜。

e.en: The mountain {hut} offered shelter from the storm.
e.zh: 那间山间小屋为人们提供了避风的地方。

e.en: The rabbit slept peacefully in its wooden {hutch}.
e.zh: 兔子在木笼里安静地睡着。

e.en: She displayed her china in the antique {hutch}.
e.zh: 她把瓷器陈列在那个古董橱柜里。

hutong.t: n. 胡同（北京老城巷弄）

e.en: Tourists love wandering through Beijing's narrow {hutong} alleys.
e.zh: 游客喜欢漫步在北京狭窄的胡同里。

e.en: Many old {hutong} neighborhoods have been preserved as heritage sites.
e.zh: 许多古老的胡同区被作为文化遗产保留下来。

e.en: Fishermen built simple {huts} along the shoreline.
e.zh: 渔民们沿着海岸搭建了简陋的小屋。

e.en: The village {huts} were lit by oil lamps at night.
e.zh: 村里的小屋夜晚靠油灯照明。

hvs.t: n. 高电压（high voltage 的缩写）

e.en: The report listed several {hvs} units needing maintenance.
e.zh: 报告列出了几台需要维护的高压设备。

e.en: Engineers monitor {hvs} performance during peak load hours.
e.zh: 工程师在用电高峰时段监测高压系统的性能。

e.en: She planted a purple {hyacinth} by the front door.
e.zh: 她在前门旁种了一株紫色风信子。

e.en: The {hyacinth} fills the room with sweet fragrance.
e.zh: 风信子让整个房间充满甜美的香气。

e.en: We booked a suite at the {hyatt} downtown.
e.zh: 我们在市中心的凯悦酒店订了一间套房。

e.en: The {hyatt} hosts an excellent breakfast buffet daily.
e.zh: 凯悦酒店每天提供丰盛的自助早餐。

hybrid.t:
adj. 混合的；杂交的
n. 混血；杂交品种

e.en: Many companies now use a {hybrid} work model.
e.zh: 许多公司现在采用混合办公模式。

e.en: The {hybrid} car saves fuel on long highway trips.
e.zh: 这辆混合动力车在长途公路上很省油。

hybridisation.t: n. 杂交；混合（英式拼写）

e.en: Plant {hybridisation} has produced disease-resistant crops.
e.zh: 植物杂交培育出了抗病的农作物。

e.en: Cultural {hybridisation} shapes modern global cuisine.
e.zh: 文化融合塑造了现代的全球美食。

hybridise.t: v. 杂交；使混合（英式拼写）

e.en: Botanists {hybridise} roses to create new colors.
e.zh: 植物学家通过杂交培育出新色的玫瑰。

e.en: Designers often {hybridise} traditional and modern styles.
e.zh: 设计师常将传统与现代风格融合在一起。

e.en: The novel explores cultural {hybridity} in immigrant families.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨移民家庭中的文化混杂性。

e.en: His art celebrates the {hybridity} of East and West.
e.zh: 他的艺术颂扬东西方文化的交融。

e.en: DNA {hybridization} helps scientists identify genetic matches.
e.zh: DNA杂交帮助科学家识别基因匹配。

e.en: Crop {hybridization} increased yields across the region.
e.zh: 作物杂交使该地区的产量大幅提高。

e.en: Researchers {hybridize} strains to improve drought resistance.
e.zh: 研究人员将品种杂交以增强抗旱能力。

e.en: Chefs love to {hybridize} flavors from different cuisines.
e.zh: 厨师喜欢融合不同菜系的风味。

hybridized.t:
adj. 已杂交的
v. 杂交（过去式）

e.en: The team {hybridized} two species to create a hardier plant.
e.zh: 团队将两个物种杂交，培育出更耐寒的植物。

e.en: Her music is {hybridized} from jazz and classical traditions.
e.zh: 她的音乐融合了爵士与古典两种传统。

e.en: We strolled through {hyde} Park on a sunny afternoon.
e.zh: 阳光明媚的午后我们漫步海德公园。

e.en: The novel's Mr. {hyde} represents the dark side of human nature.
e.zh: 小说中的海德先生象征人性的阴暗面。

hyderabad.t: n. 海得拉巴（印度城市）

e.en: {hyderabad} is famous for its delicious biryani.
e.zh: 海得拉巴以美味的比尔尼亚饭闻名。

e.en: Many tech companies have offices in {hyderabad}.
e.zh: 许多科技公司在海得拉巴设有办公室。

e.en: In Greek mythology the {hydra} grew two heads when one was cut.
e.zh: 希腊神话中，九头蛇被砍一头会再长两头。

e.en: Online misinformation behaves like a {hydra} that's hard to kill.
e.zh: 网络谣言就像九头蛇一样难以根除。

e.en: Blue {hydrangea} blooms thrive in slightly acidic soil.
e.zh: 蓝色绣球花在微酸性土壤中开得最好。

e.en: She arranged a bouquet of pink {hydrangea} for the table.
e.zh: 她为餐桌插了一束粉色绣球花。

e.en: Don't park in front of the fire {hydrant}.
e.zh: 别把车停在消防栓前面。

e.en: Firefighters connected the hose to the nearest {hydrant}.
e.zh: 消防员将水管接到了最近的消火栓。

hydrate.t:
v. 补水；水合
n. 水合物

e.en: Remember to {hydrate} before your morning run.
e.zh: 晨跑前记得补充水分。

e.en: This serum helps {hydrate} dry winter skin.
e.zh: 这款精华帮助滋润冬季干燥的肌肤。

hydrated.t: adj. 水合的；补足水分的

e.en: Stay {hydrated} during long flights to avoid fatigue.
e.zh: 长途飞行中要保持水分以免疲劳。

e.en: Her skin looked {hydrated} after using the new moisturizer.
e.zh: 用了新面霜后她的皮肤显得水润有光泽。

e.en: Coconut water is naturally {hydrating} after exercise.
e.zh: 运动后椰子水是天然的补水饮品。

e.en: She applied a {hydrating} mask before bedtime.
e.zh: 睡前她敷了一片补水面膜。

e.en: Proper {hydration} improves focus and energy levels.
e.zh: 良好的水分补充能提升专注力和精力。

e.en: Athletes track their {hydration} during intense training.
e.zh: 运动员在高强度训练中会监测补水情况。

e.en: The {hydraulic} lift raised the truck for inspection.
e.zh: 液压升降机把卡车举起来以便检修。

e.en: Modern excavators rely on powerful {hydraulic} systems.
e.zh: 现代挖掘机依靠强大的液压系统运作。

hydraulically.t: adv. 以液压方式；借水力地

e.en: The bridge gates open {hydraulically} every morning.
e.zh: 桥闸每天早晨通过液压方式开启。

e.en: The seats adjust {hydraulically} for maximum comfort.
e.zh: 座椅通过液压调节以达到最舒适的位置。

e.en: He studied {hydraulics} as part of his engineering degree.
e.zh: 他在工程学位课程中学习了液压学。

e.en: The factory's {hydraulics} need regular maintenance checks.
e.zh: 工厂的液压系统需要定期维护检查。

e.en: Rocket engines often use {hydrazine} as a propellant.
e.zh: 火箭发动机常使用肼作为推进剂。

e.en: Workers must handle {hydrazine} with extreme caution.
e.zh: 工人处理肼时必须极其小心。

e.en: Wetlands contain {hydric} soils that stay saturated year-round.
e.zh: 湿地含有常年饱和水分的湿成土壤。

e.en: Biologists classify the area by its {hydric} conditions.
e.zh: 生物学家根据该区域的水文条件进行分类。

e.en: Sodium {hydride} reacts violently with water.
e.zh: 氢化钠与水会发生剧烈反应。

e.en: Researchers use metal {hydride} for hydrogen storage.
e.zh: 研究人员使用金属氢化物来储存氢气。

e.en: Invasive {hydrilla} clogs many freshwater lakes in Florida.
e.zh: 入侵性水蕴草堵塞了佛罗里达的许多淡水湖。

e.en: Workers spent weeks removing {hydrilla} from the canal.
e.zh: 工人花了数周时间清除运河中的水蕴草。

hydro.t:
n. 水力发电
adj. 水的；液压的

e.en: Norway generates most of its electricity from {hydro} power.
e.zh: 挪威大部分电力来自水力发电。

e.en: The new {hydro} plant will supply the entire valley.
e.zh: 新建的水电站将为整个山谷供电。

e.en: Gasoline is a complex mixture of {hydrocarbon} compounds.
e.zh: 汽油是多种碳氢化合物的复杂混合物。

e.en: Burning {hydrocarbon} fuels releases carbon dioxide.
e.zh: 燃烧碳氢燃料会释放二氧化碳。

e.en: The infant was diagnosed with {hydrocephalus} shortly after birth.
e.zh: 婴儿出生后不久被诊断出脑积水。

e.en: Surgery can effectively manage {hydrocephalus} in most patients.
e.zh: 手术能有效治疗大多数患者的脑积水。

hydrochloric.t: adj. 盐酸的（hydrochloric acid 盐酸）

e.en: The lab uses dilute {hydrochloric} acid for the experiment.
e.zh: 实验室在实验中使用稀盐酸。

e.en: Stomach acid contains {hydrochloric} acid to digest food.
e.zh: 胃酸中含有盐酸用以消化食物。

e.en: The pharmacist labeled the bottle as pseudoephedrine {hydrochloride}.
e.zh: 药剂师把瓶子标为盐酸伪麻黄碱。

e.en: Many cold medicines contain diphenhydramine {hydrochloride} as the active ingredient.
e.zh: 许多感冒药含有盐酸苯海拉明作为活性成分。

hydrocortisone.t: n. 氢化可的松（激素药物）

e.en: The doctor recommended a {hydrocortisone} cream for the rash.
e.zh: 医生建议用氢化可的松药膏治疗皮疹。

e.en: A low-dose {hydrocortisone} ointment can ease itchy skin quickly.
e.zh: 低剂量氢化可的松软膏能快速缓解皮肤瘙痒。

e.en: Engineers designed a {hydrodynamic} hull to reduce fuel use.
e.zh: 工程师设计了流线型船体以减少油耗。

e.en: The new swimsuit has a {hydrodynamic} surface that cuts drag.
e.zh: 这款新泳衣表面具有流体动力学结构,可减少阻力。

e.en: She studies {hydrodynamics} to improve submarine performance.
e.zh: 她研究流体动力学以提升潜艇性能。

e.en: Understanding {hydrodynamics} helps engineers design faster racing yachts.
e.zh: 了解流体力学有助于工程师设计更快的赛艇。

e.en: The valley's {hydroelectric} dam supplies power to three cities.
e.zh: 山谷里的水电大坝为三个城市供电。

e.en: Norway gets most of its electricity from {hydroelectric} plants.
e.zh: 挪威大部分电力来自水力发电站。

e.en: Brazil generates a huge share of its energy from {hydroelectricity}.
e.zh: 巴西很大一部分能源来自水力发电。

e.en: Falling water at the dam is converted into clean {hydroelectricity}.
e.zh: 大坝下落的水被转化为清洁的水电。

e.en: We took a {hydrofoil} from Hong Kong to Macau.
e.zh: 我们乘水翼船从香港去澳门。

e.en: The racing boat lifts onto its {hydrofoil} at high speed.
e.zh: 这艘赛艇高速行驶时会升起水翼。

e.en: The wound dressing uses a {hydrogel} to keep skin moist.
e.zh: 这种伤口敷料用水凝胶保持皮肤湿润。

e.en: Her new face mask contains a cooling {hydrogel} layer.
e.zh: 她的新面膜含有一层清凉的水凝胶。

e.en: Water is made of {hydrogen} and oxygen atoms.
e.zh: 水由氢原子和氧原子组成。

e.en: Toyota is investing heavily in {hydrogen} fuel cell cars.
e.zh: 丰田正在大力投资氢燃料电池汽车。

e.en: Avoid snacks that contain partially {hydrogenated} oils.
e.zh: 要避免含有部分氢化油的零食。

e.en: Margarine is often made from {hydrogenated} vegetable fats.
e.zh: 人造黄油通常由氢化植物脂肪制成。

e.en: The factory uses {hydrogenation} to turn liquid oils into solid fats.
e.zh: 工厂利用氢化作用将液态油转化为固态脂肪。

e.en: Chemists control {hydrogenation} carefully to avoid trans fats.
e.zh: 化学家会仔细控制氢化反应以避免产生反式脂肪。

e.en: The team completed a {hydrogeologic} survey before drilling the well.
e.zh: 团队在打井前完成了水文地质勘测。

e.en: A detailed {hydrogeologic} map shows where groundwater flows.
e.zh: 详细的水文地质图显示了地下水的流向。

hydrographic.t: adj. 水文的；水道测量的

e.en: The navy released an updated {hydrographic} chart of the coast.
e.zh: 海军发布了更新的海岸水文图。

e.en: Sailors rely on {hydrographic} data to navigate shallow waters.
e.zh: 水手依靠水文数据在浅水区航行。

e.en: Climate change is disrupting the global {hydrologic} cycle.
e.zh: 气候变化正在扰乱全球水文循环。

e.en: Engineers reviewed the {hydrologic} model before approving the dam.
e.zh: 工程师在批准建坝前审查了水文模型。

e.en: The agency monitors {hydrological} conditions across the river basin.
e.zh: 该机构监测整个流域的水文状况。

e.en: Heavy rain caused unusual {hydrological} patterns this spring.
e.zh: 今春的强降雨造成了异常的水文情况。

e.en: A {hydrologist} warned that the reservoir was dangerously low.
e.zh: 一位水文学家警告说水库水位低得危险。

e.en: The {hydrologist} mapped underground streams beneath the city.
e.zh: 这位水文学家绘制了城市地下水流的分布图。

e.en: She majored in {hydrology} to help solve drought problems.
e.zh: 她主修水文学以帮助解决干旱问题。

e.en: Local {hydrology} affects which crops farmers can grow.
e.zh: 当地的水文情况决定了农民能种植哪些作物。

e.en: Enzymes in saliva begin to {hydrolyse} starch into sugar.
e.zh: 唾液中的酶开始把淀粉水解为糖。

e.en: Strong acid can {hydrolyse} proteins into amino acids.
e.zh: 强酸可以将蛋白质水解为氨基酸。

e.en: Digestion relies on the {hydrolysis} of large food molecules.
e.zh: 消化依赖于大分子食物的水解作用。

e.en: The lab studied the {hydrolysis} of fats by lipase.
e.zh: 实验室研究了脂肪在脂肪酶作用下的水解。

e.en: This baby formula contains {hydrolyzed} milk protein for sensitive stomachs.
e.zh: 这款婴儿奶粉含有水解乳蛋白,适合敏感肠胃。

e.en: The shampoo is enriched with {hydrolyzed} keratin for stronger hair.
e.zh: 这款洗发水添加了水解角蛋白,使头发更强韧。

e.en: The fabric has a {hydrophilic} coating that pulls sweat away.
e.zh: 这种面料有亲水涂层,可以把汗水吸走。

e.en: Sugar molecules are {hydrophilic} and dissolve easily in water.
e.zh: 糖分子是亲水的,能轻易溶于水。

e.en: The phone case has a {hydrophobic} layer that repels rain.
e.zh: 这款手机壳有疏水层,可以防雨。

e.en: Oil is {hydrophobic}, which is why it floats on water.
e.zh: 油是疏水的,所以会浮在水面上。

e.en: Researchers dropped a {hydrophone} to record whale songs.
e.zh: 研究人员放下水听器录制鲸鱼的歌声。

e.en: The submarine's {hydrophone} picked up a distant ship engine.
e.zh: 潜艇的水听器捕捉到了远处船只的发动机声。

hydroplane.t:
n. 水上飞机；快艇
v. (车辆) 打滑

e.en: Slow down in heavy rain so your tires don't {hydroplane}.
e.zh: 暴雨中要减速,以免轮胎打滑失控。

e.en: Worn treads make a car much more likely to {hydroplane}.
e.zh: 磨损的胎纹会让汽车更容易在水面打滑。

hydroponic.t: adj. 水培的；无土栽培的

e.en: Their startup grows lettuce in a {hydroponic} greenhouse.
e.zh: 他们的初创公司在水培温室里种植生菜。

e.en: A small {hydroponic} system can fit on your kitchen counter.
e.zh: 小型水培系统可以放在厨房台面上。

e.en: The basil on the menu is grown {hydroponically} on the roof.
e.zh: 菜单上的罗勒是在屋顶水培种植的。

e.en: Lettuce raised {hydroponically} uses far less water than field crops.
e.zh: 水培生菜比田间作物用水少得多。

e.en: Urban farms use {hydroponics} to grow vegetables without soil.
e.zh: 城市农场用水培技术无土种植蔬菜。

e.en: He took a weekend class on home {hydroponics}.
e.zh: 他参加了一个周末家庭水培课程。

e.en: China is the world's largest producer of {hydropower}.
e.zh: 中国是全球最大的水电生产国。

e.en: Small {hydropower} plants can supply remote mountain villages.
e.zh: 小型水电站可以为偏远的山村供电。

e.en: The unborn baby was diagnosed with {hydrops} during the scan.
e.zh: 超声检查时胎儿被诊断为水肿。

e.en: Fetal {hydrops} requires close monitoring throughout pregnancy.
e.zh: 胎儿水肿需要在整个孕期密切监测。

e.en: Some skin creams contain {hydroquinone} to lighten dark spots.
e.zh: 有些护肤霜含有对苯二酚,用于淡化色斑。

e.en: Doctors warn against long-term use of {hydroquinone} on the face.
e.zh: 医生警告不要长期在脸上使用对苯二酚。

e.en: Pollution is steadily damaging Earth's {hydrosphere}.
e.zh: 污染正在不断破坏地球的水圈。

e.en: The {hydrosphere} includes all the oceans, rivers, and lakes.
e.zh: 水圈包括所有的海洋、河流和湖泊。

hydrostatic.t: adj. 静水压的；流体静力的

e.en: Divers must account for {hydrostatic} pressure at great depths.
e.zh: 潜水员在深水中必须考虑静水压力。

e.en: The tank was tested for leaks using a {hydrostatic} test.
e.zh: 这个储罐用静水压力测试检查是否漏水。

e.en: After surgery, she did {hydrotherapy} to rebuild leg strength.
e.zh: 手术后,她通过水疗恢复腿部力量。

e.en: The spa offers {hydrotherapy} sessions for sore muscles.
e.zh: 水疗中心为肌肉酸痛提供水疗服务。

e.en: Strange creatures thrive near deep-sea {hydrothermal} vents.
e.zh: 奇特的生物在深海热泉附近繁衍生息。

e.en: Iceland taps {hydrothermal} energy to heat most of its homes.
e.zh: 冰岛利用地热能为大多数家庭供暖。

e.en: Sodium {hydroxide} is the main ingredient in many drain cleaners.
e.zh: 氢氧化钠是许多管道清洁剂的主要成分。

e.en: Add calcium {hydroxide} to neutralize the acidic soil.
e.zh: 加入氢氧化钙来中和酸性土壤。

e.en: Tooth enamel is mostly made of {hydroxyapatite}.
e.zh: 牙釉质主要由羟基磷灰石构成。

e.en: This toothpaste contains {hydroxyapatite} to help repair tiny cavities.
e.zh: 这款牙膏含有羟基磷灰石,有助于修复细小的蛀牙。

e.en: Alcohol molecules all contain a {hydroxyl} group.
e.zh: 所有醇分子都含有一个羟基。

e.en: The chemist replaced a hydrogen atom with a {hydroxyl} group.
e.zh: 化学家用一个羟基取代了一个氢原子。

e.en: A {hyena} laughed in the distance as we set up camp.
e.zh: 我们扎营时,远处传来一只鬣狗的笑声。

e.en: The lion chased a {hyena} away from the kill.
e.zh: 狮子把一只鬣狗从猎物旁赶走。

e.en: Good hand {hygiene} helps prevent the spread of colds.
e.zh: 良好的手部卫生有助于防止感冒传播。

e.en: The restaurant lost stars over poor kitchen {hygiene}.
e.zh: 这家餐厅因厨房卫生差而被扣星。

e.en: The textbook compared sleep and dental {hygienes} side by side.
e.zh: 教科书将睡眠卫生与口腔卫生作了对比。

e.en: Different cultures follow different food preparation {hygienes}.
e.zh: 不同文化遵循不同的食物准备卫生规范。

e.en: Stainless steel surfaces are easier to keep {hygienic}.
e.zh: 不锈钢表面更容易保持卫生。

e.en: Always store raw meat separately for {hygienic} reasons.
e.zh: 出于卫生考虑,生肉一定要单独存放。

e.en: The sushi is prepared {hygienically} behind a glass partition.
e.zh: 寿司是在玻璃隔断后卫生地制作的。

e.en: Staff are trained to handle food {hygienically} at every step.
e.zh: 工作人员被培训在每个环节都卫生地处理食物。

e.en: My dental {hygienist} cleaned my teeth in under thirty minutes.
e.zh: 我的牙科保健师不到三十分钟就洗完了我的牙。

e.en: The {hygienist} showed me a better way to floss.
e.zh: 那位口腔保健师教了我一种更好的用牙线方法。

e.en: Salt is {hygroscopic} and clumps in humid weather.
e.zh: 盐有吸湿性,在潮湿天气里会结块。

e.en: Store this powder in a sealed jar because it's {hygroscopic}.
e.zh: 这种粉末有吸湿性,要存放在密封罐里。

e.en: The doctor explained that the {hymen} varies greatly between individuals.
e.zh: 医生解释说处女膜在不同人之间差异很大。

e.en: Many myths about the {hymen} are not medically accurate.
e.zh: 关于处女膜的许多传言在医学上并不准确。

e.en: The choir sang an old {hymn} at the memorial service.
e.zh: 唱诗班在追悼会上唱了一首古老的赞美诗。

e.en: Her new song feels like a {hymn} to small-town life.
e.zh: 她的新歌像是一首献给小镇生活的赞歌。

hymnal.t:
n. 赞美诗集
adj. 赞美诗的

e.en: She opened the {hymnal} to page forty-two.
e.zh: 她翻开赞美诗集到第四十二页。

e.en: Each pew had a worn leather {hymnal} tucked inside.
e.zh: 每张长椅里都塞着一本磨损的皮面赞美诗集。

e.en: Grandma kept her old {hymnbook} on the piano.
e.zh: 奶奶把她那本旧的赞美诗集放在钢琴上。

e.en: The choir shared a single {hymnbook} between two singers.
e.zh: 唱诗班每两位歌手共用一本赞美诗集。

hyoid.t:
n. 舌骨
adj. 舌骨的

e.en: A fractured {hyoid} bone often suggests strangulation.
e.zh: 舌骨骨折通常提示有勒颈伤害。

e.en: The {hyoid} is the only bone not connected to another.
e.zh: 舌骨是唯一一块不与其他骨骼相连的骨头。

hype.t:
n. 大肆宣传；炒作
v. 大力宣传

e.en: The new phone didn't live up to the {hype}.
e.zh: 这款新手机并没有传说中那么厉害。

e.en: Influencers are paid to {hype} products on social media.
e.zh: 网红收钱在社交媒体上为产品造势。

hyped.t: adj. 被大肆宣传的；兴奋的

e.en: Fans got really {hyped} for the new album release.
e.zh: 粉丝们对新专辑的发行非常兴奋。

e.en: The movie was overly {hyped} and ended up disappointing.
e.zh: 这部电影被过度炒作,结果令人失望。

hyper.t: adj. 过度兴奋的；亢奋的

e.en: The kids get {hyper} after eating too much sugar.
e.zh: 孩子们吃太多糖后会变得很亢奋。

e.en: He's a bit {hyper} before big presentations.
e.zh: 他在重大演讲前会有点过度兴奋。

hyperactive.t: adj. 过度活跃的；多动的

e.en: My puppy is {hyperactive} and never sits still.
e.zh: 我的小狗特别好动,从不安静。

e.en: The {hyperactive} child needed extra attention in class.
e.zh: 那个多动的孩子在课堂上需要额外关注。

e.en: Doctors linked his {hyperactivity} to lack of sleep.
e.zh: 医生把他的多动症状与睡眠不足联系起来。

e.en: Sugar doesn't actually cause {hyperactivity} in most kids.
e.zh: 糖其实不会让大多数孩子变得多动。

e.en: People with {hyperacusis} find normal sounds painfully loud.
e.zh: 听觉过敏的人会觉得普通声音吵得难受。

e.en: She developed {hyperacusis} after the concert injury.
e.zh: 演唱会受伤后她患上了听觉过敏症。

e.en: Divers use a {hyperbaric} chamber to recover safely.
e.zh: 潜水员使用高压氧舱来安全恢复。

e.en: The clinic offers {hyperbaric} oxygen therapy for wounds.
e.zh: 该诊所为伤口提供高压氧治疗。

e.en: Saying "I've told you a million times" is {hyperbole}.
e.zh: 说"我跟你讲过一百万遍"就是夸张说法。

e.en: His speech was full of {hyperbole} and empty promises.
e.zh: 他的演讲满是夸张言辞和空洞承诺。

e.en: The ad relied on cheesy {hyperboles} to grab attention.
e.zh: 那广告靠浮夸的夸张说法来吸引眼球。

e.en: Poets often use {hyperboles} to heighten emotional impact.
e.zh: 诗人常用夸张手法来增强情感冲击。

e.en: His {hyperbolic} claims about the product seemed dishonest.
e.zh: 他对产品的夸张说法显得不太诚实。

e.en: The graph shows a {hyperbolic} curve approaching the axis.
e.zh: 图表显示一条逼近坐标轴的双曲线。

e.en: He {hyperbolically} described the meeting as a total disaster.
e.zh: 他夸张地把那场会议形容为彻底的灾难。

e.en: Critics {hyperbolically} called it the worst film ever made.
e.zh: 评论家夸张地称它为有史以来最烂的电影。
