e.en: {Hypercalcemia} can cause kidney stones and fatigue.
e.zh: 高钙血症可能导致肾结石和疲劳。

e.en: The blood test revealed mild {hypercalcemia} in the patient.
e.zh: 血液检测显示该患者有轻度高钙血症。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed {hypercalciuria} after analyzing her urine sample.
e.zh: 医生分析尿样后诊断她患有高钙尿症。

e.en: Children with {hypercalciuria} often need dietary adjustments.
e.zh: 患高钙尿症的儿童通常需要调整饮食。

e.en: {Hypercapnia} occurs when carbon dioxide builds up in blood.
e.zh: 血液中二氧化碳堆积时就会发生高碳酸血症。

e.en: Patients on ventilators are monitored for {hypercapnia}.
e.zh: 使用呼吸机的患者会被监测高碳酸血症。

e.en: The trial recruited {hypercholesterolaemic} adults for the new statin.
e.zh: 试验招募高胆固醇成人来测试新型他汀类药物。

e.en: Doctors prescribed a strict diet to the {hypercholesterolaemic} patient.
e.zh: 医生给这位高胆固醇患者开了严格的饮食方案。

e.en: Family history puts him at risk for {hypercholesterolemia}.
e.zh: 家族病史使他有患高胆固醇血症的风险。

e.en: Statins are commonly prescribed to treat {hypercholesterolemia}.
e.zh: 他汀类药物常用于治疗高胆固醇血症。

hypercritical.t: adj. 苛求的；吹毛求疵的

e.en: Her {hypercritical} boss never seemed satisfied with anything.
e.zh: 她那位吹毛求疵的老板似乎对什么都不满意。

e.en: Try not to be {hypercritical} of your own writing.
e.zh: 尽量不要对自己的写作过分苛刻。

e.en: The injury caused visible {hyperemia} around the wound.
e.zh: 这处受伤导致伤口周围出现明显充血。

e.en: {Hyperemia} of the eye often indicates infection or strain.
e.zh: 眼部充血通常表明感染或用眼过度。

e.en: The gymnast injured her knee from {hyperextension} during landing.
e.zh: 那位体操运动员在落地时膝盖过度伸展受伤。

e.en: Avoid {hyperextension} of your elbow during push-ups.
e.zh: 做俯卧撑时避免肘部过度伸展。

e.en: Atomic clocks rely on {hyperfine} transitions in cesium atoms.
e.zh: 原子钟依靠铯原子的超精细跃迁来计时。

e.en: The spectrum showed clear {hyperfine} splitting between the lines.
e.zh: 光谱显示谱线之间有明显的超精细分裂。

e.en: Diabetics must watch for signs of {hyperglycaemia} after meals.
e.zh: 糖尿病患者必须留意餐后出现的高血糖症状。

e.en: Untreated {hyperglycaemia} can lead to serious complications.
e.zh: 未经治疗的高血糖会导致严重并发症。

e.en: {Hypericum} extract is sometimes used for mild depression.
e.zh: 贯叶连翘提取物有时用于治疗轻度抑郁。

e.en: The garden was filled with bright yellow {hypericum} flowers.
e.zh: 花园里开满了亮黄色的金丝桃花。

e.en: Zimbabwe suffered devastating {hyperinflation} in the late 2000s.
e.zh: 津巴布韦在2000年代末遭受了灾难性的恶性通货膨胀。

e.en: {Hyperinflation} wiped out the savings of millions of families.
e.zh: 恶性通胀让数百万家庭的积蓄化为乌有。

e.en: The country entered a {hyperinflationary} spiral after the war.
e.zh: 战争之后该国陷入恶性通胀的螺旋之中。

e.en: Investors fled the {hyperinflationary} economy for safer markets.
e.zh: 投资者纷纷逃离恶性通胀经济,转向更安全的市场。

hyperkinetic.t: adj. 运动过度的；多动的

e.en: The film features a {hyperkinetic} editing style throughout.
e.zh: 这部电影通篇采用极度快节奏的剪辑风格。

e.en: Children with {hyperkinetic} disorder struggle to focus in class.
e.zh: 患有多动障碍的儿童在课堂上难以集中注意力。

hyperlink.t:
n. 超链接
v. 以超链接连接

e.en: Click the {hyperlink} to read the full article online.
e.zh: 点击超链接即可在线阅读完整文章。

e.en: She added a {hyperlink} to her portfolio in the email.
e.zh: 她在邮件里加了个指向作品集的超链接。

e.en: We bought groceries and a TV at the {hypermarket}.
e.zh: 我们在大型超市买了食品和一台电视。

e.en: The new {hypermarket} stays open twenty-four hours daily.
e.zh: 这家新开的大型超市每天24小时营业。

e.en: Modern websites are essentially {hypermedia} with text, video, and audio.
e.zh: 现代网站本质上是包含文字、视频和音频的超媒体。

e.en: The course explores {hypermedia} design for interactive storytelling.
e.zh: 该课程探讨用于互动叙事的超媒体设计。

hyperparathyroidism.t: n. 甲状旁腺功能亢进

e.en: {Hyperparathyroidism} causes the body to release too much calcium.
e.zh: 甲状旁腺功能亢进会导致身体释放过多钙质。

e.en: Surgery is often the cure for primary {hyperparathyroidism}.
e.zh: 手术通常是治愈原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进的方法。

e.en: Sunscreen helps prevent {hyperpigmentation} on sensitive skin.
e.zh: 防晒霜有助于预防敏感皮肤上的色素沉着。

e.en: She uses vitamin C serum to fade {hyperpigmentation}.
e.zh: 她用维生素C精华来淡化色素沉着。

e.en: Benign prostatic {hyperplasia} commonly affects men over fifty.
e.zh: 良性前列腺增生常见于五十岁以上的男性。

e.en: The biopsy revealed mild {hyperplasia} but no cancer cells.
e.zh: 活检显示轻度增生但没有癌细胞。

hypersensitive.t: adj. 过度敏感的；过敏的

e.en: He's {hypersensitive} to criticism about his work.
e.zh: 他对针对自己作品的批评极其敏感。

e.en: My skin is {hypersensitive} to most fragrances and dyes.
e.zh: 我的皮肤对大多数香料和染料过度敏感。

e.en: His {hypersensitivity} to peanuts requires him to carry an EpiPen.
e.zh: 他对花生的高度过敏使他必须随身带肾上腺素笔。

e.en: The team noted her {hypersensitivity} to feedback during reviews.
e.zh: 团队注意到她在评审时对反馈过于敏感。

e.en: China tested a new {hypersonic} missile last month.
e.zh: 中国上个月试射了一种新型高超音速导弹。

e.en: {Hypersonic} aircraft travel at more than five times sound's speed.
e.zh: 高超音速飞行器的速度超过五倍音速。

e.en: The starship jumped into {hyperspace} to escape the attackers.
e.zh: 星舰跃入超空间以摆脱攻击者。

e.en: Mathematicians study geometry in higher dimensions called {hyperspace}.
e.zh: 数学家研究被称为超空间的高维几何。

e.en: Reducing salt intake can help control {hypertension}.
e.zh: 减少盐的摄入有助于控制高血压。

e.en: His doctor diagnosed him with mild {hypertension} last year.
e.zh: 医生去年诊断他患有轻度高血压。

hypertensive.t:
adj. 高血压的
n. 高血压患者

e.en: {Hypertensive} patients should monitor their blood pressure daily.
e.zh: 高血压患者应每天监测血压。

e.en: She had a {hypertensive} crisis and was rushed to hospital.
e.zh: 她突发高血压危象,被紧急送往医院。

e.en: The web is built on {hypertext} that links pages together.
e.zh: 网络建立在将各页面相互链接的超文本之上。

e.en: HTML stands for {hypertext} Markup Language.
e.zh: HTML是超文本标记语言的缩写。

e.en: Marathon runners risk {hyperthermia} on hot summer days.
e.zh: 马拉松选手在炎热夏日有体温过高的风险。

e.en: {Hyperthermia} therapy is sometimes used alongside cancer treatments.
e.zh: 高温疗法有时与癌症治疗联合使用。

e.en: Symptoms of {hyperthyroidism} include weight loss and rapid heartbeat.
e.zh: 甲状腺功能亢进的症状包括体重减轻和心跳加速。

e.en: She takes medication daily to manage her {hyperthyroidism}.
e.zh: 她每天服药来控制甲亢。

hypertonic.t: adj. 高渗的；张力过高的

e.en: A {hypertonic} solution draws water out of cells.
e.zh: 高渗溶液会把水分从细胞中吸出来。

e.en: Doctors used a {hypertonic} saline drip to reduce swelling.
e.zh: 医生用高渗盐水静滴来减轻肿胀。

e.en: The athlete suffers from {hypertrophic} cardiomyopathy and avoids contact sports.
e.zh: 这位运动员患有肥厚型心肌病,因此避免身体接触类运动。

e.en: Some people develop {hypertrophic} scars after surgery.
e.zh: 有些人在手术后会出现增生性疤痕。

hypertrophied.t: adj. 肥大的；变得肥大的

e.en: The bodybuilder's {hypertrophied} biceps bulged through his shirt.
e.zh: 那位健美运动员肥大的二头肌从衬衫下凸了出来。

e.en: Scans showed a {hypertrophied} heart muscle on the left side.
e.zh: 扫描显示左侧心肌出现肥厚。

hypertrophy.t:
n. 肥大
v. 变肥大

e.en: Lifting heavy weights promotes muscle {hypertrophy} over time.
e.zh: 长期举重会促进肌肉肥大。

e.en: Cardiac {hypertrophy} can result from untreated high blood pressure.
e.zh: 未经治疗的高血压可能导致心肌肥厚。

hyperventilate.t: v. 过度换气；喘不过气

e.en: She started to {hyperventilate} during the panic attack.
e.zh: 她在恐慌发作时开始过度换气。

e.en: Try not to {hyperventilate} when you feel anxious.
e.zh: 感到焦虑时尽量不要过度呼吸。

e.en: Breathing into a paper bag can help stop {hyperventilation}.
e.zh: 对着纸袋呼吸有助于停止过度换气。

e.en: Anxiety often triggers {hyperventilation} and dizziness.
e.zh: 焦虑常常引发过度换气和头晕。

e.en: Use a {hyphen} to connect compound adjectives like "well-known".
e.zh: 用连字符连接复合形容词,例如"well-known"。

e.en: Her last name has a {hyphen} between two family names.
e.zh: 她的姓氏在两个家族姓之间有一个连字符。

e.en: Editors usually {hyphenate} compound modifiers before a noun.
e.zh: 编辑通常会给名词前的复合修饰语加上连字符。

e.en: Should we {hyphenate} "long term" in this context?
e.zh: 在这个语境下要不要给"long term"加连字符?

e.en: Many couples use {hyphenated} surnames after marriage.
e.zh: 许多夫妻婚后使用带连字符的复姓。

e.en: "Mother-in-law" is a {hyphenated} compound noun.
e.zh: "Mother-in-law"是一个带连字符的复合名词。

hyphenation.t: n. 用连字符连接；断字

e.en: Word processors handle {hyphenation} automatically at line breaks.
e.zh: 文字处理软件会在换行处自动处理连字符断词。

e.en: The style guide explains correct {hyphenation} for compound words.
e.zh: 这本风格指南讲解复合词的正确连字符用法。

e.en: Don't use {hyphens} where en dashes are appropriate.
e.zh: 在该用半字线的地方不要使用连字符。

e.en: The document had inconsistent {hyphens} throughout the text.
e.zh: 这份文件全文连字符使用不一致。

e.en: She used {hypnosis} to help him quit smoking.
e.zh: 她用催眠帮他戒了烟。

e.en: Stage {hypnosis} shows can be surprisingly entertaining.
e.zh: 舞台催眠表演有时出奇地有趣。

e.en: Modern {hypnotherapies} address anxiety and chronic pain.
e.zh: 现代催眠疗法可处理焦虑和慢性疼痛。

e.en: Several {hypnotherapies} are now covered by insurance.
e.zh: 一些催眠疗法现已纳入保险范围。

e.en: The {hypnotherapist} guided her into deep relaxation.
e.zh: 催眠治疗师引导她进入深度放松。

e.en: He became a certified {hypnotherapist} last year.
e.zh: 他去年成为了认证催眠治疗师。

e.en: She tried {hypnotherapy} to overcome her fear of flying.
e.zh: 她尝试催眠疗法来克服飞行恐惧。

e.en: {Hypnotherapy} sessions usually last about an hour.
e.zh: 催眠治疗一般持续大约一小时。

hypnotic.t:
adj. 催眠的；令人着迷的
n. 安眠药

e.en: The dancer's movements were absolutely {hypnotic}.
e.zh: 那位舞者的动作令人完全着迷。

e.en: Doctors rarely prescribe {hypnotic} drugs long-term.
e.zh: 医生很少长期开具安眠类药物。

hypnotically.t: adv. 催眠般地；令人入迷地

e.en: The waves rolled {hypnotically} onto the empty beach.
e.zh: 海浪如催眠般拍打着空荡的海滩。

e.en: She stared {hypnotically} at the spinning coin.
e.zh: 她出神地盯着旋转的硬币。

hypnotise.t: v. 对…施催眠术（英式拼写）

e.en: The therapist offered to {hypnotise} him to ease pain.
e.zh: 治疗师提出催眠他以缓解疼痛。

e.en: You can't {hypnotise} someone against their will.
e.zh: 你无法违背他人意愿对其进行催眠。

e.en: He studied {hypnotism} as part of his psychology degree.
e.zh: 他在心理学课程里学习了催眠术。

e.en: Stage {hypnotism} relies heavily on willing volunteers.
e.zh: 舞台催眠很依赖愿意配合的志愿者。

e.en: The {hypnotist} put three audience members into a trance.
e.zh: 催眠师让三位观众进入了恍惚状态。

e.en: A skilled {hypnotist} can help patients quit smoking.
e.zh: 熟练的催眠师能帮助患者戒烟。

hypnotize.t: v. 对…施催眠术；使入迷

e.en: The magician promised to {hypnotize} a volunteer onstage.
e.zh: 魔术师承诺在台上催眠一位志愿者。

e.en: Bright screens can almost {hypnotize} young children.
e.zh: 明亮的屏幕几乎能把小孩子催眠住。

e.en: The crowd seemed {hypnotized} by the singer's voice.
e.zh: 观众仿佛被歌手的声音催眠了。

e.en: She {hypnotized} him to recall his childhood memories.
e.zh: 她催眠他以唤起儿时的记忆。

hypo.t: n. 皮下注射（针）；低血糖发作

e.en: The nurse prepared a {hypo} for the morning injection.
e.zh: 护士准备好了用于晨间注射的皮下针。

e.en: Diabetics carry sugar in case of a {hypo}.
e.zh: 糖尿病患者会随身带糖以防低血糖发作。

hypoallergenic.t: adj. 低致敏的，不易引起过敏的

e.en: This {hypoallergenic} lotion is safe for sensitive skin.
e.zh: 这款低致敏乳液适合敏感肌肤使用。

e.en: She bought {hypoallergenic} pillows for her allergies.
e.zh: 她为过敏症买了防过敏的枕头。

e.en: Severe {hypocalcemia} can cause muscle cramps and seizures.
e.zh: 严重低血钙会引发肌肉痉挛和抽搐。

e.en: The blood test revealed mild {hypocalcemia}.
e.zh: 血检显示存在轻度低血钙。

e.en: Sodium {hypochlorite} is the active ingredient in bleach.
e.zh: 次氯酸钠是漂白剂中的活性成分。

e.en: Pool water is disinfected with calcium {hypochlorite}.
e.zh: 泳池水用次氯酸钙进行消毒。

hypochondria.t: n. 疑病症，过度担心生病

e.en: His {hypochondria} drove him to the doctor weekly.
e.zh: 他的疑病症让他每周都跑医院。

e.en: Reading symptom websites can fuel {hypochondria}.
e.zh: 浏览症状网站可能加重疑病症。

hypochondriac.t:
n. 疑病症患者
adj. 疑病症的

e.en: My uncle is a {hypochondriac} who fears every cough.
e.zh: 我叔叔是个疑病症患者,听到咳嗽就紧张。

e.en: She joked that googling symptoms made her a {hypochondriac}.
e.zh: 她开玩笑说搜症状把自己变成了疑病症患者。

e.en: His {hypochondriacal} tendencies worsened during the pandemic.
e.zh: 他的疑病倾向在疫情期间加重了。

e.en: She dismissed his complaints as purely {hypochondriacal}.
e.zh: 她认为他的抱怨纯粹是疑病心理作祟。

e.en: The article exposed the {hypocrisies} of the industry.
e.zh: 那篇文章揭露了行业中的种种伪善。

e.en: Voters are tired of political {hypocrisies}.
e.zh: 选民已厌倦了政治上的种种虚伪。

e.en: Critics accused the senator of blatant {hypocrisy}.
e.zh: 批评者指责这位参议员公然伪善。

e.en: There's real {hypocrisy} in preaching what you don't practice.
e.zh: 嘴上一套手上一套确实是真的虚伪。

e.en: Don't be a {hypocrite} who lectures others about honesty.
e.zh: 别做那种满口诚实却言行不一的伪君子。

e.en: He felt like a {hypocrite} smoking after the speech.
e.zh: 演讲完又抽烟,他觉得自己像个伪君子。

e.en: The film exposes politicians as shameless {hypocrites}.
e.zh: 这部电影把政客们刻画成无耻的伪君子。

e.en: Nobody likes {hypocrites} who say one thing and do another.
e.zh: 没人喜欢说一套做一套的伪君子。

e.en: It's {hypocritical} to criticize habits you secretly enjoy.
e.zh: 批评自己私下也喜欢的习惯,这很虚伪。

e.en: Her {hypocritical} apology fooled no one.
e.zh: 她那虚伪的道歉骗不了任何人。

e.en: He {hypocritically} preached patience while losing his temper.
e.zh: 他一边发脾气,一边虚伪地宣讲耐心。

e.en: The CEO {hypocritically} demanded cuts while raising his salary.
e.zh: 那位 CEO 一边给自己加薪,一边虚伪地要求裁员。

hypodermic.t:
adj. 皮下注射的
n. 皮下注射针

e.en: The nurse filled the {hypodermic} needle with vaccine.
e.zh: 护士把疫苗抽进了皮下注射针管。

e.en: Used {hypodermic} syringes must be disposed of safely.
e.zh: 用过的皮下注射针必须安全处置。

e.en: The {hypoglossal} nerve controls movement of the tongue.
e.zh: 舌下神经负责控制舌头的运动。

e.en: Damage to the {hypoglossal} nerve can affect speech.
e.zh: 舌下神经受损可能影响说话。

hypoglycaemia.t: n. 低血糖症（英式拼写）

e.en: Skipping meals can trigger {hypoglycaemia} in diabetics.
e.zh: 糖尿病患者不吃饭可能引发低血糖。

e.en: Symptoms of {hypoglycaemia} include shaking and sweating.
e.zh: 低血糖的症状包括颤抖和出汗。

hypoglycaemic.t: adj. 低血糖的（英式拼写）

e.en: She felt {hypoglycaemic} after the long morning run.
e.zh: 晨跑过久后她出现了低血糖症状。

e.en: Always carry sweets if you suffer {hypoglycaemic} attacks.
e.zh: 如果有低血糖发作请随身带糖。

e.en: {Hypoglycemia} can cause dizziness and confusion.
e.zh: 低血糖会导致头晕和意识模糊。

e.en: Doctors warned her about repeated {hypoglycemia} episodes.
e.zh: 医生提醒她注意反复出现的低血糖发作。

e.en: Diabetics often carry juice for {hypoglycemic} emergencies.
e.zh: 糖尿病人常带果汁以应对低血糖紧急情况。

e.en: He went {hypoglycemic} after skipping breakfast.
e.zh: 没吃早餐后他出现了低血糖反应。

e.en: {Hypomania} can feel productive but often precedes a crash.
e.zh: 轻躁狂感觉很高效,但常会随之崩溃。

e.en: Her doctor diagnosed mild {hypomania} after the interview.
e.zh: 医生在问诊后诊断出她有轻度轻躁狂。

e.en: During {hypomanic} episodes, he barely sleeps for days.
e.zh: 在轻躁狂发作时,他几天几乎不睡觉。

e.en: She felt {hypomanic} and unusually talkative all week.
e.zh: 整整一周她都处于轻躁狂状态,异常健谈。

e.en: Surgeons removed a small {hypopharyngeal} tumor successfully.
e.zh: 外科医生成功切除了一个下咽部小肿瘤。

e.en: {Hypopharyngeal} cancer is often diagnosed late.
e.zh: 下咽癌往往确诊较晚。

hypoplasia.t: n. 发育不全，生长不足

e.en: Dental {hypoplasia} left visible pits on his teeth.
e.zh: 牙釉质发育不全在他牙齿上留下了明显凹痕。

e.en: The scan revealed mild {hypoplasia} of the kidney.
e.zh: 扫描显示肾脏有轻度发育不全。

hypostasis.t: n. 本质；（医）沉积；（神学）位格

e.en: Theologians debated the {hypostasis} of Christ for centuries.
e.zh: 神学家争论基督的本质几百年。

e.en: Forensic {hypostasis} helps determine the time of death.
e.zh: 法医通过尸斑帮助推断死亡时间。

e.en: The doctrine of the {hypostatic} union remains central to theology.
e.zh: 位格联合的教义至今仍是神学的核心。

e.en: {Hypostatic} pneumonia can develop in bedridden patients.
e.zh: 长期卧床的患者可能出现坠积性肺炎。

e.en: Severe {hypotension} can cause fainting and dizziness.
e.zh: 严重低血压会导致晕厥和头晕。

e.en: The medication caused mild {hypotension} in some patients.
e.zh: 该药物在部分患者中引起轻度低血压。

e.en: The patient remained {hypotensive} despite IV fluids.
e.zh: 尽管输液,病人血压仍然偏低。

e.en: Doctors prescribed a {hypotensive} drug to lower his pressure.
e.zh: 医生开了降压药来降低他的血压。

hypotenuse.t: n. 直角三角形的斜边

e.en: The {hypotenuse} is the longest side of a right triangle.
e.zh: 斜边是直角三角形中最长的一条边。

e.en: Use the Pythagorean theorem to find the {hypotenuse}.
e.zh: 用勾股定理来求斜边的长度。

e.en: The {hypothalamus} regulates body temperature and hunger.
e.zh: 下丘脑负责调节体温和饥饿感。

e.en: Damage to the {hypothalamus} can disrupt sleep cycles.
e.zh: 下丘脑受损会扰乱睡眠周期。

hypothermia.t: n. 体温过低；低体温症

e.en: The hiker nearly died of {hypothermia} on the mountain.
e.zh: 那名徒步者在山上几乎死于体温过低。

e.en: Wet clothes greatly increase the risk of {hypothermia}.
e.zh: 湿衣服会大大增加体温过低的风险。

e.en: Rescuers found the climber {hypothermic} but alive.
e.zh: 救援人员发现登山者体温过低但仍活着。

e.en: Babies can become {hypothermic} surprisingly quickly.
e.zh: 婴儿出现体温过低的速度可能快得惊人。

e.en: Scientists tested several {hypotheses} about the virus's origin.
e.zh: 科学家检验了关于病毒起源的几种假说。

e.en: Most of her {hypotheses} were rejected by the data.
e.zh: 她的大部分假说都被数据推翻了。

e.en: The data strongly supported her {hypothesis} about climate change.
e.zh: 数据有力地支持了她关于气候变化的假说。

e.en: A good {hypothesis} should be both testable and specific.
e.zh: 好的假设应该既可检验又足够具体。

hypothesise.t: v. 假设，推测（英式拼写）

e.en: Researchers {hypothesise} that sleep helps consolidate memories.
e.zh: 研究人员推测睡眠有助于巩固记忆。

e.en: We can {hypothesise} a connection but need more proof.
e.zh: 我们可以假设两者有关联,但还需更多证据。

e.en: Economists {hypothesize} that lower rates will boost spending.
e.zh: 经济学家推测利率降低会刺激消费。

e.en: Scientists {hypothesize} that dark matter shaped early galaxies.
e.zh: 科学家推测暗物质塑造了早期星系。

hypothesized.t: v. 假设（过去式）；假定的

e.en: Newton {hypothesized} that gravity acts at a distance.
e.zh: 牛顿提出引力可在远距离作用的假设。

e.en: She {hypothesized} that the bug came from a race condition.
e.zh: 她推测这个 bug 来自竞态条件。

hypothesizes.t: v. 假设（第三人称单数）

e.en: The paper {hypothesizes} a link between gut bacteria and mood.
e.zh: 这篇论文提出肠道菌群与情绪存在关联。

e.en: He {hypothesizes} that remote work boosts long-term productivity.
e.zh: 他推测远程办公能提升长期生产力。

hypothesizing.t: v. 提出假设（hypothesize 的现在分词）

e.en: She spent the afternoon {hypothesizing} about the strange data.
e.zh: 整个下午她都在对那组奇怪数据提出假设。

e.en: Stop {hypothesizing} and just run the experiment.
e.zh: 别再瞎猜了,直接做实验吧。

e.en: Let's consider a {hypothetical} situation where prices double.
e.zh: 我们来设想一种价格翻倍的假设情境。

e.en: His question was purely {hypothetical}, not a real plan.
e.zh: 他的问题只是假设性的,并不是真实计划。

e.en: {Hypothetically}, what would you do if you won the lottery?
e.zh: 假设一下，如果你中了彩票会怎么做？

e.en: Let's {hypothetically} assume the deal falls through next week.
e.zh: 我们假设这笔交易下周告吹。

hypothyroid.t: adj. 甲状腺功能减退的

e.en: The doctor said her cat is mildly {hypothyroid}.
e.zh: 医生说她的猫有轻度甲状腺功能减退。

e.en: Many {hypothyroid} patients feel tired and gain weight easily.
e.zh: 许多甲减患者容易感到疲倦并体重增加。

hypothyroidism.t: n. 甲状腺功能减退症

e.en: She takes daily medication to manage her {hypothyroidism}.
e.zh: 她每天服药来控制甲状腺功能减退症。

e.en: {Hypothyroidism} can cause fatigue, weight gain, and dry skin.
e.zh: 甲减会导致疲劳、体重增加和皮肤干燥。

hypoxaemia.t: n. 低氧血症（血氧不足）

e.en: The patient developed {hypoxaemia} after the surgery.
e.zh: 病人在手术后出现了低氧血症。

e.en: Severe {hypoxaemia} requires immediate oxygen therapy.
e.zh: 严重的低氧血症需要立即进行氧疗。

e.en: Climbers risk {hypoxia} above eight thousand meters.
e.zh: 登山者在八千米以上有缺氧的风险。

e.en: The pilot lost consciousness due to sudden {hypoxia}.
e.zh: 飞行员因突发缺氧而失去了知觉。

e.en: Athletes train in {hypoxic} chambers to boost endurance.
e.zh: 运动员在低氧舱里训练以提高耐力。

e.en: The patient's brain was {hypoxic} for several minutes.
e.zh: 病人的大脑缺氧了好几分钟。

hyrax.t: n. 蹄兔（小型哺乳动物）

e.en: A small {hyrax} sat sunning itself on the rocks.
e.zh: 一只小蹄兔坐在岩石上晒太阳。

e.en: The {hyrax} is surprisingly related to the elephant.
e.zh: 蹄兔竟然和大象有亲缘关系。

e.en: She added fresh {hyssop} to the lamb stew.
e.zh: 她在炖羊肉里加了新鲜的牛膝草。

e.en: Bees love the purple flowers of the {hyssop} plant.
e.zh: 蜜蜂喜欢牛膝草那紫色的花朵。

e.en: She is recovering well after her {hysterectomy} last month.
e.zh: 她上个月做完子宫切除手术后恢复得很好。

e.en: A {hysterectomy} is sometimes necessary to treat uterine cancer.
e.zh: 有时切除子宫是治疗子宫癌的必要手段。

e.en: Engineers must account for magnetic {hysteresis} in transformer design.
e.zh: 工程师在变压器设计中必须考虑磁滞现象。

e.en: The thermostat uses {hysteresis} to avoid rapid switching.
e.zh: 恒温器利用滞后效应来避免频繁切换。

hysteria.t: n. 歇斯底里；极度恐慌

e.en: Media {hysteria} around the scandal lasted for weeks.
e.zh: 围绕这桩丑闻的媒体狂热持续了好几周。

e.en: There's a lot of {hysteria} online about the new policy.
e.zh: 网上对这项新政策有很多歇斯底里的反应。

hysterias.t: n. 歇斯底里（hysteria 的复数）

e.en: History has seen many moral {hysterias} grip entire nations.
e.zh: 历史上曾出现许多席卷整个国家的道德恐慌。

e.en: The book examines mass {hysterias} from the past century.
e.zh: 这本书研究了上个世纪的多场群体性歇斯底里事件。

hysteric.t:
n. 歇斯底里患者
adj. 歇斯底里的

e.en: Don't be such a {hysteric} about a tiny spider.
e.zh: 别为了一只小蜘蛛就大惊小怪的。

e.en: He was branded a {hysteric} by his cynical colleagues.
e.zh: 他被那些愤世嫉俗的同事说成是歇斯底里的人。

hysterical.t: adj. 歇斯底里的；极其搞笑的

e.en: That meme is absolutely {hysterical} — I can't stop laughing.
e.zh: 那个表情包简直笑死我了，我停不下来。

e.en: She became {hysterical} when she heard the bad news.
e.zh: 听到坏消息时她变得歇斯底里。

hysterically.t: adv. 歇斯底里地；极其地

e.en: The kids were laughing {hysterically} at the cartoon.
e.zh: 孩子们看着动画片笑得前仰后合。

e.en: She sobbed {hysterically} after reading the letter.
e.zh: 读完那封信后她歇斯底里地哭了起来。

hysterics.t: n. 歇斯底里发作；狂笑不止

e.en: His stand-up routine had the audience in {hysterics}.
e.zh: 他的脱口秀让观众笑得前仰后合。

e.en: She went into {hysterics} when she saw the mess.
e.zh: 看到一片狼藉，她当场情绪崩溃。

e.en: We spent the weekend at a quiet seaside {hythe}.
e.zh: 我们在一个安静的海边小码头度过了周末。

e.en: The old {hythe} once served fishing boats from the village.
e.zh: 那座古老的小码头曾经停泊村里的渔船。

hyundai.t: n. 现代（韩国汽车品牌）

e.en: He just bought a new {Hyundai} sedan online.
e.zh: 他刚在网上买了一辆全新的现代轿车。

e.en: {Hyundai} unveiled an electric SUV at the auto show.
e.zh: 现代汽车在车展上发布了一款电动SUV。

hairier.t: a. 多毛的, 毛状的, 长毛的

hairiest.t: a. 多毛的, 毛状的, 长毛的

handsomest.t: a. 英俊的, 大方的, 慷慨的, 相当可观的, 美观的, 灵敏的

handier.t: a. 便利的, 敏捷的, 容易取得的\n[化] 便于使用的; 易操作的

handymen.t: n. 杂务工, 手巧的人, 水手

hangmen.t: n. 绞刑吏, 刽子手\n[法] 执行绞刑者

happier.t: a. 快乐的, 幸福的, 愉快的, 恰当的

happiest.t: a. 快乐的, 幸福的, 愉快的, 恰当的

hardier.t: a. 难的, 艰苦的, 坚硬的, 勇敢的\nadv. 努力地, 辛苦地, 坚硬地

hardiest.t: a. 难的, 艰苦的, 坚硬的, 勇敢的\nadv. 努力地, 辛苦地, 坚硬地

harshest.t: a. 粗糙的, 刺耳的, 严厉的\n[法] 粗糙的, 严厉的, 苛刻的

hastiest.t: a. 匆匆的, 轻率的, 性怠的

hastier.t: a. 匆匆的, 轻率的, 性怠的

haughtiest.t: a. 傲慢的, 骄傲的, 崇高的

haziest.t: a. 朦胧的, 模糊的, 烟雾弥漫的

hazier.t: a. 朦胧的, 模糊的, 烟雾弥漫的

headmen.t: n. 队长, 首领, 酋长\n[经] 领班, 工头

headier.t: a. 顽固的, 任性的, 性急的, 猛烈的

healthier.t: a. 健康的, 有益健康的, 卫生的\n[医] 健康的

healthiest.t: a. 健康的, 有益健康的, 卫生的\n[医] 健康的

heartiest.t: a. 诚恳的, 健壮的, 热烈的, 丰盛的

heartier.t: a. 诚恳的, 健壮的, 热烈的, 丰盛的

heavier.t: a. 重的, 巨大的, 沉重的, 笨重的, 过度的\nadv. 沉重地\nn. 重物, 严肃角色

heaviest.t: a. 重的, 巨大的, 沉重的, 笨重的, 过度的\nadv. 沉重地\nn. 重物, 严肃角色

heftier.t: a. 重的, 肌肉发达的

heftiest.t: a. 重的, 肌肉发达的

henchmen.t: n. 忠实追随者, 党羽, 跟踪者\n[法] 亲信, 心腹, 顺从者

highwaymen.t: n. 路劫, 拦路强盗\n[法] 强盗

hilliest.t: a. 多丘陵的, 多山岗的, 险峻的

e.en: The orchestra played two lively {habaneras} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后，乐队演奏了两首轻快的哈巴涅拉舞曲。

e.en: She studied Cuban {habaneras} for her music thesis.
e.zh: 她为了音乐论文研究古巴哈巴涅拉舞曲。

e.en: Waiting for the results gave me the {habdabs}.
e.zh: 等待结果让我紧张得坐立不安。

e.en: That strange noise always gives her the {habdabs}.
e.zh: 那种怪声总会让她心里发毛。

e.en: The study measured activity in the {habenula}.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了缰核中的活动。

e.en: Damage to the {habenula} may affect mood regulation.
e.zh: 缰核受损可能会影响情绪调节。

e.en: He decided to {haberdash} rather than sell groceries.
e.zh: 他决定经营男装小件，而不是卖杂货。

e.en: The old shop used to {haberdash} for local gentlemen.
e.zh: 这家老店过去为当地绅士经营帽子、领带等用品。

e.en: The knight wore a {habergeon} beneath his cloak.
e.zh: 骑士在披风下面穿着一件短锁子甲。

e.en: The museum displayed a rusty medieval {habergeon}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件生锈的中世纪短锁子甲。

e.en: The essay notes several {habilatory} customs of the court.
e.zh: 文章提到宫廷中几种有关穿着的习俗。

e.en: Her research focused on {habilatory} symbols in medieval art.
e.zh: 她的研究关注中世纪艺术中的服饰象征。

e.en: A {habile} negotiator can calm both sides quickly.
e.zh: 灵巧的谈判者能很快安抚双方。

e.en: His {habile} fingers repaired the watch in minutes.
e.zh: 他灵巧的手指几分钟就修好了那块表。

e.en: The actor wore a royal {habiliment} on stage.
e.zh: 演员在舞台上穿着一身皇家装束。

e.en: Her ceremonial {habiliment} was heavy with embroidery.
e.zh: 她的礼仪服装满是刺绣，显得很厚重。

e.en: The novel describes his {habilimentation} in comic detail.
e.zh: 小说用滑稽的细节描写了他的穿衣打扮。

e.en: Proper {habilimentation} mattered greatly at the ceremony.
e.zh: 在那场仪式上，得体的服饰配备非常重要。

e.en: The dancers were richly {habilimented} for the festival.
e.zh: 舞者们为节日穿上了华丽的服装。

e.en: A strangely {habilimented} figure stood by the gate.
e.zh: 一个穿着奇特的人影站在门边。

e.en: He packed his finest {habiliments} for the visit.
e.zh: 他为这次拜访打包了自己最体面的衣服。

e.en: The priest appeared in white ceremonial {habiliments}.
e.zh: 神父穿着白色礼仪服装出现。

e.en: The university may {habilitate} her as a professor.
e.zh: 大学可能会授予她教授资格。

e.en: The program aims to {habilitate} adults for independent living.
e.zh: 该项目旨在使成年人具备独立生活能力。

e.en: He was {habilitated} after years of academic work.
e.zh: 经过多年学术工作后，他获得了任教资格。

e.en: The center {habilitated} patients to manage daily tasks.
e.zh: 中心帮助患者具备处理日常事务的能力。

e.en: The faculty {habilitates} scholars through a formal review.
e.zh: 学院通过正式评审授予学者资格。

e.en: This training {habilitates} residents for basic employment.
e.zh: 这项培训使居民具备基本就业能力。

habilitating.t: 授予资格的；训练能力的

e.en: She is {habilitating} in modern German history.
e.zh: 她正在现代德国史领域取得任教资格。

e.en: The clinic offers {habilitating} therapy for young children.
e.zh: 诊所为幼儿提供能力训练治疗。

e.en: Her {habilitation} qualified her to teach at the university.
e.zh: 她的任教资格使她可以在大学授课。

e.en: Early {habilitation} can help children with developmental delays.
e.zh: 早期能力训练可以帮助发育迟缓的儿童。

habit-forming.t: 易成瘾的；易养成习惯的

e.en: Some sleeping pills are {habit-forming} if used too often.
e.zh: 有些安眠药如果使用太频繁，容易成瘾。

e.en: Morning walks can become pleasantly {habit-forming}.
e.zh: 晨间散步可能会愉快地变成一种习惯。

e.en: The attic was small but {habitably} warm in winter.
e.zh: 阁楼虽小，但冬天暖和得适合居住。

e.en: They repaired the cabin enough to live {habitably}.
e.zh: 他们把小屋修到足以舒适居住的程度。

e.en: The pilot climbed into the narrow {habitacle}.
e.zh: 飞行员爬进狭窄的驾驶舱。

e.en: The vehicle's {habitacle} was designed for two passengers.
e.zh: 这辆车的乘员舱设计为容纳两名乘客。

e.en: The law recognized their long {habitancy} of the valley.
e.zh: 法律承认他们长期居住在这个山谷。

e.en: The report studied bird {habitancy} in restored wetlands.
e.zh: 这份报告研究了鸟类在修复湿地中的栖居情况。

e.en: A strict routine can be a powerful {habitmaker}.
e.zh: 严格的日常安排会成为强有力的习惯养成因素。

e.en: The coach was a patient {habitmaker} for young athletes.
e.zh: 这位教练耐心地帮助年轻运动员养成习惯。

e.en: His morning walk became a cherished {habitude}.
e.zh: 晨间散步成了他珍视的习惯。

e.en: The novel lingers over the {habitude} of village life.
e.zh: 这部小说细致描写乡村生活的惯常状态。

e.en: A sudden {haboob} swallowed the highway in dust.
e.zh: 突如其来的哈布沙尘暴把公路卷入尘土中。

e.en: Pilots delayed the flight because a {haboob} was approaching.
e.zh: 由于哈布沙尘暴正在逼近，飞行员推迟了航班。

e.en: The guide warned us about the venomous {habu}.
e.zh: 导游提醒我们小心有毒的波布蛇。

e.en: A {habu} was displayed in a jar at the museum.
e.zh: 博物馆里有一条泡在罐中的波布蛇展品。

e.en: The scarf was made of soft {habutai}.
e.zh: 这条围巾是用柔软的羽二重丝绸制成的。

e.en: Designers use {habutai} when they need a light lining.
e.zh: 设计师需要轻薄衬里时会使用羽二重丝绸。

e.en: The letter carries a {hacek} above it.
e.zh: 这个字母上方带有倒置尖音符。

e.en: She forgot the {hacek} when typing the Czech name.
e.zh: 她输入这个捷克名字时忘了加倒置尖音符。

e.en: The old map used {hachure} to show steep slopes.
e.zh: 这张旧地图用地形阴影线表示陡坡。

e.en: Each {hachure} points downhill on the survey drawing.
e.zh: 测绘图上的每条地形阴影线都指向下坡方向。

e.en: The cartographer drew {hachures} along the ridge.
e.zh: 制图员沿山脊画了地形阴影线。

e.en: Dense {hachures} made the mountains look dramatic.
e.zh: 密集的地形阴影线让群山显得很有气势。

e.en: The {haciendado} controlled most of the fertile land.
e.zh: 这位庄园主控制着大部分肥沃土地。

e.en: Workers negotiated wages with the local {haciendado}.
e.zh: 工人们同当地的大地主谈判工资。

e.en: The trainer used a {hackamore} on the young horse.
e.zh: 驯马师给这匹小马用了无衔马笼头。

e.en: A {hackamore} can guide a horse without a bit.
e.zh: 无衔马笼头不用马衔也能引导马匹。

e.en: The soldier carried a heavy {hackbut}.
e.zh: 那名士兵扛着一支沉重的旧式火绳枪。

e.en: A restored {hackbut} stood beside the armor display.
e.zh: 一支修复过的旧式火绳枪陈列在盔甲旁边。

e.en: The {hackbuteer} waited behind the town wall.
e.zh: 火绳枪手在城墙后等待。

e.en: A single {hackbuteer} could slow the cavalry advance.
e.zh: 一名火绳枪手就能拖慢骑兵的推进。

e.en: The review dismissed the script as lazy {hackery}.
e.zh: 评论把这个剧本斥为懒散的蹩脚写作。

e.en: The conference celebrated creative {hackery} and open tools.
e.zh: 这场会议赞赏有创意的黑客实践和开放工具。

e.en: The editor called herself a cheerful {hackette}.
e.zh: 这位编辑自称是个乐观的女雇佣文人。

e.en: A young {hackette} chased quotes outside the courthouse.
e.zh: 一名年轻女记者在法院外追着采访引语。

e.en: He broke the old concrete with a {hackhammer}.
e.zh: 他用凿锤敲碎了旧混凝土。

e.en: The mason chose a {hackhammer} for the rough stone.
e.zh: 石匠选用劈石锤处理这块粗石。

e.en: The {hackie} knew every shortcut downtown.
e.zh: 这位出租车司机熟悉市中心每条近路。

e.en: A tired {hackie} waited outside the station.
e.zh: 一名疲惫的出租车司机在车站外等候。

e.en: The collector bought a small piece of {hackmanite}.
e.zh: 收藏者买了一小块方钠石变种矿物。

e.en: Some {hackmanite} changes color after exposure to sunlight.
e.zh: 有些方钠石变种矿物在日晒后会变色。

e.en: A {hackmatack} grew beside the cold marsh.
e.zh: 一棵美洲落叶松长在寒冷的沼泽旁。

e.en: Settlers used {hackmatack} for tough, curved timber.
e.zh: 定居者用美洲落叶松制作坚韧的弯曲木材。

e.en: The {hackmen} gathered outside the busy theater.
e.zh: 车夫们聚集在热闹的剧院外。

e.en: Several {hackmen} argued over the next fare.
e.zh: 几名出租马车夫为下一位乘客争执起来。

e.en: The article was obvious {hackwork} written overnight.
e.zh: 这篇文章显然是连夜赶出的粗制滥造之作。

e.en: He took {hackwork} to pay the rent.
e.zh: 他接些低质的应付活来付房租。

e.en: The fix works, but it feels {hacky}.
e.zh: 这个修复能用，但感觉很凑合。

e.en: She wrote a {hacky} script to clean the data.
e.zh: 她写了个不太优雅的脚本来清理数据。

e.en: {H'm}, I am not sure that answer is correct.
e.zh: 嗯，我不确定那个答案是对的。

e.en: She said {h'm} before agreeing to the unusual plan.
e.zh: 她先嗯了一声，才同意这个不寻常的计划。

e.en: The plumber installed an {h-bend} beneath the sink.
e.zh: 水管工在水槽下面安装了一个H形弯管。

e.en: A cracked {h-bend} reduced the pressure in the system.
e.zh: 一个开裂的H形弯管降低了系统压力。

e.en: The radar operator checked the {h-display} during the storm.
e.zh: 雷达操作员在暴风雨中查看了H显示屏。

e.en: A dim {h-display} made the altitude data difficult to read.
e.zh: 昏暗的高度显示屏让高度数据很难读取。

e.en: Her {h-index} rose after several papers were widely cited.
e.zh: 几篇论文被广泛引用后，她的H指数上升了。

e.en: Committees should not judge a scholar only by the {h-index}.
e.zh: 委员会不应只凭H指数来评价一位学者。

e.en: The spectrum showed bright {h-lines} from excited hydrogen.
e.zh: 光谱显示出由受激氢产生的明亮氢谱线。

e.en: Astronomers used the {h-lines} to estimate the star's composition.
e.zh: 天文学家利用这些H线估算恒星的组成。

e.en: The circuit diagram included an {h-network} for impedance matching.
e.zh: 电路图中包含一个用于阻抗匹配的H网络。

e.en: Technicians replaced the damaged {h-network} in the transmitter.
e.zh: 技术人员更换了发射机里损坏的桥式电路网络。

e.en: The designer added an {h-pad} to reduce the signal level.
e.zh: 设计师加入了一个H形衰减垫来降低信号电平。

e.en: Each {h-pad} on the board had to be inspected under magnification.
e.zh: 电路板上的每个H形焊盘都必须在放大镜下检查。

e.en: The engineer calculated the transistor's {h-parameters} from the test data.
e.zh: 工程师根据测试数据计算了晶体管的H参数。

e.en: Older textbooks often explain amplifiers using {h-parameters}.
e.zh: 较老的教材常用混合参数来解释放大器。

e.en: The paper proposed an {h-particle} to explain the unusual decay pattern.
e.zh: 这篇论文提出一种H粒子来解释异常的衰变模式。

e.en: No detector has yet confirmed the predicted {h-particle}.
e.zh: 目前还没有探测器证实这种预测中的H粒子。

e.en: The aircraft relied on {h-radar} while descending through fog.
e.zh: 飞机在雾中下降时依靠高度测量雷达。

e.en: A fault in the {h-radar} delayed the test flight.
e.zh: H雷达出现故障，导致试飞推迟。

e.en: The technician adjusted the {h-scan} to center the image.
e.zh: 技术员调整了水平扫描，使图像居中。

e.en: A distorted {h-scan} made the display flicker at the edges.
e.zh: 变形的H扫描让显示画面边缘闪烁。

e.en: The diagram marks the {h-vector} perpendicular to the electric field.
e.zh: 图中标出H矢量与电场方向垂直。

e.en: Students measured the {h-vector} inside the waveguide.
e.zh: 学生们测量了波导内部的磁场强度矢量。

e.en: The antenna was tuned to receive the {h-wave} component clearly.
e.zh: 天线经过调谐，以清楚接收H波分量。

e.en: In the model, the {h-wave} traveled along the metal guide.
e.zh: 在模型中，H波沿着金属导体传播。

e.en: He would not spend a {ha'p'orth} more on the broken cart.
e.zh: 他不愿再为那辆坏车多花半便士。

e.en: There is not a {ha'p'orth} of truth in that rumor.
e.zh: 那个谣言里连一点点真实都没有。

e.en: The garden's {ha-ha} kept sheep out without blocking the view.
e.zh: 花园里的隐墙壕沟挡住了羊，却不遮挡视野。

e.en: His loud {ha-ha} echoed across the empty hall.
e.zh: 他响亮的哈哈笑声在空大厅里回荡。

e.en: The crew sailed to the {haaf} before dawn.
e.zh: 船员们在黎明前驶向远海渔场。

e.en: Old islanders still remember the dangers of {haaf} fishing.
e.zh: 岛上的老人仍记得远海捕鱼的危险。

e.en: A thick {haar} rolled in from the North Sea.
e.zh: 一阵浓重的海雾从北海涌来。

e.en: The village disappeared when the {haar} covered the coast.
e.zh: 海雾笼罩海岸时，村庄消失在雾中。

e.en: The orchestra played a slow {habanera} during the festival.
e.zh: 管弦乐队在节日期间演奏了一首缓慢的哈巴涅拉舞曲。

e.en: She learned the {habanera} from a Cuban dance teacher.
e.zh: 她向一位古巴舞蹈老师学习了哈巴涅拉舞。

e.en: Scientists found microbes in the {hadal} trench.
e.zh: 科学家在超深海海沟中发现了微生物。

e.en: The {hadal} zone lies deeper than most submarines can go.
e.zh: 深渊带位于大多数潜艇无法到达的深处。

e.en: I {hadda} leave before the storm arrived.
e.zh: 暴风雨来之前我不得不离开。

e.en: She said she {hadda} work late again.
e.zh: 她说她又得加班到很晚。

e.en: The geologist measured the vein's {hade}.
e.zh: 地质学家测量了矿脉的倾角。

e.en: The fault planes {hade} toward the valley.
e.zh: 这些断层面向山谷方向倾斜。

e.en: The scholar quoted a {hadith} during the lecture.
e.zh: 学者在讲座中引用了一段圣训。

e.en: Many legal debates refer to collections of {hadith}.
e.zh: 许多法律讨论都会参考圣训汇编。

e.en: His grandfather made the {hadj} in old age.
e.zh: 他的祖父晚年完成了麦加朝觐。

e.en: The family saved money for the {hadj}.
e.zh: 这家人为去麦加朝圣攒钱。

e.en: The villagers welcomed the {hadji} home.
e.zh: 村民们欢迎这位朝觐者回家。

e.en: He was respectfully called {hadji} after the pilgrimage.
e.zh: 朝觐之后，人们尊称他为哈吉。

e.en: Several {hadjis} returned on the same flight.
e.zh: 几位朝觐者乘同一班飞机返回。

e.en: The guide helped the {hadjis} through the crowded streets.
e.zh: 向导带着朝觐者们穿过拥挤的街道。

e.en: A {hadrosaurus} skeleton stood near the museum entrance.
e.zh: 一具鸭嘴龙骨架立在博物馆入口附近。

e.en: Children drew a {hadrosaurus} with a long tail.
e.zh: 孩子们画了一只长尾巴的鸭嘴龙。

e.en: Thou {hadst} no reason to fear.
e.zh: 你当时没有理由害怕。

e.en: If thou {hadst} listened, all might be well.
e.zh: 如果你当初听从了，一切也许都会好。

e.en: They {hae} little time to spare.
e.zh: 他们几乎没有多余时间。

e.en: Ye {hae} done enough for today.
e.zh: 你们今天已经做得够多了。

e.en: The philosopher discussed the {haecceity} of each person.
e.zh: 哲学家讨论了每个人独特的个体性。

e.en: A portrait can suggest the {haecceity} of its subject.
e.zh: 一幅肖像能暗示被画者的独特此性。

e.en: The enzyme binds to {haem} inside the cell.
e.zh: 这种酶会与细胞内的血红素结合。

e.en: Dietary iron is partly absorbed as {haem}.
e.zh: 食物中的铁有一部分以血红素形式被吸收。

haemachrome.t: 血色素；血红蛋白衍生物

e.en: The sample contained a dark {haemachrome} pigment.
e.zh: 样本中含有一种深色的血色素。

e.en: Researchers identified {haemachrome} in the preserved tissue.
e.zh: 研究人员在保存的组织中鉴定出血红蛋白衍生物。

e.en: She counted the cells with a {haemacytometer}.
e.zh: 她用血细胞计数板统计细胞数量。

e.en: The lab cleaned the {haemacytometer} after each use.
e.zh: 实验室每次使用后都会清洗血细胞计数板。

e.en: Some viruses can {haemagglutinate} red blood cells.
e.zh: 有些病毒能使红细胞发生凝集。

e.en: The assay showed that the serum did not {haemagglutinate}.
e.zh: 检测显示这种血清不会引起红细胞凝集。

e.en: The test detected {haemagglutination} in the sample.
e.zh: 这项检测在样本中发现了红细胞凝集反应。

e.en: Vaccines are often studied with {haemagglutination} assays.
e.zh: 疫苗研究常使用红细胞凝集试验。

e.en: Influenza viruses carry {haemagglutinin} on their surface.
e.zh: 流感病毒表面带有血凝素。

e.en: The vaccine targets a changing {haemagglutinin} protein.
e.zh: 这种疫苗针对一种不断变化的血凝素蛋白。

e.en: The old manual listed the herb as a {haemagogue}.
e.zh: 那本旧手册把这种草药列为促血行药。

e.en: Doctors no longer use that substance as a {haemagogue}.
e.zh: 医生已不再把那种物质用作通经药。

haemal.t: 血液的；血管的；腹侧的；血腔的

e.en: The surgeon identified a {haemal} vessel near the spine.
e.zh: 外科医生在脊柱附近辨认出一条血管。

e.en: In fish anatomy, the {haemal} arch protects major vessels.
e.zh: 在鱼类解剖中，血弓保护主要血管。

e.en: The baby's {haemangioma} faded during childhood.
e.zh: 这个婴儿的血管瘤在童年时期逐渐消退。

e.en: Doctors removed a painful {haemangioma} from her liver.
e.zh: 医生切除了她肝脏上的一个疼痛性血管瘤。

e.en: The paper described the {haematal} side of the vertebra.
e.zh: 论文描述了椎骨的腹侧面。

e.en: Older texts sometimes use {haematal} for blood-related structures.
e.zh: 较早的文献有时用haematal指与血液有关的结构。

haematein.t: 苏木精氧化色素；苏木红

e.en: The stain depends on {haematein} binding to cell nuclei.
e.zh: 这种染色依赖苏木红与细胞核结合。

e.en: Fresh {haematein} gave the sample a sharper contrast.
e.zh: 新鲜的苏木红让样本对比更清晰。

e.en: Severe {haematemesis} requires urgent medical assessment.
e.zh: 严重呕血需要立即接受医学评估。

e.en: The nurse recorded one episode of {haematemesis} overnight.
e.zh: 护士记录到夜间发生过一次呕血。

e.en: The lab measured several {haematic} changes after treatment.
e.zh: 实验室测量了治疗后的几项血液变化。

e.en: A dark {haematic} stain marked the old bandage.
e.zh: 旧绷带上有一块深色的血样污迹。

e.en: The rare condition {haematidrosis} can alarm patients and families.
e.zh: 罕见的血汗症会让患者和家属感到惊慌。

e.en: Ancient writers described {haematidrosis} under extreme stress.
e.zh: 古代作者描述过极端压力下出现的血汗症。

haematin.t: 血红素衍生物；高铁血红素

e.en: The reaction produced {haematin} from damaged blood pigment.
e.zh: 该反应由受损的血色素生成了高铁血红素。

e.en: Crystals of {haematin} helped confirm the forensic sample.
e.zh: 高铁血红素晶体帮助确认了这份法医样本。

e.en: The old manual called the pigment {haematine}.
e.zh: 那本旧手册把这种色素称为haematine。

e.en: Some dyers used {haematine} to produce a reddish tone.
e.zh: 一些染工用苏木红来产生偏红的色调。

e.en: Iron is a common {haematinic} prescribed for anaemia.
e.zh: 铁剂是治疗贫血时常用的补血药。

e.en: The doctor recommended a {haematinic} supplement after surgery.
e.zh: 医生建议她术后服用促进造血的补充剂。

e.en: The valley contains rich deposits of {haematite}.
e.zh: 这个山谷含有丰富的赤铁矿矿床。

e.en: Polished {haematite} has a dark metallic shine.
e.zh: 抛光后的赤铁矿带有深色金属光泽。

e.en: Early histologists used {haematoblast} for a developing blood cell.
e.zh: 早期组织学家用haematoblast指发育中的血细胞。

e.en: The term {haematoblast} once referred to platelets in medical texts.
e.zh: haematoblast这个词曾在医学文献中指血小板。

e.en: Ultrasound showed a {haematocele} around the injured testicle.
e.zh: 超声显示受伤睾丸周围有积血肿。

e.en: The surgeon drained the painful {haematocele} carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生小心地引流了这个疼痛的血肿性囊肿。

e.en: Sudden {haematochezia} may signal lower gastrointestinal bleeding.
e.zh: 突然便血可能提示下消化道出血。

e.en: The patient denied pain but reported {haematochezia}.
e.zh: 患者否认疼痛，但报告有鲜血便。

haematocrit.t: 红细胞压积；血细胞比容

e.en: Her {haematocrit} rose after the transfusion.
e.zh: 输血后，她的红细胞压积升高了。

e.en: Dehydration can make the {haematocrit} appear unusually high.
e.zh: 脱水会使血细胞比容看起来异常偏高。

e.en: The zoologist classified the reptile as {haematocryal}.
e.zh: 动物学家把这种爬行动物归为冷血动物。

e.en: Older biology books used {haematocryal} for cold-blooded species.
e.zh: 较早的生物书用haematocryal指冷血物种。

e.en: Octopus blood carries oxygen with {haematocyanin}.
e.zh: 章鱼血液通过血蓝蛋白运输氧气。

e.en: The copper in {haematocyanin} gives some blood a bluish color.
e.zh: 血蓝蛋白中的铜使某些血液呈蓝色。

e.en: Each {haematocyte} was counted under the microscope.
e.zh: 每个血细胞都在显微镜下被计数。

e.en: The parasite invaded a circulating {haematocyte}.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫侵入了一个循环中的血细胞。

e.en: The smear revealed a {haematocytozoon} inside red cells.
e.zh: 涂片显示红细胞内有血细胞寄生原虫。

e.en: Researchers tracked the {haematocytozoon} through its insect host.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪这种血细胞寄生原虫在昆虫宿主体内的过程。

e.en: Bone marrow is central to {haematogenesis} in adults.
e.zh: 骨髓是成人造血的核心部位。

e.en: The study examined {haematogenesis} after severe radiation exposure.
e.zh: 该研究考察了严重辐射暴露后的血液生成。

e.en: The drug showed a strong {haematogenic} effect in trials.
e.zh: 这种药在试验中显示出明显的造血作用。

e.en: Doctors suspected a {haematogenic} spread of the infection.
e.zh: 医生怀疑感染是经血源性传播的。

e.en: The infection reached the bone by {haematogenous} spread.
e.zh: 感染通过血源性播散到达骨骼。

e.en: A {haematogenous} tumour deposit appeared in the liver.
e.zh: 肝脏出现了一个血源性肿瘤沉积灶。

e.en: The mineral had a dark {haematoid} streak.
e.zh: 这种矿物有一道深色的血样条痕。

e.en: Pathologists noted {haematoid} material in the cyst.
e.zh: 病理学家注意到囊肿内有似血物质。

e.en: A {haematologist} reviewed the abnormal blood results.
e.zh: 一位血液科医生复查了异常的血液结果。

e.en: The {haematologist} studies how leukaemia cells resist treatment.
e.zh: 这位血液学家研究白血病细胞如何抵抗治疗。

e.en: The toxin caused rapid {haematolysis} in the sample.
e.zh: 这种毒素使样本迅速发生溶血。

e.en: Laboratory staff checked whether storage had caused {haematolysis}.
e.zh: 实验室人员检查储存过程是否导致了血细胞破裂。

haggish.t: 像丑老太婆的；巫婆似的

e.en: The mask gave him a {haggish} grin.
e.zh: 那副面具让他露出巫婆似的狞笑。

e.en: She disliked the portrait's {haggish} exaggeration.
e.zh: 她不喜欢那幅画像把人画得像丑老太婆般夸张。

haggishly.t: 像巫婆般；丑老太婆似地

e.en: The old actor laughed {haggishly} on stage.
e.zh: 那位老演员在台上像巫婆般大笑。

e.en: The villain was painted {haggishly} in the cartoon.
e.zh: 漫画里那个反派被画得像丑老太婆一样。

e.en: The sect imagined a future {hagiarchy}.
e.zh: 这个教派设想未来会出现圣徒统治。

e.en: Critics mocked the council as a {hagiarchy}.
e.zh: 批评者嘲笑那个委员会像圣人政体。

e.en: His utopia depended on a perfect {hagiocracy}.
e.zh: 他的乌托邦依赖一种完美的圣徒统治。

e.en: The novel satirizes politics as {hagiocracy}.
e.zh: 这部小说把政治讽刺成圣人政体。

e.en: A devout {hagiolater} collected relics from every shrine.
e.zh: 一位虔诚的圣徒崇拜者收集各处圣祠的遗物。

e.en: The historian was no blind {hagiolater}.
e.zh: 那位历史学家并不是盲目的圣徒崇拜者。

hagiolatrous.t: 崇拜圣徒的；圣徒崇拜的

e.en: The chapel kept a {hagiolatrous} atmosphere.
e.zh: 那座小教堂保留着崇拜圣徒的氛围。

e.en: Her biography avoided a {hagiolatrous} tone.
e.zh: 她的传记避免了圣徒崇拜式的口吻。

e.en: Reformers condemned the practice as {hagiolatry}.
e.zh: 改革者谴责这种做法是圣徒崇拜。

e.en: The memoir slips into political {hagiolatry}.
e.zh: 这本回忆录流于政治上的过度颂圣。

hagiologic.t: 圣徒传研究的；圣徒传的

e.en: The scholar cited a rare {hagiologic} text.
e.zh: 那位学者引用了一部罕见的圣徒传研究文本。

e.en: Its {hagiologic} details impressed medievalists.
e.zh: 其中关于圣徒传的细节令中世纪研究者印象深刻。

hagiological.t: 圣徒传研究的；圣徒传的

e.en: She published a {hagiological} study of Irish saints.
e.zh: 她发表了一项关于爱尔兰圣徒的圣徒传研究。

e.en: The archive holds many {hagiological} manuscripts.
e.zh: 档案馆收藏了许多圣徒传手稿。

hagiologist.t: 圣徒传研究者；圣徒传作者

e.en: The {hagiologist} compared several medieval legends.
e.zh: 那位圣徒传研究者比较了几个中世纪传说。

e.en: A careful {hagiologist} noted the doubtful miracle.
e.zh: 一位谨慎的圣徒传作者记录了那个可疑的奇迹。

e.en: Her thesis focused on Byzantine {hagiology}.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦于拜占庭圣徒传学。

e.en: The library's {hagiology} collection is extensive.
e.zh: 图书馆的圣徒文献收藏十分丰富。

e.en: A narrow {hagioscope} looked toward the altar.
e.zh: 一扇狭窄的教堂斜视窗朝向祭坛。

e.en: Visitors noticed the medieval {hagioscope} in the wall.
e.zh: 游客注意到墙上的中世纪望圣窗。

hagioscopic.t: 教堂斜视窗的；望圣窗的

e.en: The guide explained the {hagioscopic} opening.
e.zh: 导游解释了那个教堂斜视窗开口。

e.en: Its {hagioscopic} angle revealed the altar.
e.zh: 它的望圣窗角度能看到祭坛。

hagridden.t: 受噩梦折磨的；苦恼不堪的

e.en: He woke {hagridden} after another nightmare.
e.zh: 又做了一场噩梦后，他醒来时备受折磨。

e.en: The scandal left the minister {hagridden}.
e.zh: 那桩丑闻让部长苦恼不堪。

hagride.t: 使受噩梦折磨；不断困扰

e.en: Old debts continued to {hagride} the family.
e.zh: 旧债仍不断困扰着这个家庭。

e.en: In folklore, witches could {hagride} sleepers.
e.zh: 在民间传说中，女巫会让睡梦中的人受噩梦折磨。

hagseed.t: 丑老太婆的后代；卑贱之人

e.en: The insult {hagseed} sounds archaic today.
e.zh: hagseed这个骂人的词如今听起来很古旧。

e.en: Shakespeare used {hagseed} as a bitter curse.
e.zh: 莎士比亚把hagseed用作恶毒的咒骂。

e.en: She replied with a quick {haha}.
e.zh: 她很快回了一声哈哈。

e.en: The message ended with {haha} and a smile.
e.zh: 那条消息以哈哈和一个笑脸结尾。

e.en: Some old tables listed element 105 as {hahnium}.
e.zh: 一些旧元素表把105号元素列为hahnium。

e.en: The name {hahnium} was later abandoned officially.
e.zh: hahnium这个名称后来被官方弃用。

e.en: He wrapped a white {haick} around his shoulders.
e.zh: 他把一条白色北非长方披巾裹在肩上。

e.en: The museum displayed a striped {haick}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一条有条纹的北非披巾。

e.en: The traveler bought a wool {haik}.
e.zh: 那名旅行者买了一条羊毛北非长方披巾。

e.en: A loose {haik} protected her from the sun.
e.zh: 一条宽松的北非披巾为她遮挡阳光。

e.en: The scan showed a small {haematoma} under the skin.
e.zh: 扫描显示皮肤下面有一个小血肿。

e.en: A large {haematoma} formed after the injury.
e.zh: 受伤后形成了一个较大的瘀血肿块。

e.en: The technician cleaned the {haematometer} before the test.
e.zh: 技术员在检测前清洁了血液测量仪。

e.en: An old {haematometer} was kept in the teaching lab.
e.zh: 教学实验室里保存着一台旧式血细胞计。

e.en: Mosquitoes are {haematophagous} insects.
e.zh: 蚊子是吸血昆虫。

e.en: The study focused on {haematophagous} parasites in cattle.
e.zh: 这项研究关注牛身上的吸血寄生虫。

haematophyte.t: 血寄生植物；血中微生物

e.en: The old paper described a supposed {haematophyte} in infected blood.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文描述了一种据称存在于感染血液中的血中微生物。

e.en: The term {haematophyte} is rarely used in modern biology.
e.zh: 现代生物学中很少使用血寄生植物这个术语。

e.en: Bone marrow is essential for {haematopoiesis}.
e.zh: 骨髓对造血至关重要。

e.en: The drug may suppress normal {haematopoiesis}.
e.zh: 这种药物可能会抑制正常的血细胞生成。

e.en: The patient received a {haematopoietic} stem cell transplant.
e.zh: 患者接受了造血干细胞移植。

e.en: Radiation can damage {haematopoietic} tissue.
e.zh: 辐射会损伤造血组织。

e.en: The lecture defined {haematosis} as oxygenation of the blood.
e.zh: 讲座把血液氧合定义为haematosis。

e.en: Older texts used {haematosis} for the process of blood formation.
e.zh: 较早的文献用haematosis指造血过程。

e.en: Birds are {haematothermal} animals.
e.zh: 鸟类是温血动物。

e.en: The word {haematothermal} appears mostly in older zoology books.
e.zh: haematothermal这个词多见于较早的动物学书籍。

e.en: The microscope revealed {haematozoa} in the blood sample.
e.zh: 显微镜显示血样中有血寄生虫。

e.en: Malaria parasites are often discussed as {haematozoa}.
e.zh: 疟原虫常被作为血中原虫来讨论。

e.en: A single {haematozoon} was visible in the stained smear.
e.zh: 染色涂片中可见一个血寄生虫。

e.en: The doctor suspected a {haematozoon} caused the fever.
e.zh: 医生怀疑发热是由一种血中原虫引起的。

e.en: The patient reported painless {haematuria}.
e.zh: 患者报告有无痛性血尿。

e.en: Severe exercise can sometimes cause temporary {haematuria}.
e.zh: 剧烈运动有时会导致暂时性尿中带血。

e.en: The doctor noted several {haemic} abnormalities.
e.zh: 医生记录了几项血液异常。

e.en: Iron deficiency can cause {haemic} changes.
e.zh: 缺铁会引起与血液有关的变化。

e.en: The lab prepared {haemin} from the blood sample.
e.zh: 实验室从血样中制备了氯化血红素。

e.en: Crystals of {haemin} helped confirm the stain was blood.
e.zh: 血晶素晶体帮助确认该污渍是血迹。

e.en: The diagram labelled the early cell as a {haemoblast}.
e.zh: 图中把这种早期细胞标为成血细胞。

e.en: Older hematology texts mention the {haemoblast} as a precursor cell.
e.zh: 较早的血液学教材把造血母细胞称为前体细胞。

e.en: The pigment was identified as a {haemochrome}.
e.zh: 这种色素被鉴定为血色素。

e.en: A reduced {haemochrome} gave the sample its color.
e.zh: 还原态含血红素色素使样品呈现这种颜色。

haemochromogen.t: 血色原；还原血红素化合物

e.en: The chemist tested the sample for {haemochromogen}.
e.zh: 化学师检测样品中是否有血色原。

e.en: Reduced {haemochromogen} has a characteristic spectrum.
e.zh: 还原血红素化合物有特征性的光谱。

e.en: In insects, blood circulates through the {haemocoele}.
e.zh: 在昆虫体内，血液在血腔中循环。

e.en: The larva's {haemocoele} was filled with fluid.
e.zh: 幼虫的昆虫体腔充满了液体。

haemocyanin.t: 血蓝蛋白；含铜呼吸蛋白

e.en: Many molluscs use {haemocyanin} to carry oxygen.
e.zh: 许多软体动物用血蓝蛋白运输氧气。

e.en: Unlike haemoglobin, {haemocyanin} contains copper.
e.zh: 与血红蛋白不同，血蓝蛋白含有铜。

e.en: Each {haemocyte} was counted under the microscope.
e.zh: 每个血细胞都在显微镜下计数。

e.en: An insect {haemocyte} can help fight infection.
e.zh: 昆虫的血淋巴细胞可以帮助抵抗感染。

haemocytoblast.t: 造血干细胞；成血母细胞

e.en: A {haemocytoblast} can develop into several blood cell types.
e.zh: 造血干细胞可以发育成多种血细胞。

e.en: The textbook called the precursor a {haemocytoblast}.
e.zh: 教材把这种前体细胞称为成血母细胞。

e.en: She counted the cells with a {haemocytometer}.
e.zh: 她用血细胞计数板计算细胞数量。

e.en: The {haemocytometer} must be filled without bubbles.
e.zh: 血球计必须注入样本且不能有气泡。

e.en: The patient remained {haemodynamic}ally stable overnight.
e.zh: 患者整夜保持血流动力学稳定。

e.en: The device records {haemodynamic} pressure changes.
e.zh: 该设备记录血流动力学压力变化。

e.en: The course covers cardiac {haemodynamics}.
e.zh: 这门课程讲授心脏血流动力学。

e.en: Sepsis can seriously alter {haemodynamics}.
e.zh: 败血症会严重改变血流动力学。

haemoflagellate.t: 血鞭毛虫；血液鞭毛原虫

e.en: The parasite was classified as a {haemoflagellate}.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫被归为血鞭毛虫。

e.en: A {haemoflagellate} may be transmitted by biting insects.
e.zh: 血液鞭毛原虫可能由叮咬昆虫传播。

e.en: The clinic used {haemoglobinometry} to screen for anaemia.
e.zh: 诊所用血红蛋白测定法筛查贫血。

e.en: Accurate {haemoglobinometry} depends on proper calibration.
e.zh: 准确的血红蛋白测定法取决于正确校准。

e.en: The clinic screens newborns for inherited {haemoglobinopathies}.
e.zh: 这家诊所会筛查新生儿是否患有遗传性血红蛋白病。

e.en: Several {haemoglobinopathies} are more common in malaria regions.
e.zh: 几种血红蛋白病在疟疾流行地区更常见。

e.en: Sickle cell disease is a serious {haemoglobinopathy}.
e.zh: 镰状细胞病是一种严重的血红蛋白病。

e.en: Genetic testing confirmed the child's {haemoglobinopathy}.
e.zh: 基因检测确认了这个孩子患有血红蛋白病。

e.en: Dark urine after exercise suggested {haemoglobinuria}.
e.zh: 运动后尿色变深提示可能有血红蛋白尿。

e.en: The report listed {haemoglobinuria} among the warning signs.
e.zh: 报告把血红蛋白尿列为警示症状之一。

e.en: The sample had a {haemoid} stain under the lens.
e.zh: 样本在镜下呈现类似血液的染色。

e.en: Researchers described the pigment as {haemoid} rather than true blood.
e.zh: 研究人员称这种色素像血，但并非真正的血液。

e.en: Insects circulate nutrients through their {haemolymph}.
e.zh: 昆虫通过血淋巴输送营养物质。

e.en: The parasite was found in the crab's {haemolymph}.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫是在螃蟹的血淋巴中发现的。

e.en: Some bacterial toxins can {haemolyse} red blood cells.
e.zh: 有些细菌毒素能使红细胞溶解。

e.en: Rough handling may {haemolyse} the blood sample.
e.zh: 操作粗暴可能会导致血液样本发生溶血。

e.en: The bacterium produces a powerful {haemolysin}.
e.zh: 这种细菌会产生一种强效溶血素。

e.en: The test detected {haemolysin} in the culture.
e.zh: 检测在培养物中发现了溶血素。

e.en: The lab rejected the tube because of {haemolysis}.
e.zh: 实验室因样本发生溶血而退回了那支试管。

e.en: Certain drugs can trigger severe {haemolysis}.
e.zh: 某些药物可能引发严重的红细胞破裂。

e.en: The solution can {haemolyze} fragile cells quickly.
e.zh: 这种溶液能迅速使脆弱的细胞溶血。

e.en: Do not shake the vial, or you may {haemolyze} the specimen.
e.zh: 不要摇晃小瓶，否则可能让标本发生溶血。

e.en: A {haemophile} needs treatment before major surgery.
e.zh: 血友病患者在大手术前需要接受治疗。

e.en: The charity supports every young {haemophile} in the region.
e.zh: 该慈善机构帮助本地区每一位年轻血友病患者。

e.en: The doctor reviewed the boy's {haemophilic} history.
e.zh: 医生查看了这个男孩的血友病病史。

e.en: A {haemophilic} patient may bleed longer after injury.
e.zh: 患血友病的病人受伤后出血时间可能更长。

e.en: The child showed a {haemophilioid} bleeding pattern.
e.zh: 这个孩子表现出类似血友病的出血模式。

e.en: Doctors noted {haemophilioid} symptoms after the treatment.
e.zh: 医生注意到治疗后出现了类似血友病的症状。

e.en: Bone marrow is central to {haemopoiesis}.
e.zh: 骨髓是造血作用的核心部位。

e.en: Chemotherapy can temporarily suppress {haemopoiesis}.
e.zh: 化疗可能暂时抑制造血作用。

e.en: Persistent {haemoptysis} requires urgent assessment.
e.zh: 持续咯血需要紧急评估。

e.en: The patient denied fever but reported mild {haemoptysis}.
e.zh: 患者否认发热，但报告有轻微咯血。

e.en: She recovered slowly after the {haemorrhoidectomy}.
e.zh: 她在痔切除术后恢复得比较慢。

e.en: A {haemorrhoidectomy} is usually reserved for severe cases.
e.zh: 痔切除术通常只用于严重病例。

haemospasia.t: 拔罐引血；局部充血疗法

e.en: Older manuals described {haemospasia} as a therapeutic method.
e.zh: 旧版手册把拔罐引血描述为一种治疗方法。

e.en: The lecturer mentioned {haemospasia} only as a historical practice.
e.zh: 讲师只是把局部充血疗法作为历史做法提了一下。

e.en: The surgeon achieved {haemostasia} before closing the wound.
e.zh: 外科医生在缝合伤口前完成了止血。

e.en: Old texts used {haemostasia} to describe arrested bleeding.
e.zh: 旧文献用haemostasia描述出血停止的状态。

e.en: Platelets play a key role in {haemostasis}.
e.zh: 血小板在止血过程中起关键作用。

e.en: The drug may disturb normal {haemostasis}.
e.zh: 这种药物可能扰乱正常的凝血平衡。

e.en: The nurse handed the surgeon a {haemostat}.
e.zh: 护士递给外科医生一把止血钳。

e.en: A topical {haemostat} helped control the bleeding.
e.zh: 一种外用止血剂帮助控制了出血。

e.en: They applied a {haemostatic} dressing to the wound.
e.zh: 他们给伤口敷上了止血敷料。

e.en: The study compared several {haemostatic} agents.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了几种止血剂。

e.en: The scan revealed a left-sided {haemothorax}.
e.zh: 扫描显示左侧有血胸。

e.en: Chest trauma can cause a dangerous {haemothorax}.
e.zh: 胸部外伤可能导致危险的血胸。

e.en: The physician recorded {haemuresis} in the notes.
e.zh: 医生在病历中记录了血尿。

e.en: Painful {haemuresis} can indicate a urinary stone.
e.zh: 伴疼痛的血尿可能提示泌尿系结石。

e.en: He did not care a {haet} for the warning.
e.zh: 他对那个警告一点儿也不在乎。

e.en: There was not a {haet} of truth in it.
e.zh: 那里面没有丝毫真实成分。

e.en: The old sailor rubbed his {haffet} thoughtfully.
e.zh: 老水手若有所思地揉了揉自己的脸颊。

e.en: A cold wind struck her left {haffet}.
e.zh: 冷风吹打着她左边的脸颊。

e.en: The child had a smear of jam on one {haffit}.
e.zh: 孩子一边脸颊上沾着一点果酱。

e.en: He turned his {haffit} toward the fire.
e.zh: 他把脸的一侧转向炉火。

e.en: The village respected him as a learned {hafiz}.
e.zh: 村里人敬重他，认为他是博学的古兰经背诵者。

e.en: A young {hafiz} recited before the congregation.
e.zh: 一位年轻的古兰经背诵者在会众面前诵读。

e.en: The coating contains {hafnia} for heat resistance.
e.zh: 这种涂层含有氧化铪，以提高耐热性。

e.en: Engineers tested {hafnia} in the ceramic layer.
e.zh: 工程师在陶瓷层中测试了氧化铪。

e.en: The paper described a new {hafnifluoride} compound.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种新的氟化铪化合物。

e.en: They heated the {hafnifluoride} sample under vacuum.
e.zh: 他们在真空中加热了那份氟化铪样品。

e.en: He chanted the {hafta} after the Torah reading.
e.zh: 在诵读《托拉》之后，他吟诵了先知书选读。

e.en: The rabbi explained the week's {hafta} to the class.
e.zh: 拉比向全班讲解了本周的先知书选读。

e.en: She practiced the {haftarah} for her ceremony.
e.zh: 她为自己的仪式练习诵读先知书选段。

e.en: The {haftarah} was read in a clear voice.
e.zh: 那段先知书选读被人用清晰的声音读出。

e.en: He woke {hag-ridden} after another restless night.
e.zh: 又一个不安的夜晚之后，他醒来时像被噩梦折磨过。

e.en: Her {hag-ridden} face showed weeks of worry.
e.zh: 她憔悴的脸显出几周来的忧虑。

e.en: The collector labeled the specimen as {hagatalite}.
e.zh: 收藏者把这块标本标为哈加塔石。

e.en: Few museums display {hagatalite} in their mineral cases.
e.zh: 很少有博物馆在矿物展柜中展示哈加塔石。

e.en: A {hagberry} grew beside the old stone wall.
e.zh: 老石墙旁长着一棵稠李树。

e.en: Birds gathered to eat the dark {hagberries}.
e.zh: 鸟儿聚在一起啄食那些深色的稠李果。

hagborn.t: 女巫所生的；邪恶出身的

e.en: The tale calls the prince {hagborn} and cursed.
e.zh: 故事称那位王子为女巫所生，并且受到诅咒。

e.en: Villagers feared the {hagborn} child in the legend.
e.zh: 村民害怕传说中那个邪恶出身的孩子。

e.en: The soldier carried a heavy {hagbut} into battle.
e.zh: 士兵扛着一支沉重的旧式火绳枪上了战场。

e.en: A rusty {hagbut} hung above the tavern door.
e.zh: 一支生锈的旧式火绳枪挂在酒馆门上方。

e.en: A lone {hagden} circled above the cliff.
e.zh: 一只大型海鸥独自在悬崖上方盘旋。

e.en: Fishermen watched the {hagden} follow their boat.
e.zh: 渔民看着那只海鸟跟在他们的船后。

e.en: The {hagdon} cried loudly over the harbor.
e.zh: 那只大型海鸥在港口上空大声鸣叫。

e.en: Old books sometimes name the shearwater a {hagdon}.
e.zh: 旧书有时把某种海鸥或海鸟称作hagdon。

e.en: A {hagfish} can produce thick slime when threatened.
e.zh: 盲鳗受到威胁时会分泌黏稠的黏液。

e.en: The biologist studied {hagfish} feeding behavior.
e.zh: 那位生物学家研究盲鳗的进食行为。

e.en: The family read from the {haggada} at dinner.
e.zh: 一家人在晚餐时诵读了逾越节讲述文本。

e.en: This old {haggada} has beautiful illustrations.
e.zh: 这本古老的逾越节讲述文本配有精美插图。

e.en: They opened the {haggadah} before the Passover meal.
e.zh: 逾越节晚餐前，他们打开了讲述文本。

e.en: Her grandmother kept a handwritten {haggadah}.
e.zh: 她的祖母保存着一本手写的逾越节讲述文本。

e.en: The scholar discussed a {haggadic} interpretation of the verse.
e.zh: 学者讨论了对这节经文的哈加达式解释。

e.en: His sermon used several {haggadic} stories.
e.zh: 他的讲道用了几个犹太讲述传统中的故事。

e.en: The {haggadist} connected law with memorable stories.
e.zh: 这位哈加达学者把律法和令人难忘的故事联系起来。

e.en: A skilled {haggadist} could hold the audience's attention.
e.zh: 熟练的讲述者能牢牢吸引听众的注意。

e.en: The passage has a strongly {haggadistic} tone.
e.zh: 这段文字带有很强的哈加达式语气。

e.en: He preferred {haggadistic} teaching to dry legal debate.
e.zh: 比起枯燥的法律辩论，他更喜欢哈加达式的讲授。

e.en: The library owns several medieval {haggadoth}.
e.zh: 这座图书馆收藏了几部中世纪哈加达文本。

e.en: Collectors compared the illustrations in the {haggadoth}.
e.zh: 收藏者比较了这些哈加达文本中的插图。

e.en: He greeted every stranger like a {hail-fellow}.
e.zh: 他像热情老友一样招呼每个陌生人。

e.en: The mayor's {hail-fellow} manner charmed the crowd.
e.zh: 市长那种亲热随和的作风迷住了人群。

e.en: His {hail-fellow-well-met} style annoyed the quieter guests.
e.zh: 他那种过分亲热随和的作风让较安静的客人反感。

e.en: She gave a {hail-fellow-well-met} laugh at every joke.
e.zh: 每个笑话她都报以一种故作亲热的笑声。

e.en: The car missed the cyclist by a {hair-breadth}.
e.zh: 那辆车以毫厘之差避开了骑车人。

e.en: They won the vote by a {hair-breadth}.
e.zh: 他们以极微弱的差距赢得了投票。

e.en: The barber cleaned the {hair-clippers} after each customer.
e.zh: 理发师每接待一位顾客后都会清洁电推剪。

e.en: He used {hair-clippers} to trim his beard.
e.zh: 他用电推剪修剪自己的胡子。

e.en: I need a {hair-cut} before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前我需要理个发。

e.en: Her new {hair-cut} makes her look younger.
e.zh: 她的新发型让她看起来更年轻。

e.en: She arrived with an elaborate {hair-do}.
e.zh: 她顶着一个精心打理的发型来了。

e.en: The wind ruined my {hair-do} in minutes.
e.zh: 大风几分钟就把我的发型吹乱了。

e.en: The hotel room has a {hair-dryer}.
e.zh: 酒店房间里有一台吹风机。

e.en: She packed her {hair-dryer} for the trip.
e.zh: 她把吹风机装进行李准备旅行。

e.en: He rubbed {hair-oil} into his dry curls.
e.zh: 他把护发油揉进干燥的卷发里。

e.en: The old bottle of {hair-oil} smelled strongly of flowers.
e.zh: 那瓶旧发油有一股很浓的花香。

e.en: The actor wore a {hair-piece} for the role.
e.zh: 那位演员为这个角色戴了假发片。

e.en: Her {hair-piece} matched her natural color perfectly.
e.zh: 她的接发片和本来的发色完全吻合。

e.en: That ghost story was a real {hair-raiser}.
e.zh: 那个鬼故事真让人毛骨悚然。

e.en: The final descent became a {hair-raiser} in the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中的最后下降变成了一场惊险经历。

e.en: We heard a {hair-raising} scream upstairs.
e.zh: 我们听见楼上传来一声令人毛骨悚然的尖叫。

e.en: The driver told a {hair-raising} story about the icy road.
e.zh: 司机讲了一个关于结冰路面的惊险故事。

e.en: The bridge was {hair-raisingly} narrow in places.
e.zh: 那座桥有些地方窄得吓人。

e.en: He drove {hair-raisingly} fast through the rain.
e.zh: 他在雨中开得快得令人心惊。

e.en: The monk wore a {hair-shirt} under his robe.
e.zh: 那位修士在长袍下面穿着苦修衣。

e.en: Her apology became a political {hair-shirt}.
e.zh: 她的道歉变成了一种政治上的自我惩罚。

e.en: He adopted a {hair-shirted} approach to success.
e.zh: 他以一种近乎自我惩罚的方式追求成功。

e.en: The essay has a {hair-shirted} tone of moral guilt.
e.zh: 这篇文章带着一种苦修般的道德负罪语气。

e.en: The debate collapsed into legal {hair-splitting}.
e.zh: 辩论最后变成了法律条文上的吹毛求疵。

e.en: Stop {hair-splitting} and answer the main question.
e.zh: 别再抠字眼了，回答主要问题。

e.en: She changed her {hair-style} for summer.
e.zh: 她为了夏天换了个发型。

e.en: This {hair-style} is easy to maintain.
e.zh: 这种发型很容易打理。

e.en: A {hair-thin} crack appeared in the glass.
e.zh: 玻璃上出现了一道细如发丝的裂缝。

e.en: The surgeon used a {hair-thin} needle.
e.zh: 外科医生使用了一根极细的针。

e.en: The old pistol had a {hair-trigger}.
e.zh: 那把旧手枪有个极灵敏的扳机。

e.en: He has a {hair-trigger} temper under pressure.
e.zh: 他在压力下脾气一点就着。

e.en: She wore a red {hairband} to school.
e.zh: 她戴着红色发带去上学。

e.en: This {hairband} keeps my hair out of my eyes.
e.zh: 这条发带能防止头发遮住我的眼睛。

e.en: The drawer was full of colorful {hairbands}.
e.zh: 抽屉里装满了彩色发带。

e.en: They sell {hairbands} near the checkout counter.
e.zh: 他们在收银台附近卖发带。

e.en: A single {hairbell} grew beside the path.
e.zh: 小路旁长着一朵蓝钟花。

e.en: The meadow was dotted with pale {hairbells}.
e.zh: 草地上点缀着淡色的风铃草。

hairbrained.t: 愚蠢鲁莽的；欠考虑的方案或想法

e.en: His {hairbrained} plan almost ruined the project.
e.zh: 他那个愚蠢鲁莽的计划差点毁了这个项目。

e.en: It sounded {hairbrained}, but the trick actually worked.
e.zh: 这听起来很不靠谱，但这个办法居然真管用。

e.en: She fastened her bangs with a red {hairclip}.
e.zh: 她用一个红色发夹夹住刘海。

e.en: I found a broken {hairclip} under the sofa.
e.zh: 我在沙发下面找到一个坏掉的发夹。

e.en: The old chair was covered in rough {haircloth}.
e.zh: 那把旧椅子蒙着粗硬的马毛布。

e.en: Monks once wore {haircloth} as a sign of penance.
e.zh: 僧侣过去会穿粗毛布衣作为忏悔的象征。

e.en: She bought a new {haircurling} iron yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天买了一根新的卷发棒。

e.en: The salon offers {haircurling} before evening parties.
e.zh: 这家美发店为晚宴前的客人提供卷发服务。

hairdersser.t: 理发师；美发师的误拼写

e.en: The sign outside misspelled {hairdersser} in large letters.
e.zh: 外面的招牌把“美发师”这个词大字拼错了。

e.en: She meant to write {hairdersser} as hairdresser.
e.zh: 她本想把“hairdresser”写成美发师这个词。

e.en: Her elaborate {hairdress} suited the period costume.
e.zh: 她精致的发式很配那套年代服装。

e.en: The portrait shows a queen with jeweled {hairdress}.
e.zh: 这幅肖像画中，王后戴着珠宝头饰。

e.en: The hotel room has a {hairdrier} in the bathroom.
e.zh: 酒店房间的浴室里有一台吹风机。

e.en: My old {hairdrier} stopped working this morning.
e.zh: 我的旧吹风机今天早上坏了。

e.en: This {hairdye} fades after a few washes.
e.zh: 这种染发剂洗几次后就会褪色。

e.en: He used black {hairdye} to cover the gray.
e.zh: 他用黑色染发剂遮住白发。

hairgrip.t: 发夹；固定头发的小夹子

e.en: She pinned the loose strand with a {hairgrip}.
e.zh: 她用一个小发夹夹住那缕散发。

e.en: A silver {hairgrip} fell from her bag.
e.zh: 一个银色发夹从她包里掉了出来。

hairologist.t: 头发专家；毛发护理专家

e.en: A {hairologist} examined her damaged scalp.
e.zh: 一位头发专家检查了她受损的头皮。

e.en: The magazine quoted a {hairologist} on hair loss.
e.zh: 杂志引用了一位毛发护理专家对脱发的看法。

e.en: The cyclist missed the bus by a {hairsbreadth}.
e.zh: 骑车人以毫厘之差避开了公交车。

e.en: Their proposal survived by a {hairsbreadth} in the vote.
e.zh: 他们的提案在投票中以微弱差距得以保留。

e.en: She wore a pearl {hairslide} at the wedding.
e.zh: 她在婚礼上戴了一只珍珠发卡。

e.en: The child lost her {hairslide} during playtime.
e.zh: 那个孩子玩耍时把发卡弄丢了。

hairsplitter.t: 吹毛求疵的人；钻牛角尖者

e.en: Only a {hairsplitter} would object to that wording.
e.zh: 只有吹毛求疵的人才会反对那种措辞。

e.en: The lawyer sounded like a {hairsplitter}, but the detail mattered.
e.zh: 那位律师听起来像在钻牛角尖，但那个细节确实重要。

e.en: Stop {hairsplitting} and answer the question plainly.
e.zh: 别再吹毛求疵了，直接回答问题。

e.en: The debate turned into legal {hairsplitting}.
e.zh: 这场辩论变成了法律细节上的过分较真。

e.en: The watchmaker replaced the damaged {hairspring}.

e.zh: 他傻乎乎地咧嘴一笑，耸了耸肩。

e.zh: 面对他一再的愚蠢，她仍保持耐心。

e.zh: 她第一次见到了同母异父的兄弟。

half-blooded.t: 同父异母或同母异父的；混血的

e.en: The novel mentions his {half-blooded} brother.
e.zh: 小说提到了他同父异母的兄弟。

e.en: Some old texts use {half-blooded} for mixed ancestry.
e.zh: 一些旧文本用这个词指混合血统。

e.en: He likes {half-boiled} eggs for breakfast.
e.zh: 他早餐喜欢吃半熟蛋。

e.en: The potatoes were still {half-boiled} inside.
e.zh: 土豆里面还没有完全煮熟。

e.en: The library owns a {half-bound} Victorian edition.
e.zh: 图书馆藏有一本维多利亚时期的半皮装订本。

e.en: Collectors often prefer {half-bound} books with marbled covers.
e.zh: 收藏者常偏爱带大理石纹封面的半皮装订书。

e.en: The farmer sold a {half-bred} mare at auction.
e.zh: 农夫在拍卖会上卖掉了一匹混种母马。

e.en: The phrase {half-bred} sounds offensive in human contexts.
e.zh: 这个词用于人时听起来很冒犯。

e.en: The slur {half-breed} appears in old Western novels.
e.zh: 这个冒犯性称呼出现在一些旧西部小说里。

e.en: Do not call someone a {half-breed}.
e.zh: 不要把别人称作混血杂种。

half-brother.t: 同父异母或同母异父的兄弟

e.en: My {half-brother} lives in Canada.
e.zh: 我同父异母的兄弟住在加拿大。

e.en: She met her {half-brother} for the first time.
e.zh: 她第一次见到了自己同母异父的哥哥。

half-brothers.t: 同父异母或同母异父的兄弟们

e.en: The two {half-brothers} grew up apart.
e.zh: 这两个同父异母的兄弟从小分开长大。

e.en: Her {half-brothers} came to the wedding.
e.zh: 她同母异父的兄弟们来参加了婚礼。

e.en: The term {half-caste} is now considered offensive.
e.zh: 这个称呼现在被认为带有冒犯性。

e.en: Older colonial records described him as {half-caste}.
e.zh: 旧殖民档案把他称作混血儿。

half-castes.t: 混血者；冒犯性旧称复数

e.en: The document referred to them as {half-castes}.
e.zh: 那份文件用冒犯性的旧称称呼他们。

e.en: People once labeled as {half-castes} challenged the term.
e.zh: 曾被这样称呼的人反对这个词。

e.en: A {half-cell} contains one electrode and electrolyte.
e.zh: 半电池包含一个电极和电解质。

e.en: Students measured the voltage of each {half-cell}.
e.zh: 学生们测量了每个半电池的电压。

e.en: The building stood empty for a {half-century}.
e.zh: 这栋楼空置了半个世纪。

e.en: The opener scored a quick {half-century}.
e.zh: 开局击球手很快拿到了五十分。

e.en: The old pistol rested at {half-cock}.
e.zh: 那把旧手枪处于半待发状态。

e.en: Keep the hammer at {half-cock} while loading.
e.zh: 装弹时让击锤保持在半待发位置。

half-cocked.t: 仓促鲁莽的；准备不足的

e.en: They rushed into a {half-cocked} rescue attempt.
e.zh: 他们仓促鲁莽地展开了救援行动。

e.en: Don't go off {half-cocked} without checking the facts.
e.zh: 别没核实事实就贸然行动。

e.en: The chicken was still {half-cooked} in the middle.
e.zh: 鸡肉中间还半生不熟。

e.en: Management presented a {half-cooked} strategy to investors.
e.zh: 管理层向投资者提出了一个准备不足的策略。

e.en: He made a {half-court} shot at the buzzer.
e.zh: 他在终场哨响前投进了一个半场球。

e.en: The coach focused on {half-court} defense today.
e.zh: 教练今天重点训练半场防守。

e.en: His {half-cracked} theory made the room silent.
e.zh: 他那有点疯的理论让全场沉默了。

e.en: She sounded {half-cracked} after three sleepless nights.
e.zh: 三晚没睡后，她听起来有些不正常。

e.en: He found a {half-crown} in the drawer.
e.zh: 他在抽屉里发现了一枚旧英国半克朗硬币。

e.en: A {half-crown} was worth two shillings and sixpence.
e.zh: 一枚半克朗相当于两先令六便士。

e.en: He arrived {half-cut} at the office party.
e.zh: 他半醉着来参加办公室聚会。

e.en: By midnight, most guests were {half-cut}.
e.zh: 到午夜时，大多数客人都有些醉了。

e.en: Friday is a {half-day} at school.
e.zh: 星期五学校只上半天课。

e.en: I took a {half-day} to visit the doctor.
e.zh: 我请了半天假去看医生。

e.en: Different isotopes have different {half-lives}.
e.zh: 不同同位素有不同的半衰期。

e.en: The drug's {half-lives} affect the dosing schedule.
e.zh: 这种药物的半衰期会影响给药安排。

e.en: She wore a {half-long} coat in spring.
e.zh: 春天她穿了一件半长外套。

e.en: The tailor suggested {half-long} sleeves for the dress.
e.zh: 裁缝建议这条裙子用半长袖。

half-man.t: 半人半兽；不完整的男人

e.en: The myth describes a {half-man} creature.
e.zh: 这个神话描写了一种半人半兽的生物。

e.en: He felt like a {half-man} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故之后，他觉得自己像个不完整的人。

e.en: The flag flew at {half-mast} after the tragedy.
e.zh: 悲剧发生后，旗帜降半旗致哀。

e.en: They ordered all flags to be lowered to {half-mast}.
e.zh: 他们下令所有旗帜都降到半旗位置。

e.en: The reform was only a {half-measure}.
e.zh: 这项改革只是一个不彻底的措施。

e.en: We need real action, not another {half-measure}.
e.zh: 我们需要真正行动，而不是又一个折中办法。

e.en: A bright {half-moon} hung above the town.
e.zh: 一轮明亮的半月挂在小镇上空。

e.en: Cut the dough into {half-moon} shapes.
e.zh: 把面团切成半月形。

e.en: A {half-naked} man ran across the beach.
e.zh: 一个半裸的男人跑过海滩。

e.en: The children were {half-naked} in the summer heat.
e.zh: 夏日炎热，孩子们几乎衣不蔽体。

e.en: Use a {half-nut} where space is limited.
e.zh: 空间有限时可以使用薄螺母。

e.en: The mechanic tightened the {half-nut} carefully.
e.zh: 机械师小心地拧紧了半高螺母。

e.en: The officer was placed on {half-pay}.
e.zh: 这名军官被安排领取半薪。

e.en: He survived for months on {half-pay}.
e.zh: 他靠半薪撑了好几个月。

e.en: The signal reverses after each {half-period}.
e.zh: 信号在每个半周期后反向。

e.en: The teacher used a {half-period} for revision.
e.zh: 老师用了半个课时来复习。

e.en: He ordered a {half-pint} of beer.
e.zh: 他点了半品脱啤酒。

e.en: Everyone called the small boy {half-pint}.
e.zh: 大家都叫那个小男孩“小不点”。

e.en: She practiced tricks on the {half-pipe}.
e.zh: 她在U形滑道上练习动作。

e.en: The snowboarders competed in the {half-pipe} event.
e.zh: 单板滑雪选手参加了U形场地项目。

e.en: The team won by a {half-point}.
e.zh: 这个队以半分优势获胜。

e.en: Increase the font by a {half-point}.
e.zh: 把字体调大半点字号。

e.en: Buy a {half-pound} of cheese.
e.zh: 买半磅奶酪。

e.en: The package weighed about a {half-pound}.
e.zh: 这个包裹重约半磅。

e.en: The temple wall was carved in {half-relief}.
e.zh: 寺庙墙面刻成了半浮雕。

e.en: A figure in {half-relief} decorated the panel.
e.zh: 面板上装饰着一个浅浮雕人物。

e.en: The carpenter added a {half-round} trim.
e.zh: 木匠加了一条半圆线脚。

e.en: They sat around a {half-round} table.
e.zh: 他们围坐在一张半圆形桌子旁。

e.en: He came home {half-seas-over} after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜后他醉醺醺地回了家。

e.en: The sailors were already {half-seas-over} by dinner.
e.zh: 到晚饭时，水手们已经有些醉了。

e.en: She asked for a {half-shot} of espresso.
e.zh: 她要了半份浓缩咖啡。

e.en: The golfer played a careful {half-shot}.
e.zh: 那名高尔夫球手谨慎地打了一个半力球。

half-sister.t: 同父异母或同母异父的姐妹

e.en: My {half-sister} lives in Canada.
e.zh: 我同父异母的姐妹住在加拿大。

e.en: She met her {half-sister} for the first time.
e.zh: 她第一次见到了自己同母异父的姐妹。

half-sisters.t: 同父异母或同母异父的姐妹们

e.en: The two women are {half-sisters}.
e.zh: 这两个女人是同父异母的姐妹。

e.en: His {half-sisters} grew up in another city.
e.zh: 他同母异父的姐妹们在另一个城市长大。

e.en: The model is built at {half-size}.
e.zh: 这个模型按半尺寸制作。

e.en: These shoes come in every {half-size}.
e.zh: 这些鞋每个小半号都有。

e.en: She wore a {half-slip} under the skirt.
e.zh: 她在裙子里面穿了一条半身衬裙。

e.en: The vintage store sold a silk {half-slip}.
e.zh: 那家古着店卖一条丝质半身衬裙。

e.en: The cobbler replaced the worn {half-sole}.
e.zh: 修鞋匠换掉了磨损的前掌鞋底。

e.en: These boots need a {half-sole} repair.
e.zh: 这双靴子需要换半底。

e.en: Flags were flown at {half-staff} nationwide.
e.zh: 全国各地都降半旗致哀。

e.en: The governor ordered the flag to {half-staff}.
e.zh: 州长下令降半旗。

e.en: The children visit their grandparents during {half-term}.
e.zh: 孩子们在期中假去看望祖父母。

e.en: She joined the course at {half-term}.
e.zh: 她在半个学期时加入了这门课。

e.en: The choir sang the {Hallel} during the festival service.
e.zh: 唱诗班在节日礼拜中唱起哈利路亚赞美诗。

e.en: Several psalms form the traditional {Hallel} in Jewish worship.
e.zh: 几篇诗篇构成犹太礼拜中的传统哈利路亚赞美诗。

e.en: The sailor pulled the {halliard} to raise the small sail.
e.zh: 水手拉动升降帆索，把小帆升了起来。

e.en: A frayed {halliard} slapped against the flagpole all night.
e.zh: 磨损的旗索整夜拍打着旗杆。

e.en: A loud {halloa} came from the dark lane.
e.zh: 黑暗的小巷里传来一声响亮的喂喊。

e.en: He tried to {halloa} the rider before she passed.
e.zh: 他想在骑手经过前大声喊住她。

e.en: The sample contained fine tubes of {halloysite}.
e.zh: 样品中含有细小的埃洛石管状颗粒。

e.en: Engineers studied {halloysite} for use in ceramic materials.
e.zh: 工程师研究埃洛石在陶瓷材料中的用途。

e.en: She left her umbrella on the {hallstand}.
e.zh: 她把雨伞放在门厅衣帽架上。

e.en: The antique {hallstand} had hooks for coats and hats.
e.zh: 那件古董门厅衣帽架有挂外套和帽子的钩子。

e.en: Two wooden {hallstands} stood beside the front door.
e.zh: 前门旁放着两个木制门厅衣帽架。

e.en: Old houses often had {hallstands} for visitors' coats.
e.zh: 老房子里常有门厅衣帽架给访客挂外套。

e.en: The fossil showed unusually long {halluces}.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出异常长的大脚趾。

e.en: Surgeons checked both {halluces} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后，外科医生检查了两只大脚趾。

e.en: The patient described a {hallucinant} dreamlike experience.
e.zh: 病人描述了一种致幻般的梦境体验。

e.en: Some drugs have a powerful {hallucinant} effect.
e.zh: 有些药物具有强烈的致幻作用。

e.en: The report called him a chronic {hallucinator}.
e.zh: 报告称他是长期产生幻觉的人。

e.en: A {hallucinator} may sincerely believe the voices are real.
e.zh: 产生幻觉的人可能真心相信那些声音是真实的。

e.en: Alcohol withdrawal can sometimes cause {hallucinosis}.
e.zh: 酒精戒断有时会引发幻觉症。

e.en: The doctor distinguished {hallucinosis} from ordinary confusion.
e.zh: 医生把幻觉症同一般的意识混乱区分开来。

e.en: The injury affected the joint of the {hallux}.
e.zh: 这次受伤影响了大脚趾的关节。

e.en: In birds, the {hallux} often points backward.
e.zh: 在鸟类中，后趾通常向后伸出。

e.en: A single {halm} of wheat bent in the wind.
e.zh: 一根小麦禾秆在风中弯了下去。

e.en: The nest was woven from dry {halm} and leaves.
e.zh: 这个巢是用干草茎和叶子编成的。

e.en: They played {halma} on a square board after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他们在方格棋盘上下哈尔马跳棋。

e.en: The rules of {halma} influenced later jumping games.
e.zh: 哈尔马跳棋的规则影响了后来的跳棋类游戏。

e.en: Several old {halmas} were stored in the game cupboard.
e.zh: 游戏柜里存放着几副旧的哈尔马跳棋。

e.en: The shop sold wooden {halmas} for collectors.
e.zh: 这家店出售供收藏者购买的木制哈尔马跳棋。

e.en: Dry {halms} crackled under their boots.
e.zh: 干草茎在他们的靴子下噼啪作响。

e.en: The farmer tied the {halms} into small bundles.
e.zh: 农民把禾秆扎成小捆。

e.en: Geologists discussed {halmyrolysis} in the marine sediment layer.
e.zh: 地质学家讨论了海洋沉积层中的海水蚀变作用。

e.en: The mineral changed through slow {halmyrolysis} on the seabed.
e.zh: 这种矿物在海床上因缓慢的海水蚀变作用而改变。

e.en: Pink lakes often contain many {halobacteria}.
e.zh: 粉红色湖泊中常含有大量嗜盐古菌。

e.en: Scientists grew {halobacteria} in a very salty medium.
e.zh: 科学家在高盐培养基中培养嗜盐古菌。

e.en: This tiny alga is a true {halobiont}.
e.zh: 这种微小藻类是真正的盐生生物。

e.en: A {halobiont} can survive where ordinary plants die.
e.zh: 盐生生物能在普通植物死亡的地方存活。

e.en: The study focused on {halobiotic} communities near salt flats.
e.zh: 这项研究关注盐滩附近的盐生生物群落。

e.en: Some microbes have special {halobiotic} adaptations.
e.zh: 一些微生物具有特殊的盐生适应能力。

e.en: The insect has {hamated} bristles on its legs.
e.zh: 这种昆虫腿上有钩状刚毛。

e.en: A {hamated} tool caught the thread easily.
e.zh: 一件带钩的工具很容易勾住了线。

e.en: She used a {hambone} to flavor the soup.
e.zh: 她用一根火腿骨给汤增味。

e.en: The comedian was a cheerful {hambone} on stage.
e.zh: 那个喜剧演员在台上是个爱卖弄的滑稽角色。

e.en: The old leather strap was fixed to the {hame}.
e.zh: 那条旧皮带固定在挽具的颈轭片上。

e.en: A cracked {hame} can hurt the horse.
e.zh: 裂开的颈轭片可能会弄伤马。

e.en: The beetle's {hamete} claw gripped the bark.
e.zh: 甲虫的钩状爪紧紧抓住树皮。

e.en: Botanists noted the plant's {hamete} hairs.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种植物有钩状绒毛。

e.en: The family removed all {hametz} before Passover began.
e.zh: 逾越节开始前，这家人清除了所有禁食的发酵食品。

e.en: Bread is treated as {hametz} during the holiday.
e.zh: 节日期间，面包被视为禁食的发酵食品。

e.en: Critics dismissed him as a noisy {hamfatter}.
e.zh: 评论家把他斥为吵闹的蹩脚演员。

e.en: The village play needed enthusiasm, not another {hamfatter}.
e.zh: 村里的戏需要热情，而不是又一个拙劣表演者。

e.en: Do not let that {hamfist} repair the watch.
e.zh: 别让那个笨手笨脚的人修这块表。

e.en: Only a {hamfist} would force the fragile lock.
e.zh: 只有笨手笨脚的人才会硬撬这把脆弱的锁。

e.en: His {hamfisted} apology made everyone more uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他笨拙的道歉让大家更加尴尬。

e.en: The policy was a {hamfisted} attempt to control prices.
e.zh: 这项政策是一次粗糙地控制价格的尝试。

e.en: The {hamfooted} dancer stumbled across the stage.
e.zh: 那个脚步笨拙的舞者踉跄着穿过舞台。

e.en: His {hamfooted} approach spoiled the delicate negotiation.
e.zh: 他笨拙的处理方式毁了这场微妙的谈判。

e.en: The larva was described as {hamipneustic} in the report.
e.zh: 报告把这种幼虫描述为半气门式呼吸。

e.en: A {hamipneustic} insect breathes through limited spiracles.
e.zh: 半气门式呼吸的昆虫通过有限的气门呼吸。

e.en: The caravan crossed a barren {hammada} at dawn.
e.zh: 商队在黎明时穿过一片贫瘠的石质荒漠。

e.en: Few plants survive on the exposed {hammada}.
e.zh: 裸露的砾石沙漠上几乎没有植物能存活。

e.en: A {hammal} carried the trunks through the bazaar.
e.zh: 一个搬运工把箱子扛过集市。

e.en: The tired {hammal} rested beside the warehouse.
e.zh: 疲惫的脚夫在仓库旁休息。

e.en: We visited a traditional {hammam} after the tour.
e.zh: 参观结束后，我们去了一家传统土耳其浴室。

e.en: The old {hammam} still serves the neighborhood.
e.zh: 那座老公共浴场仍为附近居民服务。

e.en: The roof was supported by a carved {hammer-beam}.
e.zh: 屋顶由一根雕刻过的锤梁支撑。

e.en: Each {hammer-beam} projected from the stone wall.
e.zh: 每根悬臂托梁都从石墙上伸出。

e.en: One {hammer-blow} drove the nail straight in.
e.zh: 一记锤击把钉子直接敲了进去。

e.en: The defeat was a {hammer-blow} to their hopes.
e.zh: 这次失败对他们的希望是一次沉重打击。

e.en: The wrestler caught him in a {hammer-lock}.
e.zh: 摔跤手用反臂锁制住了他。

e.en: The old rifle had a rusty {hammer-lock}.
e.zh: 那支旧步枪有一个生锈的锤式锁扣。

e.en: The geologist identified the pale crust as {halurgite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把那层浅色结壳鉴定为盐类矿物。

e.en: Old mining notes mentioned {halurgite} near the brine deposits.
e.zh: 旧采矿记录提到卤水矿床附近有岩盐矿物。

e.en: The young {halutz} helped drain the marshland.
e.zh: 那位年轻的犹太复垦先锋帮助排干沼泽地。

e.en: In the memoir, each {halutz} is portrayed as stubbornly hopeful.
e.zh: 在回忆录中，每位开拓者都被写得顽强而怀抱希望。

e.en: She bought a box of pistachio {halva}.
e.zh: 她买了一盒开心果哈尔瓦甜食。

e.en: The dessert table included dense sesame {halva}.
e.zh: 甜点桌上有质地厚实的芝麻糖糕。

e.en: Grandma sliced the crumbly {halvah} carefully.
e.zh: 奶奶小心地切开那块易碎的哈尔瓦甜食。

e.en: A small piece of {halvah} was enough after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后吃一小块芝麻糖糕就足够了。

e.en: The two {halvers} split the prize evenly.
e.zh: 这两个平分者把奖金平均分了。

e.en: Careful {halvers} reduce each portion without waste.
e.zh: 细心的减半者会把每份缩小而不浪费。

e.en: The festival stall sold warm carrot {halwa}.
e.zh: 节日摊位出售热乎乎的胡萝卜哈尔瓦甜食。

e.en: He served almond {halwa} with tea.
e.zh: 他端上杏仁南亚甜糕来配茶。

e.en: The champion dismissed him as a {ham-and-egger}.
e.zh: 冠军把他轻蔑地说成平庸拳手。

e.en: I was just a {ham-and-egger} trying to pay rent.
e.zh: 我只是个普通打工人，努力挣房租。

e.en: Critics mocked the play's {ham-and-eggery}.
e.zh: 评论家嘲笑这出戏的平庸表现。

e.en: There was some cheerful {ham-and-eggery} in their early songs.
e.zh: 他们早期歌曲里有些愉快但粗浅的手艺。

ham-fisted.t: 笨手笨脚的；粗暴生硬的

e.en: His {ham-fisted} repair made the leak worse.
e.zh: 他笨手笨脚的修理让漏水更严重了。

e.en: The minister gave a {ham-fisted} apology.
e.zh: 部长作了一番粗暴生硬的道歉。

e.en: A {ham-handed} waiter spilled soup on the table.
e.zh: 一个笨拙的服务员把汤洒在桌上。

e.en: The company made a {ham-handed} attempt to calm customers.
e.zh: 公司试图安抚顾客，但处理得很粗糙。

e.en: He {ham-handedly} glued the broken vase together.
e.zh: 他笨拙地把破花瓶粘了起来。

e.en: The policy was {ham-handedly} explained to the public.
e.zh: 这项政策被粗暴生硬地解释给公众听。

e.en: A {hamadryad} guarded the ancient oak in the tale.
e.zh: 故事里有一位树精守护着古老橡树。

e.en: The zoo displayed a rare {hamadryad} from Asia.
e.zh: 动物园展出了一条来自亚洲的罕见王眼镜蛇。

e.en: The poem imagines {hamadryades} whispering in the grove.
e.zh: 这首诗想象树精们在树林中低语。

e.en: Ancient myths said {hamadryades} lived and died with their trees.
e.zh: 古代神话说树仙们与自己的树同生共死。

e.en: The painter filled the forest with dancing {hamadryads}.
e.zh: 画家把森林画满了起舞的树精们。

e.en: Several {hamadryads} were kept in separate glass enclosures.
e.zh: 几条王眼镜蛇被分养在不同的玻璃围栏里。

e.en: A tired {hamal} carried trunks through the bazaar.
e.zh: 一个疲惫的脚夫扛着箱子穿过集市。

e.en: The merchant paid the {hamal} before sunset.
e.zh: 商人在日落前付了搬运工的钱。

e.en: We relaxed in a marble {hamam} after the journey.
e.zh: 旅途之后，我们在大理石土耳其浴室里放松。

e.en: The old {hamam} still serves the neighborhood.
e.zh: 那座老公共浴场仍为附近居民服务。

e.en: She filled each {hamantasch} with poppy seeds.
e.zh: 她给每个哈曼塔申三角饼都填上罂粟籽馅。

e.en: A fresh {hamantasch} sat beside the coffee cup.
e.zh: 咖啡杯旁放着一个新鲜的哈曼塔申三角饼。

e.en: Pride is the hero's {hamartia} in the tragedy.
e.zh: 在这部悲剧中，骄傲是主人公的致命弱点。

e.en: The lecture defined {hamartia} as a fatal error in judgment.
e.zh: 讲座把悲剧性缺陷定义为致命的判断错误。

hamartoma.t: 错构瘤；组织发育畸形瘤

e.en: The scan revealed a small lung {hamartoma}.
e.zh: 扫描显示肺部有一个小的错构瘤。

e.en: Doctors monitored the benign {hamartoma} every year.
e.zh: 医生每年监测这个良性的组织发育畸形瘤。

e.en: The cyclist fractured his {hamate} during the fall.
e.zh: 那名骑车人在摔倒时钩状骨骨折了。

e.en: The specimen had a clearly {hamate} tip.
e.zh: 这个标本有一个明显呈钩形的尖端。

hammer-on.t: 吉他连奏按弦技巧；锤上音

e.en: The guitarist used a {hammer-on} to make the phrase smoother.
e.zh: 吉他手用了锤上音，让这句旋律更顺滑。

e.en: Practice each {hammer-on} slowly before speeding up.
e.zh: 先慢慢练每个连奏按弦动作，再逐渐加快速度。

e.en: Soft copper is {hammerable} into thin decorative sheets.
e.zh: 柔软的铜可以锤打成很薄的装饰片。

e.en: The clay stayed {hammerable} while it was still damp.
e.zh: 泥土还潮湿时仍能被敲压成形。

e.en: One {hammerblow} cracked the old stone slab.
e.zh: 一记锤击就把那块旧石板砸裂了。

e.en: The defeat felt like a {hammerblow} to the campaign.
e.zh: 这次失败对竞选来说像一次沉重打击。

e.en: The coachman sat above a faded {hammercloth}.
e.zh: 车夫坐在一块褪色的马车御座罩布上方。

e.en: The restored carriage had a red {hammercloth} trimmed with gold.
e.zh: 修复后的马车配有一块镶金边的红色御座罩布。

e.en: A {hammerkop} stood motionless near the muddy riverbank.
e.zh: 一只锤头鹳一动不动地站在泥泞河岸旁。

e.en: The guide pointed out the huge nest of a {hammerkop}.
e.zh: 向导指出了锤头鹳搭建的巨大鸟巢。

e.en: He bought a {hammerless} shotgun for safer carrying.
e.zh: 他买了一支无外露击锤的霰弹枪，携带更安全。

e.en: The kit uses a {hammerless} fastening system.
e.zh: 这套工具采用不用锤子的固定系统。

e.en: The {hammerman} shaped the hot iron with steady blows.
e.zh: 锤工用稳定的敲击把烧红的铁块打成形。

e.en: Every {hammerman} in the workshop wore heavy gloves.
e.zh: 车间里的每个锤工都戴着厚手套。

e.en: The {hammermen} worked in rhythm beside the forge.
e.zh: 锤工们在炉边有节奏地干活。

e.en: Several {hammermen} were hired to break the old concrete.
e.zh: 几名用锤作业的工人受雇来砸碎旧混凝土。

e.en: Tight shoes can make a {hammertoe} more painful.
e.zh: 鞋子太紧会让锤状趾更加疼痛。

e.en: The doctor suggested exercises for her mild {hammertoe}.
e.zh: 医生建议她通过练习缓解轻度锤状趾。

e.en: He bowed {hammily} after the joke landed.
e.zh: 笑话奏效后，他夸张地鞠了一躬。

e.en: The villain laughed {hammily} in the old film.
e.zh: 那部老电影里的反派做作地大笑。

e.en: The actor's {hamminess} made the scene unexpectedly funny.
e.zh: 那个演员的夸张表演让这场戏意外地好笑。

e.en: A little {hamminess} suits this comic role.
e.zh: 这个喜剧角色带点做作劲儿反而合适。

e.en: The insect had a {hamose} tip on each antenna.
e.zh: 这种昆虫每根触角末端都有钩状结构。

e.en: Botanists noted the seed's {hamose} surface under magnification.
e.zh: 植物学家在放大观察时注意到种子表面呈弯钩状。

e.en: The drawing showed a {hamous} spine on the larva.
e.zh: 图中显示幼虫身上有一根钩状刺。

e.en: A {hamous} projection helped the plant cling to bark.
e.zh: 一个带钩的突起帮助植物附着在树皮上。

e.en: The guards tried to {hamshackle} the prisoner before transport.
e.zh: 押送前，守卫试图给囚犯脚上镣铐。

e.en: Debt can {hamshackle} a small company for years.
e.zh: 债务可能多年束缚一家小公司的发展。

e.en: The seed has {hamulate} hairs that catch on fur.
e.zh: 这种种子有带小钩的毛，能挂在皮毛上。

e.en: Under the lens, the edge looked finely {hamulate}.
e.zh: 在镜头下，边缘看起来布满细小钩状结构。

e.en: Bee wings are linked by tiny {hamuli}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂的翅膀由细小的钩状突起连接在一起。

e.en: The anatomist counted the {hamuli} along the margin.
e.zh: 解剖学家数了数边缘上的小钩。

e.en: The {hamulose} bristles helped the burr attach to cloth.
e.zh: 这些带小钩的硬毛帮助刺果粘在布料上。

e.en: A {hamulose} margin was visible under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下可以看到布满小钩的边缘。

e.en: Each wing has a small {hamulus} near the edge.
e.zh: 每片翅膀边缘附近都有一个小钩。

e.en: The surgeon identified the bony {hamulus} on the scan.
e.zh: 外科医生在扫描图上辨认出那个骨性钩突。

hamza.t: 阿拉伯字母声门塞音符号

e.en: The word begins with a {hamza} in Arabic script.
e.zh: 这个词在阿拉伯文字中以哈姆扎符号开头。

e.en: Students often forget to write the {hamza} correctly.
e.zh: 学生常常忘记正确书写哈姆扎符号。

hamzah.t: 哈姆扎；阿拉伯声门塞音符号

e.en: A {hamzah} marks the glottal stop in this word.
e.zh: 这个词里的哈姆扎标示声门塞音。

e.en: She added the missing {hamzah} above the letter.
e.zh: 她在字母上方补上了漏写的哈姆扎。

hanamichi.t: 歌舞伎花道；观众席通道

e.en: The actor entered along the {hanamichi} through the audience.
e.zh: 演员沿着穿过观众席的花道登场。

e.en: A spotlight followed her down the {hanamichi}.
e.zh: 一束追光跟着她走过歌舞伎花道。

e.en: The museum displayed a silver {hanap} from the fifteenth century.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一只十五世纪的银制高脚酒杯。

e.en: Wine was poured into the ornate {hanap} at the feast.
e.zh: 宴会上，酒被倒入那只华丽的中世纪高脚杯。

e.en: The clerk placed the sealed writ in the {hanaper}.
e.zh: 书记员把封好的令状放进文书篮里。

e.en: A woven {hanaper} sat beside the old desk.
e.zh: 一只编织篮箱放在旧书桌旁。

e.en: The old fire extinguisher contained a {halocarbon} gas.
e.zh: 那只旧灭火器里含有一种卤代烃气体。

e.en: Scientists measured {halocarbon} levels in the atmosphere.
e.zh: 科学家测量了大气中的卤代烃含量。

e.en: The dye showed {halochromism} in acidic solution.
e.zh: 这种染料在酸性溶液中出现卤致变色现象。

e.en: Researchers used {halochromism} to detect small pH changes.
e.zh: 研究人员利用卤致变色来检测微小的pH变化。

e.en: Divers noticed the {halocline} as the water suddenly blurred.
e.zh: 潜水员发现盐跃层时，水面一下子变得模糊。

e.en: A strong {halocline} can separate deep water from surface water.
e.zh: 明显的盐跃层会把深层水和表层水隔开。

e.en: The botanist described the flat as a {haloeremion}.
e.zh: 那位植物学家把这片滩地描述为盐生荒漠群落。
