e.en: Only specialized shrubs survived in the {haloeremion}.
e.zh: 只有适应性很强的灌木能在这片盐生荒漠群落中存活。

e.en: Chemists can {halogenate} methane under controlled light.
e.zh: 化学家可以在受控光照下使甲烷卤化。

e.en: The process will {halogenate} the surface of the polymer.
e.zh: 这个工艺会让聚合物表面发生卤化。

e.en: The lab stores {halogenated} solvents in a separate cabinet.
e.zh: 实验室把含卤素溶剂存放在单独的柜子里。

e.en: Some {halogenated} compounds persist for years in soil.
e.zh: 一些卤化化合物会在土壤中残留多年。

e.en: The reaction requires careful {halogenation} of the aromatic ring.
e.zh: 这个反应需要小心地对芳香环进行卤化。

e.en: Industrial {halogenation} can produce useful flame retardants.
e.zh: 工业卤化过程可以生产有用的阻燃剂。

e.en: Silver {halogenide} crystals react quickly to light.
e.zh: 银卤化物晶体对光反应很快。

e.en: The chemist identified the unknown salt as a {halogenide}.
e.zh: 化学家确认这种未知盐是一种卤化物。

e.en: Cyanide can behave as a {halogenoid} group in reactions.
e.zh: 氰基在反应中可能表现得像拟卤素基团。

e.en: The paper compares {halogenoid} ions with true halides.
e.zh: 这篇论文把拟卤素离子与真正的卤化物作比较。

e.en: Ranchers removed {halogeton} from the grazing field.
e.zh: 牧场主清除了牧场里的盐生草属植物。

e.en: The weed {halogeton} can poison sheep after heavy growth.
e.zh: 盐生草这种杂草大量生长后可能毒害绵羊。

e.en: The mineral has a {haloid} taste and dissolves easily.
e.zh: 这种矿物有卤盐样味道，而且很容易溶解。

e.en: Early photographers used {haloid} salts on glass plates.
e.zh: 早期摄影师在玻璃底片上使用卤化物盐。

e.en: The technician checked the brine with a {halometer}.
e.zh: 技术员用盐度计检查了盐水。

e.en: A broken {halometer} gave the factory false readings.
e.zh: 损坏的测盐仪给工厂提供了错误读数。

e.en: Chloroform is a familiar {halomethane} used in laboratories.
e.zh: 氯仿是一种实验室里常见的卤代甲烷。

e.en: The report tracked {halomethane} emissions from old equipment.
e.zh: 报告追踪了旧设备排放的卤代甲烷。

e.en: The survey mapped {halomorphic} soils near the coast.
e.zh: 这次调查绘制了海岸附近盐渍土的分布。

e.en: Few crops grow well in {halomorphic} ground without treatment.
e.zh: 未经处理的盐渍土地里很少有作物能长好。

e.en: A {halophile} can thrive in water saltier than the sea.
e.zh: 嗜盐生物能在比海水更咸的水中繁盛。

e.en: The team isolated a red {halophile} from the salt pond.
e.zh: 团队从盐池中分离出一种红色嗜盐生物。

e.en: The marsh supports many {halophilous} plants.
e.zh: 这片沼泽养活了许多喜盐植物。

e.en: Some {halophilous} bacteria die when salt levels drop.
e.zh: 一些嗜盐细菌在盐度下降时会死亡。

e.en: This freshwater alga is a {halophobe} and avoids salty water.
e.zh: 这种淡水藻是忌盐生物，会避开咸水。

e.en: The botanist classified the seedling as a {halophobe}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这株幼苗归为避盐植物。

e.en: Glasswort is a {halophyte} often found in salt marshes.
e.zh: 海蓬子是一种常见于盐沼的盐生植物。

e.en: Farmers are testing a {halophyte} for use on saline land.
e.zh: 农民正在试种一种可用于盐碱地的盐生植物。

e.en: The coast has a narrow strip of {halophytic} vegetation.
e.zh: 海岸边有一条狭窄的盐生植被带。

e.en: Researchers studied {halophytic} roots for salt tolerance.
e.zh: 研究人员研究盐生植物的根系以了解耐盐性。

e.en: The lake's {haloplankton} changed after evaporation increased.
e.zh: 蒸发加剧后，湖中的盐水浮游生物发生了变化。

e.en: Fish larvae feed on {haloplankton} in the briny lagoon.
e.zh: 鱼苗在咸水潟湖中以盐水浮游生物为食。

e.en: The class studied a {halosere} from mudflat to meadow.
e.zh: 全班研究了从泥滩到草甸的盐沼演替系列。

e.en: A disturbed {halosere} may recover slowly after drainage.
e.zh: 受扰动的盐沼演替系列在排水后可能恢复缓慢。

e.en: The anesthetist used {halothane} during the short operation.
e.zh: 麻醉师在这台短手术中使用了氟烷。

e.en: Modern hospitals rarely choose {halothane} for routine anesthesia.
e.zh: 现代医院很少在常规麻醉中选择氟烷。

e.en: She wore a white {halter-top} to the beach party.
e.zh: 她穿了一件白色露背挂脖上衣去海滩派对。

e.en: The designer paired the skirt with a silk {halter-top}.
e.zh: 设计师把这条裙子配上了一件丝质挂脖上衣。

e.en: They began to {halterbreak} the young colt in spring.
e.zh: 他们春天开始训练那匹小马戴笼头。

e.en: It takes patience to {halterbreak} a nervous calf.
e.zh: 训练一头紧张的小牛接受笼头需要耐心。

haltere.t: 平衡棒；昆虫后翅退化器官

e.en: A fly uses each {haltere} to keep balance in flight.
e.zh: 苍蝇飞行时用每个平衡棒来保持平衡。

e.en: Under the microscope, the {haltere} looked like a tiny knob.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，平衡棒看起来像一个小小的圆突。

e.en: The servant carried linen in two old {hanapers}.
e.zh: 仆人用两个旧有盖大篮子装着亚麻布。

e.en: The museum displayed medieval {hanapers} beside the kitchen tools.
e.zh: 博物馆把中世纪有盖大篮子陈列在厨房用具旁。

e.en: The mason repaired the {hance} of the stone arch.
e.zh: 石匠修补了石拱的拱脚弯曲处。

e.en: A sharp {hance} gave the wooden frame a decorative edge.
e.zh: 一个明显的斜角让木框边缘更有装饰感。

e.en: She tossed a {hancful} of herbs into the pot.
e.zh: 她把一把香草丢进锅里。

e.en: Only a {hancful} of coins remained in the purse.
e.zh: 钱包里只剩下一把硬币。

e.en: She put her phone in her {hand-bag}.
e.zh: 她把手机放进手提包里。

e.en: The red {hand-bag} matched her shoes perfectly.
e.zh: 那个红色手提包和她的鞋子非常相配。

e.en: The teacher rang a {hand-bell} to start the class.
e.zh: 老师摇响手铃，示意开始上课。

e.en: An old silver {hand-bell} stood on the hotel desk.
e.zh: 酒店前台摆着一只旧银手摇铃。

e.en: The sailor lifted the crate with a small {hand-block}.
e.zh: 水手用一个小型手用滑轮组吊起木箱。

e.en: The artisan printed the cloth with a carved {hand-block}.
e.zh: 工匠用雕刻好的手模版给布料印花。

e.en: Read the {hand-book} before using the machine.
e.zh: 使用机器前请先阅读手册。

e.en: The travel {hand-book} lists cheap places to stay.
e.zh: 这本旅行指南列出了便宜的住宿地点。

e.en: A single {hand-clap} echoed through the hall.
e.zh: 一声拍手声在大厅里回响。

e.en: The dancers kept time with a steady {hand-clap}.
e.zh: 舞者用稳定的拍手声保持节奏。

e.en: They sell {hand-crafted} bowls at the market.
e.zh: 他们在市场上卖手工制作的碗。

e.en: The letter had a {hand-crafted} look that felt personal.
e.zh: 这封信带着手工制作的质感，显得很有个人味道。

e.en: The officer had to {hand-cuff} the suspect.
e.zh: 警察不得不给嫌疑人戴上手铐。

e.en: One broken {hand-cuff} lay on the floor.
e.zh: 地板上有一只坏掉的手铐。

e.en: I will {hand-deliver} the invitation tomorrow.
e.zh: 我明天会亲手递送这份邀请函。

e.en: The documents were {hand-delivered} to the lawyer.
e.zh: 这些文件被亲手送到了律师那里。

e.en: Parents often {hand-down} stories from one generation to the next.
e.zh: 父母常常把故事一代代传下去。

e.en: The judge will {hand-down} the sentence on Friday.
e.zh: 法官将在星期五宣布判决。

e.en: Volunteers {hand-feed} the injured birds every morning.
e.zh: 志愿者每天早上用手喂养受伤的鸟。

e.en: Do not {hand-feed} wild animals in the park.
e.zh: 不要在公园里用手喂野生动物。

e.en: The soldier threw a {hand-grenade} into the bunker.
e.zh: 士兵把一枚手榴弹扔进了掩体。

e.en: Police found an old {hand-grenade} near the river.
e.zh: 警方在河边发现了一枚旧手榴弹。

e.en: The exercise improves your {hand-grip} over time.
e.zh: 这项练习会逐渐增强你的握力。

e.en: The camera has a rubber {hand-grip} for comfort.
e.zh: 这台相机有一个橡胶把手，握起来更舒服。

e.en: The photo showed quiet {hand-holding} on the beach.
e.zh: 照片里两人在海滩上安静地牵着手。

e.en: New staff need guidance, not constant {hand-holding}.
e.zh: 新员工需要指导，而不是一直被手把手照看。

e.en: He spent the money {hand-hot} as soon as he earned it.
e.zh: 他钱一到手就立刻花掉了。

e.en: Serve the cakes {hand-hot} from the oven.
e.zh: 蛋糕刚出炉还热着时就端上来。

e.en: The charity works {hand-in-glove} with local doctors.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构与当地医生密切合作。

e.en: The report says officials acted {hand-in-glove} with smugglers.
e.zh: 报告称官员与走私者相互勾结。

e.en: The children walked {hand-in-hand} across the street.
e.zh: 孩子们手拉手穿过街道。

e.en: Economic growth and education often go {hand-in-hand}.
e.zh: 经济增长和教育往往密切相关。

e.en: My grandmother can {hand-knit} a sweater in a week.
e.zh: 我奶奶能在一周内手工织好一件毛衣。

e.en: They bought {hand-knit} scarves from a small shop.
e.zh: 他们从一家小店买了手工编织的围巾。

e.en: She wore a {hand-knitted} hat in winter.
e.zh: 她冬天戴着一顶手工编织的帽子。

e.en: The baby slept under a {hand-knitted} blanket.
e.zh: 婴儿睡在一条手工编织的毯子下面。

e.en: You may take one piece of {hand-luggage} on board.
e.zh: 你可以带一件手提行李上飞机。

e.en: Keep your passport in your {hand-luggage}.
e.zh: 把护照放在随身行李里。

e.en: The queen trusted her young {hand-maid}.
e.zh: 女王信任她年轻的侍女。

e.en: In the old novel, a {hand-maid} brings the lamp upstairs.
e.zh: 在那本旧小说里，一个女仆把灯拿到楼上。

e.en: He wore his brother's {hand-me-down} jacket to school.
e.zh: 他穿着哥哥传下来的旧夹克去上学。

e.en: The recipe is a family {hand-me-down}.
e.zh: 这个食谱是家里一代代传下来的东西。

e.en: Most of her childhood clothes were {hand-me-downs}.
e.zh: 她童年时的大多数衣服都是别人穿过传下来的。

e.en: The charity collects {hand-me-downs} for families in need.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构为困难家庭收集旧衣物和旧用品。

e.en: Please {hand-me-up} the final report today.
e.zh: 请今天把最终报告向上提交。

e.en: The clerk used a {hand-me-up} note for approval.
e.zh: 职员用一张上呈便条申请批准。

e.en: The nurse completed the patient {hand-off} before leaving.
e.zh: 护士离开前完成了病人的交接。

e.en: A smooth {hand-off} kept the project moving.
e.zh: 顺利的交接让项目继续推进。

e.en: Please {hand-on} this message to your manager.
e.zh: 请把这条消息转交给你的经理。

e.en: The tradition was {handed-on} through many generations.
e.zh: 这个传统经过许多代传了下来。

e.en: The teacher gave each student a {hand-out}.
e.zh: 老师给每个学生发了一份讲义。

e.en: Volunteers {handed-out} blankets after the storm.
e.zh: 风暴过后，志愿者分发了毯子。

e.en: They will {hand-over} the keys tomorrow.
e.zh: 他们明天会交出钥匙。

e.en: The army refused to {hand-over} power.
e.zh: 军方拒绝移交权力。

e.en: She bought a {hand-painted} ceramic bowl.
e.zh: 她买了一个手绘陶瓷碗。

e.en: The sign was {hand-painted} in bright blue letters.
e.zh: 招牌是用亮蓝色字母手工画成的。

e.en: The coach will {hand-pick} the final team.
e.zh: 教练会亲自挑选最终队员。

e.en: We {hand-pick} every apple at peak ripeness.
e.zh: 我们在苹果最成熟时逐个手摘。

e.en: The CEO chose a {hand-picked} advisory group.
e.zh: 首席执行官选了一个亲自挑选的顾问团队。

e.en: The restaurant uses {hand-picked} herbs from nearby farms.
e.zh: 这家餐厅使用附近农场手工采摘的香草。

e.en: Hold the {hand-rail} on the stairs.
e.zh: 走楼梯时扶着扶手。

e.en: Workers installed a metal {hand-rail} beside the ramp.
e.zh: 工人在坡道旁安装了金属扶手。

e.en: They {hand-rear} orphaned lambs on the farm.
e.zh: 他们在农场人工饲养失去母羊的小羊。

e.en: It is difficult to {hand-rear} wild bird chicks.
e.zh: 人工养育野鸟雏鸟很困难。

hand-reared.t: 人工饲养的；亲手养大的

e.en: The zoo released several {hand-reared} birds.
e.zh: 动物园放归了几只人工饲养的鸟。

e.en: A {hand-reared} kitten may trust people quickly.
e.zh: 亲手养大的小猫可能很快信任人。

e.en: He lifted the {hand-receiver} and dialed slowly.
e.zh: 他拿起手持听筒，慢慢拨号。

e.en: The old {hand-receiver} crackled during the call.
e.zh: 通话时那个旧电话听筒发出噼啪声。

e.en: The team won five games {hand-running}.
e.zh: 这支队伍连续赢了五场比赛。

e.en: He lost three bets {hand-running} that night.
e.zh: 那天晚上他一连输了三次下注。

hand-setter.t: 手工排字工；手动装配者

e.en: The {hand-setter} arranged each metal letter carefully.
e.zh: 手工排字工小心地摆放每个金属字母。

e.en: A skilled {hand-setter} adjusted the stones by eye.
e.zh: 熟练的手工镶嵌工凭眼力调整宝石。

e.en: Workers {hand-sort} the beans before roasting.
e.zh: 工人在烘焙前手工分拣豆子。

e.en: The archive staff must {hand-sort} damaged records.
e.zh: 档案馆人员必须人工整理受损记录。

e.en: She held a {hand-stand} for ten seconds.
e.zh: 她保持倒立十秒钟。

e.en: The gymnast practiced a perfect {hand-stand} daily.
e.zh: 体操运动员每天练习完美的手倒立。

e.en: Keep the rope {hand-taut} while I tie it.
e.zh: 我打结时你用手把绳子拉紧。

e.en: The canvas stayed {hand-taut} under steady pressure.
e.zh: 帆布在持续手拉下保持绷紧。

e.en: Turn the nut until it is {hand-tight}.
e.zh: 把螺母拧到用手拧紧为止。

e.en: The cap should be {hand-tight}, not forced.
e.zh: 盖子应手拧到紧即可，不要硬拧。

e.en: The soldiers received {hand-to-hand} combat training.
e.zh: 士兵接受了近身格斗训练。

e.en: The argument became almost {hand-to-hand} in the crowd.
e.zh: 在人群中，这场争执几乎变成了近身冲突。

e.en: They lived a {hand-to-mouth} existence for years.
e.zh: 他们多年过着勉强糊口的生活。

e.en: A {hand-to-mouth} budget leaves no room for emergencies.
e.zh: 仅够维持的预算没有应急余地。

e.en: A chisel is a simple {hand-tool}.
e.zh: 凿子是一种简单的手工具。

e.en: The carpenter keeps every {hand-tool} clean and sharp.
e.zh: 木匠把每件手动工具都保持干净锋利。

e.en: Use a {hand-truck} to move the boxes.
e.zh: 用手推搬运车来搬这些箱子。

e.en: The delivery driver rolled the fridge in on a {hand-truck}.
e.zh: 送货司机用两轮推车把冰箱推了进来。

e.en: Regular {hand-washing} helps prevent illness.
e.zh: 经常洗手有助于预防疾病。

e.en: This sweater needs gentle {hand-washing}.
e.zh: 这件毛衣需要轻柔手洗。

e.en: Grandma used a {hand-wringer} for wet clothes.
e.zh: 奶奶用手摇拧衣器处理湿衣服。

e.en: The old {hand-wringer} squeezed water from the sheets.
e.zh: 旧式手摇脱水器把床单里的水挤出来。

e.en: The old shepherd leaned on his {handstaff} while crossing the field.
e.zh: 老牧羊人穿过田地时拄着手杖。

e.en: The performer raised a carved {handstaff} during the ceremony.
e.zh: 表演者在仪式中举起一根雕刻的手持杆。

e.en: The clerk pressed the {handstamp} onto each receipt.
e.zh: 店员把手戳盖在每张收据上。

e.en: They {handstamped} the invitations with blue ink.
e.zh: 他们用蓝色墨水手工给请柬盖章。

e.en: She learned to {handstitch} the leather edges neatly.
e.zh: 她学会了把皮革边缘手工缝得很整齐。

e.en: A tiny {handstitch} repaired the torn cuff.
e.zh: 一个细小的手缝针脚补好了破裂的袖口。

e.en: He bought a {handstitched} wallet from a local maker.
e.zh: 他从本地工匠那里买了一个手工缝制的钱包。

e.en: The {handstitched} hem gave the dress a careful finish.
e.zh: 手工缝制的下摆让这条裙子显得更精细。

e.en: The carpenter sharpened the blade with a small {handstone}.
e.zh: 木匠用一块小磨刀石把刀刃磨利。

e.en: Archaeologists found a worn {handstone} beside the ancient hearth.
e.zh: 考古学家在古代火塘旁发现了一块磨损的手持磨石。

e.en: The workshop can {handtailor} a jacket to your exact measurements.
e.zh: 这家工坊可以按你的精确尺寸手工裁制夹克。

e.en: A skilled {handtailor} adjusted the suit without using machines.
e.zh: 一位熟练的手工裁缝不用机器就改好了西装。

e.en: Every apprentice must learn to use each {handtool} safely.
e.zh: 每个学徒都必须学会安全使用每件手工具。

e.en: A simple {handtool} often works better than a noisy machine.
e.zh: 简单的手用工具常常比吵闹的机器更好用。

e.en: She slipped a {handwarmer} into each glove before skiing.
e.zh: 滑雪前她在每只手套里塞了一个暖手器。

e.en: The reusable {handwarmer} stayed warm for several hours.
e.zh: 这个可重复使用的暖手袋保温了好几个小时。

e.en: Turn the {handwheel} slowly to open the valve.
e.zh: 慢慢转动手轮来打开阀门。

e.en: The machinist adjusted the table with a metal {handwheel}.
e.zh: 机工用金属手动转轮调节工作台。

e.en: The market sold {handwoven} baskets from nearby villages.
e.zh: 市场出售附近村庄制作的手工编织篮子。

e.en: Her coat had a rough, {handwoven} texture.
e.zh: 她的外套有一种粗朴的手工编织质感。

handwringer.t: 焦虑抱怨者；手摇绞干机

e.en: He sounded like a political {handwringer} after every bad poll.
e.zh: 每次民调不好后，他听起来都像个焦虑抱怨的政客。

e.en: Grandma used a {handwringer} to squeeze water from the shirts.
e.zh: 奶奶用手摇绞干机把衬衫里的水挤出来。

e.en: There was too much {handwringing} and not enough planning.
e.zh: 大家过度担忧太多，实际规划却不够。

e.en: The minister dismissed the criticism as media {handwringing}.
e.zh: 部长把批评斥为媒体的焦虑姿态。

e.en: Please {handwrite} your address at the top of the form.
e.zh: 请在表格顶部手写你的地址。

e.en: She likes to {handwrite} thank-you notes after interviews.
e.zh: 她喜欢在面试后亲笔写感谢信。

e.en: The gate was made of {handwrought} iron.
e.zh: 这扇大门是用手工锻造的铁制成的。

e.en: Collectors admired the {handwrought} detail on the silver cup.
e.zh: 收藏家们欣赏银杯上手工打造的细节。

handy-dandy.t: 方便好用的；小巧实用的

e.en: This {handy-dandy} chart shows all the train times.
e.zh: 这张方便好用的图表列出了所有火车时间。

e.en: He pulled out his {handy-dandy} notebook and took notes.
e.zh: 他掏出自己小巧实用的笔记本做记录。

e.en: We called a {handyperson} to repair the leaking sink.
e.zh: 我们叫了一位维修杂工来修漏水的水槽。

e.en: A good {handyperson} can handle many small jobs around a house.
e.zh: 好的万能工能处理家里许多小活。

e.en: The vineyard grows {hanepoot} for sweet dessert wine.
e.zh: 这座葡萄园种植哈尼普特葡萄来酿甜点酒。

e.en: She served chilled {hanepoot} grapes after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后她端上了冰镇的哈尼普特甜葡萄。

hang-dog.t: 羞愧沮丧的；可怜巴巴的

e.en: He wore a {hang-dog} look after missing the penalty.
e.zh: 罚点球失误后，他露出羞愧沮丧的表情。

e.en: The apology came in a quiet, {hang-dog} voice.
e.zh: 道歉时他的声音低低的，显得可怜巴巴。

e.en: The problem is {handleable} with a small team.
e.zh: 这个问题一个小团队就能处理。

e.en: She kept the workload {handleable} during exams.
e.zh: 考试期间她把工作量控制在可承受范围内。

e.en: He caught the fish with a {handline}.
e.zh: 他用手钓线钓到了那条鱼。

e.en: The old printer learned to {handline} type.
e.zh: 那位老印刷工学过手工排字。

e.en: She kept a {handlist} of every guest.
e.zh: 她手写了一份每位客人的名单。

e.en: The clerk would {handlist} the missing parts.
e.zh: 职员会手工列出缺失的零件。

e.en: The careful {handloader} weighed each cartridge.
e.zh: 那名细心的手装弹者给每发子弹称重。

e.en: A {handloader} fed coal into the small furnace.
e.zh: 一名手动装料工把煤送进小炉子里。

e.en: {Handloading} ammunition requires steady attention.
e.zh: 手工装弹需要持续细心。

e.en: The factory still used {handloading} for fragile goods.
e.zh: 这家工厂仍用手动装料处理易碎货物。

e.en: The rug was woven on a {handloom}.
e.zh: 这块地毯是在手织机上织成的。

e.en: They sell {handloom} cotton from local villages.
e.zh: 他们出售当地村庄生产的手工棉织品。

e.en: Her quick {handpass} opened the defense.
e.zh: 她一次快速手传球撕开了防线。

e.en: Please {handpass} the documents down the row.
e.zh: 请把文件沿着这一排用手传下去。

e.en: I left my {handphone} in the taxi.
e.zh: 我把手机落在出租车上了。

e.en: His {handphone} rang during the meeting.
e.zh: 会议期间他的手机响了。

e.en: The magician's {handplay} fooled the audience.
e.zh: 魔术师的手法表演骗过了观众。

e.en: Good guitar {handplay} needs relaxed fingers.
e.zh: 好的吉他手上动作需要手指放松。

e.en: The cards were printed on a {handpress}.
e.zh: 这些卡片是用手工印刷机印的。

e.en: Use a {handpress} to squeeze the juice.
e.zh: 用手压机把果汁挤出来。

e.en: The mechanic used a {handraulic} jack.
e.zh: 机械师使用了一台手动液压千斤顶。

e.en: A {handraulic} pump raised the platform slowly.
e.zh: 一台手动液压泵慢慢升起平台。

e.en: She won the race {hands-down}.
e.zh: 她毫无悬念地赢得了比赛。

e.en: This is {hands-down} the best option.
e.zh: 这毫无疑问是最好的选择。

e.en: He answered with a {hands-free} headset.
e.zh: 他用免提耳机接了电话。

e.en: The car has {hands-free} parking assistance.
e.zh: 这辆车有无需手动操作的泊车辅助。

e.en: Her manager takes a {hands-off} approach.
e.zh: 她的经理采取不干预的管理方式。

e.en: The policy was strictly {hands-off} during talks.
e.zh: 谈判期间这项政策严格保持不插手。

e.en: The shelf missed the wall by a {handsbreadth}.
e.zh: 架子离墙只差一掌宽。

e.en: Victory was a {handsbreadth} away.
e.zh: 胜利只差一点点就到手了。

e.en: The museum displayed several Ming {handscrolls}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几幅明代手卷。

e.en: She unrolled the {handscrolls} very carefully.
e.zh: 她非常小心地展开那些横向书画卷轴。

handsel.t: 新年礼物；开张第一笔钱

e.en: Grandmother gave each child a {handsel}.
e.zh: 祖母给每个孩子一份新年礼物。

e.en: The first sale was a lucky {handsel}.
e.zh: 第一笔生意是一笔吉利的开张钱。

handseled.t: 给了新年礼；开张收款了

e.en: The children were {handseled} with bright coins.
e.zh: 孩子们收到了亮闪闪的硬币作新年礼。

e.en: The shop was {handseled} before noon.
e.zh: 这家店中午前就收到了开张第一笔钱。

e.en: They were {handseling} neighbors after breakfast.
e.zh: 早饭后他们在给邻居送新年礼。

e.en: The merchant enjoyed {handseling} the new stall.
e.zh: 商人很高兴新摊位收到了开张钱。

e.en: He made a living {handselling} pamphlets.
e.zh: 他靠沿街叫卖小册子为生。

e.en: The team tried {handselling} tickets outside the hall.
e.zh: 团队尝试在大厅外手递手卖票。

e.en: She learned to {handsew} her own dresses.
e.zh: 她学会了手工缝制自己的裙子。

e.en: They {handsew} the labels onto each coat.
e.zh: 他们把标签手工缝到每件外套上。

e.en: Use {handsfree} mode while driving.
e.zh: 开车时请使用免提模式。

e.en: The device supports {handsfree} calling.
e.zh: 这台设备支持免提通话。

e.en: A skilled {handsman} repaired the fence.
e.zh: 一位善于动手的人修好了篱笆。

e.en: The captain sent his {handsman} for tools.
e.zh: 船长派助手去拿工具。

e.en: The sailor lifted the hatch with a {handspike}.
e.zh: 水手用撬棍撬起了舱口盖。

e.en: They turned the capstan with a {handspike}.
e.zh: 他们用手用操纵杆转动绞盘。

e.en: The tailor measured the {handarm} carefully.
e.zh: 裁缝仔细量了他的手臂部位。

e.en: Pain ran through his {handarm} after the fall.
e.zh: 摔倒后，他的手臂一阵疼。

e.en: They carried stones on a wooden {handbarrow}.
e.zh: 他们用木制手推担架搬石头。

e.en: The injured miner was placed on a {handbarrow}.
e.zh: 受伤的矿工被放到双人抬运器上。

e.en: She bought a {handblown} glass vase.
e.zh: 她买了一个手工吹制的玻璃花瓶。

e.en: Each {handblown} ornament has tiny differences.
e.zh: 每个手工吹制的装饰品都有细微差别。

e.en: The library displayed a {handbound} poetry book.
e.zh: 图书馆展出了一本手工装订的诗集。

e.en: He gave her a {handbound} notebook.
e.zh: 他送给她一本手工装订的笔记本。

e.en: Move the shelf a {handbreadth} to the left.
e.zh: 把架子向左挪一手宽。

e.en: They escaped by barely a {handbreadth}.
e.zh: 他们几乎只差一点点就没逃掉。

e.en: The workers rode a {handcar} along the track.
e.zh: 工人们坐着手摇铁路小车沿轨道前进。

e.en: An old {handcar} stood beside the station.
e.zh: 车站旁停着一辆旧手摇铁路小车。

e.en: A loud {handclap} started the rhythm.
e.zh: 一声响亮的拍手开启了节奏。

e.en: The coach gave one sharp {handclap}.
e.zh: 教练干脆地拍了一下手。

e.en: The chair shows excellent {handcraftsmanship}.
e.zh: 这把椅子展现出精湛的手工技艺。

e.en: Visitors admired the {handcraftsmanship} of the silver bowl.
e.zh: 参观者赞赏这只银碗的手艺水准。

e.en: She wore a {handed-down} wedding dress.
e.zh: 她穿了一件家里传下来的婚纱。

e.en: The rule was a {handed-down} custom.
e.zh: 这条规矩是沿袭下来的习俗。

e.en: The couple entered a {handfast} before witnesses.
e.zh: 这对伴侣在见证人面前订下婚约。

e.en: In old law, a {handfast} could bind families.
e.zh: 在古代法律中，婚约可能会把两个家族联系起来。

handfasted.t: 已订婚的；已举行结手礼的

e.en: They were {handfasted} in a small ceremony.
e.zh: 他们在一个小仪式上举行了结手礼。

e.en: The {handfasted} pair promised loyalty for a year.
e.zh: 这对已订婚的伴侣承诺相守一年。

e.en: Their {handfasting} took place at sunset.
e.zh: 他们的结手礼在日落时举行。

e.en: The novel describes a medieval {handfasting}.
e.zh: 小说描写了一场中世纪的古式订婚仪式。

e.en: The mechanic used a {handfree} lamp.
e.zh: 机修工使用了一盏免手持的灯。

e.en: This device keeps communication {handfree}.
e.zh: 这个设备让通话不用手拿。

e.en: The sword had a brass {handguard}.
e.zh: 这把剑有一个黄铜护手。

e.en: Wear the {handguard} when using the cutter.
e.zh: 使用切割器时要戴上手部防护件。

e.en: The {handicraftsman} carved toys from pine.
e.zh: 这位手工艺人用松木雕刻玩具。

e.en: A skilled {handicraftsman} repaired the basket.
e.zh: 一位熟练的手工艺人修好了篮子。

e.en: The officer carried a spare {handicuff}.
e.zh: 警官带着一副备用手铐。

e.en: They planned to {handicuff} the prisoner securely.
e.zh: 他们打算把囚犯牢牢铐住。

e.en: The guard spoke into a {handie-talkie}.
e.zh: 保安对着手持对讲机说话。

e.en: Each volunteer received a {handie-talkie}.
e.zh: 每位志愿者都拿到了一部手持对讲机。

e.en: The phone's {handiness} made it popular.
e.zh: 这款手机的方便性让它很受欢迎。

e.en: His {handiness} around the house saved money.
e.zh: 他在家里动手能力强，省了不少钱。

e.en: She heated the {handiron} on the stove.
e.zh: 她把手熨斗放在炉子上加热。

e.en: The museum kept an old {handiron} for visitors.
e.zh: 博物馆保存了一只旧式手熨斗供游客观看。

e.en: The film includes a joke about a {handjob}.
e.zh: 电影里有一个关于手交的笑话。

e.en: He used the word {handjob} in a vulgar way.
e.zh: 他用这个词时带着粗俗意味。

e.en: She packed three clean {handkerchieves}.
e.zh: 她装了三条干净手帕。

e.en: The drawer was full of embroidered {handkerchieves}.
e.zh: 抽屉里满是绣花手帕。

e.en: The inspector carried a bright {handlamp}.
e.zh: 检查员拿着一盏明亮的手提灯。

e.en: A {handlamp} helped them search the cellar.
e.zh: 一盏手持灯帮助他们搜查地窖。

e.en: Engineers tested the package's {handleability}.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这个包装的易操作性。

e.en: Good {handleability} matters in emergency equipment.
e.zh: 应急设备的可处理性很重要。

e.en: A pale {halfmoon} hung over the harbor.
e.zh: 一弯淡淡的半月挂在港口上空。

e.en: The table had a {halfmoon} cutout for cables.
e.zh: 桌面有一个半月形开口用来穿线。

e.en: The wrestler trapped him in a {halfnelson}.
e.zh: 摔跤手用半尼尔森式把他制住了。

e.en: She joked that the toddler had her in a {halfnelson}.
e.zh: 她开玩笑说那个小孩像用半尼尔森式缠住了她。

e.en: They paused on the {halfpace} between floors.
e.zh: 他们在两层之间的楼梯平台上停了一下。

e.en: A narrow {halfpace} led to the old chapel door.
e.zh: 一处狭窄的平台通向旧礼拜堂的门。

halfpennyworth.t: 半便士价值；微不足道的量

e.en: He bought a {halfpennyworth} of sweets.
e.zh: 他买了半便士的一点糖果。

e.en: There was not a {halfpennyworth} of truth in it.
e.zh: 那里面连一点点真话都没有。

e.en: The children are home for {halfterm} next week.
e.zh: 孩子们下周放半学期假在家。

e.en: Her marks improved after the {halfterm} break.
e.zh: 半学期假之后，她的成绩提高了。

e.en: The museum restored a wartime {halftrack}.
e.zh: 博物馆修复了一辆战时半履带车。

e.en: A {halftrack} vehicle could cross the muddy field.
e.zh: 半履带式车辆能穿过泥泞的田地。

e.en: She won the point with a sharp {halfvolley}.
e.zh: 她用一次利落的半凌空击球赢下这一分。

e.en: The batsman mistimed a {halfvolley} outside off stump.
e.zh: 击球手没有掌握好外侧一记半凌空球的时机。

e.en: The bartender poured him a {halfy} of whisky.
e.zh: 酒保给他倒了半瓶量的威士忌。

e.en: As a child, she paid a {halfy} on the bus.
e.zh: 她小时候坐公交只付儿童半票。

e.en: The poet praised the {halid} ground of his ancestors.
e.zh: 诗人赞美祖先那片神圣的土地。

e.en: They kept the old relic as a {halid}.
e.zh: 他们把那件旧遗物当作圣物保存。

e.en: The knight swore by his {halidom}.
e.zh: 骑士以自己的圣物起誓。

e.en: Pilgrims traveled far to visit the {halidom}.
e.zh: 朝圣者远道而来参拜那处圣地。

e.en: The abbey guarded a famous {halidome}.
e.zh: 那座修道院守护着一件有名的圣物。

e.en: Legends called the island a {halidome} of peace.
e.zh: 传说把这座岛称作和平的圣地。

e.en: The report examined {halieutic} practices along the coast.
e.zh: 报告考察了沿海的捕鱼做法。

e.en: He collected old {halieutic} poems from Greece.
e.zh: 他收集了希腊古代关于捕鱼的诗作。

e.en: She studied {halieutics} at the marine institute.
e.zh: 她在海洋研究所学习渔业学。

e.en: Ancient writers treated {halieutics} as both craft and science.
e.zh: 古代作者把捕鱼术既看作技艺也看作学问。

e.en: The musician played a mournful tune on the {halil}.
e.zh: 乐师用哈利勒长笛吹出哀婉的曲调。

e.en: A carved {halil} hung above the shop door.
e.zh: 一支雕刻过的土耳其长笛挂在店门上方。

e.en: The mine produced clear crystals of {halite}.
e.zh: 这座矿出产透明的岩盐晶体。

e.en: Geologists identified the layer as ancient {halite}.
e.zh: 地质学家确认这一层是古老的石盐。

e.en: The doctor noticed a sour {halitus}.
e.zh: 医生注意到一股酸味的口气。

e.en: A warm {halitus} rose from the wet earth.
e.zh: 湿土中升起一股温热的气息。

e.en: The child hid in a dark {halk} of the barn.
e.zh: 孩子躲在谷仓一个黑暗的角落里。

e.en: Old tools lay forgotten in the {halk}.
e.zh: 旧工具被遗忘在那个隐蔽处。

e.en: The chemist tested a new {hallachrome} under light.
e.zh: 化学家在光照下测试一种新的变色物质。

e.en: A {hallachrome} coating made the label change color.
e.zh: 变色涂层让标签改变了颜色。

e.en: Traders paid {hallage} before setting up their stalls.
e.zh: 商贩摆摊前要缴纳市场摊位费。

e.en: The town records listed {hallage} among local dues.
e.zh: 镇上的记录把市集租费列为地方税费之一。

e.en: She baked {hallah} for the Friday meal.
e.zh: 她为星期五的晚餐烤了犹太辫子面包。

e.en: Slices of {hallah} made excellent French toast.
e.zh: 切片的犹太面包很适合做法式吐司。

hallal.t: 猎人的欢呼声；围猎呐喊

e.en: The riders gave a loud {hallal} at the finish.
e.zh: 骑手们在终点发出响亮的围猎欢呼。

e.en: A distant {hallal} echoed across the valley.
e.zh: 远处的猎人呐喊在山谷中回荡。

e.en: The horn sounded the {hallali} after the chase.
e.zh: 追猎结束后，号角吹响了猎号声。

e.en: They heard a faint {hallali} from the woods.
e.zh: 他们听见树林里传来微弱的追猎欢呼。

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered a {hallcist} near the ridge.
e.zh: 考古学家在山脊附近发现了一座史前石室墓。

e.en: The {hallcist} contained pottery and bone fragments.
e.zh: 这座石室墓里有陶器和骨片。

e.en: The old port belonged to the {Hanse}.
e.zh: 这座古老港口曾属于汉萨同盟。

e.en: Merchants of the {Hanse} traded across northern Europe.
e.zh: 汉萨同盟的商人在北欧各地经商。

e.en: A lonely {hant} was said to roam the road.
e.zh: 据说有个孤魂在那条路上游荡。

e.en: The child feared every shadow was a {hant}.
e.zh: 那孩子害怕每个影子都是幽灵。

e.en: They lit candles for {Hanukkah} each evening.
e.zh: 他们每天晚上为光明节点蜡烛。

e.en: The school concert included several {Hanukkah} songs.
e.zh: 学校音乐会里有几首光明节歌曲。

e.en: The priest prepared {haoma} for the ritual.
e.zh: 祭司为仪式准备了豪麻圣饮。

e.en: Scholars debate the plant used in ancient {haoma}.
e.zh: 学者们争论古代豪麻所用的植物。

e.en: She wore a silk {haori} over her kimono.
e.zh: 她在和服外面穿了一件丝质羽织。

e.en: The vintage {haori} had a crane pattern.
e.zh: 那件复古羽织有仙鹤图案。

e.en: The report noted severe {haparinemia} after treatment.
e.zh: 报告指出治疗后出现严重血液肝素过多症。

e.en: Doctors monitored the patient for signs of {haparinemia}.
e.zh: 医生监测病人是否有血液肝素过多症迹象。

e.en: By {hapchance}, we met again at the station.
e.zh: 我们碰巧又在车站见面了。

e.en: The discovery came through {hapchance}, not planning.
e.zh: 这个发现出于偶然，并非事先计划。

e.en: He would not spend a {hapenny} more.
e.zh: 他连半便士都不肯多花。

e.en: The old sweet cost only a {hapenny}.
e.zh: 那种老式糖果只卖半便士。

e.en: The files showed years of administrative {haphazardry}.
e.zh: 这些文件显示多年行政管理杂乱无章。

e.en: Her method had too much {haphazardry} for science.
e.zh: 她的方法太随意，不适合科学研究。

e.en: His {haphephobia} made crowded trains unbearable.
e.zh: 他的接触恐惧症让拥挤的火车难以忍受。

e.en: Therapy helped her manage {haphephobia} gradually.
e.zh: 治疗帮助她逐渐控制接触恐惧症。

hang-glider.t: 悬挂式滑翔机；滑翔伞翼

e.en: A {hang-glider} circled above the ridge.
e.zh: 一架悬挂式滑翔机在山脊上方盘旋。

e.en: She bought a secondhand {hang-glider} for training.
e.zh: 她买了一架二手悬挂式滑翔机用于训练。

e.en: Two {hang-gliders} launched from the cliff.
e.zh: 两架悬挂式滑翔机从悬崖上起飞。

e.en: The club stores its {hang-gliders} in a shed.
e.zh: 俱乐部把悬挂式滑翔机存放在棚屋里。

e.en: He tried {hang-gliding} during his holiday.
e.zh: 他在假期里尝试了悬挂式滑翔。

e.en: {Hang-gliding} requires careful weather checks.
e.zh: 悬挂式滑翔需要仔细查看天气情况。

e.en: The cafe became our favorite {hang-out}.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆成了我们最爱去的聚会处。

e.en: Their weekend {hang-out} is near the station.
e.zh: 他们周末常去的地方在车站附近。

e.en: She has a {hang-up} about public speaking.
e.zh: 她对公开演讲有心理障碍。

e.en: I heard the {hang-up} before he answered.
e.zh: 他还没来得及回答，我就听到电话被挂断了。

e.en: His {hang-ups} about money caused arguments.
e.zh: 他对金钱的那些顾虑引发了争吵。

e.en: Everyone has private {hang-ups} to overcome.
e.zh: 每个人都有需要克服的私人心理障碍。

e.en: The frame is light and {hangable}.
e.zh: 这个框架很轻，可以挂起来。

e.en: Only {hangable} decorations are allowed here.
e.zh: 这里只允许使用可悬挂的装饰品。

e.en: The airport charges monthly {hangarage}.
e.zh: 机场按月收取机库停放费。

e.en: Private pilots often struggle to find {hangarage}.
e.zh: 私人飞行员常常很难找到机库存放空间。

e.en: The {hangbird} built a nest over water.
e.zh: 那只织巢鸟在水面上方筑了巢。

e.en: A bright {hangbird} flashed through the trees.
e.zh: 一只色彩鲜艳的悬巢鸟掠过树林。

e.en: A {hanger-on} followed the celebrity everywhere.
e.zh: 一个攀附者到处跟着那位名人。

e.en: He disliked being treated as a {hanger-on}.
e.zh: 他不喜欢被人当成无足轻重的跟班。

e.en: The singer arrived with several {hangers-on}.
e.zh: 那名歌手带着几个跟班到了。

e.en: Successful politicians attract {hangers-on} quickly.
e.zh: 成功的政治人物很快会吸引一批攀附者。

e.en: Old muskets sometimes {hangfire} after the trigger is pulled.
e.zh: 老式火枪有时扣动扳机后会延迟发火。

e.en: The committee chose to {hangfire} on the proposal.
e.zh: 委员会决定暂缓处理这项提案。

e.en: The oriole wove a {hangnest} from grass.
e.zh: 那只黄鹂用草编了一个悬挂式鸟巢。

e.en: We found a tiny {hangnest} under the branch.
e.zh: 我们在树枝下发现了一个小小的悬挂式鸟巢。

e.en: The jacket still had its {hangtag}.
e.zh: 这件夹克还挂着吊牌。

e.en: Scan the {hangtag} to check the price.
e.zh: 扫描吊牌就能查看价格。

hangtime.t: 滞空时间；空中停留时间

e.en: The basketball player showed amazing {hangtime}.
e.zh: 那名篮球运动员展现了惊人的滞空时间。

e.en: A longer jump gives the snowboarder more {hangtime}.
e.zh: 跳得更远会让单板滑雪者有更长的空中停留时间。

e.en: She learned to read {Hangul} in a week.
e.zh: 她一周内学会了读韩文字母。

e.en: The sign was written in {Hangul}.
e.zh: 那个标牌是用谚文写的。

e.en: His biggest {hangup} is fear of failure.
e.zh: 他最大的心理障碍是害怕失败。

e.en: Don't let one {hangup} stop the project.
e.zh: 不要让一个顾虑阻碍整个项目。

e.en: The lamp was supported by a thin {hangwire}.
e.zh: 那盏灯由一根细吊挂钢丝支撑。

e.en: Replace the rusty {hangwire} before installing the sign.
e.zh: 安装标牌前先更换生锈的悬挂线。

e.en: The museum displayed a clay {haniwa}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件陶制埴轮。

e.en: A {haniwa} figure guarded the ancient tomb.
e.zh: 一个埴轮人像守在古墓旁。

e.en: He wiped his glasses with a {hankerchief}.
e.zh: 他用手帕擦了擦眼镜。

e.en: She tied a red {hankerchief} around her neck.
e.zh: 她把一条红方巾系在脖子上。

e.en: There was some {hanky-panky} with the accounts.
e.zh: 账目里有些欺骗把戏。

e.en: They suspected {hanky-panky} between the two coworkers.
e.zh: 他们怀疑那两名同事之间有暧昧勾当。

haphtara.t: 哈夫塔拉经文选读；先知书选段

e.en: The cantor chanted the {haphtara} after the Torah reading.
e.zh: 领唱者在诵读妥拉之后吟诵了哈夫塔拉经文。

e.en: She studied the weekly {haphtara} before the service.
e.zh: 礼拜前，她研读了每周的先知书选段。

e.en: The lab identified the sample as a {haplite} form.
e.zh: 实验室确认该样本是一种单倍体形态。

e.en: A {haplite} carries only one set of chromosomes.
e.zh: 单倍体只携带一套染色体。

e.en: The alga is a {haplobiont} with no separate diploid generation.
e.zh: 这种藻类是单相生活史生物，没有独立的二倍体世代。

e.en: Researchers compared each {haplobiont} to related species.
e.zh: 研究人员把每种单相生活史生物与近缘物种作比较。

e.en: The fungus has a {haplobiontic} life cycle.
e.zh: 这种真菌具有单相生活史。

e.en: A {haplobiontic} organism lacks an alternating multicellular phase.
e.zh: 单相生活史的生物没有交替出现的多细胞阶段。

e.en: Each {haplochromosome} was mapped during the genetic study.
e.zh: 在遗传研究中，每条单倍染色体都被绘制出来。

e.en: The mutation appeared on a single {haplochromosome}.
e.zh: 该突变出现在一条单倍染色体上。

haplography.t: 漏写相同音节的书写错误

e.en: The scribe's {haplography} changed the meaning of the line.
e.zh: 抄写员漏写重复音节，改变了这一行的意思。

e.en: Editors marked the omission as {haplography}.
e.zh: 编辑把这个遗漏标注为重复音节漏写。

e.en: The parasite showed a {haplohaustorial} attachment pattern.
e.zh: 这种寄生物表现出单吸器附着模式。

e.en: A {haplohaustorial} structure penetrated the host tissue.
e.zh: 一个单吸器结构穿入了宿主组织。

e.en: The rust fungus follows a {haploheteroecious} cycle.
e.zh: 这种锈菌遵循单倍异寄主生活周期。

e.en: A {haploheteroecious} parasite needs different hosts at different stages.
e.zh: 单倍异寄主的寄生物在不同阶段需要不同宿主。

e.en: The cells remained {haploidic} throughout the experiment.
e.zh: 这些细胞在整个实验中都保持单倍体状态。

e.en: A {haploidic} nucleus contains one chromosome set.
e.zh: 单倍体细胞核含有一套染色体。

e.en: The treatment induced {haploidization} in the cultured cells.
e.zh: 这种处理诱导培养细胞发生单倍体化。

e.en: Researchers tracked {haploidization} after chromosome loss.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪染色体丢失后的单倍体化过程。

e.en: Yeast can survive in a state of {haploidy}.
e.zh: 酵母可以在单倍体状态下存活。

e.en: The study measured {haploidy} across several cell lines.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了多个细胞系的单倍性。

haplology.t: 省略重复音节的语音现象

e.en: The word changed through {haplology} in everyday speech.
e.zh: 这个词在日常口语中因重复音节省略而发生变化。

e.en: Linguists cite {haplology} to explain the shorter form.
e.zh: 语言学家用音节省略现象解释这个较短形式。

e.en: The organism reproduces through {haplomitosis} under stress.
e.zh: 这种生物在压力下通过单倍有丝分裂繁殖。

e.en: Microscopy revealed {haplomitosis} in the fungal cells.
e.zh: 显微观察显示真菌细胞中发生了单倍有丝分裂。

e.en: A {haplont} spends most of its life with one chromosome set.
e.zh: 单倍体生物一生大多时候只有一套染色体。

e.en: The textbook contrasts a {haplont} with a diplont.
e.zh: 教材把单倍体生物与二倍体生物作对比。

e.en: The insect has a {haploparthenogenetic} mode of reproduction.
e.zh: 这种昆虫具有单倍孤雌生殖方式。

e.en: In a {haploparthenogenetic} lineage, males may develop from unfertilized eggs.
e.zh: 在单倍孤雌生殖谱系中，雄性可能由未受精卵发育而来。

e.en: The moss stage is treated as a {haplophyte}.
e.zh: 苔藓的这一阶段被视为单倍体植物。

e.en: A {haplophyte} produces gametes without meiosis.
e.zh: 单倍体植物产生配子时不经过减数分裂。

e.en: The therapy helped restore {haplopia} after months of double vision.
e.zh: 经过数月复视后，治疗帮助恢复了单视。

e.en: Doctors tested for {haplopia} during the eye examination.
e.zh: 医生在眼科检查中测试是否为单视状态。

haploscope.t: 单视镜；双眼视觉测试仪

e.en: The optometrist adjusted the {haploscope} for the patient.
e.zh: 验光师为患者调节了单视镜。

e.en: A {haploscope} can test how the two eyes work together.
e.zh: 单视镜可以测试双眼如何协同工作。

e.en: The paper describes {haplosis} during gamete formation.
e.zh: 论文描述了配子形成过程中染色体数减半的现象。

e.en: Abnormal {haplosis} can affect fertility.
e.zh: 异常的单倍化可能影响生育能力。

e.en: The leaves form a {haplostichous} pattern along the stem.
e.zh: 叶片沿茎形成单列排列。

e.en: Botanists noted the {haplostichous} arrangement of the bracts.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到苞片呈单列排列。

e.en: The specimen had a {haplostromatic} fruiting structure.
e.zh: 该标本具有单层子座的结果结构。

e.en: A {haplostromatic} fungus forms only one stromatic layer.
e.zh: 单层子座真菌只形成一层子座组织。

e.en: The rust was classified as {haplosynoecious} by the specialist.
e.zh: 专家将这种锈菌归为单倍同寄主类型。

e.en: A {haplosynoecious} life cycle occurs on one host species.
e.zh: 单倍同寄主的生活周期发生在同一种宿主上。

e.en: By {happ}, the lost letter reached him.
e.zh: 机缘巧合之下，那封遗失的信到了他手里。

e.en: Old poems often speak of {happ} and fortune.
e.zh: 古诗中常会谈到偶然和命运。

e.en: Their meeting was pure {happenchance}.
e.zh: 他们的相遇纯属机缘巧合。

e.en: By {happenchance}, she found the note in an old coat.
e.zh: 偶然间，她在一件旧外套里发现了那张便条。

happenstantial.t: 偶然发生的；出于巧合的

e.en: The discovery was {happenstantial}, not planned.
e.zh: 这个发现是偶然发生的，并非事先计划。

e.en: He described their alliance as {happenstantial} and fragile.
e.zh: 他形容他们的联盟出于巧合，而且十分脆弱。

e.en: The small inlet offered {harborage} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中，那个小海湾提供了停泊避风的地方。

e.en: Old barns sometimes provide {harborage} for pests.
e.zh: 旧谷仓有时会给害虫提供藏身之处。

e.en: The {harborless} coast was dangerous for small boats.
e.zh: 这片没有港口的海岸对小船很危险。

e.en: He felt {harborless} after leaving his old community.
e.zh: 离开旧社区后，他觉得自己像失去了避风港。

e.en: They ate dinner at a {harborside} restaurant.
e.zh: 他们在一家港边餐厅吃了晚饭。

e.en: The old warehouses were converted into {harborside} apartments.
e.zh: 那些旧仓库被改造成了港口附近的公寓。

e.en: The bay gave ships safe {harbourage} overnight.
e.zh: 这个海湾让船只夜里能安全停泊。

e.en: Dense weeds can provide {harbourage} for insects.
e.zh: 茂密的杂草会给昆虫提供藏身处。

e.en: Fishing was difficult along the {harbourless} shore.
e.zh: 在这片没有港口的海岸边捕鱼很困难。

e.en: The refugees felt {harbourless} in a foreign city.
e.zh: 难民们在异国城市里感到无处安身。

e.en: The {harbourmaster} warned sailors about the fog.
e.zh: 港务长提醒水手注意大雾。

e.en: Every visiting boat had to report to the {harbourmaster}.
e.zh: 每艘来访船只都必须向港口管理员报到。

hard-and-fast.t: 严格固定的；不可变通的

e.en: There is no {hard-and-fast} rule for every case.
e.zh: 并没有一条适用于所有情况的死规定。

e.en: The manager set a {hard-and-fast} deadline for Friday.
e.zh: 经理把周五定成了不可变通的最后期限。

e.en: The new coach is a {hard-ass} about punctuality.
e.zh: 新教练在准时这件事上非常严厉。

e.en: He acts like a {hard-ass}, but he is fair.
e.zh: 他表现得像个狠角色，但其实很公正。

e.en: Her {hard-assed} approach improved the team's discipline.
e.zh: 她强硬严厉的做法改善了团队纪律。

e.en: The officer sounded {hard-assed} but gave clear instructions.
e.zh: 那名官员听起来很不通融，但指示很清楚。

hard-bitten.t: 饱经风霜的；冷峻老练的

e.en: The {hard-bitten} detective trusted almost no one.
e.zh: 那位冷峻老练的侦探几乎不信任任何人。

e.en: She gave a {hard-bitten} smile after years of disappointment.
e.zh: 多年失望之后，她露出一个饱经风霜的笑容。

e.en: Please {hard-boil} six eggs for the salad.
e.zh: 请把六个鸡蛋煮成全熟，用来做沙拉。

e.en: It takes about ten minutes to {hard-boil} an egg.
e.zh: 把一个鸡蛋煮老大约需要十分钟。

e.en: She packed two {hard-boiled} eggs for lunch.
e.zh: 她午餐带了两个煮老的鸡蛋。

e.en: The novel features a {hard-boiled} private detective.
e.zh: 这部小说里有一位冷硬世故的私家侦探。

hard-burned.t: 烧得很硬的；严重灼伤的

e.en: The potter used {hard-burned} bricks for the kiln.
e.zh: 陶工用烧得很硬的砖来砌窑。

e.en: His hands were {hard-burned} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后，他的双手被严重灼伤。

e.en: Do not {hard-code} the password in the script.
e.zh: 不要把密码硬编码在脚本里。

e.en: They had to {hard-code} the value for the demo.
e.zh: 为了演示，他们不得不把这个值写死在程序里。

hard-core.t: 核心顽固的；露骨色情的

e.en: Only the {hard-core} fans stayed until midnight.
e.zh: 只有最铁杆的粉丝一直待到午夜。

e.en: The site was blocked for showing {hard-core} material.
e.zh: 该网站因展示露骨色情内容而被封锁。

hard-drawn.t: 冷拉硬化的；费力拉出的

e.en: The engineer specified {hard-drawn} copper wire.
e.zh: 工程师指定使用冷拉硬化的铜线。

e.en: A {hard-drawn} breath escaped his lips.
e.zh: 他费力地从嘴里吐出一口气。

e.en: He played a {hard-drinking} journalist in the film.
e.zh: 他在电影中饰演一名酗酒的记者。

e.en: The town had a {hard-drinking} reputation among sailors.
e.zh: 这座镇子在水手中有豪饮成风的名声。

hard-driving.t: 强力进取的；逼人奋进的

e.en: She is a {hard-driving} lawyer with little patience for delays.
e.zh: 她是一位强势进取的律师，几乎不能容忍拖延。

e.en: The band played a {hard-driving} rhythm all night.
e.zh: 乐队整晚都演奏着强劲有力的节奏。

hard-earned.t: 辛苦挣来的；来之不易的

e.en: They spent their {hard-earned} savings on a house.
e.zh: 他们把辛苦攒下的积蓄花在了买房上。

e.en: The victory was {hard-earned} after months of training.
e.zh: 经过数月训练，这场胜利来之不易。

hard-edged.t: 棱角分明的；冷峻强硬的

e.en: The painting uses {hard-edged} shapes and bright colors.
e.zh: 这幅画使用了棱角分明的形状和鲜艳色彩。

e.en: Her speech had a {hard-edged} tone.
e.zh: 她的讲话带着冷峻强硬的语气。

hard-eyed.t: 目光冷峻的；精明不动情的

e.en: The {hard-eyed} negotiator refused the first offer.
e.zh: 那位目光冷峻的谈判者拒绝了第一份报价。

e.en: She gave him a {hard-eyed} look across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子冷冷地看了他一眼。

e.en: Workers {hard-face} the drill bits to reduce wear.
e.zh: 工人给钻头做硬面处理以减少磨损。

e.en: The company will {hard-face} the valve seats before shipment.
e.zh: 公司会在发货前对阀座进行硬面堆焊。

e.en: The app tries to {happify} daily routines.
e.zh: 这个应用试图让日常事务变得更开心。

e.en: No slogan can {happify} a tired workforce.
e.zh: 任何口号都无法让疲惫的员工真正开心起来。

e.en: He disliked the {happy-clappy} tone of the meeting.
e.zh: 他不喜欢会议那种过分热情乐观的调子。

e.en: The service ended with {happy-clappy} songs.
e.zh: 礼拜以热闹欢快的歌曲结束。

e.en: They posed as one big {happy-family}.
e.zh: 他们装出一个大家庭其乐融融的样子。

e.en: The team was hardly a {happy-family} after the dispute.
e.zh: 争执过后，这个团队很难说还是和睦的一伙。

happy-go-lucky.t: 无忧无虑的；随遇而安的

e.en: His {happy-go-lucky} attitude annoyed the planners.
e.zh: 他无忧无虑的态度让策划人员很恼火。

e.en: She seemed {happy-go-lucky}, but she saved carefully.
e.zh: 她看似随遇而安，但其实存钱很谨慎。

e.en: A {hapten} can trigger immunity only after binding to a carrier.
e.zh: 半抗原只有与载体结合后才可能引发免疫反应。

e.en: The lab tested whether the dye acted as a {hapten}.
e.zh: 实验室检测这种染料是否起半抗原作用。

e.en: Some small chemicals are {haptens} in allergic reactions.
e.zh: 一些小分子化学物质在过敏反应中是半抗原。

e.en: The researchers compared two {haptens} in the assay.
e.zh: 研究人员在测定中比较了两种半抗原。

e.en: The alga anchors itself with a {hapteron}.
e.zh: 这种藻类用附着器把自己固定住。

e.en: Each {hapteron} helps the parasite cling to its host.
e.zh: 每个固着器官都帮助寄生体附着在宿主上。

e.en: The device gives {haptical} feedback through tiny vibrations.
e.zh: 这个设备通过细微震动提供触觉反馈。

e.en: Her study focused on {haptical} perception in infants.
e.zh: 她的研究关注婴儿的触觉感知。

e.en: Low {haptoglobin} may suggest red blood cell destruction.
e.zh: 结合珠蛋白偏低可能提示红细胞被破坏。

e.en: The doctor ordered a {haptoglobin} test.
e.zh: 医生开了结合珠蛋白检测。

e.en: The clinic used a {haptometer} to measure touch sensitivity.
e.zh: 诊所用触觉计测量触觉敏感度。

e.en: A digital {haptometer} recorded the pressure threshold.
e.zh: 数字触感测量器记录了压力阈值。

e.en: The antibody binds through its {haptophore} group.
e.zh: 抗体通过其亲和基团发生结合。

e.en: Early immunologists described the toxin's {haptophore} region.
e.zh: 早期免疫学家描述了这种毒素的结合区域。

e.en: Vines show {haptotropism} when they curl around supports.
e.zh: 藤蔓缠绕支架时表现出向触性。

e.en: The experiment measured {haptotropism} in young tendrils.
e.zh: 实验测量了幼嫩卷须的触向性。

e.en: The chef grilled fresh {hapuku} with herbs.
e.zh: 厨师用香草烤了新鲜的新西兰石斑鱼。

e.en: Divers sometimes see {hapuku} near deep reefs.
e.zh: 潜水员有时会在深礁附近看到新西兰石斑鱼。

e.en: The novel describes a samurai committing {hara-kiri}.
e.zh: 小说描写了一名武士剖腹自杀。

e.en: Ignoring the warnings was political {hara-kiri}.
e.zh: 无视这些警告等于政治自毁。

e.en: The old account says he chose {harakiri} over capture.
e.zh: 旧记载说他宁愿剖腹自杀也不愿被俘。

e.en: Canceling the project now would be financial {harakiri}.
e.zh: 现在取消这个项目会是财务上的自毁。

e.en: Pork is considered {haram} in Islamic law.
e.zh: 在伊斯兰教法中，猪肉被视为禁忌。

e.en: He asked whether the investment was {haram}.
e.zh: 他询问这项投资是否违反伊斯兰禁忌。

e.en: The village held a {harambee} to repair the school.
e.zh: 村里举行公益筹款会来修缮学校。

e.en: The president called for {harambee} during the crisis.
e.zh: 总统在危机中呼吁大家齐心协力。

e.en: The museum displayed {Harappan} seals from the Indus Valley.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了印度河流域的哈拉帕文明印章。

e.en: Scholars still debate the {Harappan} writing system.
e.zh: 学者们仍在争论哈拉帕文明的文字系统。

hard-faced.t: 表情冷硬的；面貌严厉的

e.en: The guard looked {hard-faced} and tired after the long shift.
e.zh: 长时间值班后，那个守卫看起来表情冷硬又疲惫。

e.en: A {hard-faced} woman opened the door without smiling.
e.zh: 一位面容严厉的女人打开门，脸上一点笑意也没有。

hard-favoured.t: 面貌严厉的；长相粗硬的

e.en: The portrait showed a {hard-favoured} gentleman in a dark coat.
e.zh: 那幅画像描绘了一位穿深色外套、面貌严厉的绅士。

e.en: She remembered him as a {hard-favoured} man with sharp eyes.
e.zh: 她记得他是个眼神锐利、长相粗硬的男人。

hard-featured.t: 五官棱角分明而严厉的

e.en: His {hard-featured} face softened when the child smiled.
e.zh: 孩子一笑，他那张棱角分明而严厉的脸也柔和了下来。

e.en: The actor was often cast as {hard-featured} soldiers and detectives.
e.zh: 那名演员常被安排饰演面相冷峻的士兵和侦探。

hard-fought.t: 艰苦争取来的；激烈较量的

e.en: They celebrated a {hard-fought} victory after extra time.
e.zh: 加时赛后，他们庆祝了一场艰苦赢来的胜利。

e.en: The reform was a {hard-fought} achievement for local activists.
e.zh: 这项改革是当地活动人士艰难争取来的成果。

hard-hat.t: 安全帽；戴安全帽的工人

e.en: Every visitor must wear a {hard-hat} on the construction site.
e.zh: 每位访客进入建筑工地都必须戴安全帽。

e.en: The mayor promised more jobs for {hard-hat} workers.
e.zh: 市长承诺为体力工人提供更多工作机会。

e.en: We need a {hard-headed} analysis of the costs.
e.zh: 我们需要对成本作出务实冷静的分析。

e.en: He can be {hard-headed} when someone challenges his plans.
e.zh: 有人质疑他的计划时，他会变得很固执。

hard-hearted.t: 铁石心肠的；冷酷无情的

e.en: Only a {hard-hearted} person could ignore their suffering.
e.zh: 只有铁石心肠的人才会无视他们的痛苦。

e.en: The judge was firm but not {hard-hearted}.
e.zh: 那位法官很坚定，但并非冷酷无情。

hard-hit.t: 受严重打击的；受创很重的

e.en: Small shops were {hard-hit} by the sudden lockdown.
e.zh: 突如其来的封锁让小商店受到严重打击。

e.en: Aid was sent to the {hard-hit} coastal towns.
e.zh: 救援物资被送往受灾严重的沿海城镇。

hard-hitting.t: 直击要害的；猛烈有力的

e.en: The report offered a {hard-hitting} critique of the policy.
e.zh: 这份报告对该政策提出了直击要害的批评。

e.en: She is known for {hard-hitting} questions in interviews.
e.zh: 她在采访中以提问犀利有力而闻名。

e.en: The pilot managed to {hard-land} the damaged aircraft safely.
e.zh: 飞行员设法让受损飞机硬着陆并保证了安全。

e.en: Investors feared the economy would {hard-land} after years of growth.
e.zh: 投资者担心多年增长后经济会出现硬着陆。

e.en: A party {hard-liner} opposed any compromise with the opposition.
e.zh: 一名党内强硬派反对与反对派作任何妥协。

e.en: The minister sounded like a security {hard-liner} during the debate.
e.zh: 辩论中，那位部长听起来像个安全政策强硬派。

e.en: It was a {hard-luck} story, but he told it without bitterness.
e.zh: 那是个倒霉的故事，但他说起来并没有怨气。

e.en: The team suffered another {hard-luck} defeat in the final minute.
e.zh: 那支队伍在最后一分钟又遭遇了一场倒霉的失利。

e.en: The film made him famous as a local {hard-man}.
e.zh: 那部电影让他以本地硬汉形象成名。

e.en: He played the political {hard-man} in cabinet meetings.
e.zh: 他在内阁会议上扮演政治强硬人物的角色。

hard-nosed.t: 精明务实的；不讲情面的

e.en: The company hired a {hard-nosed} negotiator to cut costs.
e.zh: 公司聘请了一位精明务实的谈判者来削减成本。

e.en: Her {hard-nosed} approach upset some idealists on the team.
e.zh: 她不讲情面的做法让团队里一些理想主义者不满。

e.en: My grandfather is {hard-of-hearing}, so please speak clearly.
e.zh: 我祖父听力不太好，所以请说清楚一点。

e.en: The theater provides headsets for {hard-of-hearing} guests.
e.zh: 剧院为听力不佳的客人提供耳机。

e.en: He was embarrassed when he got a {hard-on} unexpectedly.
e.zh: 他突然勃起时感到很尴尬。

e.en: The critic seemed to have a {hard-on} for attacking popular films.
e.zh: 那位评论家似乎特别热衷于攻击热门电影。

e.en: The museum displayed rare {hard-paste} porcelain from the eighteenth century.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了十八世纪罕见的硬质瓷器。

e.en: Collectors value {hard-paste} pieces for their strength and translucence.
e.zh: 收藏家看重硬质瓷作品的坚固和半透明质感。

hard-pressed.t: 处境困难的；难以做到的

e.en: Many families are {hard-pressed} to pay the rent.
e.zh: 许多家庭支付房租都很吃力。

e.en: You would be {hard-pressed} to find a better guide.
e.zh: 你很难找到比这更好的向导。

e.en: Customers dislike a {hard-sell} approach in expensive stores.
e.zh: 顾客不喜欢高档商店里的强行推销方式。

e.en: The proposal will be a {hard-sell} after last year's failure.
e.zh: 去年失败之后，这项提案会很难说服别人接受。

hard-set.t: 坚决固定的；下定决心的

e.en: He was {hard-set} against selling the family farm.
e.zh: 他坚决反对卖掉家族农场。

e.en: The glue became {hard-set} after several hours in the sun.
e.zh: 胶水在太阳下晒了几个小时后变得牢牢凝固。

e.en: The recipe calls for {hard-shell} clams and fresh herbs.
e.zh: 这道菜需要硬壳蛤蜊和新鲜香草。

e.en: He remained a {hard-shell} conservative throughout his career.
e.zh: 他整个职业生涯中一直是强硬保守派。

e.en: The beach was covered with {hard-shelled} crabs at low tide.
e.zh: 退潮时，海滩上满是有硬壳的螃蟹。

e.en: Her {hard-shelled} manner hid a generous heart.
e.zh: 她强硬的外表下藏着一颗慷慨的心。

e.en: The sail was made from {hard-spun} cotton thread.
e.zh: 那面帆是用紧捻的棉线制成的。

e.en: He preferred {hard-spun} yarn for durable work clothes.
e.zh: 他更喜欢用结实纺成的纱线来做耐穿的工作服。

hard-to-reach.t: 难以到达的；难以接触的

e.en: The charity serves children in {hard-to-reach} villages.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构服务于偏远难达村庄里的儿童。

e.en: Advertisers struggle to engage {hard-to-reach} young audiences.
e.zh: 广告商很难吸引那些难以触达的年轻受众。

e.en: We were {hard-up} after my father lost his job.
e.zh: 父亲失业后，我们手头很拮据。

e.en: The school is {hard-up} for science teachers this year.
e.zh: 这所学校今年很缺科学教师。

hard-won.t: 来之不易的；艰苦赢得的

e.en: The treaty was a {hard-won} victory for the negotiators.
e.zh: 这项条约是谈判代表来之不易的胜利。

e.en: She refused to waste her {hard-won} savings.
e.zh: 她不愿浪费自己辛苦攒下的积蓄。

e.en: Success usually requires {hard-work} and patience.
e.zh: 成功通常需要努力和耐心。

e.en: The farm taught him the value of {hard-work}.
e.zh: 农场生活让他懂得了辛勤劳动的价值。

e.en: Grandmother kept pieces of {hardbake} in a tin.
e.zh: 祖母把几块硬太妃糖放在铁盒里。

e.en: The old recipe for {hardbake} uses almonds and brown sugar.
e.zh: 这份老式硬糖配方会用杏仁和红糖。

e.en: He ate two {hardboiled} eggs for breakfast.
e.zh: 他早餐吃了两个煮老的鸡蛋。

e.en: The novel follows a {hardboiled} detective in Chicago.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述一名芝加哥冷硬派侦探的故事。

e.en: The frozen computer needed a {hardboot}.
e.zh: 那台死机的电脑需要强制重启。

e.en: A {hardboot} may clear the temporary memory problem.
e.zh: 硬重启可能会清除这个临时内存问题。

e.en: She bought a {hardbound} edition of the novel.
e.zh: 她买了一本这部小说的精装版。

e.en: The library keeps rare {hardbound} volumes in a locked room.
e.zh: 图书馆把珍贵的精装书卷放在上锁的房间里。

e.en: The new teacher quickly spotted the class {hardcase}.
e.zh: 新老师很快就看出了班里那个难管的学生。

e.en: Even the police considered him a real {hardcase}.
e.zh: 连警方都认为他是个真正难对付的人。

e.en: The lens has a {hardcoat} to resist scratches.
e.zh: 这片镜片有硬质涂层，可以防刮。

e.en: Manufacturers {hardcoat} plastic screens for extra durability.
e.zh: 制造商会给塑料屏幕加硬涂覆，以提高耐用性。

e.en: Please bring a {hardcopy} of your report.
e.zh: 请带一份报告的纸质打印件来。

e.en: The contract exists online, but I prefer a {hardcopy}.
e.zh: 合同有电子版，但我更喜欢纸质副本。

e.en: The photos are saved on an external {harddisk}.
e.zh: 这些照片保存在一块外接硬盘上。

e.en: A damaged {harddisk} can make the computer fail to start.
e.zh: 硬盘损坏可能会让电脑无法启动。

e.en: Engineers tested the steel's {hardenability} before production.
e.zh: 工程师在投产前测试了这种钢的淬透性。

e.en: Higher carbon content can improve {hardenability} in some alloys.
e.zh: 在某些合金中，较高的含碳量能提高可硬化能力。

e.en: The factory chose a {hardenable} steel for the gears.
e.zh: 工厂为齿轮选用了可淬硬钢。

e.en: Not every plastic coating is {hardenable} under heat.
e.zh: 并非每种塑料涂层受热后都能硬化。

e.en: The sample contained a small amount of {hardenite}.
e.zh: 样品中含有少量硬化物。

e.en: Older mineral guides list {hardenite} under rare compounds.
e.zh: 较旧的矿物指南把哈登石列在稀有化合物中。

e.en: The shaded bank was covered with {hardfern}.
e.zh: 阴凉的河岸上长满了硬蕨。

e.en: A botanist pointed out the {hardfern} beside the trail.
e.zh: 一位植物学家指出了小路旁的硬蕨。

e.en: The landlord was too {hardfisted} to repair the roof.
e.zh: 房东太吝啬，不肯修屋顶。

e.en: His {hardfisted} management style angered the workers.
e.zh: 他强硬的管理作风激怒了工人。

e.en: The store sells furniture, tools, and other {hardgoods}.
e.zh: 这家店销售家具、工具和其他耐用品。

e.en: Retailers separate clothing from {hardgoods} in their reports.
e.zh: 零售商在报告中把服装和硬质商品分开统计。

e.en: Pink {hardhack} flowers grew along the marsh.
e.zh: 沼泽边长着粉色的硬枝绣线菊花。

e.en: The guide identified the shrub as {hardhack}.
e.zh: 向导认出那株灌木是硬枝绣线菊。

hardhanded.t: 手段粗暴的；手很粗糙的

e.en: The mayor's {hardhanded} response drew criticism.
e.zh: 市长粗暴的回应招来了批评。

e.en: Years of farm work left him {hardhanded}.
e.zh: 多年农活让他的双手变得粗糙。

hardhattism.t: 蓝领保守主义；硬帽工人作风

e.en: The article linked the protest to urban {hardhattism}.
e.zh: 文章把这场抗议同城市蓝领保守主义联系起来。

e.en: His speeches borrowed the blunt tone of {hardhattism}.
e.zh: 他的演讲借用了硬帽工人作风中的直白语气。

hardhead.t: 顽固的人；实际冷静的人

e.en: Only a {hardhead} would reject such clear evidence.
e.zh: 只有顽固的人才会拒绝这么清楚的证据。

e.en: We need a {hardhead} to review the budget.
e.zh: 我们需要一个务实冷静的人来审查预算。

e.en: The committee's {hardheads} demanded exact figures.
e.zh: 委员会里的务实派要求提供准确数字。

e.en: A few {hardheads} still opposed the compromise.
e.zh: 仍有几个顽固的人反对这项妥协。

hardhearted.t: 冷酷无情的；铁石心肠的

e.en: It seemed {hardhearted} to ignore their request for help.
e.zh: 无视他们的求助显得冷酷无情。

e.en: The judge was strict but not {hardhearted}.
e.zh: 那位法官很严厉，但并非铁石心肠。

hardheartedly.t: 冷酷无情地；铁石心肠地

e.en: He {hardheartedly} refused to forgive his brother.
e.zh: 他冷酷无情地拒绝原谅自己的兄弟。

e.en: The company {hardheartedly} dismissed workers before the holidays.
e.zh: 公司在假日前冷酷地解雇了工人。

e.en: They {hardily} crossed the frozen river.
e.zh: 他们勇敢地穿过了结冰的河。

e.en: She {hardily} endured the long illness.
e.zh: 她顽强地忍受了漫长的病痛。

e.en: His {hardiment} impressed the weary soldiers.
e.zh: 他的勇气让疲惫的士兵深受触动。

e.en: Few had the {hardiment} to challenge the king.
e.zh: 很少有人有胆量挑战国王。

e.en: The rancher planted {hardinggrass} on the dry hillside.
e.zh: 牧场主在干燥的山坡上种了哈丁草。

e.en: Cattle grazed on {hardinggrass} through early summer.
e.zh: 初夏时，牛群在哈丁草地上吃草。

e.en: The specimen was identified as {hardite} by the curator.
e.zh: 馆长把这件标本鉴定为哈达石。

e.en: A vein of {hardite} ran through the rock.
e.zh: 岩石中有一条哈达石矿脉。

e.en: He told another {hardluck} story at dinner.
e.zh: 他吃饭时又讲了一个倒霉的故事。

e.en: The team became a {hardluck} favorite among fans.
e.zh: 这支屡遭不顺的队伍反而成了球迷心中的宠儿。

hardmouthed.t: 马不服缰的；倔强难驾驭的

e.en: The {hardmouthed} horse ignored the rider's pull.
e.zh: 那匹不服缰的马不理会骑手的拉缰。

e.en: He was a {hardmouthed} negotiator who rarely yielded.
e.zh: 他是个倔强难缠的谈判者，很少让步。

hardnose.t: 强硬现实的人；硬派作风

e.en: The coach was a {hardnose} about discipline.
e.zh: 那位教练在纪律问题上非常强硬。

e.en: She earned a reputation as a business {hardnose}.
e.zh: 她赢得了商场硬派人物的名声。

hardscrabble.t: 贫瘠艰苦的；勉强维生的

e.en: They grew up on a {hardscrabble} farm.
e.zh: 他们在一个贫瘠艰苦的农场长大。

e.en: The town survived through {hardscrabble} mining jobs.
e.zh: 这个小镇靠辛苦微薄的采矿工作维持生计。

e.en: The equipment was moved to a {hardsite} near the runway.
e.zh: 设备被移到跑道附近的硬质场地。

e.en: Engineers designed the {hardsite} to resist explosions.
e.zh: 工程师设计了能抗爆的加固阵地。

hardstand.t: 硬质停机坪；硬地停车区

e.en: The aircraft waited on the {hardstand} overnight.
e.zh: 那架飞机整夜停在硬质停机坪上。

e.en: Trucks lined up along the new {hardstand}.
e.zh: 卡车沿着新建的硬地停车区排队。

hardstuff.t: 烈酒；难懂或棘手的东西

e.en: He gave up the {hardstuff} after New Year.
e.zh: 新年后他戒掉了烈酒。

e.en: The lecture skipped straight to the {hardstuff}.
e.zh: 那场讲座直接进入了最难懂的内容。

e.en: The {hardwareman} found the right hinge.
e.zh: 五金店员找到了合适的铰链。

e.en: My grandfather worked as a {hardwareman} downtown.
e.zh: 我祖父曾在市中心当五金商。

e.en: The {hardwaremen} met suppliers every spring.
e.zh: 五金商们每年春天都会见供应商。

e.en: Local {hardwaremen} knew which tools lasted.
e.zh: 当地五金店员知道哪些工具更耐用。

hardwave.t: 强硬派浪潮；硬波音乐风格

e.en: A {hardwave} of protests shook the capital.
e.zh: 一波强硬的抗议浪潮震动了首都。

e.en: The club played {hardwave} until dawn.
e.zh: 那家俱乐部播放硬波音乐直到天亮。

hardwired.t: 硬接线的；天生根深蒂固的

e.en: The alarm is {hardwired} into the building.
e.zh: 警报器是直接接入大楼线路的。

e.en: Humans seem {hardwired} to seek patterns.
e.zh: 人类似乎天生就会寻找规律。

e.en: Success usually takes {hardwork} and patience.
e.zh: 成功通常需要辛苦努力和耐心。

e.en: Cleaning the old house was {hardwork}.
e.zh: 打扫那栋老房子是件苦差事。

hare-brained.t: 轻率愚蠢的；异想天开的

e.en: His {hare-brained} scheme cost us a week.
e.zh: 他那个轻率愚蠢的计划让我们浪费了一周。

e.en: She proposed a {hare-brained} but funny idea.
e.zh: 她提出了一个异想天开但挺有趣的点子。

e.en: The travelers were not allowed inside the {hareem}.
e.zh: 旅行者不被允许进入后宫。

e.en: The novel describes life in a royal {hareem}.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了王室后宫中的生活。

e.en: The dog had a narrow {harefoot} prized by breeders.
e.zh: 这只狗有育种者看重的狭长兔足。

e.en: A lucky {harefoot} hung from his keychain.
e.zh: 他的钥匙链上挂着一只幸运兔足。

e.en: The {hareiest} creature vanished into the grass.
e.zh: 那只最像野兔的动物消失在草丛里。

e.en: He was the {hareiest} child in the haunted house.
e.zh: 在鬼屋里，他是最胆小的孩子。

hari-kari.t: 切腹自杀；鲁莽自毁行为

e.en: The old text mentions {hari-kari} after defeat.
e.zh: 那本旧文献提到战败后的切腹自杀。

e.en: Quitting now would be political {hari-kari}.
e.zh: 现在退出无异于政治上的自毁。

harijan.t: 哈里真；印度旧称贱民者

e.en: Gandhi used {harijan} for people then called untouchable.
e.zh: 甘地用哈里真称呼当时被称为不可接触者的人。

e.en: The term {harijan} is now often considered patronizing.
e.zh: 哈里真这个词如今常被认为带有居高临下的意味。

e.en: The guide warned us that a {harlequin-snake} can be highly venomous.
e.zh: 向导提醒我们，丑角蛇可能有很强的毒性。

e.en: Bright bands make the {harlequin-snake} easy to recognize.
e.zh: 鲜艳的环纹让丑角蛇很容易辨认。

e.en: The final act became a noisy {harlequinade} of mistaken identities.
e.zh: 最后一幕变成了一场身份错认的喧闹滑稽剧。

e.en: She studied the old {harlequinade} tradition in European theater.
e.zh: 她研究欧洲戏剧中旧式丑角表演的传统。

e.en: The preacher denounced {harlotry} in language that now sounds archaic.
e.zh: 那位传教士用如今听来古旧的措辞谴责卖淫。

e.en: In the novel, {harlotry} is treated as a symptom of poverty.
e.zh: 在这部小说里，卖淫被视为贫困的一种表现。

e.en: The lab measured {harmaline} levels in the plant extract.
e.zh: 实验室测定了植物提取物中的骆驼蓬碱含量。

e.en: Researchers discussed how {harmaline} affects certain neural receptors.
e.zh: 研究人员讨论了哈尔马林如何影响某些神经受体。

e.en: The paper identified {harmalol} as a minor alkaloid in the sample.
e.zh: 论文把骆驼蓬酚列为样品中的一种微量生物碱。

e.en: Chemists compared {harmalol} with related compounds from the same seeds.
e.zh: 化学家把哈尔马洛尔与同一批种子中的相关化合物作了比较。

e.en: The {harmattan} covered the city with a fine brown dust.
e.zh: 哈马丹风让整座城市蒙上了一层细细的褐色尘土。

e.en: Flights were delayed when the {harmattan} reduced visibility.
e.zh: 哈马丹风降低了能见度，航班因此延误。

e.en: Traditional healers burned {harmel} seeds during the ceremony.
e.zh: 传统治疗者在仪式中焚烧骆驼蓬种子。

e.en: The botanist found {harmel} growing beside the dry road.
e.zh: 植物学家在干燥路边发现了叙利亚芸香。

e.en: Scientists isolated {harmine} from the seeds of the plant.
e.zh: 科学家从这种植物的种子中分离出骆驼蓬碱。

e.en: The study examined whether {harmine} could influence cell growth.
e.zh: 这项研究考察哈尔明是否会影响细胞生长。

e.en: The chromatogram showed a small peak for {harmol}.
e.zh: 色谱图显示哈尔莫尔有一个小峰。

e.en: Analysts tested whether {harmol} appeared after the compound broke down.
e.zh: 分析人员检测该化合物分解后是否出现骆驼蓬醇。

e.en: The theorist proposed a {harmonical} relation between the tones.
e.zh: 这位理论家提出这些音之间存在一种和谐关系。

e.en: Old texts sometimes use {harmonical} where modern writers say harmonic.
e.zh: 旧文本有时用harmonical，现代作者则会说harmonic。

e.en: The museum displayed a nineteenth-century {harmonicon} in a glass case.
e.zh: 博物馆在玻璃柜中展出了一件十九世纪的和声琴。

e.en: He found the review in an old issue of the {harmonicon}.
e.zh: 他在一本旧的音乐刊物中找到了那篇评论。

e.en: As a {harmonist}, she arranged the choir parts with great care.
e.zh: 作为和声编写者，她非常细致地安排合唱声部。

e.en: The philosopher was a political {harmonist} who distrusted conflict.
e.zh: 这位哲学家在政治上讲求和谐，不信任冲突。

e.en: His {harmonistic} style made even simple hymns sound rich.
e.zh: 他的和声风格让简单的赞美诗也显得丰满。

e.en: The essay presents a {harmonistic} view of society.
e.zh: 这篇文章提出了一种强调社会和谐的观点。

e.en: The melody is easily {harmonizable} for a four-part choir.
e.zh: 这段旋律很容易为四声部合唱配上和声。

e.en: Their proposals were different but still {harmonizable}.
e.zh: 他们的提案虽有差异，但仍然可以协调一致。

e.en: The inventor claimed his {harmonometer} could measure musical intervals precisely.
e.zh: 发明者声称他的和声测量器能精确测量音程。

e.en: A dusty {harmonometer} stood beside other obsolete instruments.
e.zh: 一台蒙尘的谐音计摆在其他过时仪器旁边。

harmost.t: 斯巴达总督；古希腊军事长官

e.en: A Spartan {harmost} governed the occupied city after the war.
e.zh: 战后，一名斯巴达总督统治了这座被占领的城市。

e.en: The historian described the {harmost} as both commander and administrator.
e.zh: 历史学家把这位古希腊长官描述为兼具指挥官和行政官身份的人。

e.en: The collection included a pale crystal of {harmotome}.
e.zh: 这批收藏中有一块浅色的十字沸石晶体。

e.en: Geologists found {harmotome} in cavities within the old basalt.
e.zh: 地质学家在古老玄武岩的孔洞中发现了钡沸石。

e.en: The old sack was made of coarse {harn}.
e.zh: 那个旧袋子是用粗亚麻布做的。

e.en: She patched the sail with a strip of {harn}.
e.zh: 她用一条粗亚麻布补了船帆。

e.en: Several {harns} lay folded in the storeroom.
e.zh: 几块粗亚麻布叠放在储藏室里。

e.en: The merchant sold cheap {harns} to sailors.
e.zh: 商人把廉价粗亚麻布卖给水手。

e.en: My aunt makes sweet {haroseth} with apples and nuts.
e.zh: 我姑妈用苹果和坚果做甜的逾越节果泥酱。

e.en: They served {haroseth} during the Passover meal.
e.zh: 他们在逾越节餐上端出了果泥酱。

e.en: The warrior carried a curved {harpe} at his side.
e.zh: 那名武士腰间佩着一把弯刀。

e.en: In the myth, Perseus used a {harpe}.
e.zh: 在神话中，珀尔修斯使用了一把镰形刀。

e.en: The bacterium releases {harpin} into plant tissue.
e.zh: 这种细菌会把植物病原蛋白释放进植物组织。

e.en: Researchers tested {harpin} as a crop treatment.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了将植物病原蛋白用作作物处理剂。

e.en: The index listed {harpsichork} as a doubtful term.
e.zh: 索引把这个词列为可疑词条。

e.en: She assumed {harpsichork} was a misspelling of harpsichord.
e.zh: 她认为这个词可能是harpsichord的拼写错误。

e.en: The soldier loaded his {harquebus} before dawn.
e.zh: 士兵在黎明前给火绳枪装弹。

e.en: A rusty {harquebus} hung above the fireplace.
e.zh: 壁炉上方挂着一支生锈的旧式火枪。

e.en: The museum displayed three Spanish {harquebuses}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了三支西班牙火绳枪。

e.en: Smoke rose as the {harquebuses} fired together.
e.zh: 那些火绳枪同时开火时升起了烟雾。

e.en: A {harquebusier} guarded the narrow gate.
e.zh: 一名火绳枪手守着狭窄的城门。

e.en: The young {harquebusier} marched behind the cavalry.
e.zh: 年轻的火绳枪手跟在骑兵后面行进。

e.en: A thick {harr} rolled in from the sea.
e.zh: 一阵浓重的海雾从海上涌来。

e.en: The village disappeared under the evening {harr}.
e.zh: 村庄消失在傍晚的寒雾中。

e.en: The complaint used {harrassment} instead of harassment.
e.zh: 投诉书把harassment误拼成了harrassment。

e.en: Spell-check flagged {harrassment} in the report.
e.zh: 拼写检查在报告中标出了harrassment这个误拼。

e.en: The geologist identified the sample as {harrisite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这个样本鉴定为哈里斯岩石。

e.en: Layers of {harrisite} formed unusual crystal patterns.
e.zh: 层状哈里斯岩石形成了异常的晶体纹理。

e.en: He gave a loud {harrumph} and folded his arms.
e.zh: 他大声哼了一下，抱起双臂。

e.en: She would {harrumph} whenever the topic came up.
e.zh: 每当这个话题被提起，她都会不满地哼一声。

e.en: The judge {harrumphed} before announcing his decision.
e.zh: 法官在宣布决定前不满地哼了一声。

e.en: Dad {harrumphed} at the messy kitchen.
e.zh: 爸爸看着乱糟糟的厨房哼了一声。

e.en: His speech was met with several {harrumphs}.
e.zh: 他的演讲引来了几声不满的哼声。

e.en: She {harrumphs} whenever the rules change.
e.zh: 每当规则改变，她都会不满地哼声。

e.en: Cold weather can {harshen} the skin.
e.zh: 寒冷天气会使皮肤变得粗糙难受。

e.en: His tone began to {harshen} during the argument.
e.zh: 争吵中他的语气开始变得严厉。

e.en: The cook fried a {harslet} with onions.
e.zh: 厨师把动物内脏杂碎和洋葱一起煎了。

e.en: A traditional {harslet} included liver, heart, and lungs.
e.zh: 传统的内脏杂碎包括肝、心和肺。

e.en: The damp wall was covered with {hart's-tongue} ferns.
e.zh: 潮湿的墙上长满了鹿舌蕨。

e.en: She planted {hart's-tongue} in the shaded garden.
e.zh: 她在阴凉的花园里种了鹿舌蕨。

e.en: Shops closed during the citywide {hartal}.
e.zh: 全城罢工停业期间，商店都关门了。

e.en: The opposition called a {hartal} after the arrests.
e.zh: 逮捕事件后，反对派号召举行罢工抗议。

e.en: A lone {hartbeest} crossed the dry plain.
e.zh: 一只孤零零的狷羚穿过干旱的平原。

e.en: The guide pointed out a {hartbeest} near the acacia trees.
e.zh: 向导指着金合欢树旁的一只狷羚给大家看。

e.en: The {hartebeest} ran with a strange, rocking gait.
e.zh: 那只狷羚以一种奇特的摇摆步态奔跑。

e.en: We watched a {hartebeest} grazing at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时，我们看着一只狷羚在吃草。

e.en: Several {hartebeests} gathered near the waterhole.
e.zh: 几只狷羚聚集在水坑附近。

e.en: The lions followed the {hartebeests} across the grassland.
e.zh: 狮子跟着那群狷羚穿过草原。

e.en: The specimen contained pale yellow {hartite}.
e.zh: 这个标本含有淡黄色的哈蒂石。

e.en: Collectors prize {hartite} for its unusual resinous origin.
e.zh: 收藏者看重哈蒂石，因为它有少见的树脂来源。

e.en: The calculation gave an energy of one {hartree}.
e.zh: 计算得到的能量为一个哈特里。

e.en: Chemists often convert {hartree} values into electronvolts.
e.zh: 化学家常把哈特里数值换算成电子伏特。

e.en: Old recipes sometimes use {hartsalz} instead of baking powder.
e.zh: 老食谱有时用碳酸氢铵代替发酵粉。

e.en: The baker added {hartsalz} to make crisp cookies.
e.zh: 面包师加入碳酸氢铵，让饼干更酥脆。

e.en: The old pharmacy sold spirits of {hartshorn}.
e.zh: 那家老药房出售鹿角氨水。

e.en: Early bakers used {hartshorn} as a leavening agent.
e.zh: 早期烘焙者把鹿角盐用作膨松剂。

e.en: His {harum-scarum} driving frightened everyone in the car.
e.zh: 他莽撞的开车方式吓坏了车里的每个人。

e.en: The play's hero is a cheerful {harum-scarum}.
e.zh: 这出戏的男主角是个快活的冒失鬼。

e.en: The judge gave a loud {harumph} before speaking.
e.zh: 法官开口前大声哼了一下。

e.en: He would {harumph} whenever the topic annoyed him.
e.zh: 每当话题惹他不快，他就会不满地哼一声。

e.en: She {harumphed} and folded her arms.
e.zh: 她哼了一声，然后抱起双臂。

e.en: The professor {harumphed} at the careless answer.
e.zh: 教授听到那个草率的回答，不满地清了清嗓。

harunganin.t: 哈伦加宁；植物色素成分

e.en: Researchers isolated {harunganin} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 研究人员从植物提取物中分离出哈伦加宁。

e.en: The paper described {harunganin} as a natural pigment.
e.zh: 论文把哈伦加宁描述为一种天然色素。

e.en: A {haruspex} examined the sacrificed animal's liver.
e.zh: 一名古罗马占卜祭司查看祭牲的肝脏。

e.en: The novelist compared the analyst to a modern {haruspex}.
e.zh: 小说家把那位分析师比作现代的占卜祭司。

e.en: The lecture discussed {haruspicy} in ancient Rome.
e.zh: 讲座讨论了古罗马的内脏占卜术。

e.en: To modern readers, {haruspicy} can seem both ritualistic and political.
e.zh: 对现代读者来说，内脏占卜术既像仪式，也带有政治意味。

e.en: The village becomes busy at {harvest-time}.
e.zh: 到了收获时节，村子就忙碌起来。

e.en: Families return home for {harvest-time} celebrations.
e.zh: 许多家庭会回家参加收获时节的庆祝活动。

e.en: A long drought left the fields {harvestless}.
e.zh: 长期干旱让田地颗粒无收。

e.en: After years of effort, the project still felt {harvestless}.
e.zh: 努力多年之后，这个项目仍让人觉得毫无成果。

e.en: A {harvestman} rested on the garden wall.
e.zh: 一只盲蛛停在花园墙上。

e.en: The {harvestman} worked late during the wheat season.
e.zh: 小麦季节里，那个收割工干到很晚。

e.en: Several {harvestmen} moved slowly under the leaves.
e.zh: 几只盲蛛在叶子下面慢慢移动。

e.en: The {harvestmen} returned from the fields at dusk.
e.zh: 傍晚时，收割工们从田里回来。

harvestry.t: 收获季；收获物总量；收获工作后的成果或代价；教区收入的一种

e.en: The village celebrated the {harvestry} with a simple supper.
e.zh: 村里用一顿简单的晚餐庆祝收获季。

e.en: The old account book listed the church's {harvestry} for that year.
e.zh: 那本旧账簿列出了教会那一年的收成收入。

e.en: At {harvesttime}, the whole family worked in the fields.
e.zh: 到了收获时节，全家都在田里干活。

e.en: Prices often changed sharply around {harvesttime}.
e.zh: 收割期前后，价格常常变化很大。

e.en: The critic dismissed him as a {has-been}.
e.zh: 评论家把他贬为一个过气人物。

e.en: She refused to behave like a bitter {has-been}.
e.zh: 她拒绝表现得像一个怨气满腹的昔日名人。

e.en: The reunion was full of former stars and {has-beens}.
e.zh: 那场聚会里全是昔日明星和过气人物。

e.en: They mocked the old executives as {has-beens}.
e.zh: 他们嘲笑那些老高管是过气人物。

e.en: The restaurant served {hasenpfeffer} with red cabbage.
e.zh: 那家餐馆供应德国炖兔肉，配红卷心菜。

e.en: My grandfather made {hasenpfeffer} every winter.
e.zh: 我祖父每年冬天都会做德国炖兔肉。

e.en: The police found {hasheesh} hidden in the suitcase.
e.zh: 警方在手提箱里发现了藏着的大麻脂。

e.en: The novel describes sailors smoking {hasheesh} in port.
e.zh: 小说描写水手们在港口吸食印度大麻制品。

e.en: They ate breakfast at a noisy {hashery} near the station.
e.zh: 他们在车站附近一家嘈杂的小饭馆吃早餐。

e.en: The old {hashery} served cheap stew and coffee.
e.zh: 那家老简餐店供应便宜的炖菜和咖啡。

e.en: The detective called the informant a harmless {hashhead}.
e.zh: 侦探把那个线人称作无害的吸大麻成瘾者。

e.en: He hated being dismissed as just another {hashhead}.
e.zh: 他讨厌别人把他当成又一个大麻瘾君子。

e.en: Put a {hashmark} before the topic tag.
e.zh: 在话题标签前加一个井号。

e.en: The ball stopped near the left {hashmark}.
e.zh: 球停在左侧的场地短线标记附近。

hashslinger.t: 小饭馆厨师；廉价餐馆伙计

e.en: He worked as a {hashslinger} before becoming a chef.
e.zh: 他成为厨师以前，在小饭馆里当过伙计。

e.en: The tired {hashslinger} poured coffee for the truckers.
e.zh: 疲惫的小饭馆伙计给卡车司机们倒咖啡。

e.en: She added a funny {hashtag} to the photo.
e.zh: 她给照片加了一个有趣的话题标签。

e.en: The campaign's {hashtag} spread quickly online.
e.zh: 这场活动的井号标签很快在网上传播开来。

e.en: The butcher sold slices of {haslet} with mustard.
e.zh: 肉铺卖配芥末的猪内脏肉糕切片。

e.en: She packed {haslet} sandwiches for the picnic.
e.zh: 她为野餐准备了熟杂碎肉三明治。

hassium.t: 𬭶元素；人工放射性金属元素

e.en: {Hassium} is produced only in tiny amounts.
e.zh: 𬭶元素只能以极少量人工制得。

e.en: The chemistry article listed {hassium} among superheavy elements.
e.zh: 那篇化学文章把𬭶列在超重元素之中。

e.en: The soldier carried a heavy {hasta} in the reenactment.
e.zh: 那名士兵在历史重演中扛着一支沉重的罗马长矛。

e.en: The auctioneer's {hasta} symbol marked the sale record.
e.zh: 拍卖人的枪状标志标在销售记录上。

e.en: The plant has {hastate} leaves with pointed lobes.
e.zh: 这种植物有带尖裂片的戟形叶。

e.en: A {hastate} outline helped identify the arrowhead.
e.zh: 戟形轮廓有助于辨认那枚箭头。

e.en: The botanist noted the {hastated} base of the leaf.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到叶基呈戟形。

e.en: The old drawing showed a {hastated} spearhead.
e.zh: 那幅旧图画展示了一个戟形矛头。

e.en: The {hastati} formed the first line of the legion.
e.zh: 古罗马青年重步兵组成军团的第一线。

e.en: Historians debate how the {hastati} fought in early battles.
e.zh: 历史学家争论青年重步兵在早期战役中的作战方式。

hatha.t: 哈达瑜伽；体位瑜伽练习

e.en: She practices {hatha} yoga every morning before work.
e.zh: 她每天上班前都练习哈达瑜伽。

e.en: The class focused on slow {hatha} poses and breathing.
e.zh: 这节课重点练习缓慢的哈达瑜伽体式和呼吸。

e.en: He hung his cap on the old {hatpeg}.
e.zh: 他把帽子挂在那个旧帽钉上。

e.en: A brass {hatpeg} was fixed beside the door.
e.zh: 门旁装着一个黄铜挂帽钩。

e.en: She fastened the wide hat with a silver {hatpin}.
e.zh: 她用一根银色长帽针固定那顶宽边帽。

e.en: The antique {hatpin} had a pearl at the end.
e.zh: 那根古董帽针末端镶着一颗珍珠。

e.en: The drawer contained several old {hatpins}.
e.zh: 抽屉里放着几根旧的长帽针。

e.en: Victorian women often used {hatpins} to secure large hats.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的女性常用长帽针固定大帽子。

e.en: Leave your coat on the {hatrack} by the entrance.
e.zh: 把你的外套放在入口旁的衣帽架上。

e.en: The wooden {hatrack} was crowded with scarves and umbrellas.
e.zh: 木制衣帽架上挂满了围巾和雨伞。

e.en: His umbrella leaned against the {hatstand} in the hall.
e.zh: 他的雨伞靠在门厅的衣帽架旁。

e.en: The antique {hatstand} matched the dark wooden floor.
e.zh: 那件古董衣帽架和深色木地板很相配。

e.en: The shop sells mirrors, benches, and {hatstands}.
e.zh: 这家店出售镜子、长凳和衣帽架。

e.en: Two iron {hatstands} stood beside the cloakroom door.
e.zh: 衣帽间门旁立着两个铁制衣帽架。

e.en: The village {hattery} made felt hats by hand.
e.zh: 村里的制帽作坊手工制作毡帽。

e.en: She inherited a small {hattery} from her aunt.
e.zh: 她从姨妈那里继承了一家小帽子店。

e.en: The knight wore a {haubergeon} beneath his surcoat.
e.zh: 骑士在罩袍下面穿着一件短锁子甲。

e.en: A rusted {haubergeon} hung in the castle display.
e.zh: 城堡展柜里挂着一件生锈的短锁子甲。

e.en: The warrior's {hauberk} protected his chest and arms.
e.zh: 战士的锁子甲长衫保护着他的胸部和手臂。

e.en: Museum visitors examined the heavy iron {hauberk}.
e.zh: 博物馆参观者仔细看那件沉重的铁锁子甲。

e.en: Cattle grazed on the green {haugh} beside the river.
e.zh: 牛群在河边低洼的绿草地上吃草。

e.en: After heavy rain, the {haugh} was covered with shallow water.
e.zh: 大雨过后，那片河边低地被浅水覆盖。

e.en: He became {haughtier} after the promotion.
e.zh: 升职以后，他变得更加傲慢。

e.en: Her reply sounded {haughtier} than she intended.
e.zh: 她的回答听起来比她本意更高傲。

haulabout.t: 粗暴拖来拖去；用力拉扯

e.en: Do not {haulabout} the boxes by their straps.
e.zh: 不要抓着带子把这些箱子粗暴地拖来拖去。

e.en: The sailors had to {haulabout} the heavy rope in the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中，水手们不得不用力拉扯那根沉重的绳索。

haulageway.t: 矿井运输巷道；运料通道

e.en: The miners cleared debris from the main {haulageway}.
e.zh: 矿工们清理了主运输巷道里的碎石。

e.en: A small rail line ran through the {haulageway}.
e.zh: 一条小铁轨穿过那条运料通道。

e.en: The farmer burned the dry potato {haulm} after harvest.
e.zh: 收获后，农民烧掉了干枯的马铃薯茎秆。

e.en: Pea {haulm} can be composted for the next crop.
e.zh: 豌豆藤茎可以堆肥，用于下一季作物。

e.en: The sailor pulled the {haulyard} to raise the sail.
e.zh: 水手拉动升帆索把帆升起来。

e.en: A frayed {haulyard} snapped in the strong wind.
e.zh: 一根磨损的升帆索在强风中断裂。

e.en: The mason repaired the cracked {hauncheon} of the arch.
e.zh: 石匠修补了拱门开裂的拱肩部分。

e.en: Decorative stones marked each {hauncheon} in the old bridge.
e.zh: 旧桥每处拱腰都用装饰石标出。

e.en: Seawater splashed near the ship's {hause}.
e.zh: 海水溅到了船首锚链孔附近。

e.en: The anchor cable passed through the {hause} with a groan.
e.zh: 锚缆伴着吱呀声穿过船首小孔。

e.en: Her {hastiness} led to several small errors.
e.zh: 她的草率导致了几个小错误。

e.en: The manager regretted the {hastiness} of the announcement.
e.zh: 经理后悔那次公告发布得太仓促。

e.en: She fastened the veil with a silver {hat-pin}.
e.zh: 她用一枚银色帽针固定住面纱。

e.en: An old {hat-pin} lay inside the sewing box.
e.zh: 针线盒里放着一枚旧帽针。

e.en: The striker scored a {hat-trick} before halftime.
e.zh: 那名前锋在半场前就上演了帽子戏法。

e.en: She completed a {hat-trick} of awards this season.
e.zh: 她本赛季连续拿下三项奖项。

e.en: The villain is written as thoroughly {hatable}.
e.zh: 这个反派被写得十分可憎。

e.en: His smug smile made him instantly {hatable}.
e.zh: 他那自鸣得意的笑容让人立刻讨厌他。

e.en: The sailor secured the {hatchcover} before the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前，水手把舱口盖固定好。

e.en: A loose {hatchcover} rattled under the truck.
e.zh: 卡车下面一个松动的检修口盖咯咯作响。

e.en: The worker pulled flax through the {hatchel}.
e.zh: 工人把亚麻从麻梳上拉过。

e.en: They used a wooden tool to {hatchel} the fibers.
e.zh: 他们用一件木制工具梳理纤维。

e.en: The {hatcheled} flax was ready for spinning.
e.zh: 梳理过的亚麻已经可以纺线了。

e.en: She stored the {hatcheled} fibers in a dry basket.
e.zh: 她把梳好的纤维放在干燥的篮子里。

e.en: The {hatcheler} worked all morning beside the mill.
e.zh: 梳麻工整个上午都在磨坊旁干活。

e.en: A small {hatcheler} separated the rough fibers quickly.
e.zh: 一台小梳麻机很快分开了粗纤维。

e.en: {Hatcheling} removes the coarse pieces from flax.
e.zh: 梳麻会去掉亚麻中的粗硬部分。

e.en: The apprentice learned {hatcheling} before spinning thread.
e.zh: 学徒在纺线前先学习梳麻。

e.en: The {hatchelled} hemp felt smoother to the touch.
e.zh: 梳理过的大麻纤维摸起来更顺滑。

e.en: Bundles of {hatchelled} flax hung from the rafters.
e.zh: 一束束梳好的亚麻挂在椽子上。

e.en: {Hatchelling} was a dusty but necessary job.
e.zh: 梳麻是一项满是灰尘却必不可少的工作。

e.en: The museum demonstrated {hatchelling} with antique tools.
e.zh: 博物馆用古老工具演示了梳麻过程。

e.en: Several iron {hatchels} stood on the workbench.
e.zh: 工作台上放着几把铁制麻梳。

e.en: She {hatchels} the flax before twisting it into thread.
e.zh: 她先梳理亚麻，再把它捻成线。

e.en: A {hatchet-faced} guard watched the gate.
e.zh: 一个脸瘦削而严厉的守卫看着大门。

e.en: The actor played a {hatchet-faced} schoolmaster.
e.zh: 那位演员扮演了一名面容严厉瘦削的校长。

e.en: The company sent a {hatchet-man} to cut jobs.
e.zh: 公司派来一个专门裁员的整肃者。

e.en: In the gang, he worked as a {hatchet-man}.
e.zh: 在那个帮派里，他充当打手。

e.en: The geologist identified the sample as {hatchettolite}.
e.zh: 地质学家认出这块样品是铌钽铀矿。

e.en: Small crystals of {hatchettolite} appeared in the rock.
e.zh: 岩石中出现了细小的铌钽铀矿晶体。

e.en: The farmer repaired the old {hatchibator} in spring.
e.zh: 农民在春天修好了那台旧孵化器。

e.en: A steady temperature keeps the {hatchibator} working properly.
e.zh: 稳定的温度能让孵化器正常运转。

e.en: A black {hatchment} hung above the church door.
e.zh: 教堂门上方挂着一块黑色丧葬纹章。

e.en: The family displayed a {hatchment} after the lord died.
e.zh: 那位贵族去世后，家族展示了丧葬盾徽。

e.en: The map used {hatchures} to show steep slopes.
e.zh: 这张地图用晕滃线表示陡坡。

e.en: Old surveyors drew {hatchures} by hand on terrain maps.
e.zh: 早期测量员在地形图上手绘阴影线。

e.en: Police are investigating the attack as a {hate-crime}.
e.zh: 警方正按仇恨犯罪调查这起袭击。

e.en: The law increased penalties for a {hate-crime}.
e.zh: 该法律提高了对仇恨犯罪的处罚。

e.en: The character is selfish but not completely {hateable}.
e.zh: 这个角色很自私，但并非完全可恨。

e.en: His cruelty made him easy and {hateable} to audiences.
e.zh: 他的残忍让观众很容易讨厌他。

e.en: She gave a calm, {hateless} account of the conflict.
e.zh: 她平静而不带仇恨地讲述了那场冲突。

e.en: His faith taught him to remain {hateless}.
e.zh: 他的信仰教他保持不怀恨的心态。

e.en: The speaker was condemned as a {hatemonger}.
e.zh: 那名演讲者被谴责为煽动仇恨的人。

e.en: Online platforms removed posts by the {hatemonger}.
e.zh: 网络平台删除了那名仇恨煽动者的帖子。

hatemongering.t: 煽动仇恨；散布仇恨言论

e.en: The campaign rejected his {hatemongering} rhetoric.
e.zh: 竞选团队拒绝接受他煽动仇恨的言辞。

e.en: Strict rules banned {hatemongering} on the forum.
e.zh: 严格规定禁止在论坛上散布仇恨言论。

e.en: The judge called the betrayal truly {hateworthy}.
e.zh: 法官称这次背叛确实可恨。

e.en: Few mistakes are as {hateworthy} as deliberate cruelty.
e.zh: 很少有错误像蓄意残忍那样值得憎恨。

e.en: The novel portrays her as a dutiful {hausfrau}.
e.zh: 小说把她描写成一位尽职的家庭主妇。

e.en: He used {hausfrau} in a deliberately old-fashioned way.
e.zh: 他故意用“家庭主妇”这个带旧时代色彩的词。

e.en: The storm seemed to {haust} the old roof all night.
e.zh: 暴风雨整夜像是在猛击那座旧屋顶。

e.en: The tax felt designed to {haust} the small merchants.
e.zh: 这项税收让人觉得是在榨取小商贩。

e.en: The insect's {haustella} can draw nectar from deep flowers.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的吸食口器能从很深的花中吸取花蜜。

e.en: Under the microscope, the {haustella} looked like fine tubes.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，这些吸食口器像细细的管子。

e.en: Butterflies are {haustellate} insects with coiled mouthparts.
e.zh: 蝴蝶是有吸食口器的昆虫，口器呈卷曲状。

e.en: The guide separates chewing beetles from {haustellate} flies.
e.zh: 这本指南把咀嚼式甲虫和有吸食口器的蝇类区分开。

e.en: A moth uncoils its {haustellum} to feed.
e.zh: 飞蛾会展开它的吸食口器来取食。

e.en: The damaged {haustellum} made feeding impossible.
e.zh: 受损的吸食口器使它无法进食。

e.en: The parasite sends {haustoria} into the host plant.
e.zh: 这种寄生植物把吸器伸进宿主植物体内。

e.en: Fungal {haustoria} absorb nutrients from living cells.
e.zh: 真菌吸器会从活细胞中吸收养分。

e.en: The plant develops {haustorial} organs after germination.
e.zh: 这种植物发芽后会形成吸器器官。

e.en: Researchers measured {haustorial} growth inside infected roots.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了受感染根部内吸器的生长情况。

e.en: A {haustorium} anchors the parasite to its host.
e.zh: 吸器把寄生体固定在宿主上。

e.en: Each fungal {haustorium} draws food from the cell.
e.zh: 每个真菌吸器都会从细胞中汲取养分。

e.en: The scan showed normal {haustration} of the colon.
e.zh: 扫描显示结肠的袋状分节正常。

e.en: Loss of {haustration} may suggest bowel inflammation.
e.zh: 袋状分节消失可能提示肠道炎症。

e.en: Each {haustrum} forms a small pouch in the colon.
e.zh: 每个结肠袋都会在结肠上形成一个小囊状部位。

e.en: The radiologist noted one enlarged {haustrum}.
e.zh: 放射科医生注意到有一个结肠袋增大。

e.en: He took a {haustus} of bitter medicine.
e.zh: 他喝下了一服苦药液。

e.en: The traveler refreshed himself with one {haustus}.
e.zh: 旅人一饮而尽，让自己恢复了些精神。

e.en: The salon catered to a {haut} clientele.
e.zh: 这家沙龙服务的是上流顾客。

e.en: She mocked the city's {haut} manners.
e.zh: 她嘲讽这座城市所谓的高级礼仪。

e.en: The temple wall is carved in {haut-relief}.
e.zh: 神庙墙面采用高浮雕雕刻。

e.en: A dramatic {haut-relief} rises from the stone panel.
e.zh: 一幅富有戏剧感的高浮雕从石板上凸起。

e.en: The score calls for a mellow {hautbois}.
e.zh: 这份乐谱需要一支音色柔和的双簧管。

e.en: He collects early instruments, including a wooden {hautbois}.
e.zh: 他收藏早期乐器，其中包括一支木制旧式双簧管。

e.en: The {hautboy} carried the melody above the strings.
e.zh: 双簧管在弦乐之上奏出了主旋律。

e.en: An old {hautboy} hung in the music room.
e.zh: 音乐室里挂着一支旧式双簧管。

e.en: The {hautboyist} tuned carefully before the overture.
e.zh: 双簧管手在序曲开始前仔细调音。

e.en: A skilled {hautboyist} can shape a plaintive tone.
e.zh: 熟练的双簧管手能塑造出哀婉的音色。

e.en: The goats grazed on the windswept {hauts}.
e.zh: 山羊在风大的高地上吃草。

e.en: The satire targets the {hauts} of society.
e.zh: 这篇讽刺作品针对的是社会上层人士。

e.en: Their {Havanese} greeted every guest at the door.
e.zh: 他们家的哈瓦那犬在门口迎接每位客人。

e.en: A {Havanese} has a long, silky coat.
e.zh: 哈瓦那犬有又长又柔滑的被毛。

e.en: The critic dismissed him as a {have-been}.
e.zh: 评论家把他贬为过气人物。

e.en: She refused to be treated like a {have-been}.
e.zh: 她拒绝被当作一个过气的人。

e.en: The policy widened the gap between haves and {have-nots}.
e.zh: 这项政策扩大了富人和贫困者之间的差距。

e.en: He wrote about the anger of the {have-not} classes.
e.zh: 他描写了贫困阶层的愤怒。

e.en: He {havered} for ten minutes before answering.
e.zh: 他犹豫唠叨了十分钟才回答。

e.en: The old men {havered} about weather and politics.
e.zh: 那些老人闲扯着天气和政治。

e.en: Bone tissue contains {Haversian} canals for blood vessels.
e.zh: 骨组织中含有供血管通过的哈弗氏骨管。

e.en: The slide showed several {Haversian} systems clearly.
e.zh: 切片清楚显示出几个哈弗氏系统。

e.en: The app uses the {haversine} formula for distance.
e.zh: 这个应用用半正矢公式计算距离。

e.en: A {haversine} table helped old navigators avoid errors.
e.zh: 半正矢表曾帮助早期航海者减少误差。

e.en: The old {haybag} hung beside the stable door.
e.zh: 那个旧干草袋挂在马厩门旁。

e.en: She filled a {haybag} before feeding the ponies.
e.zh: 喂小马前，她先装满了一个干草袋。

e.en: Grandmother kept the stew warm in a {haybox}.
e.zh: 祖母把炖菜放在保温箱里保温。

e.en: A {haybox} can finish cooking food without extra fuel.
e.zh: 保温烹饪箱不用再加燃料也能把食物焖熟。

e.en: That retired racehorse is now just a gentle {hayburner}.
e.zh: 那匹退役赛马如今只是一匹温顺的吃草老马。

e.en: He joked that his truck cost less to keep than a {hayburner}.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说，养他的卡车比养匹马还便宜。

e.en: Rain darkened the {haycock} at the edge of the field.
e.zh: 雨水把田边的小圆干草堆淋得发暗。

e.en: The children hid behind a {haycock} during the game.
e.zh: 孩子们玩耍时躲在一个小干草堆后面。

e.en: The farm used a {haycruiser} to carry workers across the meadow.
e.zh: 农场用一辆干草拖车载工人穿过草地。

e.en: They rented a {haycruiser} for a slow ride through the countryside.
e.zh: 他们租了一辆敞篷马车，在乡间慢慢兜风。

e.en: He lifted the loose straw with a {hayfork}.
e.zh: 他用干草叉把松散的稻草挑起来。

e.en: A rusty {hayfork} leaned against the barn wall.
e.zh: 一把生锈的干草叉靠在谷仓墙边。

e.en: The horses were fed {haylage} through the winter.
e.zh: 整个冬天，马匹都吃半干青贮饲料。

e.en: Good {haylage} smells fresh rather than sour.
e.zh: 好的半干青贮饲料闻起来清新，而不是发酸。

e.en: The kittens slept in the warm {haymow}.
e.zh: 小猫们睡在暖和的谷仓干草堆里。

e.en: He climbed into the {haymow} to toss down bales.
e.zh: 他爬上谷仓的干草阁，把草捆往下扔。

e.en: The goats pulled hay from the wooden {hayrack}.
e.zh: 山羊从木制干草架上扯草吃。

e.en: We fixed the broken {hayrack} before filling it again.
e.zh: 我们先修好坏掉的饲草架，然后再往里添草。

e.en: The farmer used a {hayrake} after the grass was cut.
e.zh: 草割好后，农民用搂草耙把草拢起来。

e.en: An old horse-drawn {hayrake} stood behind the shed.
e.zh: 棚屋后面停着一台旧式马拉搂草机。

e.en: Smoke rose beyond the {hayrick} near the lane.
e.zh: 小路旁的大干草堆后升起了烟。

e.en: They covered the {hayrick} before the storm arrived.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前，他们把大干草堆盖好了。

e.en: The broken {hayshaker} delayed work in the field.
e.zh: 坏掉的干草翻晒机耽误了田里的活。

e.en: A {hayshaker} spreads cut grass so it dries evenly.
e.zh: 干草翻晒机会把割下的草摊开，让它均匀晾干。

e.en: The {hazan} led the congregation in prayer.
e.zh: 犹太教领唱员带领会众祈祷。

e.en: His grandfather served as a {hazan} for many years.
e.zh: 他的祖父担任犹太教领唱员很多年。

e.en: Only a small sum was {hazardable} on such a risky venture.
e.zh: 在这样冒险的事业上，只有一小笔钱可以拿来冒险。

e.en: He considered whether his reputation was {hazardable} in court.
e.zh: 他考虑自己的名声是否值得在法庭上冒这个险。

e.en: The technician checked the plastic sheet with a {hazemeter}.
e.zh: 技术员用雾度计检查那张塑料片。

e.en: A {hazemeter} measures how much light a sample scatters.
e.zh: 雾度计用来测量样品散射了多少光。

havildar.t: 印度军队的下士军衔或军士

e.en: The {havildar} inspected the soldiers before dawn.
e.zh: 那名印度下士在黎明前检查士兵。

e.en: He served as a {havildar} in the old regiment.
e.zh: 他曾在旧团里担任印度军士。

e.en: The old record called him a {havilder}.
e.zh: 那份旧记录称他为印度军士。

e.en: A {havilder} stood guard at the gate.
e.zh: 一名印度军士在门口站岗。

e.en: The storm was {havocking} the coastal villages.
e.zh: 暴风雨正在沿海村庄造成严重破坏。

e.en: Rumors kept {havocking} the fragile peace talks.
e.zh: 谣言不断搅乱脆弱的和平谈判。

havurah.t: 犹太小型学习或礼拜团体

e.en: Their {havurah} meets every Friday evening.
e.zh: 他们的犹太小团体每周五晚上聚会。

e.en: She joined a {havurah} for study and prayer.
e.zh: 她加入了一个犹太小团体，一起学习和祈祷。

e.en: He gave a loud {haw-haw} at his own joke.
e.zh: 他讲完自己的笑话后发出一声夸张的哈哈笑。

e.en: The actor used a clipped {haw-haw} accent.
e.zh: 那名演员用了装腔作势的上流腔调。

e.en: The money moved through a {hawala} network.
e.zh: 这笔钱通过哈瓦拉地下汇款网络转移。

e.en: Investigators traced the payments to {hawala} dealers.
e.zh: 调查人员把这些付款追查到哈瓦拉汇兑商。
