e.zh: 工程师在沙漠中测试了一台小型超级高铁原型。

e.en: The city studied whether a {hyperloop} could reduce travel time.
e.zh: 该市研究真空管道列车是否能缩短出行时间。

e.en: The report described a {hypermakroskelic} body type in clinical terms.
e.zh: 报告用临床术语描述了一种四肢异常修长的体型。

e.en: A {hypermakroskelic} habitus may suggest an underlying connective tissue disorder.
e.zh: 四肢异常修长的体态可能提示潜在的结缔组织疾病。

hypermal.t: 极其有害的；高度恶性的

e.en: The old medical text used {hypermal} to describe an extreme condition.
e.zh: 那本旧医学书用高度恶性来描述一种极端病情。

e.en: He called the policy {hypermal}, though the term sounded archaic.
e.zh: 他称那项政策极其有害，虽然这个词听起来很古旧。

hypermatic.t: 过度自动化的；超自动的

e.en: The factory adopted a {hypermatic} control system for production.
e.zh: 工厂采用了过度自动化的生产控制系统。

e.en: Critics said the {hypermatic} process left too little human oversight.
e.zh: 批评者说这种超自动流程几乎没有人工监督。

e.en: The model stores its values in a sparse {hypermatrix}.
e.zh: 该模型把数值存放在一个稀疏超矩阵中。

e.en: Researchers used a {hypermatrix} to represent relationships across many dimensions.
e.zh: 研究人员用高维矩阵表示多维度之间的关系。

e.en: The specimen was classified as a {hypermegasoma} in the old catalogue.
e.zh: 该标本在旧目录中被归为身体异常巨大的个体。

e.en: Doctors rarely use {hypermegasoma} in modern clinical descriptions.
e.zh: 现代临床描述中医生很少使用身体异常巨大的个体这一说法。

e.en: The scan revealed a {hypermetabolic} area near the lung.
e.zh: 扫描显示肺部附近有一处代谢过度活跃的区域。

e.en: A fever can make the body temporarily {hypermetabolic}.
e.zh: 发烧会使身体暂时处于代谢过度活跃的状态。

e.en: Severe burns often trigger {hypermetabolism} in the body.
e.zh: 严重烧伤常会引发身体代谢亢进。

e.en: The patient lost weight because of prolonged {hypermetabolism}.
e.zh: 患者因长期过度代谢而体重下降。

e.en: Some insects have a {hypermetamorphic} life cycle with very different larval stages.
e.zh: 有些昆虫具有超变态发育的生命周期，幼虫阶段差异很大。

e.en: The paper described the beetle as {hypermetamorphic}.
e.zh: 论文把这种甲虫描述为超变态发育的。

e.en: The beetle undergoes {hypermetamorphosis} before reaching adulthood.
e.zh: 这种甲虫在成虫前会经历超变态发育。

e.en: Biologists study {hypermetamorphosis} to understand unusual insect development.
e.zh: 生物学家研究超变态发育，以了解昆虫异常的发育方式。

e.en: The composer shaped the phrase as a four-bar {hypermeter}.
e.zh: 作曲家把这个乐句处理成四小节的超韵律单位。

e.en: The poem ends with a {hypermeter} that disrupts the expected rhythm.
e.zh: 这首诗以一个过长诗行结尾，打乱了预期节奏。

e.en: Cerebellar damage can cause {hypermetria} during finger testing.
e.zh: 小脑损伤可在手指测试中引起动作过度。

e.en: The neurologist noted {hypermetria} when the patient reached for the target.
e.zh: 患者伸手触碰目标时，神经科医生注意到辨距过度。

e.en: The line is {hypermetric} because it has an extra syllable.
e.zh: 这一诗行因多了一个音节而属于超格律。

e.en: The patient showed {hypermetric} movements during the coordination exam.
e.zh: 患者在协调性检查中表现出幅度过大的动作。

e.en: The editor marked the verse as {hypermetrical}.
e.zh: 编辑把这行诗标为超格律。

e.en: A {hypermetrical} ending can give the rhythm a deliberate stumble.
e.zh: 音节过多的结尾会让节奏产生刻意的顿挫感。

e.en: A {hypermetrope} may see distant objects more clearly than nearby text.
e.zh: 远视者看远处物体可能比看近处文字更清楚。

e.en: The optometrist prescribed reading glasses for the {hypermetrope}.
e.zh: 验光师为这名远视者配了阅读眼镜。

e.en: Children with {hypermetropia} may struggle to read small print.
e.zh: 患有远视的儿童可能难以阅读小字。

e.en: Mild {hypermetropia} often goes unnoticed for years.
e.zh: 轻度远视常常多年未被察觉。

e.en: The child was found to be {hypermetropic} during an eye exam.
e.zh: 这个孩子在眼科检查中被发现患有远视。

e.en: A {hypermetropic} lens helps focus nearby images properly.
e.zh: 远视镜片有助于正确聚焦近处图像。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed {hypermetropy} during the eye exam.
e.zh: 医生在眼科检查中诊断出他有远视。

e.en: Mild {hypermetropy} can cause headaches after reading.
e.zh: 轻度远视可能会在阅读后引起头痛。

e.en: The lab used a {hypermicroscope} to study tiny particles.
e.zh: 实验室用超显微镜研究微小颗粒。

e.en: A {hypermicroscope} can reveal structures below ordinary optical limits.
e.zh: 超显微镜能显示普通光学极限以下的结构。

e.en: The pathologist noted a {hypermicrosoma} in the sample.
e.zh: 病理学家在样本中注意到一个超微小体。

e.en: Older papers used {hypermicrosoma} for an unusually small body.
e.zh: 早期论文用hypermicrosoma表示异常微小的体。

e.en: The patient described episodes of vivid {hypermnesia}.
e.zh: 患者描述了几次鲜明的记忆亢进发作。

e.en: Some drugs may produce temporary {hypermnesia} in experiments.
e.zh: 一些药物在实验中可能产生短暂的记忆增强。

e.en: The case report discussed {hypermnesis} after head injury.
e.zh: 病例报告讨论了头部受伤后的记忆亢进。

e.en: Hypnosis was once linked with apparent {hypermnesis}.
e.zh: 催眠曾被认为与表面上的记忆增强有关。

e.en: The geneticist classified the mutant as a {hypermorph}.
e.zh: 遗传学家把这种突变体归为功能过强型。

e.en: A {hypermorph} often shows increased activity of a gene product.
e.zh: 功能增强突变通常表现为基因产物活性升高。

e.en: The larvae showed {hypermorphosis} under unusual conditions.
e.zh: 幼虫在异常条件下表现出过度形态发育。

e.en: Biologists used {hypermorphosis} to describe excessive developmental change.
e.zh: 生物学家用hypermorphosis描述过度的发育变化。

e.en: Intestinal {hypermotility} can cause cramping and diarrhea.
e.zh: 肠道蠕动亢进会引起腹绞痛和腹泻。

e.en: The drug reduced sperm {hypermotility} in the study.
e.zh: 这项研究中，该药降低了精子的运动过度。

hypermultiplet.t: 超多重态；高重数谱线组

e.en: The physicist labeled the signal as a {hypermultiplet}.
e.zh: 物理学家把这个信号标为超多重态。

e.en: A {hypermultiplet} appears in certain supersymmetric theories.
e.zh: 超多重态出现在某些超对称理论中。

e.en: The report mentioned {hyperneocytosis} in the blood sample.
e.zh: 报告提到血样中有新生细胞过多症。

e.en: Severe {hyperneocytosis} may suggest abnormal marrow activity.
e.zh: 严重的新生细胞过多可能提示骨髓活动异常。

hyperneurotization.t: 神经过度支配；神经化过度

e.en: The surgeon suspected {hyperneurotization} around the scar.
e.zh: 外科医生怀疑瘢痕周围有神经过度支配。

e.en: Experimental {hyperneurotization} changed the muscle response.
e.zh: 实验性神经化过度改变了肌肉反应。

e.en: The chart listed {hypernitremia} as a possible complication.
e.zh: 病历把高钠血症列为一种可能并发症。

e.en: Untreated {hypernitremia} can disturb brain function.
e.zh: 未经治疗的血钠过多会影响脑功能。

e.en: The hematologist described the finding as {hypernormocytosis}.
e.zh: 血液科医生把这一发现描述为正常形态细胞过多症。

e.en: Persistent {hypernormocytosis} required further blood tests.
e.zh: 持续的正常形态细胞过多需要进一步验血。

e.en: The experiment produced a short-lived {hypernucleus}.
e.zh: 实验产生了一个寿命很短的超核。

e.en: A {hypernucleus} contains a hyperon as well as nucleons.
e.zh: 超核除核子外还含有一个超子。

e.en: The fossil was compared with a {hyperoartian} jawless fish.
e.zh: 这块化石被拿来与七鳃鳗类无颌鱼比较。

e.en: A {hyperoartian} species can attach to other fish.
e.zh: 七鳃鳗类物种能够附着在其他鱼身上。

e.en: A {hyperon} contains at least one strange quark.
e.zh: 超子至少含有一个奇异夸克。

e.en: The detector recorded the decay of a {hyperon}.
e.zh: 探测器记录到一个超子的衰变。

e.en: The author called the specimen a {hyperontomorph}.
e.zh: 作者把这个标本称为过度个体发育型。

e.en: A {hyperontomorph} may retain features from exaggerated development.
e.zh: 过度个体发育型可能保留发育过度形成的特征。

e.en: The dermatologist treated {hyperonychosis} on both feet.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生治疗了双脚的指甲过度生长症。

e.en: Long-term pressure can worsen {hyperonychosis} in elderly patients.
e.zh: 长期受压会加重老年患者的指甲过度生长。

e.en: A {hyperope} may see distant objects more clearly.
e.zh: 远视者看远处物体可能更清楚。

e.en: The optometrist fitted the {hyperope} with reading glasses.
e.zh: 验光师给这位远视者配了阅读眼镜。

e.en: Children with {hyperopia} may struggle to read comfortably.
e.zh: 有远视的儿童阅读时可能会感到吃力。

e.en: Glasses can correct most cases of {hyperopia}.
e.zh: 眼镜可以矫正大多数远视病例。

e.en: The child was mildly {hyperopic} in both eyes.
e.zh: 这个孩子双眼都有轻度远视。

e.en: A {hyperopic} lens helps focus images on the retina.
e.zh: 远视镜片有助于把影像聚焦在视网膜上。

e.en: The medication caused {hyperorexia} in several patients.
e.zh: 这种药导致几名患者食欲亢进。

e.en: Sudden {hyperorexia} can signal an endocrine problem.
e.zh: 突然食欲过盛可能提示内分泌问题。

e.en: The infant was tested for {hyperornithinemia} after seizures.
e.zh: 婴儿抽搐后接受了高鸟氨酸血症检测。

e.en: Dietary treatment may help manage {hyperornithinemia}.
e.zh: 饮食治疗可能有助于控制高鸟氨酸血症。

e.en: Pregnancy gave her temporary {hyperosmia}.
e.zh: 怀孕让她暂时出现嗅觉过敏。

e.en: People with {hyperosmia} may find perfumes overwhelming.
e.zh: 有嗅觉过敏的人可能觉得香水味难以忍受。

e.en: Severe dehydration can lead to {hyperosmolality}.
e.zh: 严重脱水可能导致高渗透压状态。

e.en: The lab result confirmed serum {hyperosmolality}.
e.zh: 化验结果确认了血清高渗透压。

e.en: The scan suggested {hyperosteogeny} around the old fracture site.
e.zh: 扫描显示旧骨折处周围有骨生成过多。

e.en: Researchers linked the abnormal {hyperosteogeny} to a rare genetic disorder.
e.zh: 研究人员把这种异常骨生成过多与一种罕见遗传病联系起来。

e.en: The X-ray showed {hyperostosis} along the patient's spine.
e.zh: X光片显示患者脊柱旁有骨质增生。

e.en: Diffuse idiopathic skeletal {hyperostosis} can make the back feel stiff.
e.zh: 弥漫性特发性骨肥厚会让背部感到僵硬。

e.en: The surgeon removed a {hyperostotic} section of bone near the skull base.
e.zh: 外科医生切除了颅底附近一段骨质增生的骨头。

e.en: Imaging revealed {hyperostotic} changes around the joint.
e.zh: 影像检查显示关节周围有骨质增生性改变。

e.en: The fossil was described as a {hyperotretan} in an old zoological paper.
e.zh: 这块化石在一篇旧动物学论文中被描述为闭孔过多的动物。

e.en: Few modern readers recognize the term {hyperotretan} outside specialist texts.
e.zh: 现代读者很少在专业文本之外认得闭孔过多动物这个术语。

e.en: Doctors tested him for {hyperoxaluria} after repeated kidney stones.
e.zh: 他反复出现肾结石后，医生为他检查是否有尿草酸过多症。

e.en: Primary {hyperoxaluria} can damage the kidneys early in life.
e.zh: 原发性尿草酸过多症可能在幼年就损害肾脏。

e.en: Prolonged oxygen therapy may cause {hyperoxemia} in vulnerable patients.
e.zh: 长期氧疗可能让脆弱患者出现血氧过多症。

e.en: The team adjusted the ventilator to avoid severe {hyperoxemia}.
e.zh: 团队调整了呼吸机，以避免严重血氧过多。

e.en: Newborn lungs can be injured by prolonged {hyperoxia}.
e.zh: 新生儿肺部可能因长期高氧状态而受损。

e.en: Divers study {hyperoxia} because excess oxygen can become toxic under pressure.
e.zh: 潜水员会研究氧过多，因为高压下过量氧气可能产生毒性。

e.en: The reaction produced a small amount of {hyperoxide}.
e.zh: 该反应产生了少量超氧化物。

e.en: Chemists compared the stability of each metal {hyperoxide}.
e.zh: 化学家比较了每种金属超氧化物的稳定性。

e.en: A {hyperparasite} can live on another parasite rather than on the host directly.
e.zh: 重寄生物可以寄生在另一种寄生物上，而不是直接寄生在宿主身上。

e.en: The wasp acted as a {hyperparasite} in the insect community.
e.zh: 这种黄蜂在昆虫群落中充当重寄生物。

e.en: The researchers found a {hyperparasitic} fungus attacking the plant pathogen.
e.zh: 研究人员发现一种重寄生真菌正在侵袭植物病原体。

e.en: Some {hyperparasitic} insects lay eggs inside other parasites.
e.zh: 一些重寄生昆虫会把卵产在其他寄生物体内。

e.en: The paper explains {hyperparasitism} in several species of wasps.
e.zh: 这篇论文解释了几种黄蜂中的重寄生现象。

e.en: Farmers may benefit when {hyperparasitism} weakens crop pests.
e.zh: 当重寄生现象削弱作物害虫时，农民可能会受益。

e.en: The medication caused {hyperperistalsis} and abdominal cramping.
e.zh: 这种药物导致肠蠕动过强和腹部绞痛。

e.en: Doctors heard signs of {hyperperistalsis} during the examination.
e.zh: 医生在检查时听到了肠蠕动过强的迹象。

e.en: The child developed {hyperphagia} after damage to the hypothalamus.
e.zh: 这个孩子在下丘脑受损后出现食欲亢进。

e.en: Severe {hyperphagia} can make weight control extremely difficult.
e.zh: 严重贪食症会让体重控制变得极其困难。

e.en: The mice became {hyperphagic} after the gene was disrupted.
e.zh: 该基因被破坏后，这些小鼠变得食欲亢进。

e.en: Clinicians monitored the patient's {hyperphagic} behavior during treatment.
e.zh: 临床医生在治疗期间监测患者的贪食行为。

e.en: The whale flipper shows {hyperphalangism} compared with a typical mammal limb.
e.zh: 与典型哺乳动物肢体相比，鲸的鳍肢表现出指趾骨过多。

e.en: A rare congenital form of {hyperphalangism} affected the child's toes.
e.zh: 一种罕见的先天性指趾骨过多症影响了这个孩子的脚趾。

e.en: Newborn screening can detect {hyperphenylalaninemia} before symptoms appear.
e.zh: 新生儿筛查可以在症状出现前发现高苯丙氨酸血症。

e.en: Untreated {hyperphenylalaninemia} may affect brain development.
e.zh: 未经治疗的高苯丙氨酸血症可能影响大脑发育。

e.en: The linguist used {hyperphoneme} to describe an abstract sound contrast.
e.zh: 这位语言学家用超音位来描述一种抽象的语音对立。

e.en: A {hyperphoneme} may cover several related phonemes in a dialect analysis.
e.zh: 在方言分析中，一个超音位可能涵盖几个相关音位。

e.en: Kidney failure often leads to {hyperphosphatemia}.
e.zh: 肾衰竭常常会导致高磷血症。

e.en: The dietitian limited phosphate intake to control {hyperphosphatemia}.
e.zh: 营养师限制磷酸盐摄入，以控制高磷血症。

e.en: The philosopher rejected any {hyperphysical} explanation of consciousness.
e.zh: 这位哲学家拒绝用任何超物质的解释来说明意识。

e.en: The poem hints at a {hyperphysical} world beyond ordinary perception.
e.zh: 这首诗暗示了一个超越普通感知的超自然世界。

e.en: Older medical texts often used {hyperpiesia} for high blood pressure.
e.zh: 较早的医学文献常用hyperpiesia指高血压症。

e.en: The physician noted mild {hyperpiesia} during the routine visit.
e.zh: 医生在常规就诊中记录到轻度高血压。

e.en: The chart described the patient as {hyperpietic}.
e.zh: 病历把这名患者描述为高血压状态。

e.en: A {hyperpietic} episode required careful monitoring overnight.
e.zh: 一次高血压发作需要整夜仔细监测。

e.en: The old diagnosis of {hyperpinealism} is rarely used today.
e.zh: 松果体功能亢进这一旧诊断如今很少使用。

e.en: Researchers once blamed early symptoms on {hyperpinealism}.
e.zh: 研究人员曾把早期症状归因于松果体功能亢进。

e.en: Excess growth hormone may indicate {hyperpituitarism}.
e.zh: 生长激素过多可能提示垂体功能亢进。

e.en: The tumor caused {hyperpituitarism} and changes in the patient's face.
e.zh: 这个肿瘤导致垂体功能亢进，并使患者面部发生变化。

e.en: The endocrinologist suspected a {hyperpituitary} disorder.
e.zh: 内分泌科医生怀疑存在垂体功能亢进性疾病。

e.en: Her symptoms pointed to a {hyperpituitary} state rather than simple stress.
e.zh: 她的症状指向垂体功能亢进状态，而不是单纯压力。

e.en: The biopsy showed {hyperplastic} tissue, but no cancer.
e.zh: 活检显示为增生性组织，但没有癌变。

e.en: A {hyperplastic} polyp is often found during routine colonoscopy.
e.zh: 增生性息肉常在常规结肠镜检查中被发现。

hypersensitize.t: 使过度敏感；使高度敏化

e.en: Repeated exposure can {hypersensitize} the skin to sunlight.
e.zh: 反复接触可能使皮肤对阳光过度敏感。

e.en: The drug may {hypersensitize} certain nerve pathways.
e.zh: 这种药物可能使某些神经通路高度敏化。

e.en: The lab installed a {hypersensor} to detect tiny pressure changes.
e.zh: 实验室安装了一台超灵敏传感器来检测微小压力变化。

e.en: A wearable {hypersensor} tracked every slight movement of his hand.
e.zh: 一个可穿戴超灵敏传感器记录了他手部的每个细微动作。

e.en: The child was tested for {hyperserotonemia} after unusual lab results.
e.zh: 化验结果异常后，孩子接受了血清素过多症检查。

e.en: Researchers linked {hyperserotonemia} with several developmental findings.
e.zh: 研究人员把血清素过多症与几项发育表现联系起来。

hypersexual.t: 性欲过强的；性化过度的

e.en: The medication left him feeling unusually {hypersexual}.
e.zh: 这种药让他感到性欲异常强烈。

e.en: Critics called the advertisement {hypersexual} and exploitative.
e.zh: 批评者称这则广告性化过度且带有剥削意味。

e.en: The therapist discussed {hypersexuality} as a possible symptom.
e.zh: 治疗师讨论了性欲亢进作为一种可能症状。

e.en: The essay examines {hypersexuality} in modern celebrity culture.
e.zh: 这篇文章探讨现代名人文化中的过度性化现象。

e.en: The old report described {hyperskeocytosis} in several blood samples.
e.zh: 那份旧报告描述了几份血样中的血细胞异常增多症。

e.en: Doctors rarely use {hyperskeocytosis} in modern clinical notes.
e.zh: 医生在现代临床记录中很少使用血细胞异常增多症这个词。

e.en: The camera captured the impact in {hyperslow} motion.
e.zh: 摄像机以超慢速画面捕捉了撞击瞬间。

e.en: Progress felt {hyperslow} during the final approval stage.
e.zh: 到了最后审批阶段，进展慢得出奇。

e.en: Her doctor diagnosed {hypersomnia} after months of daytime sleepiness.
e.zh: 她白天嗜睡数月后，医生诊断为嗜睡症。

e.en: Severe {hypersomnia} made it hard for him to keep a job.
e.zh: 严重的睡眠过多让他很难保住工作。

e.en: The test vehicle traveled {hypersonically} over the ocean.
e.zh: 测试飞行器以高超音速飞越海面。

e.en: Engineers studied how air behaves {hypersonically} around the craft.
e.zh: 工程师研究空气在飞行器周围以高超音速流动时的表现。

e.en: The new material showed {hypersorption} of industrial pollutants.
e.zh: 这种新材料对工业污染物表现出超强吸附能力。

e.en: Soil {hypersorption} can change how quickly chemicals spread.
e.zh: 土壤的过度吸收会改变化学物质扩散的速度。

e.en: The neurologist mentioned {hyperspasmia} in the differential diagnosis.
e.zh: 神经科医生在鉴别诊断中提到了痉挛过强症。

e.en: Old medical texts used {hyperspasmia} for excessive muscular spasms.
e.zh: 旧医学文献用痉挛过强症来指肌肉痉挛过度。

e.en: The novel sends its ships through a {hyperspatial} tunnel.
e.zh: 这部小说让飞船穿过一条超空间隧道。

e.en: The model uses {hyperspatial} geometry to compare complex data.
e.zh: 该模型利用高维空间几何来比较复杂数据。

hyperspecialization.t: 过度专业化；高度专门化

e.en: Academic {hyperspecialization} can make collaboration harder.
e.zh: 学术上的过度专业化可能让合作变得更困难。

e.en: The company benefited from {hyperspecialization} in battery materials.
e.zh: 这家公司因在电池材料上的高度专门化而受益。

e.en: The satellite used {hyperspectral} imaging to map crop health.
e.zh: 卫星利用高光谱成像来绘制作物健康状况图。

e.en: A {hyperspectral} camera can separate materials by their reflected light.
e.zh: 高光谱相机能根据反射光区分不同材料。

e.en: A {hypersphere} is the higher-dimensional version of a sphere.
e.zh: 超球体是球体在更高维度中的对应形式。

e.en: The algorithm searches points on a {hypersphere}.
e.zh: 该算法在一个高维球面上搜索点。

e.en: The bridge was modeled as a {hyperstatic} structure.
e.zh: 这座桥被建模为超静定结构。

e.en: The scene felt {hyperstatic}, with no visible movement anywhere.
e.zh: 这个场景显得过度静止，到处都看不到明显动作。

e.en: The exhibit demonstrated {hyperstereography} with distant mountain views.
e.zh: 展览用远处山景演示了超立体摄影术。

e.en: Early photographers used {hyperstereography} to exaggerate depth.
e.zh: 早期摄影师用超立体摄影术来夸大景深。

e.en: The rock sample contained dark crystals of {hypersthene}.
e.zh: 这块岩石样本含有深色的紫苏辉石晶体。

e.en: Geologists identified {hypersthene} under the microscope.
e.zh: 地质学家在显微镜下鉴定出了紫苏辉石。

hypersthenic.t: 体格粗壮的；机能亢进的

e.en: The physician described him as having a {hypersthenic} build.
e.zh: 医生形容他的体格属于粗壮型。

e.en: Old manuals linked a {hypersthenic} state with heightened bodily activity.
e.zh: 旧手册把机能亢进状态与身体活动增强联系起来。

e.en: The urine test suggested {hypersthenuria} after prolonged dehydration.
e.zh: 长期脱水后，尿检提示有尿比重过高症。

e.en: Clinicians may note {hypersthenuria} when urine is unusually concentrated.
e.zh: 尿液异常浓缩时，临床医生可能会记录尿比重过高症。

e.en: The leaf was described as {hyperstomatous} under drought stress.
e.zh: 在干旱胁迫下，这片叶子被描述为气孔过多。

e.en: A {hyperstomatous} surface may lose water more rapidly.
e.zh: 气孔过多的表面可能更快失水。

hypersusceptibility.t: 过度易感性；高度敏感性

e.en: Genetic factors may explain her {hypersusceptibility} to infection.
e.zh: 遗传因素可能解释她对感染的过度易感性。

e.en: The study measured {hypersusceptibility} to a common pesticide.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了对一种常见农药的高度敏感性。

e.en: Some patients are {hypersusceptible} to the drug's side effects.
e.zh: 有些患者对这种药的副作用过度敏感。

e.en: The seedlings were {hypersusceptible} to frost after warm weather.
e.zh: 天气转暖后，这些幼苗变得特别容易受霜冻影响。

e.en: After the scam, he became {hypersuspicious} of every email.
e.zh: 被骗之后，他对每封邮件都变得过度多疑。

e.en: The report criticized the agency's {hypersuspicious} attitude toward applicants.
e.zh: 报告批评该机构对申请者过度多疑的态度。

hypersynchronous.t: 高度同步的；过度同步的

e.en: The EEG showed {hypersynchronous} activity during the seizure.
e.zh: 脑电图显示癫痫发作期间出现高度同步活动。

e.en: The dancers moved in a {hypersynchronous} pattern that felt almost mechanical.
e.zh: 舞者以高度同步的模式移动，感觉近乎机械。

e.en: The study linked neural {hypersynchrony} to seizure activity.
e.zh: 这项研究把神经元过度同步与癫痫活动联系起来。

e.en: Market {hypersynchrony} can make separate stocks move together.
e.zh: 市场过度同步会让原本不同的股票一起波动。

e.en: The linguist described the clause as a {hypertagmeme}.
e.zh: 这位语言学家把这个从句描述为超标位素。

e.en: A {hypertagmeme} may combine several smaller grammatical patterns.
e.zh: 一个超标位素可能结合几个较小的语法模式。

e.en: The patient reported episodes of {hypertarachia} after exercise.
e.zh: 患者说运动后会出现心跳过速的发作。

e.en: Doctors monitored the sudden {hypertarachia} overnight.
e.zh: 医生整夜监测这次突然的脉搏过快。

e.en: Researchers once called angiotensin {hypertensin}.
e.zh: 研究人员曾把血管紧张素称为hypertensin。

e.en: The experiment measured {hypertensin} in the blood sample.
e.zh: 实验测量了血样中的血管紧张素。

e.en: The enzyme {hypertensinase} breaks down hypertensin in plasma.
e.zh: 这种名为血管紧张素酶的酶会分解血浆中的血管紧张素。

e.en: Low {hypertensinase} activity affected the pressure response.
e.zh: 血管紧张素酶活性低影响了血压反应。

hypertextual.t: 超文本的；含链接结构的

e.en: The novel has a strongly {hypertextual} structure.
e.zh: 这部小说有很强的超文本结构。

e.en: Online articles often use {hypertextual} links for context.
e.zh: 网络文章常用超文本链接来补充背景。

e.en: The doctor noted mild {hyperthelia} during the examination.
e.zh: 医生在检查中发现了轻度多乳头症。

e.en: Congenital {hyperthelia} is usually harmless.
e.zh: 先天性乳头过多通常没有危害。

e.en: A {hypertherm} can survive near boiling vents.
e.zh: 嗜高温生物能在接近沸腾的热泉口附近生存。

e.en: The lab cultured a {hypertherm} from deep-sea samples.
e.zh: 实验室从深海样本中培养出一种高温微生物。

e.en: The runner became {hyperthermic} in the afternoon heat.
e.zh: 这名跑者在下午的高温中体温过高。

e.en: Doctors began {hyperthermic} treatment for the tumor.
e.zh: 医生开始对肿瘤进行高热治疗。

e.en: The furnace used a {hyperthermocouple} for extreme temperatures.
e.zh: 这台炉子用高温热电偶测量极端温度。

e.en: A damaged {hyperthermocouple} gave unstable readings.
e.zh: 受损的高温热电偶给出了不稳定读数。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {hyperthermometer} before testing.
e.zh: 技术员在测试前校准了高温温度计。

e.en: A {hyperthermometer} is needed inside the kiln.
e.zh: 窑炉内部需要使用高温温度计。

hyperthite.t: 古老矿物名；辉石类矿物

e.en: The old catalogue listed {hyperthite} among the minerals.
e.zh: 旧目录把hyperthite列在矿物之中。

e.en: A sample labeled {hyperthite} was kept in the museum.
e.zh: 博物馆保存着一块标为hyperthite的矿物样本。

e.en: The report mentioned {hyperthrombinemia} as a clotting risk.
e.zh: 报告提到高凝血酶血症是一种凝血风险。

e.en: Severe {hyperthrombinemia} requires careful monitoring.
e.zh: 严重高凝血酶血症需要密切监测。

e.en: The psychiatrist used {hyperthymergasia} in an older diagnosis.
e.zh: 这位精神科医生在旧式诊断中使用了情感活动亢进这一说法。

e.en: Symptoms of {hyperthymergasia} included excessive emotional reactivity.
e.zh: 情感活动亢进的症状包括过度的情绪反应。

e.en: Persistent {hyperthymia} can resemble mild mania.
e.zh: 持续的情绪高涨可能类似轻躁狂。

e.en: Her {hyperthymia} made her unusually energetic and talkative.
e.zh: 她的情感亢进让她显得异常精力充沛、爱说话。

e.en: Older texts sometimes call hyperthyroidism {hyperthyrea}.
e.zh: 旧文献有时把甲状腺机能亢进称为hyperthyrea。

e.en: The physician suspected {hyperthyrea} after the weight loss.
e.zh: 看到体重下降后，医生怀疑是甲状腺机能亢进。

hyperthyroid.t: 甲亢的；甲状腺过度活跃的

e.en: She was diagnosed as {hyperthyroid} last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天被诊断为甲状腺功能亢进。

e.en: A {hyperthyroid} patient may feel anxious and hot.
e.zh: 甲亢患者可能会感到焦虑和怕热。

e.en: The baby showed signs of {hypertonia} in both legs.
e.zh: 这个婴儿双腿出现了肌张力过高的迹象。

e.en: Cell shrinkage can occur in severe {hypertonia}.
e.zh: 严重高渗状态下可能发生细胞皱缩。

e.en: The equation describes motion on a {hypertorus}.
e.zh: 这个方程描述的是高维环面上的运动。

e.en: A {hypertorus} generalizes the ordinary doughnut shape.
e.zh: 超环面是普通环面形状的推广。

e.en: The drug showed {hypertoxicity} at higher doses.
e.zh: 这种药在较高剂量下表现出高毒性。

e.en: Environmental {hypertoxicity} harmed the nearby fish population.
e.zh: 环境中的过强毒性伤害了附近的鱼群。

e.en: The medication caused mild {hypertrichosis} on her arms.
e.zh: 这种药导致她手臂出现轻度多毛症。

e.en: Congenital {hypertrichosis} is extremely rare.
e.zh: 先天性多毛症极为罕见。

e.en: Diet changes helped control his {hypertriglyceridemia}.
e.zh: 饮食调整帮助控制了他的高甘油三酯血症。

e.en: Severe {hypertriglyceridemia} can increase pancreatitis risk.
e.zh: 严重高甘油三酯血症会增加胰腺炎风险。

e.en: The physicist discussed the {hypertron} in an old paper.
e.zh: 这位物理学家在一篇旧论文中讨论了超子。

e.en: A {hypertron} was proposed as a heavy unstable particle.
e.zh: 超子曾被提出为一种重的不稳定粒子。

hypertrophyte.t: 过度生长植物；肥大植物

e.en: The botanist described the specimen as a {hypertrophyte}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这个标本描述为过度生长植物。

e.en: A {hypertrophyte} may develop unusually enlarged tissues.
e.zh: 肥大植物可能形成异常增大的组织。

hyperurbanism.t: 过度城市化；矫饰都市语

e.en: Rapid {hyperurbanism} strained the region's transport system.
e.zh: 快速的过度城市化给该地区交通系统带来压力。

e.en: His speech showed {hyperurbanism} in its overcorrected forms.
e.zh: 他的言语中出现了过度纠正的矫饰都市语形式。

hyperuricacidemia.t: 高尿酸血症；血尿酸过高

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {hyperuricacidemia} after repeated blood tests.
e.zh: 多次血液检查后，患者被诊断为高尿酸血症。

e.en: Diet and medication can help control {hyperuricacidemia}.
e.zh: 饮食调整和药物可以帮助控制血尿酸过高。

hyperuricaemia.t: 高尿酸血症；血尿酸过高

e.en: The doctor linked his gout attacks to {hyperuricaemia}.
e.zh: 医生把他的痛风发作与高尿酸血症联系起来。

e.en: Regular monitoring is important in chronic {hyperuricaemia}.
e.zh: 慢性血尿酸过高需要定期监测。

hyperuricemia.t: 高尿酸血症；血尿酸过高

e.en: Untreated {hyperuricemia} may increase the risk of gout.
e.zh: 未经治疗的高尿酸血症可能增加痛风风险。

e.en: Her {hyperuricemia} improved after changes in diet.
e.zh: 调整饮食后，她的血尿酸过高有所改善。

hyperuricuria.t: 高尿酸尿症；尿酸排泄过多

e.en: The urine test showed marked {hyperuricuria}.
e.zh: 尿检显示明显的高尿酸尿症。

e.en: Children with {hyperuricuria} may develop kidney stones.
e.zh: 有尿酸排泄过多的儿童可能会形成肾结石。

e.en: The specialist considered {hypervagotonia} as a cause of the slow pulse.
e.zh: 专家认为迷走神经过度兴奋可能导致心率过慢。

e.en: Fainting episodes were sometimes attributed to {hypervagotonia}.
e.zh: 晕厥发作有时被归因于迷走神经过度兴奋。

e.en: Newborn screening can detect {hypervalinemia} early.
e.zh: 新生儿筛查可以早期发现高缬氨酸血症。

e.en: The report described {hypervalinemia} as a rare metabolic disorder.
e.zh: 报告将高缬氨酸血症描述为一种罕见代谢病。

hyperverbal.t: 话特别多的；言语过多的

e.en: The child became {hyperverbal} when excited.
e.zh: 那个孩子一兴奋就变得话特别多。

e.en: During the interview, his {hyperverbal} answers were hard to follow.
e.zh: 面试时，他过于冗长的回答让人难以跟上。

hypervitaminosis.t: 维生素过多症；维生素中毒

e.en: Taking excessive supplements can cause {hypervitaminosis}.
e.zh: 过量服用补充剂可能导致维生素过多症。

e.en: The symptoms suggested {hypervitaminosis} A rather than an infection.
e.zh: 这些症状提示是维生素A中毒，而不是感染。

hypervolemia.t: 血容量过多；高血容量症

e.en: Severe {hypervolemia} can strain the heart.
e.zh: 严重的血容量过多会给心脏造成负担。

e.en: The nurses monitored signs of {hypervolemia} after the transfusion.
e.zh: 输血后，护士们监测高血容量症的迹象。

e.en: The injury caused {hypesthesia} in two fingers.
e.zh: 这次受伤导致两根手指出现感觉减退。

e.en: Patients reported numbness and {hypesthesia} around the scar.
e.zh: 患者报告疤痕周围有麻木和触觉迟钝。

e.en: The ancient shrine had a {hypethral} central court.
e.zh: 这座古代神殿有一个露天的中央庭院。

e.en: Architects debated whether the temple was {hypethral}.
e.zh: 建筑师们争论这座神庙是否是无屋顶结构。

hypethron.t: 露天空间；无顶建筑部分

e.en: Rain fell directly into the temple's {hypethron}.
e.zh: 雨水直接落进神庙的露天空间。

e.en: The guide pointed out the {hypethron} above the sanctuary.
e.zh: 导游指出圣所上方的无顶建筑部分。

e.en: Each {hypha} grows through the soil in search of nutrients.
e.zh: 每根菌丝都会在土壤中生长以寻找养分。

e.en: Under the microscope, a single {hypha} looked like a fine thread.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，单根菌丝看起来像一条细线。

e.en: The sample showed dense {hyphal} growth.
e.zh: 样本显示出密集的菌丝生长。

e.en: Researchers measured the {hyphal} network in the infected tissue.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了受感染组织中的菌丝网络。

e.en: A blow to the eye caused a small {hyphema}.
e.zh: 眼部受到撞击后出现了少量前房积血。

e.en: The ophthalmologist treated the {hyphema} carefully to protect his vision.
e.zh: 眼科医生谨慎治疗眼前房出血，以保护他的视力。

hyphenise.t: 用连字符连接；加连字符

e.en: British editors may {hyphenise} the compound differently.
e.zh: 英国编辑可能会用不同方式给这个复合词加连字符。

e.en: Please {hyphenise} the phrase when it modifies a noun.
e.zh: 当这个短语修饰名词时，请用连字符连接。

hyphenism.t: 连字符用法；连字号倾向

e.en: The editor disliked excessive {hyphenism} in technical prose.
e.zh: 编辑不喜欢技术文章中过度使用连字符。

e.en: His style guide treats {hyphenism} as a matter of clarity.
e.zh: 他的风格指南把连字符用法视为清晰表达的问题。

e.en: Automatic {hyphenization} can improve narrow newspaper columns.
e.zh: 自动加连字符可以改善狭窄的报纸栏排版。

e.en: The software's {hyphenization} rules failed on several names.
e.zh: 该软件的连字符化规则在几个名称上失效了。

hyphenize.t: 用连字符连接；加连字符

e.en: Writers often {hyphenize} compound modifiers before nouns.
e.zh: 作者常在名词前给复合修饰语加连字符。

e.en: The program can {hyphenize} long words at line breaks.
e.zh: 这个程序能在换行处给长词加连字符。

hyphenless.t: 无连字符的；不带连字符的

e.en: The newer spelling is {hyphenless}.
e.zh: 较新的拼写是不带连字符的。

e.en: Search results differed for the {hyphenless} form of the term.
e.zh: 该术语无连字符形式的搜索结果有所不同。

e.en: The fungus formed a {hyphopode} on the leaf surface.
e.zh: 真菌在叶片表面形成了附着枝。

e.en: Researchers identified the {hyphopode} as an infection structure.
e.zh: 研究人员将这种菌丝附着器识别为感染结构。

e.en: The old report used {hypinosis} to describe low fibrin levels.
e.zh: 这份旧报告用血纤维蛋白减少症来描述纤维蛋白水平偏低。

e.en: Modern doctors rarely use the term {hypinosis}.
e.zh: 现代医生很少使用血纤维蛋白减少症这个术语。

e.en: She heard a {hypnagogic} voice as she drifted off.
e.zh: 她快要睡着时听见了半睡半醒中的声音。

e.en: The artist tried to capture {hypnagogic} images in his drawings.
e.zh: 这位艺术家试图在画中捕捉入睡前出现的意象。

e.en: The physician prescribed a mild {hypnagogue} for short-term insomnia.
e.zh: 医生为短期失眠开了一种温和的催眠药。

e.en: Warm music acted as a {hypnagogue} after a stressful day.
e.zh: 在压力很大的一天后，温柔的音乐起到了助眠作用。

hypnal.t: 催眠药的；安眠的；与睡眠有关的

e.en: The doctor described the tablet as a {hypnal} aid for severe insomnia.
e.zh: 医生把这种药片描述为治疗严重失眠的安眠辅助药。

e.en: The old paper used {hypnal} to mean related to sleep.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文用 hypnal 表示与睡眠有关。

e.en: The pharmacist warned that {hypnan} could cause morning drowsiness.
e.zh: 药剂师提醒说，这种安眠药可能导致早晨嗜睡。

e.en: In the case notes, {hypnan} was listed beside other sedatives.
e.zh: 病例记录中，hypnan 和其他镇静剂列在一起。

e.en: She reported vivid {hypnic} images just before falling asleep.
e.zh: 她说自己入睡前看到了鲜明的睡前影像。

e.en: The therapist tried to create a calm, {hypnic} atmosphere.
e.zh: 治疗师试图营造一种平静而催眠般的氛围。

hypnoanalysis.t: 催眠分析；催眠心理分析

e.en: The psychiatrist used {hypnoanalysis} to explore buried memories.
e.zh: 精神科医生用催眠分析来探查被压抑的记忆。

e.en: Modern clinicians rarely rely on {hypnoanalysis} alone.
e.zh: 现代临床医生很少只依赖催眠心理分析。

e.en: The organism survived winter as a {hypnocyst} in the mud.
e.zh: 这种生物以休眠囊的形式在泥中越冬。

e.en: Under stress, the cell formed a thick-walled {hypnocyst}.
e.zh: 在压力下，细胞形成了厚壁休眠包囊。

hypnodontia.t: 牙齿发育不足；牙数不足

e.en: The child was diagnosed with {hypnodontia} during a dental exam.
e.zh: 孩子在牙科检查中被诊断为牙齿发育不足。

e.en: Mild {hypnodontia} may affect only one or two teeth.
e.zh: 轻度牙数不足可能只影响一两颗牙。

hypnodrama.t: 催眠心理剧；催眠戏剧疗法

e.en: The workshop combined role-play with {hypnodrama}.
e.zh: 工作坊把角色扮演和催眠心理剧结合起来。

e.en: Some therapists used {hypnodrama} to revisit traumatic scenes safely.
e.zh: 一些治疗师用催眠戏剧疗法安全地重访创伤场景。

e.en: The study examined {hypnogenesis} after prolonged sensory deprivation.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了长期感官剥夺后的睡眠发生。

e.en: Early psychologists debated the mechanism of {hypnogenesis}.
e.zh: 早期心理学家曾争论催眠产生的机制。

e.en: The researcher tested the drug's {hypnogenetic} effect in mice.
e.zh: 研究人员在小鼠身上测试这种药物的致睡眠作用。

e.en: Soft rhythmic sounds may have a {hypnogenetic} influence.
e.zh: 柔和而有节奏的声音可能具有催眠作用。

hypnogenetically.t: 以引起睡眠的方式；催眠性地

e.en: The compound acted {hypnogenetically} at low doses.
e.zh: 这种化合物在低剂量下以促眠方式起作用。

e.en: The chant worked {hypnogenetically} on the exhausted audience.
e.zh: 那段吟唱对疲惫的听众产生了催眠般的作用。

e.en: He heard a {hypnogogic} voice as he drifted off.
e.zh: 他快睡着时听到一个半梦半醒中的声音。

e.en: The novel turns {hypnogogic} visions into eerie imagery.
e.zh: 这部小说把入睡前幻象化成了诡异的意象。

hypnograph.t: 睡眠记录仪；催眠记录图

e.en: The lab used a {hypnograph} to record the patient's sleep patterns.
e.zh: 实验室用睡眠记录仪记录病人的睡眠模式。

e.en: The old {hypnograph} showed irregular breathing during the night.
e.zh: 那台旧睡眠记录仪显示夜间呼吸不规则。

e.en: The patient entered a {hypnoid} state after the shock.
e.zh: 病人在受到惊吓后进入了类似催眠的状态。

e.en: His memories returned in brief {hypnoid} episodes.
e.zh: 他的记忆在短暂的恍惚样发作中恢复。

e.en: She specialized in {hypnology} and sleep disorders.
e.zh: 她专攻睡眠学和睡眠障碍。

e.en: Nineteenth-century {hypnology} mixed medicine with speculation.
e.zh: 十九世纪的催眠学把医学和推测混在一起。

e.en: The chemist identified {hypnone} by its almond-like odor.
e.zh: 化学家通过类似杏仁的气味识别出苯乙酮。

e.en: In perfumery, {hypnone} can add a sweet floral note.
e.zh: 在香水制作中，苯乙酮能增添甜美的花香调。

e.en: The novel imagines children learning slogans through {hypnopaedia}.
e.zh: 小说设想孩子们通过睡眠教学学习口号。

e.en: Scientists found little evidence that {hypnopaedia} teaches complex facts.
e.zh: 科学家几乎没有发现睡眠学习法能教授复杂知识的证据。

hypnopaedic.t: 睡眠教学的；睡眠学习的

e.en: The school tested a strange {hypnopaedic} language program.
e.zh: 学校测试了一套奇怪的睡眠语言学习课程。

e.en: The film mocks {hypnopaedic} propaganda played at night.
e.zh: 这部电影讽刺夜间播放的睡眠教学式宣传。

e.en: The dystopia depends on {hypnopedia} to condition its citizens.
e.zh: 这个反乌托邦依靠睡眠教学来制约公民。

e.en: Many products promise {hypnopedia}, but the science is weak.
e.zh: 许多产品承诺睡眠学习法，但科学依据很薄弱。

e.en: After the nightmares, she developed {hypnophobia}.
e.zh: 经历那些噩梦后，她患上了睡眠恐惧症。

e.en: Therapy helped him manage {hypnophobia} without medication.
e.zh: 治疗帮助他在不用药的情况下控制害怕入睡的问题。

e.en: She saw a {hypnopompic} image as she woke.
e.zh: 她醒来时看见了一个将醒时幻象。

e.en: The report distinguished {hypnopompic} hallucinations from dreams.
e.zh: 报告把醒前幻觉与梦境区分开来。

hypnoses.t: 催眠状态；催眠术的复数

e.en: The experiment compared several {hypnoses} induced by different methods.
e.zh: 实验比较了用不同方法诱导出的几种催眠状态。

e.en: Clinical {hypnoses} must be documented carefully.
e.zh: 临床催眠术案例必须仔细记录。

e.en: His essays treated dreams as part of {hypnosophy}.
e.zh: 他的随笔把梦境视为睡眠哲学的一部分。

e.en: The lecturer used {hypnosophy} as a poetic term for sleep wisdom.
e.zh: 讲师把 hypnosophy 当作表示睡眠智慧的诗性词语。

e.en: The alga formed a {hypnosporangium} under dry conditions.
e.zh: 这种藻类在干燥条件下形成了休眠孢子囊。

e.en: Each {hypnosporangium} protected spores until water returned.
e.zh: 每个休眠孢子囊都保护孢子，直到水分恢复。

e.en: The larva rested inside a tough {hypnotheca}.
e.zh: 幼虫在坚韧的休眠壳内休息。

e.en: Researchers described the {hypnotheca} as a protective covering.
e.zh: 研究人员把休眠包被描述为一种保护性外壳。

e.en: The lecturer spoke in a slow, {hypnotical} rhythm.
e.zh: 讲师用缓慢而催眠般的节奏说话。

e.en: Her dance had a strangely {hypnotical} beauty.
e.zh: 她的舞蹈有一种奇异而令人着迷的美。

e.en: The biopsy showed {hyperplasy} of the glandular tissue.
e.zh: 活检显示腺体组织出现增生。

e.en: Doctors monitored the mild {hyperplasy} after treatment.
e.zh: 治疗后，医生继续观察这处轻度增生。

hyperploid.t: 超倍体的；染色体过多的

e.en: The lab identified a {hyperploid} cell line.
e.zh: 实验室鉴定出一株超倍体细胞系。

e.en: Some tumors contain {hyperploid} populations of cells.
e.zh: 有些肿瘤含有染色体过多的细胞群。

e.en: The report noted {hyperploidy} in several samples.
e.zh: 报告指出几个样本存在超倍性。

e.en: Cancer researchers studied how {hyperploidy} affects cell growth.
e.zh: 癌症研究人员研究染色体数过多如何影响细胞生长。

e.en: Exercise can cause temporary {hyperpnea}.
e.zh: 运动可能引起暂时性的呼吸加深加快。

e.en: The patient developed {hyperpnea} during the stress test.
e.zh: 患者在压力测试中出现呼吸加深加快。

e.en: The insect larva has a {hyperpneustic} respiratory system.
e.zh: 这种昆虫幼虫具有气门发达的呼吸系统。

e.en: A {hyperpneustic} pattern helps the species breathe in dry habitats.
e.zh: 多气门结构有助于该物种在干燥栖息地呼吸。

e.en: The runner's {hyperpnoea} eased after a short rest.
e.zh: 跑者短暂休息后，呼吸加深加快的情况缓解了。

e.en: Clinicians recorded {hyperpnoea} without signs of distress.
e.zh: 临床人员记录到呼吸加深加快，但没有痛苦迹象。

e.en: The molecule showed strong optical {hyperpolarizability}.
e.zh: 该分子表现出很强的光学超极化率。

e.en: Researchers calculated the {hyperpolarizability} of the new material.
e.zh: 研究人员计算了这种新材料的超极化率。

e.en: The drug can {hyperpolarize} nerve cells.
e.zh: 这种药物能使神经细胞发生超极化。

e.en: Potassium channels often {hyperpolarize} the membrane.
e.zh: 钾通道常常会使细胞膜超极化。

e.en: The current {hyperpolarizes} the cell membrane.
e.zh: 这股电流会使细胞膜超极化。

e.en: Opening the channel {hyperpolarizes} nearby neurons.
e.zh: 通道打开会使附近神经元发生超极化。

e.en: The chart described a rare {hyperpostpituitary} condition.
e.zh: 病历描述了一种罕见的垂体后叶功能亢进状态。

e.en: Specialists debated whether the symptoms were {hyperpostpituitary}.
e.zh: 专家们讨论这些症状是否属于垂体后叶功能亢进。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {hyperprebetalipoproteinemia}.
e.zh: 患者被诊断为高前β脂蛋白血症。

e.en: Diet changes may help manage {hyperprebetalipoproteinemia}.
e.zh: 调整饮食可能有助于控制高前β脂蛋白血症。

e.en: The vessel failed under {hyperpressure}.
e.zh: 容器在超高压下失效了。

e.en: Engineers tested the seals in a {hyperpressure} chamber.
e.zh: 工程师在超高压舱中测试密封件。

e.en: Genetic testing confirmed {hyperprolinemia} in the child.
e.zh: 基因检测确认这个孩子患有高脯氨酸血症。

e.en: Some cases of {hyperprolinemia} cause few symptoms.
e.zh: 有些高脯氨酸血症病例几乎没有症状。

e.en: The specialist considered {hyperprothrombinemia} as a clotting risk.
e.zh: 专科医生认为高凝血酶原血症会增加血栓风险。

e.en: Blood tests suggested mild {hyperprothrombinemia}.
e.zh: 血液检查提示有轻度高凝血酶原血症。

e.en: The child arrived in a {hyperpyretic} state.
e.zh: 孩子送到时处于超高热状态。

e.en: A {hyperpyretic} reaction requires urgent cooling.
e.zh: 高热反应需要紧急降温处理。

e.en: The infection led to dangerous {hyperpyrexia}.
e.zh: 感染导致了危险的超高热。

e.en: Doctors treated the {hyperpyrexia} immediately.
e.zh: 医生立即处理了这种过高热。

e.en: The model uses {hyperquantization} to compress parameters.
e.zh: 该模型使用超量子化来压缩参数。

e.en: Physicists discussed {hyperquantization} in the seminar.
e.zh: 物理学家在研讨会上讨论了超量子化。

e.en: The gallery focused on American {hyperrealism}.
e.zh: 这家画廊重点展出美国超写实主义作品。

e.en: Her paintings use {hyperrealism} to unsettle the viewer.
e.zh: 她的画作通过超写实主义让观者感到不安。

hyperrealist.t: 超写实主义者；超写实的

e.en: He became known as a {hyperrealist} painter.
e.zh: 他作为超写实主义画家而闻名。

e.en: The film has a {hyperrealist} visual style.
e.zh: 这部电影具有超写实的视觉风格。

e.en: Severe dehydration can contribute to {hypersalemia}.
e.zh: 严重脱水可能导致血盐过多。

e.en: The team monitored {hypersalemia} during the trial.
e.zh: 团队在试验期间监测高盐血症情况。

e.en: The medicine caused {hypersalivation} at night.
e.zh: 这种药导致夜间唾液分泌过多。

e.en: Nausea and {hypersalivation} often appeared together.
e.zh: 恶心和流涎过多常常一起出现。

e.en: Acid {hypersecretion} can worsen stomach pain.
e.zh: 胃酸分泌过多会加重胃痛。

e.en: The tumor caused hormonal {hypersecretion}.
e.zh: 肿瘤导致激素过度分泌。

e.en: Repeated exposure caused {hypersensitisation} to the chemical.
e.zh: 反复接触导致对这种化学物质过敏化。

e.en: The study measured pain {hypersensitisation} after injury.
e.zh: 研究测量了受伤后的疼痛敏感性增强。

hypersensitised.t: 已过敏化的；过度敏感的

e.en: The skin became {hypersensitised} after the treatment.
e.zh: 治疗后皮肤变得过度敏感。

e.en: A {hypersensitised} immune system may overreact.
e.zh: 已过敏化的免疫系统可能会反应过度。

e.en: The vaccine study tracked {hypersensitization} in volunteers.
e.zh: 疫苗研究追踪志愿者的过敏化情况。

e.en: Chronic inflammation can lead to nerve {hypersensitization}.
e.zh: 慢性炎症可能导致神经敏感性增强。

e.en: The researcher isolated a {hypnotoxin} from the venom sample.
e.zh: 研究人员从毒液样本中分离出一种催眠毒素。

e.en: Early papers used {hypnotoxin} to describe a sleep-inducing poison.
e.zh: 早期论文用催眠毒素来指一种诱发睡眠的毒物。

e.en: She bought a {hypo-allergenic} pillow for her son.
e.zh: 她给儿子买了一个低致敏枕头。

e.en: The label says the cream is {hypo-allergenic}.
e.zh: 标签上写着这款面霜是防过敏的。

e.en: The doctor suspected gastric {hypoacidity} after the tests.
e.zh: 检查后，医生怀疑他有胃酸不足。

e.en: Soil {hypoacidity} can affect how some nutrients dissolve.
e.zh: 土壤酸度过低会影响某些养分的溶解。

hypoactive.t: 活动不足的；机能低下的

e.en: The child seemed unusually {hypoactive} during the visit.
e.zh: 就诊时，这个孩子显得异常少动。

e.en: A {hypoactive} thyroid can slow the body's metabolism.
e.zh: 甲状腺功能低下会减慢身体代谢。

e.en: The audiologist diagnosed mild {hypoacusis} in one ear.
e.zh: 听力师诊断出他一只耳朵有轻度听力减退。

e.en: Age-related {hypoacusis} often develops gradually.
e.zh: 与年龄有关的听力减退通常是逐渐发展的。

e.en: The report noted {hypoaffectivity} during the interview.
e.zh: 报告指出，他在访谈中情感反应减弱。

e.en: Severe depression may include {hypoaffectivity} and social withdrawal.
e.zh: 重度抑郁可能伴有情感反应减弱和社交退缩。

e.en: Blood tests confirmed severe {hypoalbuminemia} after surgery.
e.zh: 血液检查确认他术后出现严重低白蛋白血症。

e.en: Chronic liver disease can cause {hypoalbuminemia}.
e.zh: 慢性肝病可能导致低白蛋白血症。

e.en: The refugees suffered {hypoalimentation} during the long blockade.
e.zh: 长期封锁期间，难民遭受营养不足。

e.en: Hospital records described {hypoalimentation} in several elderly patients.
e.zh: 医院记录显示几名老年患者存在供食不足。

e.en: The old chart listed {hypoalonemia} among the possible findings.
e.zh: 旧病历把低盐血症列为可能的检查结果之一。

e.en: Severe vomiting may contribute to {hypoalonemia}.
e.zh: 严重呕吐可能造成血盐过低。

hypoascidium.t: 下位瓶状叶；捕虫囊基部

e.en: The botanist measured the {hypoascidium} of the pitcher leaf.
e.zh: 植物学家测量了瓶状叶的下位捕虫囊部分。

e.en: In this species, the {hypoascidium} is narrow and pale.
e.zh: 在这个物种中，捕虫囊基部狭窄且颜色较浅。

e.en: The laboratory report mentioned {hypoazoturia} after fasting.
e.zh: 实验室报告提到禁食后出现尿氮过低。

e.en: Prolonged malnutrition can be associated with {hypoazoturia}.
e.zh: 长期营养不良可能与低氮尿有关。

e.en: Pilots trained inside a {hypobaric} chamber.
e.zh: 飞行员在低压舱内接受训练。

e.en: The study tested exercise under {hypobaric} conditions.
e.zh: 这项研究测试了低气压条件下的运动表现。

e.en: Mountain climbers must adapt to {hypobarism} at high altitude.
e.zh: 登山者必须适应高海拔的低气压环境。

e.en: The experiment examined how {hypobarism} affects breathing.
e.zh: 实验考察了低气压状态如何影响呼吸。

e.en: The aviator was treated for suspected {hypobaropathy}.
e.zh: 这名飞行员因疑似低压病接受治疗。

e.en: Rapid ascent can increase the risk of {hypobaropathy}.
e.zh: 快速上升会增加发生低气压损伤的风险。

e.en: The fungus showed a distinct {hypobasidial} structure under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，这种真菌呈现出明显的下担子结构。

e.en: The paper compared {hypobasidial} features across related fungi.
e.zh: 论文比较了相关真菌的下担子特征。

e.en: The hematologist noted possible {hypobasophilism} in the blood count.
e.zh: 血液科医生注意到血细胞计数中可能有嗜碱细胞偏低。

e.en: Drug treatment may sometimes lead to {hypobasophilism}.
e.zh: 药物治疗有时可能导致嗜碱细胞偏低状态。

e.en: The survey mapped a {hypobatholitic} zone beneath the granite mass.
e.zh: 勘测绘出了花岗岩体下方的深成岩基下部带。

e.en: Geologists debated the origin of the {hypobatholitic} rocks.
e.zh: 地质学家讨论了这些深成岩基下部岩石的成因。

hypobenthos.t: 底下生物；下层底栖生物

e.en: The trawl collected {hypobenthos} from the deep channel.
e.zh: 拖网从深水槽采集了下层底栖生物。

e.en: Pollution can alter the composition of {hypobenthos}.
e.zh: 污染会改变底下生物群落的组成。

e.en: Genetic testing confirmed {hypobetalipoproteinemia} in the patient.
e.zh: 基因检测确认该患者患有低β脂蛋白血症。

e.en: Some people with {hypobetalipoproteinemia} have very low cholesterol.
e.zh: 一些低β脂蛋白血症患者胆固醇水平很低。

e.en: The abnormal panel showed mild {hypobilirubinemia}.
e.zh: 异常化验结果显示有轻度低胆红素血症。

e.en: Researchers studied whether {hypobilirubinemia} had clinical significance.
e.zh: 研究人员考察低胆红素血症是否具有临床意义。

e.en: The {hypoblast} forms early in the developing embryo.
e.zh: 下胚层在胚胎发育早期形成。

e.en: Students labeled the epiblast and {hypoblast} in the diagram.
e.zh: 学生在图中标出了上胚层和下胚层。

e.en: The dissection revealed a small {hypobranchial} gland.
e.zh: 解剖显示有一个小的鳃下腺。

e.en: The fossil preserved part of the {hypobranchial} skeleton.
e.zh: 这块化石保留了部分鳃下骨骼。

e.en: The chemist monitored {hypobromination} of the organic compound.
e.zh: 化学家监测了该有机化合物的次溴化反应。

e.en: Controlled {hypobromination} changed the molecule's reactivity.
e.zh: 受控次溴化改变了分子的反应性。

e.en: The psychiatrist described the symptom as {hypobulia}.
e.zh: 精神科医生把这种症状描述为意志减退。

e.en: Severe {hypobulia} made ordinary decisions difficult.
e.zh: 严重的意志减退让日常决定都变得困难。

e.en: The newborn was treated for {hypocalcaemia}.
e.zh: 这个新生儿因低钙血症接受治疗。

e.en: Vitamin D deficiency can lead to {hypocalcaemia}.
e.zh: 维生素D缺乏可能导致低钙血症。

e.en: The child's test showed {hypocalciuria} despite normal blood calcium.
e.zh: 这个孩子的检查显示尿钙排出量过低，尽管血钙正常。

e.en: Doctors considered {hypocalciuria} when reviewing her kidney results.
e.zh: 医生查看她的肾脏检查结果时考虑到尿钙过低。

e.en: Rapid breathing can cause {hypocapnia} during a panic attack.
e.zh: 惊恐发作时呼吸过快可能导致血二氧化碳过低。

e.en: The monitor suggested mild {hypocapnia} after ventilation was increased.
e.zh: 增加通气后，监测仪提示有轻度低碳酸血症。

e.en: The neurologist described the brief stiffness as {hypocatalepsis}.
e.zh: 神经科医生把这种短暂僵硬描述为轻度僵直症。

e.en: Older psychiatric texts sometimes mention {hypocatalepsis} as a minor cataleptic state.
e.zh: 较早的精神病学文献有时把轻度僵直症称为较轻的僵直状态。

e.en: The villa still had traces of a Roman {hypocaust}.
e.zh: 这座别墅仍保留着古罗马地暖系统的痕迹。

e.en: Hot air moved under the floor through the {hypocaust}.
e.zh: 热空气通过地板下的古代地暖通道流动。

e.en: Seismologists located the earthquake's {hypocenter} beneath the bay.
e.zh: 地震学家确定这次地震的震源位于海湾下方。

e.en: The bomb's {hypocenter} was marked on the historical map.
e.zh: 那枚炸弹的爆心被标在历史地图上。

e.en: The orchid's {hypochil} was hidden beneath the upper petals.
e.zh: 这朵兰花的唇瓣基部藏在上方花瓣下面。

e.en: Botanists examined the {hypochil} to identify the species.
e.zh: 植物学家检查兰花唇瓣基部来辨认物种。

e.en: Long-term medication may contribute to {hypochlorhydria} in some patients.
e.zh: 长期用药可能使一些患者出现胃酸过少症。

e.en: Her bloating was later linked to {hypochlorhydria}.
e.zh: 她的腹胀后来被认为与胃酸过少有关。

e.en: The wound spray contained a weak {hypochlorous} solution.
e.zh: 这种伤口喷雾含有低浓度的次氯酸溶液。

e.en: White blood cells can produce {hypochlorous} acid to kill bacteria.
e.zh: 白细胞能产生次氯酸来杀死细菌。

e.en: Severe malnutrition can lead to {hypocholesteremia}.
e.zh: 严重营养不良可能导致低胆固醇血症。

e.en: The lab report noted unexpected {hypocholesteremia} in the patient.
e.zh: 化验报告指出患者出现了意外的低胆固醇血症。

e.en: His fear of every ache was diagnosed as {hypochondriasis}.
e.zh: 他对每次疼痛都过度恐惧，被诊断为疑病症。

e.en: Modern clinics often use other terms instead of {hypochondriasis}.
e.zh: 现代诊所通常用其他术语来替代疑病症这个说法。

e.en: She felt pain in the right {hypochondrium} after eating.
e.zh: 她饭后感到右侧肋下区疼痛。

e.en: The liver lies partly under the right {hypochondrium}.
e.zh: 肝脏有一部分位于右侧季肋部下方。

e.en: The doctor compared both {hypochondriums} during the examination.
e.zh: 医生在检查时比较了两侧肋下区。

e.en: Tenderness in the {hypochondriums} may suggest abdominal disease.
e.zh: 两侧季肋部压痛可能提示腹部疾病。

e.en: The embryo developed a small {hypochordal} structure beneath the notochord.
e.zh: 胚胎在脊索下方形成了一个小的脊索下结构。

e.en: Researchers traced {hypochordal} cells during early development.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了早期发育中的脊索下方细胞。

e.en: The smear showed one pale {hypochrome} among normal red cells.
e.zh: 涂片显示正常红细胞中有一个色素不足的淡染细胞。

e.en: A {hypochrome} contains less hemoglobin than expected.
e.zh: 低色素细胞所含血红蛋白少于正常预期。

e.en: Iron deficiency often causes red-cell {hypochromia}.
e.zh: 缺铁常会导致红细胞低色素症。

e.en: The pathologist reported marked {hypochromia} on the blood film.
e.zh: 病理医生报告血涂片上有明显低色素表现。

e.en: The patient had {hypochromic} red blood cells.
e.zh: 这名患者的红细胞呈低色素性。

e.en: Iron therapy improved the {hypochromic} anemia over several weeks.
e.zh: 补铁治疗在数周内改善了低色素性贫血。

e.en: Parkinson's disease can cause {hypocinesia} and stiffness.
e.zh: 帕金森病可能导致运动减少和身体僵硬。

e.en: The scan showed cardiac {hypocinesia} in the damaged region.
e.zh: 扫描显示受损区域存在心肌运动减弱。

e.en: The bird skeleton had a prominent {hypocleidium}.
e.zh: 这具鸟类骨骼有明显的锁骨下突。

e.en: Fossil experts used the {hypocleidium} to compare related species.
e.zh: 化石专家利用锁骨下突来比较相关物种。

e.en: The museum specimens showed differently shaped {hypocleidiums}.
e.zh: 博物馆标本显示出形状不同的锁骨下突。

e.en: Researchers measured the {hypocleidiums} of several ancient birds.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了几种古鸟类的锁骨下突。

e.en: The philosopher used {hypocolasia} to describe insufficient punishment.
e.zh: 这位哲学家用惩罚不足来描述处罚不够的情况。

e.en: In rhetoric, {hypocolasia} can mean an intentionally mild penalty.
e.zh: 在修辞语境中，惩罚不足可指有意设置的轻微处罚。

e.en: Liz is a common {hypocorism} for Elizabeth.
e.zh: Liz 是 Elizabeth 常见的爱称形式。

e.en: The linguist studied how families create {hypocorism} in speech.
e.zh: 语言学家研究家庭成员如何在口语中创造昵称形式。

e.en: Bobby is a {hypocoristic} form of Robert.
e.zh: Bobby 是 Robert 的昵称形式。

e.en: Her grandparents used a {hypocoristic} nickname from childhood.
e.zh: 她的祖父母一直使用她童年时的爱称昵称。

e.en: The child was {hypocoristically} called Mimi by her family.
e.zh: 这个孩子被家人以爱称方式叫作 Mimi。

e.en: He shortened the formal name {hypocoristically} in private letters.
e.zh: 他在私人信件中以昵称方式缩短了那个正式名字。

e.en: Untreated {hypocorticoidism} can cause fatigue and low blood pressure.
e.zh: 未经治疗的肾上腺皮质功能低下会导致疲劳和低血压。

e.en: The endocrinologist suspected {hypocorticoidism} after the hormone test.
e.zh: 激素检查后，内分泌科医生怀疑是肾上腺皮质功能低下。

e.en: The {hypocotyl} lifted the seed leaves above the soil.
e.zh: 下胚轴把子叶抬到土壤上方。

e.en: Light can slow {hypocotyl} elongation in young seedlings.
e.zh: 光照会减缓幼苗下胚轴的伸长。

hypocrateriform.t: 高脚碟状的，花冠筒细长平展

e.en: The flower has a {hypocrateriform} corolla with flat lobes.
e.zh: 这种花有高脚碟状花冠，裂片平展。

e.en: Botanists described the blossom as {hypocrateriform} rather than bell-shaped.
e.zh: 植物学家把这朵花描述为高脚碟状，而不是钟形。

e.en: The specimen showed a {hypocraterimorphous} bloom under magnification.
e.zh: 放大观察时，标本呈现高脚碟状花冠形的花。

e.en: A {hypocraterimorphous} corolla often has a narrow tube and spreading limb.
e.zh: 高脚碟状花冠通常有狭窄的管部和外展的檐部。

e.en: The old report used {hypocrinism} for reduced glandular activity.
e.zh: 那份旧报告用内分泌功能减退来指腺体活动降低。

e.en: Doctors now prefer more specific terms than {hypocrinism}.
e.zh: 如今医生更倾向于使用比内分泌功能减退更具体的术语。

e.en: His {hypocritic} praise sounded more like an attack.
e.zh: 他那种假批评式的赞美听起来更像攻击。

e.en: The essay mocked a {hypocritic} tone in moral debates.
e.zh: 这篇文章讽刺了道德争论中的伪善批评腔调。

hypocrystalline.t: 半结晶的，结晶不完全的

e.en: The rock contained a {hypocrystalline} groundmass around larger crystals.
e.zh: 这块岩石在较大晶体周围含有半结晶基质。

e.en: A {hypocrystalline} texture suggests the melt cooled unevenly.
e.zh: 半结晶结构说明熔体冷却得不均匀。

hypocycloid.t: 内摆线，圆内滚动形成的曲线

e.en: A {hypocycloid} is traced by a point on a rolling circle.
e.zh: 内摆线由滚动圆上的一点描出。

e.en: The gear tooth follows a {hypocycloid} curve in this design.
e.zh: 在这个设计中，齿轮齿形沿着内摆线曲线。

e.en: The surgeon discussed {hypocystotomy} in the historical case notes.
e.zh: 外科医生在历史病例记录中提到了膀胱下部切开术。

e.en: Modern techniques have largely replaced {hypocystotomy}.
e.zh: 现代技术已在很大程度上取代了膀胱下部切开术。

e.en: The laboratory report listed {hypocythaemia} as a possible finding.
e.zh: 化验报告把血细胞减少症列为一种可能发现。

e.en: Severe {hypocythaemia} can leave patients vulnerable to infection.
e.zh: 严重血细胞减少症会使患者更容易受到感染。

e.en: The biopsy suggested {hypocytosis} in the affected tissue.
e.zh: 活检显示受影响组织中细胞数偏低。

e.en: Drug toxicity may cause {hypocytosis} in bone marrow.
e.zh: 药物毒性可能导致骨髓细胞减少。

e.en: The diagram labels the {hypodactyle} beneath the toe.
e.zh: 图中标出了脚趾下方的趾下部。

e.en: Pressure on the {hypodactyle} caused pain while walking.
e.zh: 趾下侧受压让人走路时疼痛。

hypodactylia.t: 指趾发育不全或数目不足

e.en: The infant was examined for {hypodactylia} after birth.
e.zh: 婴儿出生后接受检查，以确认是否有指趾发育不全。

e.en: Mild {hypodactylia} may affect only one hand or foot.
e.zh: 轻度指趾不足可能只影响一只手或脚。

e.en: The needle passed into the {hypoderm} below the skin.
e.zh: 针头进入了皮肤下方的皮下组织。

e.en: In plants, the {hypoderm} can strengthen the outer tissue.
e.zh: 在植物中，表皮下层可以增强外层组织。

e.en: Fluid collected in the {hypoderma} after the injury.
e.zh: 受伤后液体积聚在皮下层。

e.en: The leaf's {hypoderma} contains thick-walled support cells.
e.zh: 叶片的表皮下组织含有厚壁支持细胞。

e.en: The drug was delivered through a {hypodermal} injection.
e.zh: 这种药物通过皮下注射给入。

e.en: The cactus has {hypodermal} cells that store water.
e.zh: 仙人掌有储水的表皮下层细胞。

e.en: The nurse used {hypodermatoclysis} when veins were hard to access.
e.zh: 静脉难以穿刺时，护士采用了皮下输液法。

e.en: In palliative care, {hypodermatoclysis} can provide gentle hydration.
e.zh: 在姑息护理中，皮下输液法可以温和补液。

e.en: The medication was given {hypodermically} once a day.
e.zh: 这种药每天以皮下注射方式给药一次。

e.en: Some vaccines can be administered {hypodermically}.
e.zh: 有些疫苗可以通过皮下注射方式接种。

e.en: Fat cells are common in the {hypodermis}.
e.zh: 脂肪细胞常见于皮下组织中。

e.en: The plant {hypodermis} helps reduce water loss.
e.zh: 植物的下皮层有助于减少水分流失。

e.en: The hospice team chose {hypodermoclysis} for overnight fluids.
e.zh: 临终关怀团队选择皮下输液法来夜间补液。

e.en: {Hypodermoclysis} is useful when intravenous access is difficult.
e.zh: 当静脉通路困难时，皮下输液法很有用。

e.en: Cattle with {hypodermosis} may develop swellings along the back.
e.zh: 患皮下蝇蛆病的牛背部可能出现肿块。

e.en: Veterinarians treat {hypodermosis} before larvae damage the hide.
e.zh: 兽医会在幼虫损伤皮革前治疗皮下蝇蛆病。

e.en: The anatomist identified the {hypodesmus} near the joint.
e.zh: 解剖学家在关节附近辨认出下方韧带。

e.en: Damage to the {hypodesmus} reduced stability during movement.
e.zh: 下方韧带受损降低了运动时的稳定性。

hypodiploid.t: 亚二倍体的，染色体少于二倍体的

e.en: The tumor cells were {hypodiploid} in the chromosome analysis.
e.zh: 染色体分析显示肿瘤细胞为亚二倍体。

e.en: A {hypodiploid} cell has fewer chromosomes than the normal diploid number.
e.zh: 亚二倍体细胞的染色体数少于正常二倍体数。

e.en: The patient complained of {hypodynamia} after weeks in bed.
e.zh: 卧床数周后，患者抱怨体力减退。

e.en: The report linked prolonged inactivity with {hypodynamia}.
e.zh: 报告把长期缺乏活动与体力减退联系起来。

e.en: The patient remained {hypodynamic} after the operation.
e.zh: 手术后患者仍然处于低活力状态。

e.en: A {hypodynamic} circulation can reduce blood flow to organs.
e.zh: 低动力循环会减少流向器官的血流。

e.en: Neurological testing showed {hypodynia} in the left foot.
e.zh: 神经系统检查显示左脚痛觉减退。

e.en: Localized {hypodynia} may follow nerve injury.
e.zh: 局部痛觉减退可能出现在神经损伤之后。

hypoemotivity.t: 情感反应低下；情绪淡漠

e.en: The psychiatrist noted marked {hypoemotivity} during the interview.
e.zh: 精神科医生在访谈中注意到明显的情感反应低下。

e.en: His {hypoemotivity} made grief hard for others to read.
e.zh: 他的情绪淡漠让别人很难看出他的悲伤。

e.en: The disorder caused generalized {hypoendocrinism} in childhood.
e.zh: 这种疾病在儿童期导致了全身性内分泌功能低下。

e.en: Doctors suspected {hypoendocrinism} after several hormone levels fell.
e.zh: 多项激素水平下降后，医生怀疑是内分泌功能低下。

e.en: The blood test showed mild {hypoeosinophilia} after treatment.
e.zh: 治疗后血液检查显示轻度嗜酸性粒细胞减少。

e.en: Severe stress can sometimes produce transient {hypoeosinophilia}.
e.zh: 严重压力有时会造成一过性嗜酸性粒细胞减少。

e.en: The old report described fatigue with possible {hypoepinephria}.
e.zh: 那份旧报告描述了疲劳，并认为可能存在肾上腺素分泌不足。

e.en: Experimental {hypoepinephria} reduced the animals' stress response.
e.zh: 实验性肾上腺素分泌不足降低了动物的应激反应。

hypoeutectic.t: 亚共晶的；低于共晶成分的

e.en: A {hypoeutectic} alloy contains less solute than the eutectic composition.
e.zh: 亚共晶合金的溶质含量低于共晶成分。

e.en: The {hypoeutectic} silicon phase changed during slow cooling.
e.zh: 缓慢冷却过程中，亚共晶硅相发生了变化。

hypoeutectoid.t: 亚共析的；低于共析成分的

e.en: {Hypoeutectoid} steel contains less carbon than eutectoid steel.
e.zh: 亚共析钢的碳含量低于共析钢。

e.en: Ferrite forms first in a {hypoeutectoid} microstructure.
e.zh: 在亚共析显微组织中，铁素体会先形成。

e.en: Chronic bleeding may lead to {hypoferrism} before anemia appears.
e.zh: 慢性出血可能在贫血出现前先导致铁缺乏状态。

e.en: The clinician treated {hypoferrism} with dietary iron and supplements.
e.zh: 临床医生通过膳食铁和补充剂治疗低铁症。

e.en: Postpartum bleeding worsened because of {hypofibrinogenemia}.
e.zh: 由于低纤维蛋白原血症，产后出血加重了。

e.en: The lab confirmed {hypofibrinogenemia} before surgery began.
e.zh: 手术开始前，实验室确认了低纤维蛋白原血症。

e.en: Thyroid {hypofunction} can cause fatigue and weight gain.
e.zh: 甲状腺功能减退会引起疲劳和体重增加。

e.en: The scan suggested {hypofunction} in part of the gland.
e.zh: 扫描提示腺体某一部分功能低下。

e.en: The mother sought help for persistent {hypogalactia}.
e.zh: 这位母亲因持续乳汁分泌不足而寻求帮助。

e.en: Dehydration can contribute to temporary {hypogalactia} after delivery.
e.zh: 脱水可能导致产后一时性的乳汁分泌不足。

e.en: British clinicians diagnosed {hypogammaglobulinaemia} after repeated infections.
e.zh: 英国临床医生在反复感染后诊断为低丙种球蛋白血症。

e.en: Inherited {hypogammaglobulinaemia} can weaken antibody responses.
e.zh: 遗传性低丙种球蛋白血症会削弱抗体反应。

e.en: The child had {hypogammaglobulinemia} and frequent sinus infections.
e.zh: 这个孩子患有低丙种球蛋白血症，并经常发生鼻窦感染。

e.en: Treatment for {hypogammaglobulinemia} may include immunoglobulin replacement.
e.zh: 低丙种球蛋白血症的治疗可能包括免疫球蛋白替代疗法。

e.en: The study examined patterns of {hypogamy} in urban marriages.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了城市婚姻中的向下婚配模式。

e.en: Her family disapproved of the {hypogamy} implied by the match.
e.zh: 她的家人不赞成这门亲事所意味着的下嫁。

e.en: The patient reported sharp {hypogastralgia} after the meal.
e.zh: 患者报告饭后出现尖锐的下腹痛。

e.en: Recurrent {hypogastralgia} prompted further abdominal imaging.
e.zh: 反复的下腹痛促使医生安排了进一步腹部影像检查。

e.en: Tenderness was noted in both {hypogastria} during examination.
e.zh: 检查时发现两侧下腹部区域都有压痛。

e.en: The surgeon marked the {hypogastria} before making the incision.
e.zh: 外科医生在切口前标记了下腹部区域。

e.en: She felt a dull {hypogastric} pain all morning.
e.zh: 她整个上午都感到下腹部隐痛。

e.en: The {hypogastric} artery supplies blood to pelvic organs.
e.zh: 下腹动脉为盆腔器官供血。

e.en: The rash spread across the {hypogastrium} overnight.
e.zh: 皮疹一夜之间扩散到下腹部。

e.en: Pain in the {hypogastrium} may come from the bladder.
e.zh: 腹下区疼痛可能来自膀胱。

e.en: The archaeologists mapped the ancient {hypogea} beneath the site.
e.zh: 考古学家绘制了遗址下方古代地下结构的图。

e.en: Several {hypogea} served as burial chambers in the settlement.
e.zh: 该聚落中的几处地下结构曾用作墓室。

e.en: Peas show {hypogeal} germination, leaving the cotyledons below ground.
e.zh: 豌豆表现为子叶不出土萌发，子叶留在地下。

e.en: The cave held a rare {hypogeal} insect species.
e.zh: 这个洞穴里有一种罕见的地下昆虫。

e.en: The stone {hypogee} was hidden below the old chapel.
e.zh: 这座石砌地下墓室隐藏在旧礼拜堂下面。

e.en: Tourists entered the {hypogee} through a narrow stairway.
e.zh: 游客通过一条狭窄楼梯进入地下建筑。

e.en: The mine contained {hypogene} ore formed deep underground.
e.zh: 这座矿山含有在地下深处形成的深成矿石。

e.en: Geologists distinguished {hypogene} minerals from later surface alteration.
e.zh: 地质学家把深成矿物同后来的地表蚀变区分开来。

e.en: Renal {hypogenesis} was visible on the prenatal scan.
e.zh: 产前扫描显示肾脏发育不全。

e.en: The syndrome involves {hypogenesis} of several facial bones.
e.zh: 这种综合征涉及多块面骨发育不足。

hypogenetic.t: 发育不全的；深成成因的

e.en: The infant showed {hypogenetic} development of the jaw.
e.zh: 这个婴儿表现出颌骨发育不全。

e.en: The paper described a {hypogenetic} origin for the mineral veins.
e.zh: 论文描述了这些矿脉的深成成因。

hypogenitalism.t: 性腺功能低下；生殖器发育不全

e.en: Delayed puberty led doctors to investigate {hypogenitalism}.
e.zh: 青春期延迟使医生开始检查是否存在性腺功能低下。

e.en: The textbook linked {hypogenitalism} with reduced secondary sex characteristics.
e.zh: 教科书把生殖器发育不全与第二性征减弱联系起来。

hypointense.t: 影像上信号偏低的区域或组织

e.en: The scan showed a {hypointense} lesion in the liver.
e.zh: 扫描显示肝脏有一个低信号病灶。

e.en: On MRI, old blood may appear {hypointense}.
e.zh: 在核磁共振上，陈旧性出血可能呈低信号。

e.en: The chemist prepared a dilute {hypoiodite} solution.
e.zh: 化学家配制了一份稀的次碘酸盐溶液。

e.en: A {hypoiodite} ion contains iodine in a low oxidation state.
e.zh: 次碘酸根离子中的碘处于较低氧化态。

e.en: Severe {hypokalaemia} can cause muscle weakness.
e.zh: 严重低钾血症会导致肌肉无力。

e.en: The doctor checked for {hypokalaemia} after prolonged vomiting.
e.zh: 长期呕吐后，医生检查是否有低钾血症。

e.en: The blood test confirmed mild {hypokalemia}.
e.zh: 血液检查确认有轻度低钾血症。

e.en: Diuretics may increase the risk of {hypokalemia}.
e.zh: 利尿剂可能增加低钾血症的风险。

e.en: The neurologist noted {hypokinemia} during the examination.
e.zh: 神经科医生在检查中注意到运动减少。

e.en: Drug-induced {hypokinemia} can make daily tasks slower.
e.zh: 药物引起的活动力减退会让日常动作变慢。

e.en: Parkinson's disease often involves {hypokinesia}.
e.zh: 帕金森病常伴有运动减少。

e.en: Cardiac {hypokinesia} was visible on the ultrasound.
e.zh: 超声检查可见心肌运动减弱。

e.en: The echocardiogram showed regional {hypokinesis}.
e.zh: 超声心动图显示局部运动减弱。

e.en: Neurological {hypokinesis} may affect walking speed.
e.zh: 神经性活动不足可能影响行走速度。

hypokinetic.t: 运动减退的；活动不足的

e.en: The patient had a {hypokinetic} gait.
e.zh: 患者步态表现为运动减退。

e.en: A {hypokinetic} heart segment may pump poorly.
e.zh: 心脏中运动减弱的节段可能泵血不佳。

e.en: The philosopher used {hypokolasia} to describe insufficient punishment.
e.zh: 这位哲学家用hypokolasia来描述惩罚不足。

e.en: In that old theory, {hypokolasia} weakened social discipline.
e.zh: 在那套旧理论中，处罚不够会削弱社会纪律。

e.en: The report listed {hypoleukia} among the blood abnormalities.
e.zh: 报告把白细胞减少列为血液异常之一。

e.en: Persistent {hypoleukia} may require further testing.
e.zh: 持续的白细胞减少可能需要进一步检查。

e.en: The specialist suspected {hypoleydigism} after the hormone tests.
e.zh: 激素检查后，专科医生怀疑莱迪希细胞功能低下。

e.en: Congenital {hypoleydigism} can affect testosterone production.
e.zh: 先天性莱迪希细胞功能低下会影响睾酮生成。

hypolimnile.t: 湖下层水的；属湖底温层的

e.en: The researchers measured {hypolimnile} oxygen levels in August.
e.zh: 研究人员在八月测量了湖下层水的含氧量。

e.en: Cold {hypolimnile} water supported different organisms.
e.zh: 寒冷的湖下层水养育了不同的生物。

e.en: The {hypolimnion} remained cold through the summer.
e.zh: 整个夏季，湖泊下层水仍保持寒冷。

e.en: Low oxygen in the {hypolimnion} can stress fish.
e.zh: 湖底温层含氧量低会让鱼类承受压力。

e.en: The laboratory result suggested {hypolipaemia}.
e.zh: 实验室结果提示有低脂血症。

e.en: Severe malnutrition may lead to {hypolipaemia}.
e.zh: 严重营养不良可能导致血脂过低。

e.en: Doctors rarely diagnose {hypolipemia} without repeated tests.
e.zh: 医生通常不会只凭一次检查就诊断低脂血症。

e.en: Genetic disorders can sometimes cause {hypolipemia}.
e.zh: 遗传性疾病有时会引起血脂过低。

hypolithic.t: 石下生长的；石下生态的

e.en: The desert stones sheltered {hypolithic} microbes.
e.zh: 沙漠石块下面庇护着石下生长的微生物。

e.en: A {hypolithic} community can survive intense sunlight.
e.zh: 石下生态群落能在强烈阳光环境中生存。

hypolutemia.t: 黄体功能不足；黄体酮偏低

e.en: The clinician considered {hypolutemia} in the fertility workup.
e.zh: 临床医生在生育力评估中考虑了黄体功能不足。

e.en: Possible {hypolutemia} was followed by progesterone testing.
e.zh: 怀疑黄体酮偏低后，医生进行了孕酮检测。

e.en: The old paper described {hypolymphemia} after severe dehydration.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文描述了严重脱水后的淋巴液减少。

e.en: Clinicians no longer use {hypolymphemia} very often.
e.zh: 临床医生现在已经很少使用淋巴不足这个术语。

e.en: Untreated {hypomagnesaemia} may trigger abnormal heart rhythms.
e.zh: 未经治疗的低镁血症可能引发心律异常。

e.en: Alcohol misuse can contribute to {hypomagnesaemia}.
e.zh: 酒精滥用可能导致低镁血症。

e.en: The patient received supplements for {hypomagnesemia}.
e.zh: 患者因低镁血症接受了补充治疗。

e.en: Chronic diarrhea can cause {hypomagnesemia}.
e.zh: 慢性腹泻可能造成低镁血症。

hypomastia.t: 乳房发育不全；乳房过小

e.en: The diagnosis was congenital {hypomastia}.
e.zh: 诊断结果为先天性乳房发育不全。

e.en: Some patients seek reconstruction for {hypomastia}.
e.zh: 一些患者会因乳房过小寻求重建手术。

hypomelancholia.t: 轻度忧郁；轻性抑郁状态

e.en: The nineteenth-century doctor called her sadness {hypomelancholia}.
e.zh: 那位十九世纪医生把她的悲伤称为轻度忧郁。

e.en: In older psychiatric writing, {hypomelancholia} meant a milder depression.
e.zh: 在较早的精神病学文献中，hypomelancholia指较轻的抑郁状态。

e.en: She consulted a doctor about {hypomenorrhea}.
e.zh: 她因月经过少去咨询医生。

e.en: Stress and weight loss may contribute to {hypomenorrhea}.
e.zh: 压力和体重下降可能导致月经过少。

e.en: The embryology text labeled the lower segment a {hypomere}.
e.zh: 胚胎学教材把下部节段标为hypomere。

e.en: A {hypomere} forms part of the developing body wall.
e.zh: 下体节构成发育中体壁的一部分。

hypometamorphism.t: 低度变质作用；浅变质作用

e.en: The slate formed under {hypometamorphism}.
e.zh: 这块板岩是在低度变质作用下形成的。

e.en: Geologists identified {hypometamorphism} in the altered sediments.
e.zh: 地质学家在变质沉积物中识别出浅变质作用。

hypophosphatasia.t: 低磷酸酶症；低磷酸酶病

e.en: The infant was diagnosed with {hypophosphatasia} after repeated fractures.
e.zh: 这个婴儿多次骨折后被诊断为低磷酸酶症。

e.en: Adult {hypophosphatasia} can cause chronic bone pain.
e.zh: 成人低磷酸酶症可能导致长期骨痛。

e.en: The chemist added {hypophosphate} to the solution.
e.zh: 化学家向溶液中加入了次磷酸盐。

e.en: A blood test showed {hypophosphate} levels after treatment.
e.zh: 治疗后血液检测显示磷酸盐水平偏低。

e.en: Sodium {hypophosphite} is used in some plating processes.
e.zh: 次磷酸钠用于某些电镀工艺。

e.en: The label listed {hypophosphite} as a reducing agent.
e.zh: 标签上把次磷酸盐列为还原剂。

e.en: The paper described the structure of {hypophosphoric} acid.
e.zh: 论文描述了连二磷酸的结构。

e.en: They prepared a {hypophosphoric} compound in the laboratory.
e.zh: 他们在实验室制备了一种连二磷酸化合物。

e.en: The reaction produced {hypophosphorous} acid as a byproduct.
e.zh: 该反应产生了次磷酸作为副产物。

e.en: Handle {hypophosphorous} solutions with proper protective equipment.
e.zh: 处理次磷酸溶液时要使用合适的防护装备。

e.en: The neurologist noted {hypophrasia} during the examination.
e.zh: 神经科医生在检查中注意到患者言语减少。

e.en: Severe fatigue sometimes led to brief {hypophrasia}.
e.zh: 严重疲劳有时会导致短暂的表达不足。

e.en: Older case notes used {hypophrenia} for intellectual impairment.
e.zh: 较早的病历用低智来指智力受损。

e.en: The term {hypophrenia} is now rarely used in clinics.
e.zh: 低智这一术语现在在临床上已很少使用。

hypophyge.t: 柱脚凹槽；建筑退缩曲线

e.en: The restorer cleaned the {hypophyge} beneath the column.
e.zh: 修复人员清理了柱子下方的柱脚凹槽。

e.en: A shallow {hypophyge} softened the base of the pillar.
e.zh: 一道浅浅的退缩曲线让柱基显得更柔和。

e.en: Tiny spores covered the {hypophyll} of the fern.
e.zh: 细小孢子覆盖在蕨类植物的叶背上。

e.en: The insect eggs were hidden on the {hypophyll}.
e.zh: 昆虫卵藏在叶子的下表面。

hypophyllanthin.t: 叶下珠苦素；叶下珠成分

e.en: Researchers measured {hypophyllanthin} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了植物提取物中的叶下珠苦素含量。

e.en: The supplement claimed to contain {hypophyllanthin}.
e.zh: 这种补充剂声称含有叶下珠成分。

e.en: The botanist found {hypophyllous} spores on the specimen.
e.zh: 植物学家在标本上发现了生于叶背的孢子。

e.en: Some fungi form {hypophyllous} patches on leaves.
e.zh: 有些真菌会在叶下形成斑块。

e.en: The scan showed a small {hypophyseal} lesion.
e.zh: 扫描显示有一个小的垂体病灶。

e.en: Doctors monitored her {hypophyseal} hormone levels closely.
e.zh: 医生密切监测她的垂体激素水平。

e.en: The researchers planned to {hypophysectomize} the laboratory rats.
e.zh: 研究人员计划切除实验鼠的垂体。

e.en: Surgeons rarely {hypophysectomize} patients except in special cases.
e.zh: 外科医生很少切除患者垂体，除非情况特殊。

e.en: The patient recovered slowly after {hypophysectomy}.
e.zh: 患者在垂体切除术后恢复较慢。

e.en: Animal studies sometimes use {hypophysectomy} to test hormone effects.
e.zh: 动物研究有时用垂体切除术来测试激素作用。

e.en: The tumor affected the {hypophysial} region of the brain.
e.zh: 肿瘤影响了大脑的垂体区域。

e.en: They studied {hypophysial} control of growth hormones.
e.zh: 他们研究了垂体对生长激素的调控。

e.en: The hypothalamus releases {hypophysiotrophic} hormones into nearby vessels.
e.zh: 下丘脑向附近血管释放促垂体激素。

e.en: A {hypophysiotrophic} signal can alter pituitary secretion.
e.zh: 一种调节垂体的信号会改变垂体分泌。

e.en: The {hypophysis} helps regulate several endocrine glands.
e.zh: 垂体有助于调节多个内分泌腺。

e.en: An MRI revealed swelling of the {hypophysis}.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示脑下垂体肿胀。

e.en: The headache was linked to autoimmune {hypophysitis}.
e.zh: 这种头痛与自身免疫性垂体炎有关。

e.en: Doctors treated the {hypophysitis} with steroids.
e.zh: 医生用类固醇治疗垂体炎。

e.en: The study compared normal and {hypophysoprivus} animals.
e.zh: 该研究比较了正常动物和无垂体动物。

e.en: A {hypophysoprivus} state changes many hormone levels.
e.zh: 垂体缺失状态会改变许多激素水平。

e.en: The nurse recorded {hypopiesia} after the patient fainted.
e.zh: 患者昏倒后，护士记录到低血压。

e.en: Chronic {hypopiesia} can cause dizziness when standing.
e.zh: 慢性低血压会在站立时引起头晕。

e.en: Dehydration may lead to {hypopiesis} in older adults.
e.zh: 脱水可能导致老年人低血压。

e.en: The chart listed {hypopiesis} as a possible side effect.
e.zh: 病历表把低血压列为一种可能的副作用。

hypopigmentations.t: 色素减退斑；低色素沉着

e.en: The dermatologist examined several {hypopigmentations} on her arm.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生检查了她手臂上的几处色素减退斑。

e.en: Postinflammatory {hypopigmentations} may fade over time.
e.zh: 炎症后的低色素沉着可能会随时间变淡。

hypopistephanine.t: 海帕斯特法宁；植物生物碱

e.en: The analysis detected {hypopistephanine} in the root sample.
e.zh: 分析在根部样本中检测到海帕斯特法宁。

e.en: Few clinical studies have examined {hypopistephanine}.
e.zh: 很少有临床研究考察这种植物生物碱。

e.en: Radiation therapy can sometimes cause {hypopituitarism}.
e.zh: 放射治疗有时会导致垂体功能减退症。

e.en: She takes hormones to manage {hypopituitarism}.
e.zh: 她服用激素来控制垂体功能减退症。

e.en: The child showed {hypopituitary} growth patterns.
e.zh: 这个孩子表现出垂体功能低下相关的生长模式。

e.en: Blood tests supported a {hypopituitary} diagnosis.
e.zh: 血液检测支持垂体功能低下的诊断。

hypometria.t: 运动幅度不足；动作过小

e.en: The neurologist noticed {hypometria} during the finger-to-nose test.
e.zh: 神经科医生在指鼻试验中注意到患者动作幅度不足。

e.en: Her reaching movements showed mild {hypometria} after the stroke.
e.zh: 中风后，她伸手取物的动作表现出轻度幅度不足。

e.en: The filter can trap {hypomicron} particles in the air.
e.zh: 这种过滤器能截留空气中小于一微米的颗粒。

e.en: Researchers measured {hypomicron} dust with specialized instruments.
e.zh: 研究人员用专门仪器测量小于一微米的粉尘。

e.en: The patient reported {hypomnesia} after the head injury.
e.zh: 患者称头部受伤后出现记忆力减退。

e.en: Severe stress can sometimes cause temporary {hypomnesia}.
e.zh: 严重压力有时会导致暂时性的记忆减退。

e.en: The examination suggested {hypomnesis} rather than complete amnesia.
e.zh: 检查结果提示是回忆能力不足，而不是完全失忆。

e.en: Clinicians documented {hypomnesis} in the elderly patient's chart.
e.zh: 临床医生在这位老年患者的病历中记录了记忆减退。

e.en: Intestinal {hypomotility} can lead to severe constipation.
e.zh: 肠道蠕动低下可能导致严重便秘。

e.en: The scan showed gastric {hypomotility} after surgery.
e.zh: 扫描显示手术后胃部运动减弱。

e.en: The leaf showed a {hyponastic} curve as its lower surface grew faster.
e.zh: 由于下表面生长更快，叶片呈现偏下性弯曲。

e.en: Botanists described the petiole as {hyponastic} under flooded conditions.
e.zh: 植物学家描述叶柄在淹水条件下出现偏下性生长。

e.en: Flooding can trigger {hyponasty} in some plant leaves.
e.zh: 淹水会触发某些植物叶片的偏下性生长。

e.en: The experiment measured {hyponasty} after ethylene exposure.
e.zh: 实验测量了乙烯处理后的偏下性生长。

e.en: Severe {hyponatremia} can cause confusion and seizures.
e.zh: 严重低钠血症会引起意识混乱和癫痫发作。

e.en: The marathon runner was treated for {hyponatremia} after drinking too much water.
e.zh: 这名马拉松选手因饮水过多而接受低钠血症治疗。

e.en: Larvae in the {hyponeuston} live just below the water surface.
e.zh: 水表下层生物群中的幼虫生活在水面正下方。

e.en: The study compared the {hyponeuston} with organisms floating above the surface film.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了水表下层生物群和漂浮在表面膜上方的生物。

e.en: The chemist isolated a stable {hyponitrite} from the reaction mixture.
e.zh: 化学家从反应混合物中分离出一种稳定的连二亚硝酸盐。

e.en: A metal {hyponitrite} may decompose when heated.
e.zh: 金属连二亚硝酸盐受热时可能分解。

e.en: The paper discussed {hyponitrous} acid and its salts.
e.zh: 论文讨论了连二亚硝酸及其盐类。

e.en: They prepared a {hyponitrous} compound under cold conditions.
e.zh: 他们在低温条件下制备了一种连二亚硝酸化合物。

e.en: The critic searched for {hyponoia} beneath the poem's simple surface.
e.zh: 评论家在这首诗朴素的表面之下寻找潜在含义。

e.en: Ancient commentators often treated myth as {hyponoia}.
e.zh: 古代注释者常把神话看作隐含意义。

e.en: In linguistics, {hyponymy} links 'rose' to 'flower'.
e.zh: 在语言学中，下义关系把“玫瑰”和“花”联系起来。

e.en: The dictionary project marked cases of {hyponymy} between related terms.
e.zh: 这个词典项目标出了相关词之间的词义从属关系。

e.en: The diagnosis included {hypoorchidia} and delayed puberty.
e.zh: 诊断包括睾丸发育不全和青春期延迟。

e.en: Doctors evaluated the boy for possible {hypoorchidia}.
e.zh: 医生评估这个男孩是否可能有睾丸发育不全。

e.en: Chronic {hypoparathyroidism} can lower calcium levels in the blood.
e.zh: 慢性甲状旁腺功能减退症会降低血钙水平。

e.en: She developed {hypoparathyroidism} after thyroid surgery.
e.zh: 她在甲状腺手术后出现了甲状旁腺功能减退症。

e.en: The hand X-ray revealed {hypophalangism} in two fingers.
e.zh: 手部X光片显示两根手指的指骨节数减少。

e.en: Congenital {hypophalangism} may affect both hands and feet.
e.zh: 先天性指趾骨节数减少可能影响手和脚。

e.en: The surgeon used a {hypopharyngoscope} to inspect the lower throat.
e.zh: 外科医生使用下咽镜检查咽喉下部。

e.en: A flexible {hypopharyngoscope} helped locate the obstruction.
e.zh: 一根柔性下咽镜帮助定位了阻塞部位。

e.en: The patient underwent {hypopharyngoscopy} before the biopsy.
e.zh: 患者在活检前接受了下咽镜检查。

e.en: Rigid {hypopharyngoscopy} revealed swelling near the larynx.
e.zh: 硬式下咽镜检查显示喉部附近有肿胀。

e.en: Cancer of the {hypopharynx} may affect swallowing.
e.zh: 下咽部癌可能影响吞咽。

e.en: The scope passed into the {hypopharynx} for a closer view.
e.zh: 内镜进入下咽部以便更仔细观察。

e.en: After the seizure, the patient was briefly {hypophasic}.
e.zh: 癫痫发作后，患者短时间内言语减少。

e.en: The report described a {hypophasic} state with slow responses.
e.zh: 报告描述了一种少语且反应迟缓的状态。

e.en: The fungus was described as {hypophloedes} because it grew under bark.
e.zh: 这种真菌因生长在树皮下而被描述为树皮下生长的。

e.en: Collectors found {hypophloedes} lichens on fallen branches.
e.zh: 采集者在倒落的树枝上发现了树皮下生长的地衣。

e.en: The beetle larvae occupy a {hypophloeodal} habitat beneath loose bark.
e.zh: 甲虫幼虫栖息在松动树皮下的环境中。

e.en: A {hypophloeodal} species can be difficult to spot from outside the trunk.
e.zh: 树皮下生的物种从树干外部很难发现。

e.en: The analysis treated the variant sound as a {hypophoneme}.
e.zh: 该分析把这个变体音看作次音位。

e.en: A {hypophoneme} may represent a smaller contrast within a phonemic system.
e.zh: 次音位可以表示音位系统内部较小的区别。

e.en: Parkinson's disease often causes {hypophonia} in later stages.
e.zh: 帕金森病在后期常会导致声音低弱。

e.en: Speech therapy helped reduce her {hypophonia}.
e.zh: 言语治疗帮助减轻了她的发声减弱。

e.en: The eye exam detected mild {hypophoria} in the left eye.
e.zh: 眼科检查发现左眼有轻度隐性下斜视。

e.en: Prism lenses can sometimes relieve symptoms of {hypophoria}.
e.zh: 棱镜镜片有时能缓解隐性下斜视的症状。

hypoplastic.t: 发育不全的；形成不足的

e.en: The scan showed a {hypoplastic} left kidney.
e.zh: 扫描显示他的左肾发育不全。

e.en: Doctors noted {hypoplastic} enamel on several teeth.
e.zh: 医生注意到几颗牙的牙釉质形成不足。

hypopleura.t: 下侧胸膜；昆虫侧板下部

e.en: The entomologist examined the {hypopleura} under magnification.
e.zh: 昆虫学家在放大镜下检查侧板下部。

e.en: Damage near the {hypopleura} helped identify the specimen.
e.zh: 下侧胸膜附近的损伤帮助鉴定了这个标本。

e.en: The lab found a {hypoploid} cell line in culture.
e.zh: 实验室在培养物中发现了染色体数偏少的细胞系。

e.en: A {hypoploid} embryo may fail to develop normally.
e.zh: 染色体数少于正常的胚胎可能无法正常发育。

e.en: The report linked {hypoploidy} to early cell division errors.
e.zh: 报告把染色体数低于正常与早期细胞分裂错误联系起来。

e.en: Severe {hypoploidy} can make the tumor genetically unstable.
e.zh: 严重的低倍性会使肿瘤的遗传状态不稳定。

hypopraxia.t: 动作能力减退；活动减弱

e.en: The neurologist described the patient's slowness as {hypopraxia}.
e.zh: 神经科医生把患者动作迟缓描述为动作能力减退。

e.en: Postoperative {hypopraxia} limited her hand movements.
e.zh: 术后活动减弱限制了她的手部动作。

e.en: Chronic malnutrition can lead to {hypoproteinosis}.
e.zh: 长期营养不良可能导致低蛋白血症。

e.en: The veterinarian treated the calf for {hypoproteinosis}.
e.zh: 兽医给这头小牛治疗蛋白不足。

e.en: The patient reported {hypopselaphesia} in both fingertips.
e.zh: 患者说双手指尖触觉减退。

e.en: Peripheral nerve damage may cause {hypopselaphesia}.
e.zh: 周围神经损伤可能造成触感迟钝。

hypopsychosis.t: 精神活动减退；意识迟钝

e.en: The old textbook used {hypopsychosis} for reduced mental activity.
e.zh: 那本旧教材用这个词表示精神活动减退。

e.en: Severe exhaustion produced a state of {hypopsychosis}.
e.zh: 极度疲劳造成了一种意识迟钝的状态。

e.en: The medication caused {hypoptyalism} and constant thirst.
e.zh: 这种药导致唾液分泌减少和持续口渴。

e.en: Dentists often ask about {hypoptyalism} before treatment.
e.zh: 牙医治疗前常会询问是否有口干问题。

e.en: The mite survives winter as a {hypopus}.
e.zh: 这种螨以休眠若虫阶段越冬。

e.en: A {hypopus} can attach itself to passing insects.
e.zh: 螨的休眠若虫可以附着在经过的昆虫身上。

hypopyon.t: 前房积脓；眼内脓液沉积

e.en: The ophthalmologist diagnosed {hypopyon} after examining the eye.
e.zh: 眼科医生检查眼睛后诊断为前房积脓。

e.en: A visible {hypopyon} suggests serious eye inflammation.
e.zh: 可见的眼内脓液沉积提示眼部炎症严重。

e.en: The chorus performed a lively {hyporchema} for Apollo.
e.zh: 合唱队为阿波罗表演了一首活泼的古希腊舞歌。

e.en: Scholars debate how a {hyporchema} was staged.
e.zh: 学者们争论这种古希腊合唱舞歌当时如何演出。

e.en: Radiation therapy can cause severe {hyposalivation}.
e.zh: 放射治疗可能引起严重的唾液分泌不足。

e.en: Patients with {hyposalivation} often need saliva substitutes.
e.zh: 口干症患者常常需要使用人工唾液替代品。

e.en: Older physicians used {hyposarca} to describe generalized swelling.
e.zh: 旧时医生用这个词描述全身水肿。

e.en: The diary mentioned {hyposarca} after weeks of illness.
e.zh: 日记提到病了几周后出现皮下积液。

hyposcheotomy.t: 阴囊切开术；古代放血术

e.en: The manuscript described {hyposcheotomy} as a surgical procedure.
e.zh: 手稿把阴囊切开术描述为一种外科操作。

e.en: Modern medicine no longer uses {hyposcheotomy} for dropsy.
e.zh: 现代医学不再用这种古代放血术治疗水肿。

hyposcope.t: 低位观察镜；向下窥视镜

e.en: The engineer adjusted the {hyposcope} for a lower viewing angle.
e.zh: 工程师调整低位观察镜以获得更低的视角。

e.en: A {hyposcope} let the operator inspect the underside safely.
e.zh: 向下窥视镜让操作员能安全检查底面。

e.en: Thyroid {hyposecretion} can slow the body's metabolism.
e.zh: 甲状腺分泌不足会使身体代谢变慢。

e.en: The doctor suspected gastric {hyposecretion} after the test.
e.zh: 检查后医生怀疑胃液分泌减少。

hyposensitive.t: 敏感度低的；感觉迟钝的

e.en: Some children are {hyposensitive} to loud sounds.
e.zh: 有些孩子对很大的声音敏感度较低。

e.en: The injured skin remained {hyposensitive} for months.
e.zh: 受伤的皮肤有好几个月都感觉迟钝。

e.en: The therapist assessed his tactile {hyposensitivity}.
e.zh: 治疗师评估了他的触觉敏感度降低。

e.en: Drug tolerance may produce {hyposensitivity} to the same dose.
e.zh: 药物耐受可能使人对同一剂量反应变弱。

e.en: Allergy {hyposensitization} requires repeated controlled exposure.
e.zh: 过敏减敏治疗需要反复进行受控接触。

e.en: Long exposure caused {hyposensitization} to the stimulus.
e.zh: 长期接触导致对这种刺激的敏感性降低。

e.en: Doctors may {hyposensitize} patients to specific allergens.
e.zh: 医生可能会让患者对特定过敏原逐步减敏。

e.en: Repeated exposure can {hyposensitize} the nerve response.
e.zh: 反复接触可以降低神经反应的敏感性。

hyposensitized.t: 已减敏的；敏感性降低的

e.en: The {hyposensitized} patient tolerated the pollen extract well.
e.zh: 经过减敏的患者很好地耐受了花粉提取物。

e.en: The tissue became {hyposensitized} after constant stimulation.
e.zh: 组织在持续刺激后敏感性降低。

e.en: She began a {hyposensitizing} treatment for bee venom.
e.zh: 她开始接受针对蜂毒的减敏治疗。

e.en: The drug had a {hyposensitizing} effect on pain receptors.
e.zh: 这种药对痛觉受体有降低敏感性的作用。

hyposkeocytosis.t: 白细胞减少；细胞数偏低

e.en: The rare report listed {hyposkeocytosis} among blood abnormalities.
e.zh: 那份罕见报告把白细胞减少列为血液异常之一。

e.en: Severe infection was considered despite apparent {hyposkeocytosis}.
e.zh: 尽管看似细胞数偏低，医生仍考虑严重感染。

e.en: After the infection, she noticed persistent {hyposmia}.
e.zh: 感染之后，她注意到嗅觉持续减退。

e.en: Neurologists sometimes test {hyposmia} in early Parkinson's disease.
e.zh: 神经科医生有时会检测早期帕金森病中的嗅觉低下。

e.en: Severe {hyposodemia} can cause confusion and seizures.
e.zh: 严重的低钠血症会导致意识混乱和癫痫发作。

e.en: The doctor monitored her {hyposodemia} during treatment.
e.zh: 医生在治疗期间监测她的血钠过低情况。

e.en: The surgeon examined the {hypospadiac} opening carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了尿道下裂的开口。

e.en: A {hypospadiac} child may need specialist care.
e.zh: 尿道下裂的儿童可能需要专科护理。

e.en: The baby was born with {hypospadias}.
e.zh: 这个婴儿出生时患有尿道下裂。

e.en: Mild {hypospadias} may be repaired with surgery.
e.zh: 轻度尿道下裂可以通过手术修复。

e.en: The mineral formed a small {hyposphene} crystal.
e.zh: 这种矿物形成了一枚小的低斜楔形晶体。

e.en: She described the specimen as {hyposphene} in shape.
e.zh: 她把这个标本描述为低斜楔形。

e.en: The nurse used a {hypospray} to deliver the dose.
e.zh: 护士用无针注射喷雾器给药。

e.en: In science fiction, a {hypospray} replaces the needle.
e.zh: 在科幻作品中，无针注射喷雾器取代了针头。

e.en: The theologian discussed the three {hypostases}.
e.zh: 这位神学家讨论了三个神圣位格。

e.en: Philosophers sometimes treat abstractions as {hypostases}.
e.zh: 哲学家有时把抽象概念当作实体。

e.en: Writers often {hypostasize} society as a single actor.
e.zh: 作家常把社会实体化为一个单一行动者。

e.en: The argument tends to {hypostasize} desire itself.
e.zh: 这个论证往往把欲望本身实体化。

e.en: The essay {hypostasizes} culture as a living force.
e.zh: 这篇文章把文化实体化为一种有生命的力量。

e.en: His theory {hypostasizes} the market too readily.
e.zh: 他的理论过于轻易地把市场实体化。

e.en: The doctrine uses {hypostatical} language about Christ.
e.zh: 这项教义用位格化语言谈论基督。

e.en: Her analysis rejects such {hypostatical} categories.
e.zh: 她的分析拒绝这类实体化范畴。

e.en: The text speaks {hypostatically} of divine wisdom.
e.zh: 文本以位格化方式谈论神圣智慧。

e.en: He treats the nation {hypostatically} in the lecture.
e.zh: 他在讲座中把国家当作实体来谈。

e.en: Some critics {hypostatise} tradition as an authority.
e.zh: 一些批评者把传统实体化为一种权威。

e.en: We should not {hypostatise} every social label.
e.zh: 我们不应把每个社会标签都实体化。

e.en: The paper criticizes the {hypostatization} of race.
e.zh: 论文批评了对种族概念的实体化。

e.en: In theology, {hypostatization} has a technical meaning.
e.zh: 在神学中，位格化有专门含义。

e.en: Do not {hypostatize} the economy as a person.
e.zh: 不要把经济实体化成一个人。

e.en: The poet seems to {hypostatize} grief itself.
e.zh: 诗人似乎把悲伤本身实体化了。

e.en: Justice is {hypostatized} as a stern figure.
e.zh: 正义被实体化为一个严厉的人物。

e.en: The {hypostatized} concept dominated the debate.
e.zh: 这个被实体化的概念主导了辩论。

e.en: The article {hypostatizes} history as destiny.
e.zh: 这篇文章把历史实体化为命运。

e.en: He {hypostatizes} language into an independent power.
e.zh: 他把语言实体化为一种独立力量。

e.en: She warned against {hypostatizing} mental illness.
e.zh: 她警告不要把精神疾病概念实体化。

e.en: His {hypostatizing} style makes abstractions feel alive.
e.zh: 他的实体化写法让抽象概念显得有生命。

e.en: The map was drawn by {hypostereography}.
e.zh: 这幅地图是用下部立体投影法绘制的。

e.en: Few students had heard of {hypostereography}.
e.zh: 很少有学生听说过下部立体投影法。

e.en: The illness left him with marked {hyposthenia}.
e.zh: 这场病使他明显体力衰弱。

e.en: Chronic {hyposthenia} may require further investigation.
e.zh: 长期乏力可能需要进一步检查。

e.en: The patient appeared pale and {hyposthenic}.
e.zh: 病人脸色苍白，显得体力衰弱。

e.en: Doctors once described this as a {hyposthenic} constitution.
e.zh: 医生过去把这称为虚弱型体质。

e.en: Persistent {hyposthenuria} suggested impaired kidney function.
e.zh: 持续尿比重过低提示肾功能受损。

e.en: The laboratory reported {hyposthenuria} in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室报告该样本存在尿比重过低。

e.en: The film had a {hypostoichiometric} oxygen content.
e.zh: 这层薄膜的含氧量低于化学计量比。

e.en: Researchers prepared a {hypostoichiometric} oxide sample.
e.zh: 研究人员制备了一个低于化学计量比的氧化物样品。

e.en: The fossil preserved a clear {hypostoma}.
e.zh: 这块化石保存了清晰的下口板。

e.en: A tick uses its {hypostoma} to anchor in skin.
e.zh: 蜱用口下结构固定在皮肤中。

e.en: The leaf is {hypostomatous}, with pores below.
e.zh: 这片叶子是下表面有气孔的类型。

e.en: Many floating leaves are not {hypostomatous}.
e.zh: 许多漂浮叶并不是气孔只在下表面的。

e.en: The shell's {hypostracum} showed a pearly surface.
e.zh: 贝壳的内层呈现珍珠般的表面。

e.en: Damage reached the {hypostracum} beneath the outer layer.
e.zh: 损伤到达了外层下面的贝壳内层。

e.en: Tourists entered the ancient {hypostyle} hall.
e.zh: 游客进入了古老的多柱式大厅。

e.en: The temple has a grand {hypostyle} design.
e.zh: 这座神庙采用宏伟的多柱式设计。

hyposulfite.t: 连二亚硫酸盐；次硫酸盐

e.en: The old formula called for {hyposulfite} as a reducing agent.
e.zh: 这个旧配方需要用连二亚硫酸盐作还原剂。

e.en: Photographers once used sodium {hyposulfite} to fix images.
e.zh: 摄影师过去曾用连二亚硫酸钠来定影。

hyposulfurous.t: 连二亚硫酸的；次硫酸的

e.en: The chemist described a {hyposulfurous} acid derivative.
e.zh: 化学家描述了一种连二亚硫酸衍生物。

e.en: The paper used the older term {hyposulfurous} for the compound.
e.zh: 论文用较旧的术语“次硫酸的”来称呼该化合物。

hyposulphite.t: 连二亚硫酸盐；次硫酸盐

e.en: The British text spells the reagent as {hyposulphite}.
e.zh: 这本英国教材把该试剂拼作连二亚硫酸盐。

e.en: A small amount of {hyposulphite} remained in the solution.
e.zh: 溶液中还残留了少量连二亚硫酸盐。

hyposulphurous.t: 连二亚硫酸的；次硫酸的

e.en: The lecture mentioned {hyposulphurous} acid only briefly.
e.zh: 讲座只简略提到了连二亚硫酸。

e.en: Older British sources may use {hyposulphurous} instead of hyposulfurous.
e.zh: 较旧的英国资料可能用hyposulphurous来表示连二亚硫酸的。

e.en: Severe fatigue can be a sign of {hyposuprarenalism}.
e.zh: 严重疲劳可能是肾上腺功能减退症的征兆。

e.en: The physician considered {hyposuprarenalism} after reviewing the hormone tests.
e.zh: 医生查看激素检查后考虑为肾上腺功能减退症。

e.en: The motor entered a {hyposynchronous} operating range under heavy load.
e.zh: 电机在重负载下进入了低于同步的运行区间。

e.en: Engineers measured a {hyposynchronous} vibration in the rotating shaft.
e.zh: 工程师测到了转轴中的亚同步振动。

hyposynergia.t: 协同运动减弱；协同障碍

e.en: The neurologist noted mild {hyposynergia} during the coordination test.
e.zh: 神经科医生在协调测试中发现轻度协同运动减弱。

e.en: Cerebellar disease may cause {hyposynergia} in the patient's gait.
e.zh: 小脑疾病可能导致患者步态出现协同障碍。

hypotactic.t: 从属结构的；主从句式的

e.en: Her prose became more {hypotactic} in the later chapters.
e.zh: 她在后几章的行文变得更偏主从句式。

e.en: The teacher contrasted {hypotactic} sentences with short coordinate clauses.
e.zh: 老师把从属结构的句子和短并列分句作了对比。

e.en: The study measured {hypotaurine} levels in reproductive tissue.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了生殖组织中的亚牛磺酸水平。

e.en: Cells can convert {hypotaurine} into taurine under certain conditions.
e.zh: 细胞在某些条件下可将亚牛磺酸转化为牛磺酸。
